The young man let's Jim know that the girl Jim accidentally shot was his girlfriend, and despite his plea of "being even" with Jim, Jim kills him with the revolver.
Jim takes the robber's semiautomatic, but again finds that the gun has been emptied while shooting.
Without any further bullets for his revolver, Jim tracks the father and calls him out.
The father captures Jim, forcing him to take him to the money at gunpoint.
The father taunts Jim about his daughter's death and his divorce, and threatens to kill Jim's son after he gets the money from Jim.
Jim responds by telling the father that he killed his son.
The father goes into a fit of rage.
As he goes to shoot Jim, Jim spits up blood into his face, and uses the distraction to tackle the man and push them both off a steep hill.
The fall leaves the father incapacitated, having broken an arm and a leg.
Barely alive, Jim gets up and starts walking, but he has been severely wounded from the combination of the fall and blood loss after being shot two days earlier.
Jim accepts his fate, and lies peacefully on the ground.
A heavy snow starts to fall, which will bury both men.
The next day, the manager at the logging site finds Jim's note at the office and drives to town, leaving it at the restaurant where Debbie works.

When Debbie starts reading and sees that Jim sketched a map for her to find the cave where the money bag is hidden (together with the line "this is for you and for your kids") she apparently believes it to be a prank or otherwise worthless, so she rips it in half and throws it away.
Seconds later, she comes back and recovers it from the trash can.

52056718.title: Globetrotter's Journey to Heartbreak
synopsis: Elizabeth Johnson, a meticulously thorough and unprecedentedly diligent travel coordinator, pours every ounce of her energy into her job at Globetrotters, a premium international travel agency.

Her smooth-sailing life is violently upheaved when Michael, her reliable partner of five years since their chance meeting at Columbia University, terminates their romantic relationship without warning.
Amidst her personal turmoil, an intriguing envelope, inscribed with her name in beautiful calligraphy, appears on her doorstep.
The herald of change contains a formidable assignment for Elizabeth to boost the tourism industry of Bangkok, Thailand.
Managing her emotional turmoil, she perceives this intimidating mission as an ideal distraction to mend her bruised heart, along with being an opportunity to start afresh.
She travels to Bangkok, and is immediately swept away by the striking colors of Thai culture, the warmth of the locals, and the breathtaking landscapes.
She gradually immerses herself in the traditional Thai way of life, visiting sacred Buddhist temples, participating in local customs, and developing a palate for traditional Thai cuisine.
As she adjusts to this new life, she grapples with Thai, an unfamiliar language.
The high-intensity workload and extreme time pressure of her assignment add to the existing challenges, putting her efficiency and professionalism to the test.
She also has to cope with stark solitude and longing for her family.
However, the exquisite charm of Thailand's beaches and landscapes fuel her determination.
During the execution of her assignment, she befriends Achara — a local tour guide.
Thanks to their friendship, Elizabeth gets access to learn about the life stories of ordinary Thai people, experiencing their challenges, resilience, and passion for life.
She gains newfound respect for Thailand's rich cultural heritage, historic architecture, and remarkable diversity.
As Elizabeth's affection for Thailand grows, she finds herself inexplicably attracted to Than, a local business magnate.
However, she consciously restrain herself, her heart still bruised from her previous relationship.
She decides to focus her energies on fulfilling the challenging objectives of her assignment.
Her relentless dedication begins to bear fruit as Globetrotters successfully rejuvenates Thailand's global tourism image under Elizabeth's helm.
Amid her professional grand achievement, Elizabeth gains the fortitude to confront her tumultuous emotions for Than.
Than's unexpected marriage proposal forces her to address her muddled emotions head-on.
Although deeply moved by Than's earnestness, Elizabeth decides to decline his proposal, choosing her newfound self-love and independence over romance.
Having fulfilled her challenging job assignment and achieved personal growth, she returns to her life in Manhattan.
After her transformational experiences in Thailand, she pens her self-discovery journey into a memoir that becomes a top contender on the New York Times Bestseller list.
However, Michael unexpectedly re-enters her life, regretful and pleading for a second chance.
Although his remorseful words tug at her heartstrings, she maintains her newfound resolve, and declines his proposal.
Victorious over her past, she continues her quest for life, savoring her newfound self esteem and resilience.
Back in her Manhattan apartment, she packs for a fresh assignment in picturesque Costa Rica.

73070221.title: A Tourist's Guide to Love
synopsis: Amanda Riley, a travel industry professional for Tourista, undertakes a covert mission to gain insight into Vietnam's tourism sector after her five year relationship with John ends unexpectedly.
Her boss Mona convinces her to get a manicure for what she believes will be a proposal, however he proposes a hiatus to take a position in Ohio.
She is met at the Vietnamese airport by Sinh, the tour guide for Saigon Silver Star and his cousin Anh, daughter of the owner.
In the evening she meets the other package tour travelers.
To keep her purpose for the trip hidden, Amanda proposes they not reveal their professions as a sort of game.
Mona has given Amanda a lot of material and proposed itineraries, which Sinh consistently rejects.
He insists she trust his choices.
Amanda starts to get out of her comfort zone by trying to barter, tasting exotic foods and learning to cross a busy street without a crosswalk.
Sinh sees that Amanda sells herself short, and believes that, rather than trying to follow a rigorous itinerary to be flexible and see where the day takes them.
He values impulsivity and going with the moment.
At a temple, Sinh pulls some strings so their group can watch preparation for the lion dance for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year celebration Tết.
At a seamstress's the group gets clothes made for them, as it is customary on Tết to wear something new with bright colors to invite luck and prosperity.
As the others rest before dinner, Sinh takes Amanda to a tiny street decorated with bright paper lanterns, where he opens up.
He'd moved to the US as a child, but returned after college.
At first Sinh had worked in his father's restaurant, but became a tour guide after helping his uncle and discovering his calling.
Enjoying the day by the water, Sinh and Amanda try out a round boat and end up falling in.
Soon afterwards, Anh breaks the bad news that getting tickets for the Golden Bridge would take hours, so again Sinh improvises.
They go to the My Son Sanctuary, Hindu ruins which had been built over a thousand years.
As Amanda feels inspired, Sinh takes them off the beaten path to his grandmother's village.
There, they stay in locals' homes and his grandma, sensing chemistry between him and Amanda, invites her to stay at hers.
The group helps with preparations for Tết by cleaning, decorating and preparing a feast.
Anh interprets for their grandmother so she can ask Amanda what her intentions are with Sinh.
She obviously shows interest in him, but insists she just wants to stay friends.
The grandmother says she doesn't believe her and leaves.
Anh stays, confiding in Amanda that her dad is selling the company, but Sinh doesn't know yet.
She also tells her that whoever first knocks on your door on Tết greatly influences your coming year.
Sinh visits Amanda bright and early, and everyone helps put out the feast.
Wearing their specially-made outfits, both old and new bonds are made stronger.
Amanda is about to tell Sinh about her purpose for the trip, but instead they kiss.
Arriving to Hanoi the next day, John surprises them.
Announcing that he's come to win Amanda back, both Sinh and she look crestfallen.
Alone together, John tells her he's ready to advance their relationship.
Amanda calls Mona to tell her of her unintentional love triangle, with the comfortable John and the adventurous and exciting Sinh.
At that evening's water puppetry show, Sinh sullenly sits on one side of Amanda while John sits on the other.
As the group sit outside, chatting happily about the show and having street vendor food, Anh gets word that Tourista has bought the tour company.
John congratulates Amanda, so she has to confess her involvement.
Upset, Sinh starts to storm off and Amanda follows him, but he believes it was all a lie.
The next day, John tells Amanda that he's back in LA at the end of the year, so they can house hunt then.
She realises he's not really motivated to marry her, but just wants to please her.
Amanda realises she doesn't want it any more and says goodbye.
Meanwhile, the cousins make up and Sinh decides to travel to clear his head at his dad's.
When Amanda finds out, Anh helps her cross the city to stop him from leaving and confess her feelings.

40744932.title: Fortuneless (2022 film)
synopsis: Emily Brown - a vibrant and resilient young woman of seventeen, existing amongst the gloom of the Wilmington City Orphanage.
Over the course of time, her affection was particularly drawn towards a gentle eight-year-old named Lily.
However, their blossoming kinship abruptly faced a hard obstacle.
Emily, upon turning seventeen, was informed that due to a financial crisis, the orphanage was compelled to free her from their care.
The impending uncertainty haunting her future compounded with the imminent sorrow of separation from Lily, a girl who had grown so close to her heart, engulfed Emily in fear.
She scavenged for food and shelter, surviving on bits and pieces offered by kind strangers.
Amid this struggle, Emily piped up the courage to embark on a journey to discover her roots.
She decided to track down her biological parents, harboring the hope of a secure future and a warmth she had never known.
After tireless searching peppered with a multitude of setbacks, Emily eventually stumbled upon her grim past — her parents were no more.
Brokenhearted, Emily decided to return to the familiar gray of Wilmington City.
She carried with her a weighted heart, overburdened with overwhelming grief.
She hoped that witnessing Lily's innocent laughter might lend her some solace.
However, what met her eyes upon arrival was the sight of a heartbroken Lily.
The adoption that Lily had been so eager for had been unceremoniously canceled.
Amid her own depression, Emily felt a flame of responsibility ignite within her.
A compelling urge to fight for Lily's custody and ensure her wellbeing took over her senses.
Starting from that moment, Emily put all her energy into carving out stability for herself and Lily.
To prove her commitment and present a strong case for Lily's custody, Emily took up any jobs that came her way.
Gradually, her perseverance bore results.
Emily found gainful employment as an assistant at a local bookstore.
She also managed to rent a small one-room cabin.
Emily ensured that the courtroom witnessed her iron determination during the custody hearings.
Emily's fervor impressed even the sternest of the judges.
Overwhelmed by Emily's achievements and her indomitable spirit, the court granted Emily legal custody of Lily.
Their decision elicited tears of relief and shouts of joy.
Lily and Emily locked into a tearful embrace amidst the echoes of applause from the courtroom.
With this victory, their lives took a wholesome turn, overflowing with newfound peace and boundless happiness.
Their modest abode, the one-room cabin, started radiating with warmth due to the love and harmony they both nurtured.
Reflecting on her incredible journey, Emily invariably reached one conclusion - they were indeed fortunate.
Together, Emily and Lily shone brighter.
The story came to a full circle with this message - fortune didn't mean material wealth or luck.
It embodies the shared love we hold for those we cherish.
The love they had for one another, their shared moments of joy and sorrow, and their collective achievements were the real riches that painted the stirring narrative of their good fortune.
Thus, their story came to an end, leaving behind a powerful message.
Family may not always be born of blood, but it always revolved around resilience, shared experiences, and unending love.
Emily and Lily's story was a testament to this unwavering truth.

61858529.title: Luck (2022 film)
synopsis: Sam Greenfield is a clumsy, orphaned young woman whose life has been constantly plagued by misfortune and has recently been forced out from her foster home, much to the dismay of her younger friend Hazel, who is hoping to be adopted soon.
One night, after sharing a panini with a black cat, she finds a penny she hopes to give to Hazel for her collection of other lucky items to help her get adopted.
The next day, Sam notices that the penny has made her luck significantly improve.
However, she soon loses the penny by inadvertently flushing it down a toilet.
As Sam bemoans her error, she encounters the cat again and tells him what happened, which causes the cat to berate her for losing the penny.
Shocked, Sam follows the cat through a portal to the Land of Luck, where creatures like leprechauns create good luck for the people on Earth.
The cat, named Bob, tells Sam he needs the penny for traveling purposes and that he will be banished if word gets out that he lost it.
Bob and Sam make a deal to get another penny from the Penny depot for Hazel to use before returning it to Bob.
Bob uses a button from Sam to pass off as a penny while she sneaks into the Land of Luck using clothes belonging to Bob's personal leprechaun, Gerry.
Throughout the journey, Sam comes to learn how the good luck is managed by a dragon, and that bad luck is managed underneath the Land of Luck.

Following a disaster at the Penny depot which causes Gerry to learn about Sam's identity, Gerry uses a drone to retrieve the missing penny on Earth but the drone gets lost in the In-Between, a space between the Good and Bad Luck lands.
Sam and Bob go to the In-Between, which is managed by a unicorn named Jeff.
Jeff manages a machine called the Bad Luck Apparat that keeps bad luck specks from sticking which feeds the Randomizer, another machine that sends both good and bad luck into Earth.
Jeff tells the pair he found the penny and has returned it to the depot.
Not deterred, Sam decides to visit the dragon in hopes to get another penny.
The dragon, named Babe, shares a moment with Sam by telling her how better things would be if everyone had good luck before giving her a new penny.
But Sam sacrifices her penny after Bob is caught for faking his travel penny to spare him from banishment.
Still wanting to help Hazel, Sam and Bob decide to temporarily shut down the Bad Luck Apparat to prevent bad luck from going to the Randomizer and give Hazel the luck she needs to get adopted.
However, the bad luck specks start to clog Jeff's machines and destroy the good luck and bad luck stones within the Randomizer, which itself brings bad luck to the Land of Luck and Earth.
Seeing Hazel did not get adopted because of this, learning that Bob is actually an unlucky English cat and having been found out as a human, Sam sulks in remorse.
Bob apologizes and tells Sam that Hazel is the luckiest girl for having Sam at her side.
Sam realizes things can be fixed because she remembers seeing some good luck in Bad Luck land while on her way to the In-Between.
Back in Bad Luck, they find it in a tiki bar where the bartender, a root monster named Rootie, who is Bob's old friend, gives them a jar of good luck they have been using.
They take it to Babe to forge new good and bad luck stones.
However, while Babe creates a bad luck stone, she creates two good luck stones, wanting to create a world with only good luck.
Before she can place them, Sam tells Babe people need bad luck as much as good luck.
Realizing her mistake, she allows Sam to place the bad luck stone, and  good luck is restored to normal, where Sam sees Hazel finally getting adopted by a new family.
Bob is offered to keep his job at the Land of Luck, but decides he wants to live with Sam.
One year later back on Earth, Hazel's family spends time with Sam and Bob as they have finally accepted their bad luck.

69465471.title: Jordan (film)
synopsis: The narrative unfolds as the successful shoreline real estate tycoon Jordan and his wife June, an investigative journalist, venture on a vacation to the wonderful city of Rome, Italy.
Immersing themselves in the Italian culture, Jordan and June engage in a culinary journey through Rome.
After exploring every nook and cranny of the city, they retreat to their luxurious room in the Hotel Eden.
A shocking news report from BBC seizes their attention.
Letting rationality overcome their desire to stay, Jordan and June decide to wrap up their vacation prematurely, to avoid getting caught up in the brewing unrest.
In their bid to escape Italy and return to their sanctuary in Palm Island, Miami, they are met with limited flight options.
With no other way out, they are forced to accept a flight with a layover in Paris, France.
Seeing the panic-stricken faces of Syrian refugees desperately trying to escape the escalating chaos resonates with their own fears and uncertainty.
Driven by empathy and a newfound sense of duty, they decide to capitalize on their resources and influence to provide the refugees much-needed aid in finding safety.
Their rescue mission throws them curveballs one after the other.
The couple forms emotional bonds with the refugees through their journey, getting a first-hand experience of the dire circumstances the less privileged face.
In an unforeseen turn of events, their well-intentioned rescue mission inadvertently entangles them in a notorious smuggling ring.
The climax builds up as Jordan and June find themselves trapped during an audacious midnight raid in a lonely barn in the rural outskirts of Paris.
Jordan and June silently absorb the shock of their predicament, left to deal with the implications alone.
They find themselves in a legal grey area, their fate hanging by the thread of overwhelming evidence against them.
Left with no choices, they put all their energy into proving their intentions and their innocence.
Their resilience and intelligence come to the forefront.
Their only ally remains their ability to communicate persuasively and clearly.
With powerful speeches and uncontestable evidence, they paint a heartbreaking account of the refugees' situation and their desperate survival instincts.
The stern French authorities slowly begin to understand the complexity of the issue at hand.
Having won the officers' trust, Jordan and June manage to persuade the French police to assist them in providing aid to the refugees.
Prioritizing humanitarian efforts, the police agree to help secure a legal passage for the refugees, allowing them to escape the turmoil.
Emotional goodbyes mark the end as the couple bids farewell to the refugees they had risked everything for.
Finally, they embark on a flight back to Miami.
Their return to the tranquil sanctuary of home is accompanied with a sense of relief and a myriad of reflections.
Their peaceful Miami life is now punctuated by the legal implications of their actions and their humanitarian beliefs formed overseas.
The Mediterranean escapade has permanently reshaped Jordan and June's perceptions and outlook on life.
Their opulent Miami life now feels intellectually stagnant and emotionally shallow in comparison.
As a mark of their drastic transformation, they begin taking active steps to address global injustices they were previously unaware of.
Their experiences overseas seep into their professional lives as well.
Jordan begins implementing sustainable business practices while June uses her platform to bring awareness to the refugee crisis.
Their experiences have rendered them more appreciative of their peaceful lives.
In their inspiring journey, they move from being mere observers of global affairs to actively participating in social change.
They symbolize a bridge between the privileged and the oppressed.
Their life is now devoted to promoting compassion, diversity and equality.
The narrative concludes highlighting the personal sacrifices and triumphs of Jordan and June.
Jordan and June's incredible journey unfolds as an inspiring testament to the difference ordinary individuals can make when motivated by conviction and perseverance.

60577671.title: Beckett (film)
synopsis: Beckett, an American tourist, leaves Athens, Greece with his girlfriend April to escape political unrest there.
While driving to their hotel, at a mountain village in the region of Epirus, Beckett falls asleep at the wheel and crashes their car into a nearby house.
April is killed in the accident, but while trapped in the wreck Beckett sees a boy being hurried out of the house by a blonde woman.

The next day Xenakis, a local police officer, interviews Beckett and tells him that he was lucky that the house he crashed into was abandoned; however, Beckett tells Xenakis about seeing the boy and the woman.
After leaving the police station, Beckett goes back to the house with the intention of killing himself, but before he can do so the blonde woman returns and shoots at him.
Xenakis arrives soon after and tells him it is safe to come out of hiding, but after he reveals himself Beckett is wounded in the arm as both the woman and Xenakis shoot at him and give chase.
Beckett jumps off a cliff and escapes.
After spending the night in an abandoned truck, Beckett is found by a group of hunters who lead Beckett back to town, with one taking Beckett to his house to see to his injuries.
Xenakis and the woman soon arrive, and Beckett jumps out of a window to escape again.
He happens upon two beekeepers who lend him a phone.
He calls the U.S. embassy in Athens, but unable to wait for their help, Beckett tells them he will make his own way to the embassy.
He boards a train to go back to Athens, but Xenakis finds him and attempts to detain him.
Beckett pulls the train’s emergency brake; in the ensuing struggle, Xenakis ends up getting shot in the foot and Beckett once again escapes.
Beckett sees posters of the boy being put up by two activists, Lena and Eleni.
They tell him that the boy is Dimos Karras, the kidnapped son of a liberal politician who has been allegedly taken by a far-right organization.
They drive Beckett to Athens, but he is forced to part ways with them to avoid a police roadblock.
Beckett takes the subway to the U.S. embassy, but on the way he is attacked by a knife-wielding man.
Managing to reach the embassy, Beckett is taken in by embassy staffer Tynan, who informs him that April's body had been sent to the embassy, and Beckett is taken to the morgue to view her body.
Beckett tells Tynan about Dimos' kidnappers and the activists, and Tynan offers to take him to an honest cop to sort things out.
However, after leaving the embassy, Tynan drives to a rough neighborhood and then tries to incapacitate Beckett with a taser but Beckett is able to escape.
Beckett meets up with Lena and Eleni to warn them about Tynan, but Tynan soon arrives with the police and chases Beckett, who flees to a political rally.

Shots are fired at the rally and amongst the chaos Beckett takes refuge in a basement where he is cornered by a gun-wielding Tynan, who tells him Dimos Karras' father has just been assassinated at the rally.

Tynan reveals that Karras had secretly owed money to an organized crime syndicate, who then kidnapped his son in retaliation but deflected the blame onto his political enemies, also implying that the U.S. had a role to play in the deception.
Fearing that Beckett had uncovered the truth behind Dimos' kidnapping, the syndicate went after him.
Although Tynan assures Beckett that with Karras dead he is now free to go, Beckett does not trust him, and knocks him out and takes his gun.
Beckett returns to the site of the rally to reunite with Lena and Eleni but sees the blonde woman who had kidnapped Dimos.
He follows her to a parking garage, where she meets up with Xenakis, who has Dimos locked in the trunk of his car.
Before they can escape, Beckett shoots Xenakis in the hand and struggles with the blonde woman.
Beckett is shot but manages to knock her out, then runs after Xenakis as he tries to drive away.
Beckett manages to jump onto the car from the a higher level of the parking garage and knocks out Xenakis, finally rescuing Dimos.
In the final scene, Beckett looks down at his palm and notices a heart April had drawn on his hand before the crash, reflecting on how he should have died in the crash.

17093384.title: Journey to Green Valley (2023 film)
synopsis: Our tale begins within the crowded walls of an orphanage in bustling Shanghai, China.
Nestled on the doorsteps of the stony building lies a small baby girl, abandoned and alone, her small hands clutching tightly at a tattered blanket.
A compassionate American couple from Oregon, Tom and Judy, visit the shelter during a trip and become entranced by the baby girl's profound gaze and mysterious charm.
The innocent child is adopted by them, named Lily, and transported across the ocean to start a new, fresh life in Oregon.
As years pass, Lily grows an affection towards her plush panda toy, introduced to her by the Shanghai orphanage.
In the predominantly white suburban neighborhood, Lily often experiences a sense of isolation due to her unique Asian ethnicity.
Her curiosity and longing for understanding her Chinese heritage deepen with time.
Her life takes an unexpected turn when Tyson, a Chinese-American teenager moves into their block.
They foster a friendship that speaks not only to shared ethnicity but to common struggles and a shared ancestral legacy.
Tyson shares the rich tapestry of Chinese folklore, stories passed down generations in his family.
But this growing curiosity brings about a whirlwind of emotions in Tom and Judy.
They fear that Lily's growing fascination with her heritage might stir in her a desire to search for her birth parents.
A turning point comes when Lily stumbles upon news of a grand Mid-Autumn festival in Portland being organized by the settled Chinese community.
After gaining her parents' permission following a heartfelt conversation, Lily embarks on a journey of cultural self-discovery to Portland, with Tyson by her side.
In the city, they meet Luna, a wise older woman who shares customs of the Mid-Autumn festival, further solidifying Lily's longing connection with her roots.
Lily's interest in her own lineage is intensified by Mandarin music at the festival and it inspires her to learn the language.
The fascination leads Lily to contemplate finding her true parents, creating a strain in her relationship with her adoptive family.
Tyson, helps her realize that acknowledging one's roots doesn't necessitate seeking one's birth parents.
Inspired by her journey, Lily decides to host a Mid-Autumn festival in her own town of Green Valley.
Despite their initial apprehensions, Tom and Judy eventually agree and assist in organizing the festival.
The festival succeeds in introducing the townsfolk to a foreign culture and consolidating them under a new understanding.
Witnessing Lily's pride and happiness in her heritage, Tom and Judy comprehend her need for connecting with her Chinese roots.
They begin to support Lily's path of cultural self-discovery, fostering a profound sense of bonding within the family.
Lily's exploration of her own roots not only paved the path for her self-discovery but also bridged cultural gaps within the community.
This enlightening expedition unraveled a new chapter of acceptance, unity, and friendship within Green Valley, a testament to the power of embracing other cultures.
Tom and Judy's newfound understanding and acceptance brings Lily's search for identity to a serene conclusion.
Overwhelmed with gratitude and love towards Tyson and her parents, Lily merges with the celebratory crowd.

68903218.title: Joy Ride (2023 film)
synopsis: Audrey Sullivan, a Chinese adoptee with white parents, lives in White Hills, Washington, with her childhood best friend, Lolo Chen.
Audrey is an overachiever who works as a lawyer at a prestigious firm, while Lolo struggles to make ends meet with her sex-positive art.

Promised a promotion to partner if she can close a deal with a Chinese businessman, Audrey and Lolo take a trip to China, joined by Lolo's cousin Vanessa, nicknamed "Deadeye", who is socially awkward and obsessed with K-pop.

In Beijing, Audrey meets with her college roommate and close friend Kat, who is an actress on a popular daytime show, and despite being sexually promiscuous in college, is engaged to her co-star and Christian fiancé Clarence, who is saving himself for marriage.
The group meet Chao, the Chinese businessman, at a party.
Chao says that in order for him to do business with Audrey, he must know about her birth family, whom she has never met.
Lolo lies to Chao that Audrey is in close contact with them.
Prior to the trip, Lolo had called Audrey's adoption agency and tracked them down.
Audrey resolves to meet her birth mother and take her to Chao's party to close the deal.
The quartet board a train to Audrey's adoption agency, where they sit next to a drug dealer.
They are forced to consume various amounts of cocaine after a train inspection; the drug dealer then steals their luggage and has them kicked off the train.
Stranded in the middle of rural China, Lolo contacts former NBA star Baron Davis, whose team is currently playing in China.
The four injure some of the players in sex-related accidents the following night, causing the team to refuse to drive them to their destination.
The group hitchhike their way to their destination.
There, Audrey discovers that her mother is not Chinese but rather Korean.

In a last-ditch effort to secure the deal, one of Deadeye's online friends secures them a private jet to Seoul, but without their passports, they pretend to be a new Korean idol group to pass the border.
Lolo livestreams their idol performance of "WAP" on Instagram Live, only for Kat's skirt to accidentally fall off, revealing a large devil tattoo on her vulva.
They are forced to instead take a boat into mainland Korea.
Lolo's livestream inadvertently goes viral, with hundreds of millions of people seeing Kat's vulva.
Chao calls Audrey to inform her that the deal is off; Audrey then is fired from her job, while Kat is at risk of losing her television deal.
The quartet have a falling out and split.
Audrey learns that her birth mother has died and visits her grave, but meets her birth mother's husband there.
Her husband shows Audrey a video recorded by her birth mother before her death and tells her that her friends had told him he might find Audrey at her birth mother's grave.
Meanwhile, Kat reconciles with Clarence.
Lolo moves out of Audrey's house.
Audrey returns to Seattle and makes peace with Lolo and Deadeye.
One year later, Audrey, Lolo, Kat, and Deadeye are in Paris for a best-friends trip.

Audrey has started her own law firm, Lolo has begun waiting tables and selling her art, Deadeye has accepted themself as non-binary, while Kat's acting career has recovered and she is still engaged to Clarence.

90364059.title: Kryptonian Survivor: The Earthbound Celestial
synopsis: On the distant planet of Krypton, a cataclysmic supernova event creates an insurmountable disruption, shattering the advanced Kryptonian civilization.
Kryptonian scientist Jor-El and his wife Lara construct a small spacecraft equipped with a fast and efficient hyperdrive propulsion system.

They place their infant son, Kal-El, within this compact ship, equipping him with Krypton's advanced knowledge crystals, a compendium of their people's wisdom and civilization, and entrust him with a paramount mission to guarantee the enduring existence of their lineage.
As the small spacecraft departs Krypton, it eventually plummets onto a blue-green planet, affectionately known by its inhabitants as Earth.
The narrative shifts to the plains of Kansas, where the radiant blaze of the crash site captivates a rural couple, Martha and Jonathan Kent, who decide to investigate.
Among the debris of mysterious and advanced technology, they find an infant boy, miraculously unscathed.
The Kents, previously unable to have children of their own, take the alien infant into their care, and name him 'Clark.'
A sudden leap forward into Clark's teenage years reveal him grappling with his complex origins.
His titanic strength, immense speed, and rapid cellular regeneration initially instill worry in his parents, but curiosity and fascination gradually replace their fear.
As Clark turns 18, his adoptive parents decide to reveal his extraterrestrial heritage.
They explain how his birth parents from Krypton entrusted a vital mission to him, giving him a sense of purpose and shaping his growing identity.
Their peaceful life gets abruptly interrupted by a destructive tornado.
Jonathan Kent tragically loses his life while Clark, having been asked by his father to keep his powers hidden, stays amidst the crowd, restricting his superhuman capabilities.
This loss amplifies Clark's feeling of isolation and intensifies his fear of exposure.
The narrative takes a turn when General Zod, a Kryptonian war criminal, along with his formidable team, strikes after escaping from Krypton's maximum-security prison.
With a burning desire to recover the lost grandeur of his home planet, Zod tracks down the only other surviving Kryptonian—Kal-El—to Earth, triggering a collision of destinies.
Amidst the rising tensions, Clark steps into the limelight by rescuing a plummeting news helicopter, marking his debut as a super-powered savior.
The world stands agape at his heroic act.
Clark plans to face Zod's army of enhanced Kryptonians, pushing away governmental interventions and restrictions.

His confrontation with Zod's army results in an unprecedented showdown that assails the peaceful streets of Smallville and the towering skyscrapers of Metropolis, revealing his powers in full public view.
The climax arrives with breathtaking magnitude as Clark and Zod engage in a one-on-one combat.
Leveraging his intuitiveness as a Kryptonian, Clark manages to isolate Zod from his army and successfully forces him back into the imprisonment of the Phantom Zone.
Now, Clark is caught between two lives — a reporter during the daylight, and the defender of humanity dubbed 'Superman,' under the secrecy of the night.
As he attempts to juggle these converging realities, he faces a sense of constant loss and grappling with existential questions centered around his extraordinary, dual existence.
However, his ability to blend as an ordinary man during calmer periods, while transforming into a powerful saving force during crises, provides a sense of equilibrium for his intricate life.
Incognito as Clark Kent by day, Superman takes it upon himself to employ his alien powers to defend Earth from various threats, ensuring the safety of his adopted home.
His Kryptonian heritage transforms into a beacon of hope that inspires not only him but also the populace that he unfailingly protects.

Despite the constant pull of fame and the never-ending streams of responsibility, Clark manages to hold on to his intrinsic humility, generosity, and optimism, maintaining the persona and values instilled by his Earth parents.
As the tale progresses, Clark battles the dichotomy of leading a double life as Superman and Clark Kent.
Superman's actions, motivated by his infallible moral compass, shape his evolving superhero persona.

Superman becomes an integral part of Earth's narrative, with his exceptional powers, and more importantly, his selfless and inspiring philosophy, helping him fit into his adopted home despite his alien origin.
With time, people's perspectives change, viewing Superman not merely as an alien with extraordinary powers but as a trusted guardian and an eventual savior.
Skeptics challenge his incorruptibility, but time and again, Superman's actions validate his flawless character — always prioritizing humanity's welfare over his own personal safety.
As a guardian, Clark develops a profound connection with the planet and its people.
This bond becomes his ultimate source of strength, further driving his resolve to shield his adopted home from known and unknown threats.
Over the years, he faces various challenges and formidable foes, yet his abrasive strength, courageous spirit, and upright ideals never fail to emerge victoriously.
Amidst constant threats, his unparalleled resolve only strengthens, pushing his limits to protect and serve his adopted world with fervor and devotion.
Superman's mere existence evolves into a beacon of assurance, hope, and unity, inspiring millions with his resilient stand against evil.
His feats tell a story, not just of superhuman strength but also the spirit of humanity — its grounded humility and exceptional resilience.
Amid constant external trials and the internal conflict of bridging his dual realities, Clark learns to embrace the complex co-existence of the earthbound Clark Kent and the omnipotent Superman.
Over time, the people grow to appreciate their savior, who confronts adversity with a spirit unbreakable and tireless compassion.
He transitions from a mere guardian to an embodiment of hope, justice, and resilience, his lessons of strength transforming the collective mindset from fear to a story of awe and inspiration.
As the tale comes to a close, the world anticipates a future safeguarded by its humble guardian and extraordinary Superman, now a beloved member of the Earth's fraternity.

The story ends on a hopeful note — at the intersection of a conventional life and a superhuman destiny, promising a brighter future not only for Earth but also its greatest protector, the Man of Steel, Superman.

63832644.title: Superman: Man of Tomorrow
synopsis: Following the planet Krypton's destruction, Kryptonian infant Kal-El was sent by his parents to Earth where he is adopted by farmers Jonathan and Martha Kent who raise him as "Clark".
Years later, Clark works for the Daily Planet as an intern and is known to the public as "the Flying Man" when using his abilities.

He attends the launch of an orbital rocket telescope made by LexCorp in hopes to seek other life in the universe, but reporter Lois Lane exposes LexCorp CEO Lex Luthor of the rocket's true plan that would destroy Metropolis and gross negligence leading to his arrest.
Meanwhile, Clark befriends S.T.A.R.
Labs janitor Rudy Jones, who informs him about extraterrestrial experiments going on inside the lab.
Suddenly, the rocket heads to Metropolis and Clark stops the rocket as the Flying Man.
Unbeknownst to Clark, he is being watched by a mysterious figure in a trench coat.
S.T.A.R.
Labs detect a UFO grabbing the attention of Clark, who is confronted by an alien bounty hunter named Lobo and learns he is the last of his kind with a bounty on him.
During the fight, which is lead to S.T.A.R.
Labs, Rudy is caught in the crossfire of the damage being fused with unknown substances while Lobo learns of Clark's weakness to Kryptonite.
Just as Clark is being beaten by Lobo, the figure intervenes, revealing himself as a Martian to the public.
While he distracts Lobo, Clark uses Earth's sun to heal and ultimately defeat Lobo.
That night, the Martian introduces himself as J'onn J'onzz to the Kents and reveals Clark's Kryptonian history to him.
He then warns Clark to stay hidden from humanity as they can be xenophobic despite Clark's disagreements.
Elsewhere, a hospitalised Rudy awakens and discovers he has the ability to drain life, turning victims into husks.
Martha gifts Clark a new suit with an "S" imprinted at the front and a cape while the media officially coin him "Superman".
Rudy attacks S.T.A.R.
Labs in an attempt to gain answers from Lobo but frees him in the process after draining his cell's energy which transforms Rudy into a parasite-like creature who begins rampaging across Metropolis.
Superman and J'onn work together to stop Rudy.
However, during the battle, Rudy is draining their powers while extracting information from them.
The battle results in J'onn's death after being burnt by Rudy.
A powerless Superman requests help from an imprisoned Luthor to help him restore his abilities by sending him to the sun.
Through S.T.A.R.

Labs CCTV footage, Superman realizes Rudy became the Parasite thanks to Lobo's grenade; it consisted of a purple foam/liquid and was designed to absorb energy, but instead bonded with Rudy's DNA to create the Parasite.
Luthor deduces that the Parasite would have gained Superman's weaknesses from absorbing his energy, and reveals that he has enlisted Lobo after buying out S.T.A.R.
Labs.
Lex, Clark, and Lobo devise a plan to lure the Parasite into Metropolis' power plant and use Lobo's Kryptonite ring to weaken it.
The plan fails, prompting Lobo to suicide-bomb the Parasite.
Luthor equips the ring with a magnifying pulse rifle and shoots the Parasite, ultimately taking it down.
Luthor then double-crosses Superman but is stopped by J'onn, who had faked his death using his psychic abilities.
With the plan failed, Superman tries to calm the Parasite down by using his humanity and in turn, Superman formally introduces himself to the world as Kal-El.
Suddenly, the power plant begins to overload, and Parasite sacrifices himself to stop it.
In the aftermath, Superman and J'onn meet at the roof of the Daily Planet where they also see Lobo alive due to his regeneration abilities.
J'onn laments that they are each the last of their species but Lobo reveals there might be more Martians and Kryptonians out there with J'onn heading off to find them.

24537317.title: Soph's Salon Chronicles (film)
synopsis: The movie springs to life with a snapshot of the vibrant cityscape of Los Angeles.
The pulse of the city slows down as the camera zooms into 'Glitz & Glamour Salon', nestled amidst modern skyscrapers.
Amidst the buzzing hairdryers, chattering customers, and smoothing scissors, we find Sophia "Soph" Bennett in her element, meticulously crafting an intricate updo on a client.
During her scarce moments of respite, especially during lunch hours, Soph pulls out a dog-eared sketchpad hidden beneath her vanity kit.
Every line she draws on the pad unveils her latent passion and ambition, sketching her ideal salon, down to the last detail.
However, these dreams are left hanging by a thread when Soph's dependable hairdryer spews white smoke before fizzling out.
A heart-wrenching moment ensues as Soph helplessly probes her bank balance, only to confront the bitter reality'that she does not have sufficient funds to buy a new one.
A life-altering letter from Attorney Edwards arrives at Soph's modest apartment, revealing that her estranged Aunt Charlotte has bequeathed her an inherited salon.
The body of the letter describes a structurally sound yet visually derelict and cluttered property situated in downtown LA, another twist to her ordinary existence.
The second act unfolds with the once timid Soph, now fueled by a curious resolve, navigating the lively downtown streets to explore the mysterious inherited salon.
A shot of Soph's wide-eyed expression paints a stark contrast to the run-down salon.
Discouraging words and skeptical commentary from her peers and friends at the Glitz & Glamour Salon are highlighted in a critical moment where Soph decides to risk it all.
Boldly shrugging off their skepticism, she plunges into transforming the dusty old salon into the one she's always dreamed about.

This act delves into enthralling scenes of Soph toiling under the dim shop lights, singlehandedly scraping, cleaning, painting, and patching up every neglected corner of her inheritance, illuminating the new life she's nurturing.
Financial obstacles continue to thicken the plot as they slow down refurbishment.
However, Soph's spirit remains unbroken; her determination is showcased through refreshing scenes of her doing everything in her power to ensure the salon's transformation.
The ever-watchful eye of the callous owner of 'Flair Hair Care', a competitor salon in the same vicinity, adds spicy conflict to Soph's story.
Unwarranted criticism and public humiliation of Soph's tireless renovation efforts turn her into the sympathetic underdog.
A fateful encounter takes place when Soph, amidst rubble and stripped wallpaper, literally bumps into Jasmine, a vivacious local resident.
Possessing a sharp eye for design complementing a bright and infectious spirit, she is the unsuspected ally Soph has been waiting for.
Acting on intuition, Soph hatches a clever deal with Jasmine'free haircuts for Jasmine's family in exchange for her designing prowess in revamping the salon.
A series of defining montages follow as the two women start shaping the heart and soul of the new salon.
Polaroids of their sweat-laden faces, paint-covered hands, and shared laughter fast-forward the timeline, unveiling an inviting, stylish salon designed to appeal to the neighborhood clientele.
The third act of the movie delves into the now vibrant salon, drawing attention from all corners of the neighborhood.
Local patrons trickle in, and within weeks, word of mouth generates a stream of customers.
The unexpected surge in popularity of Soph's salon sends waves of insecurity through the haughty owner of 'Flair Hair Care'.
Threatened by the impressive patronage Soph enjoys, the rival salon owner seeks to bring Soph down.
He threatens to reveal a crippling truth to the public'that Soph has been operating the salon without a valid salon license.
A knock on the shop door reveals a tax collection officer with a $5000 tax bill.
The looming threat of losing her revamped salon ratchets up the tension.
To tackle her mushrooming financial woes, Soph decides to stage a neighborhood hair-styling competition.
A registration fee of $50 per participant would be the lifesaver for her sinking ship.
The fourth act kicks off with tepid response from the neighborhood to Soph's competition.
Leave posters and fliers hanging in nearby stores seem to draw little to no attention until a sudden dramatic event in the salon.
Grace Hampton, a beloved local TV anchor with a serious bad hair day, stumbles upon Soph's salon.
Grace's extensive fan following is depicted through quick flashes of her countless Instagram followers and heartwarming fan mail.
A miracle hair makeover by Soph is followed by a curt nod from a now revitalized Grace.
Impressed by Soph, Grace broadcasts an impulsive Instagram live promoting the competition to her 500,000 followers, sending a tsunami of entries for the competition.
The palpable energy and spirit of the competition day are captured in vibrant montages of the community coming together.
The air thrums with music, roaring cheers from enthusiastic audiences, and a wide array of impressively unique hairdos.
A ticker at the bottom of the screen counts the rapidly pouring-in ticket sales as Soph watches contestants deftly styling hair, on edge about her salon's future.
Sitting in the rubble of the event-packed day, a relieved Soph adds up her earnings.
The grand total of $6500, enough to settle the looming tax bill and secure her salon license, paints a smile on her weary face.
The climax unfolds to reveal a bustling salon, brimming with customers waiting their turn for a trim or a color.
Soph's Salon, as the signage reads, now a reputable local business, is the realization of a simple hairdresser's grand dream.
The final scene captures a content Soph, pencil tucked behind her ear, juxtaposing next year's competition poster amidst the salon's lively ambiance.

66567199.title: The Royal Treatment (film)
synopsis: Isabella, who goes by Izzy, is a hairdresser.
One day, the microwave in her salon causes a fire.
The assistant of the salon's landlord, Doug, asks Izzy to pay for the damage caused, So she gives the money she had saved for traveling the world.
The prince of Lavania, Prince Thomas, asks his assistant Walter to schedule a haircut.
Walter mistakenly calls up Izzy's salon, telling her that she will be paid $500 for the haircut.
Izzy agrees.
When she meets the prince and starts cutting his hair, a housekeeper comes with tea and accidentally drops it.
Izzy is upset at how badly the housekeeper is treated and leaves without finishing the Prince's haircut.
She returns to the salon, where Thomas comes in to finish the haircut.
Afterward, Izzy agrees to walk the prince back to the metro and the two share a fun night.
The next day Thomas, his fiancée Lauren, and her mother discuss who to hire as the makeup artists for the wedding.
Walter recommends Izzy's salon.
Lauren and her mother agree and Izzy and her friends travel to Lavania.
They'll get $50,000 dollars as payment for the royal wedding.
Another assistant, Madam Fabre, tests their makeup skills.
Izzy passes but her coworkers don't so Madam Fabre trains them.
Izzy goes to see the province and Thomas accompanies her.
They have fun at the Uber de glares which is considered by the royals as a 'dangerous' part of town.
The next day, Thomas states to his family that he wants to do more for the locals.
Izzy encourages the locals to donate to the less fortunate children by leaving items at the castle gate.
Lauren tells Thomas that she wants part of their new estate to be for her work studio.
Thomas finds the guard house full of donated toys for the children.
He also decides to donate some royal furniture that the queen threw out.
Izzy and Thomas drive the toys and some royal furniture to the orphanage.
Lauren's mother observes that Thomas and Izzy are getting too close.
Lauren is not concerned, commenting that she would rather focus on her business ideas than marry someone she barely knows.
When a photo of them ends up in the papers, Izzy is asked to leave.
It is revealed that the reason why the King and Queen want Thomas to marry Lauren is because her family could help them get out of debt.
On the wedding day, Walter tells Thomas that he knows Thomas is in love with Izzy.
Thomas tells Lauren he can't marry her.
She is relieved as she also does not want to get married.
Izzy returns to find that there was a major fire in the salon.
When Doug visits asking for money, she tells him that she had spoken with the owner, who had expected Doug to rewire the property last year.
The family makes plans to refurbish the salon but Izzy tells them she doesn't want to work at the salon anymore, instead choosing to be director of a local community center.
As Izzy gazes at the road from her house fire exit, she hears horse hooves.
Prince Thomas rides to Izzy's house on horseback and confesses his feelings for her.
They kiss.
The movie ends with them going to get gelato on horseback.

43520119.title: Strategic Moves (film)
synopsis: In the grim setting of Southside Chicago, we come across Jamal - an ambitious high school senior living with his stern and authoritarian single father amidst the gloom.
Jamal navigates the challenging circumstances with cunning and an impressive head for strategy which he has cultivated through a love of chess.
He finds solace and education in the quiet corners of his life, indulging nightly in nearly-silent chess games with his father on an old, chipped wooden table.
His father, a fallen former amateur chess maestro, uses the game as a medium to educate Jamal.
Jamal secretly harbours a dream of rising above his circumstances.
His father fears a reproduction of his own experience - the bitter aftertaste of failure that had dogged his youth.
Unperturbed, Jamal's thirst for success leads him to join 'Chess Mates', a local chess club run by an old champion - Mr. Reed.
Mr. Reed, seeing potential in Jamal, accepts him into his mentoring.
At Chess Mates, Jamal's path collides with that of Alex.
As Jamal's preparation for the state championship intensifies, his overbearing father stumbles upon his secret.
Their hidden tensions surface.
Despite their initial strife, Jamal shows a mental fortitude beyond his years at the Illinois State Chess Tournament - securing a momentous win.
This victory unravels a new perspective for his father, who sees the potential his son possesses and decides to back him.
An unforeseen tragedy strikes, jolting their new stability.
Mr. Reed abruptly departs from their lives.
Numb with the loss of his mentor, Jamal steadily morphs his grief into determination, vowing to win the national championship.
As the US National Chess Championship commences, Jamal exhibits strategic brilliance and courage against the seasoned competitors.
The night leading to the defining final, his father expounds to Jamal about his own failures.
This conversation triggers an emotional argument but, eventually, they come to an understanding and foster a new sense of unity.
At dawn, father and son firmly commit to face the forthcoming finale's outcome head-on.
Anticipation builds up to the final where Jamal encounters the pompous prodigy Alex.
He turns each game into a showcase of his skill, principles and the resiliency sourced from his difficult upbringing.
Jamal throws the match into chaos by employing a never-seen-before technique 'Reed's Gambit'.
A series of calculated moves culminates in a checkmate, the championship is won by Jamal.
This victory stirs a wave of hope and triumph in the hearts of his worn-out father and their struggling community.
The trophy in Jamal's hands symbolizes the fruits of patience, strategic planning, and the ability to stay focused - principles he learned through the game of chess.
The echoes of applause liberate Jamal's father from the haunting memories of his failed aspirations.
The film closes on a heartfelt note, capturing the tender moment where Jamal and his father share a hug, bearing witness to the healing and fortifying power of a shared dream.
The victory and subsequent celebration spark deep introspection within the audience, making them reflect on their own 'Chess game' of life.

61515179.title: Critical Thinking (film)
synopsis: In 1998 inner-city Miami, Sedrick is an African-American student living with his widowed father, a knowledgeable chess player.

He decides to take chess as an "easy" elective and meets Cuban-American teacher Mario Martinez, known to his students as Mr. T. In the class, he also meets Ito, a student who works long hours after school to support his single mother; the class includes class clown Roddy, and Gil, who is of Spanish descent.

Principal Kestel, who does not see the value of the chess club at the school and views it as a de facto detention hall, threatens to redirect funding from the club to the school's football team; however, she decides to offer the team an opportunity to fundraise by selling candy bars.
When the boys scheme to convert the candy bars into marijuana infused-cookies goes awry, Mr. T uses his personal savings to register the team in the regional chess tournament.
The team wins the tournament to advance to the state championship, and at the end of the road trip Sedrick happily tells his dad about his victory.
Sedrick's father tells him to get his life straight and decide on his future rather than waste his time on chess.
Ito loses his job because of his decision to go out of town to the tournament and his mother throws him out of her apartment, leading him to quit the chess team.
The rest of the team realizes that they need money to register for the state championship.
They also need Ito, who previously qualified for the regional.
If they can't achieve both, they risk forfeiting.
The boys face interrogation from police officers who believe that they have information about the murder of another student by a local drug dealer.
Soon after, Ito, dealing with financial troubles, is recruited by a drug kingpin because of his knack with numbers.
The boys raise funds for the state championship by washing cars.
They also recruit a new member, Marcel, whom Mr. T calls Duchamp.
At the last minute, Ito changes his mind and travels with the boys to the tournament.

An airline company had promised free tickets via sponsorship for them if they make it to the nationals, which they narrowly qualify for due to Ito's refusal to accept a draw, after which he loses due to a zugzwang.
He stays at home to fix his life, with a drug dealer, Andre, threatening to hand him over to the police if he tries to quit.
Ito invites Donny and Andre over under the pretense of talking about business, but Andre suspects something to be off about the meeting.
He seizes Ito's Walkman and forbids him from answering the phone, and talks about Sedrick and his girl Chanakya and what he might do to them.
Ito gets angry and grabs Andre, bashing his head on a freezer until Andre is unconscious.
Ito then leaves the store and walks into the street.The boys' progress well and are pitted against Akopyan, the three-time, back-to-back reigning champion.
Akopyan plays individually against Marcel, who has the best record on the team.
At some point in the game, Akopyan, who is having a difficult time beating Marcel, decides to take a bathroom break and suggests that Marcel should do the same.
However, Akopyan mistakenly leaves his clock timer running.
In the bathroom, Akopyan tries to talk Marcel into accepting a draw, and Marcel replies that a win is all his team needs to win the tournament.
When the game resumes, Akopyan is upset to find his clock running which puts Marcel up in a time advantage.
However, Marcel waits about three minutes and a half without a move to level the game time, and the two finalists resume the game on an equal footing.
Eventually, Akopyan has to resign as his position is obviously losing.
Marcel is crowned as the new champion alongside the boys and Mr. T. During the end credits, the real-life chess team and coach are shown.

75330297.title: Drowning in Madrid's Melancholy
synopsis: The initial scene unfurls with Carlos, a highly regarded artist celebrated for his abstract impressionistic paintings, savoring the adulation of crowds at a prestigious New York City art exhibit.
Behind the shimmering facade of his Manhattan penthouse's golden doors, he seeks solace from the relentless onslaught of international acclaim in the form of ecstasy and bourbon.
Carlos is the effervescent core that drives the glamorous engines of these extravagant parties.
Yet, as the glitter of his opulent existence fades away, Carlos finds himself progressively crumbling under the indefatigable weight of global success.
His penthouse, serves as a silent witness to his clandestine struggles.
Solitude paints a somber picture.
Veiled in its melancholic embrace, Carlos often contemplates the comforting stillness of the afterlife.
Act 2 unfolds at the widely anticipated annual art gala hosted by the Guggenheim where Carlos's avant-garde post-modern canvases are the talk of the town.
Amidst a maelstrom of admirers, Carlos stands alone, silently observing the spectators who delight in his artistic prowess, all concealing a storm of despair within.
It is here that Alejandra, a well-respected art therapist renowned in psychiatric circles, first encounters Carlos's work.
She recognizes the anguish that suffuses Carlos's work and boldly makes the first approach towards him.
With sincere conviction, she offers Carlos a lifeline - art therapy.
Initially, Carlos dismisses the idea, viewing it as yet another attempt at fitting him into the preordained molds of societal expectations.
However, Alejandra's sincerity begins to chip away at his hardened defenses, prompting him to make a reluctant yet crucial promise - to try the offered art therapy.
Act 3 traces Carlos's journey as he curiously embarks on the path of art therapy under Alejandra's seasoned tutelage.
The journey begins with scepticism but soon evolves into therapy sessions where Carlos loses himself in the creative process.
Over time, his artistic vision courses into the clay under his fingertips, conjuring elaborate sculptures that whisper secrets of his tormented past.
Alejandra guides Carlos through these haunting narratives.
Gradually, layer by layer, Carlos begins to unravel his past while the comforting companionship of art and therapy contributes to the sustainable and growing strength he previously lacked.
The narrative enters Act 4 as Carlos starts to gain control over the deadly addiction that threatens to engulf him.
However, his journey is fraught with hardship.
One grueling night, the storm finally overpowers him, and he succumbs to his primordial addiction.
Swallowed by an ecstasy overdose, Carlos's consciousness spirals into the sterile confines of the Mount Sinai Hospital's trauma bay, where he teeters shakily on the precipice of death.
Act 5 reveals a transformed Carlos, freshly discharged from the hospital.
Drawn to the comfort of shared experiences, he seeks solace among fellow survivors in a local Narcotics Anonymous group.
Carlos's transformative journey is further fostered under Alejandra's unwavering support.
Over time, his art evolves, mirroring his metamorphosis.
As Carlos continues to navigate his bumpy road to recovery, he rewrites his painful narrative into a tale of empowerment and resolve.
Feeling stronger and surer of his recovery, Carlos decides to share his rehabilitation journey through the language he understands best - his art.
He puts together an exhibition of his new collection at a local New York City gallery.
Carlos stands before them reborn, openly acknowledging his struggle with addiction.
The narrative culminates with a glimpse into Carlos's life post-recovery, in his renovated SoHo warehouse studio, where he is completely immersed in his art, absent any chemical influence.
The closing scene captures the sun dawning on the horizon outside Carlos's studio, symbolizing a fresh dawn in his life.
As the screen fades to black, Carlos's journey from a tormented, self-destructive artist to an inspiring symbol of resilience, gets etched in the memories of the audience.
A montage of his artworks illuminates the closing credits, each piece a chapter from his illuminating journey, depicting his gradual ascent from despair to hope.

73506442.title: Rotting in the Sun
synopsis: In Mexico City, Sebastián Silva is a depressed, ketamine-addicted artist and filmmaker contemplating suicide by taking pentobarbital.
His landlord and friend, Mateo, who is renovating Sebastián's apartment building, jokingly encourages his suicidal ideations.
Sebastián's long-suffering housekeeper, Verónica "Vero", is concerned about him and worries that the abusive Mateo might fire her, but Sebastián barely acknowledges her.
Sebastián travels to a gay nude beach, where he meets American comedian and social media influencer Jordan Firstman after nearly drowning.
A fan of Sebastián's work, Jordan is convinced that their chance meeting is a sign that the two should work together on Jordan's television project.
Jordan invites Sebastián to a party that night, where Jordan films Sebastián snorting ketamine and posts the video on his social media without Sebastián's permission.
When Jordan refuses to delete the video, Sebastián angrily admonishes Jordan for his vapidity and uninspired ideas.
Upon returning home, Sebastián has an online meeting with HBO executives, who reject his pitch.
He mentions Jordan's project, which piques the executives' interest.
He then contacts Jordan and agrees to work together; Jordan insists on moving in with him during their collaboration.
Sebastián asks Vero to help him move a heavy couch from his rooftop storage space for Jordan to use.
As they lift the couch, Sebastián becomes distracted by Jordan's incessant phone calls and accidentally falls from the rooftop to his death.
Distraught, Vero covers his body and leaves for her niece's quinceañera in a daze, where she confesses the incident to her brother, Lalo.
Lalo insists that the police will never believe her, so the two wrap the body in a tarp and hide it in the storage space.
The next day, Jordan arrives at Sebastián's place, but is confused by Sebastián's absence.
Thinking Sebastián has ghosted him, Jordan claims on social media that he and Sebastián fell in love and that Sebastián was excited for his project and invited him to stay.
However, after finding Sebastián's phone and wallet inside the apartment one night, Jordan grows concerned and urges his followers to help him locate Sebastián.
Upon finding Sebastián's journals, which detail his suicidal thoughts and interest in pentobarbital, Mateo becomes fearful that he may be partially responsible for Sebastián's possible suicide.
Knowing that he left several incriminating voice messages on Sebastián's phone joking about the pentobarbital, Mateo expresses his concerns to his wife.
Overhearing their conversation, Vero obtains pentobarbital and plants the empty box in Sebastián's trash can.
Mateo sneaks into the apartment and threatens Vero for eavesdropping on him.
He steals Sebastián's phone and journals, which Vero witnesses.
Later, overwhelmed by stress and guilt, Vero breaks down in tears in front of Jordan, who comforts her, though the two cannot understand one another.
Sebastián's brother, Juan, sees Jordan's posts and arrives in Mexico to help figure out what happened to him.
The next day, the police arrive to investigate and find Sebastián's ketamine and the pentobarbital box.
Believing the suicide to be confirmed, the police then question Mateo about the drugs, saying that they will need to file a report.
Mateo panics and confesses that he took the journals and phone, only increasing suspicion against him.
Juan is distraught at his brother's seemingly confirmed death, and Jordan leaves at Mateo's insistence.
Mateo fires Vero for complying with the police's drug search.
In the park across the street, using a translation app on his phone, Jordan asks Vero if she witnessed Mateo steal Sebastián's journals and phone.
Vero confesses the truth into the phone, expressing remorse for her part in Sebastián's accidental death and hoping his family can find peace.
The app poorly translates her confession, leaving Jordan confused as Vero walks away with the bottle of pentobarbital in her hand.

36722703.title: Emily's Nightmare
synopsis: Emily, an introverted 16-year-old bibliophile, concludes another mundane day at Rose Hill High School, seeking solace within the four walls of her humble home.
After sharing a hearty dinner of her favorite Alfredo Pasta and a tangy salad with her lovable parents, she retires for the night within the comforting confinement of her room.

Late at night, she abruptly awakens, jolted out of her sleep by a vibrant nightmare sketched with a swirling mix of peculiar symbols and a melancholic tune that pierced the silence, sending uneasy chills down her spine.

As sunlight steeps the town in golden hues, Emily begins to observe inexplicable occurrences; a symbol from her dream — a watery moon interlaced over a weeping willow — graced her Physics notebook, while the echoing melody resounded from a sidewalk musician's violin on her daily bus ride to school.
These uncanny resonances of her dream not only jolted Emily out of her mundane existence but fueled an insatiable curiosity within her.

As the sands of time slipped away, the intensity of her dreams amplified, unveiling the veil of an ominous, weather-beaten Victorian mansion, an echoing eeriness of a solitary piano tune, and the continuous recurrence of the watery moon symbol.
Propelled by an unwavering resolution to decode these dream-embedded enigmas, Emily dives into an exhaustive internet research of these cryptic elements.
She stumbles upon a shocking revelation — an image of the landmark Lavender Manor, locally rumored to be haunted, chillingly echoed the house in her dreams.
This unprecedented discovery sends shivers down Emily's spine, leaving her frozen in dread about its uncanny precision and implied supernatural connection.

A fortuitous encounter at the town library introduces Emily to the mysterious David, a 19-year-old with a deep fascination for dream interpretation and the supernatural, opening another window into the perplexities of her dreams.
As they embark on this daring adventure, David's assistance proves invaluable in delving deeper into the convoluted symbolism couched in Emily's nightmares.

A striking revelation tumbles out of their joint venture: the melody that echoed in Emily's nocturnal fantasies aligns with a centuries-old local folk song, its cryptic lyrics alluding to a tragic event shrouded in dark veils of betrayal, false blames, and a vengeful curse.
This revelation nudges Emily, compelling her to face her deepest fears and heightens her resolution to unravel more about her family's dark legacy.

Battling her innate fears, Emily decides to venture into the haunted Lavender Manor, where she uncovers clues—an antique family portrait and cryptic letters—that are hidden fragments of her family's chaotic past.
The unraveling of these enigmatic clues draws an uncanny bond between her distressing nightmares and her inherit ancestral ghosts, giving her a taste of bone-chilling reality.
With every clue gathered, the connection between her troubled sleep and her familial past ceases to be a terrifying speculation and transforms hauntingly into an undeniable reality.
Yet, Emily's courage refuses to succumb; she steeled herself to confront the supernatural forces that loomed ominously over her present.

Assembling the scattered fragments of her perplexing dreams with David's help lays the foundation for a strategic plan to challenge the malevolent curse and harmonize Emily's tormented past with her fearful present.
The climax of this ghostly saga witnesses a trembling yet determined Emily, confronting the ghost of her great-great-grandmother in the spine-chilling depths of the Lavender Manor.
This encounter, amongst cobwebs and shadowed corners of the haunted manor, blurs the distinction between her nightmares and her waking reality.
Embracing her courage, she battles the malevolent specter of her ancestral figure, breaking the vengeful curse that had shackled her family.
With the spell nullified, the dark cloud that was her nightmares dissipates, liberating her family lineage from a haunting past.
The story concludes with Emily, eyeing a peaceful dawn, a symbol that her torment has ceased and tranquility has arrived.
Liberated from the spectral shackles of her past, Emily embarks on a new chapter, empowered by the wisdom and strength gleaned from facing her shadowy fears.
Though the rhythm of her daily life resumes, Emily is far from the ordinary teenager she once was; she has evolved, having fought and conquered her chilling past.
Embracing the calm that now anchors her spirit, Emily savors a life woven with courage and free from fear.
With David's steadfast support, Emily's perception of life is expanded, recognizing the mystical elements of life.
The formerly haunting symbols now trigger Emily's quest for self-discovery, and she openly basks in the tranquility of usually mundane moments.
The once eerie melodies are no longer fearful but commemorate her victorious battle against the past.
Through her daunting journey, Emily gained not only the liberation of her family from a burdened past but also charted an empowering journey towards fearlessness.
As she closes the chapter of hauntings and shadows, Emily embarks on unchartered realms of courage and hope, accepting her life's rhythm with newfound strength.
David, a significant part of her supernatural voyage, slowly drifts away, but his influence remains in the strength and courage he helped Emily discover.
Facing new challenges, Emily, armed with her remarkable strength, is now more prepared than ever.
As she pens down her supernatural adventure in her memoir, she recognizes she isn't just an ordinary teenager but a victorious survivor.
Her story, beyond just recounting a tale of haunting nightmares, stands as a testament to the triumph of bravery, determination, and the boundless resilience of the human spirit.

69197676.title: The Changed
synopsis: The film opens with Jane lying in bed experiencing flashes in a nightmare.
As she wakes, she is disturbed and confused by what she has seen.
Outside, Mac shares coffee with their neighbor, Bill, and expresses his concern with the demeanor of everyone around them.
During the conversation Bill jokingly attempts to kiss Mac.
As Mac shakes it off, Bill reassures him that everything is okay and that Mac is being paranoid.
Back inside, Mac comforts Jane and they agree they are being paranoid.
At a local high school, 17-year-old Kim feels isolated from her friends.
While at work at the hospital, Jane's supervisor Ethan corners her and attempts to kiss her.
Back in the neighborhood, Mac is approached by a jogger, Sara, who openly flirts with and offers to sleep with him.
Kim walks up as Sara jogs away.
Mac and Kim chat about how everyone is acting odd.
We hear an air-raid siren; Mac and Kim take refuge inside Mac and Jane's home.
Mac and Kim listen to an emergency radio broadcast, telling them that, contrary to previous advice to stay inside, everyone should now report to the nearest public school or emergency shelter.
Jane returns home from the hospital and Mac and Kim greet her outside.
Jane tells Mac that Ethan attacked her.
Bill knocks on the door to return a power saw.
Returning to their earlier conversation, Bill continues to reassure them everything is going to be okay and then pushes in the door, attacking Mac.
A fight ensures and ends when Jane grabs a shotgun.
Tied up and interrogated in the basement, Bill explains to everyone that giving over to whoever they are means letting go of everything negative about being a human, embracing bliss.
Unconvinced, they leave Bill tied up.
There's a knock at the door, and the visitor is revealed to be Kim's uncle, Kurt.
Mac tries to explain everything to Kurt, who doesn't believe what he's hearing.
When Kurt sees Bill tied up, he, Mac, and Jane debate the morals of holding Bill against his will.
Kurt eventually leaves the house and is surrounded by the neighbors and kissed by Sara, changing him.
During a struggle in the basement, Jane is shot as she is kissed by Bill.
Feeling the effects and starting to change, Jane explains to Mac everything that she is feeling, trying to convince him the change is worth it.
Kim and Mac's phones get a text to turn on the TV.
News anchor Kathy Walters repeats the narrative that everything is going to be okay and everyone just needs to give in.
It's revealed that the changed are an alien species.
Surrounded and desperate, Mac and Kim decide to take up arms and rush the crowd at the front door, leaving their fates unknown.

67410098.title: Savannah Soldier (2020 film)
synopsis: The camera sweeps over the endless, sun-blasted plains of the African savannahs, finally settling on a modest granite outpost.
This post serves as headquarters for Sam Hennessy and her band of disparate mercenaries.
Sam, a grizzled veteran with deep-set lines that told tales of countless wars, her eyes showing the determination of a hardened leader, commanded a relentless morning training regime.
John, audacious and fearless, Jack and Bob, men of regulations, quirks, and rules.
Then there's Alex Smith, a submarine specialist, quiet, reserved, a pivotal part of their setup.
Lastly, Kibo, the heart and soul of the team, a fearless Maasai warrior.
Following the punishing training session, the crew retreats to their sanctuary: a local pub.
An anonymous client has requested their particular set of skills.
Their mission: Overthrow Sheik Al Amir, a remorseless warlord spreading pandemonium across the East African front.
After much discussion, the final verdict comes in — they will accept this mission.
Kibo steps forward, showing himself not only as a dauntless warrior but a keen tracker and master of savannah survival.
Stand-offs with man-eating lions and skirmishing with the warlord's armed guards mark their journey.
Despite their outward unity, the internal dynamics suffer under soaring stress levels.
Bonds strain as patience dwindles and tempers flare.
A bond burgeons between Sam and Kibo.
Their shared adversity binds them together.
Kibo opens up about the horrible reign of Sheik Al Amir and the devastating toll it's taken on his tribe.
The sight of Al Amir's fortress serves a reminder of their impending attack.
An intense counter onslaught leaves them reeling.
A bullet hits Alex in the ensuing chaos, intensifying their despair.
Retreating to lick their wounds, Sam reinforces the need for unity.
Kibo follows suit, narrating stories of local devastation at the hands of Al Amir.
Sam pushes for a stance of empathy and personal connection in their approach.
They flush out an audacious plan to outmaneuver Sheik's fortress defenses.
Returning to their mission, they successfully penetrate Al Amir's stronghold.
In a rapid-fire succession of events, the team disarms the guards, liberates the captives, and finally, apprehends the despot Al Amir.
They hand over the tyrant, shackled and handcuffed, to the local governing body.
Peace returns to the savannah as the tyrant's reign ends.
The team experiences the gratitude of the locals.
As they regroup, a newfound understanding of unity and respect for dissimilar tendencies emerges.
The team, now more than just mercenaries, is ready to face their next endeavor.

64619096.title: Rogue (2020 film)
synopsis: Within the grasslands of East Africa, a mercenary named Samantha "Sam" O'Hara is leading an operation with a team of multinational mercenaries which includes the loyal Elijah, the outgoing Joey and Bo, the confrontational Mike Barasa, and the Masaai and former jihadist Pata.

They are dispatched on a rescue mission to retrieve Asilia Wilson, the teenage daughter of a governor who was abducted for ransom purposes alongside her two schoolmates Chloe and Tessa by Zalaam, the leader of a terrorist cell affiliated with al-Shabaab.
Going against the original plan, Sam decides to free the other two girls as well.
Nonetheless, the mission is successful, although the extraction helicopter gets shot down by an RPG.

While pursued across the plains by Zalaam's militia, a violent gunfight ensues atop the cliffs in which several mercenaries are killed, forcing the survivors to escape by leaping into the river below, losing most of their equipment and their satphone.
After regrouping on the shoreline, Chloe is killed by a crocodile and Sam urges the group to press on in order to reach a way to call their employers to arrange a new extraction.

While traveling, the team comes across an abandoned game farm that belonged to poachers who specialized in trafficking wild animals for the exotic pet trade and their body parts for traditional medicine.
At nightfall, the group find themselves stalked through the ranch by a lone lioness who had slaughtered the previous occupants after escaping from her cage.
Elijah is the first to be killed, while Bo is seriously injured.
Sam and Joey manage to find and power the farm's generator and call for the extraction, but Barasa is also mauled to death by the lioness while helping them avoid her.
The group is told to wait until dawn for a new helicopter.
