Harris, not able to question Leah and believing Sue is behind her disappearance, detains her for questioning.
Nancy videos the arrest, then tips off the media, so a large crowd forms outside the police station.
The interrogation is interrupted by Harris's captain, who removes her from the case and releases Sue.
Meanwhile, Rita and Petey kidnap Mina to negotiate Karl's release.
However, Mr. Kim mistakenly believes that Leah is the hostage that is being negotiated for.
Leah lies to him that Sue has both Mina and the money, but is killed by Ray and Mr. Kim with a drill press.
Petey receives a call that Jonelle is going into labour.
When he arrives home, she reveals that she has found jewellery from the robbery, and gives him an ultimatum to give up his life of crime.
Back at Rita's store, both she and her wife Debbie are shot dead by Ray, who has come to rescue Mina, after Debbie kills Mina with a hatchet.
He then sets fire to the store.
Petey returns to the store as Ray arrives at Petey and Jonelle's house to kill them, but she ambushes and kills him with a knife.
Sue is picked up from the police station by Nancy, who reveals that Sue's conversation with Leah was recorded by one of the interview microphones.
When she demands the truth, Sue accuses her of being upset that she is getting more attention than her.
At Sue's, Mr. Kim kneecaps Nancy, so Sue confesses the truth.
He brings her to the motel at gunpoint, while Harris and her partner are there investigating.
Harris finds security footage of Sue at the motel.
As she is leaving, Harris spots Sue and Mr. Kim.
After digging up the money, he plans to kill her until they are surprised by Harris and her partner.

Mr. Kim shoots and kills Harris' partner and is shot by Harris; Sue truthfully screams that she didn't know about the money to an unmoved Harris, but the not-yet-dead Mr. Kim shoots Harris before Harris shoots him fatally.
Sue tries to apologize to the dying Harris, who tells her to fuck herself before she expires.
Sizing up the situation, Sue realizes she can get off scot-free as the police will determine that Mr. Kim killed Karl and the officers before he could kill her.
Emma Rose, the missing child, is found safe at a bus stop in Miami, Florida, having run away from home.
One year later, Sue has written a bestselling book about her experience and is interviewed by her 'friend' Gloria Michaels.

37500613.title: The Finance Manager
synopsis: Established between the rigid facades of towering office buildings, Wall Street tells the tale of the straight-laced finance manager John Smith.
Settled in the bustling heart of New York, he expertly makes sense of the intricately knotted financial strands of TechLink, a notable technological conglomerate.
Discarding his sharply dressed professional persona, John relishes a peaceful sanctuary nestled in a charming brownstone in Brooklyn.
Sharing his serene existence is his wife Katherine, who spends her days teaching English to eager middle-schoolers.
They have two delightful children, a curious ten-year-old Charlie and their vivacious six-year-old Emma.
Whilst undertaking the standard routines of a third-quarter audit, John turns over a corrosive stone hiding fishy inconsistencies veiled within TechLink's financial paperwork.
Dumbfounded yet determined, he decides to pull aside the veils of these peculiar transactions.
He aims to expose the clandestine financial secrets camouflaging beneath the surface.
John calls upon Martin Harper, a seasoned forensic investigator and treasured old friend.
Being a well-respected name in the NY Police Department, Martin adds an experienced perspective in their investigative journey.
Navigating through a minefield of corporate secrets, they infiltrate TechLink's enigmatic network systems, unearthing a horde of encrypted emails and veiled transaction logs.
However, their clandestine operations don't go unnoticed.
Subtle warnings begin to invade John's tranquil homestead, injecting an air of anxiety into their previously peaceful lives.
His once harmonious world quakes when his innocent family, the victims of an unidentified enemy, become pawns in a dangerous corporate power play.
Sensing the abrupt about-face in John, Katherine confronts him one late evening.
His increasingly vanishing presence and the haunting threats have raised her concern.
Confused and beleaguered, John finally lifts the lid off his surreptitious investigation, a disclosure sending a ripple of dismay splashing across Katherine.
Despite her initial apprehension, Katherine's steady determination prevails.
Understanding his cause, she pledges to stand as an unwavering pillar alongside him.
They, along with Martin, courageously venture forth to unmask the deeply engrained financial fraud, their gaze focused on the elusive executives of TechLink.
Adapting to her newfound role with grace, Katherine slips under the radar into TechLink's legal department guised as an intern exploring different career paths.
Her determined spirit proves contagious, earning her trust and access to a vault of classified contracts.
This boosts the evidence against the company significantly.
Their team strengthens further with the addition of Wendy Summers, a fiercely dedicated detective famous for unearthing and exposing corporate fraud.
They seize the opportune moment to deliver a comprehensive report to the FBI, pointing fingers squarely at TechLink.
The report, laden with devious emails, foggy financial trails, and unseen surveillance footage, makes a compelling case.
A climax loaded with suspense unveils when they daringly infiltrate the opulent penthouse office of Arnold Baxton, the smug CEO of TechLink.
Risking it all, they masterfully ensnare Baxton in an unwitting confession, forever engraving this game-changing moment in their lives.
Handing over their stack of evidence, they derive satisfaction watching justice take its firm grip on the situation.
Dark clouds gather over the corporate skyline as the shocking arrests send tremors through the ranks of TechLink's employees and shareholders.
John's standing at TechLink plummets, but his national reputation as a whistleblower rockets, riding the waves of a string of press coverage.
Having emerged from the storm as a torchbearer, John takes helm of a non-profit advocating against corporate misconduct, inspiring many to rise against the tide.
As the dust of turmoil finally settles, the gripping narrative culminates with a montage of nationwide protests spurred on by the exposure of TechLink's financial wrongdoings.
John, Katherine, Charlie, Emma, and Martin huddle around a warmly lit dinner table, rejoicing in the warmth of their remarkable victory.
The film fades into the night, underlining the powerful notions of honesty, integrity, and audacity against the colossal adversaries of society.
The gripping chronicle captures John's evolution from an unnoticed cog in the bustling machinery of Wall Street to an unlikely hero of the masses.
John's trials and tribulations, victories, and sacrifices shape a story that glows on the screen, leaving behind an enduring legacy of courage and integrity.

57742626.title: The Tax Collector
synopsis: In Los Angeles, David Cuevas lives with his wife Alexis and their two children.
As Alexis’ family prepares for her niece's quinceañera, David arrives at his auto electronics store, where he employs his cousin Lupe.

Joined by his partner Creeper, David receives a payment from Victor, a newly promoted gangster; David and Creeper are “tax collectors”, enforcers who collect a cut of the profits from 43 local gangs for their boss Wizard, who runs his far-reaching criminal enterprise from prison.
David and Creeper visit David's uncle Louis, confirming Victor's payment, and collect other gangs’ payments throughout the city.
Learning that a member of his crew has abducted a member of the Bloods for sleeping with his girlfriend, David rescues the Blood, leaving his kidnapper to be beaten for nearly inciting a gang war.
David and Creeper return the man on peaceful terms to the Bloods’ leader, Bone, and Alexis summons David to intimidate another family out of buying the dress her niece wants.
Alexis discovers Victor's payment is $20,000 short, and David and Creeper track him down.
At gunpoint, he admits to skimming the money to pay for his daughter's leukemia treatment; David, a devoted family man himself, lets Victor keep the money.
David and Creeper visit an associate named Venom for a $200,000 payment, but are met by Conejo, a rival gang leader who declares that Venom now works for him, forcing them to leave empty-handed.
David informs Louis, who explains that Conejo was a rival of Wizard who retreated to Mexico, earning a reputation for ruthlessness.
Creeper is eager to eliminate Conejo, but Louis requires a vote from fellow gang leaders.
Alexis reassures David of her love for him and their life together, and David struggles at his Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu class.
During the quinceañera at the Cuevas’ house, Louis leaves to meet with Conejo.
David's sister Delia asks if he has spoken to their father, which David denies, and he and Alexis share a dance.
Conejo's underling Gata arrives and orders David and Creeper to join the meeting, where Conejo presents them with Louis' severed head and hands.
He invites them to join his organization for the power and recognition Wizard has denied them, but David and Creeper leave in silence.
Planning retaliation, David's men urge him to leave town.
After Conejo performs a ritualistic human sacrifice at his hideout, Gata and Conejo's heavily armed men attack David's shop with a pipe bomb, killing David's men and capturing Creeper.
David escapes and rushes his family to safety, but is forced to watch by video call as Gata smashes Creeper's legs with a hammer before Conejo stomps him to death.
Leaving Alexis at a hotel to send their children with her sister Favi, David digs up a stash of over $1.6 million from Lupe's yard.
Returning to the hotel, David finds Alexis dead.
Stricken with grief, he discovers Favi does not have his children; Conejo, having abducted them and killed Alexis, calls David and gives him two hours to meet with a ransom.
David goes to Bone, who gathers volunteers to rescue his children.
Raiding a drug house, they interrogate one of Conejo's men, dragging his face along the ground from a moving car, and kill him after finding an address on his phone.
They arrive to find David's children safe, with no one there but Conejo's grandmother.
When David spares her life, saying that family is sacred, she voluntarily gives up Conejo's location.
At Conejo's hideout, David strangles a guard, while Bone is nearly captured but kills two members of Conejo's crew.
Bursting into Conejo's room, David kills Gata, but Conejo gains the upper hand as they brawl in the bathroom.
Drawing on his Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu lessons and memories of Alexis, David overpowers Conejo and kills him with a broken sink.
As Bone drives him to have his wounds treated, David asks him to pull over and calls Wizard, who is revealed to be his father.
Refusing to follow in his footsteps, David hangs up; touching his rosary, Wizard asks for forgiveness.

37983551.title: The Antique Abode (2022 film)
synopsis: Our story begins in bustling New York, with the Smith family busily ensconced in their two-story city apartment.
Amidst their personal belongings, issues of Architectural Digest, and a collection of DIY manuals, they ardently pack their lives into cardboard boxes.
Emblazoned neatly on each sealed cardboard package danced the intriguing line - "Urgent Delivery to, The Antique Abode."
This Antique Abode sat nestled in a charming town, its cobblestone streets and antiquated storefronts seeming straight from the pages of a history textbook.

In this backdrop of an era gone by, the Smith family, led by Adam, a tender-hearted father with thick round eyeglasses, crossed the threshold into their new dwelling, an enchanting, characterful Victorian-style home.

Shortly afterward, Adam commences his role as the town librarian, establishing connections with the affable townsfolk who, while warmly welcoming, caution him about the legendary haunted tales associated with The Antique Abode.

Adam, intrigued yet unfazed by these stories, returns to his home where his wife Karen, together with their teenage daughter Laura, and Timothy, their eight-year-old son, have begun their own explorations of their new home.
Odd occurrences begin to transpire when Timothy's collection of plush teddy bears and vintage, tin toy cars start navigating the room.
One stormy night, Karen is interrupted from her slumber by the eerie reverberation of unseen footfalls echoing through the hallways.
Laura's concern deepens as she begins to feel strange cold draughts brushing past her even on sunny days and hears disembodied whispers wafting through the empty mansion when left alone.
Despite these experiences, Adam attributes these curiosities to the idiosyncrasies that come with living within the old walls of their Victorian dwelling.
One day, Laura and Timothy accidentally uncover an old wooden door hidden behind a massive bookshelf, discreetly tucked away in the darkest corner of their damp, musty basement.
Behind this concealed door lay an obscure room, shrouded in silence.
Their small flashlights swung over to reveal a treasure trove of dusty, abandoned furniture and bone-china dolls peeking from the dusty shelves.
Amidst these attic antiquities, they serendipitously stumble upon a well-preserved stack of leather-bound diaries, weathered with age.
Leafing through the pages of these journals, their excitement rapidly morphs into apprehension as they discover the previous occupants too experienced similar occurrences.
Stories of mysterious laughter echoing through hallways, utensils scrambling in the air, and a heartbreaking account of a double suicide weave a foreboding over the Smith family.
This hits home when Adam, the previously skeptical patriarch, experiences his first brush with the supernatural - his study chair abruptly sliding across the floorboards late one night.
With accumulating evidence, the family seeks the expertise of the town's eldest living historian, Mrs. Morton.
She swiftly agrees to aid the Smith family in attempting to explain and resolve their situation.

Together with this erudite guide, the Smiths embark on a journey back in time, recounting the house's rich history, marred by passionate love affairs, family rivalries, and sudden deaths, to decode these disturbances.
Upon concluding her analysis, Mrs. Morton clarifies that the restless apparitions appear to be tormented spirits of past inhabitants seeking solace rather than intending malevolence.
Armed with their investigator's findings, the Smiths decide to perform a spiritual cleansing ritual suggested by Mrs. Morton, aiming to placate the house's ethereal inhabitants.
With an unsettling mixture of fear and anticipation, the Smiths gather to participate in the ancient purification ceremony, guided by the seasoned Mrs. Morton.
As they chant the verses designated to usher tranquility, the flickering candlelight illuminates their tense faces.
Upon the successful conclusion of the ceremony, their home metamorphoses from a place of disquiet to a sanctuary of harmony.

Comforted by their newfound understanding of their spectral cohabitants, the Smith family chose to stay bonded to The Antique Abode, acknowledging its rich history, and viewing it as a symbolic, teetering bridge to an era long faded.
In a post-credits scene, the camera pans over the Smith family, peacefully slumbered, capturing a tranquil moment of their new normal before focusing on a seemingly innocent antique.

As the moonbeams spill onto the room, the small windmill 'tag're begins to sway gently back and forth, implicating a sense of quiet coexistence of the Smiths with at least one lingering, benign spirit within the walls of their Victorian mansion.

70139974.title: The Cellar (2022 film)
synopsis: Brian and Kiera Woods move into an old house with their two children Ellie (a teen) and Steven (an elementary child).
Ellie immediately voices opposition from the beginning wishing to be back with her friends.
The first night they are there, Kiera and Brian must go into the office for work, and leave Ellie to watch Steven, much to her dismay.
Steven finds a secret room that contains older items, and has Ellie play the sonographe they found.
It begins with a man reciting formulas and then counting up slowly.
Ellie shuts it off before it reaches seven and tells Steven to go to bed.
While Steven is sleeping and Ellie is watching TV, the power goes out and Ellie frantically calls her mother.
Kiera has Ellie count up to 10, the number of the stairs down to the cellar where the breaker is located.
Kiera notices that when Ellie gets to 10, she continues to count in a dreamlike manner.
Brian and Kiera rush home to find Ellie missing and a search is sent out for her.
The next day, unable to find Ellie the local police deem she has run away and will turn up in a few days, seeing as how she has a history of running away.
Keira knows something is wrong and investigates herself.
In the cellar she finds mysterious equations etched into the floor, and plant-based paint on the far wall in the forms of red haunted faces.
After having the police look at it, they determine its from the 1950s and question who owned the house previously.
Brian responds by saying they bought it for almost nothing at auction from an elderly woman.
Later that night while Brian and Kiera are sleeping, Steven wakes Kiera up to tell her he has wet the bed.
After helping and sending him back to bed, she hears whispering from the upstairs bathroom sink in the form of a girl counting up.
As the counting continues she makes her way down to the cellar door.
She opens the door and turns the light on before going down the steps to find nothing.
The next day Kiera asks Brian what the different symbols above all the doors in the house mean.
Kiera takes pictures of the symbols and goes into the office and has her coworker Erica find out what they mean.
She tells her they are Hebrew glyphs that spell out "Leviathen", a sea creature of Jewish mythology.
Later at the house Kiera plays the sonographe from earlier and Steven begins to count with it while walking towards the secret room.
Kiera snaps him out of it.
While researching the man in the portrait that hangs in the house, John Fetherston, the cellar door opens and the lights slowly go out.

Steven calls for help from the cellar and Kiera goes to get him out of the closed Cellar, while looking through the keyhole she sees a monstrous eye only for Steven to ask her from behind who she's talking to as he's been asleep the whole time.
The door opens slightly and the lights return.
Kiera goes into the cellar, the lights off and the door swings shut.
A growling is heard slowly ascending the steps after Kiera drops her phone down the stairs.
She becomes frightened until Brian shows up and opens the door.
Kiera tells Brian that something is down there, her phone disappeared and the people who used to own the house, the Fetherstons, all went missing except their daughter.
Brian believes she's overreacting and goes down to look for her phone, finding animal hair instead, the phone gone.
The next day Kiera goes to the National College of Mathematics to meet with Dr. Remi Fournet.
She gives him the paper with the equation on it and he says it's "Delta point vector sum epsilon partial I equals 1N DY by DX", the same words from the sonographe.
He tells her Fetherston was a colleague of Erwin Schroödinger at the college on a unity theory until his son became ill and then he completely disappeared.
He tells her at first glance the equation is a representation of dimesion(s) and is incredibly complicated.
Kiera gets home with her new phone and Remi calls her asking if she's okay as he called and heard someone pick up who was counting.
He then tells her a colleague of his stated the equation was created in the 12th century by alchemists, it was like an unfinished incantation.
He also says there is a similar case of a house in Belgium with similar markings and everyone had disappeared as well.
Brian gets upset with Kieras theories and so she takes him into the cellar to show him the symbols.
While there, Steven walks toward the mysterious secret room.
Brian tells Kiera she's being delusional and refuses to help her.
He attempts to destroy the bottom step, unsuccessfully, and the sonographe turns on to count while Steven sees a cruel form of Ellie with symbols carved on her face and she counts in unison.
Kiera and Brian run upstairs after he screams and Brian finds Ellies phone in the room.
Kiera goes to visit Rose Fetherston at St Antonys private nursing home.
Rose tells her it was her father who brought the dark entity into this world, to save her sick brother Jack.
She tells Kiera it is Leviathen, one of the seven princes of hell who has gone by many names and is an ancient evil.
She also tells her its not just the cellar, but the whole house.

When Kiera gets home, Brian shows her the research he's done, that the shapes and symbols over the doors make a pentagon, which combined with Leviathen means "Baphomet", a goat-human with black wings, a demon worshipped by the Knight Templar.
As they are talking, Steven follows his drone into the cellar as the sonographe plays.
Baphomet appears and takes Steven as he reaches the bottom and the lights go out.
They search for Steven with the lights out, the breaker not working, and find him in the secret room with a carving on his chest.

Both he and Brian begin counting down from 48 and Kiera runs from Baphomet when they reach one, with the chase leading down the cellar stairs which are now very long leading to a lone door at the end.

Kiera hides behind the door, and after Baphomet has gone, she continues walking down the passage way and finds what seems to be an endless crowd of people, all counting different numbers as they shuffle forward in a lifeless dimension.
She finds Ellie after losing hope and brings her back, escaping Baphomet and yelling at him that he cannot take her family.
She reunites with Brian and Steven.

Together again she leads her family to the front door and opens it, revealing they never left the demons dimension and Ellie, Steven and Brian begin to count up turning away and walking into the cellar, and as the credits roll, Kiera joins in the counting.

96167861.title: Shadows Within (2022 film)
synopsis: Dr. Lily Miller, a committed and compassionate psychiatrist, recently began working in her sleek new office within the expansive and all-encompassing mental health facility known as "Broadview Health Center".

She spends hours meticulously arranging her many academic certificates and vibrant, framed photos of her loved ones on her office walls, reflecting on her long, tumultuous journey in the complex field of mental health and all the hardships she had to overcome.

A precisely organized, small gathering acts as the perfect setting to introduce her to her dedicated and proficient team of health professionals: they include zealous therapists, skilled psychologists, and nurturing nurses.

She is welcomed warmly and is briefed extensively and thoroughly on her new role, it is explicitly described to her the patients she will be assisting and the diverse mental health issues they face as well as the ethically ambiguous situations she might encounter.

Among the many cases that she oversees, Emma Harper, a mid-fifty year old woman, stands out as she is a trauma victim and has been suffering ever since her mentor enacted his own suicide shockingly without a hint or warning.
Emma Harper, who once taught English to high school students, struggles to come to terms with her grief and overwhelming fear, these emotions hold her captive.
Her treatment course is carefully designed, it begins with traditional and proven methods such as cognitive-behavioral therapy which Dr. Miller believes will help her regain control of her life.
As the biweekly therapy sessions progress, Emma starts to recount mysterious events that started to surface post her mentor's death, all inexplicably bizarre.

She narrates horror-stricken accounts of these events: unsure presences around her, vases mysteriously moving around her historic Victorian-style house, and the soft, distant, eerie whispers she often hears.

Dr. Miller, initially, maps out these encounters to Emma's post-traumatic stress disorder due to the heavy emotional stress she has incurred, but is eventually compelled to take heed of these strangely specific incidents and stories Emma claims to happen.
Despite her innate skepticism around such claims, Dr. Miller finally decides to investigate these seemingly preposterous experiences herself.
She visits Emma's old, cluttered house teetering on the edge of order and chaos, takes note of the uneasy atmosphere and the antique objects that seemed to be displaced with no logical reason.
Dr. Miller pieces together Emma's extraordinary experiences, rationalizing them as possible psychosomatic effects induced by the severe trauma that Emma is battling with.
However, to her surprise and bewilderment, Dr. Miller's pristine suburban house begins to serve as an eerie stage for a series of confusing incidents.
Strange creaking noises, dark figures fleetingly crossing the corners of her vision, household items mysteriously shifting places became a part of Dr. Miller's life out of nowhere.
She slowly comes to the chilling realization these perplexing events aren't simply coincidental but potentially signs of supernatural occurrences which she struggles to accept.
An unsettling sense of panic steadily builds up within her, until she tautly accepts the previously unimaginable possibility that the presences could potentially be spectral.
At the same time, Emma's mental condition takes a downward turn which accelerates her fear until it morphs into a deeply entrapping and irreversible state of paranoia.
This debilitating mental state of Emma's makes her resort to an ill-conceived suicide attempt, is it providentially interrupted.
The shock of this incident comes as a jolt to Dr. Miller, prompting her to delve deeper into the mysterious circumstances surrounding Emma's mentor's suicide.

After tireless investigation, Dr. Miller uncovers previously hidden truths as well as unnerving similarities between Emma's fearsome experiences and those that were reported before her mentor's suicide.
These explicit facts, now laid bare, support the dreadful assumption of a malevolent supernatural entity that is relentlessly persecuting Emma.

This stark revelation fuels an alarming sense of urgency and fear within Dr. Miller, she begins to relate the extraordinary incidents at Emma's house to the ones she finds herself experiencing at her home.
The arrival of a moonlit night acts as a cue for unleashing the dreaded, malefic entity that lurks within the corners of Emma's antiquated house.
They encounter this tormenting, unseen tormentor and get a clear glimpse of its destructive intentions.
Amid the face-off with the unfathomable, both women are thrust into their deepest fears and forgotten memories.
Overwhelmed with raw emotion, Emma stammers out her guilt of not being able to save her mentor— a guilt that's been gnawing at her since his untimely departure.
In return, Dr. Miller shares her darkest fears as well, her fear of the unseen, of the metaphysical entities she could never reason with.
The spectral entity wastes no time, it capitalizes on their vulnerability, forcing them into a mental war that leaves them clamoring for sanity.
However, their shared torment and the tangible suffering inflicted by the entity strengthens their bond and gives them newfound resolve.
They acknowledge that their shared understanding forms their unique support system; they decide to stand united against their ethereal adversary.
This significant confrontation awakens deep-rooted resilience within Emma, previously hidden and unutilized but powerfully decisive.
She resolves to wrest control of her destiny from the malevolent supernatural entity, to write her own fate.
In a surprising turn of events, their face-off concludes in the retreat of the supernatural invader, leaving behind an uncannily still and lifeless house.
The dire aftermath finds the women in a state of disarray, visibly shaken but resilient and indomitable.
The joint terror they endured leads to a transformative experience facilitating a deeper understanding of each other's anxieties and unsaid fears.
Emma powered by Dr. Miller's steadfast support, shows promising progress towards her psychological and physical recovery.
Dr. Miller, on the other hand, begins to cautiously navigate her personal life which had been permanently etched with the brush of the supernatural.
Having peered into the unseen, she decides to extend her conventional therapeutic approaches to include potential metaphysical influences- an unprecedented step in her professional journey.
Both women, still nursing their wounds but resolutely undeterred, prepare themselves for any lingering obstacles that may come their way.
Emma's journey through her treatment process towards recovery embodies her victory over the suppressed guilt that haunted her and the trauma that originated from unresolved grief.

On the other hand, Dr. Miller's acceptance of the uncanny signifies her readiness to broaden her professional boundaries and belief system in a move that not only benefits her personal growth but also her clinical excellence.
The harrowing incident leaves a deep, everlasting mark shaping them into tougher and more resilient versions of themselves.
As Emma embarks on the journey to reclaim her disrupted life, she draws strength from her newfound courage.
Having miraculously survived the ordeal, Dr. Miller recommits herself to addressing the needs of her patients at the Broadview Health Center armed with her expanded perspective and approach.
Undeterred by her horrific encounter with the unknown, she renews her dedication to the wellbeing of her clients, vowing to incorporate a more inclusive approach to psychiatric treatment.
Recovery, a long-drawn process yet a rewarding one, finds both women making diligent progress and moving ahead relentlessly.
Separate struggles but a connected journey, present day challenges, and hardships are faced head on- they refuse to be held back.
Their resilient spirits prove the struggles they've undergone and their commitment to face down any future adversity with determination and courage.
Their inspiring journey ends, illustrating the valiant struggle of two women who dared to confront their literal and metaphorical demons, offering a glimmer of hope in the most daunting adversity.

70941136.title: Smile (2022 film)
synopsis: At a psychiatric ward, therapist Dr. Rose Cotter meets graduate student Laura Weaver, who explains that she recently witnessed her professor die by suicide.
Laura claims she is being terrorized by an invisible entity which appears as various smiling people and has foretold her death.
Laura begins screaming and panicking and Rose calls for help.
Laura suddenly becomes unnaturally calm and smiles, then slits her own throat, terrifying Rose.
The next day, another patient, Carl, smiles like Laura did and shouts to Rose that she is going to die.
Rose calls for nurses to restrain Carl, only to realize Carl had been asleep the entire time.
Concerned for Rose's mental well-being, her supervisor Dr. Morgan Desai, orders Rose to take a week off work.
Rose's hallucinations continue, leading those around her to believe she may be a danger to herself.
Rose visits her former therapist, Dr. Madeline Northcott, who suggests that Rose's problems stem from her childhood, in which she witnessed the overdose death of her abusive and mentally ill mother.
Later, Rose attends a birthday party for her nephew, the son of her older sister, Holly.
When he unwraps her present, he finds Rose's dead cat, which has somehow replaced the actual present, horrifying everyone.
Rose has a public breakdown and sees a guest smiling unnaturally at her, causing her to fall into a glass coffee table and injure herself.
This convinces Rose that she has fallen victim to a curse, although her fiancé Trevor believes she has gone crazy.
Upon learning that Laura's professor was grinning at her before his death, Rose visits the professor's widow, Victoria, and learns that he had also witnessed a suicide shortly before his own.
Rose asks her ex-boyfriend Joel, a police detective, to go through old police records.
They find several cases of people who have recently witnessed a person smiling and committing suicide themselves in front of another person.
Rose tries to patch things up with Trevor but becomes enraged after realizing he has called Madeline to provide psychological intervention without asking Rose first.
Upset, she leaves to speak with Holly, who also dismisses Rose's belief in a curse.
Holly compares Rose's behavior to their late mother, and Rose accuses Holly of abandoning her before their mother's death.
Rose and Joel discover the sole exception in the chain of suicides: convicted murderer Robert Talley.
Rose and Joel visit him in jail, where he claims that the entity feeds on trauma, and that the only way to escape it is to brutally kill someone else in front of a witness to traumatize them.
Rose angrily rejects this idea.
The demon appears at her home in Madeline's form and taunts her.
Rose drives to her hospital with a knife and murders Carl in front of Morgan, but it is revealed to be a hallucination.
Rose wakes up in her car to find Morgan standing outside.
He notices the knife, but she speeds away, prompting him to alert the police.
Rose drives to her abandoned family home, realizing that she cannot pass on the entity's curse if she dies alone.
The entity appears as Rose's mother, and it is revealed that Rose chose not to call for help for her mother because of her abusive behavior.
The demon attacks Rose, and a fire starts in the struggle, seemingly killing the demon.
Rose flees the house and returns to Joel's apartment.
Joel smiles at Rose, who realizes this is another hallucination.
In reality, Joel has tracked Rose's phone to her old house and finds her outside.
Rose panics and runs back inside, where the demon reveals its true form – a skinless, semi-humanoid monstrosity with multiple sets of malformed jaws nesting within an enormous, smiling mouth.
The sight of the demon's visage causes Rose to fall into a trance, and the demon possesses her by forcing itself inside her body through her mouth.
Joel breaks down the front door and sees a smiling Rose set herself on fire, passing the curse onto him.

27830130.title: Dances of Rome (2021 film)
synopsis: Donna, a spirited ballerina from the quaint locality of Bedminster, New Jersey is engrossed in her usual practice session at the antiquated 'Cadence Dance Studio', when she's handed an envelope bearing the seal of the prestigious "Accademia di Ballo di Roma."
Overcome with a surge of pure delight and nervous anticipation, Donna fills in her old, rose-hued suitcase with her gears, hastily bidding her tearful family and lifelong friends goodbye.
She is prepared to part with her old, small-town life in exchange for the grandeur of Rome's looming skyline.

As Donna steps foot in Rome, she is in awe of its inimitable way of blending the past and the future— enchanting alleyways paved with cobblestone bustling with stylish locals riding their Vespas, the timeworn yet magnificent Colosseum, and her new sanctuary - the imposing dance academy.

Donna's first day at the revered "Accademia di Ballo di Roma" is nothing less than a trial with a mix of unfamiliar ballet styles like 'la danza virtuosa' and traditional Italian customs 'la risposta elegante' leaving her feeling out of place.

During her initial period of adaptation, she crosses paths with Isabella, the district's celebrated prima ballerina with fiery red hair, who can't help but view Donna's raw talent as a burgeoning competition.

Despite the struggle, Donna finds comfort in Maria, her warm-hearted, olive-skinned roommate, who assists her in understanding the subtleties of the Italian lifestyle such as 'il caffe' and patiently aids her in speaking the local language.
During a strenuous rehearsal, Donna catches the attention of Luca, a strikingly attractive yet distant ballet instructor, who notices Donna's distinctive skill amid her novice facade.
Enlightened by her untapped potential, Luca decides to personally coach Donna in the intricate art of Italian ballet.

Within weeks, Donna's unique fusion of her signature Bedminster jazz style and traditional Italian ballet captivates the academy's director, the stoic Mr. Ilario, resulting in her surprising selection for the annual ballet gala named 'Canzone e Danza.'
The intimidating task of performing at 'Canzone e Danza' takes a toll on Donna's confidence, making her unblemished pirouette skeptical, and her once vibrant demeanor dimmed.
Sensing Donna's emerging vulnerability, the cunning Isabella seizes the chance to dismantle her morale further by discreetly undermining her unconventional dance style.
However, Donna resolves to resist Isabella's intimidation and the looming fear of failure, firming her determination to excel with each passing day.
Fueled by Maria's unwavering belief in her and Luca's rigorous training sessions, Donna transposes her fear into relentless passion, standing unyielding in her pursuit to master Italian ballet.
The strenuous yet rewarding endeavors coupled with their shared vision for the art, eventually forms an intimate connection between Donna and Luca.
Unexpectedly, an unfortunate misunderstanding regarding Donna's talent overshadowing Luca's expertise in their harmonized performance leads to a strained period of detachment and coldness.

Acknowledging his hasty misinterpretation, Luca extends his sincere apologies to Donna, his repentant eyes unintentionally confessing his feelings that had been gradually turning into love since their training commenced.
This shared moment of vulnerability not only manages to mend the existing rift but also resurrects Luca's own dwindling passion for ballet.
Witnessing their budding relationship grow stronger with time, a bitter Isabella succumbs to jealousy and plots vicious schemes to ruin Donna's most anticipated performance at the gala.
Alert to Isabella's tactics, Donna readies herself mentally to tackle any last-minute obstacles that may surface on her big night.

On the highly awaited gala evening, Donna delivers an astonishing performance, amalgamating the peppy beats of Jersey Jazz with the soulful rhythm of Roman Ballet, creating an unheard fusion that leaves the audience spellbound.
The audience, dazzled by her extraordinary performance uniformly rises in applause, making the gala night unforgettable for the diligent ballerina.
Donna's triumphant dance garners her a much-deserved place in the elite academy and simultaneously, she wins a special place in Luca's heart.
After the outstanding gala night, Donna and Luca find themselves nestled in a private pas de deux on Rome's cobblestone, their synchronized dance mirroring their shared emotions.
Post-gala, Donna's dance style continues to charm the 'Accademia di Ballo di Roma,' propelling her from anonymity to admiration amid her peers.
Over time, even the rival Isabella begins to acknowledge Donna's exceptional talent, her initial resentment fading into acceptance.
As Donna delves deeper into the mastery of ballet, her relationship with Luca matures, their shared dedication to dance fostering a deeper connection.
The final scene captures the captivating couple swaying rhythmically under the stars on Rome's iconic Spanish steps, aptly marking an end to Donna's unforgettable ballet journey.

63086515.title: Birds of Paradise (2021 film)
synopsis: Kate Sanders is a newly arrived student at a prestigious ballet academy in Paris.
The students at the school are all competing for "the prize"; a contract with a ballet company which will be awarded to the best male and female dancers.
On her first day, she makes a comment about Ollie, a renowned former student who committed suicide by jumping off a bridge.
This causes Ollie's sister, Marine Durand, to attack her.
The altercation leaves Marine disheveled, resulting in criticism from the academy's exacting headmistress, Madame Brunelle.
That night, Kate finds that she has been assigned to live in the same room as Marine.
Marine suggests that the two go to The Jungle, a botanical themed dance club where they do drugs.
Marine challenges Kate to a dance contest where the first one to stop dancing will be forced to drop out.
After an extended time of dancing, Kate suggests to an exhausted Marine that they both stop at the same time so that neither has to drop out.
When Kate abides by her promise to stop dancing, she earns Marine's respect and friendship.
Marine and Kate grow closer over the ensuing weeks.

As they prepare for the dance which will determine the winner of the prize, they, along with most of the other female students, hope to be paired with Felipe, who is widely regarded as the best male dancer at the academy.
Marine and Kate begin to confide more in each other.
Kate reveals that she is from a working class background and is attending the academy on a scholarship.
Marine, who has lived in Paris for years, is the daughter of the US Ambassador to France.
Marine must attend a party at the embassy, where it is revealed that Kate's scholarship is funded by Marine's family.
Her mother, seeing Kate as potential competition, threatens to revoke the scholarship, but Marine defends Kate.
Marine performs an impromptu dance sequence which ends with her knocking over a tray of drinks and injuring her feet on the broken glass.
She is comforted by Jamal, a drummer from the band working the party.
The two of them begin a sexual relationship.
Meanwhile, fellow dancer Jean Paul offers to supply Kate with drugs, an offer which she rebuffs.
Kate encounters financial difficulty paying for new shoes and is helped out by fellow dancer Gigi.
Becoming more stressed out by practice, she turns to Jean Paul for drugs and has sex with Felipe.
Marine and Kate have dinner with Marine's mother, who verbally undermines Marine's dance skills.
Kate defends her.
At the academy, the two of them make a pact that they will work together to jointly win the prize.
They have a threesome with Felipe.
Marine breaks up with Jamal, having become emotionally involved with Kate.
Marine reveals to Kate that she blames herself for Ollie's death.
The two of them had been dancing passionately at their home and their mother mistakenly believed they were having sex.
Afterwards, Ollie began using drugs.
On the night he killed himself, Marine ignored his phone calls.
Kate comforts Marine, insisting that it wasn't her fault.
As the day of the prize draws nearer, Kate rises in the class rankings, while Marine often struggles.
The students learn of another opportunity: dancer and choreographer Benjamin Mouton is going to offer one of them the job as understudy to his principal ballerina.
Kate quickly becomes frontrunner for the position.
Kate learns that her scholarship has been cancelled and that her father has to sell their house to pay for her tuition.
Benjamin tells her how a donor once forced him to pick a ballerina by threatening to cut off funds.
An enraged Kate accuses Marine of having her parents withdraw the scholarship.
The next day, Marine learns that Kate has told the other students that Marine and Ollie were having sex.
Marine is comforted by Madame Brunelle, who recounts her own difficulties as a ballerina.
She leaves Marine with a motto: "Blessed is she who falls.
Blessed is she who rises again."
Marine, who has been paired with Felipe, offers to dance solo at the final contest and Felipe is reassigned to Kate.
At the contest, Marine dances an avant garde routine of her own design, before storming out.
Fellow dancer Luc, compliments her as a great choreographer and says he will be honored to dance for her one day.
Kate wins the prize.
Three years later, Kate is a wildly successful ballerina, headlining her own show.
After a show she is approached by Marine.
Marine says that she still dances, mainly at The Jungle.
She thanks Kate, saying that her one time friend's actions forced her to move out of her comfort zone and that she is truly happy for the first time in her life.
Kate drives away, but returns and yells at Marine that she should hate Kate for how she betrayed her.
Marine responds with Madame Brunelle's motto: "Blessed is she who falls.
Blessed is she who rises again."
At The Jungle, Kate dances a routine choreographed by Marine and rises into the air.

87671415.title: The Terrifying Tour of the Trendy District
synopsis: The film opens with Megan and Lily, two best friends and creative artists, packing up their treasured belongings in their eclectic Greenwich Village loft.
Ready to open a new chapter in the ritzy Upper East Side, the vibrant duo, a talented painter named Megan, and an insightful writer named Lily, hop into an iconic yellow New York cab.
They pull up to their new home - a towering, luxury residential complex that pierces the New York sky with its opulence.
Here, they meet Jasper, their landlord, who presents them with keys to their penthouse suite and slyly warns them about the unspoken rules of the prestigious district.
Over several days, Megan and Lily immerse themselves in their new environment which is vastly different from the artsy crowd they used to mingle within Greenwich Village.
As the days passed, they began to notice strange behaviors among their well-heeled neighbors.
An embossed invitation arrives, requesting their presence at a grand social gathering in the building's ornate ballroom.
Throughout the night, chilling anecdotes unfurl about the building's grim past and eerie tales about its former residencies.
The pall of suspense grows as they discover a concealed room tucked away in their penthouse suite.

The clandestine chamber is filled with morbid mementos, piles of decaying newspaper clippings that hinted at missing persons, and a leather-bound diary filled with dark entries by former inhabitants of the penthouse.
One restless night, Megan notices an old 19th-century oil painting in the secret room that appears to morph right before her eyes.
The narrative takes a spine-chilling turn when Megan suddenly disappears without a trace, leading to Lily becoming consumed with dread.
Determined to find her friend, Lily turns to a trustworthy resident - Henry, an eccentric violinist who lived in the same building.
They resolve to uncover the haunting history hidden within the building's walls.
An adventurous dive into the annals of the building reveals a series of disappearances, each linked to newcomers taking up residence in the suite Megan and Lily inhabited.

The revelation leaves them devastated as they uncover the building's prosperity was founded on a wicked curse; a ritual sacrifice of unsuspecting newcomers to maintain the district's opulence and glory.
Piecing together the puzzle, they realize that their landlord Jasper was not simply a bystander.
He was the orchestrator of this eerie tradition.
Lily and Henry strategize a plan to confront Jasper, expose his dark secret, and save Megan and potentially future residents from the ghastly curse.
The film's climax is heart-stopping as they dodge traps set up by Jasper, outwitting him and unveiling his wicked secrets to the NYPD.
Lily and Henry manage to not only rescue Megan but also shatter the curse looming over the building, safeguarding its future inhabitants.
They etch a cryptic warning onto the grand front door of the building, before fleeing the tainted glitz of the Upper East Side, returning safely back in their beloved Greenwich loft.
Resolved to be more cautious with their future endeavors, they discuss their next steps, reflecting on the important lessons their frightful experience has taught them.
The story becomes a profound cautionary tale, warning about the deceitful facade hiding beneath the glittering allure of affluence and prestige.

66947886.title: The Scary of Sixty-First
synopsis: Noelle and Addie are young adults who are viewing an apartment on the Upper East Side of Manhattan.
Despite peculiar elements of the apartment, including abandoned furnishings and a suspicious realtor, the two move in.
On their first evening there, Noelle finds a tarot card, while Addie is plagued by nightmares.
A mysterious girl shows up at the apartment, having previously been spotted by Noelle and Addie looking inside from the street.
Initially posing as a realtor, she reveals that she is there to investigate notorious sex trafficker Jeffrey Epstein.
She believes that the apartment was previously owned by Epstein, and suggests that crimes, including child prostitution and murder, may have taken place there.
Noelle and the girl begin to obsessively research conspiracy theories surrounding Epstein's death and his alleged activities, and eventually begin a romantic relationship.
Meanwhile, Addie becomes psychologically disturbed, seemingly as a result of living in the apartment.
She wanders the streets of Manhattan in a daze.

During sex with her boyfriend Greg, she asks him to pretend they are on Epstein's Lolita Express private jet, and engages in ageplay, demanding Greg to treat her like she is 13 years old in a voice that is not her own; she has no memory of the events immediately afterward.
She also masturbates to images of Prince Andrew, who was an associate of Epstein's, while dressing and behaving childishly.
Noelle and the girl's research reveals two other Epstein properties five blocks away from the apartment on either side; Noelle suggests a connection to the pentagram.
The girl reveals that she also found a tarot card, this one in Addie's bedroom.
The two visit a "magical apothecary" to discover the meaning behind the cards, whose owner warns them to leave the apartment immediately and gives them an obsidian crystal for protection.
They return to the apartment to find Addie, still seemingly entranced and sexually obsessed with Prince Andrew.
Noelle and the girl visit the Metropolitan Correctional Center where Epstein died, only to find Addie there, dressed similarly to a young girl pictured in a photo with Epstein.
The two meet Greg at his work and learn the story of the bizarre sexual encounter between him and Addie.
The girl suggests that Addie is a victim of CIA mind control experiments, similar to Project MKUltra.
Describing Addie as a "liability", the girl implies that she should be killed, which Noelle angrily rejects.
The girl returns to the apartment to find the door chained shut, and evidence of Addie's masturbatory activities.
She flees to the apartment's basement to find Addie before a large poster of The Sun tarot card, which includes depictions of nude children.
When she discovers the girl's presence, Addie knocks her unconscious and begins to abuse her physically and sexually.
She is interrupted by the arrival of Noelle, who kills her by stabbing her repeatedly with a knife.
She returns to the apartment to meet the realtor who first showed them the apartment; their conversation implies that Addie's death was a planned part of a Satanic ritual.
The girl regains consciousness and finds Noelle in the apartment.
Noelle attacks her and attempts to kill her, but the girl fights back, bashing Noelle's skull with the obsidian crystal.
She rushes to Greg's workplace, but when the two return together, the apartment and the basement are empty and clean, with no bodies or evidence of a struggle.
Greg leaves angrily.
The girl returns to the apartment to find an anonymous note, telling her that the events she experienced are a warning for her to give up her investigations.

67666054.title: Academic Beats and Unexpected Love
synopsis: The film starts by introducing Ethan, a high school senior with a voracious appetite for knowledge.
Professor David, Ethan's father, is a stern academic who emphasizes the importance of higher education and expects nothing less from his son.
One day, Ethan stumbles upon a music blog featuring underground hip-hop music.
A few days later, he sees a flyer advertising a concert by Killer Klass, a celebrated hip-hop artist.
Ethan decides to attend the concert.
At the concert, he meets Mia, a spirited aspiring hip-hop dancer.
Their friendship blossoms into romance, filled with shared playlists, impromptu dance-offs, and mutual adoration for hip-hop culture.
Ethan's academic performance starts to decline as he spends less time studying and more time practicing dance and learning about hip-hop culture.
His poor academic performance raises concerns among his teachers and classmates.
Ethan struggles internally with his academic persona nurtured by his father and his newfound passion for hip-hop.
His two lives collide when Professor David discovers Ethan's secret life.
Ethan chooses his love for hip-hop over his father's dreams for his academic future, straining their relationship.
Professor David severs his ties with Ethan, leaving him alone to pursue his chosen path.
Ethan continues to immerse himself in the hip-hop scene.
He fails several times during dance battles, leading to self-doubt and questioning of his choice to abandon academics.
However, he overcomes these hurdles and improves his dance moves.
Meanwhile, Professor David feels regret and longs to mend their strained relationship.
Ethan spots an ad for a regional hip-hop contest and signs up.
He sees this as an opportunity to gain acceptance and respect for his decision to pursue hip-hop.
During the contest, he spots his father in the audience.
Consumed by his father's presence, Ethan pours his heart into his performance and ends up winning the contest.
Professor David, humbled by his son's success, learns to respect his son's chosen path and becomes his most vocal supporter.
Their strained relationship improves over time and they form a stronger bond.
Ethan enjoys a successful career as a hip-hop artist, representing young individuals caught between their dreams and societal pressure.
The film concludes with Ethan enjoying success, his father proud and supportive at his side.
The screen fades out on a life dedicated to passion, dreams, and understanding.

63985777.title: Life in a Year
synopsis: Groomed to get into Harvard by his father Xavier, Daryn meets a girl named Isabelle one night while trying to sneak into a rapper’s concert and is instantly drawn to her.
He courts and eventually falls in love with her but when Daryn confesses his love, Isabelle reveals that she has cancer and doesn't have much time left.
So, Daryn makes a plan to live a life in a year.
Isabelle recognises his potential as a rapper and helps him to make his first demo CD.
When Daryn takes her to meet his parents.
Xavier, disliking Isabelle, uses the moment to fire questions at her.
He concludes by saying it is his responsibility to protect his son from distractions, such as girls; especially those like Isabelle.
Feeling offended and rejected, Isabelle and her drag queen, parental figure Phil leave and Daryn is left alone and depressed.
A few days later, Daryn is shortlisted at Harvard and he attends his interview with his father.
When asked what skills and abilities he has, he loses himself to memories of Isabelle.
To his father's disappointment, he ends up saying worthless things and excuses himself.
Later at home, Daryn quarrels with his father and is almost punched by him but his mother intervenes and stops the fight.
Daryn goes to Isabelle and apologizes, deciding to abandon his family and leave town with Isabelle.
The two spend days together, and one day Daryn tries to surprise her by driving her to her mother's.
He convinces her to talk with her, but when she does, her mother recognizes her but tells her to leave.
Feeling rejected, Isabelle asks Daryn to drive away.
While driving, an upset Isabelle starts yelling and shouting at Daryn, distracting him so he crashes into a bush near the beach.
When Isabelle gets out, she becomes unconscious.
Daryn calls for help, and manages to get Isabelle to the hospital.
A few days after Isabelle is discharged, her mother comes to visit but soon leaves.
Daryn's mother discovers that he is back in town and decides to see them.
Isabelle suggests that Daryn take a break from taking care of her just for the day, as his mother is around.
Daryn uses the opportunity to record his second song.
When Daryn gets back, he finds his mother panicking and Isabelle on the floor, unconscious and bleeding through her mouth.
They get her to the hospital and there, they discover that Isabelle's cancer has spread and her organs are shutting down.
The nurse concludes by saying that Isabelle has only a few weeks left.
Soon after Isabelle is discharged, she surprises Daryn with a wedding.
They get married and consummate their love, Isabelle passes away a short time later.
Daryn reconciles with his father and moves to New York City to pursue a career in music after graduating.

82184879.title: Legion of Cashiers
synopsis: As our film begins, we get treated to an extensively detailed bird's eye view of Munich, the camera slowly closing in on the imposing, stone-cold structure of Dragon Bank located in the city's heart.
Inside this hive of financial activity thrives Alexander, a bright yet overlooked young financial analyst, trapped in an uneventful work life.
We witness Alexander's life unfolding day after day, a never-ending cycle of routine paperwork and exhaustive excel-based auditing.

As a byproduct of this frustration, Alexander begins to delve deeper into the bank's financial records, where he stumbles upon an unnoticed peculiarity - a minuscule fraction of the bank's daily revenue seemingly evaporating from the main account.
Over numerous weeks, he painstakingly records these irregularities, each entry serving as a stepping stone towards a daring and devious plan he is forming within his mind.
Keeping his findings under wraps, Alexander handpicks four of his most trusted colleagues to discuss his peculiar discovery over a clandestine meeting.
The audacious proposition he has to offer manifests in the form of 'Legion of Cashiers', a prodigal team conceived with the intent of exploiting the bank's overlooked financial idiosyncrasy.
Decked with awe and disbelief, the group listens as Alexander meticulously unpacks his complex plan.
After an amusing series of trial and errors, the team finally hits the bull's eye, executing their scheme successfully for the first time.
The initial operation results in the diversion of a subtle but significant chunk of the bank's money.
Observing these unprecedented lifestyle changes, the bank's top brass starts gnawing on the seeds of suspicion.
The group initially brushes off these inklings of doubt as mere office jealousy, ignorant of the perilous storm brewing.
Unable to stomach the recurring financial irregularities, the bank's management invites a high-profile external auditor to unearth the root of these inexplicable losses.
Panic creeps into the Legion's ranks, leading them to scramble in a desperate attempt to keep their operations under wraps while combating the auditors' prying eyes.
Overwhelmed by nervousness, the group's cautious member, Max, capitulates and shockingly abandons the team.
This abrupt desertion shakes the team's harmony, planting seeds of mistrust and amplifying the sense of uncertainty among the remaining members.
Drawing strength from their individual skills, they pledge allegiance to one another, resolving to face the crisis as a united front.
Making the decision to gamble on one last, high-stakes operation- a courageous all-or-nothing final blow.
As the wheels of their plan set in motion, the auditors manage to unlock the truth behind the exploitable financial glitch in Dragon Bank's system.
The auditors' scrutiny veers relentlessly towards the 'Legion of Cashiers'.
Despite their imminent downfall hanging over their heads, the group channels any remaining courage to bring their intricate plan to life.
They skillfully patch the financial loophole in Dragon Bank's accounting, side-tracking the auditors' investigation.
An epiphany that newfound freedom outweighed their ill-begotten wealth prompts the team to unanimously vote for disbandment.
Amid all this chaos, a clandestine romance blossoms between Alexander and Clara, another Legion member.
With the dissolution of the 'Legion', the remaining members retreat back to their familiar banking lives - their identities altered yet concealed.
They join the ranks of Dragon Bank's anonymous workforce, their identities safe behind the curtain of their usual routine.
Beaten and bewildered, the auditors are forced to prematurely end their investigation in the absence of concrete evidence.
Alexander's life rolls back to its routine rhythm but with noteworthy additions: his newfound contentment at work, a budding romance, and a taste for the extraordinary in life.
Each member of the disbanded 'Legion' resumes their banking career, bound by an enticing secret they shared.
They regard their audacious feat not with a criminal's guilt, but with an ordinary person's pride for having seized an unexpected opportunity.
Their surface-level drudgery hides a deep-seated bond of camaraderie, a shared secret tethering them for life.
As they continue their drab tasks, their heady adventures are reduced to fading memories, occasionally revived by knowing looks and hush-hush smiles shared between them.
Mundanity envelops Dragon Bank once again, but it now fosters an audacious secret beneath its veneer of drudgery.
The film ends on a hopeful note, subtly hinting at the mundane life's hidden thrills and the potential of what daring, unconventional endeavors could lie in the future.

65213428.title: Army of Thieves
synopsis: Sebastian Schlencht-Wöhnert has a mundane life as a bank teller in Potsdam, Germany.
A zombie outbreak in Nevada dominates international news, giving him nightmares about zombies.
He also produces YouTube videos about safecracking that receive no attention until a mysterious figure comments on his most recent, inviting him to an underground safecracking competition.
Sebastian wins the contest and is introduced to Gwendoline Starr, a skilled jewel thief who had commented upon his YouTube video.

Gwendoline recruits Sebastian into a heist crew consisting of herself, expert hacker Korina Dominguez, getaway driver Rolph and gunman Brad Cage to break into three banks that have the three safes created by legendary locksmith Hans Wagner, which currently belongs to billionaire Bly Tanaka.
The safes will be decommissioned in less than a week, so time is running out for someone to break into them.
Sebastian, a theoretical expert on Wagner's work and safecracking but with no practical experience, is convinced by Gwendoline to join them for the challenge of breaking into a Wagner safe.
Together, the crew successfully undertake their heist of the first safe in Paris, escaping with only a fraction of the money that is actually in it.
Gwendoline justifies this as the challenge and reputation being better than any major monetary gain.
As the crew celebrates after the Paris heist, Sebastian develops feelings for Gwendoline, drawing jealousy from Brad, her boyfriend since their teenage years, learning his real name was Alexis.

The crew travels to Prague, the location of the second safe, and are followed by Delacroix, an obsessive Interpol agent leading a unit that has been trying to capture Gwendoline and the crew for years after Brad shot him during a theft.
Sebastian and Gwendoline enter the bank but are soon identified by security, forcing Brad to create a distraction with a pretend robbery.
Sebastian cracks the second safe, leaving with Gwendoline and another haul of money as Delacroix and his team race to the bank to stop them.
Brad is shot in the shoulder by a security guard and narrowly escapes the bank, ahead of Sebastian and Gwendoline.
Brad deliberately leaves Sebastian behind as the team flees, forcing him to shake off the pursuing police alone.
Angry at Brad's actions, Gwendoline and Korina leave the crew.
However, the original plan was to ditch Sebastian after the three heists were complete.
The women head back to Potsdam and reunite with Sebastian, telling him that the pursuit of the Wagner challenge is more important to them than any monetary gain.
The trio heads to St. Moritz, location of the last safe in Europe, while Interpol also arrives.
Delacroix's team believes they have a lead on the theft, only to be tricked again by them.
They hijacked the safe during its transfer from the casino.
Their hijacking also usurps Brad and Rolph's idea of robbing the safe.
Gwendoline and Sebastian leave St. Moritz on a lorry, chased by Brad and Rolph.
Korina, caught by Interpol, manages to warn them about the other two before selling them out in exchange for her family's safety.
Sebastian has to crack the safe in the lorry while Brad, Rolph, and Interpol pursue them.
He succeeds, finding another large haul of cash.
However, before they can leave with it, Rolph and an increasingly unstable Brad arrive.
Gwendoline overpowers and handcuffs them to the truck for Interpol to find before leaving with Sebastian.
Before escaping on a boat from the town of Hallstatt, Austria, Sebastian and Gwendoline confess their mutual feelings.
However, Delacroix catches them, resulting in a standoff between him and Gwendoline.
Out of love for Sebastian, she sacrifices herself to be arrested so that he can escape, promising to find him once she is free.
Sebastian goes, vowing he will be reunited with Gwendoline one day.
Later, Scott Ward and Maria Cruz find Sebastian's (now by Ludwig Dieter's name) locksmith shop in California.
They offer him the chance to crack Wagner's legendary "missing" safe, which Gwendoline and Sebastian had resolved to break together once she was free; Ludwig accepts the job.

87516348.title: Bottled Up: Austin Grillers (2020 film)
synopsis: Embedded deep within the animated city landscape of Austin, Texas, Jacob, fresh out of community college, finds himself entwined in the day-to-day operation of his family's quaint Southern eatery named Austin Grillers.
Additionally, his responsibilities extend to the family's inherited corner liquor store, their apparent secondary source of income.
Despite this, Jacob's heart pounds for the art of brewing, a passion met with repeated disdain from his orthodox father, George.
Overseeing both the management and culinary aspects of the restaurant is a heavy responsibility for Jacob.
His mother, Linda, with her gentle demeanor, openly depended on him, especially considering the significant financial losses their family business had recently suffered.

In the midst of this grueling monotony, a pleasant surprise wafts into Jacob's life one sunny afternoon, when he crosses paths with a vibrant Marketing freshman, Emily, from the revered University of Texas.
Their meeting takes place in the very restaurant he was devoting his efforts to keeping alive.
As Jacob treads the tightrope between meeting his family's expectations and kindling his brewing aspirations, he finds tranquillity in an unexpected place: a makeshift brewing station.
He establishes it in the dim recesses of his home garage, devoting his sparse leisure hours to experiment and refine his brewing skills.
Jacob's brewing sanctuary is discovered by Emily, who stumbles upon his brewing station during one of her numerous visits.
Emily exhibits genuine interest in his brewing exploits, seeing potential in his efforts and dedication.
Emily suggests he submits his unique homebrew to the annual Austin Brewing Championship.
Despite the potential risk of increasing their financial burden, Jacob, inspired by Emily's faith in him, makes the daring decision to participate in the contest.
Jacob commits to perfecting his brewing recipes while Emily draws from her academic prowess to formulate potent marketing strategies and business plans to drive their project forward.
Their collective resolve experiences a significant challenge when George inadvertently discovers his son's brewing project, leading to an intense confrontation within the family.
George, his sense of betrayal openly apparent, responds by barring Jacob from taking part in managing the family restaurant.
Despite the setback, Jacob, reinforced by Emily's unwavering support, continues his brewing endeavors, honing his craft to create the perfect beer recipe.
Passion flourishes between Emily and Jacob, manifesting into a romantic relationship.
Their shared dream -- establishing Austin Grillers as a successful eatery-cum-brewery.
As the championship day races closer, the stakes escalate exponentially.
Jacob's beer recipe is declared the winner at the Austin Brewing Championship.
His victory is a testament to his brewing skills and his unyielding perseverance.
Meanwhile, a popular food blogger visits Austin Grillers and appreciates its authentic Southern offerings in a widely read blog post that goes viral, amassing unprecedented attention.
The unexpected praise by the influential food blogger attracts newfound clientele to Austin Grillers, and the business starts experiencing a surge in revenue and popularity.

Regret gnawing at him, George mends his strained relations with Jacob, accepting his mistake and sets aside a designated space within their restaurant for Jacob to add a flag of his beer brewing brilliance.
Now with an open commitment, Emily and Jacob combine their shared passion and distinct skills to strategically reshape the future of Austin Grillers.
Together, they integrate both the family restaurant and the liquor store into a combined food and beer business venture.
The refurbished eatery is reborn as 'Austin Grillers and Brew,' a sophisticated yet warm multi-cuisine restaurant and pub.
Under Emily's strategic marketing finesse and Jacob's brewing prowess, the fresh 'Austin Grillers and Brew' experiences an unparalleled, triumphant success.
Jacob finds a balance in juggling the roles of restaurant manager, master brewer, and familial responsibilities.
The rebranded Austin Grillers and Brew becomes a fashionable destination for Austin's foodies and brewing enthusiasts.
The business's success reinstates George's faith in Jacob, strengthening the bond within the Grillers' family.
Emily's innovative marketing approach earns her recognition among Austin's thriving business fraternity.
The successful integration of traditional grilling techniques with a modern microbrewery appeals immensely to the youthful crowd.
Jacob manages to cater to his passion for brewing and his familial obligations.
Witnessing this wave of positive change, Linda's faith in her son's abilities surges dramatically.
The Grillers succeed in preserving their beloved family restaurant, backing it up with a brilliant launch of Jacob's brewing venture into the competitive Austin craft beer market.

As time heals the wounds within the family, the new generation, supported by Emily's marketing knowledge and Jacob's brewing skills, introduces a wave of innovative brewing traditions and refreshed culinary techniques.
Jacob's journey echoes as a resounding inspiration for many.
Austin Grillers and Brew has metamorphosed into an emblem of individual dedication, undying love, and unwavering ambition.
It stands as a testament of Southern cuisine's rich flavors, skillfully paired with Jacob's individually crafted beers.

The narrative concludes with a reflective Jacob, standing amidst the bustling "Austin Grillers and Brew," admiring his dream transformed into reality, overwhelmed by the journey fraught with trials, triumphs, and the unfailing belief in chasing one's dreams against all odds.

59483535.title: Uncorked (2020 film)
synopsis: Elijah works both at a wine business and at his family's local barbecue restaurant in Memphis, TN, where his father Louis and mother Sylvia also work.
His grandfather struggled and worked very hard to build the successful business and Louis expects Elijah to take it over someday.
Eli is not interested and wants to do his own thing, so he's leaning torward wine.
At a large family dinner, Eli's dad openly criticises him for forgetting something for the restaurant, so Elijah admits he was at an open mixer for a sommelier school.
Louis makes it seem like he is flighty, changing his mind as to what he wants constantly.
That night, Sylvia calls Louis out for not supporting their son.
He is frustrated at Elijah's lack of interest in the restaurant Elijah meets Tanya at the wine shop and they go on a date at a roller rink.
He tells her about how he became interested in wine, and expresses his aspiration to become a master sommelier.
Seeing his passion for it, Tanya encourages him to pursue his dream.
Elijah takes the grueling entrance exam for the Master Sommelier program and earns admittance.
Looking for his father, Elijah finds him at a location for a second restaurant he plans on opening.
Louis details his plans for the place, and finally he directly tells him he doesn't want it.
Eli announces that he's going back to school for the training, and investing all of his savings into it.
However, he also promises to continue working.
To improve their chances, Eli joins a study group.
When they are told the class is invited to an exchange program in Paris, he realizes he won't be able to afford it.
Classmate Harvard offers to split it with him, so Elijah raises the rest of the money he needs through fundraising in his extended family and selling his car.
Elijah has a major financial setback when Harvard's father calls him back home.
He is expected to return to work with him at Citibank.
While in Paris Elijah learns Sylvia's cancer, which had been in remission for two years, has metastasized.
However, she insists he stay in France and wires him money despite Louis's disapproval.
Sylvia dies, and Elijah returns home for the funeral.
He tries to concentrate, but is constantly distracted, thinking about his mom.
Eli begins missing classes for his sommelier program in order to help Louis at the family restaurant.
Eventually, Elijah is forced to withdraw from the program.
Louis gives in and, with Tanya and others, helps Elijah study for the master sommelier exam.
He takes his exam and later finds out that he did not pass, so returns to his two jobs.
Sometime thereafter, out to dinner one night with Tanya, he comes across one of his friends who'd struggled in the study group but still became a master sommelier.
Inspired, Elijah reenrolls in the program.

11436303.title: Promise (2021 film)
synopsis: High-profile lawyer Carla Dempsey and her influential software entrepreneur husband Liam Frost, stroll hand in hand through the labyrinthine streets of polished steel and glass skyscrapers of downtown Los Angeles.
Their palpable, affection-filled connection strikes a poignant contrast against the hustling, corporate cityscape.

Emotion-laden flashbacks guide us through the different chapters of their enriching love story — from inseparable high-school sweethearts messing around in the sleepy town of Ventura, classrooms turning into chatrooms about their future, to the influential power couple of Beverly Hills epitomizing the new-age American Dream.
Carla and Liam negotiate the relentless barrage of challenges that their professional life throws at them.
The couple's lives take a harrowing detour when Carla's mother, a revered journalist and an unwavering pillar of her life, succumbs to a grueling battle with cancer.
Going through the painstaking process of packing away her mother's prized belongings, Carla stumbles upon a concealed, dusty-old letter tucked away in the crypt-like mahogany chest.
Unfolding the yellowed page, her heart sinks as the shocking revelation seeps in - she was adopted from a family deeply entrenched in LA's nefarious underworld.
With an imploding heart, Carla rushes to her family estate - a painstakingly preserved ranch-style house.
Bursting through the doors, she confronts her father, demanding answers about the life she never knew existed, challenging the very foundations of their familial bond.
Her father, a man that exudes firmness, cracks under the pressure of his daughter's heart-wrenching pleas for the truth.
He tells her that her biological parents were deeply involved in the East LA Bratva.
They adopted her to save her from having to grow up amidst the dense fog of violence and power struggles.
Absorbing the life-altering revelation, Carla decides to share her secret with Liam.
At their favorite intimate Italian eatery, amidst flickering candlelight and a half-eaten lasagna, she pours out her tormented heart.
Liam, shaking with the impact of the news, holds Carla in his comforting embrace.
He pulls her closer, whispering reassurances of his undying love and unwavering support into her ear.
He promises to stand alongside her, no matter how menacing the storm.
With a resolute unity, they make the brave decision to unearth the brutal history of Carla's biological family, unknowingly plunging into the grimy, illicit underbelly of Los Angeles.
As they delve deeper into their pursuit, the investigation becomes a leviathan that threatens to capsize the ship of their highly-respected professional lives.
Their lives, meticulously built on the pillars of success and companionship, become a house of cards standing against a mounting tempest.
Their lives take another dreadful twist when Liam is abducted by an ominous figure - thought to be a disgruntled member of the crime syndicate who mistakes him to be a law enforcement informant.
Carla, devastated by Liam's sudden disappearance, is left alone to grapple with her fears.
Her despair, however, metamorphoses into an iron determination.
She decides to take matters into her own hands, stooping into the perilous world of crime syndicates to rescue Liam, injecting raw courage into her deep-seated love.

Through her relentless perseverance and painstakingly gathered breadcrumbs of information, she discovers that her biological parents were innocents, callously framed by their treacherous 'friends' in the unforgiving syndicate.
Armed with this critical information, Carla confronts the syndicate at their clandestine warehouse hideout.
Displaying unflinching nerve, she offers a daring deal — secure Liam's release in exchange for her solemn vow to stop digging into the past, a promise laced with conviction and desperation.
The syndicate, after intense deliberation inside their heavily-fortified bunker, succumbs to Carla's relentless resolve.
They grant Liam's release, slightly bewildered and traumatized but physically unharmed.
Freed but irrevocably changed, Liam and Carla could not return to their former, pampered lives.
Trading their luxuries for a sprint into vigilante justice, they decide to join forces with Sergeant Martinez's hardened LAPD squad.
Their shared agenda - to dismantle the shadowy syndicate that disrupted their calm existence while mercilessly wreaking havoc through the city.
Through sleepless nights fueled by endless caffeine, they team up with the seasoned police squad.
Bit by bit, they go about weaving an intricate strategy, a masterstroke designed to ensnare the notorious gang that disturbed the tranquility of their lives.
The day of the operation breaks with the growing hum of anticipation.
