Carla and Liam, armed with kevlar and a spirit of justice, sit huddled in a nondescript van parked a stone's throw away from the syndicate's hideout.

With infrared lasers during the dead of the night scanning their every micro-movement, they march into the dimly lit syndicate's den, teetering on the razor-thin edge between victory and impersonal defeat.
The operation unfolds exceptionally smooth, a real-life thriller climax that ends with the impounding of the syndicate's finances and the arrest of its ruthless leaders.
With their determination molded into a granite-hard fortitude, they begin the arduous task of piling together the remnants of their shattered life.
No longer the aloof power couple of Beverly Hills, they find solace in their new reality.
Their relationship, battered by the ferocity of adversities, emerges stronger and unfaltering.
Their bond develops into an unbreakable fortress, their love story scribbled with the impassioned ink of unwavering support and trust.
As they rebuild the fragments of their life, they decide to bring in a new chapter of love.
In a heart-touching twist, they navigate the laborious yet emotionally gratifying process of adoption.
Their decision to open their hearts and home to an innocent child subtly mirrors the trajectory of Carla's own life, spinning an artful parallel.
It nurse a new beacon of hope, a symbol of love birthed from the ashes of shattered existences.
Carla and Liam's transformation from smitten high-school sweethearts in Ventura to revered saviors of Los Angeles becomes an awe-inspiring tale.
As they gracefully step into their new roles as doting adoptive parents and inspiring community leaders, the camera pans out, the faded Hollywood sign forming a poignant backdrop.
The sun dips into the Pacific, casting long shadows across Los Angeles as the credits rolled over the sunset canvas.
Their eyes, glowing with unwavering determination, gaze into a future that might throw at them.
Yet, they stand strong, prepared to face any challenge that life dares to toss their way.
Their love tale that bloomed in the confines of a high-school dance has evolved from innocent teenage fancy to profound, indestructible camaraderie.
Their bond encompasses the strength of their struggle and the passion of their love.

66692392.title: Trust (2021 film)
synopsis: In New York City, Brooke Gatwick and Owen Shore are a young married couple who have been together since high school.
Recently, they have been struggling with starting a family and Brooke opening her own art gallery, featuring paintings by Ansgar Doyle.
Ansgar openly expresses an attraction to Brooke and constantly attempts to communicate with her in the middle of the night, irritating Owen.
Owen wants to go to Paris for Christmas and secretly buys airplane tickets for after the exhibit’s opening, hoping that decompressing will allow them to conceive a baby.
However, Brooke wants to focus on the gallery.
One night, Brooke sees odd text messages on Owen's phone and thinks that he may be cheating on her.
Ansgar tells Brooke that Damien Light, a film director, is interested in buying his art and wants to meet with them in the Marias Hotel in Paris, which she reluctantly accepts.
Frustrated with Brooke’s sudden departure, Owen accepts an assignment in Las Vegas for when they would have gone to Paris.

Later, Brooke catches Owen leaving in the middle of the night, further increasing her suspicions about his infidelity, especially when he visits an address that's advertised online as a sort of "lovers' nest".
At a bar with his friend, Adam, Owen meets Amy, who says that she's a journalism major at Columbia.
Amy recognizes Owen from his news program and starts flirting with him.
Eventually, Owen takes Amy back to his home, where they have sex.
They are interrupted by Brooke’s text messages.
Owen, regretting their tryst, asks Amy to leave and to never meet again; Amy asks Owen for help with her career after she graduates.
After closing the deal in Paris, Brooke returns early to New York.
Ansgar wants to display a nude painting of Brooke as the centerpiece of his gallery showing.
On the night of the opening, Owen notices how close Ansgar and Brooke seem to be.
Amy appears at the opening and attracts Ansgar’s attention.
Owen lies to Brooke about meeting Amy at a bar the other night.
Owen and Ansgar get into a fight, and Amy asks Ansgar to take her home.
On their way to their apartment, Brooke begins poking holes in Owen’s story and even shows him an autographed napkin that Owen gave Amy the night at the bar.
Owen eventually admits to sleeping with Amy, and Brooke angrily leaves while taking Owen’s phone to see what he's been doing at odd hours of the night.
Ansgar drops Amy off at Brooke and Owen’s apartment, where Amy tells Owen that she met Brooke several days ago.
Brooke's friend Eleanor suggested hiring a "decoy" to test Owen’s faithfulness.
While Amy is at the bar with Owen, Brooke texts her to cancel the ruse, but Amy ignores Brooke.
On the day of the art opening, Amy meets with Brooke and lies about what happened with Owen as well as giving her the autographed napkin as proof that she did meet with him.
Brooke pays Amy and invites her to the opening.
After dropping by Eleanor and Adam’s apartment, Brooke goes through Owen’s phone and finds out that he was not seeing other women but was working on a story about an unfaithful senator.
"Sarah" is really one of Owen's work colleagues and had arranged an apartment for him and Brooke if they go to Paris.
Brooke goes back to her apartment to find Owen and Amy talking.
Amy apologizes for crossing a professional line (after promising Brooke that she wouldn't actually have sex with Owen).
Owen is upset that his wife created a situation that lured him into cheating on her.
Amy gives back the money that Brooke paid her before leaving the apartment.
Owen asks if Brooke cheated on him with Ansgar in Paris, but Brooke refuses to answer.
During Brooke’s time in Paris, Ansgar tries to seduce her.
The movie shows Brooke partially undressed, but Brooke refuses to confirm or deny if she actually had sex with Ansgar.
Owen packs a piece of luggage for his trip to Las Vegas.
Before he leaves, he shows Brooke the tickets that he bought for Paris, which they can still use.
She thinks for a second about the future where she sees a daughter with them in Paris so she accepts him at last.

95314104.title: Northern Ties
synopsis: John Bennett, an ambitious graduate from the illustrious University of Cambridge, had always envisioned his dream career in the financial hub, Goldman Sachs, located in the bustling heart of London.
Before he embarked on this high-powered job, he decided to take a trip to Burlington, Vermont, to forge a bond with family, specifically his older half-brother, Dave, who he had never met before.
The knowledge of Dave's existence was revealed when John stumbled upon his deceased father's private correspondences.
Hidden amidst the aging letters were details about a life his father led, a secret from him until that moment.
Dave was leading a starkly different life, residing in Burlington and earning his livelihood as a robust lobster fisherman.
Setting foot in Burlington, John was captivated by the town's beauty.
John found himself standing in front of a quaint, wooden fishing store called "Dave's Catch."
Seeing the board bearing Dave's name magnified his anticipation of meeting his long-lost sibling.
As the sun dipped below the horizon, Dave returned from his day at sea.
Dave initially kept a guarded demeanor but was eventually moved by John's earnestness and willingness to build a new relationship.
To deepen their bond, Dave invited John onboard his sturdy fishing boat, the "Lobster Leader," the following day.
Amidst the harsh sea environment, John experienced firsthand the satisfaction that came from physical labor.
The stark simplicity of fishery and the tactile interaction with the lobsters was a world away from his protected life.
Under the Vermont sky, the two men opened up to each other, exchanging stories, sharing memories of their shared father, and confiding their aspirations and fears.
Their openness began breaking down the prolonged discomfort, gaining a newfound understanding of each other's differing perspectives.
An unexpected squall hit Dave's boat.
The fierce winds and towering waves posed a risk to Dave's boat, highlighting John's vulnerability against the unforeseen adversary.
John found himself caring more about salvaging Dave's boat in order to preserve the very profession that Dave held close to his heart.
This event brought the two men closer.
Surveying the destruction, John decided it was now his turn to step up and provide assistance.
He created a business and marketing plan to breathe new life into his brother's struggling venture.
His plan involved forging relationships with local restaurant owners and convincing them to source their lobster supply directly from 'Dave's Catch'.
John reached out to his banking contacts in London, securing a loan to mitigate Dave's losses and enable improvements.
This action moved Dave.
Time brought an end to John's stay in Burlington.
It was time for him to return and commence his dream job in London.
After considerable self-reflection, John decided to take a path less traveled.
He submitted his resignation to Goldman Sachs.
The high-rise apartment was traded for a home in Burlington.
John liquidated his savings, buying himself a partnership in Dave's business, 'Dave's Catch.'
John managed to find serenity amidst the seemingly unending cycle of life in Burlington.
Under his management, Dave's struggling business began to bear fruit.
Even as he was involved in his work as a lobster fisherman, he emerged as a considerable influence within the community.
His inspiring journey led to an invitation from Burlington High School, asking him to share his story.
Through the ups and downs of grueling work pressures and evolving family dynamics, Dave and John found their bond growing stronger.
Dave watched as the small town he called home, accepted John as one of their own.
John, once a stranger in his life, now stood tall as a close friend, a business partner, and a recognized figure in the town of Burlington.
Although their father led divergent lives, John and Dave managed to reconcile them through their bond.
In the end, not only did they find a family in each other but also in the embracing charm of Burlington.

70502146.title: Finestkind
synopsis: On a visit to New Bedford, Massachusetts, college alumnus Charlie pays a visit to his elder half-brother Tom Eldrige, a scallop fisherman.
Disillusioned with his systematic life, he asks Tom to take him on his upcoming fishing excursion, which he reluctantly agrees to.
Sailing out on Excelsior's boat, the Harmony, Charlie is introduced to the crew – Nunes a.k.a “Nunesy”, family man Costa, and drug-addict Skeemo.
Hours into the voyage, Harmony suffers an explosion on rough seas, causing it to sink; the crew narrowly survive.
Upon being rescued the following morning, the five go to a bar to celebrate their ordeal, where Charlie encounters Skeemo, a small-time drug dealer.
His wealthy father, Gary Sykes, who tracks him down, attempts to convince him against fishing but is bluntly rebuffed.
Later, the brothers visit Tom’s employers; there, Tom demands to see the maintenance records for the Harmony, but his egotistical boss accuses him of incompetence.
Tom throws his boss against the wall and his boss dares Tom to hit him so that he can press charges.
Charlie dissuades Tom from doing so, and the brothers leave.
Later, Tom is approached by his aging father, Ray, who requests him to take his boat, the Finestkind, on a dredging excursion in his place, which Tom reluctantly acquiesces to.
Later, at a house party hosted by Costa, Tom informs the others of the assignment; whilst there, Mabel takes Charlie for a drug run, during which he meets her skeptical mother.
After the meeting ends poorly, he crashes at Mabel’s apartment, where the two share a passionate night.
Waking up late the next day, the two learn that Tom is about to leave without him; in response, Mabel rushes Charlie to the harbor, barely making it to the Finestkind just as it leaves for sea.
At sea, Tom decides to take the boat discreetly to fish in Canadian waters in the hopes of securing more lucrative catches.
The gambit nearly succeeds, but the boat accidentally ensnares itself in its fishing dredge just as a Canadian aircraft locates them, prematurely ending the excursion.
Returning to port, the Finestkind is seized by U.S. authorities, much to the crew’s dismay.
Resolving to tell Ray of the incident, the two learn he is hospitalized with terminal stomach cancer – the actual reason for his handing over the boat.

Not wanting his father to die without his beloved boat, Tom approaches his former employers to bail him out on the $100,000 fine that had been conditioned for the boat’s release, but is scornfully rejected.
Sympathetic to their plight, Mabel arranges for the crew to participate in a one-time heroin smuggling gig with Weeks, her mother’s partner.
Despite the crew’s acceptance, Tom fears being caught but is convinced otherwise.
The crew sail out to the drop spot, where a plane delivers the heroin.
Returning to port, the brothers head off alone to meet Weeks, but are cornered by a rival drug team, who make away with the heroin after subduing them.
Realizing they are betrayed, Tom accuses Mabel of snitching on them, leading to a fight – which is witnessed by Ray.
Consequently, Weeks corners the crew at Costa’s home, having taken Costa’s pregnant wife hostage.
He forces them to deliver the heroin by the following morning, promising to kill them should they fail; he reveals that he had assaulted Mabel.
After they leave, the crew helps Costa’s wife, whereupon Tom disappears.
Whilst searching for him, Ray corners Charlie, who divulges their quagmire.
The next morning, Charlie meets Nunesy, who tells him that Tom had taken a pistol with him to see Skeemo.
Realizing Skeemo was the snitch, Charlie races over to his place, arriving just as Tom is about to execute him.
Nevertheless, Charlie manages to convince him otherwise, opting to take their chances instead.
Elsewhere, Ray appears at Weeks’ meeting point with an offer of $15,000 in exchange for leaving the crew alone.
When Weeks refuses and proceeds to mock him, Ray shoots him dead – just as the brothers arrive.
Ray explains to an emotionally-moved Tom that he would do anything to save him.
Gary agrees to pay the fine on the boat, realizing he cannot change his son, whilst Mabel prepares to enter college.
Finally free, the crew prepare to sail on the Finestkind once more, while an incarcerated, yet happy Ray watches from a distance.

81394369.title: The Unraveled Identity
synopsis: The story opens in a haunting milieu of translucent apparitions and poignant memories, unraveling the intricately complex love story of Maria Smith and Jake Anderson.
Their initial encounter takes place in a charming, old-fashioned coffee shop, further depicted in a montage of a series of sunshine-drenched beach trips and disagreements over daily routines.
The falling action of the relationship is a raw, tear-filled, separation on a winter night.
Maria lives as a recluse in a compact New York City apartment.
Maria's aging father, John Smith, visits her and suggests that she needs a fresh start.
Moved by her father's earnest concern, Maria decides to relocate to a scenic, congenial town in Vermont.
Maria becomes a marketing executive in a homegrown skincare brand and joins a local women's book club.
Through the book club, she meets Sarah, a seasoned journalist, who becomes a confidante.
Maria persists in her journey towards self-discovery, reconnecting with her long-suppressed dream to write.
She begins to record her experiences and starts to paint.
Maria also enrolls herself in French classes at a nearby community center.
Maria's flashbacks of her past love story with Jake begin to fade.
Maria presents her completed manuscript at the book club.
As Maria's involvement in her new life deepen, she falls in love with her newfound independence.
Maria returns to New York City as a confident author with the first printed copy of her powerful novel.
Maria steps into a bustling Barnes & Noble bookstore in Manhattan for her inaugural book signing event.
The final frame captures her acceptance and satisfaction with her journey.

67942717.title: The Perfect Find
synopsis: A year after forty-year-old Jenna Jones has been dumped by Brian, whose 10 year high-profile relationship defined her, her mother finally kicks her out.
Moving back to NYC, she makes a career change into the world of beauty journalism.
Jenna has to ask her frenemy Darcy for a job at Darzine, and is offered Creative Director on a three-month trial basis.
That night she goes out with two close friends and randomly kisses a man 15 years younger than her.
The next day at work, the hungover Jenna meets Eric, the same younger man.
He is Darcy's son, the company's new videographer.
Jenna and Eric will work together on content for the magazine's subscription relaunch.
They agree to keep their hookup between them.
On their first day on the rebranding mission, a visit to the reclusive Greta Blumen is an epic fail.
They argue, and don't speak to each other all weekend.
On Monday they call a truce, and Jenna invites Eric to bring a couple of friends to a dinner she and her friends are hosting so she can meet 50-year-old Jimmy.
He is a perpetually single man, has a chip on his shoulder and antagonizes the much-younger Eric.
Jenna and Eric spend some alone time together after the others leave.
At work the next day, Jenna tells Eric their talk of the nostalgia for old films inspires her.
She suggests they do a tribute to classic couture called Perfect Find.
They get some designers to come aboard and offer some limited edition pieces, as well as some media influencers to help spread the word.
Walking together on the Brooklyn Bridge with champagne to celebrate their campaign, no sooner than they say that they are going to cool it, they again end up at her place.
Eric tells her about his dad Otis, who was killed when he was two.
His dream project is to make a film about him.
Jenna tells him about her and Brian, who met at college, were both overachievers and became a power couple.
Brian is featured in Forbes, and in the article he clearly shows he misses Jenna.
The NYT contacts Darcy to feature her as a media mogul for the Perfect Find.
The subscriptions surpass 1 million, and when the Times article comes out, its focus is more on Jenna and Eric's work together.
After Jenna shows she's jealous of Eric's ex Madison at a children' party, he leaves angry and ignores her calls and messages.
Arriving home, Brian is waiting for her.
He's grieving his mother's passing, so Jenna offers to drive him home, which Eric sees.
Brian tries to get her to come in, but she declines.
As Eric doesn't come in to work the next day and is 'editing at home', Jenna sneaks up to see him in Darcy's penthouse.
They make up, then Darcy catches them post-coitus.
Jenna gets fired and Eric doesn't defend them.
He moves into his own apartment and works on his own film.
After New Years, Jenna finally convinces Eric to meet with her in a cafe.
She's teaching a fashion in film course at Columbia, he's making the film on Otis thanks to a grant.
Jenna shows him her first sonogram, he is angry and leaves.
A bit later, Darcy invites herself into Jenna's apartment and announces they are now family.
Her own parents disowned her, so she alone raised Eric.
He joins Jenna at her next obstetrician appointment and they later attend the next Darzine Gala together.

15824863.title: Atomic Battlefields: Earth 2067
synopsis: The enthralling saga titled "Withering Eden" opens in the smog-engulfed year of 2067, where expansive panoramas of a dystopian Earth are presented in vivid detail; a once vibrant world reduced to a shell of its former glory by excessive pollution and mass deforestation.
The audience is guided through a seamless camera transition to a gloomy battlefield.
Split into warring tribes, the remaining human populace fiercely contests for residue-rich territories, the final spoils in this immense wasteland.
In this grim setting, we are introduced to Colt, a battle-hardened veteran soldier with a stern countenance.
He firmly clutches a weathered photograph that captures a lost idyllic era of laughter, open-air play in sprawling parks, and the warmth of familial gatherings around barbecue grills.
Colt is a crucial player in Eden, a small yet determined faction steadfastly committed to preserving the shrinking pool of human survivors amidst this desolation.
His daunting responsibilities reach beyond safeguarding his people; he actively engages in relentless skirmishes against invasive enemy factions encroaching upon their sanctuary.
As the story progresses, insightful glimpses into Colt's turbulent history are shared through emotionally charged flashback scenes, underscoring his deep-seated pain and unwavering determination.
His fervent belief in the possibility of reviving their dying world provides critical context to his character and exudes a certain poignancy and relatability.
The narrative takes an intense turn when Eden Headquarters, the heart of Colt's faction, is brutally attacked by a notorious enemy tribe.
During the chaotic aftermath, Colt unearths a classified document amidst the scorched debris.
It reveals the existence of "Zephyr" - a highly advanced terraforming device rumoured to possess the phenomenal capability of revitalizing their decimated planet.
The revelation induces palpable waves of disbelief and apprehension amongst the Eden survivors.
Yet, inspired and driven by a desperate hope, Colt, manages to convince Jess, a fiery Eden warrior, and a handful of others to join him in a perilous bid to secure Zephyr.
This rag-tag team embarks on a treacherous journey fraught with lethal encounters including grotesque, radiation-altered mutants and the relentless onslaught of savage weather conditions.
Enemy tribes, endowed with comparable intel about Zephyr, ruthlessly pursue them, adding an even sharper edge to their fraught expedition.
Their quest draws to a close within the protective gates of a surprisingly opulent, technologically advanced community, under the command of a formidable tribe, the Scorchers.
The plot thickens when Colt shockingly discovers that the ruthless Scorcher leader, Nero, is his long estranged brother.
This revelation introduces Colt's personal vendetta into an already high stakes quest, rendering the mission more complex and emotional.

Colt learns of Nero's sinister plan to seize control over the world's dwindling resources, by manipulating Zephyr's potential, escalating his resolve to seize the device before his power-mad brother can execute his cruel intentions.
The consequential standoff between the determined Eden warriors and Scorcher henchmen reaches a feverish climax.
During this frantic fray, Jess, the formidable Eden warrior, is critically injured, intensifying the pressing need to activate the still untested Zephyr.

In a calculated moment of desperation, spurred on by the perilous severity of Jess' condition, Colt makes the drastic decision to activate the uncertain Zephyr, risking the uncharted effects it could possibly have on their world.
Powering up Zephyr induces widespread seismic tremors and sweeping environmental shifts, triggering total chaos inside Scorcher's heavily fortified terrain, further convoluting the situation.
In midst of the adverse changes set off by Zephyr, Colt and Nero are locked in a cutthroat combat.
Emerging victorious from this lethal duel, Colt's final stride standing over his defeated brother symbolises his assertion of dominance over the recalibrating world order.
With the last remnants of Eden clinging on to hope, Colt, bearing physical scars and emotional trauma, cradles a grievously injured Jess in his arms.
He emerges from the smoke-filmed battlefield, stepping onto the charred plains of his homeland.
The narrative's haunting climax introduces a poignant sight of the first seeding sprouts of life breaking through the wasteland's debris-filled surface.

The dawn of a new day bathes the rejuvenating Earth with an eerie light, painting the clear skies of azure for the first time in decades'a symbolic nod to the autonomous rebirth of the world and the undying resilience of its inhabitants.

65534387.title: 2067 (film)
synopsis: In the year 2067, Earth has been devastated by climate change and an ongoing nuclear war.

Only one city in the ruins of Australia has been able to hold out against these catastrophic changes, thanks to synthetic oxygen; but this oxygen is tainted and gradually causes a deadly affliction called "The Sickness".
Ethan Whyte cares for his wife Xanthe, who is afflicted with the Sickness.
One day, Ethan is called before Regina Jackson, the Chronicorp CTO, who explains that the Sickness will eventually wipe out humanity.

During a test of the "Chronical", a prototype time machine that quantum physicist Richard Whyte (Ethan's late father) had worked on before his death twenty years earlier, the scientists received a radio signal from 400 years in the future with a message to specifically send Ethan to them.
In hopes of preventing the extinction of humankind, Ethan is asked to be sent into the future.
He refuses, as he resents his father for abandoning him and his mother, but Xanthe and Ethan's guardian and work colleague Jude manage to change his mind.

After surviving the traumatic time displacement, Ethan finds himself in a lush rainforest, with a hand computer named Archie and a wrist device given to him as a child by Richard as his only surviving pieces of equipment.
He finds the entrance to a bunker-like structure, and a skeleton wearing his jumpsuit, a decaying Archie and the wrist device, and with a bullet hole in its skull.

Shocked by the discovery of his apparent death in the near future, and sick from eating poisonous berries, Ethan is rescued by Jude, who followed him through time after his life readings, transmitted through the Chronical, were failing.
After sharing their findings, they follow Archie's directions to another, still-functional door, which leads to the Chronical lab.
Ethan's wrist device is revealed to be a DNA analyser specifically made to grant him access to the Chronical, which sets itself for automatic reactivation in four hours.

From a holographic recording left by Richard, the duo learns that the Chronical project originally entailed the reactivation of an atmospheric monitoring station which would ascertain the Earth atmosphere's breathability in the future and then transmit the data back to the past.
When first activating the machine, Richard was surprised to receive a message to send his own son to the future, so despite his misgivings, he prepared Ethan's wrist analyser.

However, an immediate follow-up mission was rendered impossible because safely sending living matter through time required an operational link from both sides and the data showed a power failure in 2474.
The Chronical's activation triggers a malfunction in its nuclear power core, threatening to unleash a nuclear explosion before the countdown is completed.
Ethan and Jude make their way to the power core, which is located beneath the overgrown ruins of their home city.
Finding the ruins littered with skeletons, including Xanthe's, they conclude that a cure against the Sickness was never found.
When Jude attempts to comfort him, Ethan recognizes Jude's voice from a recording he found on the decaying Archie, taken moments before his future self was killed.
Claiming that he's saving Ethan from himself, Jude directs Ethan at gunpoint to the reactor's control room.
Unable to activate the emergency override, Ethan decides to go inside of the airlock and pull the lever.
With 37 minutes to spare, the duo return to the Chronical lab, where Ethan finds another exit that opens the entryway next to his skeleton.
Ethan suffers a nervous breakdown and implores Jude to kill him, which Jude refuses to do.
Jude then confesses that there was no actual hope of ever changing the future.
Refusing to believe that, Ethan locks Jude in a room and plays back his father's log from the day that Richard died.

Ethan learns that his mission was a sham from the beginning: Jackson intended to flee from her dying time into the future with a "chosen few", while Ethan’s late father Richard maintained hope for humankind.

To prevent its abuse, Richard had already keyed the time machine to Ethan's DNA, but when Richard's colleague announced that the machine could be rigged to send a person into the future one-way, Jackson killed Richard.

Jude was appointed by Jackson as Ethan's guardian to ensure that he would be sent forward in time to repair the power failure and stabilise the time portal; once Ethan returned to 2067, Jackson would then have him killed.
Ethan tries to shut the Chronical down, but Jude moves to stop him.
When Ethan refuses to fight him, Jude, guilt-ridden, commits suicide.

Just before Jackson can put her plans in motion, Ethan sends the "Send Ethan Whyte" message, a copy of Richard's recorded murder on Archie, hundreds of live jungle plants, and a farewell gift to Xanthe into the past.
Then he destroys the Chronical, which changes the timeline: In the past, Jackson is arrested after Archie transmits the recording to a news station, and the plants are used to revitalize the planet.
In the future, Ethan's corpse is gone, and Ethan discovers his formerly ruined city inhabited and advanced with architecture more harmonious with the environment.

84483096.title: The Covert Meeting (2022 film)
synopsis: The year is 2022, and the retired CIA officer, John Wellington, receives an old-fashioned handwritten letter, the contents of which shock him to his core.
The letter details a haunting account of the death of notorious felon Edward Harrison.
The sudden revelation acts as a catalyst, reigniting dormant memories and thrusting us back in time, to the unwavering heat of 2003.
In 2003, we meet John in full force, at the pinnacle of his intelligence career, dealing with a case involving a complex national security plot which warranted quick resolution.

Edward Harrison, a detained and feared criminal, emerges as John's sole guide toward unravelling the vast and dangerous web sprawled out by an elusive criminal syndicate at the heart of his investigation.
For John, loyalty to his nation has always been paramount.
Fully aware of the inherent risks, he gathers his resolve, prepares diligently, leaving no stone unturned for the mission he's about to undertake.
In a daring move, John disguises himself as a guard and successfully infiltrates the cold, foreboding walls of the maximum-security San Quentin Prison where Edward is held captive.
Equipped with honed covert operative skills and polished manipulation techniques, he meticulously creates opportunities for clandestine meetings with Edward.
As their secret meetings progress, an undercover operation ensues, cloaked by an escalating national crisis that sends tremors through the highest echelons of power.
Edward, swathed in a shroud of cryptic secrets, warily agrees to assist John in his quest to shed light on the dark underbelly of the case, driven by undisclosed personal motives.
A calculated dance of power and deception unravels as John and Edward attempt to outmaneuver each other while negotiating the precarious terrain of prison politics.
Under the mounting strain, they forge a fragile alliance stained with distrust but strengthened by a common goal to expose the monstrous plot threatening their nation.

Edward uncovers a shattering truth — a revered senator is the puppet master pulling the strings to orchestrate a catastrophic terrorist attack, with collaborative efforts from moles embedded deep within John's agency.
With this vital revelation, John and Edward are hurled into the stormy ocean of their investigation, risking their lives to piece together incriminating evidence against the treacherous senator.
However, just as they approach a significant breakthrough, their operation is curtly terminated because the cloak of their covert operations has been lifted by a betrayal from within their ranks.
John, almost intuitively understanding the severe ramifications of their exposed operations, refuses to succumb to the wave of dismay sweeping over him.
He clings fiercely to his pursuit of truth and duty, irrespective of the potentially deadly consequences.

Alienated by the agency he had once considered his backbone, John embarks on a solitary and unauthorized mission, riding on the vapors of the limited information Edward had imparted before their sudden dismissal.

His fiercely independent investigation, fueled by his unwavering conviction in justice, plunges him into a whirlpool of deep-rooted corruption that directly threatens his life, his faith in the institution he served, and gravely endangers national security.
As he tirelessly treads the sticky web of corruption, uncovering friends turned enemies, his faith waivers under the glare of their deceit, while the constant threats to his life keep him on edge.
When he uncovers that some of his closest colleagues are enmeshed in the sinister plot, he is left cold, shaken to his core with disbelief and disheartenment.
The stakes escalate to an unbearable weight when he thwarts a planned terrorist attack at the eleventh hour, saving countless unsuspecting lives from the clutches of a horrific massacre.
His daunting revelation about the tainted politicians and compromised officers involved in a dance of subterfuge for power and wealth rocks the very foundations of the intelligence community.
Despite his heroic intervention, he is forced to bear searing consequences.
His actions, although justifiable, were unsanctioned leading to his ostracization from the agency he dedicated his life to serve.
Shunned and branded an outcast, he evolves into an unknown and unsung hero - laden with the burden of an undeserving stigma but held steady by the solace that his actions saved myriad innocent lives.

After digesting the tragic news of Edward's demise, John visit's Edward's final resting place in an Orlando cemetery, honoring Edward's instrumental contribution to the mission that evidently shaped the rest of his life.
Laying their past differences to rest, a solemn John pays his respects to Edward, acknowledging his contribution to the mission and recognizing him as the hero he was, even though shackled.
Just when he thought he could put everything behind him and embrace his quiet retirement, yet another elusive letter arrives at his secluded residence.
The final missive, postmarked and sealed eerily by the departed Edward, brims with an array of coded documents and voice recordings that send a shiver down John's spine.
This collection of cryptic artefacts carries an ominous prophecy - a resurgent threat that endangers national security and thumps the drumbeats of another bloody battle.
Though retired and somewhat reluctant, John's senior instincts as an intelligence operative are struck awake once more by this harrowing revelation.
Undeterred by the potential risk to his peaceful life, John jumps headfirst into the daunting task of decrypting the codes and hidden messages sequestered within Edward's posthumous correspondence.
As he pieces the incriminating information together, John stumbles upon a chilling truth that cuts through him like a knife in the wind.
Edward's demise was a meticulously planned murder.

Overcome with a transforming sense of responsibility and a sudden renewal of his bedrock instincts, John resolutely steps out of the shadows of retirement, announcing his return to the twisted and dangerous world of espionage.
Ignoring the silent threats hovering over his life, John embarks on yet another unsanctioned and potentially fatal mission that could once again put everything on the line.

The climax takes us through a visual spectacle of John meticulously analyzing the documents he'd received, arranging them on a large map that ominously reveals an even broader, more sinister conspiracy at large.
Overwhelmed by the daunting reality unfolding before his eyes and despite the strains of his advancing years, he decides to take on the invisible enemy lurking in the shadows of power and corruption.

Embarking on a perilous mission, armed with decades of experience, John once again plunges headlong into a world filled with clandestine codes and diabolical conspiracies, all in a quest to protect his homeland.

Staring down the barrel of imminent catastrophe, he single-handedly assumes the immense responsibility with grim determination — a solitary warrior pitted against a heavyweight consortium of power and corruption.
Discarded by the government and his beloved agency, John's unflinching resolve to safeguard national security stands resolute and unbroken.
Bearing the weight of explosive knowledge prompts John's determination to resurge, driving him to become an unlikely hero.
A hero, whose only acknowledgement comes from the haunting reflection staring back at him.
Raising the flag to wage another war against the formidable wheel of corruption, he stands unbowed by his status as a retired, forgotten, and disavowed CIA officer.

The film's fade-out focuses on John's undeniably fierce determination reflected in the stark shadows of his dimly lit war room — a testament to his unshakeable resilience and setting the stage for another suspense-filled saga.

64576226.title: The Gray Man (2022 film)
synopsis: In 2003, senior CIA official Donald Fitzroy visited a prisoner named Courtland Gentry in Florida.
Eight years earlier, Courtland was a minor convicted of killing his abusive father to protect his brother.
Fitzroy offers him his freedom in exchange for working as an assassin in the CIA's Sierra program.

In 2021, Courtland, now known as Sierra Six, is working with fellow CIA agent Dani Miranda to assassinate a target named Dining Car suspected of selling off national security secrets in Bangkok during the national Songkran festival.
Unable to do so stealthily without harming civilians, he attacks Dining Car directly, mortally wounding him.
Before dying, he reveals he was also in the Sierra program as Sierra Four.
He hands Six an encrypted drive detailing the corruption of CIA official Denny Carmichael, the lead agent on the assassination mission.
Carmichael is elusive about the true purpose of the mission and the contents of the drive when confronted by Six, and Six refuses evacuation from Bangkok with Carmichael's men.
Sending the drive to former Sierra Program handler Margaret Cahill in Prague, he calls a now-retired Fitzroy to request extraction.
Carmichael hires mercenary Lloyd Hansen, a former CIA agent kicked out for his sociopathnic tendencies, to track down Six and retrieve the drive.
Hansen does so by kidnapping Fitzroy's niece Claire, forcing Fitzroy to authorize Six's murder by the extraction team.
However, Six kills them and escapes.
Frustrated, Carmichael sends his subordinate Suzanne Brewer to oversee Hansen and keep him in line.
Hansen keeps Claire hostage in a mansion in Croatia, at his base of operations.
He also puts a massive bounty on Six's head to get mercenaries and assassins to hunt him down.
Six heads to Vienna to find the serial number of Claire's pacemaker from Laszlo Sosa, but he betrays him for the bounty.
Six escapes just as Hansen arrives with his team and kills Sosa, while Six kills all of Hansen's teammates and is rescued by Miranda from Hansen.
Her reputation is shot thanks to the Bangkok mission and she initially plans to bring him in to salvage her CIA career.
Six convinces her to drive him to Cahill's apartment in Prague, where she decrypts the drive.
It reveals the extent of Carmichael's corruption on behalf of a mysterious benefactor working for a shadow government.
Hansen sends several teams of assassins to Cahill, and the terminally ill Cahill blows up her home, so Six and Miranda can escape.
Six is arrested and handcuffed in the square.
A massive shootout in Prague resulted in all the police officers present slaughtered and Six escaped on a tram.
After a long chase and gun battle, Six is once again saved by Miranda, in Cahill's bulletproof car.
They infiltrate a hospital to track down Claire through her pacemaker's wireless signal.
A Tamil mercenary, Avik San also known as "Lone Wolf" steals the drive from them, knocking them out, and bringing it to Hansen.
Six and Miranda follow the pacemaker to Hansen's base.
She creates a distraction while he infiltrates the mansion rescuing Fitzroy and Claire.
Mortally wounded as they flee, Fitzroy sacrifices himself attempting to kill Hansen.
Miranda knocks out Hansen's men, but Lone Wolf narrowly escapes.
He defeats her in a fight, but gives her the drive, having become disgusted with Hansen's lack of morals and honour.
Hansen takes Claire hostage and drags her into a hedge maze.
After a standoff, he lets go of Claire and fights with Six.
Before Six can kill him, Brewer shoots Hansen.
She then tells Six that she plans to pin Carmichael's actions on Hansen to gain leverage over him.
Furthermore, Brewer pledges for Claire's safety, but only if Six continues to work for the CIA.
Six and Miranda are forced to cooperate in the cover-up, where ultimately no action is taken against Carmichael.
After the debriefing at the CIA headquarters, Miranda threatens to kill Carmichael if any harm comes to Claire.
Six escapes custody and frees Claire, who was being held at a secret location.

7506903.title: Quiet Dawn (2023 film)
synopsis: Marcus Johnson, an experienced plumber known across the quaint town of Los Manzanos, welcomes the day with an uplifting air.
The storyline transition to an aging Victorian-style house where, with expert precision and dexterity, Marcus remedies a stubborn clog in a double-bowl sink.
As the evening draws near, we see a glimpse of the Johnson family's close bond.
Sharing this table, Marcus, his wife Lily, a dedicated high school art teacher, and Lucas, their intelligent middle school-going son, vividly recount the day's events.
An air of anticipation sweeps across the town at the news of a major plumbing project.
The proposed state-of-the-art water treatment facility promises abundant economic prosperity that could propel the town towards a future of staggering growth.
Following the announcement, Marcus is chosen to spearhead this ground-breaking project, which offers a promise of a brighter future and stronger financial stability for his family.
However, a clandestine town hall meeting leaks veiled hints of covert plans and sly manipulations orbiting the project.
Disillusioned, Marcus pieces together the disturbing evidence, indicating the project might not be as beneficial as they've been led to believe.
The project aims to encroach upon the town park, an iconic landmark of Los Manzanos.
The proposed site alteration rings alarm bells for Marcus, who fears his town's peaceful life stands on the brink of unwelcome change.
Marcus musters the courage to unveil the truth, but his revelations fall on disbelieving ears.
The town, charmed by the eloquent project leaders, questions Marcus's motives instead.
The crisis also seeping into his household, his beloved wife, Lily, disputes Marcus's allegations against the project.
In their otherwise harmonious dwelling, tensions begin to brew.
Marcus, though deeply wounded by the lack of trust, has his resolve to protect Los Manzanos remain unshaken.
Armed with steely willpower, Marcus embarks on a daring mission to unearth concrete evidence that might convince the town of the lurking danger.
Braving immense challenges, Marcus dares to infiltrate the project's restricted construction site and eavesdrops on covert meetings, all in a bid to gather substantial evidence.
Utilizing his adept plumbing skills, Marcus ingeniously installs hidden recording devices, designed to capture damning conversations that could expose the deceit.
As the emotional toll of his isolation escalates, Marcus watches his once valued friendships gradually dissolve.
His relentless quest for truth eventually leads him to the discovery of indisputable evidence — Hidden contracts, covertly recorded conversations, and words that unmask the fraudulent scheme.
Armed with this concrete proof, Marcus boldly faces the town folks and local authorities at an emergent town hall meeting, drawing their attention to his well-documented discoveries.
A town once rigid with skepticism, with Marcus at the forefront, is now united in its quest for justice.
His innate leadership shines through as he galvanizes the townsfolk to band together, launching a civic lawsuit to overturn the potential harmful project.
Even while facing intimidating threats from the scathing project leaders on the court day, Marcus remains unyielding, a figure of resolute determination.
In court, his moving speech tremors through the room, rallying his once skeptical friends, and the rest of the community, together in collective struggle.
His innovative display of evidence coupled with his quick-witted responses unambiguously manages to persuade the court to halt the controversial project.
With the dawn of a new day, the camera captures the first break of serene daylight over the picturesque town of Los Manzanos.

As the golden rays of the morning sun paint the town, a contented smile spreads across Marcus's face as he overlooks the town from his picturesque porch, whispering a prayer of gratitude into the crisp air.
Marcus, just a regular plumber until recently, is revered as nothing less than a savior by the townsfolk.
His heroic act awards him a legendary status akin to a folk hero.

His act of courage proves to be an impeccable example of dedication, love, and unity for his son Lucas, and other young minds in town, sparking a new era of responsible citizens ready to stand up for their community.
In the final scene, Marcus stands on the edge of his beloved town, the sea of rooftops gleaming in the soft glow of dawn serving as testimony to his hard-won battle.
As the sun emerges, bathing his cherished town in golden hues, a content smile plays on Marcus's lips.

69148790.title: Silent Night (2023 film)
synopsis: Brian Godlock is an electrician living a happy life in the fictional town of Las Palomas, Texas with his wife Saya and young son Taylor Michael.
On Christmas Eve in 2021, Brian and Taylor are using a new bicycle on their front lawn.
They are caught in the crossfire of a drive-by shooting in the middle of a gang war and Taylor is killed.
Brian immediately tries to catch and kill the gangsters only for the leader of one of the gangs, Playa, to shoot him in the throat and leave him for dead.
Brian survives, but his vocal cords have been severely damaged.

Brian and Saya grieve over Taylor's death and Saya tries to be emotionally supportive to Brian during his physical recovery, but Brian becomes cold and distant, focused only on pursuing revenge for Taylor.
Saya becomes emotionally overwhelmed and leaves Brian, who plans to kill all the gang members involved in Taylor's death on Christmas Eve in 2022.
Over the course of the next year, Brian engages in bodybuilding, familiarizing himself with deadly weaponry and self-defense training.
At one point, Brian appears to attempt to visit Detective Dennis Vassel, who offered to help in his son's case.
Brian instead uses this opportunity to gather information on Playa's gang and begins reconnaissance on them, collecting evidence that will help put them away.
Saya attempts to contact Brian, expressing that she and his parents are worried about him, but he continues to ignore her text messages.
Brian attacks and abducts a member of Playa's gang, hurting and threatening him in an attempt to give written information on the gang's activity.
The thug briefly manages to escape, only for Brian to subdue him in a fight.

Brian delivers the bound thug to Vassel's house, along with a Christmas card, containing his intent to kill Playa and his gang, and a thumb drive with the evidence he has collected, along with the thug's written contributions to his information.
He also sends two of the thug's amputated fingers to Playa, intimidating him.
Brian spends the entire night of Christmas Eve 2022 killing the members of Playa's gang one by one, often interrupting their crimes in the process.
After stealing a cell phone from a thug and using it to record a video of him being killed and sending it to Playa, the gang leader sends a group text for his soldiers to meet him at his place.
Brian takes the opportunity to trap and kill them all there.
After a massive gunfight and fistfight bloodbath as he fights his way to Playa, Brian finds himself confronted by Detective Vassel.
Initially pointing their guns at one another, both silently put them down and agree to work as a team to finish off Playa.
Playa's drug-addicted girlfriend manages to get the drop on them, shooting them both, only for Brian to sneak around and hold her at gunpoint.
She drops her gun and feigns surrender.
When Brian hesitates to kill her, Playa's girlfriend unveils a hidden sidearm and attacks him with it.
Brian manages to kill her and confronts Playa.
In the shootout between them, Playa manages to get the upper hand and is about to shoot Brian in the throat again, but Detective Vassel shoots Playa, allowing Brian to finish him off.
Brian and Detective Vassel fall to the floor and look up at the ceiling and Christmas decorations, bleeding out and dying.
Brian sees reflections of his memories of his time with Taylor and hallucinates an alternate future, where he and Taylor are both still alive.
Saya opens a letter that Brian wrote to her, where he apologizes for how cold he has become in their marriage and thanks her for loving him.
Brian further tells that he knows no one can make Taylor's death right, but that he is going to die trying.
Saya takes the letter to Taylor's grave, where Brian had earlier brought his previously unopened Christmas present (a toy train set) that he built and set up around his grave.

20312740.title: Escape from Africa
synopsis: As the film commences, we are greeted with the stunning sight of radiant morning sunshine, dipping the quaint, mud-walled Ngozi residence in a warm honey glow.
Nestled amidst the rustling maize stalks in the sleepy outskirts of a Kenyan village, the home hums with contentment.
Kwame, the family's head, a handsome man in the prime of life, stands tall and robust.
His hands, though rough from years of hard work, shower meticulous care on the small patch of maize that supplements their modest living.
Meanwhile, his vibrant wife, Amina, her ebony skin shimmering in the sun, engages herself in grinding maize using a large, weather-beaten stone.
Their radiant 7-year-old daughter, Zuri, can be seen cavorting around, a giggle escaping her lips as she attempts to capture a vibrant blue butterfly.
This idyllic tranquillity is abruptly disrupted by the brutal, thundering gunfire, coupled with the horrific roar of vehement rebel cries.
A horde of armed militants swarms their peaceful village, their faces obscured behind harsh, inhuman masks.
The peaceful, serene morning rapidly spirals down into a nightmarish spectacle, a horrifying, blood-soaked carnage unfolding in the heart of the Ngozi family's home.
Amid the pandemonium, Kwame uses his quick thinking to secrete his loved ones under a hidden compartment beneath the floorboards of their home.
In this ingeniously concealed refuge, they manage to escape the escalating mayhem.
When the last echo of gunfire fades, leaving an eerie silence in its wake, the family cautiously emerges from their secret hideout.
Their once beautiful house stands ravaged, their bustling village transformed into a grim wasteland, singed memories and shattered dreams the only evidence of their former life.
Staring at their former home's smouldering ruins, shock and grief etched into their faces, they make an irrevocable decision: They have to leave, to seek refuge somewhere, anywhere.
Thus commences their gruelling journey across the merciless, baking Kenyan hinterlands, their bodies drained but their spirits unflagging.
The hostile desert tests their endurance, throwing at them poisonous sand serpents, blinding sandstorms, severe water shortages, and massive food scarcity.
The family's desperate trek is sidelined when they inadvertently fall into the trap of a cruel group of human traffickers, exploiting helpless asylum seekers.
A violent confrontation ensues, but they miraculously manage to escape, their brush with death reinforcing their determination to reach a safe haven.
The subsequent journey takes them on a treacherous voyage across the stormy Mediterranean Sea.
They huddle together with other bedraggled fellow escapees in a woefully overcrowded boat.
After what seems like an eternity of suffering, finally, the long-awaited sight of the Italian coastline appears on the horizon.
However, instead of the longed-for sanctuary, they are greeted by interrogation from grim-faced Italian Immigration officers and corralled into a crowded, rundown detention centre.
Amidst this crisis, their already tested nerves are strained further when Zuri, their little beam of hope, succumbs to a severe case of pneumonia, plunging the family into an ocean of despair.
Vanessa, an impassioned local journalist possessing an inherent empathy for society's underdogs, gets wind of the Ngozi family's plight.
Determined to bring their story into the public eye, Vanessa broadcasts it, spotlighting their distressing and desperate fight for survival.
As Zuri's condition deteriorates, catching the country's sympathy as the face of their plight, public opinion begins to shift as their story sparks intense debates and polarizing views.
Their heartbreaking story moves Marco, an empathetic immigration lawyer based in Rome, enough to influence him to take up their case without charge.
Public opinion begins to turn in their favour as public outrage increases towards the government's handling of refugees.
Amidst escalating public unrest and media condemnation, their request for asylum is finally granted.
Their newfound freedom signifies a bitter triumph, evident in their restrained smiles shadowed with the grievous toll of their journey.
They commence their complex journey into the mysteries of Italian culture and language, dreams of stability fused with the stark realities of immigrant life.
The film's final chapter begins with the family gingerly stepping into a petite but welcoming apartment - their new sanctuary amidst Rome's bustling chaos.
Attempting to recreate fragments of their left-behind world, they fill their new home with the comforting aroma of traditional Kenyan cuisine and the soothing rhythm of the Kamba lullabies.
Their new life brings unique tasks and trials, mirrored through their earnest attempts to understand and adapt to the complexities of Italian society.
Gradually, they take solace in the simplicity of their everyday routine - preparing meals, singing lullabies - actions evoking bittersweet memories of their African roots.
They rejoice as Zuri's condition improves noticeably, her infectious laughter gradually breathing life into their scarred existence.
The sight of Zuri, dressed in her fresh school uniform, teetering on the precipice of fear and excitement, kindles a spark of hope for a promising, safer future.
Despite lingering challenges, their hope outshines their fear as they find a rhythm in their new Italian life.
As the film nears its climax, Kwame gazes out of the window of their simple Italian apartment, his face a canvas of emotions - joy, sorrow, hope, and resilience.
Their traumatic past lingers as haunting memories, a stark reminder of their losses and the home their hearts yearn for.
Their hearts carry scars, but their spirits remain unconquerable.
Their story underscores their unchanging essence - a close-knit family longing for peace.
The closing scene witnesses Amina, bathed in the soft glow of the Italian moon, tucking Zuri into bed, whispering a heartfelt goodnight in her mother tongue, Kamba.
As the final scene fades out, Kwame can be seen perched on their modest balcony, his gaze lost in the breathtaking Roman cityscape, his countenance displaying a bittersweet blend of sorrow and hope.

62897844.title: His House
synopsis: Bol and Rial are refugees fleeing with their daughter, Nyagak, from war-torn South Sudan.
They brave stormy waters on an overcrowded motorboat, along with fellow refugees illegal traversing the perilous English Channel from France in search of a better life.
Although they survive the treacherous crossing, their daughter and many others do not.
When they are finally granted probational asylum in Britain three months later, the government assigns them a shabby house with peeling walls and dismal furnishings on the outskirts of London.
They are given strict restrictions or they may face deportation.
They experience racism and hatred from their tenement neighbours.
They are met by their case worker Mark, who tells them he hopes they are two of "the good ones."
Bol tries to assimilate: he sings football songs, asks Rial to use utensils rather than her hands when they eat, and even changes how he dresses.
Bol wants to prove to the government that he and Rial belong in the UK.
Rial, however, clings to their culture.
She retains their daughter's necklace, dresses in colourful clothes, and rather than using a table, sits on the floor to eat.
Bol and Rial soon experience strange phenomena in their new home and see visions of Nyagak and a mysterious man, who both escape into the walls.
Rial figures out that the evil in the house is an apeth or "night witch."
She tells Bol the story of a poor man in her village who accidentally stole from an apeth by the river.
When the thief built his home, the apeth moved in with him and haunted him.
Rial believes that an apeth has followed them and if they repay their debt, the apeth will bring Nyagak back to them.
However it is not immediately clear what the "debt" is.
Bol burns everything they brought with them, but the apeth continues to torment him and the couple's relationship deteriorates.
He goes to Mark and requests new accommodation under the guise that their unit is infested with rats, but is unable to convince him.
Bol tears apart the house looking for the apeth, which threatens the couple's chances of staying in the UK when Mark discovers the damage.
Rial expresses her desire to leave, but Bol confines her within the house and summons the apeth on his own.
The apeth accuses Bol of being a thief and claims that he has wrongfully claimed a life that didn't belong to him.
The apeth then offers Bol a deal: his life for Nyagak's, but he refuses this offer, resulting in Bol being forced into a state of catatonia.
Rial escapes the house but finds herself inexplicably back in South Sudan in a familiar classroom.
She is reunited with old friends, who are revealed in a further flashback to be victims of a horrendous massacre.
Rial was able to survive by hiding.
Bol finds her and they escape as violence grips the region, but find that a bus they need to board would only let people with children on.
Desperate, Bol sees Nyagak in the crowd and abducts her, falsely claiming that she is their daughter.
The couple get on the bus and escape, leaving Nyagak's real mother behind as gunfire erupts.
Later, when crossing the rough sea, Nyagak and others fall overboard.
Neither Bol nor Rial reaches her in time.
Having accepted what they did, Bol decides to repay the debt to the apeth and tells Rial.
Bol starts to let the apeth into his skin and Nyagak enters the room and returns to Rial.
Rial chooses to save Bol instead of accepting this alternative reality, by slitting the apeth's throat.
Later, Mark comes to inspect the house to find it repaired.
Bol and Rial tell him they have chosen to stay and make it their new home.
They say Rial killed the witch that haunted them, which Mark finds funny.
Bol says they decided to live with the ghosts of their past from South Sudan, including Nyagak.

59371558.title: Cosmic Horror Catalyst
synopsis: Dr. Jaxon Carter, a revered astrophysicist celebrated internationally for his groundbreaking theories on dark matter, is depicted submerged in his research, carefully examining peculiar cosmic energy patterns.
His surroundings are the impressive, sprawling premises of his state-of-the-art lab situated in Harvard University.
As this unfolds, globally unsettling data begins to flood in.
International health organizations send reports marking a harrowing 30% increase in suicide rates worldwide.
The cause remains unclear as medical professionals grapple with the rising tide of individuals overwhelmed by an unprecedented depth of despair.
Meanwhile, the world is further thrown into chaos as recognized news platforms and teeming social media channels propagate grim prophecies from various self-proclaimed 'prophets'.
They ominously predict an impending cosmic cataclysm set to unleash in just two months.
The seeds of the impending doom are sown in the public psyche.
Gripped by pandemic and fear, the global population is ensnared in an all-consuming panic, fueled perpetually by relentless hysteria disseminated by media outlets worldwide.

The reclusive Dr. Carter's academic life, once constrained within the confines of his lab, gets rattled when his solitude is interrupted by an unexpected visit from a stern-looking FBI agent, Special Agent Daniels.
Agent Daniels relays a grave message — the U.S. government has taken the prophets' predictions very seriously.
This revelation sends palpable shock waves through Jaxon, amplifying the rising dread already steeped in the global atmosphere.
Jaxon, a man of sharp intellect and unyielding resolve, deduces a connection between these troubling human reactions and the cosmic energy patterns he's been tracking.
With acute vigilance, he refines his research, certain that answers are within his reach.
His conjecture eventually bears fruit when he reveals the disturbing connection between the shifting cosmic energies and the unusual patterns in human neurotransmitters.
The revelation sends a chill down his spine.
Digging deeper into this strange cosmic energy, Jaxon discovers that it doesn't impact physical health directly.
Instead, it toys with cognitive functions, making the human mind increasingly susceptible to psychic influences exerted by enigmatic creatures from another plane of existence.
Faced with this shocking revelation, Jaxon attempts to unveil his discoveries to his peers and superiors at Harvard.
He faces a wall of skepticism that demands empirical evidence, stoking a frustrating battle to make his breakthrough recognize.

In a grim simultaneous event, Dr. Erin Thompson, one of Jaxon's trusted colleagues and a close friend, falls prey to the enigmatic phenomena and tragically transforms into another one of the doomsday prophets.
This personal loss hits Jaxon hard, prompting an even fiercer determination to neutralize this threat.

Burdened with grief and goaded by a newfound resolve, Dr. Carter amplifies his research, meticulously analyzing the altered neuronal activities in the affected brains under MRI scans, hunting for a sliver of hope amidst despair.
His conclusions prove to be dreadful; the inter-dimensional entities thrive on negative human emotions, using them as a potent energy source.
Disheartened yet spurred by his relentless spirit, Jaxon gathers a premier team of astrophysicists, neurologists, and psychiatrists.
They unite when facing a formidable challenge — to devise countermeasures against this stealthy cosmic influence.
Their effort is continually tested, with numerous failed attempts serving as a bitter pill to swallow.
But under Jaxon's steadfast leadership, their resolve survives the incessant stumbling blocks.
They meet each failure with an unyielding resolution, undeterred on their quest to save humanity.

After six relentless, grueling weeks, they finally unveil their brainchild — a hefty, cylindrical device equipped with quantum computing chips, designed specifically to curtail the rampant cosmic energy.
Despite their soaring hopes, the device seemingly remains inactive, augmenting their collective disappointment.
But gradually, they start noticing subtle, positive changes.
Global pessimism recedes by 10%, and to their relief, the once ominously cogent prophets begin losing their predictive prowess.
Amidst this tear-stained chaos, however, Jaxon finally gains a clarity that had eluded him all along.
These entities feed off negative emotions; it should work the other way around too.
A newfound knowledge giving him a renewed sense of purpose, Jaxon publicly shares his revelations about the power of positive emotions.
The survivors latch onto this belief, promoting it as a collective healing mantra against the sinister inter-dimensional parasites that have long controlled their minds.
Humanity begins to grasp the crucial role that emotional balance plays in these dire times.
Slowly, they learn to wield it as a shield against these extraterrestrial influences.
Leading the crusade against the invisible perpetrators, Jaxon emerges as a beacon of hope for the panic-stricken world.
His lab, once an epicenter of esoteric research, now transforms into a community center—a radiant beacon emitting signals of positivity, resilience, and communal unity.
As the days stretch into weeks, the once prevalent despair begins to gradually morph into collective resilience.
Jaxon commits to monitoring the cosmic energies with unparalleled vigilance from his lab, resolved to detect any future anomalies before they can turn humanity into pawns in their cosmic game again.
His lens of existence broadens as he realizes his responsibilities, transcending beyond deciphering cosmic riddles and now focused on fostering emotional stability amongst the masses.
An epiphany spreads through humanity and forges connections and unity as never seen before.
Unity against adversity begins to take shape amongst the world population.
News channels start broadcasting peaceful protests and community engagements worldwide, starkly contrasting the dire doomsday predictions that once flooded their headlines.
Jaxon's invention, the "Cosmic Shield", initially brushed off as a failure, emerges as a tangible embodiment of the sheer strength of human spirit.
The world, which once teetered on the edge of implosion, now steps tentatively into a new era, found on psychological resilience and unity.
As contrasting as night and day, governments worldwide now advocate positivity and optimism.
The fearful warnings of doom now replaced by motivational calls for hope and unity.
The inherent differences that once dissected nations now serve as conduits for global unity and collaboration against common threats.
From an astrophysicist lost within the confines of academia, Jaxon now stands on a global stage as a symbol of hope, resilience, and positivity.
The narrative concludes on an uplifting note as resilience spreads like hopeful wildfire across humanity, arming itself against cosmic adversities.
Media outlets plaster Jaxon's face worldwide—his countenance of cautious optimism becoming an emblem of new-age society that prioritizes mental fortitude over paranoid fear.
In the end, the world doesn't just survive the cosmic onslaught; it emerges stronger, a phoenix from the ashes—more united and equipped to foresee and avert future threats.

73780174.title: Bird Box Barcelona
synopsis: The world is plagued by mysterious entities that manipulate people's negative emotions, turning some into "seers" but leading most people to commit suicide once they have seen an entity.
A common prevention method is wearing a blindfold outdoors.
In Barcelona, Spain, Sebastián and his daughter Anna travel together.
One day Sebastián encounters a group of survivors, and claims he knows the location of generators that can provide light and heating.
Sebastián joins the others in their shelter inside a bus hangar.
The next morning, with everyone asleep inside a bus, Sebastián drives it outside and crashes it.
Everyone is left without blindfolds; Sebastián slowly leads each to open their eyes, and upon witnessing the entities they commit suicide.
Sebastián is revealed to be a seer, and is thus unaffected.
Anna congratulates Sebastián on having "saved" the people, urging him to find the other "lost sheep".
Nine months earlier, the arrival of the entities prompted people to flee.
Sebastián retrieved Anna but lost his wife in a car accident.
They found refuge in a church and met Padre Esteban, a pastor who opined that the entities are angels, and that humanity should be liberated from suffering by embracing death.
Sebastián and Anna tried to hide but one day a group of seers led by Padre discovered their hiding place and captured them.
He forced Anna to open her eyes, killing her.
Sebastián then faced the entities, but instead of death he saw the apparition of Anna, which has accompanied him ever since.
Anna tells him that he can join his family there when he has "saved" enough people on Earth.
Sebastián encounters another group led by Rafa, who has two dogs.

Others in the group include Octavio, a Mexican deliveryman with expertise in physics; Roberto and Isabel, a couple; Claire, an English psychiatrist; and Sofia, a young German girl separated from her mother.
Octavio theorizes that the entities are quantum beings that perceive humans' fear and grief.
Sofia shares information about Montjuïc Castle, believed to be a safe refuge which can be reached by a gondola lift.
The group embarks on a quest to reach the Castle.
Rafa dies early on after Sebastián sabotages the dog leashes, and the remainder of the group take shelter.
Sebastián leads Octavio to his death, but begins to doubt the wisdom of Anna's apparition.
Roberto and Isabel lose their lives too.
Claire suspects Sebastián is a seer and shields Sofia from him.
Sebastián, who had started to resist Anna's influence, vows that he will protect Claire and Sofia.
Meanwhile, Padre and his followers find the trio.
Sebastián helps Claire and Sofia get to the gondola lift, then fights Padre and they kill each other; Sebastián dies smiling.
Claire and Sofia enter Montjuïc, converted to a secret camp, where Sofia reunites with her mother.
Claire undergoes blood tests by scientists who are trying to develop an antibody that can provide immunity against the entities' influence.

75904026.title: Crossroads of Fate
synopsis: Our tale unravels in the throbbing heartbeat of New York's 1920s Harlem Renaissance, bathed in the energetic bustle of street vendors and the soulful, riveting sounds of jazz music wafting through the air from the world-renowned Cotton Club.
Alicia, a young African-American woman, finds herself in the epicenter of this colorful cultural upheaval.

Employed as a waitress at the luxurious Savoy Ballroom, she escapes the mundane cycle of her duties by carving out moments of solitude with her greatest possession — an ink pen and a threadbare notepad.
Her functioning as a keen observer transforms her surroundings, thoughts, and overheard conversations into intricate word sketches.

She becomes the voice of the vibrant city life around her, channeling the essence of her bustling metropolis into beautifully etched narratives, despite her subdued existence waiting tables for the city's affluent.

Constrained by the racial prejudice and gender bias tightly woven into the social fabric, Alicia nurtures a reluctant dream deep within her — to break barriers and evolve into an esteemed writer, to voice her extraordinary tales to the world.

During a routine busy shift at the ballroom, she spots a familiar face across the grand dining room - Daniel, a childhood friend from the crumbling brownstone apartment building where they had spent their innocent years in Harlem.

As they rekindle their friendship cloaked in shared past experiences, their conversations meander to their carefree childhood, ultimately leading to a decision to re-explore those forgotten paths, and unknowingly shaping their futures.
Daniel, once an unnoticed participant in their childhood antics, has grown into a key figure in Harlem's thriving jazz scene, his youthful passion blooming into his lifelong commitment.
As the compass of their shared past draws them together once more, they start exploring the vibrant jazz scene flourishing at Minton's Playhouse.
These nightly immersions act as a catalyst for reigniting their once languid friendship.
Their adventurous escapades in the dimly-lit jazz bars throbbing with the musical vibrancy and diversity of the city, expose them to the countless stories interwoven within this cultural revolution.
The city they thought they knew began unraveling into an intricate tapestry of tales.

Noticing Alicia's dormant talent simmering beneath her modest facade, Daniel introduces her to the influential figures from the journalism world in his circle, hoping that their recognition could spark her writing aspirations.

However, beneath the scintillating charade of Harlem jazz clubs, a sinister shadow casts its perpetual gloom — the menacing Italian mob led by the ruthless Don Gambino, puppeteering the city from behind the theater's curtains.

Despite his noteworthy position in the jazz realm, Daniel finds himself inextricably tangled in the malevolent undercurrents of illicit dealings and mob-controlled operations, frantically seeking a way out of the treacherous labyrinth he had unwittingly wandered into.

As Alicia becomes more entrenched in her writing and Daniel with his music, their friendship remains a beacon of hope in the whirlwind of their tumultuous lives, a testament to their unwavering trust.
Daniel's alarming slide into the ravenous pit of mob life incites a creeping dread within Alicia, whose anxieties for him continue to brew on an unsettling precipice.

Alicia's unwelcome attention from the Mob, due to perceived knowledge of their covert operations, unveils a potential threat to her life - her very existence now painted with the bullseye of unwarranted enmity.
Alicia's life becomes an precarious balancing act - her burgeoning journalistic aspirations struggling to outshine the menacing shadow shrouding her dreams with imminent danger.
Unwilling to stand by, Daniel takes a perilous decision to protect Alicia from the reach of the mob.
He decides to confront Don Gambino and his mob, venturing headlong into the lion's den.

Concurrently, Alicia wields her mightiest tool— her words - penning an expose revealing the mob's veiled operations under the apt pseudonym "Night Raven," a cloaked identity shielding her from immediate harm.
Her carefully inscribed expose pulls back the veil covering the mob's unholy operations, each carefully selected word a bullet aimed at the heart of the underworld.
In an unexpected turn of events, the explosive expose breaches the custody of the public as it is splashed across the front page of the New York Tribune, inciting a citywide uproar.

As the city reels from Alicia's expose, a confrontation ensues between Daniel and Don Gambino, culminating in an adrenaline-charged showdown resulting in the downfall of the mob's reign, marking the climax of our tale.
Amidst the city's overwhelming relief, Alicia's anonymous article garners widespread acclaim.
Her distinctive voice resonates with the public, her anonymity only sharpening the intrigue around the genesis of the groundbreaking article.

Upon recognizing the immense potential latent within Alicia's words, an influential editor from The New York Times offers her an unrivaled opportunity - a permanent position as a journalist - encouraging her pursuit of her literary dreams.
However, Alicia's ascent to literary acclaim breeds an unsettling danger for Daniel, who realizes the safest option is to detach from his life enmeshed in jazz, the mob, and, regrettably, Alicia.

A heart-wrenching farewell at their familiar crossroads signifies their diverging paths, their dreams scattering with the wind, the poignant notes of their shared symphony gradually fading into the background.

Alicia eventually realizes her dream of becoming a celebrated writer, rising above the racial prejudice and societal constraints, her fame relegating her challenging past to a subdued echo in the background.
Daniel, on the other hand, withdraws from the limelight, choosing a life of peace away from tumultuous jazz nights, mob connections, and the songbird of his life, Alicia.

The conclusion of our tale finds Alicia fully absorbed in spinning her narratives in her cozy Harlem studio, while Daniel reminisces their shared memories over preserved jazz records, miles apart but eternally interwoven through their shared past.

The closing scene narrates the bittersweet conclusion — Alicia, transform into a celebrated author, and Daniel, the revered jazz musician now leading a humble existence, their legacy inscribed in the melody of "Crossroads of Fate".

58084139.title: Passing (film)
synopsis: In 1920s New York City, Irene Redfield, a light-skinned black woman living in Harlem, meets a childhood friend, Clare Bellew, by chance at a hotel dining room.
While Irene is married to a Black doctor, the also light-skinned Clare "passes" as white and has married John, a wealthy white man from Chicago.
Clare invites Irene up to her hotel room so they can talk more openly.
Clare explains that after her father died, she was raised by her two white aunts and married John very young.
They are interrupted by John, who openly despises and degrades Black people, unaware of his wife's or Irene's racial background.
Irene leaves the hotel, angry with Clare, and refuses to respond to Clare's letter.
However, after Clare unexpectedly shows up at Irene's home and apologizes for the encounter, they rekindle their friendship.
Clare, who wishes to associate with black people again, invites herself to a dance party that Irene is organizing.
Most of the guests at the party find Clare charming, including Irene's husband, Brian.
While there, Irene reveals Clare's secret to her friend, novel writer Hugh Wentworth, who seems less impressed with Clare than the others.
As time passes, Clare soon becomes involved in all aspects of Irene's life, joining Irene and Brian to all their outings.
At first, Irene seems happy to have Clare around, but soon she becomes disillusioned with Clare, and starts to grow dissatisfied with her presence.
Brian, also dissatisfied, attempts to teach his and Irene's children about racism in America, as Irene refuses to move anywhere else.
However, Irene believes that the children are too young to learn about such things, inciting an argument between the two, further straining their marriage.
Brian invites Clare to a tea party from which Irene purposefully excluded her.
When out shopping with her friend Felise, who is unable to pass, Irene encounters John, and hurries away as he begins to realize the truth about his wife's racial background.
Irene tries to warn Clare, but decides against it when she is unable to reach her by phone.
As Brian, Irene, and Clare are on their way to Felise's Christmas party on the top floor of a six-story building, Irene asks Clare what she would do if John ever learned the truth.
