Upon returning to her apartment, Tessa finds her father, dead from an apparent overdose.
Landon calls Hardin dozens of times to let him know before he finally picks up.
He returns to Tessa and tries to comfort her, but she hides from him.
Hardin argues with her mom, Carol, about whether he's good for Tessa and how he always abandons her.
Still, Hardin, along with Landon, attends Richard's funeral to support Tessa.
They go to a dinner hosted by Hardin's dad, Ken, and Landon's mom, Karen, along with Landon and his friend, Nora, to say farewell to Landon as he moves to NYC for school, where Nora also lives.
After dinner, Tessa brings Hardin outside to talk.
She tells him they need time apart to heal from their recent family traumas and she's decided to leave Vance Publishing to move to New York with Landon.
Hardin is hurt by the bombshell and nearly hits Landon out of rage for not telling him, but Landon reminds him he is also Tessa's friend as much as Hardin is his brother.
Tessa gives Hardin an ultimatum that if he loves her, he'll not follow her to NYC and let them have their time apart, to which he reluctantly agrees.
Tessa moves in with Landon and starts working with Nora at a fancy restaurant and Hardin starts going to AA and graduates from university.
Months later, Hardin comes to NYC for work and Landon offers to host him.
Tessa takes double shifts to avoid Hardin, but Landon and Hardin come to her restaurant and request her as their server.
Hardin stays until she's off work and they talk about how they've been; Hardin's sobriety and Tessa waiting to get accepted into NYU.
Over the next couple of days, they spend time together, slowly reconnecting, during which Landon finally starts a romantic relationship with Nora, much to Hardin and Tessa's happiness.
One night when Landon is at Nora's, Tessa and Hardin give in and have sex again.
The next morning after Hardin leaves, Tessa finds a book in his bag, titled "After", documenting their entire relationship.
When he returns, she confronts him about the book, not wanting her life to be published for everyone to read about, but Hardin tells her there's already a bidding war for the book.
He had read his journal during therapy and a publisher ended up reading it and everything escalated since.
Tessa declares that their relationship is officially over.
Sometime later, Hardin's book has been named a New York Times Best Seller.
With not many friends at school and Landon having basically moved in with Nora, Tessa reaches out to Robert, Nora's friend, for company.
That night, Tessa sneaks into Hardin's book signing without him knowing so she can listen in.
She misinterprets a look between Hardin and a woman and as Tessa leaves, Hardin catches a glimpse of her.

60246522.title: Whispers & Deception
synopsis: In the stunning opening frame, the movie immerses us into an intense murder scene within a lavishly decorated seventieth-story penthouse bathed in a sublime golden glow, nestled in the throbbing heart of Sin city, Las Vegas.
The gruesome murder victim is revealed as Jackson Kline, a prominent business magnate recognized as a pivotal piston in the city's clandestine and unsavory underworld.

Ray Chandler, highly decorated investigative journalist for the prestigious Las Vegas Tribune known for his tenacious pursuit of truth, is hand-picked by his hard-nosed editor, Ed Williams, to uncover the layers surrounding this brewing scandal.
His relentless pursuit leads him to the glimmering grand halls of the notorious Quad Stallion Gambling Club, a temptation-filled oasis nestled amidst Vegas's towering casinos.
When Ray dares to penetrate the stronghold of the club's guarded entrance, he faces the blunt refusal of burly, intimidating guards lacquered in black suits like menacing ravens.
However, amidst this display of power, his presence piques the attention of Serena, the enigmatic and tantalizingly captivating brunette owner of the club who is as mysterious as she is beautiful.
As he interacts with Serena, he stumbles upon cryptic murmurs about "Rumors", an elusive entity holding extensive power in the shady underworld.
As he succumbs to Serena's intoxicating allure, he unearths salacious secrets whispered in hushed tones amidst the city's extravagant, champagne-drenched parties.
But what takes him by surprise is the magnitude of these secrets, revealing shocking connections that extend beyond Jackson Kline's cold-blooded murder.
Serena, gradually lowering her guard, invites Ray deeper into her clandestine realm, unraveling the dangerous allure of the forbidden underworld in front of his curious eyes.
As they venture further into ambiguity, their relationship transcends from a tense cat and mouse game to becoming unlikely partners in an escalating battle for power and survival.
Ray gets tangled in a web of conflicting emotions, torn between his blossoming affection for the sultry Serena and his devout pursuit for justice unmoved by personal connections.
Behind the dazzling glamour of Vegas, Ray and Serena traverse the treacherous labyrinth of deception and lies deeply entrenched in the city's shadowy underbelly.
As they unwind the complex mystery surrounding the elusive 'Rumors', they expose a sprawling network of corruption involving the city's untouchable elite.
However, this revelation is not without its price, they find themselves in the hazardous crosshairs of imminent peril.
Barely escaping death in an ambush staged in a dim-lit, grimy back alley by faceless assassins, they manage to dodge a hurtling storm of deadly bullets.
The near-death encounter jolts Serena into unraveling her tightly held underworld connections in front of Ray, extending a trusting hand in uncertain times.

Driven by a mutual desire for retribution, together, they strategize a daring plan to unmask the elusive and seemingly untouchable Rumors, vowing to cut down the rotten tree of organized crime infecting their world.

As they delve deeper into the dark maze of deception, they get entangled in a monstrous web of manipulation and power games spread across the city, far more sprawling than what they initially suspected.

Armed to the hilt with their risky discoveries, they decide to face Rumors head-on in the smoke-infused, lavishly adorned halls of high-stakes casinos and opulent penthouses, willingly putting their lives on the line.
The nail-biting climax lays bare ill-kept loyalties and stunning betrayals, the revelation adding kindling to the already blazing inferno searing its way through the narrative.
After a nerve-wracking chase through Vegas's sprawling cityscape, Ray and Serena manage to corner Rumors, who appears visibly taken aback by their united front.

With one decisive roll of a dice, a metaphor shining bright in a city perpetually under the glow of neon lights, Ray succeeds in unmasking Rumors, sparking off an unprecedented chain reaction in Vegas's crime hierarchy.

Capitalizing on the disarray sparked within rival gangs, he publishes a hard-hitting expose in the Las Vegas Tribune, sending tremors across the world of notoriety, causing several crime syndicates to crumble overnight, including Serena's Quad Stallion Gambling Club.
Consumed by the aftermath of Ray's daring expose, Serena starts detaching herself from her underworld shadows, looking for paths leading towards redemption from a world she once controlled.
Having cemented his legacy in investigative journalism with another landmark story, Ray decides to pursue fresher leads possibly leading to another explosive expose, leaving Serena behind.
The repercussions of the expose are far-reaching, with court cases popping up across the city, unearthing long buried secrets, and forever altering the landscape of Las Vegas.
The taste of victory for Ray is an odd blend of sweet and sour.
His heart aches with unspoken feelings for Serena, standing as a permanent reminder of the personal sacrifices necessary to unveil the harsh truth.
Meanwhile, Serena watches as Ray's departing figure blends into the desert horizon, her heart heavy with the weight of a world drastically different from the one she was previously part of.

Despite the unexpected downfall of her once glittering empire, Serena embarks on a long journey to redemption, aiming to transition from a feared queen of sin to an ordinary citizen seeking forgiveness.

In a different world altogether, Ray is seen hunched over countless case notes in a dim-lit bar in a quiet town, well on his way to unravel another mystery miles away from the glitz and grime of Las Vegas.
Leaving behind her notorious status, Serena now roams around the halls of her once thriving casino, the echoes of the past bouncing off its sinister silence.
For Ray, the successful expose rings the closing bell on the infamous Las Vegas underworld, while simultaneously opening doors to yet another hard-hitting expose.
The camera zooms out to catch Serena's wistful gaze tune to Ray's dwindling silhouette, her heart burdened with a fresh start and yet pulsating with newfound resolution.
The movie reaches its thrilling apex, freezing Serena in contemplation of her next move, leaving viewers at the edge of their seats, their anticipation heightened as the end credits begin to roll.

74341176.title: Johnny & Clyde
synopsis: An investigative reporter meets with Four Horse Casino owner Alana Hart, questioning her about a killer called "Bakwas" who is apparently in her employ.
The reporter refuses a $2 million offer to sign a non-disclosure agreement, so Alana kills her.
A montage shows lovers and serial killers Johnny and Clyde on an indiscriminate crime spree.

While getting fuel at a gas station, Johnny takes exception to the stuttering attendant wishing him a safe trip to Rhode Island, psychologically tortures him, then shoots him for a candy bar and a handful of cash.

Randall Lock, an overweight, alcoholic former sheriff whose daughter was tortured and killed by the duo, sees a news report that Johnny and Clyde have returned to Rhode Island, and hires bail bondsman One Time to help gain revenge.
Johnny and Clyde rob one of the casino's armored cars and torture a guard for information about Alana's secret cash room.
They use the guard as a human shield when ambushed by Lock and One Time and are able to escape when maniacal killer Zhang makes an indiscriminate attack to cause chaos.
To help rob the casino, Johnny assembles a team of his equally murderous foster-care brothers: suicidal thrill-seeker Butcher, insane arsonist Baker, and paranoid conspiracy theorist Candlestick.
Candlestick warns them that the satanic cult of the demon Bakwas performed a mass suicide at the site where the cash room was built.
The casino's head of security Guy suspects the serial killers, and Lock informs Alana of their intention to rob her secret cash room.
This provokes Alana to have the Elder of the cult perform a ritual, empowering Alana to use a mystical stone to control Bakwas and force him to guard her casino.
To maintain the secret of the stone, Alana then kills the Elder.
In preparation for the heist, Johnny's crew take an excessive amount of illegal drugs.
They kill the perimeter guards, then Baker accidentally kills himself while using explosive charges to open the door.
The crew enter the building and are quickly surrounded by Lock and One Time, who are waiting in ambush, and Zhang, who follows behind them.
This Mexican standoff is interrupted by Alana's announcement that the building has been locked and everyone will be dead by sunrise.
Bakwas appears and kills One Time.Johnny's crew descend toward the basement cash room, killing a series of guards.
Guy's elite team traps them but are killed by Bakwas, and Guy realizes that he has been betrayed as Alana is eliminating every possible witness.
Guy gives his team permission to abandon their posts.
It is revealed that Alana already moved all the money and is preparing to leave town and reunite with her father.
After Candlestick and Butcher are killed, Johnny and Clyde try to escape with a bag of counterfeit money.
Zhang, on orders from Alana's father, gets them out of the building.
Lock, who is once again waiting in ambush, kills Zhang and beats Johnny.
When Clyde holds Lock at gunpoint, Lock reveals that Johnny killed her father and concealed the crime.
Clyde shoots Lock and pistol-whips Johnny, but calls his actions romantic.
Bakwas confronts them and while the demon cannot leave the site, it throws its machetes at Johnny and Clyde, killing them.
Lock, who is wearing a bulletproof vest, recovers to gleefully view their dead bodies before Bakwas kills him.
Guy is the only one to escape, and confronts Alana at gunpoint, demanding the stone.
She gives it to him and, although she believes that she still controls Bakwas, the demon rips out her beating heart.
Guy offers to treat the demon with "respect and dignity", but it kills him and places the stone in its body.

68182474.title: Chase Dreams, Chase Love
synopsis: Liza, a resilient single mother surviving in a fast-paced urban environment, deals with the daily challenges of raising her eight-year-old daughter Emily.
After a quick goodbye to Emily, Liza rushes to the prestigious Solstice Law Firm, her employer for the past decade.
The esteemed Senior partner, Mr. Robinson, nods at her with an approving smile each time he crosses paths with her, driving her ambition further.
Their praises remind her of her long-trailed dream of becoming an attorney and fuels her passion to climb higher up the legal field.
On a frantic mid-week morning, she unintentionally bumps into Tom, a newly appointed partner staff, in the hallway.
The incident results in a perfectly brewed black coffee splattering all over his crisp white shirt.
Tom's initial irritation at the unfortunate event soon gives way to admiration when Liza maintains her composed demeanor.
They soon start interacting more often, discussing challenging case files during coffee breaks, engaging in fascinating legal banter, and exchange smiles that became more frequent and genuine.
The annual office Christmas party provided the perfect background for them to interact beyond boundaries of the office premises.
Amid clinks of champagne glasses and background jazz, they found a personal connection, a friendship that inched them closer.
This newly formed camaraderie grew stronger with time, strengthened by their shared experiences in the courtrooms and shared struggles against high profile cases.
One such evening, over a candlelight dinner at Bella Trattoria, a quaint Italian restaurant, they discovered more about each other's dreams.
Liza confessed her ambition to become an attorney, and Tom, intrigued by her potential, extended an offer to mentor her through the rigorous bar exam prep.
From then on, many nights were spent huddled over legal books in the law firm's vast library.
Civil and penal code books were sprawled across their study tables as they tirelessly practiced case arguments.
They worked together on a vital pro bono case - a challenging human rights case.
The stakes were high for their law firm reputation and this case pushed their legal expertise and resolve to its zenith.
Every late-night study session, every case analysis created a mutual attraction - an unplanned, unspoken companionship that was more than just two colleagues studying together.
However, amidst this growing relationship, Liza never let her professional ambitions be swayed; she remained resolute, allowing her relationship to exist alongside her professional aspirations.
During one archival research, Liza found a potent piece of evidence, something that could potentially undermine their entire case.
This revealing moment amplified her stress and created a moral dilemma at a time of her preparing for the approaching bar exam.
Swallowing the fear of what this revelation might lead to, she decides to speak with Tom.
She confronts Tom, revealing this potentially game-changing secret that threatened to flip the course of their case, and in an unintended consequence, their relationship.
The fallout was detrimental; their relationship, which was based on trust, took a hit.
She now found herself dealing with a postponed bar exam and a broken relationship; her world was collapsing onto her.
The court day of their pro bono case came, filled with harsh interrogations and a stern and formidable judge.
Despite their carefully crafted defense, they lost, leading to an immense blow to the firm's reputation and Liza's morale plummeted.
It felt like an end to her upwardly ascending trajectory in the law community.
Amid this disheartening chaos, Liza received the result for her bar exam.
She had passed and was now an attorney, an unexpected turn in the otherwise storm of events.
This validation of her qualification became a turning point for Liza, who decided she would not sacrifice her dream for anything, not even a romantic relationship.
Determined to rise higher, Liza drew strength from her newly acquired qualification.
She was an attorney now, and she had every skill to command respect and admiration in the legal world.
Tom, reconsidering his hard stance, decided to let his anger pass.
Reflecting on Liza's predicament, he decided to approach her.
They decided to appeal their pro bono case together.
Armed with the much-discussed evidence, they attempted to reverse the judgment once again.
Liza successfully unveiled the evidence, ultimately leading to a much-sought-after legal victory.
Celebratory joy permeated in Solstice Law Firm.
The happiness in the room felt palpable as Liza cemented her place as a strong attorney, an achiever, a survivor.
The bond between Tom and Liza solidified in the face of shared adversities.
They survived this challenge together and emerged stronger.
Liza balanced her personal life with Tom and Emily and her professional life as an attorney.
Liza drops off Emily at school.
Emily's eyes beamed with pride looking at her mom before rushing to her school bus.
Tom watched her from a corner with admiration and love in his eyes.
Emily felt proud of her mother.
Liza was not just an attorney or a loving mother; she was a real-life superhero for Emily.
With her lawyer's badge and an exceptional problem-solving skill, Liza became the go-to attorney for all high-profile cases.
The higher the stakes, the harder Liza worked.
She continued growing as an attorney, she was relentless.
The newly formed family, Liza, Tom, and Emily, often spent quality time over celebrations and food at Bella Trattoria, meticulously carving a beautiful family bond.
Tom appreciated Liza's relentless spirit and boundless courage, his warm affection reflected in his eyes.
Emily, inspired by her mother, decided to follow in her mother's footsteps.
The story concludes leaving the audience with a powerful message - perseverance, hard work, and self-belief can transform one's dreams into reality.

60090895.title: Run Sweetheart Run
synopsis: Cherie is a young single mother and pre-law student working as a secretary for a legal firm in Los Angeles.
On her way home, her boss James calls her saying that she double-booked him for dinner with an important client at the same time as his anniversary dinner, which Cherie has no memory of.
James asks Cherie to go to the dinner for him and she reluctantly accepts.
While preparing for the dinner, Cherie's period starts and she realizes that she is out of tampons.
Cherie meets the client, Ethan, at his house and the two go to dinner.
Cherie is charmed by Ethan, although he has a sudden outburst of anger when approached by a dog, explaining that he was bitten by one as a child.
Ethan invites Cherie to spend the night with him, setting an alarm on his phone for the early morning so that she can return home before her daughter wakes up.
When he does, Cherie notices that he already has an alarm for 5:25 AM.
She agrees to stay for a drink.
When they enter his house, Ethan attacks Cherie, causing her to flee.
Running down the street, Cherie tries to get help from nearby residents but is ignored.
She finally finds two women outside a movie theater and convinces them to call 911.
The police arrive and arrest Cherie for public intoxication, despite her protestations that she was attacked.
Cherie talks to another woman in the cell who panics when Cherie describes Ethan.
The woman warns Cherie that Ethan "controls men" and urges her to seek the "First Lady".
The police escort Ethan into Cherie's cell, where he tells her that he will hunt her, and that if she survives until morning, he will let her go.
Upon being released, Cherie heads to James' apartment.
He seems sympathetic, offering her clean clothes to wear.
Cherie searches for information about Ethan on James' computer and finds that she is the latest in a long string of women marked as tithes for Ethan.
James' wife, Judy, warns Cherie that Ethan can smell her blood and that she should clean herself thoroughly.
Cherie flees on a bus and then calls her ex-boyfriend Trey for help.
While stopping at a gas station to buy tampons, Cherie is ambushed by Ethan.
She strikes him in the head and escapes with the help of Trey, who drives her to his place, despite the fact that his new girlfriend Dawn, Cherie's former best friend, is there.
Realizing that Cherie has been attacked, Dawn is unexpectedly sympathetic.
When Ethan arrives looking for Cherie, Dawn and her friends arm themselves to fight him off, but he easily kills them.
Ethan forces Cherie to leave with him.
Trey, who had gone out, returns home and confronts Ethan, who decapitates him.
Cherie flees, and remembering Judy's advice, throws some of her menstrual blood onto a passing car to mislead Ethan.
Cherie flees to a church where she asks the priest for holy water and a crucifix, hoping to ward off Ethan.
She discovers the body of the priest and realizes that Ethan had assumed his form.
Ethan then reveals his true form to Cherie.
Returning to human form, Ethan is attacked by the priest, allowing Cherie to escape.
Cherie finds her way into an underground rave, where she sees a flyer for the First Lady and calls the number on it, getting the location for a nearby spa.
When Cherie is accosted by a man, she is rescued by a group of party girls who take her with them.
As they leave the rave, the girls offer to take Cherie surfing in the early morning, but Cherie realizes that Ethan's alarm was set for sunrise.
Just then, Ethan attacks them until Cherie is saved when a pitbull shows up, barking at Ethan and causing him to disappear.
At the spa, Cherie discovers the "First Lady", Dinah, and a group of women practicing martial arts.
Dinah explains that Ethan is a fallen angel whose job was to protect and guide humanity.
Ethan had decided that men should rule and used his prodigious powers to assure masculine ascendance throughout history.
Dinah says that she needs to use Cherie as bait to lure Ethan out so that he can be defeated.
The women clean Cherie up and she drives to the Santa Monica Pier.
There, Cherie reopens her wounds, attracting Ethan.
As Ethan prepares to kill Cherie, his alarm rings and he realizes that the dawn has arrived.
Cherie throws a rock through a blacked-out window, exposing Ethan to the sunlight and incapacitating him.
The women from the spa, who have gathered outside, throw more rocks through the windows, flooding the room with sunlight and mortally weakening Ethan.
Outside, Cherie mocks the now-weakened Ethan as his power dies.
Dinah lights Ethan on fire, killing him.
Cherie then returns home to her daughter.

53778343.title: Vigilant: The Dark Side of Recovery (2021 film)
synopsis: The protagonist, Jane Doe, is introduced.
Her portrayal is a seasoned one; a courageous retired Army healthcare professional.
However, the unyielding spectre of opioid addiction, a struggle from her past, continues to cast a sorrowful shade over her life.

After leaving the harsh battlegrounds for a more peaceful existence, Jane now walks the hallowed halls of Harvard University, garbed in the uniform of a safety officer, swapping her combat boots for measured footsteps and assault rifles for trusted keys.

With a profound twist of irony, Jane's prime responsibilities include ensuring the safety and wellbeing of Harvard's students and safeguarding its distinguished premises from any potential threats or dangers.
But beneath her stern demeanor and steady composure lurks a perilous secret.
Once everything has settled into a quiet stillness, Jane takes advantage of her position and stealthily breaks into Harvard's well-equipped labs, stealing the in-demand opioids.
It starts on one eventful night when Jane's clandestine operation is severely compromised.
A chemistry student, Ben, accidentally stumbles upon her illicit activities as he sneaks into the lab for some late-night research.
Jane, trapped under Ben's wide-eyed gaze, is forcefully reminded of the consequences that would follow if her secret ventures get exposed.
Her professional reputation would spiral down in an unstoppable nosedive, leaving her personal world in shambles.
In a desperate bid to salvage the situation, Jane sees no choice but to rope Ben into her secretive world.
With an awkward smile, she throws a mentoring offer on the table, promising Ben academic guidance in chemistry and personal support, hoping that he would agree to stay silent in return.
As their mentorship journey begins, Jane steps into the role of a surrogate mother for Ben, a socially awkward genius.
She understands his inhibitions and nurtures his academic growth while sharing the pearls of wisdom life has gifted her.
Time quickly passes, marked by the changing seasons and the steady transformation of Ben.
In the meanwhile, Jane finds herself forming an unexpected bond with Ben and grows to trust him with her secrets.
For Ben, Jane was not just an academic tutor.
She was also a personal moral compass who accepted him with his quirks and shortcomings, providing him companionship he greatly missed in his life.
As Ben becomes an integral part of her life, Jane starts questioning the choices she's been making.
She starts wondering if the thrill of her nocturnal adventures outweighs its grave moral repugnance.
But as their peculiar bond strengthens, their world is tossed into disarray when Jane learns about an imminent federal inspection of Harvard's pharmaceutical labs.
This sudden turn of events places her at a dangerous precipice, threatening to shatter the intricate bond she built with Ben, the only stable amid her chaotic existence.
After days of heart-wrenching turmoil, Jane finally decides to take the plunge.
She confesses to Ben about her opioid reliance during her days as an army nurse and her current clandestine pharmaceutical heists.
Even though the confession exerts an emotional toll on Jane, she bears it willingly, hopeful that Ben would understand her plight and unravel the rationale behind her daring actions.
Ben's initial reaction is shock which soon gives way to understanding.
His empathetic acceptance towards Jane's complex situation shows a maturity that defies his years.
Displaying unbelievable resolve, Ben chooses to stand by Jane in her difficult time.
He decides to assist Jane in disposing of the stolen medication before the inspection, reducing her burden appreciably.
Jane gratefully accepts his offer, moved by his unwavering loyalty and support, signifying a tight thread of trust that had become inseparable.
The duo embarks together on the precarious mission of disposing of large volumes of stolen opioids.
With every vial they dispose of, their stakes rise exponentially.
As the inspection day looms closer, the suspense nearly palpable in the air, Jane and Ben persist resiliently, growing stronger and more reliant on each other with every passing moment.
With the clock ticking ominously, the duo miraculously manages to dispose of all the stolen opioids.
They complete their task just in the nick of time, as the federal inspection team steps onto the serene Harvard campus.
Provoked by the intensity of the recent events, Jane finally acknowledges the need to turn a new leaf and reshapes the direction of her life.

She establishes a support group specifically designed for ex-military personnel, providing them a safe space to narrate their experiences, cope with their traumas, and assimilate into civilian life effortlessly.
Surprisingly, her initiative receives a warm response, acting as a beacon of hope to many retired soldiers who managed to find solace, thereby healing their troubled minds.
As the narrative unfolds, Ben, who was once a bystander in Jane's life, evolves into a prominent character, marking a remarkable progression in the storyline.
Inspired by Jane's transformation, Ben decides to channel his enthusiasm into providing mental support to others after his graduation.
Embracing his newfound role with grace and determination, Ben becomes a mental-health counselor at Harvard, where he guides others just like Jane guided him.
The film reaches its final act, where Jane and Ben are now seen leading a group therapy session in their support group — a far cry from their troubled pasts.

In an emotionally-charged scene, Jane, while addressing her audience about her journey, sends a look of heartfelt gratitude towards one individual — Ben, a chemistry student turned counselor who played an unintentional pivotal role in her life's transformation.

Jane, who was once lost in the complex web of opioid addiction and unlawful activities, is now seen walking confidently towards a promising future, with Ben by her side, ready to face whatever comes their way.

61920356.title: Awake (2021 film)
synopsis: Former U.S. Army medic and recovering addict, Jill Adams, works as a security guard at a local college where she steals drugs from the research lab to sell.
She has two children, Noah and Matilda.
While driving, their car loses power and is hit by another car, sending it into a lake.
Matilda drowns but is revived by a police officer who reveals that everything that uses electricity is malfunctioning.
At the hospital, they learn that coma patients have awoken.
At home, the family is unable to sleep.
On her way to work, Jill observes that the whole neighborhood is awake.
Psychiatrist Dr. Murphy explains that people appear to be no longer able to fall asleep and they will soon suffer from sleep deprivation.
The only known exception is an old woman who is being studied at a military base called The Hub, in hopes of finding a cure.
Jill remembers that Matilda appeared to be asleep that morning, and fears that she may be dead.
She finds Matilda at church, where the churchgoers want to sacrifice her.
After an officer opens fire, the ensuing chaos allows Jill to flee with her kids.
Noah tells a reluctant Jill that they should bring Matilda to The Hub.
En route to The Hub, an escaped prisoner steals their car with Matilda in it.
Jill and Noah are saved from the other hostile prisoners by the thief of their car, Dodge.
Upon reaching The Hub, Jill has Dodge leave and enters The Hub alone.
She finds the other woman who can sleep in ill condition.
Murphy explains that there is no cure and lab workers have been using a drug that helps the brain function to keep them going.
However, it is only temporary and causes neurological damage.
The army confronts the family and Matilda tearfully admits that she can sleep.
Doctors decide to find what makes Matilda special.
Matilda sees an ape in the lab that doesn't fall asleep when given anesthetic gas.
The doctor reveals that chimps are the only animals besides humans that can't sleep due to their biological closeness to humans.
They test the gas on Matilda and she falls asleep.
Jill is handcuffed in a room where she experiences delirium.
Murphy explains to Jill that the sleep disorder was caused by the same solar flare that knocked out power, affecting humans' brains.
Dodge is taken as a guard and given stimulants.
The woman who can sleep goes into cardiac arrest and dies.
Noah is taken away for experiments.
As the soldiers start to go insane and kill each other, Jill rescues Matilda.
Noah, hallucinating, electrocutes himself.
Jill and Matilda try resuscitating him but are unsuccessful.
Noah suddenly wakes up the next morning, saying that he was dreaming.
As Jill is exhausted and dying, Matilda realizes the reason that she and Noah could sleep was because they had both temporarily died.
They then drown Jill in a lake and attempt to resuscitate her.
She awakens just as the camera cuts to the credits.

31108485.title: Torrential Ties (2020 film)
synopsis: Jake Patterson, a man in the middle of life's complex maze, grappling with his turning fifty, wakes up to another on-the-surface unexceptional but internally restless day in the picturesque nostalgia-laced town of Elmwood, his home since childhood.

It becomes evident that Jake is still nurturing the embers of his feelings for his ex-wife, Rebecca, as he lovingly cradles an old yet cherished picture within his weathered-faded leather wallet, a remnant of their shared past showing her in a radiant and alluring light.
Setting out for the day, Jake finds himself face to face with a looming threat of rain, predicted by the local weather channel, tarnishing the quaintness of Elmwood.
His trusty, weather-beaten Ford chooses this precise moment to sputter its last breath and dies quite unceremoniously right in front of Rebecca's traditional red brick house.
Gazing at the familiar facade of Rebecca's home amidst his ruined plans, a spontaneous idea sparks within Jake's weary mind.
He contemplates stemming down the tide of his past and reignite his long-dormant bond with Rebecca.
He watches her from his incapacitated vehicle, cherishing the peals of her infectious laughter and the mesmerizing glow of her luminous smile.
The warm light pouring from her living room window captures this enchanting scene, confirming to Jake his decision.
His unexpected brush with the past gains momentum the following morning when he bumps into Rebecca at 'The Roasted Bean', a cafe that is an integral part of Elmwood's culture.
Their these chance encounter rekindles dormant emotions and revives a cascade of shared childhood memories.
Rebecca meets Jake with a charming, heart-warming smile that brings back memories of better days.
She introduces him to her fiance, a tall, charismatic architect named Richard.
But beneath Richard's charm lies a detached coldness that comes to the fore when Rebecca leaves Jake and Richard alone.
Jake quickly discerns a measured cold detachment underneath Richard's facade of pleasantness.
A wave of skepticism washes over Jake's otherwise open-minded nature, forcing him to delve into Richard's foggy past.
Jake immerses himself into a potentially dangerous quest, anxiety pushing him to its brink.
He begins unraveling fragments of Richard's murky past - a complicated puzzle he never anticipated.
Among the unsettling discoveries, Jake stumbles upon evidence of Richard's illicit activities, his secretive involvement with Elmwood's seedy underworld.
Trembling with fear for Rebecca's safety, he decides to unburden this alarming revelation.
He chooses Elmwood's tranquil park as the setting to unveil Richard's haunting secrets, only to be met with misconstrued allegations of attempting to sabotage Rebecca's happiness.

Their discussion reaches a tumultuous crescendo, mirroring the stormy heavens, dark clouds looming over Elmwood finally decid to pour their contents, indicating the overflow of their pent-up emotions.
Time poses as a cruel reminder, with each passing day bringing Rebecca's wedding date closer.
Jake's desperation peaks, his resolve to free Rebecca from Richard's crafty clutches is more robust than ever.
Friendly confrontations with Richard take an ugly turn, culminating in violent physical encounters.
Each scar on Jake stands testimony to Richard's sinister and violent inclinations.
Richard's true colors become blatantly apparent when he orders his underbelly associates to target Jake, culminating in a brutal and disorganized brawl in a shabby, dimly-lit alleyway.
Rebecca, acutely unaware of Richard's callous modus operandi, stumbles upon the violent scene, unprepared for the harsh reality that Richard's concealed violence was about to be revealed.
An unexpected beam of lightning pierces the cover of darkness illuminating the merciless expression on Richard's face and sending a chilling wave of dread coursing down Rebecca's spine.
The violent confrontation persists even as the storm gathers strength, the showdown amplifies in line with the unforgivable tempest's ferocity.
Amidst the storm's relentless onslaught, Richard's malicious personality finally meets its equal and opposite force of retribution.
The well-guarded secret of his clandestine wrongdoings is laid bare in front of the startled attendees at the grand wedding.
The reactions range from shock, disbelief, to outright terror.
Observing the reactions of childhood friends and family, Rebecca glimpses the depth of the near disaster she almost embraced.
She feels an overwhelming wave of relief mingled with feelings of betrayal and shock.
Amidst the chaos and tumult compounded by the storm, Rebecca rushes towards the shattered, beaten figure of Jake, holding back years of bottled up tears.
She acknowledges his painful yet brave endeavor to protect her from the impending disaster.
Amid the cold downpour, Rebecca reaches out to Jake, their fingers intertwining, reigniting old sparks and setting the foundation for the rebirth of their relationship.
Despite the storm's wrath, they stand united, their history interwoven, becoming the fabric of their revived relationship.

Under the towering edifice of Elmwood's long-standing clock tower, amidst the desolation left by the storm, Jake and Rebecca share a heartfelt moment, softly pledging to repair and reconcile their complex relationship.
As the turbulence of the storm wanes, they discover solace in each other's arms amidst the flood-ravaged town of Elmwood, hopeful and optimistic for sunnier days.
They stand resolute in the face of wind, ready to sail into an uncertain future.
Even in the heaviest downfall, true love refuses to be snuffed out, and the darkest wrongdoings will eventually be stripped down to the spotlight.

62858789.title: Unhinged (2020 film)
synopsis: On a rainy night, a man named Tom Cooper sits in his pickup truck outside of his ex-wife's house.
He removes his wedding ring, then grabs a hammer and a tank of gas.
He proceeds to break into the house, kill his ex-wife and her boyfriend, and sets the house on fire before driving off.
The following morning, Rachel Flynn is awakened by a call from her lawyer and best friend, Andy, about her impending divorce.
Later as she drives her son Kyle to school in rush hour traffic, she is fired by one of her clients over the phone.
Frustrated with how her life is going, she angrily honks at a pickup truck blocking traffic at a green light.
At the next red light, the pickup truck pulls up to Rachel, revealing it to be Tom behind the wheel.
Tom apologizes for not going at the previous light and asks Rachel for an apology in return.
Rachel refuses, telling him that she has nothing to apologize for.
Enraged, Tom vows to teach her what a bad day really is.
Down the road, Tom speeds in front of Rachel, slams on his brakes, and nearly causes an accident before driving off.
Though shaken, Rachel drops Kyle off at school and makes plans to meet Andy at a diner.
Rachel later stops at a gas station.
While inside the store, she sees Tom's truck parked outside.
A fellow customer escorts Rachel back to her car and relays Tom's license plate number to her, but is then killed after Tom rams him with his truck and propels him into oncoming traffic.
Tom then chases Rachel, during which he reveals that he has her phone.
Using the info on her phone, Tom goes to the diner and meets with Andy, pretending to be a friend of Rachel's.
Using Andy's phone, Tom calls Rachel on a burner phone stashed in her car.
When Andy asks for his phone back, Tom smashes a mug across his face and stabs him to death in front of everyone.
Tom then tells Rachel that she must choose someone in her contacts to die next.
When he suggests her ex-husband, her mother, or Kyle, she chooses the client who fired her.
Rachel then calls the police, who respond to the client's home while Rachel races to her son's school.
Tom arrives at Rachel's home, where her brother Fred and his fiancée Mary are living.
Tom sneaks inside and Fred arms himself with a knife.

Tom confronts him, holding Mary hostage, and explains to him that over time, he began to feel insignificant, powerless and invisible to humanity, and that revenge and violence are all he has left to get him through the day.
Tom repeatedly pushes Mary into Fred's knife, accusing Fred of killing her (as he was the one holding the knife).

He then ties Fred to a chair and tells Rachel over the phone that she has three minutes to go into the school, get Kyle, and drive away, or he will light Fred on fire, and demands Fred read a letter about how Rachel is a liar and how she is selfish.
At the school, Rachel desperately demands that the principal release Kyle.
She drives away with Kyle.
A police officer arrives at Rachel’s house, and, after being told to let Fred go, Tom sets him on fire and pushes him to the cop.
The cop is able to shoot a running Tom in the shoulder and tries to put the fire out.
Tom catches up to Rachel and Kyle on a highway.
They use a GPS app on her tablet to find out that Tom is in a minivan and is right in front of them.
When they attempt to alert a nearby police officer, Tom sees them and rams the officer's car, causing a massive multi-vehicle car accident that kills the officer.
Tom pursues Rachel to her mother's house where Kyle triggers a silent alarm to bring the cops and hides.

Rachel rams the van that Tom is driving, flipping the vehicle, but he gets out and attacks Rachel, telling her that she will always see Tom everywhere she goes, then enters the house in search of Kyle, intent on killing him.
As he is about to walk back outside, Kyle inadvertently alerts Tom to his hiding place upstairs.
Rachel sneaks inside the house and finds Kyle, but Tom finds them both and they engage in a brutal fight, beating and throwing each other around the room.
When Tom begins to strangle Kyle with a cord, Rachel stabs Tom in the eye with a pair of scissors, finally killing him.
The police arrive and inform Rachel that Fred survived Tom's attack.
Rachel and Kyle leave to see Fred at the hospital.
As they drive away, a car cuts Rachel off and she stops herself from honking at the angry driver.
Kyle says, "good choice."
They drive away as the sun sets.

69153050.title: You're Totally Not Invited to my Sweet Sixteen
synopsis: It was an ordinary day at Cafe Noir when Amy McKinley, a prominent figure among New York's social circles, organized an exclusive gathering of her closest friends at their favorite bohemian cafe in Manhattan.
Over coffee and conversation, Amy enthusiastically shared the ambitious plans for her upcoming extravagant sweet sixteen party.
Amy meticulously held a special guest list, cherry-picking individuals from the junior class of Lincoln High School.
However, noticeably absent from the roll was Nancy Williams, a figure renowned for her solitary lifestyle.
Kelly Smith Johnson, Amy's oldest and most trusted friend, quietly observed this glaring omission.
Despite the joyous laughter and excited chatter about the party, Kelly felt a pang of empathy towards Nancy.
The following day, while immersed in the solitude of the school library, Kelly watched Nancy from afar.
She noticed how Nancy seemed encapsulated in her own world, surrounded by century-old astronomy books, oblivious of the whispers about Amy's upcoming party.
Amid the hullabaloo of high school life, Amy spotted the charming Jack Rosenberg, Lincoln High's star quarterback, and eagerly approached him.
With a shy smile, she extended a personalized party invitation, waiting for his response with bated breath.
Flustered and rather taken aback, Jack gladly accepted Amy's silver-gilded invite.
A modest nod confirmed his condition to Amy's hinted-at dance proposal, assuring her that he would indeed grace the event.
News of Amy's extravagant party quickly spread through Lincoln High, triggering a whirlwind of anticipation and excitement.
The students eagerly speculated about the event, the buzz invariably reaching Nancy's book-sheltered haven.
Amid the infectious enthusiasm, Nancy, while browsing the shelves at the library, overheard the animated chatter about the party.
Upon inquiry, she discovered her conspicuous exclusion from the guest list, hitting her like a blunt realization.
Nancy, suppressing her disappointment, clutched her pile of astronomy books and retreated silently to her red-bricked home, her mind riddled with confusion and a touch of sadness.
Kelly, never one for blind conformity, decided to take matters into her own hands.
Back at Cafe Noir, she painstakingly replicated Amy's invitation and secretly delivered it to Nancy, instructing her to keep the gesture a secret.
Days later, Jack happened upon Nancy in the library while she was engrossed in a Jane Austen novel.
Intrigued by her tranquility and apparent intellectual depth, he struck up a conversation about literature, leaving him thoroughly impressed.
As Amy's party day dawned, she arrived at the Grand Central Hotel in a princess-like lavender dress, her crystal-studded tiara catching the light.
Her heart filled with anxious anticipation as she awaited Jack's arrival for their anticipated dance.
Just then, the party was ambushed by an unexpected guest — Nancy.
Her simplicity, accentuated by an emerald green dress, contrasted sharply with the extravagance around her, leaving Amy and the guests in stunned silence.
Disdaining societal norms and defying expectations, Jack chose Nancy for the opening dance.
The spectacle left the attendees agape and Amy on the verge of tears as her grand romantic vision crumbled.
Trying to cope with the emotional blow, Amy sought solace among the crowd.
No longer enjoyable, Amy found the shallow conversations and hollow laughter increasingly tasteless amidst the grandeur of the Grand Central Hotel ballroom.
Unfazed by their gaping audience, Jack and Nancy whiled away the night, sharing personal stories, delicacies, and in the process, creating a bond that was noticeably intimate.
Later that night, riding on the waves of newfound confidence, Nancy blazed away with an eloquent speech on diversity, authenticity, and genuine friendship.
Her powerful oratory filled the Grand Central Hotel, leaving the listeners enthralled and compelled for reflection, particularly Amy.
Wracked by guilt, Amy sought out Nancy the following day in the school courtyard.
Mustering the courage to own up to her mistake, Amy worded out a heartfelt apology that was graciously accepted by Nancy.
News of the unlikely friendship between Amy and Nancy was the hot talk of Lincoln High School.
This comradeship resulted in a significant change in attitude and respect towards Nancy.
Amy, realizing her wrongdoings, thanked Kelly for supplementing her understanding of authentic friendship and experienced a transformed perception about her friends.
Meanwhile, Jack and Nancy's bond deepened, blurring their initial friendship into mutual romantic feelings.
On a beautiful sunny day in the library's vintage reading room, they decided to formalize their bond.
When the news of this unexpected romantic pair circulated around the school, it initially triggered surprise but gradually morphed into widespread acceptance and support.
Even Amy felt a slight sting of regret upon hearing the news, but swiftly suppressed it, feeling thankful for her personal growth.
Amy and Nancy's unexpected camaraderie continued to evolve, leaving their peers, as well their former acquaintances, impressed by their newfound wisdom and maturity.

Graduation ceremony brought with it tearful goodbyes, shared memories, and promises of lifelong friendships—her social status utterly transformed, Nancy found herself surrounded by genuine friends, a caring boyfriend in Jack, and a promising future in Astrophysics.
Amy, on the other hand, left Lincoln High with a handful of true friends, memorable experiences and the determination to keep learning from life.
Kelly cherished her role in bringing about positive change and looked forward to growing together with her transformed friendships.
Leaving their high school years behind, the group eagerly embraced the new world filled with exciting opportunities, life lessons, and enduring friendships.

71560774.title: You Are So Not Invited to My Bat Mitzvah
synopsis: Stacy Friedman dreams about her upcoming bat mitzvah, including sharing it with her best friend Lydia Rodriguez Katz, and sharing a dance with her crush, Andy Goldfarb.
She clashes with her parents, Bree and Danny, over planning a "perfect" party, which she believes will determine her future.
When popular student Kym Chang Cohen invites Lydia to her house, Stacy tags along.
The girls go on a high ledge, where Andy and his friends meet up with them.
On a dare and to impress Andy, Stacy agrees to jump off the ledge into the water below.
Enjoying Andy's and everyone's approval is short-lived, however, as Stacy's bloody maxi-pad floats up next to her.
Angry that everyone, including Lydia, is laughing at her, Stacy "calls it", and Lydia announces the time that she lost her crush on Andy.
Once school starts, Stacy learns that Lydia and Andy are dating.
Feeling betrayed, Stacy stops talking to Lydia and sends a text message to an anonymous group that Lydia has long hair on her nipples.
Stacy even sabotages an entrance video she was making for Lydia's upcoming bat mitzvah with humiliating personal video clips.
However, she does not send it.
Stacy continues trying to get Andy's attention and visits his grandmother's retirement home.
She tries to look older and more popular, and argues with her parents over planning her bat mitzvah.
Andy eventually offers to give Stacy her first kiss.
Hiding behind the curtains of a Torah ark, they are interrupted by their teacher, Rabbi Rebecca, which leads to more fighting between her and her father.
Lydia's mother, Gabi, unaware Stacy and Lydia are fighting, arrives at the Friedman house, and asks Bree for the entrance video for Lydia's bat mitzvah.
Not realizing what the video contains, Bree sends it to her.
At Lydia's bat mitzvah, the entrance video is played.
Although Stacy tries to get the video stopped, the damage is done.
As Lydia walks into her party, she runs off and angrily chastises Stacy.
At Stacy's bat mitzvah day, she starts to read from the Torah from her parsha of Ki Tissa.
Seeing that Lydia and her parents are missing, she stops, then confesses everything to the audience.
She berates Andy for his bad behavior and for driving her and Lydia apart.
She then finishes her Torah reading at her father's urging.
Afterwards, Stacy runs through town to apologize to Lydia and invites her to her party later that night.
When Lydia and her parents arrive, they are surprised that Stacy has made it into a party for Lydia, too, and the girls make up.
Stacy starts dancing with Matteo, a foreign classmate who has been interested in her.
Sometime later, Stacy, Lydia, and their friends have a bake sale to help the retirement home.

89140230.title: Faith and Family: The Midwestern Values (2021 American Film)
synopsis: The narrative beautifully commences with the lively image of young Emily, our protagonist.
Deeply immersed in an intense game of tag, she wove through the sunflower fields that surrounded their rustic 18th-century farmhouse like a golden halo.
Her brothers, with their cherub-like laughter echoing in the valley, were hot on her heels, adding vivacity to the tranquil Mississippi idyll.
Observing this familial harmony was Jacob, Emily's father.
As a Baptist preacher, his resonant voice filled the little town church every Sunday.
Emily's mother, Martha, was the gentle balance in their family dynamic.
She centered her teachings on love, diversity, and gratitude.
The family's humble abode thrived on early morning prayers, shared meals under the warm radiance of the dining room chandelier, and grand weekend feasts.
As the plot ventures forth, Emily grows older, transitioning from a sheltered child to a critical, perceptive young woman.
During this period of metamorphosis, questions about global perspectives, science, and societal norms take roots in her mind.
Emily begins to challenge the norms and traditions dictated by her rural upbringing.
Unknowingly, Emily stirs the past, unraveling her parents' well-concealed mistakes from days gone by.
This discovery culminates to a heated confrontation, shaking their familial harmony to the core, causing the once stable fabric of their relationship to tear.
Emily finds herself grappling to comprehend this side of her parents she was unprepared to witness.
She feels an alienation, a sense of betrayal seeping into her heart.
Emily decides to make a drastic decision.
She chooses to leave her family and the isolated town to explore the world beyond.
Emily bids her parents farewell.
Her leaving is not without a sense of melancholy.
Her brothers, amid the profound ideological differences between them, promise Emily that their bond will remain unaltered, despite everything.
Emily embarks on her new journey, she lands in the heart of New York.
The relentlessly busy streets, the diverse populace, and the towering skyscrapers were a stark contrast to the serene landscapes of her hometown.
Throughout her struggles, Emily experiences an existential illumination.
Her journey makes her comprehend the intimate relevance of her parents' teachings within the hard-surfaced city.
Emily realizes that coexistence is the key to true enlightenment rather than choosing one over the other.
The matured Emily decides to return home, hoping for reconciliation and forgiveness.
Emily reunites with her family.
Her parents, overcome with elation and relief, open their arms to embrace their daughter and her evolved ideologies, thus marking a beginning towards acceptance and understanding.
Emily propels a transformation within her family, aligning her newfound progressive principles with their deep-seated values.
Emily pioneers an evolution, navigating her family towards open-minded acceptance while respecting the wisdom of their heritage.
Emily follows in her father's footsteps, becoming a Baptist preacher herself.
Her sermons underscore narratives representing her transformative journey both metaphorically and literally.
They serve as inspirations stirring her listeners to question established norms and continually thrive for personal enlightenment.
Through Emily's teachings and influence, the community gradually opens up to a varied range of doctrinal beliefs, resulting in a transformative movement within the town.
Emily, in her newfound role, not only changes her life but serves as an inspiration to the community.
Emily's teachings facilitate the harmonious synergy between the wisdom of the old and the insights of the new, fostering a welcoming environment in their community.

Emily's parents, unable to resist the enchantment of her expanded perspectives, swell with pride for their daughter, who dared to explore the path of enlightenment and invoked a significant change in her community.
Thus, Emily assumes the role of progressive influencer, paving the way for future generations.
Emily's story showcases the perfect amalgamation of steadfast respect for one's heritage and an open mind toward societal evolution.

62096834.title: Respect (2021 American film)
synopsis: In 1952, 10-year-old Aretha Franklin lives with her father C.L., pastor of Detroit’s largest Baptist church, and her siblings Cecil, Erma, and Carolyn.
Aretha’s father often has her sing for parties at their home, while her mother Barbara, separated from C.L., encourages her independence.
The predatory actions of a family friend, combined with the sudden death of Barbara, traumatizes Aretha, who ceases to speak for weeks until her father demands that she sing at church.
Seven years later, Aretha is a teen mother of two boys, but refuses to name their father.
Touring as a gospel singer with family friend Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., she meets local producer Ted White, but C.L.
warns him to stay away.
C.L.
surprises Aretha with a meeting with Columbia Records executive John Hammond.
She accepts a contract to record jazz standards, including "Ac-Cent-Tchu-Ate the Positive."
Four albums later, Aretha lacks a signature hit.
At a club, she attempts to honor family friend Dinah Washington by performing one of Dinah’s songs; outraged, Dinah advises Aretha to find songs that move her.
Struggling with the controlling influence of her father, Aretha begins a relationship with Ted.
She brings him home to meet her family, leading C.L.
to nearly shoot him, but announces Ted as her manager.
Two years later, Ted and Aretha are married with a child.
After nine albums with no real success, Aretha is dropped by Columbia.
Ted secures a deal with veteran producer Jerry Wexler of Atlantic Records, who introduces her to a group of white musicians in Muscle Shoals in 1967.
There, Aretha records "I Never Loved A Man (The Way I Love You)", but a jealous Ted becomes violent with her.
Returning to Detroit with a black eye, Aretha reconnects with her family.
Realizing her song has been released, becoming her first hit, Aretha takes a more hands-on role in her career.
She makes her sisters her new backup singers and, despite their misgivings, reunites with Ted.
Aretha and Carolyn are inspired to re-arrange Otis Redding's "Respect"; their version becomes a #1 single, launching Aretha to stardom by her 25th birthday.
At a Detroit concert, Dr. King honors Aretha for her support of the Civil Rights Movement, proclaiming February 16 "Aretha Franklin Day".
She has another signature hit, "(You Make Me Feel Like) A Natural Woman", but her career is complicated by Ted's increasingly volatile behavior.
Embarking on a European tour in 1968, Aretha is confronted with a Time magazine cover story about Ted's abuse, and finally casts him out of her life.
Dating her tour manager Ken Cunningham, Aretha eventually has her fourth child.
In the wake of Dr. King's assassination, Aretha's father drunkenly argues with her over the direction of the Movement, telling her that she no longer walks in the Spirit.
Aretha continues to release hits but overworks herself, coping with the pressure through alcohol, and rejects her family's attempts to help her.
During a performance in Columbus, Georgia, a drunken Aretha falls from the stage.
On a downward spiral and estranged from Ken and her family, she is consoled by a vision of her late mother.
Aretha finds the strength to quit drinking, leading Ken to reconcile with her, and returns to her gospel roots.
She approaches Wexler with the idea to produce her own gospel album, and he agrees on the condition that the recording of the album be filmed for a documentary.
Beginning rehearsals, Aretha confides in family friend James Cleveland, now a respected gospel artist.
The day of the album's recording, her father arrives to reconcile with her.
The service begins and, with her family in attendance, Aretha sings her arrangement of the hymn, Amazing Grace.
An epilogue reveals Aretha Franklin's legacy as a world-famous artist and the “Queen of Soul”.

538168.title: Canine Comfort: A College Tale
synopsis: Alex, a scholarly biology major at Harvard, was studying alone in his disheveled, poster-filled dorm room while noisy laughter and loud music seeped through the dormitory walls from the ongoing university campus party.
The second act finds Alex peering out of his dorm room window, his brown eyes catching sight of Sarah, a vivacious veterinary student.
Despite his growing regard for Sarah, his withdrawn persona acted as a barrier, preventing him from gathering the courage to express his affections.
His outgoing roommate, Dan, a psychology major well-versed in people skills, started tutoring Alex on the nuances of effective communication.
With bated breath and a gift of a rare biology book, Alex embarked on his mission.
However, it ended abruptly, leaving him more anxious and emotionally disoriented than before.
Alex cocooned himself further into isolation, avoiding people and places that reminded him of his unrequited love.
Spotting secluded spots in the university, he gravitated towards the reading room in the library.
On a solitary stroll along the banks of the Charles River, under the melancholic cascading dusk light, Alex stumbled across a whimpering beagle puppy, shivering from the cold.
Alex adopted the puppy, christening it Buddy - his newfound companion.
A series of sequences ensued, showing Alex painstakingly nursing the little beagle back to health.
As time ticked, Alex's once solitary routine got synchronized with Buddy's playful hours.
The camera caught candid moments of a chuckling Alex, his previous stern demeanor melting into a warm grin as he kissed Buddy's snout, played fetch or cuddled him.
Buddy, with his fur-coat and a wagging tail, brought about unimaginable changes in Alex.
He busted Alex's hesitations and coaxed him out of his shell.
Alex introduced Buddy to his university friends.
Alex, in search of canine companions for Buddy's playdates, ventured into Boston Common, his social circle unknowingly expanding with every passing day.
The reluctant, silent observer slowly transformed into a confident communicator.
Sarah, amidst her busy schedule, couldn't help but notice Alex's metamorphosis.
Witnessing Alex's tenderness and patience with Buddy softened her heart towards him.
Sarah initiated a friendly chat with Alex during their shared biology lecture.
No longer an introverted recluse, Alex balanced his interaction with others, particularly Sarah.
Although more open now, he kept a neutral rapport with Sarah, safeguarding his heart from another rejection.
Disaster struck when Buddy showed signs of illness, further diagnosed as Canine Parvovirus.
An anxious Alex was overwhelmed, fear seeping into his bones for his best friend's life.
Sarah, with her veterinary knowledge, stepped forward offering assistance.
United by love for Buddy, they whisked him off to the Angell Animal Medical Center in Boston.
As the days rolled by, they tirelessly attended to Buddy, their shared anxiety for their beloved friend deepening their bond.
Amidst the gloomy hospital waiting rooms, Sarah laid bare her affectionate feelings towards Alex.
Drawing strength from his transformed persona and newfound emotional maturity, Alex acknowledged Sarah's feelings.
He expressed his need for stability and emotional steadiness, suppressing his lingering affections.
Days of treatments and heartfelt prayers later, there was a silver lining.
Buddy had finally recovered from his illness, his jovial barks echoing in their lives, reinstating happiness.
Reflecting on the rollercoaster of emotions, Alex made a conscious resolve to maintain a balance between his personal space and social life.
He wanted to ensure neither aspect suffered, particularly his academic progress.
In the quiet of the night, Alex embraced his introverted nature, realizing it made him uniquely sensitive towards the tiniest details of life.
Sarah respected Alex's wishes.
Although her heart ached for him, she maintained a cordial, platonic friendship, honoring his decision with grace.
Their relation grew deep and meaningful, their shared affection for Buddy acting as a robust pillar.
Alex confidently attended the annual university ball.
He was seen freely conversing with peers, proudly acknowledging his introverted self.
Life had come full circle for Buddy.
No longer a sickly puppy, his cheerful barking and playful antics added a much-needed sparkle to Alex's life.
Sarah and Alex continued their friendship, their bond centered around their mutual affection for Buddy.
Alex embraced his introverted nature, attaining a level of self-confidence and emotional maturity unseen before.
He no longer questioned himself, instead garnishing love for his uniqueness.
Sarah, watching Alex enamored by his newfound confidence from a distance, couldn't help but smile.
She silently wished for a future possibility, her heart fluttering with anticipation.
The narrative closes on a positive note with Alex, Sarah, and a healthy Buddy forging ahead towards a new semester.
It hinted at a promising new chapter in their lives, filled with hopeful friendships, heartwarming moments, and strengthening bonds.

72724086.title: Dog Gone (2023 film)
synopsis: Fielding is a socially awkward college kid, who decides to adopt a puppy after being rejected by a girl.
He finds a yellow lab puppy at the local pound and adopts him.
He names the dog Gonker, and they are inseparable for the rest of his college career.
The dog often runs with him to class on campus without a leash.
When college is done, all of Fielding's friends have jobs, but Fielding does not know what he wants to do with his life, which worries his father, John.
Fielding moves in with his parents with Gonker.
A few weeks later, Gonker is diagnosed with Addison's disease and needs a life-saving shot every month for the rest of his life.
His best friend from college visits him a few weeks later, and they are out on a hiking trail with Gonker, who runs off chasing a fox.
When he doesn't return, they start looking for him, but cannot find him.
Panicked, they rush home and tell Fielding's parents that Gonker might be lost.
There are flashbacks of Fielding's mother Ginny having a dog, Oji, when she was a young girl, who was run over when she was at school.
Her parents are shown to be cold and unfeeling and encourage her to not make a big deal about it.
She buries the pain and trauma, but it gets triggered by Gonker's loss and bubbles up to the surface.
She sets up a control room in their house, calling local newspapers, animal shelters, hospitals, and starts sending out flyers throughout the state.
Local newspapers and then national newspapers pick up Gonker's story and there are now a lot of people looking for Gonker.
They have to find him before he needs his next shot in three weeks.
During the extensive search, Fielding's health takes a turn for the worse.
He is not eating much, barely sleeping, and getting weaker by the day.
They receive a call about a dog with Addison's disease from an animal shelter and rush there only to find that it is not Gonker.
They keep looking but are not having much luck.
Seeing Fielding's deteriorating health, his father decides to drive him back home and call off the search and rescue.
Just then, they receive a call of another sighting, and this time it is Gonker.
They bring him back home which immediately perks Fielding up.
But Fielding has to be rushed to the hospital where he is diagnosed with ulcerative colitis and has an emergency operation, which is successful.
The movie ends on an optimistic note with both Gonker and Fielding sleeping together in his hospital bed and recuperating.
During the credits, it was revealed that Gonker never left the Marshalls again and Fielding now lives in Chile giving kayaking tours.

62336066.title: Freedom for a Felon
synopsis: The film unfurls in the distinctive and colorful market square of the picturesque town of Abilene, nestled peacefully in the center of late-1890s Kansas.
The radiant morning sun illuminates brilliantly, casting its golden glow over the cheerful faces of the townsfolk engaged in enthusiastic barter and friendly banter in the buzzing marketplace.
An almost sacred silence sweeps over the square as the formidable figure of John Doe, a sheriff hardened by countless battles against lawlessness, edges into view atop his muscular stallion, Scout.

Rumors swell and surge through the interconnected grapevine of Abilene, alerting the vigilant Doe to the looming release of Jack Black, an infamous cardsharp and unprincipled outlaw he'd brought to justice years before.
The mere mention of Black's name stirs a previously dormant flame within Doe; he recollects Black not only as a crafty swindler but as a man capable of stirring chaos and fear.

With a face like stone yet radiating firm resolve, Doe utters his displeasure about Black's impending release, foreseeing the devastation this remorseless offender could inflict on his peaceful haven.
With a smirk of arrogant satisfaction, Black steps out of his dank jail cell, exploiting a loophole in the penal code with triumphant glee, and indulging in the sweet taste of long-desired freedom.
Almost immediately, Black plunges back into his old exploits in the criminal underworld, devising cunning plans to elude the law and evade Doe, who is now resolutely hot on his trail.
Delving into the intricate maze of Black's unusual release, Doe stumbles upon a worrisome trail of breadcrumbs leading to a manipulative politician with corrupt motives.
Displaying unflinching boldness and steadfast determination, Doe endeavours to reveal this scandalous corruption, but his attempts remain thwarted by stubborn bureaucratic walls.
The profundity of the corruption leaves Doe disoriented and overwhelmed, a sinking feeling of despair slowly engulfing him as his aspirations for justice meet increasing obstacles.

Staunch in his resolve, Doe embarks on a daring solitary expedition to gather irrefutable evidence against Black's schemes, crucially keeping his activities under wraps from prying, potentially corrupt, officers.
However, Black capitalizes on his underworld informants to decipher Doe's strategy, initiating a breath-taking manhunt that dramatically escalates the tension.
Thereafter, the men engage in a strategic dance, where each move carries significant stakes, their intense rivalry reaches its zenith as both men strategize to outsmart the other.
Despite the multitude of obstacles and the looming threats to his life, Doe manages to garner overpowering evidence against Black's reign and his corrupt political patrons.
Sensing a significant threat hovering over his newfound liberty, Black places a hefty bounty on Doe's head, transforming him into an enticing payday for ruthless mercenaries and bounty hunters.
Suddenly, Doe finds himself precariously navigating an environment fraught with high-stakes, determined to evade not just Black's henchmen but also wary of the colleagues he called brothers.
The film's climax unfolds when Doe boldly confronts Black in a dilapidated barn on the outskirts of town, culminating in a pulse-pounding showdown.
In an unforeseen twist, Doe overpowers Black, extracting a desperate confession about Black's illicit activities.
Despite having a bounty on his head and the local law enforcement hot on his trail, Doe manages to capture this damning piece of evidence on an early phonograph.

Unyielding, Doe unveils the audio-recorded confession and his substantiating evidence to the stunned authorities, thereby setting the wheels of justice in motion against both Black and his seedy political associate.

As the narrative begins its descent, Abilene's townsfolk erupt into celebratory cheers for Doe, their heartfelt respect and gratitude for his heroic deeds in rooting out the corruption that had tainted their town, is palpable.
We are left with a poignant image of Black behind bars, remorsefully watching Doe ride away, serving as a stark reminder that crime will, in the end, be served its due punishment.

The film concludes with Doe leaving a cheering Abilene behind, his faith in the judicial system restored and his eyes gleaming with determination, anticipating the thrill and challenges that await him in his future endeavours.

68009501.title: Dead for a Dollar
synopsis: In 1897, in New Mexico Territory, veteran bounty hunter Max Borlund learns that Joe Cribbens, a card shark and armed robber who served five years in prison after being brought to justice by Borlund, will soon be released.
Borlund visits Cribbens to warn him against following through with his vow to "buy a gun and look him up".
A friend of Borlund's introduces him to a businessman, Martin Kidd, who hires Borlund to retrieve his wife, Rachel.
He claims that Rachel was abducted and is being held for ransom in Chihuahua, Mexico by Elijah Jones, an African American army deserter.
The officer assigns one of his men, Sergeant Alonzo Poe, to assist Borlund as he was a close friend of Jones and has a map to his hideout, after agreeing to deliver the ransom money.
En route, the two men run afoul of Tiberio Vargas, a rich landowner who moonlights as a vicious bandit.
Borlund refuses to accede to Vargas's extortion and forces him to leave.
Cribbens also heads south to Chihuahua, where he tries to support himself by winning poker games.
One night, he wins a large sum of money from William "English Bill" Palmer; when Palmer threatens Cribbens at gunpoint for his money back, the latter shoots Palmer dead in self-defense.
Vargas goes to see Cribbens and reveals that he and Palmer were working together on a lucrative mining scheme.
Since Cribbens killed him, Vargas insists that he now owes him a "favor".
Borlund and Poe find the two runaways hiding with Jack Hannon, an American fugitive who mistakenly assumes that Borlund is after him and threatens Rachel's head.
Borlund shoots him and saves her.
Jones explains that he had made an arrangement with Vargas to obtain passage to Cuba for $5,000, which he planned to pay for out of the ransom.
Borlund and his party reach a small border town, where the local police captain agrees to incarcerate Jones and send a telegram to Martin informing him that Rachel has been found.
Told to keep an eye on Jones, Poe secretly explains that he intends to set him free, feeling that Jones deserves a chance to live his life how he chooses.
Borlund realises this and devises a plan to help Poe engineer Jones's escape once they cross over into the United States.

Borlund learns from Rachel what he had already begun to suspect: Rachel was not abducted; she chose to leave with Jones because Martin married her only for her money and routinely cheats on her with other women.
She believes that her husband, humiliated by a black man running off with his wife, has no intention of taking her back home alive.
Vargas sends Cribbens to kill Borlund; Poe and Rachel aim their guns at him and Cribbens leaves empty-handed.
Vargas then intercepts the stagecoach transporting Martin into Mexico and the two men cut a deal.
When Martin arrives, he bribes the captain's corrupt deputy to cover for him while he shoots Jones dead in his cell.
Rachel and her husband reunite and Martin admits that he paid Vargas off to rape and kill her, hoping to sell her death as a story to the newspapers to boost his political ambitions.
Rachel takes out her derringer and shoots Martin dead.
Vargas and his men arrive and murder both the captain and his deputy.
Borlund kills several bandits, while Poe and Rachel kill the rest in a close-quarters shoot-out with the help of a friendly female innkeeper.
Vargas manages to shoot Poe in the shoulder, while Cribbens sneaks up from behind and shoots him.
Borlund offers his old enemy the chance to leave with his life but Cribbens refuses and subsequently dies when Borlund outdraws him.
Poe is patched up and the movie ends as the three go their separate ways after returning to America.

Poe serves in the army for nearly thirty years, retires and dies an old man in a veterans' home in 1937, Rachel never remarries and spends the rest of her life fighting for politically progressive causes after moving to Philadelphia and Borlund works as a bounty hunter for the rest of his days.

32433620.title: My Little Horse: A Fresh Epoch
synopsis: In the picturesque town of Seaside Cove, a sage-like horse named Plaid Comet, characterized by his gleaming grey mane and mesmerizing blue eyes, narrates the tales of old to his lively, chestnut-colored son, Bright Moonranger.
Fascinating stories unfold of an age when harmony and unity were the melody of the land.
This unity encapsulated not just their fellow horses, but also the majestic winged horses and mythical unicorns who were believed to be their ancestors.

On one of his routine explorations across the vast, green-carpeted expanses of their tranquil home, Moonranger happened upon a curious and exotic artifact, lying quietly beneath a vibrant bed of pink and white peonies.
The artifact, forgotten by time, held an ancient symbol of unity, a harmony that had been lost to the centuries.
Bright Moonranger, his heart thumping with excitement, raced back to Plaid Comet as fast as his hooves would carry him.
The ancient symbol was grasped tightly between his teeth, his eyes alight with anticipation for the revelations it conveys.
Plaid Comet's eyes widened at the sight of the ancient artifact, so lost in time he had only heard of it in the oldest of tales.
Feeling its significance resonate through his veins, Plaid Comet soberly reveals its importance to Moonranger.

Deciding it was the time to pass on this great responsibility, Plaid Comet initiates Young Moonranger's destined journey, lavishing him with all the knowledge he had about the artifact and its all-healing powers.
Along his journey, he happens upon a stunning creature rare even in their world.
A white winged horse with a majestic mane named Sky Ripper; her radiant aura encapsulated joy and kindness in its purest form.
Moonranger and Ripper join their forces, forming an alliance as resilient as their characters, now pointed towards their shared aspiration.
They meet numerous trials head-on, their courage visible in pursuits both mental and physical.
They even encounter perilous mythical beasts — all in the name of a shared dream: advocating peace and unity.
Each obstacle they overcome serves to reinforce their bonds, nurturing their resolve, fortifying their determination, and helping them believe in their powers to unite the world once again.
Their thrilling quest finally leads them to their greatest challenge yet, Mount Wisdom, a towering landmass stretching towards the heavens.
It is the abode of the Grand Council of Horse Elders, the wise authority across all clans.
The council announces a Horse Tournament.
The event, known far and wide, attracts mythical creatures from across the distant lands.
Bright Moonranger and Sky Ripper, fueled by their shared vision of unity, courageously pledge their participation in the tournament.
Rising to popularity, the pair, with the council's hesitant consent, activate the artifact within the sight of the community gathered from the farthest corners of their world.
As the unsealing incantation rolls off their tongues, an incandescent blue light flows from the artifact, showering Mount Wisdom in its brilliance.
The light, a living moving spectacle, reveals vivid images of the era lost to time when peace and unity flourished.
The prophecy, chilling in its revelation, warns of dreadful impending calamities that might befall them should the different types of horses continue their strife.
The council elders, their hearts pricked by the revelation, finally agreed to put aside their long-held grudges and work towards cultivating a harmonious future.
All the way back in the sun-dappled Seaside Cove, the townsfolk gaze up towards Mount Wisdom.
Among them, Plaid Comet watches the actions unfold, a sigh of relief escaping his lips as he witnesses the shift in the horse community's mindset.
