Her innovative business plan, which marries her corporate experience with academic prowess, is deemed the best in her class, insinuating the potential of a promising academic career.
However, this twist in fortune unsettles John.
His brilliant academic record seemingly pales in comparison to his wife's newfound recognition and towering achievements.
Kate swiftly ascends the academic ladder, often invited to guest lectures and panel discussions.
Her meteoric rise associates her name with academic excellence, placing her atop a pedestal she had never envisioned.
As the cherry on top, she receives an offer to head Yale's business department, casting John deeper into the shadow of insecurity as he struggles to match her unabridged success.
This unexpected power dynamic inflicts turmoil upon their relationship.
John grapples with his bruised ego while Kate attempts to balance her flourishing career and a fraying marriage.

Act five witnesses the tensions culminating into a heated confrontation fraught with pent-up emotions, taking a toll on their two-decade-long companionship and leaving them questioning the future of their marriage.
Amidst the tension and hostility, they agree to take a break, to reflect on their identities, their ambitions, and their fracturing bond.
Amid this turmoil, a bracing encounter with Professor Smith, John's old friend, compels him to face and appreciate the true magnificity of Kate's achievements.

Concurrently, over heartfelt conversations with her girlfriends in a quaint coffee shop, Kate confronts her overeager competitive spirit, aiding her to realize the need for achieving balance, for the sake of the marriage she cherished.
Within this storm of introspection, they both comprehend the supremacy of their love, outshining any professional accomplishment.
Their brief hiatus ends as a more enlightened John, invites Kate to L'Appart, their preferred French restaurant.
It's here where he exposes his insecurities and commends her victories, marking the commencement of healing.
Kate, moved by John's candid expression of vulnerability, makes a pledge to adjust her ambitions, promising to strike a balance for preserving their delicate relationship.
With mutual understanding refueling their bond, they vow to spur each other's growth in their fields, fostering an environment of support and mutual respect.
As their tale completes a full circle, they are back at Yale.
John, brilliantly commanding lecture halls and Kate, rekindling her academia business prowess in the boardrooms.
As fate rolls the dice, a chance encounter at Yale's main library, Sterling, offers them a moment of warm reconciliation.
Their eyes meet, acknowledging each other's journeys, their shared wisdom, and their enduring love.

57441882.title: Shirley (2020 film)
synopsis: Fred and Rose Nemser are newlyweds relocating to Bennington College for Fred's job as a lecturer.

Fred is about to work for Stanley Hyman while Rose, still a student, is already enthralled by the work of Stanley's wife, Shirley Jackson, writer of "The Lottery", the dark short story which shocked readers of The New Yorker when it was published on June 26, 1948.
Minutes after their first meeting, Shirley asks Rose about her (not yet announced) pregnancy, saying "I'm a witch, didn't you know?"
Soon after, Stanley asks Rose to help with menial jobs around the house because Shirley is struggling to write after suffering another bout of agoraphobia.
Fred and Rose reluctantly assent and move into the house.
Rose realizes that she has unwittingly agreed to serve as the family housekeeper.

She also sees the pathology of Stanley and Shirley's marriage: in his worship of Shirley's genius as a writer, Stanley enables her drinking and her lethargy; in turn, Shirley tolerates Stanley's posturing and pomposity, and she winks at his serial love affairs.
The Nemsers move into the Jackson-Hyman house.
Shirley is deliberately dismissive of and even cruel to Rose, who has apparently given up on her studies in order to manage the household.
Shirley begins to write again, announcing a new work based on Paula Jean Welden, a young woman who recently disappeared from Bennington's campus.
Stanley is obsessive and controlling about Shirley's writing process; he asserts that she is a genius, but he wheedles and cajoles her to stay on task.
Despite her initial harsh treatment of Rose, Shirley begins to think of the younger woman as somewhat of a muse.
Shirley opens up to Rose, having her do research for the new book, including stealing the medical files for Paula Jean Welden.
As the two grow closer, Rose falls more and more under Shirley's spell.
She is enraptured by and protective of Shirley.
A sexual flirtation builds between them, but is never acknowledged or consummated by the two.
In the meantime, the relationship between Stanley and Fred deteriorates as Stanley seeks to tamp down Fred's ambitions and to torpedo his career as an academic.
Rose's baby is born, yet Shirley remains wrapt in the cocoon of her writing; the arrival of a baby has little effect on life in the Jackson/Hyman household.
Now feeling that the Nemsers have served their purpose, Stanley arranges for them to move out.

Desperate to stay, Rosie writes the name of Paula Jean Welden in a Bennington College library book and gives it to Shirley, hoping she'll infer that Paula had been Stanley's student and had been having an affair with him.
To Rose's shock, Shirley is unaffected, saying that she's well aware of Stanley's love affairs and that she knows Paula was not one of his lovers.
She also reveals that Rose's husband Fred is just the same as Stanley — that he too has been having sex with his students.
After confronting Fred about his infidelity, Rose runs off.
As she walks along the road, with her baby daughter in her arms, Shirley pulls up next to her in a car and offers to drive her wherever she would like.
Rose wants to see the trail where Paula disappeared.
When Shirley arrives, Rose hands her the baby and the follows the trail into the woods.
Shirley finds her at the edge of a cliff, where Rose is clearly weighing whether or not to jump.
After a tense moment, Rose gives in and turns away from the edge.
Her safe return home isn't a capitulation, though.
When she and Fred finally drive away from the Jackson-Hyman house, Rose vows never to return to being a docile wife devoted to a life of domesticity.
Alone at last, Shirley allows Stanley to read her work on Hangsaman.
He declares it to be a work of genius.
Shirley acknowledges his praise.
It's obviously a familiar pattern in their peculiar partnership.
The two celebrate by drinking and dancing — together and yet alone in their cluttered house.

4082590.title: The Rhythm Within (2021 film)
synopsis: Situated in the bustling heart of Greenwich Village, New York in 1996, our tale takes us to Johnny Bravo, once renowned as a pinnacle in the world of jazz, a music virtuoso whose fame gradually faded onto the back pages of the musical world.
Now in the late autumn of his life, Johnny lives virtually unnoticed in a nearly dilapidated single bedroom apartment.

His cherished refuge feels more like a time capsule; it is stacked with vinyl records that create spiralling towers, heaps of carefully marked music sheets from his halcyon days, and an old grand piano coated with fine dust from years of desolation.
On one seemingly ordinary day, Johnny stumbles upon an overlooked melody written during the period of his artistic prosperity.

Drawn irresistibly towards the concealed beauty of the melody, Johnny boldly decides to perform the music at The Rusty Trumpet, a nearby jazz club struggling for survival, indicating an unexpected turning point in his life.

The performance, unconventional in all its aspects -a grizzled jazz maestro breathing life into a forgotten piece- catches the unexpected attention of Lisa Montgomery, a youthful virtuoso absorbed in the vibrant and experimental music culture of the 90s.
Intrigued by Johnny's offbeat rhythm and the nostalgic allure of his antique composition, Lisa initiates a conversation.
Lisa doggedly encourages Johnny back onto the thrilling path of music.
Johnny, however, harbors deep-seated fears of public failure and the thought of his inadequacy and past glory becoming a subject of ridicule holds him back.
Lisa and Johnny find common ground and a rather unlikely professional relationship stems between them.
Lisa makes way for the musical progression, juxtaposing contemporary electronic beats against the backdrop of Johnny's classic, pulsating jazz tunes.

Their shared musical journey, although exciting, isn't free from hurdles; Johnny's deep-seated belief in the sanctity of jazz often pushes against Lisa's progressive music inclinations, resulting in momentary clashes of wills and passions.
With the intense music collaboration, Johnny unexpectedly finds himself emotionally drawn toward Lisa.
Her tenacity and unwavering conviction wake up feelings Johnny thought were long buried, stirring their professional equation.

The duo eagerly dives into the approaching storm of rehearsals for "Jazz Hands," the much-awaited annual jazz fiesta, focusing their energies on presenting their new, one-of-a-kind musical style to the world.
Yet, their jubilant collaboration comes to a sudden halt when a shocking revelation unfolds- Lisa's secretive battle with Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), a terrifying terminal ailment.
Struck with bitter desolation and absorbed in the fear of losing Lisa, Johnny debates packing his untuned piano and retreating from the pinnacle of his revitalized career.

However, Lisa, battling with the progressive physical weakness, continues to embody an unyielding spirit, prompting Johnny to march forward towards their shared dream, effectively shoving the gloomy spotlight off her detrimental health onto their combined love for symphony.
"Jazz Hands" finally dawns, and a visibly shaken Johnny steps onto the stage, his heart heavy with grief, yet his fingers gripped tightly around the dying embers of their shared dream.

This performance, a whirlwind of intertwined emotions — the sting of an upcoming loss, the sweet whispers of a silent love, the dim echoes of a past, and the sparkle of hopeful tomorrow, amalgamates into a melody that enthralls every ear in the packed auditorium.
Overwhelmed by the applause, Johnny attributes the performance to Lisa, who watches the spectacle unfold from a hospital bed through a heartfelt live stream.
A tearful Lisa watches as Johnny reconfigures his destiny on stage, reclaiming his lost glory.
The movie takes a poetic end, with Johnny reconciling with the symphonies he had forfeited long ago.
The remarkable journey of Johnny Bravo from a seclusion of music towards the path of redemption stands as the symbol of their mutual love for music.

67387224.title: The Space Between (2021 film)
synopsis: Set in 1996 Los Angeles, Micky Adams, is an eccentric, singer-songwriter, burnout 70s rock musician.
He has lost his grip on reality and his record label is looking to drop him and his newly created "unique" albums.

Hoping to be promoted out of the record-label mailroom, young Charlie Porter volunteers to seek the musician out in Montecito, his bizarre home 'Xanadont', to convince Micky to sign out of his contract.
Things do not go as Charlie planned.
Micky invites him in, with attitude, overgrown hair and beard, soon dosing him with psychedelics.
Before Charlie knows what is happening, he finds himself uninhibited, wandering alongside the free-thinking hippie through trees with a llama to the beach.
He wakes up face down in the sand, buck naked.
He finds his way back on foot, finally meeting Mickey's daughter Julia.
She says he is not crazy, but hiding.
Charlie tells the company head, Donny, that he got the contract signed, then hooks up with Cory, the singer he hopes to sign to the label.
He heads back to Micky's and instead of getting the signature, helps Julia deal with his meltdown over paparazzi photos.
Afterward, she tells him about her mom's passing, and goes out.
Wandering around the house and grounds, Charlie puts on one of Micky's many LPs, then finds an upright randomly on the back lawn.
He starts playing, which draws Micky out of the house.
He sits by him, accompanying him, inspired.
Taking over the keyboard, he has a flashback of his wife and daughter dancing.
Micky feels Charlie is his muse.
Talking in the car, Charlie opens up about his dysfunctional relationship with his alcoholic father.
They are heading to Micky's childhood home.
Finding it a shambles, he loudly tries to break in, and they get thrown into jail.
There, he calls Charlie his best friend, and Julia picks them up.
On the ride back, she and Charlie share secrets.
Cory is waiting for Charlie when he arrives home.
The next day, he introduces her at Donny's label party, and is sent away by him back to get the signature.
Again, he gets sucked in as Charlie has an odd but powerful bond with Micky/Julia.
He tags along as the newly-inspired Micky dresses to perform in a small bar.
When he chokes, he quietly asks for a pen, and signs the contract, dejected.

Talking to Charlie later, believing he will not see him again, Micky refers to the painting on the Sistine Chapel The Creation of Adam: music is the space between the two outstretched fingers, love and hate, man and woman, life and death, heaven and hell.
Shortly after Camaroon, the paparazzi resurfaces, reiterating that Charlie has lit a spark in Micky, something he has been waiting for with bated breath.
Sure enough, Donny waves away the contract Charlie has finally gotten signed.
The naked photos of their first meeting were printed on the front page of National Enquirer making Micky a hot commodity, and he gives him two weeks to prepare for the Grammys.
When Charlie goes to tell Micky, Julia is upset because he has gone missing.
As they head out to look for him, Camaroon arrives.
At first, they do not know where to look, until Charlie realizes he is gone to surf.
For the third time, he jumps in to pull out Micky.
That evening, all three go to the same bar.
This time, not only is he able to perform, but he dedicates a song to his ever-loyal Julia.
As they are leaving, Donny approaches them.
Charlie again happily hands him the contract, declaring they are set up with a recording contract elsewhere.
The film closes on a close-up photo of Charlie and Julia facing one other, barely touching, on the cover of a new CD entitled, 'The Space Between'.

14218288.title: The Unexpected Starlet
synopsis: The story begins in the ordinary, peaceful lives of Mary and Connie; they work as waitresses at 'The Rusty Spoon', a beloved small-town diner nestled in the heart of Elmwood, Nebraska.
Their mundane conversations revolved around their seemingly uneventful lives, involving exciting subjects such as the latest town bake sale or the impending county fair.
The tranquility in Elmwood is broken when news shoots through the town like a comet that Hollywood is heading to their local cornfields and main street.
The buzz comes from the announcement that 'Sunset Starlets', an anticipated Hollywood production directed by the lauded Don Simms, would be filming there.

On a breezy morning, while strolling and catching up on recent happenings, Mary and Connie notice a large, vibrant poster with bold letters fluttering in the wind, placed proudly at Elmwood's center, the Gazebol.
The poster announced auditions for a minor role in the upcoming film, 'Sunset Starlets.'

Mary confidently delivers a monologue she had rehearsed painstakingly from 'A Streetcar Named Desire,' while Connie, initially appearing anxious, delivered a sincere portrayal of a young girl returning home from war.

Amidst a spectacle of flamboyant performances from eager local talents, Don Simms, a seasoned director, finds himself captivated by the raw intensity and nuances that Connie brings into her portrayal.

To the corn-sweet surprise of Elmwood dwellers, Don Simms, with his charismatic personality and stylish blonde hair combed back, handpicks Connie for the role of Brenda, a waitress who aspires to be a singer.
Connie's sudden ascension to fame couldn't be missed.

Her face decorated morning newspapers and drew black-and-white shadows across the TV screens, causing envy and betrayal to bubble uncomfortably in the heart of Mary, her dreams dismantling around her.
Mary watches as her Broadway dreams dissolve into nothing, smashed against the harsh rocks of reality.
Overcome with swirling feelings of resentment and self-pity, Mary's world darkens.
Conversely, Connie is constantly blinded and disoriented by the bright, unfamiliar, and cold world of her newfound fame, leaving her yearning for the comforting warmth of her erstwhile quiet life.
The sharp pain of her strained friendship with Mary, amplifies Connie's isolation.
Lost in the glam world, her heart fills with an aching longing for their past simplicity.
As a climax to their feud, Act 3 hits the big screen.
'Sunset Starlets' unfurls.

While Connie basks in the new heights of stardom fuelled by applauds from industry luminaries, Mary grapples with her shattered dreams and resentful envy against the sparingly lit skyline of her humble town.
Despite the enticing world of Hollywood, populated with luxurious limousines, bubbling champagne, and red carpet events, Connie finds it increasingly difficult to fit in.
She yearned for the soothing serenity of Elmwood's open skies and the genuine warmth of its people.
Simultaneously, Mary, watched the premiere on their small black-and-white TV, layers of intense emotions bubbling within her.
As Connie delivered a brilliant performance, Mary grapples with feelings of envy and hidden guilt.
One ordinary day, Connie, in a pastel day dress, decided to visit Mary's white-picket-fence house.
The core of Act 4 revealed a heartfelt evening of intense discussions between the two estranged friends.
They delved into the turbid waters of their struggles; Mary's silent fight with envy and guilt, and Connie's escalating struggle with overwhelming fame.

With the tempting aroma of Mary's home-baked apple pie hanging in the air, an essential realization dawned upon the duo; their deep-rooted friendship, was far more precious than the illusionary glamour of fame and success.
In a shocking turn of events, Connie decides to renounce her blossoming Hollywood career.
She decides to let go of the glitz and glamour of her lavish mansion and the star-studded life, favoring her ordinary, content life in Elmwood.
In an adjacent journey of realization, Mary grapples with her twisted feelings of jealousy and resentment before finally releasing them.
The sun setting in Elmwood gives way to a heartwarming reunion, with the two friends determined to mend their strained relations.
They sank back into their simple town life, the life that once seemed too ordinary now revitalized with newfound wisdom.
The story winds up with a heartwarming scene of Mary and Connie, sharing easy laughs under the Elmwood skies over a steaming cup of diner coffee at their favorite corner booth in 'The Rusty Spoon'.
Against the sedate rhythm of the classic film playing in the background, they seal their promise to each other; never again would they let anything come between their invaluable friendship.
The tale of Connie, Elmwood's unexpected starlet, draws to a close, with her choosing to live roles that coexist with her renewed personal life.
As happiness finds her teaching at Elmwood Middle and exploring her passion at the community theater, her past life of stardom seems like another world.

66814171.title: Tall Girl 2
synopsis: Jodi's newfound fame and new desire to get a part in the spring musical, however, prove to be huge roadblocks in her otherwise smooth relationship with Dunkleman.
She finds herself fighting her own fears and dealing with anxiety attacks.
After landing the lead part of Kim in ‘Bye Bye Birdie’, Jodi is bewildered.
Her insecurities are calling to her through a voice within her head.
Tommy plays the lead opposite Jodi in the production and is a possible new love interest.
Jodi deals with typical adolescent issues.
She carries a lot of weight on her shoulders between the boy she's dating, her friendships, bullying, the musical, and her uncomfortable parents.
She is under a great deal of stress and feels completely overwhelmed.
By focusing on her confidence, Jodi eventually discovers a means to filter out that negative voice.
She makes the decision to govern her mind rather than the other way around.
Her parents go above and beyond to ensure that their children succeed.
Meanwhile, others are struggling with their own insecurities, while Jodi is battling negative thoughts in her head.
Harper, Jodi's sister, is attempting to prove that she is capable of more than just competing in beauty pageants.
Fareeda wishes for her parents to believe in her goal of becoming a fashion designer.
Dunkleman's connection with Jodi is often questioned.
Jodi's negative inner voice that tells her she's not good enough has been plaguing her since the beginning of rehearsals.
And her bully Kimmy, who she beat for the lead role, is now determined to ensure Jodi flakes out.
Kimmy wants to enlist Schnipper in her plots, but he refuses as he has a crush on Jodi since their kiss in the first film.
Kimmy finds out that she doesn't have to do much to upset Jodi, so her first week of rehearsals doesn't go as planned, despite Tommy's assurances.
The strain eventually takes its toll on Jodi's relationship when Jack, who, after promising her she can skip their anniversary dinner to rehearse, becomes upset when she actually does.
They part soon after, and Jodi becomes close to Tommy, with whom she shares a kiss one night.
Jodi starts to reconcile with Jack, but when she admits that she kissed someone else, Jack reacts angrily, and they officially break up.
He makes a contract with Stig's sister Stella, who is going through her own break-up, and swears to never see her again.
Jodi participates in the pre-show “burning ceremony”, which is meant to purge the cast of any negativity before their performance.
She intends to set fire to the shoes Jack gave her in the first film, but she changes her mind halfway through.
Kimmy is the one who saves them from the fire, which marks the beginning of her bully's redemption.
Despite Tommy's interest in her, Jodi admits that she is still not over Jack, and they agree to merely be friends.
Jodi gives Fareeda her blessing to date Stig at the pre-opening night celebration, and Jack appears to give Jodi a pep talk.
Stella also gives him a long-overdue scolding for his reaction to Jodi's kiss with Tommy.
Despite her parents’ guidance on how to deal with nerves, Jodi is still having trouble with her inner voice on the opening night of the show.
Kimmy completes her redemption by declining Jodi's offer to take her place on stage, instead telling Jodi that she will stay in the wings and give her cues if she forgets anything.
Opening night is a success, and after the show, Jodi finally silences her inner critic by reminding herself, that she is good enough to do this.
When Jack arrives, he discloses that he has been photographing in the lighting booth all night.
He confesses his love for Jodi, which she reciprocates, and they reconcile and kiss.

16525977.title: Enigma of Spectra
synopsis: Ex-detective John Doe inhabits the solitude of his artifact-ridden studio apartment in the heart of the city slickers.

Every quiet hour of his day, he engrosses himself with the modern enigma of live-streaming, sharing his latest investigative pursuits curated by his unique 'WonderSeed Network' to an eager audience of virtual mystery enthusiasts.
Now, he prepares to plunge into a new-world conundrum, unraveling the mysteries of a surprise package he received.
Amid mixed puzzles and fascinating relics, an antiquated Spectra device, akin to a 1960s radio garners attention.
Its cryptic, seemingly purposeless presence incites a deeper intrigue.
Following his seasoned instincts, John delves deep into discovering the origin of the bewildering package.
His findings unravel a tie to the gloomy, anarchic underbelly of the digital world — the dark web.
As the second act unfolds, the rusty switch of the Spectra is flipped.
Electricity thrums within its antique body, triggering the once dead device into an electrified hulk.
John crouches, his blue eyes squinting at the Spectra.
He grapples with the maddening cipher within its seemingly gibberish static, his brows furrowed as he decodes the most intricate part of the puzzle.
Recognizing patterns and connecting dots, his detective prowess awakens a potential conspiracy blooming in the shadowy quarters of the dark web.
Having unraveled prominent clues, John takes his findings public, broadcasting his investigative journey within his highly-visited blog.
His subscribers rapidly consuming each hint and inference.
As his investigations gain momentum, ominous digital threats trickle in from cyber shadows.
Each one hinting at a deep-rooted danger John is inching closer to unearthing.
Unmoved by threats, John focuses his declaration into the unexplained utility of various objects accompanying the Spectra device — each one a code-writing instrument for this vast digital puzzle.
With each artifact decrypted, the intricate web of mystery thickens.

As Act Three takes the center stage, John's workstation brims with cryptographs, and suspicious digital communication trails, the grand reveal of an expansive cybercriminal network doing business within the dark web.
The web of criminal operations starts getting clearer as John begins to understand the Spectra's unexplored functionality better, each function chaining to another within the network's nexus.
His rapid forays into the package's eccentric content uncovers the encrypted operation code, a prediction of a brewing catastrophe.
Consumed by the urgency of the night, he shares the newfound insight with his former colleagues in law enforcement.
As frantic dialogue exchanges over encrypted call, John suggests an unorthodox yet potentially game-changing strategy.
In the heart-pounding climax, the veteran detective fiddles with the Spectra, crafting misleading messages that throw the lurking criminals into utter chaos.
Oblivious felons stumble upon John's manipulative trap, attempting a futile counteract as law enforcement draws near, apprehending the criminal network.
Capturing every pulse-pounding moment of the finale on his web camera, John channels the riveting climax to his audience, their vicarious participation manifesting in the justice served.
With the operation successful and the criminals apprehended, John announces the hidden secret of the Spectra device.
His blog post marks the end of this exciting chapter.

The world remains locked in stunned silence as John meticulously details his latest discovery — the vast criminal setup, their intended plans, the sophisticated conspiracies, and the victorious sting operation led by law enforcement, all based on his crucial inputs.
As the scenario unfolds, John Doe reemerges as an everyday hero, a grittier equivalent of a modern detective warrior.
His heroic tale vividly narrated, stirs an unprecedented surge in his blog's popularity.
As the situation cools down, the camera frame extends, capturing his figure reclining in his creaky old chair.
The deactivated Spectra device lies dormant, reflecting the eerie glow of the skyline on its metal body.
As the narrative edges to the conclusion, a montage pays tribute to John — the relentless digital detective.
His life pulses with modern-day mysteries and cryptic pursuits.
Hinting at a series of unexplored sagas waiting to unfold in the depths of the enormous and invisible void that is the internet.

75090394.title: Curse of Aurore
synopsis: A YouTube video by Casey Nolan, from the channel Mindseed TV,  plays and shows him opening a mystery box he received from the Dark Web.
He digs through an odd collection of macabre artifacts that seem to be from a crime scene and discovers a USB thumb drive around the neck of a baby doll.
He decides to view its contents live on his channel and warns his viewers that the footage may be disturbing.
The footage shows two men, Aaron and Kevin, arriving at the Québec airport.
They’re greeted by their filmmaking partner Lena, who reveals her leg in a brace after an accident, but insists she can still work on their next film project.
On the long drive to Lena's family cottage, they discuss their previous film project and hope it sells soon.
Lena tells the story of Aurore Gagnon, a local girl who was abused and murdered by her parents in the 1920s.
The trio stops at a roadside restaurant and Lena introduces them to poutine.
They discuss their lives and Lena’s recent breakup, and fail to notice the odd looks from locals around them.
At the cottage, unbeknownst to the group, an apparition appears behind them while Lena gives a tour.
Over dinner, they become fascinated by Aurore’s tragedy and decide that it could be a good story to research further.
That night, while the group is hanging out in the living room, the upstairs hatch door slams mysteriously shut.
Later, Lena sees people entering a neighbor’s house, chanting as they join some sort of ritual gathering.
The filmmakers explore Aurore’s hometown of Fortierville, including the local church and graveyard.
The priest refuses to let them film at the church.
At Aurore’s gravesite, they randomly run into Chantal, an old friend of Lena’s, who explains that her uncle actually lives in Aurore’s childhood home and offers to arrange a tour.
As they spend more time in the remote town, the filmmakers have strange experiences that blur the line between reality and the supernatural.
One night while driving, Lena insists she sees Aurore’s ghost in the road, causing them to crash.
With the car stuck in a snowy ditch, they walk to a farmhouse and meet the eccentric local couple Benoit and Blanche.
Blanche is a spiritualist, and while doing a tarot card reading for Lena, ominously pulls three death cards - an unlikely, if impossible occurrence.
Benoit helps tow their car back onto the road.
On the drive back, Kevin reveals he stole Blanche’s occult book, ‘Languages of the Dead’, enraging the others.
Arguments over creative differences and romantic tension rise.
Despite the creepy events and conflicts, the three commit to sticking it out to finish researching their film.
The next day, Chantal visits their cottage and offers to take them to tour Aurore's childhood home.
Lena eagerly accepts, seeing it as a major breakthrough in their research.
That night, the trio decides to check out a supposedly haunted streetlight flicker.
Lena and Kevin smoke a joint and lay on the frozen street waiting for the flicker.
Kevin passes out just as a car comes screaming towards them.
He does not wake up, so Lena and Aaron have to drag him to safety.

At Aurore’s house, Chantal’s uncle Mr. Gagnon (who only speaks French), gives them a tour and explains that they keep Aurore’s room locked with a rosary and crucifix around the doorknob to contain evil forces.
As the tour is ending, Kevin breaks the crucifix off her door, infuriating Mr. Gagnon who throws them out.
That night, while reviewing footage, Lena and Kevin spot paranormal activity and decide to just document their lives in the moment, rather than write a script.
They hold a seance in the basement using the stolen book and crucifix.
Aaron reluctantly films but nothing happens until smoke from burnt pizza triggers the smoke alarm.
Suddenly, the house shakes violently.
Cabinets fling open and a wine glass flies across the room.
Blanche arrives to survey the damage but flees in fear when Kevin reveals new scratches and collapses writhing in pain.
Bloody scratches rise from his stomach right before their eyes.
They find chanting townspeople outside and Kevin goes missing.
Following Kevin’s screams, they arrive at a large barn where they discover a ritualistic ceremony.
They see Aurore’s uncle bound on a makeshift altar and Kevin's decapitated body hanging in a barn.
Surrounded by chanting villagers, Lena and Aaron beg for their lives before being knocked out as the video ends.

Casey Nolan ends his YouTube video by stating that he’s turning the evidence over to the authorities and encourages his viewers to reach out if they have any further information on the tragedy they all just witnessed.

29005999.title: Inquiring Inspiration: The Brontë Sisters' Story (2022 film)
synopsis: In the melancholic afternoon of October 1854, an unyielding silence blanketed the vicarage of the Brontë family in Haworth, West Yorkshire.
In their quaint study, often warmed by the crackling fireplace, sat the gifted sisters, Emily and Anne Brontë.
Their conversations wove in and about the dilemmas of existence, intricacies of life, and the spectrum of their philosophical sensibilities towards the prevalent Victorian literature.
Emily, intrigued by the psychological nuances that filled Anne's latest novella, revealed her longing to discern the myriad inspirations that her sister ingeniously danced into her prose.
This earnest curiosity smoothly morphed into a deep exploration of their shared past.
The girls were transported back to their blissful afternoons in the Haworth parsonage, where they were often found immersed in riveting storytelling games.
Reverend Patrick Brontë, their scholarly father, played a pivotal role in their fascination with the alphabet world.
They recollected the treasured evenings when their father, a clergyman with tantalizing oratory skills, narrated sagas from the Holy Bible with an enthralling eloquence.
His captivating renditions of classics authored by literary maestros like Donne and Milton sparked uncontainable intellectual curiosity in both the budding authors.
Their initial attempts at literary success were thwarted by stark rejection from renowned publication houses like Harper and Brothers.
The heart-wrenching rejection left their hopeful spirits broken and dreams at the brink of shattering.
Still, their creative flame refused to be extinguished.
Their intolerable Victorian disposition spurred them on, instigating a resilient defiance against skewed societal norms.
Emily, fascinated by the raw realism of Anne's novel "Agnes Grey," appealed to her elder sister to delve into the experiences that seeded the creation of her masterful work.
Anne, her gaze shadowed by melancholia, began to share her bittersweet encounters as a modestly compensated governess at Thornton Hall.
The gaping class disparity in the Victorian society, their implicit subjugation, and relentless struggles painted a stark picture in Anne's works.
Emily's health began spiraling down the treacherous path of tuberculosis.
Determined to immortalize their struggles through the powerful medium of story-telling, Emily decided to let her artistic imagination breathe life into her fiction.
Resolute, Emily embarked on writing her tragic novel 'Wuthering Heights,' basing it on the bittersweet trials of their lives.
Balancing her own literary quest, Anne took on the mantle of Emily's caretaker.
The narrative unfolds an ironic twist as their novels receive immense recognition under their masculine pseudonyms — Emily as Ellis Bell and Anne as Acton Bell.
Emily Brontë, after a grueling battle with her debilitating health, drew her last breath amidst her most cherished possession - her manuscripts.
Anne, the surviving sister, was left stranded in her grief to mourn the loss of Emily - her intimate companion, her inspiration, and her illustrious sister.
Amidst the chaos of grief and triumph, Anne stood tall, a beacon of resilience, taking charge of carrying forward their shared literary legacy.
Anne found the courage to step into the room where Emily breathed her last.
The once lively bedroom on the eastern end of their house now stood as a stark reminder of an eroding life.
Anne ran her fingers over Emily's unfinished manuscripts, their raw emotions still palpable in the ink stains on the timeworn parchment.

Anne discerned that Emily's unparalleled genius lay in her ability to sketch emotions from their shared experiences into her fiction, her deep empathy with Anne's personal struggles resonated with her readership.
Anne acknowledged that her personal experiences as a governess inspired Emily's magnum opus, the iconic 'Wuthering Heights.'
Anne found soothing solace in knowing her personal turmoil played a crucial role in shaping Emily's groundbreaking literary legacy.
Anne glanced out of the window at the sprawling, windswept moors, visualizing Emily, pen in hand, drafting the turbulent dynamics of Catherine and Heathcliff amidst the white heather.
Wiping away her tears, Anne steeled herself.
She made a resolute decision to honor Emily's life, celebrate their extraordinary story, and channel her grief into penning her own literary masterpiece.
As the narrative ends, the dusk melts into a foggy evening.
A desolate Anne, the last surviving Brontë, finds solace in the lingering memories of their once lively childhood abode.
The weight of her quintessential role in Emily's literary journey weighs heavy on her heart, mirroring the melancholy of the setting sun.

64025233.title: Emily (2022 film)
synopsis: As Emily Brontë is ill and near death, her older sister Charlotte asks her what inspired her to write her novel Wuthering Heights.
Sometime in the past Charlotte, nearly graduated from school, returns home for a visit.
Emily tries to talk to her about the fictional worlds she has been creating while Charlotte was at school, but Charlotte tries to dissuade her from these juvenile activities.
At the same time William Weightman, a new curate, arrives.
While her sisters and several other young women seem enamoured of the young man, Emily is dismissive of him.

While visiting the Brontë home, Weightman partakes in a game the Brontës have invented where they take turns donning a mask and impersonating a character, with the other members guessing who the character is.
When it is Emily's turn, she claims to be possessed by the ghost of their deceased mother; a strong wind bursts open the windows.
Charlotte, Anne and Branwell become distressed, while Weightman is disturbed by the scene.
The mask is buried in the ground.
Emily goes with Charlotte to her school to learn to be a teacher, while her brother Branwell goes to study at the Royal Academy of Arts.
Both Emily and Branwell return shortly after as failures, Branwell proclaiming he is now more interested in writing and Emily at a loss for what to do.
Emily's father engages Weightman to teach Emily French, which he does, while arguing religious philosophy with her.

Branwell encourages Emily to drink and play, and Emily uses some opium she finds in a desk, and has "Freedom in thought" tattooed on her arm like Branwell has; their favourite pastime involves staring in the window of a local family and scaring them at night.
They are eventually caught, but when Emily denies her involvement, Branwell is sent to work for the family as a tutor as punishment.
Branwell is caught kissing the mistress of the house and is sent elsewhere in disgrace.
Emily and Weightman grow increasingly close and begin a romantic and sexual entanglement.
When Charlotte returns and begins to suspect an affinity between the two, Weightman abruptly ends their relationship.
Emily is devastated and takes out her anger on Branwell, telling him that his attempts at fiction are clichéd and trite.
To move on with her life, Emily decides to leave with Charlotte for Brussels.
She tells Weightman she no longer intends to write.
Weightman writes Emily a letter urging her to change her mind, which he gives to Branwell, who reads its contents and does not pass on the message.
In Brussels, Emily has a vision of Weightman and shortly after receives news that he died of cholera.
The sisters return to tend an ailing Branwell.
His final act before dying is to give Emily Weightman's letter in which he urges her to continue to write.
After Branwell's death Emily writes Wuthering Heights.
Now on her death bed, Emily confesses to Charlotte that she was in love with Weightman, and asks Charlotte to burn the love letters between the two after she dies.
Charlotte does so and begins to write her own works.

51164367.title: Echoes of the Past
synopsis: Maria together with her husband Alex, and their 10-year-old daughter Emma, shuffle urgently amongst the ruins of their once comfortable home, fleeing from the mandatory evacuation in their hometown of Kiev, Ukraine due to war.
The familiar city lights of Kiev grow distant as they depart with fear and uncertainty settling within Maria.
A rusty blue van bearing signs of wear and tear from the long journey delivers them to a future they can't predict.
They step onto American soil crossing the border from Mexico, marking the end of a chapter inked in fear and the onset of a new uncertain future.
They find a safe habitat in a tiny two-bedroom apartment nestled in downtown Los Angeles, California.
As Maria unpacks the boxes brimming with memories, she carefully pins an old, yellowed map of Ukraine on Emma's bedroom wall as a reminder of their cultural heritage they have left behind.
Each silent night envelopes Maria in agonizing echoes of war, her sleep disrupted by vivid nightmares of the evacuation chaos.

Over the course of several months, the family eases into the rhythm of American life - Maria begins working as a cashier at a grocery store, and Alex commandeers a small corner of their living room for his painting.
At school, Emma shows remarkable resilience, navigating her way through a new language and culture.
One sleepless night, in the early hours, Alex finds Maria on their small apartment balcony, prompting him to advocate for Maria to consider therapy for her haunting nightmares.
Session by session, Maria begins to share her stories in therapy, reliving her locked memories, her horror, and fear resurfacing.
Maria bravely makes a decision, encouraged by her psychologist, she needs to face her nightmares by visiting the roots of her torment.
Battling anxiety coupled with anticipation, the family boards a flight back to Kiev, Ukraine.
It takes all of Maria's courage to enter their old home that now lies battered in the remnants of war.
Maria visits the local graveyard, paying tribute to each friend and family member who didn't survive.
In the midst of her grief, Maria faces her deepest regrets and fears, her survivor's guilt, and finally forgives herself, marking the first crucial steps towards her impending mental healing.
Upon her return to their Los Angeles apartment, Maria wakes, enveloped in the comfort of a peaceful night's sleep - her very first since their traumatic exodus.
Maria begins to actively participate in Emma's school activities and pays frequent visits to Alex's exhibitions.
Maria establishes a support group aiding local immigrants from Ukraine who grapple with similar traumatic pasts.
An evening sees the family in the warmth of their kitchen preparing a traditional Ukrainian dish, laughter rings through their apartment.
Their collective laughter, the symbol of their resilient journey from a war-torn past to a peaceful present echoes through their halls.
Maria who once woke up in the middle of the night, her dreams a battlefield of terror, now greets each dawn with a renewed sense of peace and hope.
Emma flourishes under her parent's newfound happiness.
Alex's art, once a means of distraction, begins to radiate light, the sign of their slowly revitalizing lives.
Maria's support group thrives, creating a non-evasive space for fellow Ukrainian immigrants to safely unpack their past.
Maria, once tormented by horrific images and vivid nightmares, becomes a beacon of hope for other Ukrainian immigrants dealing with trauma.
Maria's journey inspires not just her family, but also the members of the support group to face their unique traumas and seek professional help.
Emma grows into a compassionate and loving young adult, reflecting her mother's unwavering strength and determination.
The support group grows exponentially, its reach transcending cultural boundaries, inviting members who have endured their own unique traumas.
The family, once architects of life amidst war, now gather around the dinner table sharing stories of their day with joy and laughter.
Maria sheds the tormented shadows that had once clung to her past life, stepping into an undiscovered future, separated at last from her mental shackles.
Reminiscing on her journey, Maria learns that her torment was not a personal sentence, but a testament to the undying strength of the human spirit.
Maria, Alex, and Emma stand together in their small kitchen, sharing a moment of joy while preparing borscht, a traditional Ukrainian soup, an emblem of unity.
Maria finds herself free from her torment, ready to embrace the beauty of life, her arms wide open.

60578577.title: The Secrets We Keep
synopsis: In post-World War II America, Maja Reid is a Romanian refugee who has built a new life with her American husband, Lewis, and their young son, Patrick, but she is still haunted by her dark memories of the war, still having nightmares.
While walking on the street, she recognizes a man who she believes is a former German soldier she encountered 15 years before.
She tails him to the house where she sees that he has a wife and two children.
The next day, on the pretext that her car broke down, Maja knocks the man out and puts him in the trunk.
Returning to the house, Maja tells Lewis her past memories, saying that she and some other women escaped to Romania where the SS soldiers found them and murdered several of them.
She then admits that she has put the man, who she thinks is a Nazi war criminal, in the trunk of their car, further disturbing Lewis.
The two of them then bring the man to the basement and tie him up in a chair.

There, Maja interrogates the man who insists that his name is Thomas Steinmann and that he is Swiss but Maja disputes him, telling him that his name is “Karl” and recounting the background of his war crimes.
Thomas attempts to escape and yells for help at the front door but Lewis incapacitates him.
When one of the neighbors named Jim is awakened by Thomas' yell, Maja convinces him that it came from the street.
The next day the neighbor accompanied by police and Thomas' wife, Rachel, are going house to house, searching for Rachel's husband and the source of the screaming the night before.
At the clinic where Lewis is working, he looks up a document about Thomas, stating that he is indeed a native from Switzerland.
At the house, Thomas continues to deny Maja's allegations of Thomas' crimes until she forces him to say "Zigeunerfotze" (German word for "Gypsy Cunt").
Throughout the film, a series of flashbacks reveal the German soldiers killing and raping the women.
She reveals that her sister Miriah was among the victims.
When Thomas is confronted by Lewis, he tells him that he was in Zürich for the entire duration of the war and also tells him the name of his acquaintances to prove his whereabouts during the war.

Thomas added that he became a naturalized citizen of the United States after he married Rachel, and promises that he will not go to the police because he forged travel visa document in order to stay in the U.S. Maja pays a visit to Rachel at her home, where she discovers the wedding ring she wears has a Star of David engraved on the inside.

Believing that Thomas stole the ring from a Jewish victim, Maja goes back to her home to force Thomas to tell her his last name but then Thomas attempts to shoot her with a gun he'd hidden earlier but misses.
He continues to insist his name is Thomas but then she sees his wedding band.
She cuts off his finger and takes his wedding band with the same Star of David inside that is similar to Rachel's wedding band.
Meanwhile Lewis plans to release Thomas, believing that he won't go to the police, Maja continues to demand that Thomas confess to his war crimes.
Maja visits Rachel again at her home where Rachel tells her that Thomas does not like to discuss his past war experiences or his family.
Maja and Lewis then bring Thomas to the outskirts of town where they have dug a pit and make Thomas kneel in front of the pit.
Maja threatens to shoot him if he doesn't tell her the truth.
Maja recalls the memories of witnessing soldiers raping and killing women during the war and leaving her sister behind.
Thomas, feeling great remorse, eventually confesses his crimes, telling Maja he and the other soldiers were on amphetamines and had been up for five nights.
They acted quickly and in a frenzy as the Russians were closing in.
He is horrified, not believing he could do what he had done; he was present during the murders and tells Maja she never ran away, as she had always believed.
When he says “I did it”, Lewis executes him out of rage.
Maja and Lewis bury Thomas in the pit.
They go home, clean their basement and bury their secrets.
Later they celebrate the Fourth of July together with Rachel and their friends.

340802.title: Deceptive Guardians
synopsis: The movie undrapes with an enchanting introduction to Lily, a radiant 10-year-old girl, engrossed in her innocent worldly wonders, blissfully unaware of her guardians— life mired with illicit activities.
This captivating story adeptly depicts the contrasting life of her guardians, who mask their crime through an impoverished lifestyle.
They skillfully engage in petty offences such as pickpocketing unsuspecting tourists at Times Square and running short con schemes on trusting locals in their crumbled New York City neighborhood.

The narrative takes a bone-chilling turn after an ominous night when Lily's guardians, blinded by their greed, overstep their boundaries and involuntarily enlist Lily in a grandiose and audacious heist at a plush jewelry store situated in the heart of New York.
This daunting event ruthlessly taints Lily's pure innocence, shedding the final vestiges of her carefree childhood, and forcefully propels her into the shadowy and grim underworld of crimes.

As the harrowing heist unravels amidst the cacophony, a vigilant passerby, NYPD Detective Alex, with seasoned instincts, notices Lily's bewildered look and her anomalous presence at the eerie crime scene, invoking his professional curiosity.
Alex, with a reputation for his relentless pursuit of justice, finds himself drawn deeper into Lily's obscure predicament.
What begins as a routine investigation, soon evolves into a deeply personal mission fuelled by his growing concern for Lily.

Recognizing a series of flags that lead him to Lily - her inconsistent behavior, a conspicuous increase in police reports from her dwellings in lower Manhattan, Alex grows increasingly convinced about potential child exploitation.
To unearth the truth, he enhances his surveillance on Lily's rundown apartment block, rousing suspicion and inadvertently causing turbulence within the household unnoticed for years.
Sensing the unusual presence of police and heightened activities around her habitat, Lily grows apprehensive, causing subtle friction and heightening tension between her and her guardians.
Meanwhile, the movie's second act delves deeper into the enigma that is Lily's life, shedding light on the darker corners of her existence through a series of enlightening flashbacks.
These thoughtful retrospections paint a vivid picture of her guardians— twisted world, where crime is the only thing admissible and impress upon her a warped sense of morality.
As Lily becomes more aware of her guardians' sinister intentions, their dysfunctional relationship reaches the precipice, sparking a climate of essential rebellion and resistance.

Engrossed in Lily's case and blinded by his concern for her, Alex manages to verify a few of his lurking doubts but is thwarted by a frustrating dearth of corporeal evidence against her guardians to proceed legally.
Amid the brewing storm, Lily, in a dramatic confrontation with her guardians, inadvertently stumbles upon their hidden vault crammed with stolen jewels.
This electrifying discovery marks the ignition of her uprising.

The shocking sight of priceless jewels and trinkets unlawfully hidden away offers Lily a stark demonstration of her guardians' rampant illegal activities, inspiring a wave of rebellion and her resolve to assist Alex.
To aid Alex in his pursuit of justice, Lily embarks on a high-stakes mission of collecting proof in secret, risking every safety measure to unmask the monsters that her guardians really are.

Despite her limited knowledge of the legal system, Lily's discreet attempts of bridging communication with Alex bears fruit and she slowly begins to convey her intentions, elucidating to Alex her desire to help.
The detective, picking up on Lily's distress signals and hidden motives, cautiously steps up his exchanges with Lily, establishing discrete meetings at secure locations and predetermined schedules.
Together, they devise intricate strategies to accumulate undeniable evidence against her guardians, navigating the waters of suspicion with utmost caution.
However, Lily's redesigned behavior causes her guardians to grow wary about her clandestine activities.
As Lily edges closer to revealing the truth, the anticipation of an imminent backlash from her guardians exponentially increases, charging the narrative with electric tension.
A turning point arrives when Lily, now emboldened by her enduring spirit, confronts her guardians about their cimmerian deeds, instigating a cataclysmic discharge of pent up emotions.

The fierce confrontation spirals into an uncontrolled hurricane, with the guardians retaliating in blind fury against Lily's rebellion, thus shedding their deceptive facades and revealing their morally bankrupt souls.
Amid the escalating chaos, Alex, never far from her vicinity, storms in with a well-prepared NYPD team during the crucial moment.
An adrenaline-pumping standoff ensues as Alex and his devoted squad manage to corner the guardians, effectively liberating Lily from the suffocating clutches of their oppressive presence.

In the aftermath of the climax, viewers get to witness Lily's painstaking metamorphosis as she gradually adapts to a new and honest life with her loving foster family in suburban Chicago, attending therapeutic sessions to recover from her harrowing past.
Lily begins her ascent towards a normal life, first with faltering steps but gradually with a growing confidence.
She embraces the new bond and warmth with her foster family, casting the dreadful shadows of her tainted past afar.
Simultaneously, Alex, having formed a genuinely deep bond with Lily during the nerve-wracking investigation and rescue operation, continues to be a steady presence in Lily's evolving life.

Transitioning into a paternal figure, Alex provides Lily with much-needed solace, stability and reassurance in her scattered world, his consistent visits becoming a comfort for both Lily and her new family.

While the optimistic movie marches towards closure, it focuses on Lily's exhilarating departure for her first day at a quintessential middle school - an emblematic moment symbolizing her fresh beginning and promising her a chance at a real childhood, a luxury she was previously denied.
By the end, the bond between Alex and Lily has grown strong.
This close relationship echoes as a testament for their brave fight against her guardian's corruption.
Lily's life comes a full circle - from the grimy bylanes of crime-infested neighborhoods to a loving family in verdant suburbia - neatly wrapping up her transformative journey.

Lily's final appearance in the movie, trading her grim past for a bright morning in Chicago, as her school bus gradually dissipates into the distance, encapsulates her excitement, her resurrected innocence, and her dreams of a promising future, painting an optimistically endearing picture.

In the aftermath of her ordeal, Lily takes the reins of her own life - a formerly helpless girl now stands as a resilient symbol of courage and strength, not in spite of her past, but because of the bravery and endurance it rallied within her.
The movie ties up all loose ends, providing a satisfying closure, marking the end of Lily's heart-wrenching journey.
The conclusion is a beginning in itself, opening a new chapter of healing and recovery in Lily's life.

61076534.title: Kajillionaire
synopsis: An emotionally stunted 26-year-old woman, Old Dolio Dyne, is in a manipulative relationship with her con artist parents, who treat her as an accomplice to their petty thefts and scams rather than as a daughter.
The family owes $1,500 of back rent on their apartment in Los Angeles, which is actually a leaking office space attached to a soap factory.
Old Dolio concocts a scam in which they will fly to New York City using tickets they won in a contest.
Her parents will take her luggage at the baggage claim and Old Dolio will claim the airline has lost it.
Old Dolio will then collect on the travel insurance she purchased, which will cover their rent.
After an uneventful trip, Old Dolio and her parents return home.

She is surprised to find them chatting with Melanie, a friendly young woman in the seat next to them, and even more surprised when they reveal their scam to Melanie and have her pretend to be their daughter as they pick up the luggage.
Old Dolio reports her "lost luggage", but learns it could take six weeks for the check to come, so the family looks for alternative methods to obtain the money.
Melanie proves surprisingly amenable to their way of life and reveals she lied about being a physician's assistant and is actually a clerk at an eyeglass store.
She introduces the family to one of her elderly clients, from whom they steal a blank check and cash it for $650.
A second client, who is dying, asks the family to pretend to be his family as he passes away.
Old Dolio is shaken by the experience and hurt when her parents rush to comfort Melanie while ignoring her.
Arriving home, Old Dolio discovers the insurance check in the mail.
Old Dolio's parents try to initiate a threesome with Melanie, but she reacts badly.
They are interrupted by Old Dolio, who is heartbroken to hear her mother call Melanie "hon" and offers her mother the entire travel insurance money to do the same to her.
Old Dolio's mother refuses, but Melanie accepts Old Dolio's offer and takes her to her apartment.
Rather than simply call Old Dolio "hon", Melanie offers a "full-service" treatment fulfilling emotional needs that Old Dolio's parents failed to meet.
Old Dolio's parents turn up at Melanie's apartment, telling Old Dolio they love and miss her and giving her 17 birthday presents, promising the 18th one (though she is 26) at dinner the next night.
Old Dolio and Melanie attend the dinner even though they suspect it is another scam.
At the restaurant, Old Dolio's parents give her a necklace and swear they will change.
They return to Melanie's apartment and tuck Old Dolio into bed.

Melanie, who has hidden the insurance money in her fuse box, tells Old Dolio that if her parents have stolen the money they are monsters and do not love her, while Old Dolio says if the money is still there, it is proof her parents have changed.
She also comes up with a third possibility: that her parents will have left behind $525, her share of the cash, signifying that they love her but will never ever be able to offer her anything more.
To Melanie and Old Dolio's surprise, the cash is all there.
The next morning, Melanie and Old Dolio awaken to find that Melanie has been robbed; all removable objects and furnishings, including the cash in the fuse box, are gone.
The only things left are Old Dolio's 17 presents.
Realizing they are refundable, Old Dolio and Melanie take them to be returned.
The total refund is $485.05, until Melanie realizes they forgot to return Old Dolio's necklace, bringing the total to $525, Old Dolio's share of the insurance money.
Old Dolio and Melanie kiss in the store.

85318078.title: Farewell Footage (2020 tragedy film)
synopsis: The narrative opens with Sam, a reserved teenager living in an inconspicuous corner of sunny California.
He spends his days documenting the ordinary, yet cherished, moments of his life with his Canon camcorder which looks worn out from usage.
His favorite subjects include his close-knit family and their English cocker spaniel affectionately named Daisy.
This use of his camcorder becomes a cathartic hobby for Sam, providing a comforting lens through which he could frame his everyday reality and his seemingly mundane, but cherished existence.
One day, Sam takes the camcorder to his own personal sanctuary — his room.
Painted a calming shade of blue with tiny glow-in-the-dark stars dotted across, he records a painfully raw video confession titled "Farewell Footage", revealing a frightful, self-decided fate.
With trembling hands and a heavy heart, he uploads this disturbing confession to a secret playlist on his tiny YouTube channel, unseen by the outside world.
He lays down on his bed, surrendering himself to an uneasy sleep.
The following day, Sam's 13-year-old sister Miranda, with her abundant curls and inquisitive nature, inadvertently discovers the heartbreaking Farewell Footage".
She watches her brother's video, her heart pounding in fear and worry.
Trembling with fear and thick streams of salted tears falling down her face, Miranda turns to her best friend, Nicole.
She is known within their community as an outspoken advocate on various social issues.
Moved by the alarming revelation, both girls muster their courage and map out an urgent, yet thoughtful plan to intervene, hoping to dissuade Sam from his soul-crushing decision.
The girls find hope in Mrs. Parker, the official school psychologist, praying that her formal expertise could save the day.
However, despite their pleas soaked with tears, Mrs. Parker dismisses their worries as teenage angst and overreaction.
This casual dismissal of their genuine concerns only emboldens the girls, sparking within them the determination to save Sam themselves.
The narrative then pivots back to Sam's world, now perceived as haunted by relentless bouts of depression, merciless cyberbullying, family discord, and personal alienation.
Undeterred by these mounting challenges, Miranda starts bonding over Sam's hobby: videography.
She asks him about his favorite shots, editing techniques, breathing fresh life into his quiet, isolated world.
Hoping to reignite a spark in Sam, she encourages him to film the lively world flourishing in their own backyard, whether it be blooming flowers or the playful antics of Daisy, their family pet.
Faced with the dire realization that her brother's struggles are deeper than she initially thought, Miranda turns to their parents for help.
But the pending divorce and their constant fights make them oblivious to her desperate call for action.
Faced with the daunting reality of her parents' indifference, a fierce determination blossomed within Miranda.
She becomes Sam's protector, a beacon of hope in his darkest hours.
Miranda and Nicole set things in motion covertly, documenting Sam's daily struggle, aiming to shed light on his isolated pain.

They capture his bullies in-action using their smartphones, they secretly gather his self-recorded films from his hidden YouTube channel, and bravely decide to reach out to the local police department with the evidence.
In response to the glaring issue of bullying, the two girls stage an extensive anti-bullying campaign within the corridors of Jefferson High.
Through impassioned speeches delivered in school assemblies and bright, eye-catching posters lining school corridors, the girls stand up against the hostile attitude that has pushed Sam to despair.
One day, Miranda discovers a chilling note hidden inside Sam's locked drawer hinting at an imminent self-harming action which threw the girls into even more urgency.
Fueled by this alarming discovery, Miranda and Nicole confront Sam's main bully, Zach, and his gang during lunchtime.
They reveal Sam's life-threatening plan, inadvertently exposing Sam's private battle to the entire school.
The shocking revelation forces the students, including Sam's bullies, to introspect their behavior and actions, triggering guilt and remorse.
The school environment begins to transform, as classmates rally in support of Sam, filling the graffitied hallways with newfound unity and empathy.
His former tormentors stunned by the realization of their actions, offer apologies, and extend an olive branch of friendship.
Inspired by these unexpected gestures, Sam begins attending therapy sessions at the local wellness center.
These small steps marked the beginning of Sam's journey back from the precipice.
The impact of this change was manifested in the colorful encouragement notes found on his desk daily and warm smiles exchanged with his peers.
His previously divided parents begin mending their relationship around family dinners, offering an atmosphere of love and understanding for their troubled son.
Jefferson High, from being a playground of terror, gradually transforms into an emblem of hope and fraternity."

63921591.title: Alone (2020 horror film)
synopsis: A young man is recording a video log on his laptop saying goodbye right before he is about to hang himself in his apartment.
The young man is Aidan (Tyler Posey).
Forty-two days before his suicide attempt, he was living a peaceful life awaking from a tryst with a random girl.
During that morning, a violent outbreak happens outside his apartment; everyone is being attacked by infected people called Screamers.
Aidan encounters his first Screamer via his neighbor Brandon, who entered Aidan's apartment after being attacked by his roommate.

Aidan threatens Brandon with a kitchen knife to leave after noticing a wound in the back of his neck, later Brandon begins to turn, and Aidan gets him out of his apartment in time before the change is complete.
On the news, Aidan learns the virus is transferred by bite and scratching.
The symptoms of being infected include bleeding eyes, rage, cannibalism, inhuman screaming, and repeating the last words said before turning.
The news reports that the Screamers are aware of what they're doing but can not stop themselves; their repeated use of their last words are an attempt to plead for someone to stop them.
Aidan tries contacting his family but the signal is not working on his phone.
He can receive the text messages his Dad sent him, informing Aidan that his sister got away but is out of contact.
He and Aidan's mom are trying to reach Aidan but are having trouble with the outbreak.
The last message is for Aidan to 'Stay Alive' and not leave his home till they arrive.
Aidan follows his Dad's orders and isolates himself in the apartment.
Over time he tallies the days that pass on his bathroom mirror, keeps video logs on his laptop, and tries to keep himself entertained.
Eventually, he begins to run out of food, the water in his building is cut off, and he begins to hallucinate about his parents.
He receives his first real threat when a Screamer breaks into his home using the air ducts connecting the rooms.
He fights the Screamer off with a baseball bat and dumps the body off his balcony while sealing the vent the Screamer crashed through.
He finally receives a voicemail from his mother.
His emotional state takes a  turn for the worst when he listens and learns that his parents died while hiding from Screamers.
Aidan suffers an emotional breakdown and falls into despair.
Having no hope left, he attempts suicide, calling back to the opening of the story when he recorded his last video log.
The moment he readies to hang himself he sees a woman on a balcony across from his, a normal human woman.
He gives up his suicide attempt and now has found renewed hope.
He contacts her the next morning using premade cue cards and learns her name is Eva.
The two strike up a friendship, with Aidan offering his reserved bottled water for her.
He later gets Brandon's keys and grabs the remaining food and rock climbing gear to help Eva, even finding radios for them to communicate.
Aidan and Eva bond more and decide for Eva to escape to Aidan's room.
He first travels the air ducts to find more supplies for them to wait it out.
Aidan hits jackpot when he enters a room stocked with food, but Eva warns him to leave as the room is barricaded with no one inside signaling it may be a trap.
Aidan is surprised by Edward (Donald Sutherland), an older survivor who entered the room before Aidan after the original tenant killed himself.
Edward and Aidan initially have a conversation about the situation and different philosophies about life after death, then Edward hits Aidan with his bat while his guard is down.
Edward ties Aidan up in the bedroom to be a sacrifice for his wife, who has turned.
Aidan is saved when Eva calls the radio, providing a distraction that allows Aidan to escape and feed Edward to his wife.
He grabs his belongings and runs to his room, drops from his balcony to the ground using a makeshift rope of bed sheets, fights off Screamers, and makes it to Eva.
They both fight to return to Aidan's apartment, with Eva entering the room first while Aidan fights off a Screamer.
He returns covered in blood but believes he's been infected when a mark on his shirt is revealed.
He goes to jump to his death so he won't turn and kill Eva who pleads for him not to leave her.
After removing his shirt they are both overjoyed to see there is no bite and Aidan won't turn.
They run to Aidan's door to hold the refrigerator back against it, stopping the Screamers from entering.
They promise to survive together till the end.

23476689.title: Beacon Tower: The Maiden's Lighthouse
synopsis: Our narrative unfolds at the isolated Beacon Tower, a lighthouse sitting atop a cliff, boldly confronting the ferocious waves of the sea.
In this tranquil setting resides a spirited young maiden, Lily, who spends her days with her unyielding, elderly protector, Benjamin.

The two have formed an engaging existence, splitting their duties to keep the lighthouse running; Benjamin stolidly handles the responsibilities of the light, while Lily ensures that their awe-inspiring abode stays clean and orderly.
Their scenic world changes dramatically with the abrupt arrival of a message in a bottle, washed ashore by the sheer strength of the sea.
The rolled parchment nestled within reveals the dire search initiated by the King for his purportedly lost daughter.
This surprising news sparks a flame of curiosity in Lily, who starts questioning the novelty of her own shrouded past.
Eventually, the growing suspicions become too insistent, prompting Lily to confront Benjamin with the unsettling message.
Unable to hold back the truth any longer, Benjamin capitulates under the heaviness of Lily's questioning, revealing an astounding truth.
Lily was none other than the missing princess the King was searching for, secreted away under her mother's dying request to ensure her safety.
As Lily grapples with this unexpected revelation, Benjamin advises her to suppress her royal lineage for her safety.
However, the thrill and curiosity of her newfound identity overpower the soundness of her surrogate father's advice.
Determined to embrace her past, Lily bravely sends a response to the King, validating her identity through her sole possession, a royal locket she had unknowingly worn since her early childhood.
Meanwhile, Benjamin stumbles upon a dark conspiracy involving the assassination of the King and comprehends the world of danger that Lily might innocently precipitate herself into.
Spotting the obvious threat, he urgently sets off on a stealthy mission to protect Lily, who remains unaware of her father's silent pursuit.
The King, filled with excitement and anticipation, promptly sends his best knights to chaperone his long-lost daughter back to the grand castle.
As Lily steps onto the welcoming courtyards of the palace, she is received enthusiastically by the overjoyed King and a court filled with intrigue and curiosity.
Benjamin, shadowing her as close ally, stealthily infiltrates the castle with seamless agility, revealing a treacherous swirl of betrayals within.
Amid the royal celebration and jubilation centered around Lily's homecoming, a grand feast is hosted.
Unbeknownst to the guests, the feast works as a cover for a brewing rebellion.
The scheme births from the wily court advisor, who has orchestrated an ingenious plan of abducting Lily under the facade of friendly exchanges.
The sudden disappearance of Lily, strategically timed to shadow the coup leads to chaos, providing Benjamin the perfect opportunity to intervene.
Overcoming countless obstacles and formidable guards, Benjamin showcases heroic bravery birthed from his paternal affection for Lily.
His feat of successfully rescuing Lily from her captors brings him into glaring light as an unexpected hero.
Now witness to the murderous intent of the ones she believed were her allies, Lily musters courage and rushes to expose the advisor's treachery to the King.
The King, overwhelmed with shock and confusion, swiftly summons his knights to apprehend the duplicitous advisor.
The spiralling events bring a collective sigh of relief to the castle, the dungeons resonating with whispers of the traitor's downfall.
The ensuing tranquility settles heavily on the palace, leading to a heartfelt reunion between the King and Lily.
The warmth of their newfound relationship permeates the stone corridors, brightening the somber atmosphere.
Lily, showcasing maturity beyond her age, decides to accept and amalgamate her origins and her newfound grandeur.
She chooses to embody two distinct identities; the humble ward of Benjamin and the esteemed princess of the kingdom.

The narrative culminates with Lily, entranced by the glow of the distant Beacon Tower, appreciating the harmonization of her dual existence in the context of her dramatic journey towards self-discovery.
Lily's exciting journey concludes with her negotiation of her identities, gradually incorporating her royal lineage into her humble existence.

66812498.title: Slumberland (film)
synopsis: Nemo is a young girl who lives in a lighthouse with her widowed father Peter, a lighthouse keeper.
Peter tells her wild bedtime stories about his adventures with Flip, his partner from the old days when they were outlaws.
One night during a storm, Peter heads out to help a distressed boat.
Nemo is later visited by the family friend Carla who informs her that Peter was lost at sea.
With Nemo devastated by the news, Carla persuades Nemo's estranged uncle Philip to take her in before she becomes a ward of the state.
In contrast to his brother Peter, Philip is a doorknob salesman who leads a lonely, boring, and monotonous life.
Nemo moves to the city with Philip and the two find it difficult to adjust to each other.
When enrolled at a local school, she struggles to fit in as she meets school counselor Ms. Arya and a student named Jamal.
One night, she is awakened when her stuffed pig (Pig) comes to life.
In reality, she is still asleep and in Slumberland, the world between dreams.
Here, she meets Flip, learning that he is real and not simply a character her father made up.
A stubborn and unscrupulous outlaw, Flip is looking for a map that will lead him to magical wish-granting pearls.
Nemo finds the map in the waking world and takes it back to Slumberland by sleeping through classes.
Flip begrudgingly allows her to join him for the pearls so she can wish her father into her dreams.
Nemo learns that Flip has refused to wake up for so long he no longer remembers who he is in the real world.
He uses the map as a guide through various people's dreams to get to the Sea of Nightmares, where the pearls are.
They are attacked by Nemo's nightmare, a cloud of smoke resembling a kraken.
Flip is later imprisoned by Agent Green of the Bureau of Subconscious Activities (BoSA) for intruding on people's dreams.
In the real world, Philip shows Nemo an old videotape of him and Peter playing together as children.
Nemo realizes that Flip is Philip's dream alter ego.
As Flip has not woken up, Philip has lost that part of his personality and become Flip's opposite: docile and unadventurous.
Nemo returns to Slumberland to rescue Flip.
At the Sea of Nightmares, she reveals to him who he really is.
The truth of his boring real life upsets him and Flip decides never to wake up.
Nemo is awakened by Ms. Arya, who calls Philip to bring up her progress in school.
This event leads to an argument between her and Philip.
Nemo runs away from home and sails through a storm back to the lighthouse.
She hits her head and passes out in the boat, sending her back to Slumberland.
In the Sea of Nightmares, she acquires a wishing pearl.
Flip saves her from the kraken nightmare as in the real world, she falls into the water, unconscious.
Philip arranges a rescue boat captained by Carla and heads toward the lighthouse, terrified by the storm.
When the nightmare grabs Flip, Nemo uses her wish to force Flip to wake up.
In the real world, Philip becomes emboldened and dives into the water to rescue Nemo.
In Slumberland, Green commends Nemo on using her wish to save Flip, saying Nemo has finally found something more important than what she has lost.
Green reveals that Pig actually swallowed two pearls, allowing Nemo to wish to see her father again.
Peter appears and the two spend time together before he tells her that life is waiting for her in the real world and she cannot stay.
Nemo says goodbye to her father and wakes up, where Phillip embraces her, now embedded with the personality of Flip.
Nemo begins to improve her life in the waking world, making friends at school and repairing her relationship with her uncle as they make use of one of Peter's boats for sailing.

7129971.title: Biscuit (2020 film)
synopsis: Our story is set in motion in the tranquil small town of Riverdale, tucked serenely amidst the meandering bends of a serene river.
It is here we discover Biscuit, an endearing fifteen-year-old who stands out not just for his towering 6 feet height but also his substantial weight, significantly heavier than those his age.
Biscuit, whose footfall causes tables to shake, is visibly marked by his size.

This, unfortunately, makes him a favored target for schoolyard bullies who use his weight to assert their dominance over him and a subject of continuous neighborhood gossip, particularly around the local community garden.
To distance himself from this distressing reality, Biscity retreats to his personal digital world.
This includes a high-definition computer game buzzing with dynamic graphics and intricate code lines, offering him a reprieve within its pixelated battles and strategic showdowns.
His digital oasis is a lonely one, with just one companion - his doting mother.
She's a compassionate nurse by profession who can't quite come to terms with her son's situation but does everything she can to make it less isolating.
Riverdale witnesses an exciting stir when the Watsons, a family of four, settle down in their town.
They make quite an entrance, pulling up in their striking red Sedan, immediately hinting at the changes their presence would bring.
The family includes Leah Watson, a fiery-haired teenager in an oversized denim jacket.
She presents an air of rebellion against the norms of Riverdale, a different kind of spirit that arrives with the Watsons and catches the local attention.
