Thornton wants Buck to live for himself and hugs him as he dies reassuring him with his final words, "It's okay, boy.
You're home."
The next morning, Buck returns to the hills looking down on the burnt out cabin with sadness.
In the wilderness, Buck mates and has offspring with the white wolf, becoming the pack leader and fully embracing the call of the wild.

82672934.title: I Am Every Man
synopsis: The opening shot pans across the forbidding steel walls of the San Quentin State Prison to reveal John Smith, a refined and intelligent prisoner, coolly locked in a chess match with another encased criminal.
Despite his surroundings, his manner is calm and unperturbed.
The game of chess is abruptly interrupted by the cut to a series of flashbacks.
We see John driving his yellow cab in the vibrant and busy streets of San Francisco.
Regular sightings of Sarah, a tender-hearted social worker become the highlight of John’s daily routine.
John's mundane, eventless life is dramatically overturned following his arrest under charges of committing multiple heinous murders.
The narrative now beautifully oscillates between John's grueling prison routine as a suspected murderer and his innocent past.
The frameworn prison life is broken abruptly by the shocking news of yet another violent murder eerily similar to the previous.
In the city, Sarah has transitioned to work for "Reformity", a prestigious non-profit dedicated to aiding ex-convicts regain their societal standing.
As the news filters through, Sarah is consumed by a torrent of doubts.
Boldly, she decides to embark on a daunting solo quest, scrutinizing every detail of both the past and new murder cases.
Employing clever pretexts about assessing the prison’s welfare facilities for her new employer, Sarah manages to gain permission for regular one-on-one meetings with John.
Together, they painstakingly uncover a vast, nefarious conspiracy brewing within the prison walls involving a dangerous counterfeit currency trade.
Bit by bit, as they lift the veil off the dubious dealings, they unmask one of the prison guards, Mike.
Navigating the treacherous path to truth, Sarah succeeds in obtaining proof substantial enough to indict Mike.
His retaliation is swift and brutal; he masterminds a rampant prison riot, intending to eliminate Sarah.
Capitalizing on the riot as a veil to execute his plan, Mike tracks and corners Sarah within the labyrinthine corridors of the prison complex.
Sensing the escalating danger, John exploits the chaos, maneuvers his way out of his high-security cell block.
He rescues Sarah, culminating in a face-off with Mike.
Mike fires a bullet towards Sarah.
John intercepts the bullet, sustaining a severe shoulder injury.
As the specially trained prison SWAT team finally suppresses the riot, the officers apprehend Mike and Sarah calls for emergency medical assistance for John.
In the aftermath of the riot, John becomes an unexpected hero and his unsolved murder cases are reopened for review by the FBI.
The movie jumps ahead to a courtroom setting where the District Attorney presents the newly found evidence against Mike and in favor of John.
The courtroom erupts into shocked gasps followed by a wave of relief as John’s conviction is finally overturned.
Mike is sentenced for his monstrous crimes.
Sarah watches this victory of justice with a strong sense of accomplishment.
A supportive crowd gathers around the prison gates as John steps out into the open after being wrongfully incarcerated.
Sarah and John share in this victorious moment of peace, a bond forged through shared adversity.
John confesses his deepest appreciation for Sarah standing by his side.
He pledges to utilize his intellectual skill for societal betterment.
John's transition to civilian life isn't easy but with constant support from Sarah's non-profit, he gradually adapts to the meandering rhythms of regular life.
The last frame exhibits John heading into the Californian sunset.
He's not just a free man but a living testament of triumph over adversity, ready to embark on a journey of second chances.

67662091.title: I Am All Girls
synopsis: Inspired by true events, the narrative revolves around Gert de Jager, a South African offender who was imprisoned in 1994.
He was charged with the abduction of six girls, none of which were ever found.
In a recorded tape, Gert de Jager confessed to kidnapping these girls under the instructions of a National Party Cabinet Minister.
He smuggled the girls to Middle Eastern countries like Iran in exchange for oil.
However, this tape was never released by the Apartheid Government and Gert de Jager was killed soon after his confession.
In present-day Johannesburg, South Africa, Directorate for Priority Crime Investigation (DPCI) officer, Jodie Snyman is rigorously carrying out human trafficking raids but with little to no results.
The operation is tight on resources and is on the verge of shutting down when suddenly they find a murdered man with initials carved on his body.
Further investigation reveals that the body is Cabinet Minister Oupa who was also on the National Register for sex offenders.
Jodie finds some hidden tapes in Oupa’s garage and concludes that he was a pedophile who assaulted his own granddaughter.
The initials on his dead body, T.S.C, are the initials of  Tarrynlee Shaw Carter, one of the six missing girls abducted by Gert de Jager.
Oupa is hinted to be the same cabinet minister against whom Gert de Jager witnessed.
The case gets more complicated when more bodies with similar initials start surfacing.
Jodie assumes the killer to be a vigilante, taking revenge for the six missing girls.
However, with the help of the hooded killer, Jodie uncovers a syndicate of sex trafficking cartels thus cleaning the society by unlawful means.
Jodie begins to suspect her colleague, Ntombizonke Bapai, of being the killer after intel reveals the killer is likely to be working from within the police.
Reluctant to accuse Bapai due to her romantic feelings for her, Jodie instead investigates her flat and finds Gert de Jager’s recorded tape, left for her by Bapai.
Through Gert’s tape, Jodie finds out about a farm in Brakpan from where the Syndicate was run by FJ Nolte, the Cabinet Minister about whom Gert was actually talking about.
Out of the six girls initially kidnapped by Gert, FJ Nolte only smuggled five.
He kept Ntombizonke when she was a child and repeatedly sexually assaulted her.
Jodie learns that Brakpan has an airstrip from where girls are sold directly to potential buyers without conflicting the secured routes.
She drives to Brakpan and finds the dead, branded bodies of the two Khan brothers, shipping transporters who were smuggling girls in large numbers and were earlier captured by Jodie, but released.
In Brakpan, Jodie spots an incoming plane and realises FJ Nolte is conducting another “purchase” of six young girls to an Iranian Sheikh, who arrives there on his charter plane.
Jodie tries to intercept but fails and in the struggle, both Ntombizonke and Jodie’s coworker, Samuel, are killed.
Jodie continues the legacy of Ntombizonke and wears the hood of a vigilante herself.
She kills FJ Nolte in his house and marks his chest with Ntombizonke’s initials (a homage to the original revenge rituals).
Suspended from the force, Jodie is a suspected criminal but after the death of FJ Nolte, her commanding officer denies any connection.
Jodie boards a plane to Iran to finish off the remaining culprit, the Iranian Sheikh.

27148487.title: The Rocky Rescue
synopsis: Welcome, let’s embark on an enchanting journey to Stillwater, a small yet alluring community, home to approximately 5000 warm-hearted residents.

Nestled in the bosom of the scenic beauty that is British Columbia, the quintessential charm of Stillwater resonates from its primary lifeline – a breathtakingly colossal limestone quarry that has anchored the town’s spirit and sustenance for decades.
Beneath its captivating allure, a diligent and solemn set of 40 quarrymen immerse themselves in the daily affairs of their labor-intensive profession.

Among them stands the distinguishable figure of Ben, a tireless and dedicated miner who, after offering 35 years of his life to the constant tango of sweat and grit, is on the cusp of a well-deserved retirement.

Right beside Ben, like an ambitious, sparkling ember stands Jack – a fresh graduate from a prestigious mining engineering course who is brimming with unyielding enthusiasm to ink his legacy in the stern and challenging sphere of limestone quarrying.

Day by day, sharing grueling, 12-hour shifts in the dusty belly of the quarry fosters a camaraderie that knits them together, creating bonds as robust and tangible as the mighty expanses of rock that envelope them.
These are friendships born from their shared trials and tribulations, silent agreements forged amidst an unforgiving landscape.
There, amidst the rocky terrain, the men find respite during their hearty lunch breaks, exchanging stories and jests over the ambient noise of drilling operations.

Helping each other with their share of the heavy load, they cultivate a unity and sense of brotherhood that comes to represent an instinctive survival mechanism, a beacon in the sea of persisting hardships.
Nevertheless, floating around in this closely-knitted group are hushed whispers concerning a high-risk 60-foot deep blasting operation planned in the dangerously volatile heart of the mine.
The cautionary murmurings of potential collapse go largely unnoticed, lost amid the daily racket of rumbling rock and debris.
However, Stillwater's serene and picturesque landscape is jolted into panic as the dreaded mine collapse manifests in a gut-wrenching, monstrous boom.
A significant portion of the mine gives away, trapping 26 men including the eager young Jack under seemingly insurmountable layers of hulking limestone debris.
The catastrophic news of the quarry collapse pierces through the heart of Canada, rallying the resilient rescue teams from varied provinces of Alberta, Manitoba, and Quebec.
Together, they join hands in a desperate endeavor to reclaim their trapped brethren from nature's stone crusher.
As rescue efforts take shape, families of the trapped miners gather at the disaster site.

A makeshift chapel springs up at the edge of the quarry, where fervent prayers ascend towards the heavens, each word a plea for miracles, a desperate call to the merciful above to protect the buried beneath.
Haunted by survivor’s guilt, Ben overcomes the town's palpable fear.
Despite the impending sense of bleakness, he harnesses his decades of mining experience to lead the surge to recover his comrades from the quarry’s perilous depths.
The mission grows with complexities as relentless aftershocks continue to fracture the quarry.
The unexpected shifts in geological structure flirt with the looming dangers of additional debris falling, threatening the rescue efforts.

Against these relentless odds, Ben's knowledge proves invaluable, helping the rescuers navigate through the quarry's intricate labyrinth - a dangerous maze forged by the unending struggle between Mother Nature and mankind's insatiable hunger for progress.
Within the grim confines of the collapsed mine, Jack, alongside the remaining miners battle against the encroaching grasp of limited air, dwindling food supplies, and devastating uncertainty.
Together, they attempt to fan the fading embers of hope, the fear of oblivion looming heavily over their wearied spirits.
As the rescue operation intensifies, the situation room - a hastily erected tent on the quarry site, seethes with anxiety.
Officials grapple with the daunting task of strategizing their approach towards the dangerous and treacherously delicate process of extracting the trapped miners.
As time tolls on, the hum of worry grows into somber voices of apprehension as many succumb to the fear of risking more lives in the unstable mine.
This leads to debates favoring slower, less invasive, albeit more time-consuming methods of rescue.
Disregarding the rising tide of hesitation, Ben offers a fervent plea that echoes through the tense gathering.
Every minute spent brooding, he reminds them, gnashes away at the chances of survival for their mates languishing below.
Ben's impassioned plea reverberates through the situation room, igniting the commencement of the fifth act and plunging us into the heart of the perilous rescue mission.
Each painstaking rotation of the excavator's bucket carries with it, hope and fear in equal measure.
The rescue operation unfurls with an urgency that feels as palpable as a ticking time bomb.
The palpable foreboding hanging in the air grows significantly heavier with every chunk of dislodged rubble.
Despite the consistent efforts, the rescue brings home a bittersweet victory.
Seventeen miners are hoisted from the abyss, embraced by the grateful arms of Stillwater.
However, the victory remains incomplete as Jack remains trapped further within the mine, flanked by the merciless jaws of survival and mortality.
Emerging from the billowing dust of the collapsed quarry, the rescued miners adjust their eyes to the liberating daylight.
They surface to the sight of medical tents and their loved ones, greeted by an overwhelming surge of relieved sobs and jubilations.
Stillwater finds itself unified amidst a turmoil of conflicting emotions.
The town grieves the lost seven while cherishing its 17 victories in a co-existence of gratitude and mourning.
The climax builds as the focus shifts back to the depths of the mined abyss, where Jack remains incapacitated, trapped and feared unreachable.
However, in a stroke of blessed fortune, Jack is discovered by a weary rescue team.

He is battered, bone-weary but thankfully breathing, as he is hauled towards the surface and into the arms of collective relief marking the end of a 36-hour grueling ride on the see-saw of dread and hope.
The reunion is touching and poignant, offering a balm to the battered spirits of the town’s people.
Jack, teary-eyed with gratitude, finds himself amidst his comrades and loved ones, their bond fortified through the unyielding test of adversity.
As the turbulence settles and the credits roll, Stillwater rises from the ashes, now stronger and wiser.
The town embraces stricter safety standards for the quarry, led by none other than Ben himself, the town's seasoned rescuer.
Together, they look towards a future of rigorous caution and safety, propelled by the hope of quieter, safer tomorrows.

65295325.title: The Ice Road
synopsis: An explosion at a mine in Manitoba traps 26 miners.

Mike McCann and his brother Gurty, an Iraq War veteran suffering from PTSD and aphasia, work for a trucking company in North Dakota until Mike punches another trucker for making fun of Gurty's cognitive disability, and they are both fired.
Mike hears about ice road truckers needed in Winnipeg, and they apply.
Jim Goldenrod, another trucker, agrees to lead a rescue mission to deliver wellheads to the mine.
He hires McCann and Gurty, along with a young Indigenous woman known only as Tantoo.
Also joining the rescue mission is actuary Varnay, responsible for insurance risk assessment for Katka, the company which owns the mine.
$200,000 is split between the four truckers, which will be redistributed among the survivors if anyone dies.
Meanwhile, the miners are communicating with Katka executives using tap code, and Katka General Manager Sickle transmits a message that they plan to free the men by blasting a tunnel.
The team leaves for the mine with three wellheads.
During the trip, Goldenrod's engine seizes.
While attempting to repair it, the ice beneath his trailer breaks and his leg gets trapped.
Knowing he can't escape, he convinces Tantoo to sever the strap attaching him to her truck, causing him to drown but saving the other two rigs and wellheads.
In an attempt to flee the rapidly approaching pressure wave and cracking ice, the remaining two trucks fishtail and roll over, stopping the pressure wave.
Varnay convinces Mike to accuse Tantoo of sabotaging Goldenrod's rig, but Tantoo reveals her brother Cody is amongst the miners.
When they continue to interrogate her, she pulls out a pistol, but Gurty disarms her and ties her up.
After the men right the trucks, Varnay locks Mike and Gurty in the back of their rig.
Varnay is revealed to have been the one who sabotaged Goldenrod's rig, and knocks Tantoo unconscious.
He rigs Mike's truck with dynamite and drives off with Tantoo, but Mike and Gurty escape from the trailer and throw the dynamite away just before it explodes.
Varnay watches the explosion from afar, believing that Mike and Gurty are dead.
While winching their trailer out of the ice, Gurty tries to warn Mike the winch will fail, but Mike starts the machine anyway.
The winch snaps, causing Gurty and the trailer to fall into the water, but Mike rescues Gurty.
Varnay meets with Sickle, telling him Mike and Gurty have died.
Sickle instructs Varnay to get rid of Tantoo and the last remaining wellhead by making it seem Tantoo lost control and veered off a cliff.
Varnay prepares to kill Tantoo, but is bitten by Gurty's pet rat Skeeter, enabling Tantoo to throw him out of the rig.
Mike and Gurty arrive and kill the Katka contractors pursuing Tantoo.
After Tantoo runs out of fuel due to Varnay disconnecting her fuel equalizer, he catches up to her, but Mike crashes his rig into Varnay's truck, sending it off a cliff.
Varnay survives and creates an avalanche with dynamite.
Mike and Gurty escape, but Tantoo is hit by snow and wounded by a branch.
They uncouple her trailer, and drive off with the wellhead.
Varnay pursues them in Tantoo's rig and begins ramming them.
Mike boards Varnay's rig and both fall from the truck.
After a struggle, Mike attempts to drive away, but Varnay climbs onto the rig.
Mike knocks Varnay out, accelerates the rig, and jumps out, causing it to fall through the surface and kill Varnay.
Meanwhile, Tantoo and Gurty cross a bridge not designed for the weight of the truck, and barely make it over before the bridge collapses.
After crossing, the truck starts sliding backwards, and Gurty is crushed trying to prevent the truck from falling.
Mike arrives and comforts a dying Gurty.
Mike and Tantoo arrive just in time to rescue the miners.
After learning the truth, the Katka CEO fires Sickle, who is arrested for his actions.
Three months later, Tantoo is seen working in Goldenrod's garage as a mechanic.
Mike visits her in his new gold truck, which he drives as an independent contractor to deliver sporting goods.
As he drives off, he is seen tending to Skeeter and his license plate reads "TRK TRK TRK", in honor of Gurty's chosen name for a truck.

11194689.title: Storm Among Aristocrats
synopsis: Elena, a devoted mechanic, is seen in the confines of a small, shadowy garage in the heartland of Milwaukee.
Her mechanical know-how, an invaluable hand-me-down from her father, shines through her dexterous maneuvers around the car's spidery innards.
One evening, her routine is disrupted by the ring of her trusty landline phone.
On the other end is Gabriela, her old friend from childhood, who left the familiar monotony of their humble upbringing for a world of extravagant displays and indulgence in Los Angeles.
Gabriela entices Elena with an elegant invitation to an exclusive party at her swanky mansion.
Elena, ensnared in her uncomplicated existence that appears colorless compared to Gabriela’s opulent kaleidoscope, feels hesitant.
However, the prospect of breaking free from the monotonous familiarity of her day-to-day life gives her the nudge she needed.
The crowd circles around her with an air of elitist indifference, their curt nods and feigned handshakes interrupted by dismissive brush-offs.
Abruptly, the festivities are interrupted as ominous black clouds roll in – a vicious hurricane that wasn't on any forecast strikes without warning, casting the mansion into a state of chaos.

Disturbed and suspicious, Elena finds herself surreptitiously moving through the cavernous corridors and rooms of the mansion, trying to decipher the cause behind the unsettling energy humming through the crowd.
Elena stumbles down a hidden staircase to a secret chamber beneath the mansion.
Moving along the chamber with wary steps, she discovers odd symbols etched in the stone walls and disturbing newspaper clippings detailing several unresolved disappearances during past hurricanes.
Connecting the terrifying dots, Elena is seized with an icy dread- the hurricane, previous disappearances, the meeting of the guests during this catastrophic event - all seem intricately linked.
Burdened with trepidation, she races back to warn Gabriela of the danger they may be surrounded by.
Gabriela, intoxicated by the glitz and glamour, dismisses Elena's warnings as unfounded paranoia.
As the hurricane reaches its peak savagery, the distinguished guests shed their amiable veneers.
They reveal themselves to be acolytes of an ancient cult that worships the destructive power of storms.
The cult members confess to harnessing the immense power of hurricanes for an occult ritual.
The aim - to cheat death and gain eternal life.
Elena's blood turns to ice as realization grips her - Gabriela is the carefully planned offering required to guarantee the cult's longevity goals.
Overcome with fear yet resolved to protect her friend, Elena resolves to thwart the cultists' wicked scheme.
Relying on her in-depth mechanical knowledge accrued over years spent in her garage sanctuary, Elena prepares to engage in a perilous confrontation with the menacing cult members.
Benefiting from her earlier exploration of the mansion, Elena locates Gabriela at the ceremonial heart of the cult ritual.
Barely scraping through, they manage to escape from the mansion just as the hurricane begins to ease.
Drenched to the bone and buffeted by the relenting winds, they stumble upon a local police station in the small neighboring town of Goleta.
Shaken to their core, they relay their petrifying encounters to the incredulous local police.
After initial skepticism, the police decide to investigate the claims and head to the mansion.
Stubbornly trudging back to normalcy, both Elena and Gabriela find comfort in the shared past and the horrifying ordeal they narrowly escaped.
Elena discovers her hidden bravery, taking pride in saving Gabriela from the clutches of the heinous cult.
Gabriela, having had a close brush with death, looks at her friend with newfound respect and gratitude, acknowledging Elena's exceptional bravery.
Forced by their near-death experience, the duo continues their lives, holding their deep friendship close to their hearts.
Gabriela learns to appreciate Elena's quiet, industrious life, while Elena finds respect for Gabriela's undeniable zest.
Nonetheless, the memory of their frightful night lingers like a morose shadow, ominously coloring their lives.
As the curtains close on this chapter, the camera glides to an ominous still.
The lens focuses on a grand mansion, eerily similar to Gabriela's, basking under the menacing storm clouds in the French milieu – Mansion de la Lune.
As darkness descends, the mansion's windows inexplicably glow, suggesting an unending reign of terror.

67321742.title: Bodies Bodies Bodies
synopsis: Bee, a working-class young woman from Eastern Europe, travels with her wealthy girlfriend Sophie to a "hurricane party" at a mansion owned by the family of David, Sophie's friend.
Other guests include David's aspiring actress girlfriend Emma, the podcaster Alice, her much-older new boyfriend Greg, and the enigmatic Jordan.
Max, another guest, left after a fight with David the night before Sophie and Bee arrived.
After drinking, using drugs, and dancing, the group decides to play "Bodies Bodies Bodies", a murder in the dark-style game.
Greg goes to bed early due to hostility throughout the game from David, who also leaves soon after another fight with Emma.
As the storm worsens, the power goes out and the girls scramble to find a power source.
Minutes later, Bee finds David outside with his throat slashed, a blood-stained kukri nearby.
Panicked and without reception, the group try to go for help in Sophie's car, but find its battery dead.
The group discovers Greg has a go bag with a knife and a map of the area and become suspicious of him.
They fearfully confront Greg, who returns their hostility.
After a struggle, Bee bludgeons him to death with a kettle bell.
The group doubt that Greg was the killer and Emma theorizes that Max, who had confessed feelings for her the night before, returned to kill David.
Sophie, a sober addict, relapses.
Emma kisses her, to Sophie's confusion, before accepting drugs.
Alice later finds Emma dead from a head wound at the bottom of the stairs, and believes the group is being killed one by one.
Jordan and Alice cast suspicion on Bee, revealing that no one with her name is on record as having graduated from her college; they cast Bee out into the hurricane.
Returning to Sophie's car, Bee finds underwear that matches Jordan's bra in the backseat.
She sees Jordan holding David's father's gun through a window, then crawls back inside through a pet door.
Bee confronts the group, revealing that she dropped out of college to take care of her mother, who has borderline personality disorder.
A vicious verbal fight ensues between the group.

Jordan, who was the "killer" in the Bodies Bodies Bodies game, reveals resentment for Sophie due to her drug addiction and using David to regain access to her trust fund, and claims Sophie cheated on Bee with her, which Sophie denies.
Sophie expresses why she would not date Jordan, that she avoids her friends because their behavior challenges her sobriety, and reveals that Jordan only "hate-listens" to Alice's podcast.
After Alice responds by insulting Jordan's insecurities, Jordan shoots Alice in the leg.
A struggle for the gun follows; Alice is fatally shot in the throat.
As Sophie and Jordan fight, Bee pushes Jordan over the staircase bannister.
With her dying breath, Jordan tells Bee to check Sophie's text messages.
Bee hides from Sophie out of distrust.
When morning comes and the storm has blown over, Sophie tearfully confesses to Bee that she relapsed and witnessed Emma tripping and falling down the stairs to her death.
However, Bee holds her at gunpoint, demanding to see her texts.

Sophie tosses her phone away and they struggle, inadvertently picking up David's phone in the process, which shows that David accidentally slashed his own throat while trying to use the kukri to open a champagne bottle for a TikTok video—revealing there was no real murderer after all.
As Bee and Sophie realize the bloodshed was all for nothing, a confused Max returns to the mansion, and the power comes back on.
When Max asks what happened, Bee only says that she now has service on her phone.

30451032.title: Under the Magnolia Sky (2022 film)
synopsis: The narrative takes off with Madison, an introverted literature enthusiast, arriving at Southerland Academy, a prestigious private university nestled amidst the rich culture and history of Mississippi.
Madison prefers the company of her books over people, indulging in classic novels and poetry frequently.
Madison finds companionship in Liam, who is not only her classmate but also her closest, most trusted confidante.
Their relationship revolves around intellectual conversations and shared academic interests.
Just like Madison, Literature holds a special place in Liam's interests.
The friendships indulges in a range of activities that help establish their bond.
Undeniably, the affection they have for each other extends beyond friendship.
However, afraid of damaging their precious bond, they establish an agreement to remain platonic friends.

As Madison and Liam transition into their final year at Southerland Academy, the narrative beautifully highlights their intellectual banter about everything from Victorian prose to existential philosophies.
Over time, their heart-to-heart discussions instigate closer elements of romantic feelings in them.
Their unintended romantic inclinations stagger them causing them to struggle with the unforeseen storm of emotional turmoil.
Trapped between her love for literature and maintaining her relationship with Liam, Madison's life takes a dramatic turn.
She receives an exceptional opportunity to advance her literature studies in New York City.
Parallelly, Liam is hit with personal struggles linked to his family.
His need for emotional solace and support from Madison intensifies.
Oblivious of Madison's internal conflicts, Liam succumbs to his emotions, confessing his hidden feelings for Madison.
This unexpected confession adds another layer of complexity to their friendship.
Madison accepts the New York opportunity.
She decides to broaden her horizons, despite the painful implications it poses for her and Liam.
Madison's life in New York is a stark contrast to her serene existence in Mississippi.
The busy city life is demanding, putting her resilience to the test.
The distance physically separating them only amplifies their latent feelings.
Even with the accomplishment of her academic dream, Madison finds herself crippled by an emotional void.
Post the graduation ceremony, Madison's phone rings it's Liam.
This unexpected call reinforces Madison's suppressed feelings; she realizes that her future just doesn't seem right without Liam occupying a crucial part in it.
Without wasting any moment, Madison hurriedly books a flight back to Mississippi that very night.
The film culminates with a heartfelt reunion of Madison and Liam under the sprawling branches of their favourite magnolia tree.
They finally lift the veil on their suppressed feelings, openly confessing their undying love for each other.
Their cherished friendship, which gracefully transitioned into a deeply profound romance, now stands testament to an undying bond filled with love, respect, and companionship.

68437738.title: Look Both Ways (2022 film)
synopsis: During her senior year at the University of Texas, Natalie has sex with her friend Gabe, with both agreeing not to "make it a big deal".
A few weeks later, on the night of their graduation, Natalie feels sick and her best friend Cara gets her pregnancy tests.
When Natalie takes them, her life diverges into two parallel realities based on the result.
In the reality where Natalie's test is positive, she moves back home with her mom and dad, who are less than thrilled and unimpressed with Gabe's status as an aspiring musician.
They encourage Natalie to still pursue her dream career in animation while she struggles with the realization that she will become a mother.
In the reality where her test is negative, she moves to Los Angeles with Cara and they start building their careers.
Natalie applies to be an assistant to animator Lucy Galloway.
After pining for the job, she gets an offer, and forms a strong bond with her colleague Jake.
They encourage each other to follow their dreams, with him desiring to be a successful movie producer.
In the pregnancy reality, Natalie and Gabe struggle to coparent as their daughter Rosie is born.
He wants them to move in with him, but Natalie does not agree and tells him to date, though later she appears regretful about her decision in a conversation with Cara.
Gabe begins a relationship with a woman named Miranda, making Natalie uncomfortable.
When Natalie visits Cara and her girlfriend in LA, she gets a call from Rosie who says she is left overnight with a stranger.
Natalie rushes back, much to Cara's disappointment, and finds out that Gabe has proposed to Miranda.
Natalie throws herself into her artwork.
In the other reality where her test came negative, Natalie and Jake develop a strong romantic relationship and consider moving in together.
That is, until Jake receives a year-long job producing in Nova Scotia.
They try long distance, but Natalie finds it isn’t working for her as Jake is always busy with work.
Natalie shows Lucy her portfolio, and is given some very critical notes, saying her work is unoriginal.
She encourages her to quit to find her voice, so she does.
She returns home to a friend’s baby shower with Cara, feeling like a failure.
In both realities, Natalie has a career breakthrough.

She gets accepted to the South by Southwest film festival in Austin where in one reality, she sits on a panel of creators including Lucy and discusses a comic inspired by Rosie, and in the other, her short film is showcased.
In the negative pregnancy test reality, Nat sees Gabe’s band in a bar, catching up with him after five years.
Later on, she is surprised that Jake has traveled to see her short film, despite risking his job with the movie.
Lucy sees Natalie’s short film and encourages her to reconnect when she returns to Los Angeles.
In the positive pregnancy test reality, Natalie and Rosie also watch Gabe's band perform at a bar.
Afterwards, she asks him why Miranda isn't at the gig.
Gabe tells her that he broke off the engagement because he is in love with her, not Miranda.
In one reality, Jake and Natalie walk through the streets, happy to be reunited.
In the other, Gabe and Natalie have a serious conversation about how they would like to develop their relationship.
Both realities converge when each of the couples walk past Natalie’s sorority house, where she took the pregnancy test.
In both realities, Natalie walks up into the bathroom, looks into the mirror, and reassures herself that things worked out before leaving.

79605619.title: Breakout from Bulawayo
synopsis: The film begins with a vibrant depiction of the bustling cityscape of Bulawayo, Zimbabwe, in the year 1978.
Amid the mosaic tapestry of the locals, we are introduced to the pairing of John Doe, a suave spy hailing from Jamaica, and Robert Smith, a hardened American CIA agent.
The pair’s compelling mission comes to light - to covertly distribute anti-regime pamphlets and graffiti materials across the cityscape.
Unfortunately, adversity strikes as a neighborhood baker, albeit reluctantly turned government informant, betrays them.
His betrayal leads to their cornering, apprehension, and subsequent moving towards the gloomy threshold of Harare Central Prison.
Inside the dreary prison walls, the depth of their predicament unfolds.
However, it is some counterintuitively here that the story seeds an undeniable resilience within several inmates.
In these unlikely circumstances, John and Robert form a bond of alliance with Tinashe, a politically inclined prisoner.
Even as their backgrounds stretch across continents, the strong threads of shared stories, communal jokes and the shared anguish of their present situation unite the trio.
Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, we meet Sophie, a fierce and unyielding, ex-freedom fighter, who serves as the duo's lifeline.

Amid the crushingly bleak setting of the prison, John's innocent sketch of a flying bird, escaping its cage, triggers the much-needed inspiration and spark - a daring concept to break the thorny chains of their confinement.

The narrative now twists into a strategic gear, unraveling a meticulously crafted plan of utilizing the prison's structural vulnerabilities and outwitting the prison guards with their intelligence and willed determination.
Ingeniously embedding cryptic notes in mundane letters and crafting subtle hints, they manage to communicate their audacious escape plan to Sophie outside the prison walls.

Nights turn into mini escapades as they secretively accumulate makeshift tools from discarded prison items, understanding the pattern in the guards’ shifts, simulating their midnight escape repeatedly to iron out any potential faults.

Following a pre-conceived blueprint, they rely on creative diversion tactics, weaving their way through the labyrinth of filth-sodden sewer pipelines beneath the prison, noiselessly dodging the roving eyes of the patrolling guards.
Sophie steps into her part outside the prison, masterfully choreographing a colossal neighborhood-wide blackout, successfully diverting the guards' intensifying vigilance.
Their daring escape transitions into a dizzying cat-and-mouse pursuit through the convoluted, winding alleyways of Bulawayo.

Amid the frenetic adrenaline-high escape, they make a split-second decision - they decide not to abandon Tinashe, but to drag him along with them, adding another layer of risk to their already perilous escape.
The climax builds into a palpable crescendo of thrilling chaos, as they dash through the narrow backstreets towards a secluded rendezvous point.
Amid the cacophonous chaos of Bulawayo's pandemonium, the approaching roar of helicopter blades strikes a resonating chord of hope and imminent relief.
Breaths held tight; the trio make it aboard the patiently awaiting, military-grade helicopter, finally escaping the clutches of the menacing prison guards and their relentless pursuit.
Overcome with a surge of dutiful commitment towards his motherland, Tinashe chooses to parachute right back into the lion's den, vowing to continue his rebellion against the oppressive regime.

Moved by the raw courage radiated by Tinashe, John and Robert, pledge their continuous support for the resistance supplies from their new safehouse in London, enshrining him in their freedom-fighting narrative.
The film draws to a poignant close on a momentous chord of defiance, resistance, and hope.

60215801.title: Escape from Pretoria
synopsis: In 1978, Tim Jenkin and Stephen Lee; two white South Africans, are carrying out anti-apartheid missions in South Africa.
They are arrested on the spot and prosecuted; Jenkin is sentenced to twelve years and Lee is sentenced to eight.
At the courthouse Lee attempts to escape but to no avail.
Transported to Pretoria Prison, they meet Denis Goldberg, an older political prisoner serving four life sentences for previous work against apartheid.
He shows them the ropes but discourages them from trying to escape.
Jenkin and Lee discuss escaping with another prisoner, Leonard Fontaine.
They settle in and go about their daily routines, but Jenkin starts to analyze the prison and think of ways to escape.
He steals items from the wood shop to make wooden keys that fit the locks to their cells.
He sneaks around the prison at night, making keys for other locks.
Lee and Jenkin bury these keys in the prison garden while tending it and make many other preparations for their escape.
Fontaine and Jenkin do a test run by using keys to leave their cells.
They hide in a closet as the night guard walks by.
They use another key to leave the cell block, but they have to run back to their cells before they can use another key.
The guards search everyone's cells the next day but fail to find anything.
Later, Jenkin discovers that a new gun tower is being built.
He, Fontaine and Lee present their plan to Goldberg and other prisoners who decide against trying to escape with them.
Jenkin, Lee and Fontaine execute their plan.
They gather keys hidden in various areas and change into previously smuggled street clothes.
Once again, they hide in the closet to evade the night guard.
Unexpectedly, the night guard comes back to the closet.
Goldberg short-circuits the light in his cell, causing the electricity to go out and calls for the guard, distracting him so that the trio can reach the last door.
They cannot get any of the keys to work on this door, but Fontaine breaks it open using a chisel and screwdriver.
They leave the prison and find a taxi driven by a black driver to take them out of Pretoria after offering him cash.
It transpires that the biggest manhunt ensued in the aftermath, but they managed to escape to London via Mozambique, and Tanzania.
The three would continue their protests against apartheid under the African National Congress Party; they were ultimately pardoned in 1991.
Goldberg was finally freed in 1985 after spending 22 years in prison.
In 1992, a year after Jenkin, Lee and Fontaine's exoneration, apartheid ended.

97560665.title: The Champion and The Gladiator: Underground Battles
synopsis: As the sun rises in the bustling metropolis of New York City in the year 2002, we meet our heroes, John, known as 'The Champion', and Mark, dubbed 'The Gladiator'.
Their friendship is strengthened as they delve into the perilous yet captivating world of clandestine, grimy fight clubs that lurk in the city's underbelly.
Each fight they participate in only validates the grandeur of their skills.
Their victories are relentless, and curious whispers about their reasons for joining these savage rings echo within the underground fighting community.
Mark, the Gladiator, an ex-Golden Gloves champion, steps under the scanty lights of an underground ring against a formidable Ukrainian striker.
His victory again confirms his reputation.
Their wins, frequent and unending, gain them a reputation in the underground fighting world, capturing the interest of spectators.
Together, The Champion and The Gladiator continue to climb the ladder of New York's underground fight world.
Each bold move they make in the ring sets off ripples, leading to surges of respect and fear among their followers.
Among the spectators, a man named Frank, known as 'The Boss', a notorious mob boss decides to cash in on The Gladiator's increased popularity.
'The Boss' manipulates The Gladiator into agreeing to participate in a rigged match against his Sicilian champion, baiting him with a promise of large earnings.
The Gladiator, against his better judgment, succumbs to the allure of the fortune, completely unaware of the profound repercussions this decision will have.
The orchestrated fight leaves The Gladiator agonizingly injured.
John, The Champion, and the crowd of spectators are left aghast at the brutal scenes.
Memories of Mark's pummeling haunt The Champion, driving him to the brink of abandoning the ruthless world of underground fighting.
Despite the Gladiator's critical state, Frank 'The Boss' doesn't relent.
He relentlessly coerces him to face an intimidating Russian opponent in yet another potential death-match.
The Champion, terrified for Mark's life yet fueled by the need to protect his friend, decides to replace The Gladiator in the fight.
The Champion’s performance in the fight is strong, but his opponent, Vlad 'The Viper', proves to a strong adversary.
Despite John’s struggle, the fight reaches its climax when Vlad lands a knockout punch, leaving The Champion’s body broken.
In the aftermath of the brutal match, The Champion wakes up in a harshly lit hospital room, his body reeling from his catastrophic injuries.
As news about John's grave condition reaches Mark, he decides to confront Frank.
Filled with anger and a desire for vengeance, Mark, The Gladiator, challenges The Boss to a definitive fight.
The Gladiator squaring off against the Bulgarian beast, Frank's undefeated champion, is a showdown that keeps the audiences on the edge of their seat.
In a remarkable display of strength, The Gladiator overpowers his opponent, avenging John.
This victory seals his dominance in the world of underground fight clubs.
Their victory, though sweet, is brief as they now face the task of freeing themselves from the ruthless underworld.
It dawns upon them that transitioning to a world of peace from a life marred by incessant violence is not easy.
Confronting the haunting memories of their brutal past poses a formidable challenge.
Their decision to leave their former life behind is fraught with difficulty; their past is worn on their bodies in the form of physical scars.
As the film concludes, we join The Champion in the stillness of a hospital room, reflecting on their violent past, and contemplating the uncertainty of their future.
He finally realizes the true nature of being a champion: it's not about winning in the ring, but about fighting life's battles with resilience and unwavering spirit.
Even though their past is steeped in brutal fights, the Champion and the Gladiator now gaze hopefully towards a future filled with peace, healing, and the promise of a better tomorrow.

63560505.title: Creed III
synopsis: In 2002 Los Angeles, a young Adonis "Donnie" Creed sneaks out with his best friend, Golden Gloves champion Damian Anderson, to watch him compete in an underground boxing match.
After Dame's victory, he tells Donnie about his aspirations to turn professional and become a world champion.
During a detour at a liquor store, Donnie impulsively attacks a man named Leon, and Dame is arrested while Donnie escapes.

In the present day, three years after beating "Pretty" Ricky Conlan to avenge his only career defeat, Donnie has retired from boxing to focus on his wife Bianca and their 6-year-old daughter Amara, whose hearing impairment has since led the family to become fluent in American Sign Language.
Donnie runs the Delphi Boxing Academy with Tony "Little Duke" Evers Jr. and is promoting his protégé, world champion Felix "El Guerrero" Chavez, in a match against Viktor Drago.
While the two watch the declining health of Donnie's adoptive mother Mary-Anne, Amara aspires to become a boxer like Donnie, which gets her into trouble in school for punching a bully.
Released from prison, Dame reconnects with Donnie and shares his desire to resume his boxing career.
Donnie reluctantly invites Dame to the gym, and hires him as Chavez's sparring partner, but his presence draws scorn from Chavez and Duke as Dame is overly aggressive and hostile.
Dame later visits Donnie's home, where he meets his family and recounts their time together at a group home, a story that Bianca had never heard.
Privately, Dame asks for a title shot against Chavez, but Donnie declines.

After Drago is attacked by an unknown assailant at a party for Bianca's record label, which casts doubt on his ability to participate in his upcoming fight, Donnie nominates Dame as Drago's replacement.

Despite it being his first professional bout, Dame manages to win the unified heavyweight championship by implementing dirty tactics such as a knee and elbow, as well as targeting Chavez's shoulder, which Dame had intentionally damaged during one of their sparring sessions.
Following the match, an uneasy Donnie visits Mary-Anne, who shows him letters Dame had written to Donnie while in prison that she kept from him due to her believing that he was a bad influence.
One letter contains a picture showing Dame with a fellow inmate that Donnie recognizes as Drago's assailant.
Realizing that Dame planned the attack, Donnie confronts him, and Dame admits that he manipulated him into getting the title shot.
Donnie is unable to open up to Bianca about his guilt over Dame, who revels in his newfound fame and publicly slanders Donnie as a fraud who turned his back on him.
Mary-Anne suffers another stroke and dies.
After her funeral, Donnie confesses to Bianca about the night of Dame's arrest, revealing Leon to be the abusive caregiver in their group home before he was adopted.
After Donnie attacked Leon at the liquor store, the ensuing brawl with Leon's friends caused Dame to brandish a gun.
After Dame was arrested, Donnie never contacted Dame out of guilt.
Encouraged by Bianca, Donnie decides to come out of retirement and challenges Dame for the championship, which he accepts.
After training with Duke and a recovered Drago, Donnie faces Dame in the "Battle of Los Angeles" at Dodger Stadium.
The fight is a grueling, evenly-matched affair.
In the final round, Donnie has visions of his abusive foster home and Dame's life in jail, which leads to Donnie being knocked down.
He manages to just beat the count, then goes on to knock Dame out and regain the championship.
Afterward, Donnie reconciles with Dame, with both men admitting it was not the other's fault.
Donnie joins Bianca and Amara in the ring in the empty stadium, where he pretends to box with Amara.
As Donnie and his family leave the ring, he looks out on to the empty Dodger Stadium.

80707358.title: Wish Elephant
synopsis: Deep in the vibrant heart of Bangkok, a diligent young man by the name of Sam leads his life fervently.
He's a university scholar, juggling textbooks and theory with his part-time job as a waiter at a popular street café, his routine embedded in the buzzing city's lively rhythm.
Periodically interrupting his monotonous city life are his daydreams, filled with memories of Mia, an old childhood friend and a precious part of Sam's past.
They grew up together in a tranquil Thai village, forging deep bonds with each other, and with a spirited elephant named Hanuman, distinctive from all others in their tranquil hamlet.
Vivid flashbacks repeatedly punctuate Sam's bustling city life, painting a stark contrast.
They bring back innocent memories of their rural childhood, where life was simpler and the air fresher.
His reminiscences are resplendent with the image of open fields, rippling village river, and the soothing rhythm of daily village life.
However, the idyllic village life was drastically upended when Mia had to relocate to the city with her diplomat father.
The move distanced her from Sam and the beloved Hanuman, symbolically taking their rural history with her and placing it out of Sam's reach.
One seemingly ordinary day, the busy drum of university life leads Sam to a cultural fair.
Amidst the chaos of intrigued students and colourful stalls, he stumbles upon an antiquated charm labeled 'Make a wish'.
Caught off guard, Sam's usual pragmatic mindset wavers, giving way to whimsical curiosity.
With a hint of nostalgia and quiet yearning, he whispered his wish to reconnect with Mia, his long-lost friend, and Hanuman, their childhood companion.
The very next day, as if guided by unseen forces, a handwritten letter finds its way to Sam.
It was an invitation from none other than Mia herself; She was inviting him to a social outreach event at her luxurious residence in the upper echelons of the city.
Upon arriving at the high-end city event, Sam feels starkly out of place amidst the elite attendees.
The reunion with Mia accentuated this sense of foreignness.
The Mia he meets is a reflection of city elegance, appearing different, almost unrecognizable from the village girl he remembers once playing with by the river.
Seeing Mia so transformed confuses Sam, yet he unyieldingly clings on to their fleeting memories, refusing to acknowledge the growing chasm between their lifestyles.
As the luxurious soirée progresses, Sam stumbles upon a faded family photograph of Mia.
It shows her visiting an elephant reserve, their memory-filled hometown.
Encouraged by the photograph, Sam decides to rekindle their shared affection for elephants, carefully penning a proposal for a university trip to their home village and the elephant sanctuary.
He pitches the unconventional trip to a diverse group of his peers, representing different fields of study.
Met with both skepticism and genuine excitement, the idea was received with a unique mixture of emotions.

Through an interplay of memorable blunders, setbacks, and the unyielding enthusiasm of Sam, the scheduled trip blossoms into a unique journey of self-discovery, painted with a palette of shared laughter and surprising incidents.
Reaching the elephant sanctuary, the group is ushered into an experience that was utterly magical.
Their day was etched with lively interactions with elephants and the unique imprint of their hometown.
In a twist of fate, Mia recognizes their old companion Hanuman among the sanctuary's elephants.
The sight triggers a tsunami of nostalgia, awakening buried feelings and memories.
As the day grew old, the towering wall of years spent apart crumbled.
A surge of reminiscences engulfed Sam and Mia, revitalizing the bond that once held them together beneath the village's same sun.
The journey back to their roots is painted in vibrant strokes of old stories from their shared past, reblossoming their once strong friendship.
Through earnest conversations and nostalgic experiences, Sam begins to cherish the simplicity of his life more and admire the uncomplicated, yet purposeful existence he has chosen.
Mia, on the other hand, starts questioning her city life.
The fast-paced monotony and absence of natural calm makes her reflect upon the simplicity she traded for a life in the city.
Over the last few days, Sam, Mia, and Hanuman revel in their renewed camaraderie, re-living and rekindling the harmony of their old times.
Moved by the experience, Mia decides to honor her humble roots more often, promising to visit her village and the elephant sanctuary much more frequently.
She also encourages her fellow city-dwelling friends to contribute to elephant preservation, extending the same invitation to visit the sanctuary.
Back in the bustling city of Bangkok, the rejuvenated trio, Mia, Sam, and Hanuman find themselves reconvening at the university where another student coincidentally discovers the 'Make a wish' charm.
Recognizing the charm, Sam couldn't help but chuckle at their strange journey before he advised the curious student: "Think before you wish".

57342168.title: Wish Dragon
synopsis: Din is a working-class college student in Shanghai who dreams of reuniting with his childhood friend Li Na, who moved away ten years ago from their neighborhood with her father, Mr. Wang, and now lives a lavish life.
One day, Din is given a teapot by an elderly man, from which emerges Long, a wish dragon.
Long informs Din he will grant three wishes to his master, i.e.
whoever holds the teapot.
Din will be Long's tenth and final master and will free Long from his servitude, allowing him to enter the Spirit world.
Subsequently, Din is chased by a trio of goons led by a man named Pockets, sent by Mr. Wang to recover the teapot in hopes of saving his failing business.
Din uses his first wish to fight the goons and escape.
The next day, Din and Long arrive at Li Na's birthday party.
Din makes his second wish—to temporarily appear as a wealthy princeling for one day, hoping Li Na will notice him and rekindle their friendship.
Li Na is disappointed when she learns her father will not be attending her birthday party.
Din, sticking to his disguise as 'Dan', comforts her and they are asked by Mr. Wang (via a video call) to share a meal together.
Long warns Din that Li Na will leave him as soon as she finds out his identity, because of their different socioeconomic status.
During the date, Din asks Long for advice on how to act accordingly to his new status, but ends up upsetting Li Na in the process.
They both end up in Din's neighborhood after the goons pursue Din again.
Din reveals himself to Li Na, and they spend the rest of the day in the neighborhood reliving their childhood pastimes.
However, Li Na finally retreats claiming that she has responsibilities and expectations she needs to meet, hurting Din's feelings.
Later that night, Din angrily asks Long to make him rich in a last-ditch effort to be respected.
Long reveals to Din that in life he was a wealthy and powerful lord whose reign ended in loneliness and tragedy and was punished by the gods for his selfishness by becoming a wish dragon.
Long's servitude as a wish dragon is meant to make him appreciate the meaning of life, something he has failed to accomplish with all of his previous masters.
After tracking down Din, Pockets betrays Mr. Wang by taking the teapot for himself and asks the wish dragon for his first wish to turn everything he touches to gold.
He drops Mr. Wang from a large scaffolding, mortally wounding him in front of Li Na.
Din chases the goons, and eventually ends up fighting Pockets on Long's back.
Pockets corners Din and prepares to hit him with his golden hand, but Long puts himself in the way, causing both him and Pockets (who accidentally touched himself) to turn into gold statues.
Din is unable to stop Long's statue from sinking to the bottom of a river, while Pockets shatters to pieces against the ground.
Long finds his human self at the entrance to the Spirit world.
Despite being tempted to go through the gates, he pleads with the guardian of the gate to return to Din because he has not used his third wish.
The guardian agrees, on one condition.
Din uses his last wish to heal Mr. Wang, and Long disappears.
Sometime later, Mr. Wang starts a restaurant featuring Din's mother's cooking, with both Din and Li Na helping.
Din finds a teapot like the one Long resided in and releases him.
Long tells Din the sole condition for his return to Earth was to stay and serve ten more masters.
After saying goodbye to Long, Din places the teapot on a carriage driven by the elderly man from the beginning, who is actually the guardian of the gate to the Spirit world.

7057966.title: Belle & Jack
synopsis: Underneath the high-vaulted ceiling of a Yale University lecture hall, the story unfolds with Professor Mark delivering a spellbinding lecture on folklore, captivating a room full of eager students by spinning tales from Irish mythology.
The professor focuses on one tale in particular - the story of a mythical Irish entity dubbed "A Gorgeous Kid sporting a Mesmerizing Rose-Coloured Cap."
His voice rises and falls as he skillfully ensnares listeners in the spooky and mystical web of the ancient tale.
Belle, a young journalism major with chestnut hair, listens with a mix of curiosity and fear.
Post-lecture, Belle meets up with her roommate, Jack - a film studies student.
Her retelling of the day's folklore sparks a curious gleam in his eyes, simultaneously recognizing the unraveling narrative as a thrilling plot for his first horror documentary.

Inspired by the proverbial light bulb flashing above their heads, they decide to traverse New Haven's cobbled streets armed with digital cameras and old-school voice recorders, hunting for locals who could potentially provide first-hand accounts of the legend.
Their path crosses with a peculiar old lady, once an Irish historian, who offers additional insight into the increasingly tangible mythical creature.
Her knowledge, ingrained with the wisdom of ages, broadens their tale by revealing an ancient Celtic ritual to appease the restless spirit.
Under the flickering lights of the apartment, fraught with anxious excitement, they recite the incantation for camera, naively underestimating the power of ancient words.
The sudden disappearance of their documentary footage from Jack's MacBook hard drive is a horror trope come to life, transforming their apartment into a makeshift haunted house.

They mutually decide to split up amidst the panic, Jack making a beeline for the city library in search of further clues while Belle stays behind, pouring over ancient scripts to decode the incantation more accurately.
Formulating a daring plan amidst terror-stricken sprints and echoing whispers, they decide to counteract the spirit at midnight under the looming Harkness Tower.
A nail-biting final face-off ensues, Jack belting out the true incantation while Belle wards off the spirit’s physical attacks with a historically acclaimed defense - a Celtic silver cross.
The challenging journey measures their sanity and stakes their friendship but fortifies their bond.
Drawing strength from their shared terror, they pledge to avoid future supernatural pursuits and attempts to return to their regular, yet empty-feeling college lives.
A curious lecture on Japanese mystic entities in Professor Mark's next class sets the tone for the unexplored tales they would journey into.
While Jack infuses his filmmaking dreams with his appreciation for the supernatural, Belle’s journalistic curiosity continues to find solace in unraveling folkloric mysteries.

The appearance of a peculiar-looking amulet, allegedly associated with an evil Japanese entity, mysteriously materializing in Jack's leather backpack sets off an anticipation for their future encounters with the unknown.

61211146.title: Gretel & Hansel
synopsis: The prologue opens with a story about "A Beautiful Child with a Pretty Pink Hat".
A father takes his mortally ill baby daughter to be cured by a witch, who performs healing spells, bestowing supernatural abilities on the child in the process.
As the girl grows up, the villagers come to hear her premonitions, but her wicked nature is soon revealed when she begins murdering innocent people, including her own father.
The girl is then abandoned in the woods, where she lures children to their death.
The scene shifts to teenage Gretel (who is implied also to possess supernatural abilities and powers) and her younger brother, Hansel.
As their father dies, their mother sends them out to find work.
Gretel is offered a housekeeping job but turns it down when the master of the house asks about her virginity.
Their mother rebukes Gretel for failing to provide for them and threatens to kill both children if they do not leave the house.
The siblings flee and find temporary accommodations to stay for the night, but a ghoulish man appears and attacks Hansel.
A huntsman saves the children and takes them to his home for the night, before sending them off to find work the next morning.
They get lost in the woods and, suffering from hunger, are attracted by the scent of baked cake to a hut in the forest, in which a woman named Holda lives.
She invites the children in for a meal and allows them to stay, in exchange for performing work around the house.
Hansel is sent into the woods to practice woodcutting with an axe, while Gretel assists with housekeeping.
Hansel is happy with their new home, but Gretel is suspicious of Holda and troubled by disturbing visions and nightmares.
Sensing Gretel's abilities, Holda initiates her into witchcraft and teaches her to fly on a broomstick with the aid of flying ointment.
Hansel soon becomes wary of Holda after discovering a satanic pentagram carved into a tree.
The siblings have an argument that night, and Hansel leaves the hut and is then lured into a trap by Holda.
Gretel confronts the witch, who insists she is doing Gretel a favour by getting rid of Hansel.
It is then revealed that Holda was the mother of the wicked girl from the prologue story; Holda loathed her daughter for killing her husband.
After exiling her daughter into the woods, Holda was haunted by the girl's spirit into eating her other children to gain the same powers.
Holda has been luring the children lost in the forest to their death in the guise of an elderly woman ever since.
Holda drugs Gretel and straps her down in the cellar, where she plans for Hansel to be eaten.
Now in the form of a young woman, Holda lures Hansel into a cage atop a large fire pit so she can cook him.
Gretel manages to free herself and uses flying ointment on her hands and face to fly on a broomstick.
Holda is pinned against the wall, where she slowly burns to death over the fire, which brings Hansel to from his drugged state.

The next morning, Gretel assures her brother that Holda is gone for good and sends him back home (their mother is implied to have died in the meantime and Hansel should be able to start working at home as a woodsman).
Gretel stays behind to hone her craft.
She sees the ghosts of the children murdered by Holda, now finally free to pass on, just as her fingertips begin to turn black, like Holda's.

3315721.title: How to Sabotage a Truck: Isabel's Rebellion
synopsis: Isabel, a fiercely independent and rebellious 16-year-old, navigates her first day at Leafmore High School in the secluded and painfully sleepy town of Paynes Corner, Wastingshire.
She is the daughter of the stern Walter, Wastingshire's diligent and unyielding sheriff.
Isabel and Walter’s tumultuous relationship is marred by continual tension.
Mason Stratton, often identified as the local bully, makes his presence felt through his terrifying antics, spreading an air of palpable fear among the town's residents.
Fired up by a potent mix of frustration and unwavering courage, Isabel decides to take a stand against Mason Stratton's reign of terror.
Under the hush of a moonlit night, Isabel shakes up the peaceful atmosphere of the town by audaciously slashing the tires of Mason Stratton's prized pickup truck.
As the break of dawn reveals his vandalised truck, Mason’s simmering rage explodes.
His relentless pursuit unexpectedly reveals that the offender is Isabel, the sherrif's daughter.
News of Isabel's courageous act filters through the narrow hallways of Leafmore High, sparking an uprising against Mason Stratton's tyrannical rule among her fellow students.
As a response, Mason begins to drop ominous threats at Isabel's doorstep.
Walter, finding himself torn between maintaining law and order in Paynes Corner and assuring his daughter's safety, steps up to unveil the perpetrator behind the ongoing threats.
With repeated threats, Isabel and her newfound allies devise a bold plan to bring down Mason's regime, once and for all.
Their plan involves infiltrating Stratton's Garage, Mason's infamous auto repair shop.
As the plan shapes up, Walter unravels Mason's nexus with several illegal operations.
The climax comes to life as Isabel and her team flawlessly execute their daring plan, damaging essential parts of Mason's truck and pulling off a breath-taking narrow escape.
Their actions incite a high-stakes chase, with Mason pursuing the group through Paynes Corner's antiquated, lamp-lit lanes.
Isabel and her team are cornered in a secluded alleyway.
As tension mounts and Mason approaches threateningly, Walter steps out from the dim alley holding up his Colt Python .357 magnum.
With the evidence against Stratton compiled meticulously, Walter manages to unveil Mason's criminal alliances, leading to his immediate arrest.
Isabel’s brave actions not only instil a sense of justice among the oppressed locals but also resolves the heated tension with her father.
Isabel organises a non-violent march as a preventive measure against any potential miscarriage of justice in Paynes Corner.

As the dust of the past settles down, the final scene showcases Isabel fearlessly strolling past a menacing Ford truck near her high school, a reflection of her transformation from a reckless teen to an authoritative figure in Paynes Corner.

71580941.title: How to Blow Up a Pipeline (film)
synopsis: A young woman, Xochitl, cuts the tires of an SUV and leaves a bright yellow one-page manifesto on the window.
In Long Beach, California, Xochitl and her friend Theo witness the devastating effects of climate change.
Xochitl's mother dies during a heat wave in a city plagued by pollution from oil refineries.
Frustrated by the slow progress of their campus divestment campaign, Xochitl expresses a desire for more radical environmental action.
Theo is diagnosed with terminal cancer caused by the pollution, adding a sense of urgency to their cause.
Theo and Xochitl convince Theo's skeptical girlfriend, Alisha, and a number of other individuals, to plot an act of environmental terrorism.

Shawn, a film student who met Xochitl through the divestment movement, introduces the group to Dwayne, a blue-collar Texan with deep resentment towards an oil company that used eminent domain laws to seize his family's ancestral land, depriving him and his pregnant wife of their home.
The team also recruits Michael, a Native American self-taught explosives expert from a North Dakota reservation.
Completing the group are Rowan and Logan, an adventurous young couple drawn to the cause.

United by their shared belief that non-disruptive action is insufficient, the group devises a plan to strategically detonate homemade explosives along an unguarded section of a recently constructed oil pipeline in West Texas.
The pipeline is partially built on Dwayne's land; his intimate knowledge of the targeted area helps the group plan the attack.

They hope that the destruction of the segment will force the company to shut down its Texas operations for a period of time, causing crude oil prices worldwide to spike due to their indexing to West Texas crude.
The group gathers at a remote cabin, where they begin manufacturing explosives and digging up a section of the pipeline.
While executing their plan, the group encounters several setbacks and challenges.

Members of the crew are distracted by alcohol, Michael accidentally detonates a primer charge during preparation, a surveillance drone monitors their activities, and Alisha fractures her leg when a barrel of explosives falls on her.
Rowan and Logan, entrusted to prevent local pollution by shutting off the pipeline flow, find themselves unexpectedly confronted by armed company property inspectors.
Logan successfully distracts them while Rowan completes the task.
In the process, he sustains a gunshot wound.
Despite these challenges, the group successfully blows up the pipeline.
Xochitl broadcasts a triumphant message on Instagram calling others to action.
Following the explosion, the group scatters and Rowan tends to Logan's injuries, removing bullet fragments from his shoulder.
She then discreetly meets with two FBI agents.
Xochitl knowingly included Rowan, an FBI informant, in their plan, enabling them to outwit federal and local police by convincing them that only Theo and Xochitl were involved in the sabotage.
Rowan secures her freedom (having previously faced legal consequences following her involvement in a similar incident) and receives a substantial reward for her information.
Michael, Alisha, Shawn, and Dwayne quickly establish alibis placing them away from the scene.
The police find the cabin where the group had manufactured the explosives just moments after Theo and Xochitl detonate a final bomb inside.
The duo peacefully surrenders as planned.
Theo and Xochitl are sentenced to lengthy prison terms, though Theo dies shortly afterwards.
While the other group members remain free, family members suspect their involvement, federal agents monitor their actions, and they reflect on their decisions.
Finally, another act of sabotage is shown.
Inspired by the West Texas group, a trio of masked individuals plant a bomb in a Miami yacht, leaving behind the same manifesto seen earlier.

92764421.title: Guardians of the Manor: The Paratrooper's Duty (2020 film)
synopsis: As the movie begins, we are plunged into the chaotic turmoil of a World War II battleground, specifically the blood-stained sands of Normandy, France.
Amidst this bedlam, five resolute paratroopers stand as stalwart pillars in the face of adversity.

Leading the group is the seasoned Sergeant John Miller, followed by the resourceful Corporal James Davis, the volatile Private Sam Jenkins, the thoughtful Private Joe Thompson, and the youngest among them, the brave Private Peter Smith.
In the midst of their combative stance, a rusty brown handheld radio device comes alive with an abrupt spur of static.
A military command is conveyed, bearing an order that dictates these soldiers to retreat from their ongoing battle.
They must extricate themselves from the current frontline and delve deep into an intimidating forest close to the German border, known by the locals as Black Forest.
Their mission is a daunting one, to capture a mysterious, heavily fortified Gothic Manor.
Upon arriving at their destination, they are met with an unnerving silence.
They find a solitary old caretaker who warns the soldiers about the Manor's haunted history.
Dismissing his stories as the delirious rantings of a man isolated for too long, the fighting men shrug off his ominous tales.
However, Private Thompson soon gets a taste of the inexplicably supernatural.
Jenkins' sudden disappearance sends the already frazzled group into a desperate search.
Their frantic efforts fail to yield any trace of Jenkins.
Fear grips the squadron as spectral figures start haunting them.
Each soldier is tormented by a different apparition, piercing through their stolid outer shells, driving a stake of ice-cold terror through their hearts.
The bond among the soldiers begins to fray under the relentless supernatural terror.
The common thread of camaraderie that held them together starts slacking, giving way to frantic paranoia and distrust.
Their situation growing desperate, they resort to confronting the elusive caretaker.
The distraught soldiers' pleas leave him no other choice.
The old caretaker begins to narrate the horrific tale of the Manor - a spine-chilling narrative stained by the annals of medieval warfare, brutal tortures, and rampant bloodshed.
Harvesting their dwindling hope, they comb through the haunting corridors of the Manor.
Provoked by the ongoing trespassing, the spirits of the Manor release their centuries-long pent-up rage in a spectral onslaught.
Their resolve and strength, which held them through countless enemy ambushes, now starts to falter under the uncanny paranormal pressure.
One after another, the soldiers meet their doom, leaving only Miller and Smith to withstand the lingering horror.
With hope themselves just an ember now, they formulate a desperate plan.
Amidst their devastating plight, they stumble upon a hidden basement filled with countless decaying human skeletons, a sight that magnifies their already mounting horror.
They carefully bury each skeleton, hoping that this respectful rest might give some sought-after peace to the restless souls.

They call out to the hovering spirits, pleading them to find solace in the respectful burying of their mortal remains, to let go of their anger and sadness, to end the relentless suffering, and finally, to let the Manor be.
As the flames start to engulf the ancient mansion, the last remaining paratroopers claw their way out of the blazing hellhole.
With the vindictive flames receding behind them, they make their way back to their original position, their faces a silent testimony of the horrifying experience they just escaped.
They take a final glance at the smoldering ruins of the once ominous Manor, paying their respects.
The strategic value of the Manor pales in comparison to their torturous experience, as the fiery rubble crumbles, collapsing into a pile of ashes.
Meanwhile, the unforgiving gears of World War II grind on.
Battle cries echo in the far off distance serving as a somber reminder of the struggle still to be faced.
Nestled within the dreary silence of the Black Forest, the charred ruins of the Manor smolder ominously, its once terrifying presence reduced to cinders.
The wind gusts through the ruins, stirring clouds of ash and triggering an involuntary chill down the viewer's spine.
The soft rustling of ash precipitates an underlying sense of unease, as the camera pulls back, revealing the full scope of destruction.
Even in ashes, the entities' restless energy reverberates.
Despite the silence, the movie subtly insinuates that the spectral forces, though silenced, are far from eradicated.

53770442.title: Ghosts of War (2020 film)
synopsis: During the Allied campaign across France in 1944, five troopers of the 82nd Airborne Division are assigned to guard a chateau.
En route they ambush a German-captured jeep, executing the occupants who survive the initial attack, before encountering a group of Jewish refugees.
They arrive at their destination, and the troops they're replacing clear out hurriedly.
Chris, the group's commander, interprets a repetitive banging sound coming from the fireplace as Morse code, which Eugene transcribes as saying "I have no legs".
Eugene later finds a journal kept by a German soldier detailing the fate of the Helwigs, the former owners.
The Germans, having discovered the Helwigs had been sheltering Jews, brutally murdered them by burning the father alive, hanging the daughter and drowning the son in a bathtub.
As Eugene is transcribing another Morse code message, his hand moves without his volition to spell out the message "If you leave, you die".
That night, a German patrol attacks.
The Americans kill most of their number but Butchie is mortally wounded diving on a grenade.
Elsewhere, the men witness some of the Germans being killed by unseen forces in the same manner as the Helwig family.
Before he dies, Butchie rants that what the men are experiencing isn't real and exhorts Chris to "remember".

Convinced that the building is haunted, the survivors leave only to find themselves repeating the experiences that brought them to the chateau - the ambush of the jeep, the encounter with the refugees.
Believing they are cursed and that their only hope is to give the bodies of the Helwig family a proper burial, they return to the chateau.
An invisible force grabs Chris and hauls him towards an outhouse where they find the Helwigs' remains.
After burying the bodies, Eugene consults the diary and finds that the text is no longer German but Arabic and that the Helwigs were Afghan.
The men are then attacked by spirits, one of which tries to drown Chris.

The shock of the experience induces hallucinations before he finally snaps awake and finds himself being attended to by doctors in a futuristic hospital, surrounded by the mutilated and unconscious bodies of his comrades.

Doctor Engel and his staff inform Chris that what he and his comrades had been experiencing is a simulated reality based on World War II intended to help soldiers suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder.
Chris' memories return.
He and his men are not World War II veterans but soldiers of the present-day American military.
Their final mission in Afghanistan was to evacuate a family called the Helwigs, who had been collaborating with the Americans, before an Islamic State patrol ambushed them.
Ordered to hide by their CIA handler, the men watched as the Helwigs were slaughtered in the manner witnessed in the simulation.

As the men left, the despairing mother of the family detonated a suicide bomb and with her dying breath uttered the word "Vetrulek", revealed to be an ancient curse that forces its recipients to endlessly relive their trauma.
Back in the hospital the power fluctuates, confusing the medical staff.
Chris realises that the curse is real and that the spirits of the Helwig family now haunt the simulation that the men are experiencing.
Convinced the only way to lift the curse is to confront the family, apologise and atone for their sins, Chris explains this to the medical staff, and insists on returning to the simulation.
While the medical staff are preparing Chris' reconnection to the simulation, they are confused by the mainframe computer launching deletion of the patients memory.
They shout that fact to Chris, just before the countdown for sending him back, announces five seconds to resume link to the construct.
Finally, the timer reaches zero and the procedure initiates.
He reawakens where his experiences began - camped out at night with his comrades as a figure watches from the shadows.

32201499.title: Eclipse Encounter (2022 film)
synopsis: Alex, a powerful and influential corporate lawyer based in the business hub of San Francisco, finds himself struck with a sudden surge of intense pain around his heart as he gazes at the chilling divorce papers sprawled across his polished mahogany desk.
These damning pieces of paper dictate his separation from his wife, Mia.
Overwhelmed by the catastrophic implications of this life-changing decision, he relinquishes his high vantage point on the 30th floor of the Transamerica Pyramid abruptly.
He permits himself to become lost in the labyrinthine city streets in a desperate attempt to allow the cool winds of the Bay to temporarily alleviate the torment raging within his restless mind.
As he ambles aimlessly down streets both familiar and unknown, Alex discovers a district of San Francisco he'd never explored.
