Almost woefully, his attention is gravitated towards a quaint, locally-run antique shop nestled intimately into the embrace of an inconspicuous alley, its faintly luminescent lights warmly welcoming him under the dim-lit night.

Inside the dusty haven of history, the dominant personality is Luna – a captivating woman whose silver-gray eyes glisten like miniature moons, and who radiates an aura of mystifying secrecy that tugs at Alex’s curious spirit.
Luna, with her alluring charm, showcases an eccentric bronze talisman to Alex.
Captivated by Luna's cryptic allure and the talisman’s silent promise of adventure, Alex finds himself reluctantly drawn to purchase the obscure artifact.

Mere days after his peculiar acquisition, Alex starts to experience gut-wrenching nightmares, each of them painted with foreboding apocalyptic imagery and saturated with haunting feelings of omnipresent doom.

As if his dreams have sprung to menacing life, disgruntling incidents begin to rock his everyday reality; colleagues and friends appear increasingly erratic without previous precedent or discernible cause.
Luna begins to weave herself into Alex’s life uninvited.
His existence becomes ensnared within the talisman's insidious grasp.
Alex can't help but prioritize decoding its enigma over his professional duties.
Simultaneously, Mia starts to grow bitterly resentful of Alex’s strange fixation.
This fuels several bitter arguments between them that only exacerbate the cracks fracturing their frail relationship.
Amidst his exhaustive research, Alex stumbles upon an alarmingly eerie revelation: the talisman pertains to an arcane prophecy that ominously forecasts an upcoming lunar eclipse.
Luna, sensing his distress, admits her true connection: she is the talisman's custodian, sworn to vigilantly safeguard it from those who might harness its powers for destructive ends.
A clueless Mia, drawn towards the talisman's hypnotic allure, stumbles onto it in Alex's apartment.
Without Mia's awareness, she is marked as prey by a shadowy organization.
As the impending date for the lunar eclipse inches ever closer, the atmosphere thickens with tension.
When Mia inexplicably vanishes, the mysterious organization propositions Alex with a thrilling ultimatum: his beloved talisman in exchange for Mia’s safety.
Fuelled by desperation to save Mia, Alex forms a shaky alliance with Luna.
Together, they launch their hazardous mission against the merciless organization.
Working as a united force, they face many nerve-jangling confrontations.
The ever-mounting peril forces Alex to face his unresolved feelings for Mia, strengthening his resolve to safeguard her at all costs.
Luna bravely retrieves the talisman amid chaos, bidding Alex an emotional farewell.
She disappears like smoke, leaving not a trace behind.
The whirlpool of events imparts Alex the clarity to decide to fight tooth and nail for the survival of his agonizing relationship with Mia.
Determined to mend their broken ties, Alex sets forth on a journey of self-improvement, promising Mia a new version of himself that's attentive and understanding.
As life gradually starts rebuilding its familiar rhythm, the couple find that their unexpected encounter with Luna has left deep imprints on them.
In the film's climactic conclusion, we see Luna atop the Transamerica Pyramid, the city sprawling underneath her protective gaze and the talisman in her safekeeping.

68368780.title: Shattered (2022 film)
synopsis: Chris is delaying signing divorce papers from Jamie when he bumps into Sky during a late night shop.
He comes to her rescue by offering a ride when her taxi is cancelled.
On arriving at the motel she is staying at, she hesitates to leave saying that her roommate Lisa is a handful due to drugs and can be disruptive when not asleep.
Chris suggests she could wait at his for a few hours and then he'll bring her back.
After enjoying each other's company for a few hours, they make love and Sky heads to the motel in the morning where Lisa is furious.
Chris finds Sky at her workplace and walking back to his car catches someone trying to break in and an altercation follows.
Due to a broken leg and cast, with Chris's  lack of mobility Sky offers to help care for him.

He gives her the passcodes for his house which is powered and secured by Watchdog a security programme he wrote for his company that his wife had always came first and led to the breakdown of his marriage, even though he had sold it as an attempt to prove it wasn't.
Sky goes to the motel to pick up some things and Lisa suggests she can't move out as she knows things.
Ronald their landlord fed up with excuses on their overdue rent tries to get access to their rooms and with no answer lets himself in and is horrified to find Lisa dead in the bath.
He gives the police Sky's name but they find nobody of those details on file.
On hearing Chris broke his leg Jamie suggests an impromptu visit on Friday to allow their daughter Willow to cheer him up.
Chris feeling more positive and loved up finally feels able to say he'll sign the divorce papers for her to collect as well.
The next day Chris wakes up unable to find his phone but sees on the tv news that Lisa is dead.

Sky arrives with food and won't discuss his phone until after they eat but during the conversation she drops that she killed Lisa and only stayed there 2 months to be able to build up his very specific schedule pattern via a telescope.
Knowing that his cleaner isn't due for a number of days, she locks all the doors via the app on his phone that she took and tasers Chris.
Waking tied to a wheelchair, Sky requests his bank passwords by drilling through his broken leg.
After Sky transfers millions she stops him from attempting to escape by threatening to hurt his daughter.
Meanwhile Raymond is cleaning the rooms, spots and the telescope and spies on a neighbour doing naked yoga then pans around to Chris's house and spots Sky.
It transpires Sky was working with theft attempt man and that the broken leg was on purpose as he enters to begin removing property.
Left alone in the house, Raymond breaks in but rather than immediately helping Chris he blackmails for a reward and in the process of freeing him Sky returns after being alerted on the app.
As she chases Raymond through the house and kills him with a samurai sword, Chris frees the rest of his bonds and escapes on a snowbike but is catapulted off after hitting a rock.
Being picked up  by a driver he finally thinks he's free until he realises he's being driven back to his house to a blood-soaked Sky.
The driver is her step-father Sebastian and they started a relationship after Sky's Mother abruptly died.
She tells Chris that it's a shame he was a con as he's the better lover and Chris says she could have had it all if she hadn't turned out to be a psychopath.
The pair want millions in bonds that need face to face access at a bank and cut-off Chris's thumb so that Sebastian can pretend to be Chris by using a sling with the hidden digit.
Before they leave, Jamie and Willow arrive unexpectedly and get locked into a room with Chris.
Realising Willow is small enough to access a vent to get them out she crawls out.
Once alone, Chris says to Jamie what the thieves are after and Jamie announces the bonds aren't in that safebox as they are now in her private box which means they'll be back soon.
Willow uses the passcode to get into the house just before Sky and Seb arrive back.
Chris and Seb fight but Sky suddenly chooses to shoot Seb in the hope her and Chris can make up.
Chris stabs Sky in the shoulder and grabs the phone and hides.
He sends an SOS signal to the police whilst Sky hunts him and uses the app to access music and lights to distract her.
Sky finds him and during their fight Jamie runs out to assist but also gets hurt.
Just as Sky is about to kill them, they suddenly hear a gunshot and Sky falls to the floor, mortally wounded.
It is revealed that Willow was behind her and shot her in the back.

91259807.title: Hugo (film)
synopsis: During the rugged times of medieval England, an enormous, imposing figure known as Hugo takes his position on the sturdy oakwood scaffold.
Born into the world with a twisted and misshapen body, Hugo's grotesque form provokes terror in the simplified minds of the villagers.
Hugo assumed the role of the town’s executioner, charged with the solemn duty of ending the lives of those convicted by law.
Amidst this, Hugo finds solace in the company of Dupont, a man of pointed wit and perpetual cheerfulness.
While Hugo oversees the gruesome tasks, Dupont, with his sharp mind, excels in dissolving the intense tension that permeates the scaffold.
Their unique camaraderie, forged on the solemn grounds of executions, highlights the juxtaposition of life's often contradictory facets.
Their routine is disrupted unexpectedly when a man named Edmund enters the scene, sentenced to execution for a series of thefts.
Edmund's constant insistence on his innocence and repeated attempts to communicate his plight effectively enlivens their interactions, strengthening the bond between the trio.
As Edmund's execution day draws closer, Hugo, burdened by increasing doubt, confesses his reservations regarding Edmund's guilt to Dupont.
Hugo’s emerging sympathy, paired with Dupont’s ever-present curiosity, drive the duo to undertake a thrilling mission.
They pledge to uncover the truth about Edmund's suspicious charges, risking their reputations in the process.
Their investigative journey takes them through the rustic landscapes of medieval England.
They encounter a myriad of intriguing characters with peculiar mannerisms that add to their tales while enhancing the comic undertones of their expedition.
At one point, they happen upon a tipsy soothsayer, who manages to cryptically prophesy an intricate tale of impending doom, juxtaposed against the promise of redemption.
An encounter with a bemused knight adds an additional layer of complexity to their quest.
He joins their endeavor, providing support but also inadvertently complicating their mission with his eccentricity.
A chance meeting with a vain monarch unravels a secret linked to Edmund's accuser.
The revelation shocks the duo, steering their investigation onto a new, promising path.
Hugo and Dupont muster the evidence necessary to clear Edmund's name.
Their quest is riddled with comedic misunderstandings and blunders, but the groundbreaking revelation comes to light just as the sun rises on Edmund's scheduled execution day.
They sprint back to their village, navigating through a chaotic livestock blockade and meandering through vast seas of wheat fields.
Each stumbling step intensifies the urgency of their mission.
Their arrival at the scaffold sparks an electrifying wave of commotion amongst the spectators.
They hurriedly present the irrefutable evidence that they had gathered, leading to the climactic moment of Edmund's vindication.
The real culprit is exposed, and Edmund is released.
A boisterous celebration ensues.
In the lingering atmosphere of hilarity, the king expresses his indebtedness to Hugo and Dupont with the promise of a grand reward.
However, Dupont's notorious wit and tactless humor offend the pompous royal figure, leading to unforeseen consequences.
Hugo and Dupont leave the castle without the promised reward but with another amusing experience added into their memory bank.
Back at their execution grounds, they jest about their chaotic adventure.
Equipped with shared memories, the duo prepares for the next execution, armed with the refreshing levity of their humorous tales.
The seemingly mismatched trio of Hugo, Dupont, and Edmund derive joy and laughter from their daily lives, discovering humor in the face of their challenging profession.
Their unique personalities occasionally clash with each other, enriching each other.
Despite the many struggles, their friendship deepens, illuminating the potency of their bond.
They stand together at the scaffold, ready to carry out another solemn execution.
Their remarkable journey, undertaken to save Edmund from execution, punctuated by hilarious fumbles and embarrassing incidents.

70634676.title: Quasi (film)
synopsis: In medieval France, Quasi, a hunchback, attends work as a torturer along with his co-worker and "hut mate" Duchamp where they torture culinary student Michel.

Meanwhile, the sinister King Guy is set to marry Queen Catherine in a planned ceremony to unite the kingdoms during Pope Week which is to be attended to by Pope Cornelius, with whom King Guy shares a staunch rivalry with.
During Pope Week, a papal drawing is held, with the lucky winner getting a chance to meet the pope in person.
Out of sympathy, Duchamp gives Quasi a ticket so that he can participate and it ends up being the winning ticket, causing Quasi to suddenly become popular and Duchamp visibly becoming jealous.
Catherine takes an interest in Quasi when he leads his coworkers in a brief rebellion against their boss Lucien and sees potential in him.
Later, Quasi is invited to eat with King Guy where he asks him to assassinate Cornelius, much to his shock.
He tells Duchamp and Michel and admits that he is going through with it or else he will be killed.
When it comes time kill Cornelius, he suddenly orders him to kill King Guy during the union ceremony.
When King Guy sees that Quasi has not killed Cornelius he threatens him, but decides to have the assassination done also during the ceremony.
He tells his assistant Henri that he plans to kill Quasi afterwards, news that his heard by Catherine.
Quasi becomes depressed when he is approached by Catherine who tells him what she heard.
They concoct a plan which Quasi tells Duchamp about.
During the ceremony, Quasi ambiguously attacks King Guy and Cornelius, but Duchamp "kills" Quasi and becomes a hero.
Quasi is whisked away to stay in a cave where Duchamp promises to look out for him.
When he returns to the kingdom, nobody recalls Duchamp's heroic deed and are only saddened over Quasi's death.
Catherine comes to visit Quasi and when Duchamp sees the two of them getting along, he leaves heartbroken.
Duchamp gets drunk and tells Lucien that Quasi is still alive, causing him to tell Henri who comes and captures Quasi to have him tortured.
Catherine sneaks into the dungeon and kills Lucien before freeing Quasi.
The two of them learn that they are both of royal blood and are cousins, news that excites them into having sex.
Quasi escapes and seeks out Duchamp who confesses to outing him.
Quasi escapes the guards while Duchamp is captured and ordered to be publicly executed.
Quasi plans to leave town, but Michel manages to convince him to return and rescue Duchamp.
They arrive at the execution where Quasi outs that both King Guy and Cornelius ordered each other's death and Catherine reveals that Quasi is of royal blood.
A fight breaks out resulting in the deaths of Michel, who in his dying breath asks Quasi and Duchamp to remain friends, Henri and Cornelius' assistant Claude.
The people of France soon rally behind Quasi, not because of his royal lineage, but because they relate to him.
King Guy and Cornelius both fatally stab one another and in their dying moments reveal that they were once lovers at university and broke up due to being cheated on by the same man.
They die admitting that they still love each other.
Quasi renews his friendship with Duchamp before he and Catherine admit their love for each other and become the new rulers of France.

During the credits, Quasi and Duchamp hold a funeral for Michel, who also asked that he have a proper burial so that animals do not eat him, but they have trouble due to his height (he was constantly stretched via the rack).
In a post-credits scene, Michel's hands get eaten by dogs.

35647447.title: Ranchers of the Plains (film)
synopsis: Nestled within the serenity of the weather-beaten Midwest plains, middle-aged ranchers Sarah and Tom begin their routine.
They diligently care for their humble cattle herd, a sight as familiar as the sunrise piercing through the golden cornfields each day, a way of life they have nurtured for over two decades.
Through the relentless summer heat that scorches landscape to the biting cold of winter that paints their world white, they never falter.
On an otherwise ordinary morning, their peaceful routine is brutally interrupted.
The crash resonates across the landscape, an explosive force tearing the tranquil quiet apart.
Driven by a disturbing plume of smoke, curiosity and primal fear wrestling within them, they tread warily towards the aftermath of the unknown event.
At the site, an extraterrestrial artifact lies nested within a fresh impact crater, pulsating with an entrancing, luminous, alien green aura.
Tom, powered by his adventurous spirit and a hint of fear, bravely rallies a hesitant Sarah to inspect the mysterious object closer.
With a careful and trembling, leather-gloved hand, Sarah reaches out to the artifact.
The moment her fingers brush against its cool, alien surface, its dormant state is broken.
It retaliates with a high-frequency beacon, perforating the serene plains with an electrifying pulse, shattering their haven of tranquility.
Its activation doesn't go unnoticed.
The arrival of an unmarked black helicopter, slicing through the quietude of their deserted territory, shatters their everyday calm.
From the belly of the helicopter descends Agent Ross, a sunglasses-clad figure of ominous authority.
His piercing gaze hides behind his dark aviator glasses, a sealed mission briefing held firmly within his grasp, outlining his ominous objective - to weaponize the unearthly artifact.
Since touching the alien object, Sarah finds her reality distorted.
She is thrust into a world of psychic flashes, painting bleak images of an imminent future.
Trapped within the jaws of this unanticipated catastrophe, they outmanoeuvre Ross's surprise ambush thanks to Sarah's newfound clairvoyance.
Twisted into unexpected fugitives, they flee into the unknown, a perilous journey that veers them away from the life they once knew.
Their fugitive lifestyle leads them to Gareth, a figure from forgotten college memories, now an eccentric inventor.
Gareth leverages his cryptic knowledge to break open an unmarked government file, revealing a startling secret.
It points towards a nation-wide placement of alien artifacts, powerful tools from an unexplored world lying hidden in plain sight.
The decrypted information also spins a deadly tale of Agent Ross's malevolent intentions.
By collecting these powerful objects, he harbors terrifying ambitions of constructing unthinkable weapons, while shrouding the existence of these tools within a cloak of secrecy.
Despite the risk, Gareth frames his strategy to neutralize these impending threats.
As he plunges into the document, Sarah is once again haunted by her precognitive visions, warning him of an imminent assault by Ross's forces.
With a martyr's resolution, Gareth pulls a daring diversion, turning their safe haven into a sacrificial lamb.
His ploy allows Sarah and Tom a narrow escape from the fast-approaching onslaught, but at the price of his own freedom.
Not once faltering beneath the weight of the looming threat, Sarah and Tom provoke their fate and take the decision to deactivate one of the disclosed artifacts.
As they probe the vibrant alien device, each component taking them one step closer to its purpose—an incredible revelation thunders upon them.
The mysterious artifacts are designed to be carriers of star maps, extraordinary tools to avert a catastrophic event of alien origin.
With the newfound knowledge, they refocus their objective, pinning down Ross's covert headquarters for their final confrontation.
Their plan is clear - to counteract the timeless, relentless pursuit of the formidable Agent Ross.
Leveraging Sarah's psychic abilities, they anticipate Ross's every move, outsmarting his well-crafted plans of attack.
Using their rugged survival skills, honed over countless seasons on their sequestered ranch, they reroute the course of their fate.
In a daring heist, they wrestle the weaponizable artifact from Ross's claws.
They ingeniously amend the alien artifact and employ it as their shield, their weapon against the impending cosmic disaster.
Victorious but physically strained, they traverse the endless miles back to their dust-blanketed ranch.
Now stripped of his menacing power, a defeated Agent Ross hints at a darker narrative yet to unfold, an intricate web of clandestine networks that remains untouched.
The unsettling notion boils beneath the surface - the threat of unsolved alien artifacts, waiting to unveil chaos, ramps up the doom, yet excitingly sets the stage for further thrilling exploits.
As the enchanting sunset weaves an artistic landscape across their ranch, Sarah and Tom bask in the calm aftermath.
Their shared trials have tightened their love into an ironclad allegiance, a union that will withstand any storm to come.

67922827.title: Foe (film)
synopsis: In the year 2065, a young couple, Hen and Junior, reside on an isolated farm somewhere in the Midwest.
Fresh water and habitable land have become precious commodities, and cities are overpopulated, leaving rural areas slowly abandoned.

One night, a man named Terrance, an employee of OuterMore, a government engineered settlement in the form of a space station, orbiting the Earth, arrives and informs them of a lottery system in place to create a short list of qualified persons to resettle on the off-Earth habitation.

Junior has been selected in the preliminary lottery for relocation and Terrance says the testing process for preliminary candidates takes about two years during which they are expected to continue with their lives.
After Terrance leaves, the couple have a disagreement which they discuss the next night.
They discuss the possibility of Junior leaving as well as the day they met.
Realizing they have missed each other, they make love and Junior expresses he has always been happy and has never doubted their marriage.
Sometime later, Terrance arrives and advises them that Junior has been selected for relocation upsetting Junior.
Terrance tells them Junior will be leaving in two weeks during which Terrance must stay with them to observe Junior.
Hen is upset wondering what her life will be like without Junior.
They continue on with their lives until one day Junior leaves his job and goes to the diner where Hen works convincing her to leave with him.
In an open field, while enjoying the moment together, the couple observe a fire in the distance and Junior begins to run towards it.
They arrive at a farmhouse on fire and Junior is attacked.
The next day, Hen and Terrance tell Junior that he had shoulder surgery as a result of him being injured while two men were burning a old barn.
Terrance tells them he must interview Junior about his daily habits much to Hen's objection.
Junior is put through a series of tests.
During one interview, Hen overhears Terrance asking Junior about his marriage saying that in order to "help" Hen while he's away, his replacement must know everything.
Those selected are to be replaced with AI human substitutes that have the capacity for human consciousness.
Terrance interviews Hen as she expresses regret over doing what was expected of her.
Flashbacks of Hen and Junior's wedding in the rain are shown.
Suspicious, Junior finds a recording of an interview with Hen as well as photos of her.
In the interview, she explains she has lost herself in her marriage and Terrance is heard assuring her that the replacement Junior will be identical.
He is then shown suffocating Junior, but Junior wakes up and joins him in the basement.

Hen and Junior are showing growing closer in their marriage until one day, he discovers that he is the replacement Junior and the real Junior has returned from OuterMore after two years of being away.
Terrance tells Junior that it was never expected that Hen and the replacement would fall in love.
Hen tries to intervene as Terrance euthanizes the replacement Junior much to Hen's horror.

20933693.title: Georgia Detour (film)
synopsis: Alex is a jovial and quick-witted man from Mentone, a humble Georgian village.

Employed at the village's only car wash establishment, he converts any ordinary day into an amusing one with his side-splitting observations and contagiously funny comments about the mundaneness of rural life.
This fun-loving individual was no less than a local celebrity - his lively humor and hidden intellection blending eloquently to leave an amusing impression on the community.
The serene existence disrupted one day when a poised city girl named Sophia, with a vibrant city aura, drove into Mentone, her shiny ruby-red Ferrari glimmering under the sun.
Her sudden arrival stirred a wave of surprise and curiosity among the otherwise peaceful village dwellers.
Sophia's cosmopolitan sophistication was a stark contrast to the laid-back ambiance and amicable spirit of the modest village, creating a sense of excitement among the residents.
Catching a glance of Sophia's dust-covered luxury car, Alex is left longing for an opportunity to bring back its original shine.
He welcomes this break from the usual farm trucks and beaten-up buses he typically deals with.
The first meeting between the two at the car wash made for a hilarious affair.
Their wondering eyes and contrasting worldviews of each other's lifestyles set the stage for tons of laughs.
Sophia left her precious vehicle under Alex's care while she decided to explore the countryside.
She handed him a detailed manual carrying meticulous instructions about how she wished her car to be handled and cleaned.
As soon as Sophia left the scene, Alex’s pals doubled over in laughter as they jokingly visualized the regimented city life of Sophia.
Disregarding Sophia’s meticulous guidelines, Alex, feeling mischievous, decided to use her Ferrari for rip-roaring rides around the countryside, accompanied by his equally audacious friends.

One of the most unforgettable exploits was when they decided to participate in the local county fair's hilarious tractor race, barreling down dirt tracks amid tractors and worn-out pickup trucks in a flashy Ferrari.
Despite the fun, Alex experiences a pang of guilt when he notices minor dents and scratches on the vehicle during their adventurous expeditions.
Things get even trickier when the village gets wind of Sophia's imminent return.
A wave of panicked hilarity swept over the peaceful town, residents imagining her reaction upon finding her fancy car in a less than pristine state.
Meanwhile, Sophia was quickly falling in love with the warm and welcoming nature of the country folk, a deeply contrasting experience she relished, compared to her usual detached city life.
The unhurried pace of Mentone life, along with its intimate festivals, became a source of joy for her.
Moreover, Alex's boundless, hearty laughter made her experience infinitely delightful, making her crave his amiable companionship more and more.
As time passed, a distinct romance began to simmer between Alex and Sophia.
Their love story was infused with humor at every turn, such as the time when Alex attempted a romantic candlelit dinner that quickly escalated into a wild food fight.
As Sophia’s return neared, Alex found his guilt and anxiety piling up over the thought of confessing the damage his merry rides had inflicted on Sophia’s cherished Ferrari.
In an attempt to cover up his blunder, Alex launched into a series of hilarious actions aiming at repairing the car himself, despite his very limited knowledge of automobile mechanics.
On the verge of despair, Alex decided to involve his fellow villagers, who had become invested in his predicament, to secretly assist him in the herculean task of fixing the luxury vehicle.
The whole village came together in a heartwarming display of solidarity, mimicking a clumsy, amateur yet determined pit crew.
Upon her return, Sophia was greeted with her renovated car.
The transformation left her in pure shock and disbelief.
Initially, she felt a swell of disappointment for her once pristine, untouched sports car was now irrevocably modified.
However, anger gave way to understanding as she laid eyes on her unique, handcrafted Ferrari.
The earnest attempts made by Alex in tandem with his heartfelt apology gradually lightened her mood.
Sophia found herself increasingly drawn towards the serene tranquility of Mentone and the joy that Alex's infectious laughter brought into her life.
In an uplifting turn of events, Sophia decided to shed her city life for good and become a permanent resident of Mentone, embracing the simple pleasures of rural life.
A hilarious montage followed her decision, depicting Sophia acclimating to farming chores, partaking in village fairs, and living a wholesome and fulfilling life alongside Alex.
Sophia's revamped Ferrari remains a constant, tangible reminder of the life-altering detour she had the good fortune of experiencing.
The endearing journey of Sophia and Alex unfolds, their lives filled with comic misadventures and instances of genuine joy amidst life's simplicity.
The film wraps up with a memorable scene where Sophia, Alex, and the entire village share a hearty laugh together.

60843917.title: Bad Trip (film)
synopsis: In small-town Florida, Chris is working at a car wash when a woman, Maria, arrives.
Chris tells the man whose car he's washing that she is his high school crush.
He begins to vacuum the car, but the overpowered vacuum sucks his clothes off, leaving him naked.
He panics and hides in the car.
The man has a conversation with Maria, attempting to get her number for Chris, but she declines and leaves.
Chris' best friend, Bud, is working at a computer shop, where his sister, Trina, pulls up in her car.
After having a conversation with two customers, she begs Bud for money, but he refuses.
Although on house arrest, she robs the store and removes her ankle monitor, gives money to the two customers, warning them not to snitch.
Later, Chris and Bud talk about Trina, Maria, and going on big adventures.
One year later, a plumber enters Chris' house and Chris surprises him by rising from a bathtub full of beer cans.
Chris realises he's late and runs to his new job at a smoothie shop, causing chaos along the way.
Maria enters the shop, and they have a conversation, where she reveals she runs an art gallery in New York City.
She gives him her card for the gallery.
Looking at the card causes him to lose focus and accidentally catch his hand in a smoothie blender, splattering blood everywhere.
He later asks advice from an old man, who tells him to follow Maria to New York.
Chris then sings a musical number called "I Saw a Girl Today" to the confusion of everyone around him.
Talking with Bud on the bus, they make the ultimate plan for a road trip to New York.
Chris gets the idea to steal Trina's car, which Bud first opposes, but Chris reminds him that Trina's in jail.
Bud pays to remove the car from impound.
Meanwhile, Trina escapes from jail.
She finds out her car was taken and plans to kill Bud and Chris, stealing a police car to hunt them down.

Chris and Bud wreck a gas station pump, go drinking at a "redneck" bar where Chris vomits uncontrollably and falls off a high ledge after having too many shots, and visit a zoo where Chris is raped by a gorilla after breaking into its enclosure to take a selfie with it.
They later crash Trina's car and get into a big argument, ending their friendship, until an ROTC recruiter tells Chris some words of wisdom.
Chris finds Bud on a bus back to Florida, and they make up, finally making it to Maria's art gallery.
Trina sees her damaged car and finding Maria’s business card covered with Chris' blood, she continues to hunt them down.
After Chris declares his love for Maria, she rejects him before Trina drives through the art gallery wall, attacking Chris with various pieces of art.
Trina chases Chris down, dangling him off the gallery roof, but Bud saves him by finally standing up to her.
She embraces him, proud that he finally stood up for himself.
Chris and Bud return to Maria's gallery, but she is distraught at the chaos and demands that they leave.

The film ends with them deciding to cross-dress as white women at an environmentalist fundraising gala, which they had discussed while reviewing White Chicks earlier in the film, with Trina joining them as a white man.
They perform the DMX song "Party Up" on stage, much to the discomfort of everybody else.
Behind-the-scenes footage plays during the closing credits, showing the reactions of the people who appeared throughout the film upon being told they are part of a hidden camera prank.

759650.title: Transitions (2023 film)
synopsis: Our tale takes place in a lavish, modern penthouse apartment resting in the heartbeat of Paris, home to the main protagonist, Julien, a highly respected Spanish film director.
The apartment, tastefully adorned with art and groaning with books, serves as a quiet monument to Julien's polished, sophisticated Parisian life.

We see him halfheartedly navigating the scattered papers spread over a sleek oak table bathed in soft morning light, his despairing and helpless gaze lost in the maze of letters imprinted on the crisp, untouched pages.
His surroundings echo an unsettling stillness as he wrestles with the gnawing void of his creativity.
The messy assembly of the unfinished script is a stark reflection of his current struggle.
Julien's artistic deadlock, the fear that gnaws at every artist's heart, is palpable as he frantically hunts to quench his thirst for inspiration.
Spending days wracked by an oppressive sense of dread, he finally succumbs to frustration.

In a moment of resigned defiance, he throws the halfway done script into the gleaming silver waste bin, the papers make a soft thud against the cold metal - a sound that ricochets in his joyless apartment.
Determined to inject a new lease of life into his waning creativity, he embarks on a journey.

He tours the bustling, elegant cafes tucked around Parisian streets, and travels through the antiquated towns peppered in Spain, painstakingly scouring for the elusive artistic inspiration that would break the bleak monotony of his life.
The narrative breathes a heart-touching moment when he instigates a video call with his doe-eyed 12-year-old daughter, Amélie, who is currently living in Spain.
Their conversation serves as the only exception to Julien's solitude, a lonespace where laughter and love find its way in.
The dialogues filled with gentle humor and teeming with love portray a beautiful picture of their unusual trans-national father-daughter bond.
The miles between them may be long but cannot sever the invisible thread of love that strings their hearts together.
Yet, buried beneath their love-filled chats lie remnants of Julien's fractured past with his estranged wife Maria.
Every innocent mention of Maria serves as a searing reminder of the relationship he once had sacrificed for his art.
Meanwhile in Spain, Julien's family house seems like a distinct universe compared to his posh French den.
Its rustic charm shrouded in childhood memories is a stark reminder of how far Julien has traveled from his roots.
Vibrant family gatherings reverberate with laughter and lively debates.
This ebullient family image contrasts sharply with his solitary existence in Paris, where he dines silently by candlelight, his only company - the haunting silence of his apartment.
Despite his rustic upbringing, Julien finds it tough to reconnect with his past.
His ties to his Spanish family seem brittle, strained by a gaping absence spawned by years of relentless pursuit of his ambitions in the glitz and glamour of Paris.
As he grapples to straddle his affluent Parisian life with his humble Spanish roots, his inner struggle becomes exponentially evident.
The climax comes crashing down when Amélie, mature beyond her tender years, takes a solo journey to surprise Julien at his Parisian penthouse that soon spirals into an unplanned Spanish trip.
Her firm decision to reunite with her father unleashes a torrent of dramatic turn of events, forcing Julien to confront his long-buried past.
Upon hearing about her young daughter's audacious international trip, Maria, frantic with worry, rushes to Spain, an unavoidable confrontation with the past looming upon Julien.
The result is a tense, uncomfortable family reunion, rife with buried grievances and unspoken apologies.
The torrent of emotions culminates into a storm inside Julien.
He feels crushed under the weight of his tangled life — France and Spain, Maria and Amélie, Past and Present interlocking in a dance of his life.
His simmering emotions explode in a heated argument with Maria.
The fiery quarrel is a bitter manifestation of Julien's escalating personal crises, a dire need for a resolution groaning beneath each syllable.
Amid the turmoil, Julien finds solace in an unlikely source — his young daughter Amélie.
Despite her tender age, Amélie offers an emotional rock that Julien didn’t know he needed.
Amélie exhibits an emotional depth and wisdom that's mature beyond her years.
Her empathy serving as a catalyst that re-ignites Julien's way back to reclaiming self-peace.
His broken spirit gradually stitches itself back together, thanks to Amélie.
A renewed strength reignites within him, enabling him to face his demons head-on.
Inspired by his daughter's compassion and driven by newfound resolve, he starts penning a new screenplay.
Each typing sound echoes as an artist getting reborn, pouring out his experiences and suppressed emotions.
Julien earnestly sets on mending his strained relationships, the task as monumental as reliving past mistakes and seeking forgiveness.
While it may seem tedious, Julien, for the first time, doesn’t shy away from facing the past.
As he braces himself for this emotional journey, the realization dawns on him that his dual identity holds undeniable beauty.
His Spanish roots and Parisian accomplishments have intricately woven the story of his life, a beautiful tapestry of victories and failures.

With a sense of newfound peace and reconciliation, Julien boards a flight back to Paris, holding his newly written screenplay close to his heart, the pages brimming with tales of love, regret, and a resounding resolve.
On arriving in Paris, he rushes to present the story of his life, inked in words, to his professional team.
His narrative depicts his transformation, showcasing a journey towards self-awareness hammered with experiences reaped from his Spanish roots and French life.
The story of Julien's life metamorphoses into a metaphor that casts a path of personal transition, acceptance, reconciliation, and spiritual growth.
Julien strides gracefully into the grand production studio, glowing with the confidence of a man finally in sync with his past.
The triumphant glint in his eyes mirrors his newfound self-love.
As Julien unveils the new script, we see his energetic team waiting with bated breath, ready to delve into a narrative that promises a voyeuristic glance into their director's life.
The closing scene loops us back to Julien's penthouse — this time, the atmosphere thrums with anticipation and determination.
Every corner seems lit with a newfound energy for the imminent transformation of the script into a visual spectacle.
The revelation dawns on the audience that the script defines the narrative of Julien’s own life, a powerful portrayal of his personal transitions, confrontations, and eventual reconciliation.
As the camera fades out, snippets from Julien's life blend and transition into a deeply personal montage.
Each picture holds a memory, a moment from Julien’s past, a defining part of Julien’s story.
The scene focusing on Julien's long-overdue apology to his family marks a turning point, the first step towards rejuvenation.
With the unfolding narrative of the screenplay, the audience witnesses the emotional rollercoaster that Julien has been through.
Every word spills his raw emotions onto the pages — a stark contrast from the stale narrative that once shrouded his creativity.
With the progressive pages, Julien's screenplay morphs into his weapon of redemption, a therapeutic avenue that slowly breaks free from the shackles of his haunting past.
Each penned scene becomes a haunting echo of his trauma, alienation, and eventual catharsis that has defined Julien's mid-life transformation.
He bravely embraces his life, warts and all, pouring them onto a manuscript.
His acknowledgement of his past misgivings underlines the courage and honesty he has finally come to embody.
The merging of his humble Spanish roots with his sophisticated French achievements coalesces into a tale that is as moving as it is relatable.
Julien's apology goes on to symbolize his personal growth and newfound emotional maturity.
The action of accepting his past mistakes and seeking forgiveness highlights an evolving emotional range.
His return to Paris signifies a metaphorical completion of his emotional journey - it's his victorious leap into a carefully balanced past and wonderfully promising future.
Each line of the script adds lifelike vibrancy to his tale.
The universe of emotions he has weathered finds its way onto the pages, a dense emotional journey masterfully embedded in the essence of his words.
Having risen from his confounding past, Julien now stands tall, proudly flaunting the radiant blend of two cultures that shape his being.
As Julien embarks on nurturing healthier relationships, the acknowledgement of their sculpting role in defining his identity becomes profoundly essential.
His flaws are laid bare, and his surprised comfort in the maturity offered by his young daughter provides a unique perspective of his transformation.

As the camera pans across Julien's penthouse, voices talking excitedly about his screenplay gradually fade out, drawing curtains on the story of a brave man who dared to confront his life and laid it bare for the world to experience, understand, and appreciate.

70805884.title: Passages (2023 film)
synopsis: Tomas, a German filmmaker based in Paris, has completed his latest film.
At the wrap party, he meets Agathe, a young primary school teacher, and dances with her after his husband, Martin, an English printer, refuses to dance with him.
Tomas goes to Agathe's home for an after-party, and the two have sex.
Upon arriving home the following day, Tomas, who slept over at Agathe's, admits to Martin that he had sex with a woman and felt something he had not felt in a long time.
Tomas argues that their marriage is deteriorating and enraged by Martin's refusal to discuss it, starts packing a suitcase to leave but is stopped by Martin.
Before leaving, Martin kisses Tomas and assures him they will overcome this.
Later, Agathe visits Tomas at the editing room of his film.
They have sex again.
Tomas and Martin travel to their country house and ultimately discuss their lives together.
Tomas expresses dissatisfaction with their too-comfortable and riskless relationship, while Martin accuses him of falling in love with Agathe.
Back in Paris, Martin meets Amad, a writer and novelist, through a mutual friend at a restaurant.
When Tomas arrives, he is somewhat hostile towards Amad and later tells Martin he finds Amad "an arrogant prick".
As they leave, Tomas claims to be heading to the editing room but goes to Agathe's instead and spends the night there.
In the morning, after Agathe sings Tomas a lullaby from his childhood, he confesses he has fallen in love with her.
Tomas and Martin officially separate, and Tomas moves out of their apartment into Agathe's.
While packing, he stumbles upon Amad's book, which Martin is reading.
On his way out, Martin informs Tomas he will put the country house up for sale, as he does not wish to own anything with Tomas anymore.
Martin begins a relationship with Amad, whom Tomas runs into naked when he uses his key to enter Martin's apartment unannounced; Tomas storms out.
After Tomas turns up at Martin's workplace to share that his film had a negative first screening, Martin asks him for the apartment keys back.
While at a restaurant with Agathe and friends, Tomas sees Martin arrive with friends, but the two men do not speak to each other.

Tomas later comes by the apartment to return the keys, inviting himself to spend the night and come with Martin to the country house early the next morning for repairs, claiming it is his property as well.
At bedtime, Tomas enters Martin's room and they have sex.
In the morning, Tomas reveals to Martin that Agathe is pregnant.
Tomas arrives late to dinner with Agathe's parents at her house.
They interrogate him about his plans to support Agathe and their child, as well as his past with Martin, to which he is hostile and defensive.
Tomas returns to Martin's apartment, telling him that audiences loved the recent screening of his film.
He kisses Martin and invites himself inside.
Tomas proposes that he and Martin raise the baby as a family, confessing he is confused about his feelings for Agathe and misses being with a man.
Martin immediately breaks up with Amad, who says neither Tomas nor Martin will survive the relationship.
Some time later, Agathe, Tomas, Martin, and friends gather at the country house.
Agathe listens to the two men have sex from the other bedroom.
Tomas later climbs into Agathe's bed and embraces her while she is crying.
Agathe severs all contact with Tomas.
She meets Martin for lunch, where she reveals to him that she has undergone an abortion, stating that although she wants a family, she realised she would disappear among the three of them.
Martin holds back tears, and they say goodbye.
Upon returning home, Martin breaks up with Tomas, refusing to accompany him to Venice and telling him to never contact him again.
Tomas stops by Agathe's classroom, begging her to forgive him and inviting her to join him on his trip, but she rejects him as well.
He then rides his bicycle aimlessly through the city.

10751516.title: Storm Fury (film)
synopsis: The film commences with Helen Cho and Lorenzo Martini, two prominent news personalities from South Korea and Italy respectively, alarming the globe of an extraordinary cosmic event.
A nearby star collapses, engulfing Earth in interstellar radiation.
This causes a ripple effect, triggering a series of brain alterations, particularly in individuals with a past of psychopathy.
This previously undocumented genetic mutation spurs the birth of unique supernatural abilities in these individuals.
These unique powers, aptly named "Malefactor" powers, develop uniquely in each affected person.
In the absence of any control methods, these newfound forces wreak global havoc, turning the known world into a chaotic circus.
Among those experiencing this extraordinary phenomenon is Stan Jacobs, a low-spirited insurance accountant nearing his fifties.
Stan spends his days working for the premier conglomerate, Omega Insurance Corp, indifferent to the world around him.

Stan's humdrum existence takes a wild turn when he's charged with the Herculean task of managing a rapidly growing number of insurance claims resulting from the worldwide pandemonium caused by Malefactors.
Adding fuel to the fire is Stan’s ex-flame, Marlena, a tempestuous former pop icon.
She has recently developed her own Malefactor abilities that allow her to manipulate music to her will, immediately scheming to suspend the alimony payments to Stan.
Her cunning orchestration adds further disruption to Stan's spiralling life.
His struggle to manage the crisis and his personal finances grows more intense and complex with every payment she dodges.
Realizing the need for a team, Stan ropes in unlikely allies: a burly ex-bouncer with hands as hard as steel, and a quick-thinking college intern whose wit is as sharp as a razor.
They form an intriguing trio, their diversity and friction creating an amusing dynamic.

Together, the newly formed team embarks on an eccentric journey to curb the unprecedented chaos, with an unusual weapon of choice – exploiting insurance regulations to deal hefty fines to the misbehaving Malefactors.
Throughout their battle, they cross paths with a myriad of Malefactors, each brandishing wilder and zanier abilities than the one before.
They encounter a man whose touch turns anything into cabbages, a teen who can teleport people randomly, and a mischief-maker whose flippant wrist-flick can strip anyone naked.
Stan’s unorthodox method of countering the Malefactor menace with insurance penalties garners media attention, pushing him unexpectedly into the limelight.
His growing popularity earns him the ire of Marlena, who out of spite and schadenfreude, plots a grandiose plan designed to bring about Stan’s public downfall.
Meanwhile, unbeknown to Stan, Emily, a charming radiologist, enters his life.
Emily, herself harboring a Malefactor ability to alter her physical appearance, finds herself increasingly drawn to Stan.
Their blossoming relationship is tainted by Emily's secretive attempts to prevent her powers from being detected, fearing the dreaded insurance penalties and Stan's law-abiding nature.
Humour and adventure lace the storyline as an ultimate confrontation brews between Stan’s team and the resentful Marlena.
Stan masterminds a cunning strategy exploiting his profound knowledge of insurance loopholes to combat Marlena’s chaos-inducing plans.
Stan’s ingenious plan leads Marlena into unwittingly filing an expensive insurance claim to cover the damage of her destructive plans.
The claim activates a specific clause in her extravagant insurance policy, effectively binding her music-controlling powers to the claim, thus taking away her powers.
Stan’s plan is successful, restoring much-needed order and justice to a world teetering on the brink.
The reign of the Malefactors dwindles under the effects of Stan’s well-crafted insurance management strategies.
Stan's innovative handling of the Malefactor crisis earns him worldwide respect and prominence.
Riding on his success, Stan devises an exclusive insurance plan for Malefactors, marking the dawn of an era of tight regulation and management of their powers.
By his side in his crusade is Emily, who finally comes out to the world about her Malefactor abilities, ushering in a newfound understanding and acceptance of Malefactors across the globe.
Emily’s candidness leads to a wave of empathy and acceptance amongst the public for the misunderstood Malefactors.
The narrative comes full circle with Helen and Lorenzo, now reporting about Stan's remarkable achievements and the return of balance in the world.
In a final unexpected twist, Lorenzo unwittingly spills the beans on live TV about Stan's impending marriage to Emily, his formerly clandestine Malefactor girlfriend.
Lorenzo’s unexpected reveal leaves the audience in a gale of laughter, ending the riotous, high-stakes film on a joyful and heartwarming note of comedy and optimism.

61882494.title: Thunder Force (film)
synopsis: In 1983, Earth was subjected to cosmic rays that gave sociopaths superpowers, resulting in a rise of supervillains known as Miscreants.
With no one able to stop the Miscreants, normal people are usually left living in fear of them.
After a Miscreant kills her geneticist parents on their way home from work, Emily Stanton becomes determined to find a way to stop Miscreants.
By 1985, Emily has sacrificed much of her social life in favor of researching ways to fight back against Miscreants.
While this results in her being bullied, Lydia Berman stands up for her and becomes her best and only friend.
Lydia supports Emily's dream of giving superpowers to normal people, though she tries to make sure that Emily does not overwork herself.
When Lydia convinces Emily to take a half-hour nap from studying, Emily accidentally oversleeps and wakes up late for an AP exam, straining their relationship and causing them to drift apart.
In 2024, Emily and Lydia have gone their separate ways, with Emily becoming a successful scientist and researcher for her own company and Lydia becoming a longshoreman.
Lydia tries to reconnect with Emily when their high school reunion comes around.
When she fails to show up on the night of the reunion, Lydia concludes that Emily is still uncomfortable attending parties by herself and goes to pick her up.
Emily tells her that while she would have liked to go to the reunion, she had forgotten when the reunion was and had a project she had to work on that night, which Emily wants to show to Lydia.
Unfortunately, Lydia accidentally injects herself with a serum Emily had been working on.

Having been injected with the serum, Lydia learns from Emily that the serum was designed to give a normal person superhuman strength and that she would have to undergo special training and treatment so the serum does not kill her.
Emily also joins Lydia in the treatment, although a less painful one since Emily took the serum in a pill form to earn the other superpower concocted, invisibility.
Lydia discovers that in the years since their high school graduation, Emily had a daughter, Tracy, with one of the researchers, who could not handle the responsibility and left them.

Once they finish their training and treatment, Emily and Lydia foil a liquor store robbery run by a Miscreant with crab arms known as the Crab, who falls in love with an equally smitten Lydia, much to Emily's concern.
Emily and Lydia, now known as the superhero team Thunder Force, are praised for their heroics.
This brings Thunder Force to the attention of mayoral candidate William Stevens, whose campaign is built on the idea that only he can end the Miscreants' crimes.

With the help of Laser, a Miscreant who can generate and control whip-like energy beams, Stevens tries to get Thunder Force to work for him, leaving Chicago at the mercy of the Miscreants unless he wins the mayoral election.
Thunder Force continues to fight crime with their superpowers and support the rival mayoral candidate, thereby causing Stevens to lose the election.
Stevens then sends Laser to attack Thunder Force at a diner.
When she tries to get away, Lydia throws a bus at her despite Emily's protests.
Though nobody is hurt, Emily decides that Lydia's impulsiveness is too dangerous, again straining their friendship.
In an effort to make amends, Lydia goes on a date with the Crab to get some useful information.

From him, Lydia learns that Stevens is planning on blowing up everyone who did not vote for him in the election, along with the new mayor, at a party he's hosting under the guise of celebrating the new mayor.
She tells Emily of what she learned and they reconcile.
After fighting off Laser again, Thunder Force go to stop Stevens from bombing the building.
When they find the bomb, Stevens decides to fight Thunder Force himself, revealing himself to be a Miscreant with superhuman strength, significantly stronger than Lydia.
Before Stevens can kill Lydia, the Crab double crosses Stevens and gets his claws broken off.
Tracy also joins the fight, having injected herself with her mother's serum, giving her the ability to run at superhuman speed.
Though they manage to defeat Stevens, Thunder Force realizes that the bomb will go off before they can disarm it.

With no guarantee that the bomb would be stable enough to not go off while Tracy carries the bomb to somewhere safe, Lydia decides to sacrifice herself, knowing that she can at least reduce the impact of the explosion.
She jumps out of the building with the bomb and dives into the Chicago River, seemingly dying in the explosion.
However, the paramedics manage to find her body and resuscitate her.
Thunder Force, now with Emily and Lydia's friendship even stronger, are offered the assistance of the city's resources by the mayor, which they accept.

17537834.title: Unexpected Arrival in the Capital
synopsis: Living amongst the undulating hillsides of Tuscany, Italy, Ellie, a charming 24-year-old woman resides in a beautiful villa, a haven of love and warmth provided by her adoptive parents.
Her radiant green eyes illustrate a tale of yearning, briskly moving over a variety of dusty photographs and signature Asian trinkets, triggers to her native roots in culturally vibrant Japan.

Online, Ellie has managed to establish a moving connection with her biological brothers from whom she was separated during the adoption process, but who now express a profound eagerness to revive their lost relationship.

Her communication with them is heartfelt and relentless, manifested through weekly love-filled handwritten letters and video conversations that draw them together across the deep trenches of geographical distance.
Haunted by the questions surrounding her past, Ellie resolves to meet her siblings face-to-face and return to her ancestral home, a picturesque town tucked in tranquil Japanese countryside.

Holding her Singapore Airline boarding pass tightly in her trembling hands, the anticipation of embarking on this life-altering journey bubbled within her, her dreams brimming with visions of her much-awaited reunion.
Strangely, before Ellie could board her flight, news of a destructive earthquake in her birth town came to her notice, forcing her plans to change drastically.
Ellie's plane was rerouted to Tokyo, the bustling capital city with its skyscraper-studded skyline, a striking difference from the rural charm of her original destination.
Completely out of her element, Ellie found herself in the heart of Tokyo — a city pulsing with life, its towering structures and radiant cityscapes overwhelming, yet strangely fascinating.

As she tread on the labyrinth of Tokyo streets, encountering distinctive Shinto shrines, savouring the rich flavour of ramen, and the sound of the Japanese language, fragments of her early childhood memories seem to steadily coalesce.
Under a whirlwind of circumstances, she chanced upon Lily, a compassionate BBC Asia journalist who showed her kindness in an izakaya bustling with local chatter.
Lily offered Ellie a cot in her cosy Tokyo apartment, a safe haven nestled in the beating heart of the lively city.
Touched by Ellie's resilience and her quest to uncover her roots, Lily offered to use her network to unveil the truth about Ellie's birth parents.
While Lily pursued leads, Ellie explored the procedural aspects of Tokyo; her curiosity led her to landmarks like the famed Tokyo Tower, and the vibrant Tsukiji Fish Market.
Each bite of the traditional tempura, each local folk tale she heard, enhanced a growing emotional bond with her homeland.
After weeks of rigorous searching, Lily provided Ellie with potential information about her birth parents living conditions—a secluded traditional Japanese farmhouse.
The knowledge filled Ellie with an overwhelming wave of contrasting emotions, including fear, excitement, anticipation, and deep-seated uncertainty.
Ellie's profound reunion with her birth parents in their authentic tatami house, while brimming with an array of emotions, also bore moments of profound joy.

Heartaches filled the space as Ellie's birth parents, their eyes shining with regret, uncovered a tale steeped in hardship, battle with lethal diseases, and the consequential disconnection they felt towards Ellie and her siblings post their adoption.
Ellie was left aghast by the grim reality of her birth parents' life of hardships, her heart ached with the realization of her parents' physical state and the absence of her siblings.
Reflecting upon the whirlpool of unpredictability that had become her life, Ellie realized that her life had taken an unbeknownst turn.

Ellie was caught in the web of her life's dichotomy; the one she lived amidst the Tuscan vineyards and the one that was bound to the rural tranquillity of Japan, thereby invoking a mélange of guilt, gratitude, and self-realization.
Ellie, to Lily's absolute surprise, took charge of her new reality—she decided to reside in Tokyo, to provide a comforting presence to her birth parents in their twilight years.
Despite all hurdles, their brother-sister bond elevated Ellie's spirit, filling her with the unshakeable resolve to gather the dispersed fragments of her original family.
Her newfound mission ignited a spark in Ellie, as she found herself aboard a Singapore Airline flight once more, crossing the mighty Pacific to return to Japan.

But this time, her objective wasn't just to reunite with her family, but the added challenge to convince her brothers to return to their homeland, to witness the desperate state of their birth parents.
The story concludes with a symbolic close-up shot of Ellie, her eyes radiating a composed calm, providing evidence to her newfound inner peace.
A warm, content smile graces her face as she gazes out of the airplane window, watching the city lights shimmer underneath.
Ellie's reflection encapsulates a sea of emotions—happiness of finding her roots, acceptance of her past, and determination to craft a promising future for her fragmented family.

71003625.title: Return to Seoul
synopsis: Twenty-five-year-old Freddie, who was born in South Korea and adopted by French parents, arrives in Seoul "by accident" after her flight to Tokyo is cancelled.
She bonds with Tena, the desk clerk at her hotel, and sleeps with a man she meets with Tena in a restaurant.
Tena and a friend of hers tell Freddie she can only contact her biological parents through the Hammond Adoption Center.

Although Freddie first insists that she is not in South Korea to find her parents, she goes to Hammond and learns that the agency can send telegrams to her parents, who can respond and allow Hammond to arrange for a rendezvous or ask Hammond not to contact them again, a request Hammond must honor.
Freddie asks them to send the telegrams.
When her father responds, she travels to Gunsan to visit him, with Tena serving as their translator.
Freddie is initially uncomfortable, but agrees to stay three nights with her biological father's family.
Afterwards, her father calls Freddie and sends her text messages declaring his regret for giving her up for adoption and promising a new life in South Korea.
Freddie finds his relentless attention oppressive and stops responding.
She goes to a bar with Tena and the man she slept with on her first night in Seoul, whose declarations of love she cruelly mocks, making Tena uncomfortable.
As they are leaving, she tries to kiss Tena, who rejects her and tells Freddie she is "a very sad person".
Freddie tries to return to her hotel with the DJ from the bar, but is confronted by her drunken father, who scolds her for ignoring his attempts at contact and scares off the DJ.
Tena then suddenly appears, but her father ignores Tena's attempt to speak to him and as her father grabs hold of her arm, Freddie screams at him not to touch her and leaves.
Two years later, Freddie is living in Seoul.
She goes on a date with André, a weapons dealer, who tells Freddie that she would be good in his industry.
Freddie tells him that it is her birthday, and that every year on her birthday, she wonders if her mother is thinking about her.

At a surprise birthday party thrown for her, she reveals to a co-worker who is also an adoptee that her mother has finally responded to several follow-up telegrams to say she is not interested in meeting her.
It is revealed that Freddie's father still emails her, but she largely ignores him.
Freddie tells her co-worker to contact Hammond, but her co-worker says she is following advice to learn about the Korean culture and language beforehand.
Five years later, Freddie speaks broken Korean and works with André selling missiles.
On a business trip to South Korea, she goes with her French boyfriend, Maxime, to meet with her father.
Her father plays her a piano tune that he wrote and performed, and Freddie is surprised at how it moves her.
She becomes annoyed at Maxime when he says to her father that it is Freddie's destiny to help defend South Korea from North Korea.
After dinner, she breaks up with him, heads to the entertainment district, and wakes up the next morning alone in an alley.
Freddie learns that her biological mother has responded positively to another telegram from Hammond, sent by a sympathetic employee in violation of policy.
Freddie and her mother meet at a Hammond facility and Freddie weeps as her mother embraces her.
Her mother gives Freddie her email address so they can stay in contact.
A year later, on her birthday, Freddie arrives at a hotel seeking a room.
She writes an email to her mother apologizing for not contacting her earlier, and says that she thinks she is happy.
The email fails to deliver as her mother's email address is no longer valid.
Freddie goes to the hotel lobby and notices a piano with sheet music.
She sits down and attempts to sight read the music, hesitantly at first, but soon producing a beautiful melody.

6059194.title: Talisman: The Discovery (film)
synopsis: Jake, a retired army colonel scarred by the ravages of war, had secluded himself from the hustle and bustle of the world, choosing instead the tranquility of Sherwood Reserve, a dense, almost impenetrable forest.
During one of his solo endeavors, he stumbles upon an antiquated, desolate station shrouded in forestry - its presence so discreet that it feels like a secret the woods have nurtured.
Inspired by the allure of the unfamiliar, Jake begins exploring the derelict structure, its desolation adding a thrilling element to his mission.
His investigation yields an unexpected discovery, an ancient silver talisman hidden beneath a decayed wooden floorboard.
It glimmers ominously in the feeble sunlight filtering through the broken windows.
Captivated by the talisman's design and apparent antiquity, Jake unsuspectingly tucks it into his pocket.
The chill of the artifact against his hand and the faint pulsating energy emanating from it intrigue him, but he chooses to ignore these peculiarities, dismissing them as mere quirks.
Not long after acquiring the mysterious talisman, Jake begins experiencing terrifying nightmares, each bone-chilling dream exponentially worse than the one before.
These culminated in spectral whispers that seemed to reverberate within the shadows of his subconscious, a soft yet commanding voice gently enunciating his name, "Jacob."
From the corner of his eyes, he starts to perceive mystifying shadow figures.
Quiet whispers with no clear source infiltrate his solitude, yet instantly disappear when he turns to search for them.
Then, on a particularly frost-bitten night, a phantom voice rises from the depths of the forest.
The chilling echo calls his name in a tone that grows progressively ominous and demanding, type of call that makes hair stand on end and breath stop short.
But Jake, hardened by his military past, chooses to confront this unsettling mystery rather than abandon his chosen sanctuary.
He takes it upon himself to uncover the root of these extraordinary occurrences, suspecting that they have something to do with the peculiar talisman he'd found.
His inquisitive nature inspires him to delve into the artifact's history deeper, hoping to shed light on his disturbing experiences.
The artifact’s origins reveal a dark history; it was once a symbol of supreme power wielded by an unholy spirit.
History painted the spirit as a ruthless figure whose reign was filled with fear and untold suffering.

Jake surmises that his action of displacing the talisman from its original resting place might've invoked a dormant, ghostly curse, thereby inviting a series of supernatural incidents that he now found himself in the midst of.
After days spent pouring over obscure texts, he comes across an obscure reference, an arcane book that reveals the solution to his predicament.
He must return the talisman to its hidden sanctuary within the dilapidated station.

His resolution to end the supernatural terror is tested upon receiving an ominous call from a group of ruthless treasure hunters who seem to be on the talisman's trail, having sensed its phenomenal energy.
Jake finds himself in the eye of two converging storms - one, a tangible threat posed by the relentless treasure hunters, and the other - the spectral terror that arises from the talisman's presence.
His days devolve into carefully masking his movements from these treasure hunters, while relentlessly suffering nightmarish visions and mind games played by the malevolent spirit.

Determined to overcome, Jake develops an elaborate plan to misdirect the marauders while simultaneously charting a path back to the station within the Sherwood Reserve, effectively orchestrating a return for the haunted talisman.

Taking a deep breath, he embarks on his chilling mission back into the depths of the forest, his only companions being his undying courage and the vile artifact, a powerful, malevolent force resting ominously in his pocket.
As he journeys deeper, he faces numerous phantom-led onslaughts from the treasure hunters.
Their attacks are ruthless, revealing their desperation, and they resort to intimidation and mind manipulation to throw Jake off course.
The malevolent spirit doesn't win him any respite either.
It intensifies its mind-twisting renditions, inducing severe paranoia, making Jake question his reality, thereby testing his sanity to its breaking point.

Engaged in a battle for survival, Jake utilizes every ounce of his military training and survival skills to outwit his foes while battling the mind-altering illusory world spun by the malignant spirit.
The pressure from every quarrel strengthens his determination, fueling his mission to put an end to this cryptic nightmare once and for all by returning the talisman to the woeful station.
Enhancing every step with grit and valor, Jake finally finds himself standing once again in the dreaded, haunted station, the relentless force of the curse palpable, its weight bearing down upon him.
With hands trembling from exhaustion and nerves, he carefully positions the talisman under the dilapidated wooden floorboard from where he had retrieved it.
He senses an immediate shift in the atmosphere, the ominous darkness ebbing away.

As the ancient artifact securely reclaims its original spot, the wrathful spirit begins to dissolve into the ether, and the constant torment that has plagued Jake cease, giving him a hard-earned respite from the supernatural.
Now free from the spectral horrors, he breathes a sigh of relief, laced with a hint of lingering anxiety.
This exhalation echoes peacefully through the now tranquil forest, a poignant epitaph to his haunted journey.
His journey victorious, Jake makes the solemn choice to leave behind Sherwood Reserve.
Its horrific visions can now become distant memories.
His thirst for adventure dampened by his unnerving encounters, he fosters an appreciation for mundanity that he'd previously scorned, choosing tranquility over adrenaline-fueled exploits.
War-ridden and curse-challenged, his body craved a consistently peaceful, serene life away from the lurking specters and hidden horrors of the world.

As Jake left the forest's embrace, the wind, now free of foreboding whispers, faintly sang a gentle farewell, the rustling leaves akin to a comforting lullaby: "Wander away, noble warrior, to brighter places."
He slid into his weathered Ford pickup, gripping the old steering wheel.
His sigh, laden with relief and trepidation, filled the interior before he turned his back to the enigmatic forest forever, eager to leave behind its chilling memories.

As his beloved truck carried him away from the forest's perimeters, he spent the journey reflecting on his nerve-wracking, supernatural trek and deciphering the profound lesson he'd learned; interfering with forces beyond human comprehension is best avoided.
He yearned for a nondescript life, craving the welcome monotony he'd left behind when he'd shed his army uniform.
This longing for an 'ordinary' existence overrode his adventure-seeking spirit.
As Sherwood Reserve receded in his rearview, becoming a speck in the distance, he found a newfound resolution to reject his thrill-seeking past.
He set his heart on a new beginning, determined to leave behind every shadow of his former life.
Burying his haunted past, Jake focuses on his mundane daily routine, and contented himself with his newfound placid existence.
Choosing calm over chaos and willingly exchanging horror-stricken nights for peaceful slumbers, Jake conceals his harrowing past beneath the promise of a hopeful future.
Jake finds joy in ruminative strolls along the beach, kind sunsets, and the rhythms of everyday life, choosing peace over thrills.
Underneath the soft lights of his new home, he let out a sigh of bliss, finally free of the fear and anxiety that had once threatened to consume him.

60880471.title: Amulet (film)
synopsis: Ex-soldier, Tomaz, unearths an amulet at an outpost in the woods.
It becomes apparent that this is where he was stationed in his former country, which he eventually escaped to make it to London.
Tomaz periodically has flashbacks to this time and Mirian, a woman who took shelter with him after he spared her life when he caught her trying to pass the border.
In London Tomaz works as a day laborer while sleeping in a derelict building with other refugees.
When the building is set on fire, Tomaz is forced to flee suddenly in the night.
Unable to breathe from the smoke, he collapses in an alley way and is discovered by Sister Claire, a nun.

After visiting him in the hospital she suggests a better way of life for him and takes him to a house, explaining that a woman living there, Magda, needs help with the house upkeep as she cares for her dying mother.
As she walks away, she is seen throwing Tomaz's money (which he thought lost) into the sewer.
Magda makes it clear she doesn't want Tomaz there and he too is reluctant to stay.
However the two grow accustomed to one another and Tomaz tries to perform repairs.
When trying to fix the water pipes Tomaz discovers a live albino bat clogging the toilet.
He kills it, but not before it bites him.
Tomaz eventually sees Magda's mother, whom she keeps imprisoned in the attic.
Though she is extremely ill she attacks Magda in front of Tomaz and he becomes protective of her.
He takes her out on the town, fulfilling her wish to go out dancing all night if she was free.
Later on, returning home Magda and Tomaz see her mother giving birth to one of the bat like creatures he sees on the toilet.
Tomaz goes to consult Sister Claire, and she tells him that the mother is a demon and that she and Magda have been charged with keeping it contained for years.
Tomaz returns to the house, determined to kill the demon and save Magda.
However after stabbing the demon in the throat it bites and attacks Tomaz only to be stopped by Magda.
Tomaz then flashes back to his time with Miriam.
Developing a crush on her he urges her to stay with him until the end of the war and protects her from fellow soldiers.
However after discovering her trying to leave in an attempt to reunite with her daughter, he chases her and rapes her.
Awakening in the house, Tomaz, determined to protect Magda, returns and attacks the demon.
Once he beheads it he realizes that the host body was actually that of the previous occupant of the house, a man who murdered his wife with the intent to marry one of his own children.
Sister Claire explains that he is now the new host and asks him who he wants to be his guardian.
He demands that Magda watch over him.
Later, Tomaz is sick.
As his stomach begins to move, he too gives birth to one of the creatures.
Later, Magda drives up to a convenience store where Miriam is working the counter.
After making sure that Miriam is all right she drives off and throws some food in the back where Tomaz is hiding under a blanket.

79997875.title: Jane's Sojourn: Shadows of Extremism
synopsis: Our story sets in the heart of downtown Chicago, where our lens narrows to focus on an old, dilapidated cargo warehouse.
It is home to Jane, a resilient 19-year-old runaway who managed to turn the desolate area into her clandestine sanctuary.
To survive, Jane must rely on her skills and resourcefulness.
She's remarkably created a homemade spear which she skillfully uses to hunt rats for food, underlining the extreme circumstances of her survival.
On quieter days, we see Jane curled up within an old moth-eaten blanket.
In the silence, memories crowd her thoughts, haunting her with the loss of her father, who was cruelly snatched away by a vicious extremist organization, the Red Scorpions.

The narrative gently guides us through Jane's grim life in the crumbling city, narrating how she smartly dodges foster homes and government-run orphanages, choosing instead the instinctual preference to provide for herself.

During her many daring forays, Jane stirs up intrigue in Maria, a kind-hearted 50-year-old grocery store owner, who recognizes the puzzling enigma of Jane's life and the adversities she fights every day.
Maria, deeply moved by Jane's unfortunate circumstances, steps forward to provide shelter.
She warmly invites Jane to share her modest, two-bedroom apartment.
After Jane agrees to live with Maria, she learns Maria's past as a vigilante named 'Shadow Cat', serving dual-purpose of providing security and a peek at her intriguing past.
The plot pivots to the hideout of the Red Scorpions, where their internal conflicts almost match their ominous plan to take over the major infrastructures of the city.
Jane's unfortunate fate intertwines with the Scorpions again as they discover her existence, identifying her as the daughter of their old enemy, subsequently plotting revenge against her.
Jane discloses her violent past and the looming danger posed by the Scorpions to Maria.
Maria, inspired by her old days as 'Shadow Cat', assures Jane of her unwavering support and transforms her apartment into a bunker-like safe-house.
Jane and Maria create a network of traps to defend against their pursuers.
Jane stumbles upon a flash drive offering damning evidence against the Red Scorpions and their plans for the city.
They launch a relentless pursuit to apprehend Jane and stifle the threat she has unwittingly become.
Jane and Maria formulate a plan to deliver the damning evidence into the hands of authorities.
Their efforts eventually connect them with Detective Clark, an old comrade from Maria's vigilante days, and a pivotal figure in the Chicago police department.
The climax of our story lands Jane directly across Draco, the ruthless and unforgiving leader of the Red Scorpions.
A fierce battle erupts between Jane and Draco.
Jane uses her quick thinking to outmaneuver Draco until a SWAT helicopter spotlights the scene from above.
The climax culminates in the capture of the unmasked Red Scorpions, and Jane is recognized for providing the damning evidence.
Jane returns to Maria's safe home, surveying the familiar surroundings with a different sense of security and belonging.
Jane takes a step forward, recognizing Maria's home as her permanent dwelling.
Jane learns to trust and depend on others, forging a deeper emotional connection with her newfound guardian.
Jane finally lets herself feel safe, a momentous personal victory over her past trauma, signaling a much-needed healing process.
The film concludes on a hopeful note, with Jane starting anew.
The next steps of her journey focus on healing and finding elements of normalcy amidst the chaos.
The camera retreats to reveal the captivating image of Maria and Jane, exhibiting the unorthodox bond that has formed between the two and their combined triumph over the Red Scorpions.
