Max's ex-husband Roger gave her the Rattigan Theatre in their divorce settlement and she announces the theatrical production presently in place of the play Isabel Ascendant will be halted for one month so Mike Lane can choreograph a special dance production.
As Mike and Max discuss the logistics of this show she has come up with, her teenage daughter Zadie arrives.
Distrustful of him, she explains that her mother tries to reinvent herself every few years.
Auditions for potential dancers are soon underway.
An actress from the original show Isabel Ascendant shows up, wanting to participate.
This inspires them to rethink the new show with elements of the original, so they cast her.
Going to dinner with a few of Max's London contacts, Mike feels out of his element, and Max’s friends say she will never divorce.
Later on, in the car, when Max moves toward physical intimacy with him and he pulls back, it upsets her.
The next day in rehearsal, she is excessively critical of his choreography.

Max and Mike build a temporary extension of the stage, so the show has a much more palpable feel, but the City of Westminster threatens sanctions due to alterations to the historical building without prior approval.
They persuade the only woman on the board, Edna Eaglebauer, to support the show.
As she lives a quiet life alone, they fill her morning bus with the men from the show.
Edna gets her own sample, as the 10 men do a flirty, choreographed number just for her benefit.
She gives them her seal of approval.
Mike and Max argue about the ending of the show.
She wants him to personalize it and finish with a happy ending.
She also would really like him to dance in it, but he reiterates he is retired and will not go on stage.
The show gets shut down again, so Max confronts Roger.
He reminds her that their separation agreement includes a clause that she does not tarnish his family name.
After Max tells Mike to return to the United States, he gets the keys to the theater through Victor and rehearsals resume secretly.
The show is not open to the general public, but rather by invitation only, as Zadie taps into her mothers' contacts.
Sunday evening arrives, and Victor and Zadie drag Max out for the show she believed she had shut down; even Roger is invited.
The opening act starts the same as Isabel Ascendant, but the protagonist is offered only two possible life choices, marry the rich aristocrat or the poor one with a heart of gold.

So, she calls her imaginary friend from her childhood, the unicorn, breaks the fourth wall and then talks about modern feminist ideas about what choices women should be afforded, using a golden mic that drops from above.
Then Isabel's male counterparts strip off their formal attire and the other dancers are presented one by one.
They have sexier and sexier numbers until the last few.
After a lap dance number for three of the more mature audience members, Mike partners with a ballet dancer for the final number.
The piece, set in the rain, is reminiscent of moments shared between him and Max.
Once the show is over, Mike finds Max and they kiss.

53909526.title: Higgins (2022 film)
synopsis: As the golden hues of New York City in 1939 cast a shimmering light onto its towering structures, Jack Higgins, a seasoned private investigator with a sharp intellect and a keener eye roams the grimy streets.
One particular day, however, the monotony is broken by Olivia Sterling’s sudden appearance.
The mystery is as dense as the city's fog: her wealthy boyfriend, Adrian Collins, a rising star of the motion picture industry, has inexplicably disappeared.
Sensing the desperation in Olivia's voice, Jack eagerly agrees to lend his expertise.
His pursuit leads him to the grandiose fortress of Adrian's creativity, the renowned Atlantic Motion Pictures.
As Jack drifts deeper into Adrian's murky world, he encounters an alarming realization: perhaps Adrian did not merely vanish but chose to abscond willingly.
Suddenly, in a gripping twist, a movie prop, a relic from the film sets of Atlantic Motion Pictures, surfaces at a chilling murder location.
The frightful possibilities shake Olivia to her core, pitting her loyalties to Adrian against the mounting pressure of alarming revelations.
Realizing he's teetering on the brink of the law's intolerance and stepping into the mafia's crosshairs, Jack must balance his drive to uncover the truth with ensuring his as well as Olivia's safety.
Olivia makes a courageous commitment to aid Jack in his relentless pursuit.
United against the looming shadows of the mafia, they follow the tangled, menacing path of the criminals.
Their shared brushes with danger solidify Olivia's trust in Jack and augment her role in their increasingly hazardous mission.
Their relentless pursuit concludes at a seemingly abandoned warehouse, where they find Adrian caught in the ruthless clutches of the Mafia attempting to orchestrate their wicked games.
Olivia manages to surreptitiously alert the local police station, signaling the den of the mafia.
The exhilarating climax sees Adrian handcuffed and taken into police custody, met with the inevitable prospect of a trial for his coerced involvement in the art theft scheme.
Olivia grapples with the sting of Adrian's deceit.
However, Olivia discovers a beacon of hope in Jack’s dogged pursuit of the truth.
His unwavering integrity inspires a newfound respect in her heart.
With one more case added to his tally of solved mysteries, Jack, true to his calling, eagerly awaits the next perplexing enigma that the city would present him.

Olivia, her apprehensions replaced by an acute recognition of life's grim reality and appreciation for her newfound inner strength, dares to anticipate a fresh start, her once naïve worldview now replaced by seasoned, hard-earned wisdom.
New York City in 1939 absorbs yet another sprawling saga of deception, love, and personal transformation into its insatiable maw.

67894564.title: Marlowe (2022 film)
synopsis: In 1939 Los Angeles, private detective Philip Marlowe is hired by glamorous heiress Clare Cavendish to find her missing lover, Nico Peterson, a prop master at Pacific Film Studios.
He quickly learns that Peterson is dead, having been killed after falling down drunk before a car ran over his head outside the exclusive luxury Corbata Club.
Marlowe visits Cavendish to tell her of Peterson's demise, also meeting the Pacific's owner, Philip O'Reilly, the soon-to-be Ambassador to England.
Cavendish reveals she has seen Peterson since his supposed death, driving past her in Tijuana.

Annoyed at her withholding this information, Marlowe goes to leave, running into Cavendish's mother, film star Dorothy Quincannon, who fails to learn what service Marlowe is providing to her daughter.
Marlowe visits Peterson's grave and encounters a mourning woman but she escapes before he can talk to her.
Marlowe convinces his friend, homicide detective Joe Green, to open a murder investigation now they know the body was not Peterson's.
Green admonishes Marlowe for his relentless pursuit of the truth and reveals that the body was identified by the Corbata Club owner, Floyd Hanson.
Marlowe meets with Hanson at the club, the pair failing to extract information from each other.

While leaving, Marlowe notices the woman from the grave, Peterson's sister Lynn, and clandestinely agrees to meet with her at the Cabana club later that evening; their discussion is observed by Hanson.
When he arrives, Marlowe is assaulted by two men but beats them unconscious.
Quincannon tries to hire Marlowe to find Peterson for her instead.
She reveals that her contentious relationship with her daughter is because she spent many years pretending Cavendish was her niece on the advice of O'Reilly, her former lover.
Quincannon's former private investigator had learned that Peterson was also acting as a talent agent for actress Amanda Toxteth.
Toxteth tells Marlowe that Peterson was a serial womanizer and regularly imported cocaine from Tijuana.
Out of leads, Marlowe breaks into Peterson's house and encounters Lynn before the pair are attacked by two Mexican men looking for someone named Serena.
Marlowe is knocked unconscious while Lynn is taken captive.
On waking, Marlowe is taken by drug lord Lou Hendricks and his henchman Cedric.
Hendricks reveals he is after Peterson, his former drug courier, who stole a large amount of cocaine and the Corbata helped fake Peterson's death.
Marlowe has his officer friend Bernie Ohls begin searching for Lynn, while Cavendish visits Marlowe to seduce him; he rejects her advances but shares a dance before she leaves.
Marlowe secretly follows her to a rendezvous with O'Reilly, and runs into Quincannon who shares her anger at her daughter's relationship with the much older and powerful O'Reilly.
The following day, Ohls takes Marlowe to Lynn's body, revealing she was tortured and raped before being killed.
Ohls traces the Mexicans to the Corbata club and gives Marlowe his unofficial support to infiltrate the club and avenge Lynn.
Marlowe confronts Hanson who offers him a drink, but suspicious Hanson poisoned it, Marlowe throws it away and feigns that he is dying.

Convinced he is dead, Hanson has his men take Marlowe's body through the hedonistic areas of the club to a secret area where the Mexicans have been killed, Hendricks is being tortured, and Cedric has been restrained.
Under torture, Hendricks reveals that Serena is actually the mermaid statue Peterson placed in the adjacent fish tank and it contains the missing cocaine.
Marlowe frees Cedric and the pair kill Hanson and his men, inadvertently destroying the mermaid and the drugs.
Cedric also kills Hendricks after being told he will be indebted for years to repay the value of the drugs.
Cedric decides to work with Marlowe so they can look out for each other.
Marlowe returns home to find Peterson waiting for him.

Peterson admits he does not feel guilty about Lynn's death because of her association with him, and asks Marlowe to tell Cavendish to meet him in the studio prop house for information he has gathered about O'Reilly.
The fake Peterson was a musician who resembled Peterson.
Peterson meets Cavendish and reveals his extensive records of every drug deal performed through the prop house with Hendricks, believing it will destroy the reputation of the studio and O'Reilly.

As Marlowe arrives, Cavendish betrays Peterson, shooting him and setting both him and the evidence on fire, immolating the prop house, intending to use this deed to earn favor with O'Reilly and become vice president of the studio.
Marlowe witnesses this but decides not to sell out Cavendish, confiscating her pistol.
Cavendish offers Marlowe a job as the studio's head of security but he declines, instead recommending Cedric.
He also gives Cavendish's pistol in Cedric's hands as the film ends.

82086527.title: Highway Haunting: Maiden of the 80s
synopsis: In the stillness of the Wyomland night, devoid of any trace of moonlight, Sarah, a 25-year-old woman running from her turbulent history in Boston, hurriedly packed her belongings into her worn-down 1967 Chevy.

Navigating the desolate expanses of Highway 140, her heart pounded with nervous anticipation each time her weary eyes caught sight of an ominous-looking, 1940s style Buick Roadmaster tailing her in the rear-view mirror.
Similarly, trucker Tony noticed the same Buick in his rear-view mirror.
Sarah, in fear, tried to lose the Buick by making erratic maneuvers, but the Buick stubbornly mirrored her every action.

Tony attempted communication with the Buick through his CB radio, but his calls were met only with intense static and the faintly audible, melancholic voice of a woman serenading the lyrics to Billy Ocean's nostalgic hit - Caribbean Queen.
On the road, unsettling images began plaguing Sarah's mirror.
The faintly visible figure of a woman accompanied by her voice haunted Sarah in ways that were eerily reminiscent of her deceased mother.
Tony conversed with other truckers on the radio and heard about a local legend tied to Highway 140 - a woman had disappeared, and her ghost was said to haunt lonely travelers.
When Sarah's car stalled, Tony pulled up to help her.
They began to draw parallels between their experiences and the local folklore.
As the song Caribbean Queen played on Tony's radio—Sarah froze, remembering it was her mother's favorite.
They realized they were encountering the spectral singer who was Sarah's mother.
United by this supernatural incident, they decide to face the phantom and lead the ghostly Buick to St Mary's Chapel - famed for exorcising restless souls.
Their confrontation was intense.
Sarah spoke directly to her spectral mother, her words guiding her mother's disturbed spirit towards release.
The ordeal over, Sarah was left grappling with the reality of her mother's past.
This revelation served to strengthen her resolve to uncover this hidden mystery, a final homage to her departed mother.
Tony and Sarah emerged from the chapel as daylight washed over the Wyoming sky.
Their burdens somewhat lighter, they decided to embark on a new mission to unearth the secrets from their past.
Eventually, the spectral Buick started to lose its presence, disappearing until nothing was left.
In the aftermath of the haunting, the spirit found peace, and the highway resumed its everyday, mundane character.
Under the glow of the newborn sun, they embarked on their new mission, unwavering in their determination to unearth the secrets hidden deep within their pasts.

60755404.title: The Little Things (2021 film)
synopsis: One night in 1990, a teenaged girl drives on a highway, stalked by a motorist.
After stopping at an abandoned gas station, she catches the attention of a passing truck driver and escapes her pursuer.
Some time later in Bakersfield, Kern County Sheriff's Office Deputy Sheriff Joe "Deke" Deacon is sent to the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department to collect evidence pertaining to a recent murder.
A former LASD detective, he accompanies recently appointed lead detective Jimmy Baxter to the scene of a new murder in L.A. Deacon notices similarities between the M.O.
of the killing and the M.O.
of an old serial murder case he was unable to solve.
That night, a woman named Ronda Rathbun is followed by a car while jogging and is reported missing the following morning.
Baxter learns from Captain Farris that Deacon had gotten divorced and suffered a heart attack due to his obsession with the unsolved case.
So, he is advised not to involve him any further but Deacon takes vacation leave from his station to assist in solving Baxter's case.
The next night, the police discover the body of another victim washed up beneath a bridge.
Baxter learns the M.O.
is consistent with the earlier murder and others: the victims were all sex workers who were stabbed to death.
Deacon begins investigating Albert Sparma, a suspect working at a repair store in proximity to the murders.
He tails him but is thwarted, so he takes him in for questioning.
While under interrogation, Sparma taunts the detectives and is released after provoking Deacon into an angry outburst.
The young woman pursued in the desert is interviewed but has seen Sparma in handcuffs at the police station which compromises her eligibility as an objective witness to identify him as a suspect.
The FBI will take charge of the investigation within the week, giving Deacon and Baxter less time to resolve it.
Farris informs Baxter that eight years prior, Sparma confessed to a murder which he couldn't possibly have committed and is thus an unlikely suspect.
Baxter and Deacon nonetheless continue investigating.
Sparma's fingerprint is similar to the killer's but not a definitive match.
Their next move is an illegal search at Sparma's apartment.
With Baxter standing guard outside, Deacon unsuccessfully searches the apartment for incriminating evidence, only finding newspaper clippings related to the cases.
Suddenly Sparma's police scanner goes off and Deacon hears an "officer down" alert for this very address.
As police converge on the building, Deacon narrowly escapes over the roof, with Sparma watching his ordeal and casually waving his hand at Baxter.
While surveilling Sparma, Baxter corners the suspect alone and demands to know Rathbun's location.
Sparma offers to drive him to where he supposedly hid Rathbun's body.
Baxter cautiously agrees while Deacon secretly follows.
Sparma takes Baxter to a remote area in the desert and has him dig several holes before telling him that he never killed anyone.
Skeptical, he continues digging.
Sparma begins to taunt him until Baxter snaps and strikes him in the face with the shovel, killing him.
As Deacon arrives, a flashback reveals that he accidentally shot the one survivor of his last murder case and that Farris and Dunigan, the coroner, helped cover it up.
Deacon instructs Baxter to bury Sparma in the desert, while he spends the night collecting everything in Sparma's apartment and disposing of his vehicle.
Then he returns to the desert the following morning to find that Baxter has not buried Sparma but is instead still searching for the victim, desperate to believe he is the killer.
Deacon (whose waking dreams are haunted by the earlier victims) advises Baxter to forget about the case or it will haunt him for life.
Later, at his home, Baxter receives an envelope sent by Deacon, containing a red barrette like the one Ronda Rathbun was wearing when she was abducted.
Back in Kern County, Deacon burns everything he collected in the apartment, along with a brand new pack of barrettes that is missing the red one.
Then, he walks away.

80654675.title: Lottery Haven
synopsis: John, a battle-weary veteran and the owner of a charming, rustic lottery shop nestled in the calm surroundings of Haven, a quaint town situated in the serene countryside of Montana, increasingly feels disillusioned and restless with the routine monotony that has become his life.
His restlessness intensifies, prompting him to seriously consider selling off his beloved shop.
Before he embarks on his intended journey, he chats with the town's elder, Agnes - a delightfully eccentric lady legendary for her uncanny predictive abilities.
With a stern look on her wrinkled face, she cautions him about a long-forgotten evil that may be tied to his wooden lottery machine.
John dismisses Agnes's eerie warnings with a nonchalant chuckle.
On his last evening in Haven, John's friends organize a heartfelt goodbye party at his childhood home, a log cabin filled with the fresh scent of pine.
Amidst the unforgettable celebration, the new owners of his shop, a vibrant young couple from the city brimming with ambition, pull John aside to share unsettling news.
They've noticed eerie, cryptic messages occasionally flashing across the screen of the vintage lottery terminals at the shop.
The town is shaken by the mysterious disappearance of the recent lottery winner, Bill Hayes.
John remains firm in his decision to leave.
As John sets off on a cloudy morning, the town is further gripped by panic as more lottery winners vanish under mysterious circumstances.
The local law enforcement urgently requests John to return to Haven, given his unique and exhaustive understanding of the lottery terminals.
John is plagued by a series of disturbing dreams and terrifying visions linking back to his old shop.
Wrestling with an uncanny sense of dread and apprehension, he grudgingly admits that he might have accidently stirred a sinister entity that is now wreaking havoc amongst his familiar townsfolk.
Overwhelmed with dread and guilt, he makes the difficult decision to return to Haven.
Back in Haven, he reunites with Sam, a childhood pal who is now a dependable local cop.
Together, they form a formidable team ready to unravel the ominous mysteries ensnaring their once peaceful town.
They discover a long-forgotten secret of Haven.
The town had once served as a sanctuary for banished supernatural beings.
They find out that the malevolent spirits haunting the recent lottery winners were once imprisoned in John's old lottery machine.
By selling the shop, the balance had been disrupted, freeing the spirits.
The innocent-looking lottery balls transform into blood-curdling spectral projectiles, attacking the brave group assembled in the shop.
The missing lottery winners start reappearing, horrifyingly transformed into nightmarish versions of their most profound fears.
The death toll starts to rise.
Martha, the town's beloved baker and motherly figure, falls prey to the supernatural onslaught.

Emboldened by his sense of responsibility and the town's dire state, John galvanizes everyone around him, instilling in them renewed hope and determination to reclaim their town from the spectral tormentors.
They come face to face with the primary evil spirit, which has assumed the human form of Bill Hayes.
Relying on his vast knowledge of his store's history and the folklore surrounding it, John comes up with a daring plan to re-imprison the spirits back within the lottery terminals.
As the confrontation pushes John and his team toward their limits, they bravely fight against these formidable entities in a gripping face-off.
Amidst the ensuing intense chaos, John barely manages to trap the spirits back into the machine, restoring a temporary sense of peace in the town.
Surviving the ordeal and unearthing the depths of his resilience, he reconsiders his decision to leave and chooses to stay back in Haven.
Life in Haven gradually returns to normal, and John finds charm in what he once found mundane about the town.
But as this tale of fear and courage comes to an end, a soft, unnatural hum and a glow from John's veteran lottery machine indicate that the peaceful times might be temporary.

66979614.title: Bingo Hell
synopsis: A man named Mario comes home, having just sold his bingo hall.
Seemingly in a daze...he dances around to the tune of classic Spanish music playing on vinyl.
He begins speaking to himself, and then a picture of his dead wife Patricia about the sale.
He says  he can fulfill his promise of leaving "this place".
He puts down a suitcase of money, and begins to greedily eat a serving tray full of bingo balls.
An ominous voice coaxes him on, until he chokes to death.
An elderly woman named Lupita walks around Oak Springs one morning and meets up with her friend Clarence (who owns an auto repair shop).
Lupita then goes to see her hairdresser, Yolanda, whose electricity is being fixed by Morris.
Morris is not able to fix it because he says he doesn't have the right tools and leaves.
Cut to Dolores, who is mad at her daughter-in-law Raquel for not providing proper discipline for her grandson who has been breaking into cars and getting away with whatever he wants.
She is also angry at the daughter-in-law for not doing her part and being irresponsible around the house after moving in when her husband died.
Dolores then goes to Yolanda's and meets up with Lupita who is already there.
They have a discussion about Caleb, and Lupita brings up the similarities with Dolores's son who has died and takes issue to it.
After an awkward silence, Lupita apologizes and Dolores accepts begrudgingly before Lupita leaves.
Lupita goes to a bingo game at the local bingo hall, but they finish up when they realize Mario has not paid his electricity bills.
The next day, Lupita and her friends find flyers around town saying that the bingo hall is under new management.
Lupita, Morris, Clancy, Dolores and Yolanda decide to take a look at it and realize that the bingo hall has been transformed into a casino.
While there, Dolores spots Raquel, who wins ten thousand dollars from the owner, Mr. Big.
The next morning, Caleb and Dolores find that Raquel left them with her money.
Raquel arrives at a motel, where she begins to rip off the straps of a dress.
However, standing behind her is Mr. Big, who makes her hallucinate it while in reality she is using her fingernails to rip off her flesh.
Lupita breaks into Mario's house and finds his corpse, before realizing that she hallucinated it.
They go back to the bingo hall, and this time Clarence wins one hundred thousand dollars.
That night, Clarence parties by himself next to his car, drinking a bottle of beer, not realizing that he is actually drinking motor oil.
He then sticks his arm into a car motor, violently shredding it and eventually killing him, not seeing the shadow of Mr. Big inside the car.
Lupita finds Clarence's body and sees Morris talking to Mr. Big, who gives him a stamp on his hand which begins to disintegrate.
Lupita realizes the entire Oak Springs have been lured into the bingo hall, and heads there with her shotgun and with Eric.
Caleb tries to break in, blaming the place for his mom's disappearance, but Eric catches him and chases him inside.
Mr. Big confronts him and then makes Eric stab himself in the neck with a poisoned syringe, before killing him by stomping on his skull.
Lupita tries to get the residents to leave but Mr. Big begins to crush her head against a podium, before Caleb shoots him in the back.
Lupita destroys the TV and the residents attack Mr. Big, brutally beating him, until Lupita cracks open his head with the butt of her shotgun.
Caleb sets fire to the money and they escape, leaving Mr. Big to burn.

69043517.title: Into the Contagion
synopsis: The setting of our story unveils within the technologically advanced, steel-and-glass structure of a biotechnology laboratory, vibrating with the hum of modern scientific equipment.
The protagonist, Dr. Daniel Ross, a well-respected virologist, is engrossed in his work, scrutinizing a glass slide with a virulent strain of swine flu under a high-resolution electron microscope.
Suddenly, the shrill, startling blare of his encrypted cell phone echoes through the lab.
The call shimmers onto Daniel's dedicated crisis hotline, a channel reserved exclusively for the most pressing events, those pertaining to urgent pandemic or bio-threat scenarios.
Without delay, he answers the call, and as he listens to the intense voice on the other end of the line, his skin acquires a ghostly pallor.
His prompted response— to report immediately to the heart of American defense, the Pentagon's classified biodefense laboratory.
The reason being — a mysterious virus that is spreading at an alarming rate across the nation, requiring his specialized skills and critical judgement.
With a sense of celestial doom hanging heavy on his heart, Daniel exits his lab.
At his quaint, rustic New England-style home, he imparts the intimidating news to his companion, Emily.
She pleads with him to stay, her apprehension barely masked by her stoic demeanor.
Although inside, a tumultuous storm is stirring, Daniel reassures Emily of his imminent return.
Bearing the weight of impending danger on his sturdy shoulders, he embarks on his formidable journey.
Upon reaching the facility, he is immediately met with scenes of chaos.
Halls lined with patients are writhing in the throes of an unknown sickness.
Daniel is aghast at the sight of hundreds of distressed victims, each ensnared in the merciless grasp of a disease yet to be distinguished or understood.
He then is introduced to his new team members — an assembly of the finest minds from varying scientific fields.
Despite the thick atmosphere of fear, the newly knit team plunges into a fight against time.
They devote every waking hour in an attempt to decipher the lethal pathogen that had taken the world by surprise.
In tandem with the evolving calamity, Daniel is plagued by a profound sense of guilt.
He is haunted by the thought of abandoning Emily and their two young children during such a global emergency.
His sole comfort comes in the form of evening FaceTime conversations with Emily and their kids.
But every time his iPhone chirped with the notification of another incoming call, his heart clenches a little tighter.
As the number of infected individuals surge, the disease's stranglehold extends into the very lab tasked to vanquish it.
Amidst this turmoil, Daniel stumbles upon a potential breakthrough—an aberrant protein structure in the virus that could potentially pave the path to a solution.
The storyline takes a terrifying spin when the rogue pathogen breaches the lab’s strict biosecurity protocols.
The situation deteriorated rapidly, turning the once controlled environment into a place of dread.

The lethal virus now lurks ominously around every corner, rendering every moment within the contaminated facility a game of Russian roulette, where each spin of the cylinder could lead to a fatal consequence.
As the tale ascends to its final peak, Daniel finds himself the only one remaining.
The humble virologist transform into a lone warrior, pitted against a formidable enemy—a faceless, remorseless disease.
Working tirelessly within the isolation of his lab, the now lonely man concocts a potential vaccine—the turning point.
As the virus starts to compromise his well-being, Daniel, with sagging strength and a ceaseless will to survive, injects the experimental antidote into his system.
Now begins his perilous journey back home—navigating through the sterile confines of the abandoned lab, now tarnished by the lethal invisible adversary.
He carries with him a cooler containing vials of the life-saving serum—with it, a glimmer of hope for the chaos-stricken world outside.
The story crescendoes into a poignant climax showing Daniel, now startlingly gaunt, set against the backdrop of what remains of a forsaken city.

His face, a disquieting blend of weariness and relentless resolve, is shockingly contrasted with the decay around him—a desolate urban landscape with the occasional weed sprouting through cracked asphalt.
He stumbles on, clutching a cooler—his beacon of hope—in one hand.
As the sun, now a dull ruddy glow against the smoky haze, begins to set, he forges ahead.
The serum he carries is more than a potential cure—it is a lifeline, a bulwark against the all-encompassing tide of desolation that has turned the world upside down.
He strides forward, solemnly clutching the vials containing the prospective cure.
His haggard shoulders, weighed down by the collective grief of a world in crisis, still carry the hope for countless lives lost in the struggle with an invisible enemy.

65776092.title: In the Earth
synopsis: Martin Lowery is a scientist sent to a government-controlled outpost while an unspecified pandemic has ravaged the country.

The outpost is located in an unusually fertile forested area outside Bristol to help in the studies and experiments of his former colleague and ex-lover Olivia Wendle regarding using mycorrhiza to increase crop efficiency.
After passing a physical examination and meeting his park guide Alma, he learns of the local legend of Parnag Fegg, a woodland spirit.
The following morning, Martin and Alma begin their two-day hike toward Olivia's site.
Alma informs Martin that Olivia has not been heard from in months.
The pair come across an abandoned tent, with the remaining items indicating it belonged to a family.

The next night, Martin discovers a rash on his arm before he and Alma are assaulted by unknown assailants who also raid their camp, destroy their equipment, steal their shoes, and loot some of their supplies.
Without his shoes, Martin badly cuts his foot.
They are approached by Zach, a man living in the woods who offers to lend the pair some shoes.
Taking them to his own campsite, Zach disinfects and stitches Martin's wound and gives them both food and a drink.
Martin and Alma begin to lose consciousness and realize they have been sedated.
While they are unconscious, Zach takes ritualistic photos of them in strange clothes and positions and stitches a strange symbol and animal gut into Martin's arm.

Upon waking up Zach describes the symbol as a mark to be seen by a presence in the woods, claimed by him to have once been an ancient sorcerer who placed his essence in a standing stone somewhere in the forest.
Martin's foot becomes infected from his injury and Zach sloppily amputates some of his toes with a hatchet.
Alma acquires a discarded blade to free herself and Martin before attacking Zach.
Martin and Alma flee, but become separated.
Zach pursues Martin, who stumbles across a pair of bodies, presumed to be the owners of the abandoned camp.
After encountering the standing stone, Martin is found and rescued by Olivia.
Alma independently makes her way to the camp, and Zach is driven away by the amplified sound and lights set up around Olivia's site.
The next morning, Olivia cauterizes Martin's foot as she explains her project.
She reveals that Zach is her ex-husband, and that the pair were following the directions of a centuries-old book on local legends.
He had been helping her to try and communicate with the presence inside the stone, using the lights and noises from an electronic soundboard, but disapproved of her approach and left.

Unable to trust Olivia and fearing that Zach is still after them, Alma tries to convince Martin that they need to leave, but he will not be drawn on the nature of his relationship with Olivia and she refuses to abandon her research.
The next morning, the site is surrounded by a thick mist containing fungal spores, trapping them.
They send Alma through the mist in a hazmat suit, but the spores make it through her protective clothing and subject her to horrifying visions.

That night, the mist continues to close in on the site as Zach arrives, telling them to communicate with the standing stone using the sounds and lights as well as to consume a "sacrament," a mixture of ground mushrooms alluded to in the book.
Martin agrees to drink the sacrament and waits for it to take effect.
Zach ambushes Alma and prepares to sacrifice Martin.
Alma makes her way back to camp, where she finds Olivia in her tent surrounded by staged photographs of her and Zach's victims.
Olivia attacks Alma, but she fends her off.
Zach hears their struggle and rushes back to camp, where Alma kills him.
She then pursues Olivia back to the standing stone as the mist overtakes the camp, and they are all subjected to more visions from the spores.
By morning, Alma and Olivia suddenly find themselves far from the stone, broken out from their trances.
Olivia, overcome with awe, collapses on the ground.
Alma then approaches a waking Martin by the stone and, speaking with a distorted voice, she offers to guide him out of the woods.

50066860.title: Women (2022 film)
synopsis: The movie opens on a somber note - it's the funeral of Emily's husband, John Thompson.
In the aftermath of her loss, Emily is engulfed by an ocean of loneliness and longing.
She decides life can't go on in the same way and a drastic change is required, both for her environment and self.
Captivated by the charm of England's small, secluded towns, Emily decides to relocate to Dunster.
Upon her arrival in Dunster, Emily is greeted by welcoming smiles and hearty hellos as the friendly, down-to-earth locals take her under their wing.
They take delight in sharing the charm of their unique customs, traditions, and ancient folklore with the newcomer in their midst.
The local folklore possesses an enchanting tale of a group of witches rumored to have lived in Dunster.
One moonlit evening, during a stroll around the village’s quiet lanes, Emily discovers an ancient bronze amulet concealed within the gnarled roots of an age-old oak tree.
Captivated by its intricacy and charm, she decides to keep it as a souvenir of her time in Dunster.
That very night, she begins hearing mysterious whispers and is plagued by a series of alarming events in Dunster.
Soon, she is plagued by nightmares featuring the witches from the town's ancient tales.
Unable to continue dismissing these unnerving occurrences as figments of her imagination, Emily confides in the Dunster locals.
The villagers, alarmed by Emily's recounting, link her experiences to the dreaded witch legend they were brought up with.
Fear spreads through the village like wildfire, and in their panic, the villagers project their fear onto Emily, leaving her ostracized from the community.

Driven by a growing sense of desperation, Emily sinks her teeth into the historical records of Dunster, uncovering long-forgotten secrets about the witches' practices, discovering that the amulet she'd found played a pivotal role in the witches' reign.
She finds herself under the influence of this supernatural curse and Dunster transforms into a catastrophic nightmare as the witch's vendetta is fulfilled.
In a fleeting moment of clarity amidst her tortured existence, Emily discovers a forgotten manuscript detailing how to defeat the witches.
Exhausted, she embarks on a perilous mission to destroy the amulet and the witches' reign.
As terrifying events rage on in Dunster, the villagers come together to resist the onslaught.
Finally arriving at an ancient burial ground described in the manuscript, Emily attempts to destroy the bronze amulet, sparking a struggle between herself and the witches.
After an exhausting battle, Emily manages to shatter the amulet.
The subsequent implosion forcibly disperses the witches, banishing them into nothingness and bringing a chilling calm over Dunster.
The townsfolk, shocked but relieved, offer their gratitude to Emily, who’s now not only a mourning widow but also the savior of their village.
Inspired by the villager's unity during the crisis, Emily decides to call Dunster home permanently.
She slowly begins steering her life back on track, her newfound power aiding her in the healing process.
The film concludes with Emily reintegrating into Dunster's life, her brave act making her a part of Dunster's history.
Her image in the eyes of the villagers has transformed; someone they once feared and ostracized has become an emblem of hope and bravery.
Emily’s perseverance ignites a wave of hope, love, and unity among the Dunster residents, rejuvenating their spirits.
Deciding to make a home out of a place where she faced her biggest nightmare is a testament to Emily's unmeasurable bravery.
As the movie nears its climax, Emily's life in Dunster emerges as a sanctuary of peace, portraying her as the resilient warrior who survived to share her tale.
The movie ends with Emily's incredible story continuing to resonate within the calm confines of Dunster.

67204851.title: Men (2022 film)
synopsis: Following the apparent suicide of her husband James, Harper Marlowe decides to spend a holiday alone in the Herefordshire village of Cotson.
Flashbacks reveal that Harper, tired of James's emotional abuse and manipulation, intended to divorce him, leading James to threaten her with his suicide.
After James punched Harper in the face, he immediately attempted to apologise, but Harper angrily locked him out of the flat.
She then witnessed him fall from an upstairs balcony to his death, being partially impaled by a fence.
Upon arriving at the country house she is renting, Harper is greeted by its eccentric but well-meaning owner, Geoffrey, who gives her a tour of the house.
Harper later goes for a walk in the nearby woods and comes across a disused railway tunnel.
At the other end, a human figure begins screaming and running towards her.
Frightened, Harper runs back through the forest until she reaches an open field.
She turns back to photograph the landscape on her phone and notices a naked man standing in the distance, watching her.
The next day, during a video call with her friend Riley, Harper spots the same naked man in the front garden, his face covered with bloody scratches, further disturbing her.
Realising that the front door is slightly open, Harper quickly shuts and locks it, but the naked man sticks his hand through the letter box.
Harper calls the police and the man is arrested, with one of the arresting officers resembling Geoffrey.
Harper visits a church, where images of the Green Man and Sheela na gig are carved on a font.
Outside, she meets a young boy and a vicar who both bear a likeness to Geoffrey.
After the boy leaves, Harper discusses James's death with the vicar, who suggests that she is partially responsible for James's death because she did not allow him to apologise.
An enraged Harper leaves and later goes to a local pub, where she meets Geoffrey again.
The few patrons and the bartender all bear Geoffrey's appearance.
His policeman lookalike arrives shortly afterwards, informing Harper that the naked man has been released in the absence of any legal ground to keep him detained, to her chagrin.
Distressed by the recent events, Harper contacts Riley, who offers to drive to the village in the morning to accompany Harper for the rest of her holiday.
As Harper attempts to text Riley the address, her mobile phone's service is repeatedly interrupted.
She sees the policeman outside, but as the lights flicker, he disappears.
One of the pub's patrons then appears and chases Harper, who retreats into the house.
As she arms herself with a knife, a window breaks in the kitchen.
Geoffrey arrives and finds that the window broke due to a crow, which he then euthanises by breaking its neck.
As Geoffrey goes into the garden, the lights flicker again and the naked man emerges, chasing Harper back into the house.
When he reaches through the letter box and grabs Harper's hand, she stabs him through the arm.
He pulls his arm out, the stuck knife ripping his arm in an extreme injury resembling the one James sustained during his fall.
Both the boy and the vicar appear inside the house in turn, each of them now similarly injured.
When the vicar attempts to rape Harper, she stabs him in the stomach and escapes the house.
While attempting to drive away, Harper accidentally runs over Geoffrey.
He aggressively pulls Harper out of her car, takes control of it and chases her before crashing into a stone wall.
The naked man, now in full Green Man form, approaches Harper, his ankle now severely broken and matching another injury on James's corpse.
The naked man gives birth to the young boy, who in turn gives birth to the vicar, then Geoffrey, and finally James, heavily mutilating their bodies.
Both Harper and James sit on a sofa inside the house.
When Harper asks him what he wants from her, James responds that he wants her love.
Riley—who is pregnant—arrives at the house in the morning.
She follows a blood trail and finds Harper, who smiles when she sees her.

27588317.title: Past Bonds: Unraveled (film)
synopsis: The film introduces viewers to Westfield High graduation, where our protagonists, Jack, the diligent valedictorian, and Leo, the audacious rebel and rising graffiti artist, share secret smiles and knowing glances.
We jump to Jack, now in his New York office, as he delivers a presentation on financial strategies.
Meanwhile in the vibrant Arts District of Los Angeles, Leo is at a bustling street art exhibit.
An extravagant invitation to Leo's 30th birthday party finds its way to Jack.
He voyages to Los Angeles, where he unintentionally instigates laughter by trying to imitate the local attire and struggles with the local cuisine.
At Leo’s 30th birthday party, Jack and Leo’s reconnection is initially strained.
One of Leo's friends sets the duo on a mission to retrieve his stolen Basquiat painting, leading Jack and Leo into a clumsy investigation.
Their ill-planned investigation includes an attempted stakeout dressed as pizza delivery guys.
Jack reveals his unresolved fear of flights to Leo, which originated from a near-fatal incident caused by Leo.
This admission sparks a heart-to-heart conversation, and Leo apologizes.
The stolen Basquiat painting shows up at the bar, and Jack and Leo manage to retrieve it after a chase through LA's alleyways.
The duo ends up in a dumpster, but they are victorious.
The film concludes with Jack and Leo’s birthday celebration, where they make peace and promise to stay connected.
A montage of Leo's graffiti murals and Jack's business deals passes across the end credits.
The final shot shows Jack and Leo posing together, their clothes smeared with paint, hinting at more adventures in their future.
The enduring message of the film is clear: friendships withstand the test of time, and reunions, no matter how late, are always possible.

66916133.title: Me Time (film)
synopsis: Best friends since high school, Sonny and Huck stopped meeting up every year on Huck's birthday 15 years ago when Sonny had a near death experience.
Now Sonny is a stay-at-home dad, putting all of his focus on his family.
Huck contacts him, as he does every year, for the annual celebration.
Not wanting to attend, Sonny finds himself with some "me time" for the first time in years while his wife and kids are away.
After only a few days, Sonny is bored.

He plays golf every day but is terrible, partakes of massive amounts of food at a big barbecue a few days in a row but projectile vomits, none of his friends can participate with him so he's lonely and bored and his kids don't seem to miss him.
Sonny ends up going to Huck's wild weekend birthday bash.
Arriving at the meeting point, everyone is skinny dipping.
Afterwards they load onto Huck's chartered bus and put on matching track suits.
Meanwhile, Sonny's wife Maya and kids get a visit at the place her parents have taken them to from her wealthy client Armando, who Sonny fears is interested in her.
The bus dumps the party group in the desert, where there are communal yurts set up, and the plan is to forage for their food.
They are given hardware to do it, so Sonny heads off to do number two.
A mountain lion chases him, but he wards it off by stabbing it with an EpiPen, and is nicknamed Big Dog.
That evening, when Sonny calls his family, he finds out Armando visited them by seaplane.
Sonny gets jealous when he hears that Armando is offering Maya a big project.
The call escalates into a big shouting match until they hang up on him.
Stan, Huck's loan shark arrives, seeking the $47,000 owed him.
His muscle Dorit breaks Sonny's finger, then burns down the site.
Once everyone goes, Sonny stays behind to help Huck salvage what they can.
Huck confesses he's fallen on hard times and is lonely.
On their way back to LA in an Uber, Sonny spots Armando.
The three break in and pull off some gross pranks, but inadvertently hit one of his tortoises.
All is caught on camera.
Sonny offers his house for Huck to continue his birthday celebration, as his family is still away.
Someone shares a party notification via social media, and it becomes a rager.
Seal comes, and Sonny jams with him.
Just as the party is at the most out of control the family shows up, and Maya leaves with the kids.
She asks him to clear out and stay away for a bit.
While they are separated, Sonny tries to make amends, apologizing to Armando and working hard on the talent show.
As the closing act Dash, Sonny's son, has a meltdown declaring he hates the keyboard.
Realising he's been selfish and overcontrolling, he apologizes to everyone, encouraging all who want to perform.
Sonny chases down Huck, convincing him to join him in a party planner company.

92452207.title: The Star Island Mystery
synopsis: Under the soft, subdued light of an emerging dawn, Daniel rouses awake on the bunk of his 40-foot motor yacht.
His awakening is jolted by a migraine that burrows into his skull with the intensity of a jackhammer.
Disoriented, he glances around the cabin.
Once his comforting sanctuary at sea, it now feels like an alien landscape, with no recollection in place of how he got there or the purpose of his journey.
With a grimace, he tries to coax the yacht's VHF marine transceiver to life, aiming to put out a distress signal.
But only the agonizing noise of static crackles back, a sure sign of its ineffectiveness.
An icy shroud of fear creeps over him, as the daunting reality of his isolation sinks in.
However, a glimmering dot on his navigation chart catches his eye - Hope Island, barely visible in the horizon, an uncharted and eerily silent landmass.
Pushing aside his apprehensions, he decides to navigate towards the island, harboring hope for assistance or possibly finding a clue to his lost memory.
Setting foot on the deserted landmass of Hope Island, he is greeted by a blast of frosty wind and an oppressive silence, clearly inhospitable.
As he explores, he stumbles upon traces of a former military outpost, characterized by the fallen M1 Garand bullet casings that litter the ground and the derelict remains of the army barracks.
A cleverly concealed underground bunker, shrouded by overgrown ivy plants, piques his curiosity.

He boldly steps inside only to be greeted by a scientific laboratory frozen in time amidst thick dust layers and spider webs, its cutting-edge technology a stark contrast to its dilapidated surroundings.
To his horror, he discovers signs of human experimentation - heavy-duty restraints on isolation chambers and scattered notes documenting the process of augmenting human strength and speed.
Venturing deeper into the unknown, Daniel is hit by an unsettling memory flood, a vision of himself, seemingly familiar but fearfully altered.
His disturbing flashback pictures him as a laboratory subject, with unidentified people conducting experiments on him, causing him to spiral further into confusion and self-doubt.
Seeing his reflection on the shiny stainless steel of the lab equipment triggers an internal struggle within him, his true identity hanging in the balance.
The more he uncovers, the deeper he descends into the labyrinth of his mind filled with horrifying secrets and suppressed memories, akin to opening Pandora's box.
His intrusion inadvertently awakens the facility's dormant AI security system, causing the silent island's transformation into a deadly maze.
Wailing sirens reverberate throughout the bunker, coupled with the initiation of a lockdown protocol, effectively imprisoning Daniel within.
The once silent hallways start echoing with the constant clank of active mechanical bots, the wake of which reveals terrifying mutant humans, their eyes bearing a reflection of their lost humanity.
The facility's defense system identifies Daniel, their creation, as a foreign entity and proceeds to neutralize him.
As fugitive thereafter, Daniel is chased by these grotesque beings.
Their unnatural agility and fierceness serve as terrifying reminders of their terrifying past and his.
As he evades them, Daniel accidentally discovers his superior survival instincts pointing towards another twisted piece of his jigsaw puzzle.
An adrenaline-pumping climax unfolds as Daniel using his newfound strength and speed faces the AI system and relentless mutant adversaries.
He tactically evades their onslaught, locking up mutants within the security chambers, and timing his moves to dodge the rampaging security bots, his enhanced memory serving well.

The deeper into the facility he ventures, the more decay he encounters, finally discovering a long-abandoned control hub, its screens flickering sporadically, hauntingly reminding him of its erstwhile functionality.
Narrowly deducing the emergency shutdown sequence from fragments of available information, he manages to abort the lockdown protocol, the once oppressive siren noise segueing into a welcome silence.
Countless lab notes and ancient digital logs reveal a chilling truth - he was the single successful experiment of a project aimed at amplifying human survival instincts.
The shocking revelation solves the riddles of his enhanced physical prowess and extraordinary memory.
The dark understanding of his modified identity throws him into a moral turmoil, questioning the validity of such horrifying operations, in which he was an unwilling participant.
Amid the chaos, he discovers a dust-encrusted UHF walkie-talkie.
Miraculously, it still worked.
He hurriedly transmits SOS signals into the void, his pleas for help deficit the unsettling silence of the island.
Weeks blur into one another as Daniel endures the relentless harsh weather of the island and the lurking dread of the dormant underground mutants.
The island's chilling silence is shredded by the thump of an incoming helicopter's rotor blades, which had picked up his persistent distress signals.
With a flare of orange from his emergency survival blanket, he signals the rescue team.
His vivid flag popping out stark against the drab gray of the deserted island.
Alarmed by the gruesome remnants of the horrifying experimentation, the rescue team hurriedly escorts Daniel into the helicopter, eager to leave the dystopian hellhole.
As the helicopter ascends, Daniel gazes at the dwindling vista of Hope Island, the birthplace of his painful past and fantastic potential.
The flight back is solemn, the crew mulling over the horrific discoveries, while Daniel wrestles with assimilating his life-altering experiences.
Upon arrival, Daniel is swarmed with queries regarding his ordeal.
But he deflects them all, lost in the struggle of accepting his altered reality.
He acknowledges the fact that the unearthed atrocities on Hope Island would be profoundly overwhelming to comprehend.
The stress of salvaging his sanity while juggling mutated memories proving immense.
Notwithstanding its gruesome past, Daniel finds an uncanny gratitude to Hope Island for gifting him his supernatural capabilities.
Nevertheless, he resolves to unearth the illicit human experimentation that happened there, using his eidetic memory as a tool to gather incriminating evidence.
Weeks roll on as he readjusts to life back home, the busy city routine contrasting starkly to the desolate island life.
His newfound abilities surprisingly prove to be handy in his daily life.
Daniel confronts his paradoxical past - a terrifying existence and phenomenal capabilities.
His chilling past constantly oscillates between drawing fright and admiration, a testament to his grit and survival instinct.
His new identity stands as a constant reminder of his horrifying ordeal and a symbol of tenacity against even the most unsavory odds.
His supernatural abilities, while resultant from a horrifying experiment, serve as a coping mechanism against traumas.
Daniel transform, becoming a vociferous advocate against unethical human experimentation, utilizing his personal ordeal to battle for ethical practices in scientific research.
His journey from an oblivious test subject to an empowered survivalist underlines the gravity of human experimentation and its concerning moral implications.
The film concludes with a contemplative Daniel, staring out at the emerald expanse of the sea, its depths resonating with his dark past.
As a new dawn breaks, Daniel pledges to employ his unique abilities to advance the cause of ethical research practices.
The once terrifying Hope Island now symbolizes human resilience in face of extraordinary trials, its past serving as a cautionary tale for the future.
As the final frame of 'The Hope Island Enigma' fades out, the viewers are left with a potent mix of fear, intrigue, admiration, and enlightenment.

66932691.title: The Block Island Sound
synopsis: Tom is a fisherman who wakes up alone and bewildered on his fishing vessel off the coast of Block Island to a scene of disarray.
Reports of strange phenomena become evident on the island, including tons of dead fish washing ashore.
Meanwhile, Harry, Tom’s son notices strange behaviour from his father such as taking his fishing boat out during the middle of the night and becoming unresponsive during conversation.
Harry's sister Audry who lives on the Rhode Island mainland is sent from her job at the Environmental Protection Agency to investigate the strange wildlife occurrences along with her coworker Paul.
Audry takes her daughter Emily along and decides to stay on the island with her Tom and Harry.
As Audry and Paul investigate the strange occurrences, Harry attempts to bond with his niece by showing Emily how to fish and catch frogs.
Tom's behavior becomes erratic, and one night Tom takes his boat out during the middle of the night and vanishes without a trace.
The local police persuade Audry and Harry to accept that their father has likely drowned, which is soon proven true as Tom's body washes ashore.
Harry struggles to accept the circumstances of his father's death.
His mental health deteriorates as his other estranged sister Jen returns home to Block Island from New York for the funeral, during which Harry gets in a fight with an older man.
He talks to his conspiracy theorist friend Dale and learns that similar disturbances have been happening across the world.

He borrows scuba equipment to investigate the area where Tom drowned, but becomes unconscious underwater only to awaken on the fishing vessel while the electronics are scrambled and a strange noise is emitted.
Harry hits a deer while distracted by a vision of Tom after dropping Jen off at the ferry, and his increasingly erratic behavior spurs Audry to bring him to a psychologist.

The psychologist speculates that he may be suffering from electromagnetic hypersensitivity caused by the Block Island Wind Farm and encourages Harry and Audry to contact a former patient with similar experiences.

Harry steals a neighbour's dog after being awoken by visions of Tom, taking it to the same spot in Block Island Sound until a bizarre experience occurs where everything on the boat, including Harry and the dog, begins to ascend toward the sky.
Harry crashes back down onto the boat but the dog goes missing, leaving behind only its lead.
Audry's colleague Paul offers to watch Emily and look after Harry while she drives to meet the former patient.
The man explains to Audry that his paranoia is a result of being watched or influenced by some otherworldly force.
He warns her that someone will get hurt if she doesn't get Harry away from the island.

While Audry is unsettled by the encounter and drives back to take the last ferry home, Harry resists yet another vision of his father telling him to take the "girl" (Emily), instead going for a nighttime drive where he narrowly avoids crashing into a female jogger.
He then attempts to attack the woman but fails, and returns to the house.
Audrey returns to find Paul knocked unconscious and hears Emily's screams as Harry abducts her onto the fishing boat.
She manages to jump onto the vessel but is unable to reason with her psychotic brother, who again returns to the site of the disturbance.
Audry barricades Emily and herself in the cabin of the boat; they soon experience a wailing sound and rattling as objects on the boat - along with Harry - start ascending into the sky again.
Audry is carried into the sky as the cabin door gives way.
The next morning, Emily is discovered alone in the cabin of the vessel by the local authorities.

The movie ends with Audry being dropped into the ocean alive and treading water as a voiceover plays from an earlier scene where she describes to Emily why biologists justify taking certain individual fish out of their natural habitat to study them.

989801.title: London - The Threshold of Triumph
synopsis: Amid the populous boroughs of London, Tom, Fritz, and Anna, bursting with youthful exuberance, throw an extravagant graduation party in the refined atmosphere of the Ritz Hotel.
They were toasting to their successful completion of education from the prestigious University of Oxford in the springtime of 1932.
Surrounded by their like-minded intellectual companions, they hold their champagne-filled glasses high in the air and swear a potent oath.
They pledge to safeguard their eternal bond and protect one another from the harsh winds of adversity they might confront in their life journey.
Fritz, an adventurous spirit, is seduced by the expansive mysteries of cosmic scientific research.
He devotes his post-graduation life to unravel the enigmatic aspects of quantum physics.
Anna, fascinated by the mystic maze of the human mind, pursues psychology.
Tom, propelled by an innate sense of social responsibility and desiring to make a significant societal impact, plunges into the twisted and complicated world of British politics.
Fritz, driven by the intoxicating desire for immense global influence, discovers a classified scientific formula.
The formula is an extrapolation based on Einstein's discoveries, which have the potential to create an unprecedented weapon of mass destruction.

Sworn to absolute secrecy, Fritz begins the prepossessing journey of interpreting and applying the highly complicated mathematical equations to confine the powerful energy that the classified formula encloses.
Meanwhile, Anna and Tom find themselves welded together by a joint objective of societal growth and betterment.
Working in close proximity sparks a tender, profound, and unexpected romantic bond that strengthens over time.
However, their romantic alliance strains the balance of the trio's friendship.
Fritz's recent change in attitude, caused by his secretive scientific pursuits, sets off alarm bells in Anna and Tom's mind.
As Tom tastes the initial successes in politics and rubs shoulders with the local political influencers, he stumbles upon a confidential military document.
The document vaguely hints at the monstrous plans of Fritz, enveloping Tom in a chilly fear.
Distressed by the reality of the impending catastrophe, Tom breaks the news to Anna.
The revelation crushes their benign image of their friend, Fritz.
Equipped with the explosive truth, Tom and Anna craft a precarious plan to thwart Fritz's potentially disastrous project.
They also ensure not to alert Fritz about their secret plan and cautious activities.
Anna carefully starts implementing psychological tactics to manipulate Fritz, aiming to avert his dangerous mission.
Alongside Anna's manipulations, Tom uses his blossoming political control to create bureaucratic obstructions for Fritz's ominous research.
Fritz, clueless about the strategic displacement his friends have engineered, remains steadfast in his quest.
His relentless pursuit adds fuel to the growing crisis that London is unknowingly approaching.
Strains of suspicion, distrust, and fear begin to splinter the once robust friendship among the trio, further endangered by the imminent threat Fritz's project poses.
As Fritz inches closer to his goal, the fate of London stands balanced on a knife's edge.
Anna and Tom's desperate efforts to persuade Fritz away from his catastrophic route become a race against time.
Caught in their intricate web of deception, suppressed truths, and unchecked anxieties, they grapple with the multifaceted complexity of their mission.
Tension soars to its peak in an underground bunker beneath Fritz's quaint Victorian lab, which ironically poses as ground-zero for the potential disaster.
Tom, under the guise of a casual visit, purposely distracts Fritz while Anna unleashes her combined psychological skills and emotional appeal on Fritz.
Her calculated words attempt to convince Fritz to abort his hazardous project.
This critical crossroads force the trio to confront their deep-seated fears.
Amidst the spiraling chaos, they make drastic life-altering decisions.
Fritz, after the intense confrontation, is taken into custody for his calamitous invention, forcing him to face the grave consequences of his dangerous pursuit.
The ordeal leaves Tom and Anna grappling with their emotions.
However, they salvage their bond and recommit themselves to public service.
They use their professional prowess to contribute significantly to societal improvements.
Each of them, filled with a mix of regret, redemption, and newfound knowledge, prepare to navigate their future filled with unforeseen challenges.

As Tom, Fritz, and Anna begin their unpredictable journey towards their yet-to-be-determined destinies, the city of London carries on, blissfully ignorant of the narrowly averted disaster, stirring within its very heart.

65761837.title: Munich – The Edge of War
synopsis: In 1932, Hugh Legat, and his German friends Paul von Hartmann and Paul's girlfriend Lena celebrate their graduation from Oxford University.
Hartmann insists Legat visit him in Munich to experience the "New Germany".
Six years later, Legat is on secondment from the British Foreign Office; working as Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain's private secretary.
Europe is on the brink of war.
Chamberlain strives to obtain peace with Adolf Hitler at any cost, even if that means allowing Germany to seize control of the Sudetenland from Czechoslovakia.

Chamberlain writes to Benito Mussolini in an effort to halt military action; it seemingly works and Hitler agrees, inviting Chamberlain and French Prime Minister Édouard Daladier to Munich for a conference.

Meanwhile, Hartmann is working as a translator in the German Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Berlin while secretly plotting with a Wehrmacht general in an effort to overthrow Hitler if top army officials agree to arrest him and seize control.
The general believes this cannot be accomplished unless Hitler is allowed to invade the Sudetenland, while Hartmann doubts the collective resolve of the generals.
Hartmann is given a stolen document (the Hossbach Memorandum) by his lover, Helen Winter, that indicates Hitler intends to conquer Europe.

Hartmann and the others reconvene and agree that getting the information to Chamberlain while he is in Munich is their best option; Hartmann reveals he has a trusted former classmate, Legat, who can likely help.
Hartmann is handed a pistol to assassinate Hitler should the opportunity arise.
In London, Legat is approached by Sir Alexander Cadogan and Sir Stewart Menzies of MI6 regarding the document in Hartmann's possession.
It is suggested that Legat accompany Chamberlain to the conference, rendezvous with Hartmann, and retrieve the document.
He agrees to help, despite the dangers associated with espionage.
Legat convinces Chamberlain to bring him along to Munich as a translator.
Hartmann boards Hitler's train to Munich where he shares his compartment with a childhood friend, Franz Sauer.
Upon discovering that Sauer has become a Schutzstaffel officer, Hartmann hides the documents and gun in the compartment washroom.
Hartmann catches Sauer rummaging through his suitcase, and realizes that Sauer has become suspicious of him.
Later, Hartmann meets with Hitler, who chastises him for his Oxford education.
In Munich, Legat and Hartmann reunite, a flashback reveals they had a falling out in 1932 after a heated verbal argument related to Hartmann's then-support of the Nazi Party.
Legat agrees to take possession of the document, but is unable to pass it along to Chamberlain.
With the signing of the agreement imminent, Hartmann insists that they immediately present the argument to Chamberlain and convince him to not sign the Munich Agreement.
Legat and Hartmann meet with Chamberlain, who scoffs at the idea of not signing based on vague German military plans for a coup d'état and refuses to take action.

Hartmann takes Legat to a local nursing home to see Lena, revealing that in 1935 she attended an anti-Nazi rally, only to have a Star of David carved in her back and be thrown out of a window after she was found to be Jewish, resulting in paralysis and an inability to speak.
Hartmann reveals he intends to assassinate Hitler, much to Legat's dismay.
When Legat returns to his hotel, he finds his room has been ransacked by Sauer, who attacks him.
Legat discovers the document is gone and panics, but he is able to get a discreet message to Hartmann informing him.
Hartmann meets with Hitler but cannot bring himself to shoot him.
The Munich Agreement is signed.

As Legat enters the car bound for the airport, typist Joan Menzies reveals that she is the niece of Colonel Sir Stewart Menzies, and that she had been assigned to help Legat in his espionage activity; she took possession of the document to prevent Sauer from finding it.
Chamberlain returns to Britain and gives his famous "Peace for our time" speech.
Legat returns home to his wife and son, revealing that he plans to leave the diplomatic service and join the RAF.
The Munich Agreement ultimately fails and World War II begins.
Chamberlain resigns several months later, dying soon after.
But because of the signed agreement, the start of the war is postponed, allowing Britain more time to prepare.

6803838.title: Interrupted Journey (2020 Drama Film)
synopsis: Overwhelmed with grief, Lucy is observed meticulously packing her personal items into an old, faded blue suitcase.
Each piece of clothing unfolded, each shoe tucked away, calmly reminded her of her recently departed husband, Daniel.

As she shallowly breathes and refuses the threatening tears, she comes across an old black and white photo full of dust and nostalgia - a snapshot in time of their honeymoon in Paris, a moment frozen when they were at the peak of their youthful love; blissful, unaware of what the future held.
Unable to hold it in, her tears fall like rain descending from the corners of her eyes, distorting the jubilant smiles of her past self and Daniel in the picture.
The floodgates of loneliness have burst, and Lucy finds herself drowning in an uninvited sea of melancholy.

In an attempt to escape, she makes a drastic decision to clear out all that reminded her of Daniel, including selling their old Victorian house which held years of shared memories and laughter, with the hope that the painful memories would diminish over time.
Steeling herself for this grueling ordeal, she kicks off on a solitary path to the endearingly tiny town of Rosewood.
Her journey is abruptly interrupted when a battered blue van, as worn and tired as its driver, screeches to a halt beside her.
The driver, a man whose wrinkled face told more stories than his name, introduced himself as John and handed Lucy a brown, weather-beaten parcel.
To her astonishment, he claimed it was from Daniel posthumously.

A blend of curiosity and hesitation grips Lucy as she carefully peels off the yellowed tape, revealing an originally hidden gift from Daniel; an antiquated map of Rosewood and a slightly oxidized brass key.
Captivated by the mystery that suddenly unfolded and the whirlwind of emotions Daniel’s parcel subsequently triggered, Lucy decided to follow the path of the puzzle, into the unknown.
The map led her away from the town's centre to an isolated mansion, leaning towards the Gothic era - a relic of times long gone.
It was a hauntingly beautiful structure sitting at the outskirts of Rosewood, forgotten by all but time itself.
Gathering her courage, Lucy inserts the brass key into the intricately ornate door of the mansion, unknowingly opening the door to its well-guarded secrets, dormant for decades.
As Lucy explores the mansion, her heart is throbbing with anxiety as she discovers that this mysterious place once belonged to Daniel.
This revelation sends shockwaves throughout Lucy's reality, forcing her to question all she knew about Daniel's life.

Odd and once-in-a-lifetime incidents start occurring - numerous anonymous phone calls on the mansion's antique rotary telephone, and terrifying sightings of a hooded figure in the darkest corners of Rosewood.
The pure inexplicability of these events, further mixed with surreal apparitions of Daniel she experiences, shakes her.
Lucy starts to question her sanity, corroborated only by the chills running down her spine.

Lucy's fear transforms into a resolute curiosity when she accidentally stumbles upon a hidden door that led to Daniel's secret study, inhabited by volumes of hand-written research about a cryptic society, The Order.
Lucy is drawn into this world of secrets she never knew existed, her former fears taking a backseat.
Instead, curiosity envelops her as she peers into Daniel's world after sifting through his complex research, cryptic notes, and classified documents.
This unusual exploration leads Lucy to a terrifying revelation, raising the hair at the back of her neck.

She starts finding bits and pieces of evidence suggesting that Daniel’s unexpected death was not an accident, but a cold-blooded murder carried out by The Order, aiming to erase the evidence of their sinister motives.
Noticing that several important documents were missing from the very clutter she had been navigating, she feels an intrusion in what was once her husband's private space.
Lucy is terrified, yet her resolution towards the truth stands firm.
She sets her mind on completing the puzzle Daniel started - deciphering The Order and the secrets they held against him.
With determination engraved on her face, she is prepared to face the growing perils while figuring out who among them is The Order's spy.
To her surprise, John reemerges from the shadows, his battered blue van a stark contrast against the quieter surroundings, extending an offer to help Lucy uncover the truth.
John, his face shadowed by multiple wrinkles, wears a grin that suggests mischief and mystery.
He admits to having his own grudges against The Order.
As curiosity gets the best of them, Lucy and John unexpectedly form a partnership.
With their underlying motives aligned, they come up with a clever strategy to unearth the identity of Daniel's killers and ensure they face justice.
Their plan involves a direct confrontation with the gloomy head of The Order.
Despite the undeniable danger, they gear up for the inevitable showdown.
Utilizing their shared intelligence, they craft an elaborate trap for The Order's leader, initiating it by sending an enciphered invitation for a meeting at the mansion.
Persistently risking their lives, Lucy and John start to decode the secretive agendas of The Order.
Amidst the well-orchestrated chaos of their disguised gathering, they manage to unveil the cruel face of The Order's leader and his manipulative tactics.
Armed with this newfound courage, Lucy and John race to hand over the damning evidence to the local law enforcement of Rosewood.
Swiftly acting upon their information, the police seize all questionable evidence from the mansion and begin to build an airtight case to break The Order's ruthless reign.
The unyielding influence of The Order gradually starts to fade, leaving its hooded members to face the ramifications of their deeds.
As the dust settles and peace descends on Rosewood, Lucy and John find solace in their victorious attempts, having eradicated The Order's potent oppression.
Their success diffuses a sigh of relief through the small town's inhabitants.
As they solve one puzzle after another, Lucy develops a deeper understanding of Daniel’s perplexing lifestyle, his covert links with The Order, the mysterious events plated after his murder.
Finally, Lucy embodies closure, and garners the strength for a fresh start, leaving the shadows of her grief behind.
After going through a rollercoaster of events, their shared experiences lead to an unexpected friendship between Lucy and John, spurring endless possibilities.
In the concluding moments, Lucy and John set off towards their new journey, under the picturesque morning sky, leaving all the painful memories stirred by The Order in the past.
With Lucy taking charge of the blue van, they venture into their promising future, leaving a trail of anticipation and hope behind.
The camera pulls away, capturing Lucy's imminent journey along the vast open roads with her newfound companion, John.

As the van eventually blurs into the horizon, the screen fades to black - the end credits roll in, leaving behind the lasting impression of Lucy's unwavering resilience and her relentless pursuit of the truth.

65407580.title: Alone (2020 thriller film)
synopsis: While on the road to moving house, recent widow Jessica is brake-checked by a man in a truck.
When she attempts to pass him, he initially refuses to let her, then tailgates her until taking a different exit.
She later encounters him at a gas station where he apologises for his behaviour.
Moments later, she finds his truck blocking the road; he tells her he has broken down and asks for a ride but Jessica declines and drives off.
Later that night, she sees him again at a rest stop and flees.
She crashes her car and sees her tires have been slashed.
The man appears, breaks into her car and drugs her; Jessica wakes up in his cabin where he has locked her inside.
She pleads for her release but he alludes to her not being the first one he has kidnapped and then forces her to tell him what happened to her husband.
Jessica reveals he died by suicide.
The next morning, she hears the man leaving and notices that the key is still in the keyhole on the other side.
She slides her sweater underneath the door and uses a stray nail to push the key out.
She frees herself and hides in an upstairs closet when the man comes back.
She overhears him speaking to his wife on the phone, lying about where he is and that he'll be back soon.
Once he goes downstairs, she escapes into the woods.
The man soon notices and gives chase.
After she badly injures her foot, they face off at the river where Jessica jumps in to escape.
Wet, cold and in pain, Jessica stumbles through the forest until she hears a nearby rustling in the bushes.
She hides behind a tree and hits out at someone with a branch, thinking it is the man, but instead meets a man named Robert who is out hunting.
He offers to give her a ride and provides food, water and new boots.
As they are driving, they come to a stop where a tree has fallen, blocking the road.
When they get out to move it, the man arrives, making up a story that Jessica is his sister and she's having a psychotic episode due to her husband's recent death.
After Robert demands the man's phone to call the police, the man attacks him and then kills him with his hunting rifle.
Jessica runs from the scene and another chase ensues.
She hides in a cave at night to get out of the rain, but the man spots her and shoots her in the shoulder.
She then hides in a small pond.
The man tries to goad her into coming out by mocking her husband's suicide but gives up and leaves when she doesn't come out.
The next morning while the man is disposing of Robert's body, Jessica climbs into his car.
She steals his phone then hides in the trunk as the man returns.
While driving, Jessica leaps into the back seat and attacks him, striking him multiple times in the head.
He wrestles her away and in doing so, crashes the car, flipping it over.
Dazed, Jessica climbs out and spots a search and rescue helicopter.
She runs after it into a clearing where she uses his phone to call his wife and tell her the truth.
The man, whose name has been revealed as Sam, follows Jessica into the clearing; she puts the phone on speaker and taunts him with it.
Enraged that Jessica has exposed his true nature to his family, Sam lunges at her with a knife and a fight ensues.
Jessica ultimately overcomes him and fatally stabs Sam.
She watches him die and then lies beside him exhausted as the helicopter descends from above.

53127678.title: The Whispering Corridor 2
synopsis: Clara Bennett and Trevor McDonald, two exceptional students whose names frequently crowned the honor roll, shared a meaningful friendship frequently admired by their peers at the prestigious Lilydale High School.

These dedicated teenagers, recognized for their impressive academic achievements and aspiring dreams of pursuing education at Ivy League schools, were buckling down and entering the challenging phase of preparation for their impending final exams during their pivotal senior year.

Unsettling murmurs began to ripple through the high school, their whispers echoing off the time-worn red bricks of Lilydale High; speculation about an imminent separation between Clara and Trevor started to gain momentum.
