Sam confesses that she didn't tell the whole truth about her mother before; while caring for her, she left one night for a break and got drunk.
Her mom died alone and she has lived with regret ever since.
Sam guides Emily to a barn, where she hides as Charlie approaches.
Sam now faces the wealthy woman, her armed husband, and her manager all threatening to give the phone back.
In the barn, Emily sprays Charlie with pesticide chemicals and he tries to choke her to death.
Sam reminds her of the piece of broken mirror she put into her pocket earlier and Emily uses it to stab Charlie in the neck, killing him as sirens approach the barn.
Meanwhile, police arrive to arrest Sam.
Seeing that Emily is safe, Sam surrenders.
Some time later, Emily video calls Sam; the two are now close friends.
She is about to go to Japan with her mother for a trip while Sam is going back to school.
Emily asks her who she was trying to call that day when she got the wrong number.
Sam says she was just trying to order a pizza.
They end the call and Sam drives away after throwing the card she had out of the window.
It reads "Tallahassee Suicide Prevention Center".

79026949.title: Shadows of Sorrow
synopsis: As the soft flutter of thousands of pages turning fills the air, Emily, an aspiring novelist with dreams as vast as her imagination, crosses paths with Jack, an ambitious architect with blueprints for life both on paper and in his heart.
Their encounter under the laughs of copper-colored leaves in the Boston Book Fair bonds them instantly.
An inexplicable electric spark tantalizes their senses, a prelude to the foundation of an intense bond centered around their love for literature and design.
Propelled forward by the intoxicating winds of romance and shared dreams, the couple exchanges vows in the ethereal realm of St. Patrick's Cathedral.
Following their marooned union, Jack and Emily nestle into a quaint, picturesque house in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, the embodiment of their collective dreams.
In the gentle silence of their charming home, Emily finds the muse for her debut novel.
A love story penned down with their journey weaved into the narrative subtly, where Jack's resilient spirit and their shared adventure act as her guiding stars.
Unfortunately, Jack is wrung through a ruthless wave of relentless deadlines and insatiable demands.
A skyscraper design project for a formidable New York client begins to take hold of his life, inching its cold fingers into his vibrant spirit.
The demanding strains of his profession and relentless stress strip the color from Jack's personality.
He is tormented by severe depression snowballing into an avalanche that threatens even his existence.
Eventually losing the bitter battle with depression, Jack's story ends abruptly.
His decision to surrender his life to the specter of darkness leaves Emily marooned on the island of their once shared life, residing in the echo-filled house they cherished.
Emily seeks refuge in writing, pouring out her soul onto pages smeared with tears and ink.
Her heartbreak unfolds over chapters filled with melancholic prose.
The mundane strappings of Emily's life mutate into unsettling circumstances as keys misplaced, and whispers bleed through the choking silence, seemingly originating from nowhere.
The situation escalates as Emily finds strands of unfamiliar text woven into her unfinished manuscript as though an unseen hand edited her work during her unguarded moments.
A curious thought trickles into Emily’s life.
Could these peculiar instances indicate communication attempts by Jack from the realm of the dead?
Emily, grappling with the sharp jaws of fear and grief gnawing at her, reaches out to Dr. Alan Dreyfuss, a seasoned psychiatrist based in Pittsburgh.
Dr. Dreyfuss, diagnosing Emily’s supernatural experiences as hallucinations borne from severe bereavement, recommends continual therapy to unravel the mental knots ensnaring her.
Emily embraces his advice with open arms, agreeing to therapy sessions.
Simultaneously, she ventures into uncharted territories, considering solutions that tread on a line parallel to conventionality.
Supercharged by her plights, Emily approaches Madam Zara, a local spiritual medium with an infamous reputation.
Hoping to reach Jack amidst the beyond, she subjects herself to a séance.
However, the session proves disastrous, rending the fragile fabric separating the earthly realm and supernatural, exacerbating Emily's haunting predicaments.
Amidst the chaos, Emily stumbles upon a possible lead - Jack’s age-worn antique brass pocket watch.
A seemingly insignificant accessory that hides horrors beneath its polished surface.
Digging into its history reveals its purchase from a nondescript pawn shop in Philadelphia, tied to spine-chilling stories of cursed bloodline and untold grief.
Emily unearths the horrifying truth etched in time - the cursed watch was a catalyst for Jack's mental downfall, pushing him off the ledge into the abyss of suicide.
Upon Jack's death, the malevolent entity entrapped within the antique was released upon their home, using it as a playground for its darkness.
Emily finds herself entrenched in a war of survival within her beloved home, transmuted into a haunting ground by the volatile entity from the watch.
Fear succumbs to understanding as Emily pieces together the puzzle linking Jack’s haunting depression to the artifact and her present paranormal predicament.
To break the curse, Emily seeks the assistance of Albert Eldridge, the town loner with a deep understanding of the occult.
Together, they formulate a complex plan to imprison the malignant entity within the cursed watch again.
Along with Eldridge, Emily successfully executes the plan, luring the entity back into the brass confines of the antique.
They seal the watch within an iron casing and inter it within the calm soils of the local cemetery, eliminating the curse and liberating Jack's soul from its shackles.
Emily's haunted house reverts to peaceful silence, the terrifying whispers waning into vague echoes, leaving room for her to delve into her private sorrow.
Mustering immense strength, Emily decides to sell their love-filled suburban abode, choosing to leave behind the labyrinth of joy and horror it embodies.
With a heavy heart, she bids farewell to the dwelling that hosted her life's peak joy and despair, leaving behind rooms teeming with echoing stories.
Emily, armed with the determination to start anew, finds herself amidst the cityscape pulsing with life - New York, a city adorned with an amalgamation of stories and endless opportunities.
The haunting experiences that ebbed and flowed through her life ribbons into Emily’s next literary work.
A spine-chilling horror novel titled "Shadows of Sorrow" serves as a tribute to Jack’s love and influence.
Emerging from her tragic past like a phoenix, Emily’s story finds resonance with readers worldwide, propelling her to the zenith of literary success.
As a bestselling author, Emily continues to navigate through life’s intricate maze, merging her sorrow, loss, and triumph into the hopeful dawn of a new chapter.

62504627.title: The Night House
synopsis: Beth has just lost her husband Owen to suicide.
Devastated, she spends her nights drinking and going through Owen's belongings.
She tries to appear stable and in control, but her friend Claire and neighbour Mel are concerned for her.
Owen's ominous suicide note—"You were right.
There is nothing.
Nothing is after you.
You're safe now.
"—perplexes her.
She begins to suffer from strange supernatural events at night and finds a strange reversed floor plan for their house.
One night, she discovers a photo on his phone of a woman who looks similar to her, and suspects Owen was having an affair.
After a night out with Claire, a drunken Beth reveals that she had been clinically dead for four minutes after a car accident years ago and saw that there was nothing when she died.
Owen had always disagreed with this and was close to changing her mind before he died.
Beth says that when she suffered from depression a year ago, Owen began sleepwalking, and she thought she had passed her negative emotions to him.
That night, she is awakened by a supernatural presence and witnesses several frightened women fleeing through the woods and jumping into the lake.
She finds blood on the boat where Owen shot himself and feels an invisible presence.
Crossing the lake to investigate a strange set of lights, she discovers a reversed copy of her house and sees ghostly figures of women with Owen.
She passes out and awakens in her own house.
She looks for the reversed house again and finds it, although this time it is unfinished and empty.
She retrieves a strange statue from it and confronts Mel, who claims he never saw the house but once saw Owen in the woods at night with a woman who looked like Beth.

Searching Owen's laptop, she finds more photos of women who look similar to her, identifies the statue from one of his books as an occult voodoo doll, and determines that Owen was trying to learn how to trick and trap demonic entities.
Beth finds the bookstore where Owen bought the books and encounters Madelyne, one of the women from Owen's photos, who denies sleeping with him.
Beth visits Claire who asks her to spend a few days away from the house.
She agrees and heads home to pack, where she threatens the ghost in the house.
Madelyne arrives and tells Beth how Owen invited her to the reverse house.
When Owen kissed her, he attempted to choke her, but apologized after she panicked and drove her back home.
A drunk Beth visits the reverse house, and under the floorboards finds the bodies of the women Owen had photographed.
An invisible force caresses Beth and she hugs it, mistaking it for Owen's spirit.
The spirit reveals that it is not Owen and shows her visions of Owen attacking and murdering the women.
The entity drags her through the house, reveals that it is what Beth saw when she died in the car accident, and identifies itself as "Nothing".
It explains that it tried to convince Owen to kill Beth to bring her back to the afterlife, but he resisted.
Instead, Owen built the reverse house and murdered the Beth-lookalikes to try to trick Nothing, but Nothing realized the trick.
It then traps Beth in a position like the statue that she had retrieved from the reverse house earlier.
In the morning, Claire arrives and sees evidence of a fight in the house.
Discovering the gun Owen used to kill himself is gone, she rushes out to the dock with Mel, where they find Beth floating out in the boat with the gun.
In Nothing's dimension, the entity tries to convince Beth to join it by killing herself, but Beth decides to put the gun down and not commit suicide.
As soon as she moves the gun away from herself, Beth returns to the real world, where Claire is swimming toward the boat to save her.
Once ashore, Beth sees the outline of the entity in the boat.
Mel asks her what she is staring at and says, "There's nothing there," to which Beth replies, "I know".

66211621.title: Holiday Hustle: Northeast Edition (2023 film)
synopsis: Portland, Maine, dons a celebratory aura during the holiday season, to the point where pulchritudinous twinkling lights and cheery garlands pervade the quainter Old Port and the tranquil Back Cove.

The culmination of this merriment lies within the sprawling corridors of the annual mega-market, the Portland Mall, replete with holiday decorations and exuding vibrancy, which is known for its annual post-Thanksgiving bonanza sale.

The coterie of enthusiastic shoppers attending ranges from Jake, a film studies student at the local university with an inherent curiosity, to Maria, a diligent single mother of two working tirelessly as a nurse, Frank, the retired detective with a sharp intellect, the quiet and introspective Ellie from the city library, and Roger, a citywide famous real-estate tycoon.
Equipped with pre-prepared lists of desired items, each shopper plots their trajectory to exploit the grand sale to its fullest.
A large digital clock positioned above the entrance ticks down the seconds until midnight, at which the automated glass doors promptly swing open and inaugurate the event.
A carefully choreographed chaos engulfs the mall as folks dash in, quickly grabbing everything from the latest electronics to high-end clothes off the painstakingly arranged shelves.
The bustling scene, however, soon devolves into horrific pandemonium as a harrowing scream reverberates throughout the multi-storey complex.
The source of the chaotic screaming is the gruesome discovery of a mutilated body in the linen department, nestled candidly next to a shipment of festively scarlet tablecloths.
The response is swift, with city law enforcement closing off all egress points and transforming the previously free-roaming shopping center into a foreboding containment area.
Avid mystery enthusiast Jake, piqued by the gruesome turn of events, steps forward to provide his layman investigative nous to the incident.
Jake's resolve is not without fear as he stumbles upon more victims strategically hidden amid the retail spaces and service corridors labyrinth, their grim sight inducing a sense of looming dread.
Fear and chaos coalesce; the excited chatter and elation are replaced with terrified pleas and declarations of innocence as people realize their precarious position.
Amid the burgeoning tumult, the seemingly unrelated group of Jake, Maria, Frank, Ellie, and Roger find common ground and unite to unveil the murderer's identity.
The team's sleuthing leads them to suspect the mall's Santa Claus, who has maintained an unsettling stillness at his lavishly decorated grotto since the lockdown began.
They decide to question the costumed figure, despite his seemingly innocuous demeanor.
Their plan takes an unexpected turn when a moment of confrontation snowballs into a breathless pursuit through the jumbled maze of shoppers and merchandise.
The chase extends unexpectedly, through frozen aisles and carries them to the snowcapped rooftop of the formidable structure.
With few viable alternatives remaining, they venture into the dimly-lit, labyrinthine underground service tunnels, illuminated sporadically with emergency light.
Each person draws upon their individual talents, converting their deadly pursued-pursuer duel into a high-risk team campaign.
Frank's experience in law enforcement proves crucial in planning their strategy and Ellie's knowledge of the mall layout, acquired from numerous visits, proves invaluable.
Maria’s ability to think on her feet helps them maintain a steady pace while Roger, with his authoritative personality, helps the team remain focused and engaged in the daunting task.
Their collective efforts allow them to corner the suspicious Santa Claus amidst the colorful, toy-laden section of the mall.
An intense confrontation unfurls amidst rows of gleaming, dancing elves and the red-and-white clad figure.
With their backs against the wall, they are galvanized by the raucous noise of the police swat team forcing entry into the mall.
Their relentless efforts finally bring the murderer to justice, returning a semblance of calm to the vast, resplendently lit shopping complex.
The mall’s doors are reopened; a collective sigh of relief vibrates through the chilled December night air as the ordeal concludes.
Jake, Maria, Frank, Ellie, and Roger, having been bled dry mentally and physically, are reunited with anxious family members who had been waiting on tenterhooks outside the mall.
Despite parting ways after the experience, the bonds of shared trauma etch an unspoken understanding onto their faces, forever linking their shared nightmares.
The Portland Mall, with its dazzling holiday illuminations and festive decorations, now stands as a chilling reminder of the horrific incident.
Its once lively storefronts now deserted, its food court lit eerily by stubbornly remaining Christmas lights, the re-opened mall casts a lingering, gloomy shadow over their festive spirit.

72856967.title: Thanksgiving (2023 film)
synopsis: During Thanksgiving in Plymouth, Massachusetts, people are gathering outside the local RightMart superstore in preparation for a Black Friday sale.
Jessica Wright, whose father, Thomas, owns the store, lets her boyfriend, Bobby, and her friends, Evan, Gaby, Scuba, and Yulia, inside the store early through a side door.
The crowd outside sees them and, in a frenzy, stampedes into the store, resulting in multiple people dying, including Amanda Collins, the wife of store manager Mitch.
Bobby gets his arm broken when he tries to rescue someone and subsequently disappears from the group.
One year later, RightMart is preparing for another Black Friday sale, despite the protests of Mitch and several other residents.
Meanwhile, Jessica and her friends are tagged in a social media post of a Thanksgiving table with their names around it.
Bobby, who has broken up with Jessica, returns to Plymouth to work for his uncle after being injured in the riot, much to the chagrin of Jessica's current boyfriend, Ryan.
A waitress named Lizzie is attacked and killed by a figure dressed in black clothing wearing a John Carver mask.
The police discover that Lizzie was present at the Black Friday incident, which leads them to believe those involved in the massacre are being targeted by Carver.
Jessica aids the investigation by providing footage of the riot to the town's sheriff, Eric Newlon.
Carver rampages through Plymouth and kills several residents, including RightMart security guard Manny and high school students Lonnie and Amy.
Evan and Gaby are soon abducted by Carver, while Jessica narrowly avoids being killed.
Yulia's father decides to move their family to Florida, but he and the deputy sheriff guarding them are knocked out by Carver before he attacks Yulia.
Jessica and Scuba drive to Yulia's house, but are unable to stop Carver from disemboweling Yulia with a table saw before he escapes.
The police attempt to lure Carver out by having the Wright family and Scuba participate in a Thanksgiving parade, disguised as Pilgrims.

However, Carver deduces their plan and decapitates a turkey mascot before sending smoke bombs into the crowd, causing everyone to scatter in panic and giving Carver the opportunity to abduct the Wrights and Scuba in the chaos.
Carver then cooks Jessica's stepmother, Kathleen, alive in an oven before serving her as the "turkey" at a dinner table surrounded by his hostages and his victims' corpses.
Carver then bludgeons Evan to death in a livestream before Jessica and Scuba cut through their bindings and she escapes, luring him away from the others.
She eludes Carver by climbing over a fence and running through the woods.
Jessica makes it to a parade warehouse, and finds Newlon unconscious.
When she follows a figure wearing Carver's mask inside, she sees it is Bobby.
She calls Newlon to help capture Bobby, but he escapes.
The police soon arrive and inform them that the survivors are safe.

Once they leave Jessica and Newlon alone, Jessica notices the same bramble debris from the fence and the deep woods that stuck to her are also on Newlon's clothing and sneakers, realizing he is the killer.
Newlon reveals that he was having an affair with Amanda, who was pregnant with his child before she died.
This was his motive to become Carver and seek revenge on those responsible.
Newlon had abducted Bobby and put him in the Carver costume, intending to shoot Bobby and frame him for the murders.
To Newlon's horror, it is revealed that Jessica has livestreamed his confession, leading him to attack her until she is saved by Bobby.
As they attempt to escape in a tow truck belonging to Bobby's uncle, Newlon hooks it to a support beam and approaches them with an axe.
Jessica uses a musket to shoot a turkey parade balloon that was attached to a tank of flammable gas, causing an explosion that engulfs Newlon in flames.
The following morning, Bobby is taken away in an ambulance and Jessica reunites with Ryan, Gaby, and Scuba.
The authorities are unable to find Newlon's remains, leading them to believe he was incinerated in the explosion.
However, Jessica continues to have nightmares of a flaming Newlon attacking her.

79834291.title: Penguin Squadron: L.P.D.R. Chronicles
synopsis: Jack, a young, almost rotund penguin sporting a tropical-themed Hawaiian shirt, can't shake off the melancholy dullness of his unexciting job at the New York City Zoo's management office.
A typical day for Jack involves patiently addressing an interminable array of complaints, the majority concerning the dirty bathrooms and the cacophonic noise produced by the zoo's peacocks.
During one of his routine workdays, his curiosity prompts him to explore the seldom-visited basement of the office.

As Jack rummages through the office paraphernalia, his eyes catch sight of a retro Pac-man arcade game stationed unobtrusively in a corner, lost but still hummingly functioning, even after braving the onslaught of two decades.
Intrigued and nostalgic, Jack approaches the arcade machine.
Upon laying his flippers on the familiar, brightly colored joystick and pressing a couple of buttons, an unexpected turn of events, Jack is whisked away into the game.
This captivating world introduces Jack to an array of creatures straight out of a fairytale book.
Jack soon comes to learn about the L.P.D.R., the Land, Pinniped, Dolphin, and Raptor species knit into a gallant group known for their acts of courage.
Admiring their valor and driven by his thirst for a bit of much-needed adventure, Jack decides to join the L.P.D.R.
An extraordinary decision, considering his lack of any training, lands him a position as a low-ranking trainee in the dedicated group.
A montage of Jack's choppy training sessions follows next.
His determination never dipping, despite his frequent blunders, Jack thrusts maximum effort into his training.
His little wings, better designed for swimming than scaling heights, propel him at unprecedented speeds during his penguin-racing drills, often leading to hilarious results.

The laughter and training sessions come to an abrupt halt when an unscrupulous human corporation declares its harmful plan to convert their cherished Promontory of Tempests into a sprawling amusement park.
Faced with the impending threat of annihilation, the L.P.D.R.
group huddles in an emergency meeting.
In a surprising turn of events, it's Jack, the clumsy yet charismatic penguin, who is selected to lead a mission into the human world to foil the corporation's harmful initiative.
Still, Jack rallies forth into the human world.
His journey is a blend of courage and comedy as he attempts to master the intricacies of human behaviors.
Regardless of his many blunders, Jack manages to paint a picture of charming bluntness, primarily due to his raw unfamiliarity with the human world.

Displaying exceptional wit and unfazed by his initial misfires, Jack, through his unconventional methods, manages to dismantle the corporation's plans of converting the Promontory of Tempests into an amusement park.

The defeat of the human corporation kickstarts an extravagant victory party within the L.P.D.R., filled with pixelated fireworks brightening the sky and jubilant cheers of relief and victory reverberating through the virtual landscape.
As dawn breaks into their virtual world, a surge of nostalgia tugs at Jack.
He decides to bid goodbye to his anthropomorphic friends and return to his reality.

His departure is met with a resonating farewell - the lion knight's heartfelt roar, the colonel's promise of a triumphant welcome anytime he chooses to visit again, creating a heart-touching atmosphere of goodbyes.
Back in the bustling corporate environment of the New York City Zoo, Jack's newfound enthusiasm permeates his once mundane role.
His cheerful inflection and lively persona bring a new flavor to his job, something that's not missed by his sharp colleagues.

The zoo office witnesses a change in its vibrancy as Jack loosens a bit, often mimicking his combat sequences using pencils and staplers or treating his colleagues to a reprise of his now viral penguin dance in the break room.
Back in the bustling corporate environment of the New York City Zoo, Jack's newfound enthusiasm permeates his once mundane role.
His cheerful inflection and lively persona bring a new flavor to his job, something that's not missed by his sharp colleagues.
The zoo office witnesses a change in its vibrancy as Jack loosens a bit, treating his colleagues to sushi parties becoming a staple feature to celebrate even minor accomplishments.
Even the stern boss, initially wary of Jack's energetic transformation, gives in, struggling to stifle his chuckles at Jack's mischievous antics.
As Jack's infectious exuberance eventually spreads amongst his colleagues, the once lifeless management office of the zoo gradually transforms into a place that exudes joy and creativity.
His escapades with the L.P.D.R.
draw parallelism to the reality of countless individuals, reflecting humor, difficulty, perseverance, and a sense of adventure in every task.
Having experienced a breathtaking adventure, Jack is, for the first time, eager to encounter the mundane challenges that his desk job presents.
His anticipation marks a complete transformation from the Jack who lamented his monotonous life at the start of the story.

69623629.title: Seal Team (film)
synopsis: During the 1980s, near the Cape of Storms, an animal military unit called H.M.M.F.

(Hydro Marine Military Force), consisting of two South African cape fur seals: veteran Claggart and tech genius Switch, and a celebrity striped dolphin named Dolph, are tasked by their human superiors with trying to defuse a naval mine.
Due to a seal's color-blindness, Claggart ends up cutting the wrong wire, and the mine immediately blows up once hauled onto their ship, the Good Boy.
This causes a portion of the ship to be destroyed and the ship to wrecked on a rock, while the H.M.M.F.
all survive unscathed, though Claggart loses his name tags which drifts off to rest near Seal Island, an island endlessly full of seals.
Over time, the now retired H.M.M.F.

drift apart: Claggart stays behind on the wreck of the Good Boy, Switch goes insane and lives on his own wreck that he turns into a lab with his imaginary friend, Senior Echo, and Dolph goes into show business in his own popular superhero show titled: Dial Eck-Eck-Eck-Eck For Action.

In the present day, Claggart's name tag is found by a bold cape fur seal named Quinn and his nervous best friend Benji while hunting for a fish, before they are chased off by sharks, whom their community lives in fear of, but their fear is always scoffed at by their elder leader, Brick.
Due to the shortage of food, the seals are all forced to eat bad-tasting barnacles while having to wait for the annual sardine run.

After retrieving the name tag, Quinn and Benji both share each of the name tags, and go out at night to search for food amongst the human shipwrecks with no luck, afoul of a great white shark named Grimes and his remora associates, who tries to eat them.

Quinn manages to survive by hiding in the wreck, he calls for Benji to join him, but learns he has been eaten by Grimes after seeing his part of the name tag snagged on his teeth, who then goes for him next, but Quinn is then saved by an elderly Claggart, who drives off Grimes and brings him back to the surface and reclaims his name tag before leaving Quinn.

After he comes to, he is found by three cape gannets named Diving Dee, Roger, and Mayday, who has been trying to eat a starfish that has been stuck in her mouth for years, who guide him to the wreck of the Good Boy, where Quinn insist Claggart into teaching him how to fight a shark, which he had experienced him do that to Grimes before he passed out, so he can avenge Benji's death.

After some advice by Claggart to assemble a team in order to accomplish his goal, he returns to Seal Island, where he recruits the energetic but eccentric Beth, who prefers and suggests to licking rocks rather than eat barnacles, and the boastful yet cowardly Great Geraldo, who keeps telling everyone that comes his way about escaping an aquarium in Cape Town, but had to leave behind his Asian girlfriend, Magnificent Jing.
They arrive at the Good Boy where Claggart teaches them the skills they need to fight sharks and eventually they pass the final exam.

Later that night, after being convinced by Quinn, Claggart takes them to Switch's wreck, where he accepts the offer to join them and shows off his latest biotech weapons to help them, including snapping clam grenades, electric eel bolts, pufferfish mines, stolen synchronized watches (Geraldo instead gets a toy watch), barracuda bazookas, pistol shrimps (that shoots an blast of knockout gas when used), and a group of octopuses all named Flicka, who can all turn into a suit that makes anyone invisible.
With their training and new weapons, they successfully take down a shark.

Two onlooking sharks see this, and report to Grimes, who decides to make an example of them by using his remoras to summon all the sharks in the world, including the one that Quinn and his friends trapped.

The gannets tell the group of the situation, so Switch suggests using his special formula chum to hypnotize the sharks and lure them away from Seal Island, so they go to Cape Town to retrieve a boat in order to install the chum.

Once there, Geraldo reunites with Jing, who forces him to reveal that escaping the aquarium was Jing's idea that she escaped and left him behind due to the fact that he could not go through with it, and he was thrown out instead of escaping.

After some convincing, Jing joins the team, as they acquire a boat and head back to Seal Island, where they use the chum to lure the sharks away from Seal Island and use the advantage to bombard the sharks with their weapons.

When the shark they fought attacks their boat, it crashes into a crevice where one of Grimes' remoras gets separated from the shark and take it hostage where they learn from it that surrounding Seal Island was a distraction to keep them busy while Grimes was gathering more shark forces.

Geraldo and Jing stay behind to distract the sharks surrounding the boat wreck by tricking them with a play with fake replicas, in which they amend their ways before joining the others near Grimes' wreck to learn his true intentions.

With the help of Flicka, Quinn goes undercover and learns that Grimes is planning to lead an endless population of sharks to attack the Seal Island population on their south to the upcoming annual sardine run.
However, Quinn's cover is compromised after Flicka's effects wear off but orders Flicka to activate their countermeasures who do it by covering the entire area of ink.
In the commotion, Claggart abandons the others to keep the sharks busy, while the others escape.

After arriving on the Good Boy, Quinn leaves for Seal Island, as he no longer wants to endanger his friends, but once he arrives, he learns all the seals have gone for the sardine run, he confronts Brick for mindlessly endangering them, but then the latter regrets that he already knows about sharks, because even though some seals will not come back, the community will survive, before leaving with the rest of the seals.
Knowing that their fate is in his hands, Quinn returns to the Good Boy.
They arrive at Grimes' lair in a sunken oil tanker by sneaking inside the mouth of Dave, a goofy looking, loud-mouthed basking shark whom they frequently encounter.

Once there, they assault all the sharks with ambushes, and they hide in a container, but they eventually escape, and manage to protect all the seals, who also lose their fear and join in the fight, along with Brick.
They are also joined by Claggart, who is revealed to be alive and had gone to recruit Dolph for the team, who both restart the Good Boy, allowing a chance for the seals to escape on board.

Grimes pounces onto the ship and snags Claggart's name tag on Quinn with the other name tag snagged on his tooth, resulting in a tug-of-war, but Quinn breaks free and retrieves both name tags, while Grimes falls back into the sea and is shredded to death by the Good Boy's propeller.

After 6 Months later, Quinn and his friends have hauled the Good Boy to Seal Island as their new base, where the residents of Seal Island now honor them as heroes, and they, along with the gannets and Dave, keep the island safe from any seal-eating shark that comes by.

In a series of mid-credits scenes, Dave is seen as a caller on a talk show radio station, where continuously talks about the many objects he accidentally ate other than plankton to prove that not all sharks are dangerous.

95002167.title: Passion Across Pixels (film)
synopsis: Emily, a compassionate and endlessly inventive digital artist, continuously produces eccentric works that not only challenge contemporary art norms but serve to redefine them completely.
For years, she has taken her unique perspective to the esteemed learning environment of the Art Institute of Boston.
There, she educates and continuously inspires budding artists, teaching them the abstract nature of creativity and fostering their growth in digital artistry.
Ethan, a slightly introverted graphic designer, is positively enthralled by Emily's mind-bending lecture on the future of 3D digital design.
They quickly establish a warm bond of friendship which thrives on shared interests and mutual respect.
Their common loves include the exploration and interpretation of narratives in digital art as well as the fascinating realm of virtual realities.

Much to Emily's surprise and slight chagrin, Ethan soon departs to fulfill a longtime dream of creating an ambitious documentary project in the vibrant landscapes of Brazil, leaving Emily to navigate an unexpected reality without his physical presence.

Undeterred, their mutually passionate drive for artistic innovation remains unquenched, kept alive by rich, intellectual conversations exchanged through email and numerous messaging platforms, essentially obliterating the miles that separate them.
Virtual dinners shared over video calls often extend long into the night.
Both Emily and Ethan, despite engrossing schedules – her demanding lectures and his frequent, tiring filming sessions, reflect a mutually satisfying need for each other’s company.

Increased emotional closeness peaks in shared moments of creativity, during which they use software like Photoshop to simultaneously edit different layers of the same digital image, mastering not only digital artistry but a tender romantic bond.
Expressions of love - encompassing ingeniously artistic digital cards conceptualized by Emily and intricate digitally-rendered portraits of her crafted by Ethan, hint at their blossoming love.
It’s a love which thrives not only in the physical world but extends fluidly into the digital realm they both frequent.
Unfortunately, their relationship reaches a difficult crossroads where the euphoria sparked by online interactions collides harshly with the stark and unforgiving reality of physical loneliness.
An emotional storm brews as they struggle to comprehend and articulate the profound feelings overwhelming them, forced to do so through the limited medium of webcam videos.

Confronting the considerable psychological pressure of their unique circumstance, they attempt to bridge the physical distance that separates them through an ever-reliable, albeit invisible, internet connection.
Emily grapples with a slowly diminishing creative spark, culminating in a distressing period of artistic stagnation, which negatively impacts her teaching and personal life.
Simultaneously, Ethan faces a disastrous technical malfunction that abruptly halts the post-production process on his documentary project.
The unresolved tension of their situation culminates in their first major argument played out harshly over a discord call.
The harsh words exchanged and hurt feelings leave a tangible crack in the seeming perfection of their once flawless digital relationship.
The relationship subsequently enters murky waters as Emily attempts to tackle her relentless art block and Ethan scrambles to navigate his way through a stalled project.
In a desperate attempt to reignite her artistic flair, Emily suddenly gravitates towards traditional art.
She resurrects mediums long forgotten – oil paints and canvases – and uses them to wage war against her stifling creative block.
Meanwhile, Ethan dedicates his undiluted attention and substantial efforts towards resolving the technical glitches plaguing his documentary.
However, the twists and turns of their digital love take an unexpected whirl when Ethan, acting on an impulse, lands without warning on Emily’s doorstep in Manhattan.
The moment Ethan’s touch finds Emily’s, an epiphany washes over them both – their strictly digital relationship lacked the warm exchange of physical companionship so pivotal to human connection.
Their roller-coaster relationship becomes a source of inspiration for Ethan.
He successfully adapts their shared experiences into a critical narrative for his documentary, adding a personal touch to the project.
Intricate visual narratives of their love story start to appear in Emily’s digital canvases.
They are nostalgic, emotional, and heart-achingly beautiful.
Their story concludes with an introspective exploration of digital love's multifaceted layers and the unavoidable challenges accompanying it.
It illustrates the ups and downs of an unconventional love story between two artists emerging from the dichotomy of crafting love in the digital and physical world.
Emily and Ethan’s experience immortalizes them as iconic symbols of the potent connection between the digital and physical worlds.

63305583.title: Love Is Love Is Love (film)
synopsis: Two for Dinner On a Saturday night, Joanne and Jack have a virtual dinner date as he is presently working on location in Montana as a producer.
The couple have grown daughters and allude to having a long happy marriage.
Jack didn't call the previous night, and he claims he fell asleep watching a DVD.
He asks Joanne to join him in Montana, but she fears he wouldn't have time for her like the last time.
Suddenly, Jack's connection cuts out.
When he's back, another woman is next to him, presumably from the shoot.
She says hello, then excuses herself.
At one point, he acts jealous when another man pays a little attention to Joanne.
They sign off, as Jack says he's exhausted.
The next day Joanne, after dealing with a worker at their house, spends most of the day traveling to surprise her husband in Montana.
Arriving late to where he's staying, as he's letting her in, another woman is sneaking out the back.
Sailing Lesson Diana and John have been married over 40 years.
She has adjusted to retired life well, joining various activities like book club, a gardening group with her peers... while he is stir crazy.
Claiming that Diana's become boring, John threatens to get a girlfriend if she doesn't shape up.
So, the couple tries to reignite their honeymoon-phase heat through a spontaneous sailing trip with a boat he's recently acquired.
Arriving at the marina, the boat looks neglected, so they first have to spruce it up, with the help of a young man there.
They get a sail raised but there is no wind, so they use the outboard motor.
Dropping anchor, they have lunch and talk.
Discussing classes they did together, both realise the other had legitimate concerns with the cooking and carpentry classes.
When they cannot get the motor restarted, they flag down a speedboat, and discover they used up the gas in the tiny motor.
As they get towed back, we see Diana and John have reconnected.
Late Lunch Young Caroline recently lost her mother Clare, so gathers together a group of her mother's closest friends for an Irish-style wake/luncheon celebration of life in mourning and remembrance.
Caroline, looking stricken and a bit intimidated by the powerful, accomplished guest list, she feels both guilty and saddened about her and her mother’s last interactions.
Clare died in fact in a traffic accident on the way to visit her daughter.
A superficial round of anecdotes, most of which are news to Caroline, and comments eventually evolves into deeper remembrances.
There are revelations and confessions, stories of abortion and infidelity and secret pregnancy−Caroline−, and the unexpected mid-meal arrival of a package.
The women celebrate sisterhood in tap shoes, each chooses a scarf to remember Clare by, and one sings a song she wrote “Regrets are like rocks that sink to the bottom”

63898828.title: Uncomplicated Devotion
synopsis: Nestled amidst the enchanting, cobblestone-decked channels of the European city of Bruges, our central figure, Jane, was firmly established in the vibrant academic sphere as a captivating English Literature professor at Ghent University.
Her charisma permeated her lectures, keeping students engaged and enthralled.
Simultaneously, she shouldered the heavy, albeit, adored responsibility of being a single mother to Mark, her precocious sixteen-year-old son.
With days consumed by crafting ingenious lectures on Shakespeare's renowned works and nights dedicated to ensuring her son thrived, Jane was a constant whirlwind of activity.
In the heart of this busy existence stood Mark, a spirited teenager grappling with the unpredictable, fraught landscape of St. Joseph's high school.
Jane's retreat from her demanding academic atmosphere was invariably marked by returning to Mark, her beacon, a testament to their abiding love.
However, the universe had bitter plans nestled amidst the tranquility of their routine.
Whispers of impending layoffs at Ghent University wove an unsettling tapestry into Jane's life, introducing the formidable specters of financial issues and professional instability.
Concurrently, Mark was entrenched in the labyrinth of adolescence, wrestling with an onslaught of bullying from classmates.
His emotions were in turmoil as he navigated his blossoming affection for Emily, his first love.
As individual pressures mounted, they unwittingly ushered a stealthy disconnect into Jane and Mark's once intimate relationship.
The fragility of their relationship became vividly apparent as the symphony of their mother-son bond stumbled, marred by previously uncharacteristic miscommunications and disagreements.
Amidst the storm of shared struggles, Mark discovered an unexpected beacon of hope - a burgeoning talent for narrative fiction writing.
His English teacher, Mr. Davis, commended his talent and encouraged him to contest for a scholarship at the esteemed Cambridge School of Literature, a path his mother had once tread.
Immersed in this newfound avenue of expression, Mark distanced himself further from Jane.
The secrets that Mark penned down in his introspective writings eventually caught Jane's attention.
His words, woven together in sentences reflecting their strained relationship, painted a tapestry of veiled fears and desperate loneliness.
Discovering Mark's concealed talent and accompanying fears shook Jane profoundly.
Fate, however, had more trials in store.
Jane was laid off by Ghent University due to budget cuts, leaving her in a precarious financial position.
Hidden beneath the facade of normalcy, she tried to mitigate Mark's impending despair, deciding to keep her professional setback a secret.
Concurrently, Mark was battling his own anxieties - mostly surrounding his intimidating scholarship application process.
The emotional distance between Jane and Mark deepened, culminating in a vehement argument that bared the harsh reality of their strained relationship.
Pushed beyond the brink by sheer frustration and escalating misunderstandings, Mark decided to seek refuge at his estranged father's residence in Brussels.
He left Jane a heartfelt, handwritten letter announcing his departure, each sentence heavy with silent remorse.
After Mark's departure, Jane chanced upon his unfinished scholarship application essay.
The raw honesty in his writing offered her a shattering insight into his tumultuous emotions and worries.
A realization washed over her, the depths of her own mistakes in their relationship becoming evident as keen remorse seized her.
Summoning her courage, Jane decided to bridge the widening gap ripping them apart.
Paying a visit to Mark at his father's quaint townhouse in Brussels was her first step.
She laid her struggles bare before him, confessing about her recent layoff and her overwhelming fears.

This emotional outpour marked the turn of a new leaf in their relationship, as the festering grievances were brought to light under the shroud of genuine apologies and promises to mend the gaping rift.
The tides of confession did not stop at Jane; it led to Mark divulging his struggle with the scholarship application.
Eventually, Mark's indomitable spirit bore fruit as he secured the prestigious scholarship to Cambridge School of Literature.
His acceptance speech stood as a tribute to his resilient mother, to their redefined bond and their shared journey of emotional healing.
On the other hand, Jane found a fresh spark in teaching eager minds at the local community college, Montoire College, finding renewed joy in mentoring the next generation.
The challenges they had experienced together had led them back to the one unequivocal truth - their profound love for one another.

64284365.title: Simple Passion
synopsis: Literature professor and divorced mother Hélène lives in the Paris suburbs with her preteen son, Paul.
She begins a passionate affair with Alexandre, a younger, married Russian diplomat stationed at the Russian Embassy that she met at a party in Porto.
The two regularly meet for afternoon trysts at her house.
Alexandre, who is usually cold and evasive, only visits Hélène when it suits him and instructs her to never contact him, especially when he goes away to spend time with his wife.
She often finds herself waiting to hear from him, and over time, she becomes increasingly obsessed with him.

Hélène's best friend and confidant, Anita, believes that their affair is doomed to fail, since Alexandre is married and will return to Russia, while suggesting that Hélène is "in love with love itself".
When Alexandre announces he will be away for a few weeks with his wife, Hélène takes a reluctant Paul on an impromptu trip to Florence.
While visiting a church alone, she cries and is consoled by a stranger.
Back in Paris, Hélène receives a call from Alexandre, asking to meet.
After sex, they have a brief argument when he berates her for wearing a short skirt.
Alexandre occasionally shares personal details about himself with Hélène, telling her about his parents and revealing that he lives on Tverskaya Street in Moscow.
In a subsequent encounter, Hélène professes her love for Alexandre during intercourse, though he does not respond.
Shortly afterwards, when Alexandre again tells Hélène not to contact him as he will be away with his wife, she begs him to stay, but her behaviour annoys him and he leaves.

Following a conversation with Anita, who reprimanded Hélène for being too submissive to Alexandre, Hélène refuses to let him in during his next visit, but she is unable to resist him and the two make out.
After not hearing from Alexandre for a while, Hélène decides to call the embassy and he arranges to meet her in a hotel room the following day.
When he fails to show up, she phones his office, but is informed that he has returned to Moscow.
She subsequently sinks into depression, to the point of neglecting Paul and her work commitments.
Hélène's ex-husband, who stops by to collect Paul, harshly reminds her of her responsibilities as a mother.
During a session with her psychiatrist, she confesses that she flew to Moscow for a day, roaming around Tverskaya Street in hopes of running into Alexandre.
Eight months later, Hélène watches Paul play football, having seemingly regained control of her life.
One night, she is surprised when Alexandre calls her to announce he is coming by.
In order to be alone with him, she quickly sends Paul to stay at a friend's house for the night.
After they have sex, Hélène offers to drive Alexandre back to his hotel.
En route, she wonders if they will see each other again, presuming that their affair is over.
Upon arriving at the hotel, he calls her "my love" and goes inside.
A teary-eyed Hélène watches as Alexandre disappears from sight, then leaves.

32089210.title: Beijing Bound (2020 film)
synopsis: Emma Thompson, a highly respected architect known for her strikingly modern high rises against the backdrop of London's skyline, found herself immersed solely in her work, almost blinding her from nurturing and cultivating her romantic relationships.

Caught amidst the architectural sketches and scale models in her sunlit loft studio overlooking sprawling London, Emma had a heart-wrenching realization of distance with her longtime boyfriend, John, a passionate photographer.

The painful decision of ending their six-year relationship threw Emma into a disconcerting whirlwind of introspection, stirring within her an urgent need to break free from her monotonous routine and instigate a drastic shift in her life.

Determined to break her habitual mold, Emma bravely takes a leap of faith by enrolling in a challenging architectural exchange program located in the vibrant heart of Beijing, China, thus igniting the spark for an exciting cross-cultural journey.

Emma’s first venture into the vibrant local scene, whether bargaining for crisp, purple-red dragon fruits in the dripping wet market, or wandering through the labyrinth-like hutongs, translated into delightful misadventures.
Emma soon finds herself comfortably settled into her new lodgings – a traditionally-styled siheyuan nestled amongst the perpetually lively and sizzling hutongs of old Beijing.

Emma's initial encounters with Jake, an Australian architect participating in the same exchange program, sees them bond over their compounded misunderstandings and misinterpretations while watching over the magnificent undulating landscape of the Great Wall.

As they navigate the maze of linguistic confusion and cultural riddles, Emma experiences a sense of solace and companionship in Jake, which lays down the path for an unexpected and blossoming romance.

However, the narrative takes an unexpected turn when John, Emma's past lover, turns up in Beijing unannounced, armed with hopeful and desperate declarations of wanting to rekindle their once-burned-out romance.
John's unexpected presence in Beijing spins Emma’s seemingly steady life into a complex turmoil of emotions.

Between choosing to return to her formerly monotonous yet predictable life with John in London or continuing her thrilling and eye-opening experience with Jake in Beijing, Emma finds herself at a personal crossroad.

In the midst of the emotional turbulence, Emma still manages to remain focused on her looming architectural exhibition, a critical point that could determine her professional fate in the heretofore unfamiliar territory.
Her intuitive understanding of architectural principles guides Emma towards, and ultimately results in, the creation of a remarkable architectural model.

This unique work, which blends the traditional pagoda design with the sleek form of modern skyscrapers, elicits enthusiastic praise from her local mentors and garners respect in the wider Beijing architectural community.

This professional accolade cements Emma's decision to choose her budding life with Jake in China, prioritizing their budding romance, and the electrifying novelty of her Beijing life over the familiarity and redundancy of her past life with John back in London.
As a manifestation of her decision to leave her past behind, Emma showers John with warm, polite, but firm goodbye remarks and sends him back to London.
As the narrative draws to a close, Emma can be seen, surrounded by her host family and Jake, standing tall and proud in front of her architectural masterpiece.

59983182.title: Valley Girl (2020 film)
synopsis: In present day, Ruby Richman arrives home, upset about breaking up with her boyfriend that night over her plans to participate in a study program in Japan.
Her mother, Julie, sits her down and recounts to Ruby her own final semester of high school.
In the early 1980s, Julie is a Valley girl who lives in Encino, Los Angeles, frequents shopping malls with her friends, Stacey, Karen and Loryn and dates Mickey, a popular but arrogant jock.
However, she begins to feel disillusioned to her lifestyle and has second thoughts regarding her future with Mickey.
She also aspires to attend the Fashion Institute of Technology in New York, rather than Cal State Northridge, as her parents and friends expect.
At the beach, she comes across Randy, a Hollywood punk and lead singer of the band Safety Recall.
The two flirt briefly before she abruptly leaves.
That night, Julie and her friends attend a costume party at Mickey's house.
Randy and his bandmates, Sticky and Jack, arrive at the venue, but are promptly thrown out.
Later, Randy insists Julie leaves the party with him.
Accompanied by a reluctant Stacey, Julie joins Randy and his friends to attend the band's performance at a punk nightclub.
After Stacey leaves and Safety Recall perform, Julie spends the rest of the night with Randy, culminating with the two sharing a kiss.
The next morning, Julie breaks up with Mickey, which frustrates her friends.
She begins spending more time with Randy and changes her fashion style, while Karen begins dating Mickey.
This causes further conflict between her and her friends, while the same rift occurs between Randy and his bandmates.
One day, Julie invites Randy over for dinner on behest of her parents Diana and Steve.
However, he overhears them talk about his lack of discipline and leaves.
Later, at Stacey's birthday party, Mickey begins to antagonize Randy, resulting in the two getting into a physical fight that gets Randy thrown out.
Stacey also gets upset at Julie for bringing him and forces her to leave too.
Outside, Julie breaks up with Randy after the two argue over their clashing backgrounds and her friends' attitudes toward him.
Later, Julie reluctantly agrees to be Mickey's date to the prom, who has broken up with Karen.
She apologizes to Stacey, who forgives her and reveals she has been accepted to Dartmouth College.
Meanwhile, Randy makes amends with his bandmates and decide to leave for New York before encouraging him to go after Julie.
At the mall, Mickey reveals that Karen was not accepted to Northridge, unlike Loryn.
On the night of the prom, Julie and Mickey are crowned prom king and queen.
As the two dance, Julie breaks up with Mickey and begins to leave.
Safety Recall arrive for a surprise performance, however, Mickey and his friends sabotage the equipment.
Despite this, Julie and Randy share a duet and reunite.
Later, Julie reconciles with Karen and Loryn is contacted to be a background dancer in an upcoming music video.
As their friends dance, Julie and Randy leave the venue in Mickey's rented limousine.
In present day, Julie reveals that Safety Recall signed a record deal in New York as she was finishing her degree at FIT and joined them on their first tour before eventually breaking up with Randy.
She tells Ruby that while she did not end up with Randy, she enjoyed their time together and is happy with the life that she chose, with the principle of never having regrets.

In the end, text appears on screen, revealing everyone's future successes, except for Mickey who received a restraining order from the producers of The Bachelor for repeatedly sending them his audition tape.

40665884.title: Shattered Reflections: The Chronicles of a Historic Girl
synopsis: Gabrielle, an underrated yet committed curator at the Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York City, stumbles upon an exhibit that begins to captivate her.
Evangeline's 19th-century velvet-bound diary resides in a fractured mahogany glass case, neglected and largely unseen.

This exhibit has been lost in the sea of dazzling treasures of the museum, such as the mystifying Egyptian mummies and eye-catching Renaissance-era paintings demanding attention across the marble floors of the museum.
Gabrielle is drawn to something deeper within the diary's faded lines, sensing an untold history and a story that was desperate to be heard within its ink-stained pages.
In an eerie turn of events, a series of peculiar incidents startles the museum.
Ancient chandeliers mysteriously flicker, icy drafts whip through previously locked chambers, and sturdy Renaissance-era paintings inexplicably crash to the floor, startling staff and visitors alike.
These disturbances seem to have a disconcerting connection to Evangeline's diary exhibit located in the European Literature section, occurring within an eerie proximity.
Trusting her instinct, Gabrielle reveals her uncanny suspicions to Richard, the no-nonsense Senior Historian famed for his rational and logical reasoning.
She openly speculates about a plausible connection between the inexplicable phenomena and Evangeline's diary.

United in their purpose, Gabrielle and Richard embark on a complex journey of research into Evangeline's life based in Portland and its speculated relation to the otherworldly spirit that seems to be haunting their museum.

They uncover the untold stories of Evangeline -- a brilliant physicist, a fearless soldier during the Civil War, and a steadfast advocate for gender equality during the rigid confines of the Victorian era.
Gabrielle and Richard begin connecting the dots, tracing the correlation between Evangeline’s life and the supernatural occurrences that have been wreaking havoc in the museum.
The previously neglected story of Evangeline breaks out from its obscurity, triggering widespread debates about gender discrimination in their cosmopolitan city and beyond.
The artifact that appeared to be merely an old diary is revealed to have profound significance.
It is the key to the secrets of Evangeline's life and death, grippingly intertwined with the ghostly disturbances in the museum.
The gender discrepancies glaring at Gabrielle from the timeworn diary echo her own struggles with gender inequality in her current role as a curator.

Determined to change her fate and those around her, and inspired by Evangeline's bravery and resilience, Gabrielle steps out of her comfort zone, risking her steady job and hard-earned reputation in the museum society.
Through her bold actions, she emanates her resolve to bring justice to Evangeline, the long-deceased brave woman who dared to challenge societal prejudices.

Not one to stand by the sidelines, Gabrielle, with Richard's unwavering support, launches a public campaign to expose the secrets associated with Evangeline's tale and pushes for a fresh investigation into her sudden, suspect death.
However, the spectral disturbances that have haunted the gothic museum escalate as Gabrielle's campaign stirs the waters, creating an urgent need for closure.
Gabrielle and Richard are pushed to piece together the puzzle hastily as they sense the lurking danger.
An epoch-making public demonstration takes place under the leadership of Gabrielle.
It stands as a turning point in their pursuit of truth and justice.
The protest becomes a rallying cry against the stubborn and persisting gender disparities in the modern world.

In a dramatic turn of events, the collective public outcry and the damning evidence collected leads to an astonishing indictment of a revered Portland-based 19th-century family, revealing their sinister involvement in Evangeline's murder.

Gabrielle implores every person to acknowledge and learn from the historical injustices that Evangeline suffered, striving for an equitable future and opening the pathway to justice for generations to come.
At the heart of it all, Evangeline's tattered diary, now protected in a new crystal-clear glass case, becomes symbolic.
The museum, recovers its past serenity and is bustling with renewed life.
Patrons, lured by the fascinating story of the once-forgotten Evangeline, flock to her exhibit.
The previous disquieting supernatural disturbances come to their tranquil conclusion.
A palpable calm and peace envelop the entire museum.
Gabrielle, now the unsung heroine portrayed in local headlines, beams with satisfaction, her courage, dedication to truth, and unwavering spirit finally celebrated.
Wandering down the quiet, history-laden corridors of the museum, she pauses in the soft shadows stretching across the polished Athenian marble.
In a gentle whisper, she thanks the spirit of Evangeline for her inspiration.
The Victorian-era lanterns stop flickering, casting a soothing glow around Evangeline's exhibit.
A gentle rustling emanates from the diary's direction, as if its pages were turning softly of their own accord, marking a quiet conclusion to the restless journey.
Gabrielle had transcended her role as a museum curator, leading an impactful movement against societal norms, and rewriting Evangeline's overlooked history.
Through her actions, she demonstrated the immense potential of an individual to reshape societal consciousness, forging the path to a more balanced and just future.

68220057.title: Where Is Anne Frank
synopsis: "A year from now" in Amsterdam, the glass casing over the first volume of Anne Frank's diaries in the Anne Frank House shatters.

As ink from a fountain pen drips onto the pages, the words lift off and manifest into Kitty, a 14-year-old red-haired girl dressed in 1940s clothes who was Anne's imaginary friend while writing her diary.
Confused by the absence of Anne and her family, Kitty discovers she is invisible and intangible to people while inside the Anne Frank House as she sees civilians tour the museum.
Flashbacks to Anne writing her diary in the 1940s show how Kitty remembers the recorded events as if Anne spoke to her while writing.
After dark, two drunk men smash Anne's bedroom window with rocks after seeing Kitty turn on a light, drawing the police's attention and scaring her into fleeing with the diary.
Not knowing what happened to the Franks and the time since World War II, Kitty tries to file a missing person report at the police station for Anne.
Bemused, the police point her to several places in Amsterdam named after Anne Frank before trying to arrest her when they learn Kitty has Anne's diary.
Kitty escapes and meets a boy named Peter, whom she saw stealing wallets in the Anne Frank House yesterday, initially mistaking him for Anne's boyfriend.
While skating with him, Kitty discovers how straying too far from the diary will dissolve her into ink.
Peter takes her back to the Anne Frank House in the morning after Kitty nearly dies from separation from Anne's diary.
After Kitty spends the day sleeping, Peter comes looking for her the next morning, leading the police to seize him for disruption.
Knowing him for a burglar, they interrogate him about Kitty, but refuse to believe his account about her magical status.
At night, Peter returns to the Anne Frank House, explaining how he's learned how Kitty's powers work.
She exits to meet him, drawing the attention of the police and forcing them both to flee again.
Kitty trades one of Auguste van Daan's stashed high-price watches for modern clothes and visits the 6th Montessori School Anne Frank's library to catch up on history.
After reviewing several different editions of Anne's diary, Kitty learns about Anne's death from the librarian, who gives her Otto Frank's book before she goes to the play about Anne.
When she criticizes the actors for misquoting Anne, the audience recognizes her from the news and swarms her.
Kitty escapes and meets up with Peter, who takes her to a shelter where refugee illegal immigrants live.
Awa, a little girl, explains their plight and shows Kitty how her father plans to build a hot air balloon for them to escape.
Kitty confronts Peter about not explaining that Anne and most of her family died.
Determined to retrace Anne's footsteps, Kitty and Peter travel by train to Westerbork, Auschwitz, and Bergen-Belsen.
Kitty reads Otto's memoir and watches Hanneli Goslar's recordings, becoming more depressed.
Upon arriving at Anne and Margot's cenotaph in Bergen-Belsen, a devastated Kitty collapses while sobbing before Peter convinces her to return to Amsterdam with him.
When they return to the shelter, they discover the government has scheduled to deport the refugees back to their homelands tomorrow.
With her new experiences, Kitty becomes empowered to help them, spray-painting Awa's father's hot air balloon to reveal her location to the world.
With a crowd gathered the next day, Kitty makes an emotional speech, accusing the world of deifying Anne and mishandling her message of helping and saving people.
She threatens to burn Anne's diary unless the government agrees to shelter the refugees.
Seeing Kitty afraid of what could happen, Peter offers to take her back to the Anne Frank House to live as an immortal, invisible spirit.
Despite her fear of death, she declines, as they have fallen in love.
After a short deliberation, the officials and police accept Kitty's terms.
She hands the diary to Awa, who delivers it to the authorities as Kitty leaves with Peter.
After separating from Anne's diary for three hours, Kitty shares a passionate kiss with a distraught Peter before dissolving into ink and dispersing into the wind.

88173011.title: The Gentlemen in the Society (2020 film)
synopsis: John Stewart, a man basking in the glory of his distinguished status as a top-level investment banker, awakens in his lavish penthouse apartment, with windows expanding across Central Park, as the day of his best friend Robert's extravagant 40th birthday celebration kicks off.

A morning phone conversation transpires among John and his powerful allies that include a notable senator and an acclaimed business tycoon, their admiration for John seeping through every word, further emphasizing his critical position within this elite wheel.

As John is carefully surveying rows of luxury wines in Whole Foods to compliment Robert's party, he chances upon Rebecca, his ex-flame noted for her piercing gaze and cunning smile, in an unexpected turn of events.
Rebecca, a fierce and manipulative attorney, is in possession of a possibly devastating secret: John's birth, resulting from a scandalous affair between a wealthy magnate and a low-ranking employee.
With a single call to the press, she has the potential to obliterate John's reputation and his cherished position in the society.

An intense confrontation ensues in the fresh produce aisle between Rebecca and John, where she imposes her ruthless ultimatum - either John finances her dream law firm or face the brutal exposure of his concealed secret.
As Robert's grand birthday bash unfolds in his opulent Long Island mansion, he picks up on John's erratic behavior and swiftly grows anxious over his ordinarily cheerful friend's sudden melancholy.
Robert’s interest is piqued, his eyes firmly fixed on his friend from across the crystal chandelier-lit room, intuitively sensing the turmoil roiling within John.

Unfazed in her callous pursuit, Rebecca corners John into backing a case against one of his high-profile clients, an action that severely clashes with his professional ethics, causing John's carefully curated facade to fracture.

Locked within the quiet sanctity of his penthouse, John grapples with the demons of his predicament, devising strategies to outwit Rebecca's threats while safeguarding his secret, but the choices he makes draw attention.
John's minimal interactions and chilly attitude towards his well-known associates become noticeably worrying to Robert, who decides to confront John in the silent privacy of his study.
Rebecca, losing patience with John's stalling tact, corners him during Robert's after-party, leading to a fiery tussle over the grand piano's melodious echoes in the colossal hall.

With a final act of defiance, John storms out of the sprawling mansion right in front of stunned spectators, stirring up a whirlwind of wide-eyed whispers and instantaneously becoming the piping hot subject of society gossip.
Alone amidst the bustling crowd, Robert is left astounded but more determined than ever to help his friend, John, regain his conventional composure.

Filled with resolve, Robert calls on John in his penthouse, persistently seeking answers about his abrupt exit from the party, culminating in a jaw-dropping revelation about John's status as the illegitimate offspring of the most affluent real estate tycoon in New York.

Struggling to bear the weight of his secret any longer, John, slightly intoxicated after downing a generous helping of bourbon, finally breaks down and shares the bitter truth with Robert, his exhausted figure bent over the sleek mahogany bar in his penthouse.

Throughout his raw and emotional confession, John reveals his humbler origins and the ceaseless struggles he faced while striving for acceptance and relevance in the glittery and deceptive world of high society.
John's secret didn’t stay under wraps for long as Rebecca vindictively reveals it on a live interview with CNN, resulting in a controversial legal battle for the large estate of John's father.
Owing to the extreme pressure exerted by institutional shareholders, John reluctantly resigns from his privileged spot as a key partner in the globally known investment banking company.
Unforeseen events take a dramatic turn when Robert chooses to admit that he had known about John's clandestine past but chose to protect his friend by maintaining his silence.
Once the legal battles conclude, John retreats to his tiny ancestral home, reminiscing about simpler times drowned in the anonymity of suburbia.

Looking back at old memories washed over with intense emotions, John processes Robert's confession of the prior knowledge about his past, understanding why his friend choose to stand guard over his secret.
The tumultuous rollercoaster of emotions leads to the dawn of a fresh chapter in John’s life as he finally decides to abandon his ostentatious lifestyle and venture for a fresh start.
For the first time in years, John vows to live an authentic life, undeterred by the dismissive judgment and down looking noses of the New York high society.
He pledges to reclaim his tarnished reputation, this time under his real name, John Hamilton, demonstrating immense courage in the face of a media frenzy.
Amid the harsh glare of society's judgment, a cup of modest coffee in a quiet corner of a local diner allows John and Robert to mend the frayed ties of their friendship.
Together, they find comfort in the shared understanding that the true measure of a gentleman is not his social rank but the merit of his character.

As the relentless tides of change sweep through, John embarks on a fresh professional journey with a small brokerage firm, determined to rebuild his damaged credibility with Robert standing like a rock by his side.
John throws himself into the process of restoring his dismantled life, promising to maintain his dignity and self-respect.
John also takes steps to mend his relationship with Robert, appreciating his dependable support over a quiet dinner in his new, humble home.
Psychologically strengthened, John confronts Rebecca in her upstate New York office, denying her any control over his life using his past as a tool.
Having faced the darkest facets of his life, John is now ready for a journey of self-discovery, striving to form a new identity free from deceit and secrets.
Inexplicably, Robert stands like a beacon of support by John’s side, wearing his pride for his friend’s resilience against all odds.
Regardless of the media circus, Robert goes out of his way to help John power through the judgmental glares from the city's corporate juggernauts.
Regardless of the media circus, John makes a solemn promise to live a more humble life, making amends for his past deceptions to everyone who was led astray.
Having great resolve and his indomitable spirit, John step by step rebuilds his professional reputation as a stockbroker, striving to find success through honesty.
John finally comes to terms with his past, viewing his past missteps as essential stepping stones on his journey towards a more transparent and honest life.
Despite the scandal and the resulting societal judgment, the bond between John and Robert has proven to be stronger than before.
They reiterate their belief that a true gentleman is defined not by his social standing but by his character and his actions.
The narrative ends on a note filled with hope, with John living authentically in the suburbs, Robert exploring life beyond inheritance, and both rejecting societal judgment.

60537604.title: The Boys in the Band (2020 film)
synopsis: In 1968, Michael arrives at his apartment on the Upper East Side of Manhattan in preparation for Harold's birthday party.
Michael receives a call from his friend Donald, who will be arriving early due to a canceled psychiatrist appointment.
When Donald arrives, Michael pities his own aging and debt-riddled lifestyle.
Alan, Michael's old roommate from Georgetown, calls Michael in tears saying he has something urgent to tell Michael in person.
Michael invites Alan to the party and warns all his guests that Alan is heterosexual and doesn't know about Michael's homosexuality.
As the sun sets, Emory arrives with lovers Hank and Larry, whose relationship is on the rocks.
Bernard arrives with a stack of books for Donald before he too settles into the party atmosphere.
Alan calls Michael from a phone booth, informing him that he isn't coming to the party after all and will instead meet Michael the following day for lunch.
Larry and Bernard dance to "Heat Wave" as Emory and Michael join in.
Despite his earlier conversation with Michael, Alan arrives at the party and finds Michael and his friends dancing.
He bonds with Hank, whom he mistakes as being straight, and shows discomfort towards Emory's flamboyant behavior.
Michael takes Alan to his bedroom to discuss Alan's urgent conversation, but Alan dodges his questions.
A hustler called "Cowboy" arrives earlier than Emory expected and mistakes Michael for Harold, kissing him on the lips.
Alan descends from the upstairs bathroom and announces he's leaving.
Emory chides him for being a closeted homosexual which results in Alan punching Emory and calling him a "faggot."
Harold arrives high on marijuana and accepts Cowboy's gift of a passionate kiss.
Michael begins to drink and smoke despite having quit 5 weeks prior.
He and Harold trade vicious insults as Hank helps a vomiting Alan in Michael's bathroom.
Emory brings out Harold's birthday cake and presents.
After opening them on the terrace, a thunderstorm forces everyone inside.

Alan tries to leave again but is stopped by Michael, who informs everyone that they are playing a party game: everyone must use the telephone to call the one person they truly believe they have loved.
Michael creates a points system based on how far each one can get in their conversations with their true loves.
Bernard calls the son of his mother's employer, with whom he had a sexual encounter as a teenager.
After his call goes awry, he only earns 2 points.
Emory solemnly calls a dentist he had a crush on in high school but his call ends abruptly, earning him 3 points.
Hank calls his answering service at home and leaves a message for Larry, earning him 7 points.
Larry loudly disagrees with Hank about the insistence of monogamy in their relationship, leading Michael to deduce that Donald and Larry have had sex in the past.
Larry uses the kitchen phone to call Hank in the living room.
His tearful declaration of love earns him 10 points.
Hank and Larry go upstairs to Michael's room.
Michael angrily confronts Alan about his closeted relationship in college with a boy named Justin.
Alan makes a phone call to who Michael believes is Justin, but turns out to be Alan's wife Fran.
Alan tells her he loves her and is coming home to Washington.
He earns 10 points and leaves as Michael stands defeated.
Harold informs Michael that no matter what Michael does, he will always be a homosexual, just like the rest of them.
He departs, taking Cowboy and his presents with him.
Emory leaves with a distraught Bernard, promising to sober him up on the way home.
Michael laments over the group's treatment of each other, wishing "if we could just not hate ourselves so much."
He tells Donald that he never learned what Alan wanted to confide in him.
As midnight nears, Michael attends Mass at St. Malachy's.
Donald reads The Golden Notebook on Michael's couch, despite his earlier insistence he would not be spending the night.

Harold and Cowboy ride in a taxi to Harold's home, Emory and Bernard sit at a late night diner enjoying coffee and buttered toast, Hank and Larry have sex in Michael's bedroom, and Alan sits at a bar drinking alone.
Michael exits Mass; his walk turns into a run as he heads down the street.

11087944.title: The Ripple Effect (2021 film)
synopsis: Dover, an old coal-mining town in Australia, is a territory governed by an unrelenting cold that silences the once familiar hum of mining equipment.
Among the snow-covered homes, Ruth, a hardworking waitress and a single mother, along with her son Joey, weather the frosty conditions in their small, wooden cabin.
George, a man in his twilight years who lives alone after the recent passing of his wife, is a mere shadow of his former self.
Ruth works two jobs to cushion their scanty income, while Joey struggles to shine in his academics due to the lack of adequate educational infrastructure in Dover.
George spends his nocturnal hours simmering in whiskey at Johnny's Bar, his solitary presence complemented by Ruth who observes his sinking spirits.
One chilly evening, Ruth discovers a meticulously designed model by Joey - a prototype of a wind-powered heater that promises warmth.
Hoping to stir the defeated mechanic in George to sprouts of life, she approaches him with her son's innovative design during a severe winter storm.
George, intrigued by Joey's clever contraption, quickly finds himself getting involved in its construction.
Their misfires galvanize their bond, anchoring them in a shared purpose.Dover soon becomes abuzz with whispers of Joey's groundbreaking heater.
Word of Joey's wind-powered heater reaches distant technology corporations, and a group of callous executives make a scornful offer to purchase the invention.
Ruth, however, stands her ground, insisting on fair negotiations and suitable recognition for Joey's innovative creation.
Their tussle against corporate manipulation grips national attention.

Amidst the media circus, Samuel Grant, a self-made billionaire who has dedicated his life to conscious entrepreneurship, steps forth to ensure that Ruth and Joey retain major control in the rollout of the wind-powered heater.
Once the contracts are sealed with fairness and respect, prototypes are rolled out across Dover.
The heaters prove to be more efficient than imagined, gradually thawing the town's frosty stagnation.
Amplified by the successful launch of Joey's invention, Dover's stagnant economy springs back into life, new and old businesses alike showing interest in this picturesque town.
Amidst the economic revival, Ruth no longer frets over finances while Joey continues with his green energy projects.
