One evening, as Bobby and The General sat at the pub, the older man leaned over the counter and suggested an upcoming challenging freight mission to Bobby.
Bobby initially resisted, reluctant to trade in the predictability of his daily grind for unfamiliar challenges.
The General, however, was persistent.
He believed in the necessity of change and managed to slowly persuade Bobby to undertake the mission, bolstering his confidence each step of the way.
Thus, Bobby traded Piermont's tranquil streets for the freight ship's bustling deck, charting a course into the unknown.
As he waved goodbye to Piermont from the stern, an uncanny mixture of fear and excitement settled in him, marking the beginning of an unexpected journey.
During the course of his voyage, Bobby found himself grappling with internal struggles and external challenges.
The crew, a mishmash of personalities each steeped in their own tales, initially showed a lack of confidence in Bobby.
They harbored doubts about his leadership owing to his relative newness and questioned his ability to steer them through potential calamities.
However, Bobby, relying on his tenacity and naval acuity inherited from his days in the Navy, won over their trust.
As he efficiently navigated their vessel and thriving adversity, Bobby found himself facing down the ghosts of his past.
His metamorphosing command style was a reflection of his internal change, reshaping his perception of his role during the war and easing his emotional turmoil.
The vocal admiration and acceptance of his crew began to have a healing effect on Bobby, eating away at the guilt he carried.
However, midway through their journey, an unforeseen storm struck.
The formidable freighter was tossed about like a toy, causing untold fear and chaos among the crew.
Amid the raging storm, the hefty freighter was comparable to a cork bobbing dangerously on tumultuous waves.
The crew, huddling close, shared wide-eyed expressions of terror.
Bobby, however, stood resolute at the helm, coaxing every ounce of courage within him, maneuvering the freighter expertly through the monstrous swells.
His steadiness in the face of sure calamity shored up the crew's faith in him.
The storm proved to be a catalyst for Bobby's reconciliation with his past, and the admiration he now commanded planted the seeds of self-confidence.
The crushing burden of guilt began to lighten as he accepted his past, the storm substituting self-doubt with self-worth.
The face of victory shone bright on their return to Piermont.
The once daunting freighter was now seen as a beacon of their triumphant journey.
Docked alongside, Bobby stood tall, emerging from the echoes of regret and guilt as a transformed individual, a beacon of resilience.
The voyage gave Bobby his redemption and in return, he gained the respect and admiration of his crew.
The crew, who had introduced themselves to Bobby with suspicion, now welcomed him back with enthusiastic admiration, acknowledging his courage and wisdom.
From a veteran haunted by his past, Bobby had transformed into not only a reliable seafarer but a compassionate leader.
Having made his peace with his past and forgiving himself, he resolutely looked forward harmonizing his future, unfettered by guilt.
With the ship safely at bay, Bobby, the man of the hour, retreated to the familiar warmth of The General's pub.
Together, they sat on the old, weathered wooden bench overlooking the sea, symbolic of the transformative journey Bobby had embarked upon.
Intrigued by the visible changes in the man, The General prodded Bobby about his experiences during the voyage.
Bobby, the raw emotions of his transformative voyage evident in his narration, recounted tales from the terrifying storm to the bravery of his crew.
His recounting mirrored his personal journey and the healing process, filled with tales of inner strength and personal victories.
Listening intently, The General puffed on his pipe, feeling a surge of pride for the resilient man Bobby had become.
Humbled by Bobby's courage and his journey to self-forgiveness, The General applauded and vowed his continued support.
As the sun made its descent, bathing the dock in hues of orange, they sat in tranquil silence.
They silently agreed on the deep significance of their scars, realizing their formative influence on their present and the unknowable impact on their future.

66416302.title: The Greatest Beer Run Ever
synopsis: In 1968, Marine Corps veteran John “Chickie” Donohue is a slacking merchant seaman who lives with his family in Inwood, New York City, and likes to hang out at a bar operated by a somewhat cynical old man dubbed “The Colonel”.
Chickie's sister Christine is strongly opposed to the Vietnam War in contrast to Chickie and their father, who also formerly served.

Upon learning that an old friend, Johnny, is killed in action, Chickie and friends attend his funeral and are informed that another close friend, Tommy Minogue, whom Chickie persuaded to join the draft, has gone missing in action.
After the funeral, Chickie and his friend Red find Christine in an anti-war demonstration and get into a brief physical altercation with some protestors.
Back at the bar, Chickie and Red talk about how they could lift their serving friends' spirits.
Chickie has an idea to go to South Vietnam himself and deliver his friends some beers.
The next day, Chickie appears to backtrack on this, but as Tommy's mother suggests Chickie take to her son a set of rosary beads if he finds him, he sets out on the trip against Christine's warnings.
Chickie signs on to a ship sailing to Saigon with a duffle bag full of Pabst Blue Ribbon cans in search of military policeman Tommy Collins.
He finds Collins, who is ecstatic to see him.
That night, Collins' superior officer comes in and chastises Chickie for delivering the beers, then suspects him to be a CIA agent.
Chickie and Collins' friends map out a plan for reaching Chickie's other friends, despite Collins urging Chickie to not put himself at risk in the battlefields and return to his ship.
With guidance from a local named Hieu, Chickie stops at the Caravelle Hotel, where he finds American and British reporters opposed to the war.

Using his CIA guise, he hitches a ride on a military caravan to Bien Hoa Air Base and is flown to Danang Air Base and then on to LZ Jane, where he searches for Rick Duggan, who is serving in the 1st Cavalry Division.
Duggan’s sergeant radios him to report to the command post, forcing Duggan to run in plain sight under enemy fire.
When Chickie surprises him, Duggan reacts angrily but allows Chickie to join him and his squad on the battlefield as they fire upon the Viet Cong from trenches.
When night falls, Chickie again passes around beers.
Duggan also tells Chickie that one of their friends, Reynolds, was killed.
After parting ways with Duggan in the morning, Chickie is put on a chopper with two CIA agents who brutally interrogate and throw out a prisoner.
Landing at Kontum Airfield, Chickie requests a ride to Saigon, and one officer explains that he may leave his post to escort Chickie to Pleiku Air Base.
When Chickie looks outside, he sees the officer standing by his vehicle has someone hiding in its backseat to ambush him.
Realizing the agents are after him, he runs into the jungle, hiding until the agents give up the chase.
Chickie walks alone and passes by a busted jeep and a child who runs away in fear with her mother.
Later that night, after nearly being trampled by elephants running from napalm, Chickie is found by another old friend, Kevin “Looney” McLoone.
Despite their orders to move in the opposite direction of where Chickie is headed, Chickie persuades McLoone and his men to drive him to Pleiku.
McLoone puts Chickie on a chopper, and Chickie throws him his beer as the helicopter ascends.
Back in Saigon, Chickie learns that his ship has left early due to warnings of an impending attack and is on the way to the Philippines.
Hieu gives Chickie directions to the U.S. Embassy, and he gives Hieu his address to visit him in New York.
At the embassy, a woman helps him book a flight to Manila the next day in order to rejoin his ship.
He returns to the Caravelle Hotel and shows the journalists photos as proof that he really went to LZ Jane.

As the Viet Cong suddenly invades Saigon in the surprise Tet Offensive, Chickie and photographer Arthur Coates explore the streets, where Chickie sees Hieu killed in the Viet Cong attack on US Embassy.
Chickie sees an armored car blow a hole in the embassy wall.
The next morning, Coates photographs the aftermath of the embassy attack and witnesses a huge explosion in the distance.

The two drive to the scene of the explosion at Long Binh Post, where Coates explains that the military would rather fake an entry hole in the embassy wall than admit that the attack was an inside job.
At Long Binh, Chickie looks for and shares a beer with one last wounded friend, Bobby Pappas, who confirms Tommy Minogue's death.
Chickie returns home with a changed perspective on the war.
Before drinking with his friends, he visits Mrs. Minogue to give her the rosary beads he was to give to Tommy.
Chickie takes responsibility for talking Tommy into enlisting and his ultimate death, but Mrs. Minogue forgives him with a hug.
In the park, he sits among the tributes for soldiers and shares his last beer with Christine.
The epilogue reveals that Collins, Duggan, McLoone, and Pappas all survived the war and returned home safely while Chickie went on to have a long career with the New York City sandhoggers union.
The film ends with a modern day photograph of the group gathered for drinks.

46782850.title: Departure Duo (film)
synopsis: Nestled in the rolling, verdant hills of a quiet Vermont hamlet, childhood friends Samuel and Leo cherish the giddy rush of the annual local silver birch fair.
While soaking in the fair's vibrant fervor, the friends take leisurely pauses in the shade of the silver birch trees.
Their shared laughter carries a strain of regret, echoing the looming news of Samuel's impending move to the lively city of San Francisco.

As the last echoes of celebration fade away with the dusk, the friends seek comfort within the dusty confines of Leo's antiquated attic—an intimate space where dreams were exchanged, and childhood mischief conceived.
By the dim, nostalgic light of the attic, the friends stumble upon a yellowed newspaper clipping.
The brittle piece of record detailed the unsolved case of two mysterious disappearances—two individuals who were uncannily similar to themselves.
The baffling resemblance transcended their physical traits; it delved deep, into the unspoken bond that they shared, knitting their lives together.
Looted by uncertainty and animated by a strange empathy, Samuel and Leo decide to delve deeper into the enigma.
They head to the village library, a grand old building that stood as proud as it was rich in the annals of their sleepy hamlet.
In that repository of untold stories, the friends unearth more anomalies, reinforcing the uncanny resemblance between them and the disappeared pair.
The coincidences they unravel rouse a sense of trepidation that they can no longer dismiss lightly.
Returning to their once idyllic hamlet, they now find it distorted by mysterious happenings that unsettle their quiet lives.
Their beloved village now seemed adorned with an invisible shroud of eeriness.
However, as they continue exploring the oddities connecting them to the disappeared duo, these tenuous links grow into incontrovertible leylines.
The ghostly 'showings' evolve in intensity to present spine-tingling spectral presences.
Haunted by the terrifyingly real doppelgängers that start shadowing their lives, the friends confront a horrifying revelation—they mirror the departed, in life and death.
Unwillingly tethered to their spectral twins, Samuel and Leo find themselves navigating a grim history.
They are led to the untold saga of the spirits' past, stained by the prejudice they had endured for their LGBTQ+ identities.
As the spectral parallels reveal themselves under the watchful gaze of the friends, a sorrow-filled past unveils itself.
A tale of ostracization, relentless bullying, and a woeful end was their lot merely for being true to their identities.
The interactions with the restless spirits grow more intense and depressingly tangible, making the spectral presences an unavoidable reality.
Encumbered by the tragedy they're privy to, Samuel and Leo pledge to transform their homogenous hamlet.
They vow to create a safer, more accepting environment—for the spirits of the departed, for themselves, and for future generations.
To honor their spectral counterparts and advocate for acceptance, they organize a public memorial.
It stands as a testament to the strength of those who lived their truth, regardless of societal norms.
They defiantly express their true identities before the entire community.
Despite their endeavors brimming with optimism, the supernatural disturbances persist.
Determined and undeterred, Samuel and Leo delve deeper into the cryptic behaviors of the restless spirits.
An epiphany dawns—they realize the answers hover in the shadows, tethered to the dusty crypts beneath the village’s ancient stone church.
A place of worship, decadently draped in gothic grimness, beckons them.
Driven by the urge to unearth the truth, they embark on a midnight exploration into its chilling silence.
They uncover a vile secret—the village's serene façade had shrouded a horrendous crime for decades.
The crypts lay bare a sordid history, teeming with artifacts and whispers of unspeakable violence.
These horrifying conserved pieces of the past expose the monstrous face of homophobia, engraved deep within the history of their home village.
The harrowing discoveries fit into their puzzle, unmasking an ominous conspiracy masterminded by influential village elders.
Horrified by their shocking discovery, the friends resolve to expose this dark truth.
A town meeting is called at the wooden community center, bearing the weight of their potentially destructive revelation.
They lay out the damning record of discrimination that had marred the hamlet's history.
As their damning evidence unravels, the town hall plunges into an uneasy silence.
A tempest of guilt, shock, and raw emotion engulfs the assembly.
Century-old secrets shatter their quaint tranquility, sparking a fervent demand for justice from the very souls they had been wronged.
Encouraged by enlightened youngsters and open-minded elders, the architects of the heinous crime stand trial.
Justice is sought, shining a ray of hope on the village's dark past.
The village, once entangled in the web of ignorance, now finds unity in the face of shared sorrow and regret.
The hamlet pledges to learn from its sins and paints a picture of promise on the canvas of the future.
The harrowing reveal begins to calm the supernatural disturbances, hinting that the tormented spirits are finally finding their peace.
A sense of fortitude overcomes the spectral specters, a sign of their journey towards liberation.
Tranquility gradually replaces the ominous darkness over the village, symbolizing the release of the spectral grasp.
The time of Samuel's departure to San Francisco dawns.
As the sight of him leaving threatens to shatter Leo's heart, Samuel vows to return to their newly evolving, broad-minded home.
The bus carrying Samuel eerily mirrors the phantom carriage of the past, creating a hauntingly beautiful parallel between their current reality and the spectral realm they had confronted.
Samuel's departure not only signifies a new chapter in his life but also indicates newfound acceptance for Leo and their incipiently progressive home.
Looking back at his village, Leo senses the silent novel-like gratitude of their spectral counterparts.
Their borrowed courage had transformed the village into a safer, more accepting place for future generations.
Despite the emotionally charged journey, Leo realizes their spectral guide led to a necessary transformation.
The unwavering affection between Samuel and Leo not only liberated their village from the spectral torment but also inspired a foundation for a more empathetic future.
The story ends with a heartening image of tranquility and liberation.

73210391.title: Swallowed (film)
synopsis: Two friends, Benjamin and Dom, are celebrating their last night together in a small Maine town before Ben flies to Los Angeles to become a gay porn star.
Dom, who is secretly in love with Ben and wants to show how much he believes in him, drives them to pick up a special going-away gift.
It turns out that Dom has agreed to do a drug run into Canada to make some money for Ben to help him set up his life in LA.
The contact, Alice, gives them the packages: five condoms containing an unknown substance.
She says Dom must swallow them.
When he refuses, she pulls a gun on him and makes him swallow four and Ben swallow the fifth.
She tells Dom to text her once the packages are out of their systems.
Across the border, the boys pull over at a rest stop so that Dom can pass the packages through in the toilet, but he has trouble doing so.
Randy, a homophobic redneck, enters and confronts Ben until Dom steps out to defend him.
Randy punches Dom in the stomach and leaves, slashing their tires on his way out.
Dom initially seems all right, but quickly begins to experience stomach pains.
Refusing to call the authorities, he excretes one of the packages, which has something moving inside it.
Ben takes Dom back to the truck, but Dom starts to lose the feeling in his legs and begins to get an uncontrollable erection.
Ben calls for an ambulance just as Alice, alerted by a text sent earlier by Dom, arrives and makes him hang up.
Alice takes the boys in her truck, and explains that the condoms contain larvae with venomous bites that get people high.

She takes them to a woodland cabin owned by her boss, Rich, intending to collect the packages from their stools, but when Rich calls to say he is coming to the cabin, she panics and tells Ben to fish them out of Dom with his fingers.
Ben manages to get one package out before Rich – an older gay man – arrives.
He is immediately attracted to Ben, but reacts poorly when Dom demands the money.
He puts his gun in Dom's mouth and tells Ben to get back to work.
When Alice tries to talk him down, he tells her to leave.
Ben extracts all but one of the packages.
Dom begins to scream in pain and convulse, and Rich retrieves the last condom from Dom – but it is broken and the bugs are still inside him.
Dom, overdosing on the venom, falls unconscious.
Alice returns, feeling guilty after hearing Dom's cries, and an increasingly upset Rich refuses to let her take Dom to the hospital.
Alice and Rich go outside to discuss matters.
Dom regains consciousness and Ben kisses him, but Dom dies shortly afterwards.
There is a gunshot and Rich returns, saying Alice pulled a knife on him.
Rich begins to cry, and tells Ben that he is not a bad person.
He demands Ben agree.
Ben does, robotically, and Rich immediately lightens up.
Rich runs a bath, and tells Ben to take off his clothes and go in the bathroom.
Ben retrieves a sharp pair of tweezers – the nearest thing to a weapon – and gets in the bath just as Rich enters, still armed.
Rich begins to wipe Ben down with a washcloth and makes small talk; Ben, biding his time, asks what it is like when the bugs bite.
Rich says it is a full-body experience; "you can feel everything, you just can't move".
Rich, trying to placate Ben and in the hopes of seducing him, offers him all the money Alice and Dom would have got: $15,000.
Ben charms Rich into letting him put on his underpants, shoes and a jacket before stabbing him in the neck with the tweezers and fleeing.
Without the keys to the trucks, however, Ben is stranded.
He escapes to a nearby waterfall, where the final condom leaves his system.
Ben returns to the cabin, and watches Rich dump Alice's body down the outhouse toilet.
Ben sneaks into the house and when Rich returns, he subdues Rich with a poker, grabs the gun and makes one of the larvae bite him.
Ben washes Dom's body in a river and cradles him quietly.
Then he drags the now-paralyzed Rich to the outhouse and, ignoring the man's pleas, dumps him down it.
Over the credits, Ben is seen being interviewed on the red carpet at the fictional Squirty pornography awards, where he is up for best newcomer.
He emotionally thanks "all the people who believed in me".

4577694.title: Extra Dwelling Intruder (2023 film)
synopsis: The film plot begins to unfold as Dylan Hendricks, who's navigating the arduous world of law, and his partner Naomi O'Sullivan, a gifted painter renowned for her works, find themselves wrestling with numerous personal and legal dilemmas, which are primarily due to their struggle with substance addiction.
Driven by a desire for solace and rehabilitation, they purchase a secluded 20-acre estate in the tranquil wilderness of Montana.
Their newly acquired property provides an escape from the bustling city life of New York, offering them a serene space for healing and transformation.
As they grow accustomed to their expansive property, they stumble upon an undisclosed rustic cabin, hidden within the lush, emerald-green pine woods.
In an attempt to unravel the mysterious origin of the cabin, they approach their real estate agent, Madeline Stone.
After prodding, Madeline hesitantly admits that Eddie Thornton, a former heroin-addict with no legal claims over the property, has been residing in the cabin.
Surprisingly, rather than being taken aback or infuriated, Dylan and Naomi permit Eddie to persist in his unusual home.
However, Eddie’s eccentric behaviour and peculiar routines begin to disrupt Dylan and Naomi's anticipated serene lifestyle.
Eddie's untypical lifestyle includes bizarre friends such as a boisterous, retired clown and a flame-swallowing stunt artist.
Their peaceful slumber is abruptly disturbed when Eddie starts playing African Djembe drums in the early fervour of dawn.

The comedic exploits hit an unforeseen peak when a friendly Golden Retriever, digging enthusiastically in their backyard, unearths bagfuls of Eddie's old illicit substances, instigating a full-scale police raid that disrupts their tranquil mountain life even further.
Due to his troubled past, Dylan regularly joins Narcotics Anonymous meetings.
Eddie, misunderstanding these gatherings, naively treats them as casual social meets.
Eddie's innocence leads him to thoughtlessly introduce marijuana to the group meeting, causing uproar.
Spurred by a mixture of curiosity, frustration and intrigue, Dylan and Naomi decide to delve into Eddie's dwelling.

To their astonishment, they discover an elaborately hidden system incorporated within the cabin, designed to conceal a valuable collection of baseball cards and pre-second World War stamps stolen over the years.
They start piecing together patterns of Eddie's turbulent past, which reveals how his peculiar hobby had helped him navigate through his strenuous journey towards recovery.
Instead of being repelled by Eddie's eccentricities, they find common ground in their past and hopes for sobriety, forging an unexpected connection through shared stories.
Eddie’s life experiences are initially bewildering, yet his street-smart sensibilities support Dylan in facing his own addiction history, facilitating a process of reconciliation.
Their lives take an unforeseen twist when Eddie is abruptly abducted by a local biker gang seeking to lay their hands on his hidden collectables.
Driven by a sense of camaraderie and brotherhood, Dylan and Naomi decide on an audacious plan to free Eddie, embarking on a wild adventure in their rugged old Jeep.
Despite numerous roadblocks and comedic diversions, their fierce determination clinches their victory, and they manage to free Eddie from the dreary confines of a dilapidated bar's basement.
This shared adventure brings them to the realization that Eddie has become more akin to a family member than a mere intriguing outcast.
Back at their estate, their triumph brings newfound fulfilment and solidarity within their uniquely formed family.
To make their connection official, they extend an invitation to Eddie to abandon the shack in the woods to become a permanent fixture at the main house.
The film concludes on a quirky twist, revolving around the discovery of another unexpected squatter - a reclusive potter found living tranquilly in a treehouse on the banks of their river.
Welcoming their reality with humor, Dylan, Naomi, and Eddie burst into shared hearty laughter, preparing for their next series of misadventures.

60915120.title: Guest House (2020 film)
synopsis: Three years after getting in trouble for drug use in College, Blake Renner and his girlfriend, Sarah Masters, move into a house with an excellent backyard and a guest house; however, the realtor reveals that there is one catch: a drug-addict-turned-squatter named Randy Cockfield who is living in the guest house collecting drugs and priceless artifacts.
Blake works at a Skateboard shop run by Shred, while Sarah works as a school teacher.
After two months, Randy is still there.
He finds a wild possum and captures it.
Blake and Randy talk to each other and smoke Cannabis.
Sarah is annoyed by the issues and her father, Douglas Masters, does not approve of her relationship with Blake.
Blake proposes to Sarah and she accepts, despite her fathers disapproval.
Six months later, Randy is still there and Blake and Sarah are fed up.
Randy organizes an orgy, and when Blake tries to stop them he is drugged and destroys a gazebo shooting fireworks into the sky.
Following the incident, Blake is arrested by corrupt cops, who are friends of Randy.
A turf war starts between Randy and Blake.
Blake assaults Randy and is arrested and bailed out again.
The corrupt cops allow Randy to get a restraining order from Blake.
Randy sneaks into the couple's house and injects MDMA in their water bottles, altering their behavior and resulting in uncontrolled sexual activity which results in Blake getting fired.
With more time on his hands, Blake hires a crew to bug-bomb the guest house, causing Randy to have to escape for medical reasons.
With Randy gone, Blake and Sarah organize a quiet dinner in the backyard.
Randy returns and releases a drug-addicted possum with rabies on them, and the group are bitten by the possum, leading to the need of rabies injections.
One member ends up in the emergency room due to the severity of the bites.
Blake and Sarah organize their wedding in the backyard and, despite her father's objections, the wedding proceeds and the couple is married.
Randy puts MDMA in their drinks, causing the wedding guests to behave abnormally and cause home damages.
Blake finds Randy hidden in the attic and attempts to beat him to death until Douglas stops him and beats him.
Randy and Blake are arrested and Sarah bails Blake out.
Sarah also reveals that she's pregnant with Blake's son.
Blake finds a new job and the two are separated until they are asked to return for questioning about the house.
They find Randy and make peace, officially ending their turf war.
He explains that he repaired the home damages with money made from selling a priceless artifact from his collection which was worth millions.
Randy explains that the house was originally owned by his parents and he had been preventing it from being sold because of his childhood memories.
Randy shows that he has redesigned the guest house into a room for their baby and that he wants a family to live in the house.
Randy leaves, and the two newly-weds move in and start to raise their son in the house.
They eventually get a video chat from Randy who is now partying on a Yacht.
He claims that he and his companions will be coming to the guest house.
Blake and Sarah say that they won't allow him to squat in the guest house again.

68339631.title: The Hive (2020 film)
synopsis: Our cinematic journey commences with a montage of scenes showcasing the life of the Thompsons.
John is a vigorous character, constantly engrossed in the technical maze of his independent software firm.
Sarah is a professional watercolor artist, passionately engrossed in her work.
Kate, is an architecture student diligently building her dreams, while Charlie, the youngest, is adorably obsessed with Legos.
Kate receives a mysterious phone call shrouded in anonymity that hints at her mum's past relationship and momentously alters the course of the narrative.
Kate, burdened by the knowledge of her mother's affair and her own unclear origins, feels estranged.
Under the veil of the night, she immerses herself in the stories told through Sarah's old letters, memorabilia, and vintage photographs.
Among the scattered evidences of Sarah's bohemian past, Kate stumbles upon the repeated references of a man named James.
As she pieces together scattered glimpses of her mother's past, she realizes her connection with James and uncovers her own biological roots.
Simultaneously, Sarah senses the walls growing between her and Kate.
Unable to face her guilt, she attributes this to Kate's burgeoning independence instead of her closely guarded past.
On a scavenger hunt around the house, Charlie unexpectedly tumbles upon a letter scribbled by Kate, addressing James.
Charlie, although the younger one, deciphers the crux of the message and is jolted by the revelation that Kate is his half-sibling.
But this shocking discovery fortifies their bond, paving the way for a new alliance.
Gathering his innocent courage, Charlie confronts Kate about the disturbing discovery, pledging his support in her quest for truth and reconciliation.
Emboldened by their newfound solidarity, the siblings decide to embark on an unplanned expedition to meet James.
They encounter James in a bohemian coffee shop nestled among the bustling streets of New York.
James, a seasoned watercolor artist with mannerisms reminiscent of Sarah, is initially shocked by the sudden revelation of his previously unknown offspring.
Despite the initial shock, James reconciles himself to the disturbing truth, fostering a budding camaraderie with Kate and Charlie while sharing tales from his past relationship with Sarah.
In the midst of his Sunday cleaning routine, John discovers the concealed letter, a grim revelation alluding to his wife's past and his children's unannounced expedition.

Overwhelmed by the shocking discovery, John gives in to his simmering anger and confronts Sarah, catapulting them into a heated argument, culminating in an unprecedented silence in their once harmonious relationship.
The house gets engulfed with an icy tension and unsaid accusations.
Returning from their soul-searching journey, Kate and Charlie meet the impending storm brewing between their parents with shell-shocked expressions.
Yet, they find strength in their newfound reality.
Kate musters the courage to shatter her silence, deciding to share her life-altering journey and the revelations about her birth and her ties with James.
As the family plunges deep into emotional turmoil, a confrontation of seismic proportions takes place, laying bare all the secrets that have been skulking in the shadows.
Sarah's past has finally caught up with her.
Overwhelmed, she confesses about her past mistakes, breaking down as she begs John and her children for forgiveness.
Facing the wave of shocking revelations, the Thompson family decides to stick together, to face the implications of the secrets, and to understand their new family dynamics.
Despite the initial shock of the revelations, they decide to weather the storm together, vowing to face their new reality as a tightly knit family.
As a gesture of reconciliation with Sarah over her previous misgivings, John extends his acknowledgement of the situation, pledging forgiveness towards his remorseful wife.
Similarly, Kate and Charlie decide to accept the reality of their half-sibling relationship, and open their hearts to welcome James into their unique family mosaic.
As a symbolic start to this shared journey, they cordially invite James to their Christmas celebration.
Initially reluctant, James soon accepts the invitation.
John, extends a friendly handshake to James, who is visibly moved by this reception.
Sarah and John steal a private moment under the mistletoe, taking a step towards mending the chasm created by past secrets.
Kate and Charlie, now comprehending the complexities of their mother's past, rekindle their relationships with her.
The reinvented and resilient Thompson family manages to find balance amidst the chaos, their shared experiences fueling a newfound camaraderie.
Kate and Charlie welcome James in their annual family portrait.
John, with his ability to forgive and accept the inherited family circumstances, restores the home to its former warmth.

57246760.title: The Nest (2020 film)
synopsis: In the late 1980s, Rory and Allison O'Hara live a middle-class life in NYC with their kids Samantha 'Sam' and Benjamin 'Ben', the former born from Allison's previous relationship.
Allison teaches horseback riding, while Rory works as a trader.
Believing his opportunities in the States are limited, Rory persuades Allison to relocate with him to London, where he plans to return to the firm of his former employer Arthur Davis.

Despite Allison's initial misgivings, the family moves into a huge old mansion in Surrey where Rory persuades Allison to start a horse farm on the property and brings her horse, Richmond, over from the States.
Construction begins on a stable while Ben and Sam are enrolled in separate schools.
Rory later takes Allison to high-class dinner parties with Arthur and his colleagues.
However, the family has some difficulty adjusting, as their secluded location and respective commutes make it difficult for the children to get to school on time.
Several weeks later, construction abruptly stops on the stable.
Learning that Rory never paid the builders, Allison discovers that his bank account is nearly empty.
Rory promises he will have money soon, but Allison is forced to provide for the family by cutting into her hidden cash fund.
Allison bristles at Rory's efforts to appear high-class while they remain nearly broke.
At work, Rory proposes that Arthur sell his company to a larger American firm looking for a London office.
After brief consideration, Arthur refuses.
Back at the mansion, Richmond collapses in pain and Allison is forced to go to a neighbouring farmer, who puts the horse down.
Rather than go home following Arthur's rejection, Rory pays a visit to his mother, who shows no interest in his family and accuses Rory of abandoning her.
Rory returns home late and gets into an argument with Allison over their financial woes and Rory's reckless, delusional behaviour.
In order to provide income to the household, Allison begins working as a farmhand.
Allison's relationships with her children also become strained when Sam makes some disreputable friends and Ben gets into a fight with some school bullies.
Rory and his colleague Steve arrange a potentially lucrative deal with a Norwegian fish-farming corporation.
That night, he and Allison attend a dinner with Steve and their prospective clients while Sam and her friends throw a house party.
As the party gets out of control, Ben flees outside and witnesses Richmond's carcass being pushed to the surface of the grave due to improper burial.
During the dinner, Allison openly mocks Rory before leaving the restaurant, taking the car and getting drunk at a nightclub.
Rory attempts to downplay Allison's behaviour but his clients opt to go into business with Steve while cutting him out.
Rory tries to take a taxi back to Surrey and confesses his many indiscretions to the driver, claiming his job is "pretending to be rich".
With Rory's confessions making it clear that he is both broke and a liar, the driver anticipates that he will be unable to pay for the long fare and leaves him in the middle of nowhere.
The next morning, Allison wakes up hungover in her parked car and drives home, finding the house trashed after the party.
Ben shows her Richmond's grave, where the carcass has risen almost completely to the surface.
As Allison breaks down over the grave, Sam and Ben agree to make breakfast.
Rory finishes the long walk home and finds his family seated at the table.
He starts proposing a new business idea and another relocation, but Allison tells him to stop.
Rory starts to break down and cry.
Sam hugs him, then prepares a seat for him with them.

22415370.title: Connection: Survival Mode
synopsis: We meet our six friends, Sarah, Lauren, Ava, Emily, Madelyn, and Max, in varying snapshots of the mundanity of quarantine life.

Today's session starts off as it always does – a mix of quarantine trivia, reminiscing about lost experiences; closed movie theaters, canceled trips, and just the profundity of the blameless world they missed.
Amidst the chatter, an alert pops up on Lauren's screen; the computer science whiz has received an email from an unknown sender.
The email contains a link to an online game named 'Survival Mode'.

Presenting this peculiar finding to the group during the call, Lauren breathes quiet excitement into an otherwise monotonous day – an online multi-user game promising adrenaline-fueled escapism from the tedium of quarantine.
After an extensive discussion, during which the desire for excitement battles the caution of internet safety, the friends decide to dive into the unknown and play the game.
With strange enthusiasm, they begin their journey into 'Survival Mode'.
However, their initial excitement is slightly dulled as their screens begin to flicker with strange pixels and indecipherable glitches.

Static distorts Lauren’s webcam and among the chaos, horrifying glimpses of faceless entities briefly appear on her Macbook before disappearing, Ava and Max, hear eerie, unexplainable sounds of whispers and far-off thunderstorms.
Despite these unsettling occurrences, they attribute it to game ambiance and decide to play on.
The game, now truly underway, directs them to perform tasks that need to be accomplished within their respective homes.
The tasks start innocuously, merely causing minor disruptions to their households like turning off lights or rifling through papers to locate an old yearbook.
Yet as time ticks on, each task intensifies in danger, creating an environment of pervasive tension, a stark contrast to the safety they previously found in their homes.
Emily, the daring athlete amongst them, stumbles during a task involving retrieving a necklace from her dark, unsettling basement.
The failure takes an immediate toll on Emily, as her lively personality begins to fade toward a terrifying unpredictability, and her usual flush of health drains from her face.
Alarmed by Emily's transformation, the friends start to question the invasive effects of this supposed game.
Their doubts only grow as the game continues to unfold, dishing out darker and more personal tasks; forcing them to confront their deepest fears.
Soon, Madelyn, Ava, and Lauren follow Emily, falling victim to the game which now preys on them, escalating the horrors they each experience.
In a desperate attempt to regain some semblance of control, Sarah, who studies psychology, and Max, a literature major, try to pull the plug on the game.
Their efforts, however, prove pointless, with the game resisting their frantic attempts at uninstallation.
'Survival Mode' wields an iron grip over their lives, turning their once safe homes into a perpetual house of horror.
Recognizing the looming threat and with no escape in sight, Sarah proposes a solution – they must beat the game.
Now on the precipice of desperation, the group, though fearful, accept Sarah's proposed strategy as their last remaining lifeline.
Armed with a plan, they get back into the game, analytically dissecting the rules and patterns underlying their personal ordeal.
As they delve deeper, the game bears the full extent of its teeth, revealing a terrifying game-scape filled with each player's worst nightmares.
Their resilience is continuously tested as the challenges escalate, featuring physical threats and psychological trickeries designed to erode hope.
With each breath, they uncover layers of trauma deeply embedded within themselves, and their survival hangs by these very revelations.
The climax is a brutal psychological battleground where they are forced to confront their deepest, darkest fears.
After countless spine-chilling confrontations and drained of emotional energy, only Max and Sarah stand defiantly against the horrors of the game.
Utilizing all the patterns they've analyzed and exploiting weaknesses they've identified, they successfully navigate to the game's final stage.
They've survived the terrifying journey imposed by 'Survival Mode', but at a cost that weighs heavy on their souls.
Eventually, Sarah, Max, and their remaining friends slowly try to pick up the pieces of their pre-pandemic lives.
The terror they endured is seared into their subconscious, leaving each of them with deep psychological scars that may never fully heal.
Their world is forever changed, having lost friends, confronted unspeakable horrors, and endured traumas far worse than their darkest nightmares.
Their eventual return to virtual college life manifests a fragile return to normalcy, even as the specter of 'Survival Mode' looms relentlessly over their lives.
Their bond deepens in this shared tragedy as they grapple with residual nightmares and endure the healing process together.
Just as they dare to dream of recovery, Sarah's peace is shattered; she receives another email, ominously introducing a new update of 'Survival Mode'.
The film concludes with a zoomed shot on Sarah's taut face suggesting that their nightmare may not have reached its conclusive end.

64703403.title: Host (film)
synopsis: During a July 2020 COVID-19 lockdown in London, friends Haley, Jemma, Radina, Emma, Caroline, and Teddy join the weekly Zoom call they have been using to stay in touch.
Haley has arranged for them to partake in a virtual séance led by the medium Seylan, who emphasises that they should not disrespect the spirits, though only Haley takes it seriously.
Teddy is forced to leave the call when his girlfriend Jinny disconnects him.
Jemma claims to feel intense tension around her neck and begins to cry, explaining that she feels the presence of a school friend who killed himself by hanging.
Seylan's internet cuts out and disconnects her from the call, prompting a laughing Jemma to admit to the group that she made her deceased friend up because she was getting bored, which angers Haley.

The remaining members begin to experience terrifying phenomena: Haley's chair is violently pulled backwards by an unseen force, the legs of a hanging corpse briefly appear in Caroline's attic when she goes to investigate a noise, and Emma's wine glass shatters even though nobody is holding it.
Haley points her instant camera down the hallway to take a photo of her living room, which shows a ghostly figure hanging from the ceiling.

As the girls panic, Haley manages to get back in touch with Seylan and tell her what happened, prompting Seylan to ask the spirit a series of yes or no questions; using this method, she quickly confirms that the spirit is not a friendly one.

Seylan explains that Jemma's prank, which involved fabricating a deceased person, may have led a tulpa to take on the guise of the deceased person and wear his identity like a mask that allows the demon to pass into the world of the living.
She gives them instructions on how to close the séance, but the demon interrupts her and she is disconnected again before the girls attempt to close the circle using her advice.
Relieved that the ordeal seems to be over, the members of the group begin to leave the call.
Radina leaves the room, unaware of her boyfriend Alan's body hanging behind her.
Caroline's Zoom background, which shows a looping video of her doing chores, continues playing as the real Caroline suddenly has her face smashed into the camera.

Forgetting to switch off a filter that superimposes masks and face paint onto her, Emma turns her camera towards her living room, where the filter places a kabuki mask on an invisible figure which then turns to look at her.
She runs away and scatters flour on the floor, showing the footprints of the demon approaching her.
Her kitchen cupboards burst open before the demon attacks her, but she escapes into her bedroom.
Radina attempts to flee after Alan's body drops down behind her, but the demon kills her by throwing her into the wall.

Noticing that Caroline is typing gibberish in the chat, Haley and Jemma watch as her camera turns back on to show her being killed by the demon repeatedly smashing her head into her keyboard while she pleads for help.
Haley and Jemma argue and blame each other before Haley is pulled out of the room.
Jemma, who lives around the corner from Haley, immediately leaves her home to help.
Teddy returns to the call to see that only Emma remains, and a warning pops up to remind the group that the call will end in 10 minutes unless they upgrade to the premium version of Zoom.
Unaware of everything that has occurred, Teddy believes Emma is pranking him, but he is attacked by the demon after it takes the form of a horrifying humanoid figure.
He is chased into his garden, where he sees Jinny being lifted into the air before her neck is snapped and her body falls into the swimming pool.
He runs away and hides, using a lighter to see where he is going, but the demon distracts him with an eerie music box his brother used to prank him with as a child.
The demon then knocks him down and he drops the lighter, causing a fire that burns him to death.
Emma, now the only person still active in the call, fearfully turns her camera towards the door of her room after it opens.
She throws a blanket, which drapes itself over an invisible human shape.
She opens her window to escape, but trips and falls to her death.
Jemma breaks into Haley's home and checks the Zoom call on Haley's laptop to see that Emma and Teddy are dead.

The demon smashes a wine bottle over her head and starts to destroy the kitchen, but she recovers and finds Haley hiding under her desk, with the pair attempting to escape the house using the flash of Haley's instant camera to light the way.
The demon appears in the final flash of light, taking the form of a mutilated human, and rushes at them as the Zoom call timer expires.

40177133.title: Viral Craze (film)
synopsis: Jack Johnson, an unnoticed Instagram influencer, pours the majority of his time into creating an array of content, varying from photography to videos, for his followers.

With the bitterness of discouragement circulating in his veins, Jack is engrossed in his motivation to find a remarkable and outstanding idea to astound the internet users and make them notice his work.
His zealous chase for a captivating concept leads him into a seemingly archaic and forgotten thrift store nestled in an obscure corner of the town.
While aimlessly exploring the store, a peculiar, antiquated tome, apparently centuries old, catches his eye.
With curiosity piqued, Jack decides to buy this ancient book, filled to the brim with esoteric supernatural rituals originating from an age and place far beyond his comprehension.
Ever eager for a rise in his follower count, Jack determines to perform one of these cryptic rituals live on an Instagram live-stream, hoping to pique the curiosity of internet dwellers.

As he performs the ritual, in the privacy of his apartment, strange phenomenon start occurring around him – lights begin to flicker erratically, and the room’s temperature takes a bizarre, sudden plunge.
Jack, however, decides to brush off these occurrences as mere coincidences.
The live-stream ends, and Jack finds himself enveloped in an eerily ominous aura of unease.
The newfound atmosphere of his apartment is unfamiliar and perturbing, wrapping him up like an unwelcoming cold shroud.

Ignoring his intuition and the odd aura pervading his apartment, Jack wakes up to the usual morning sunlight, only to almost choke on his coffee when he sees a surge of notifications on his smartphone.
The ritual clip that he had shared the previous night has attracted a colossal multitude of views, likes, and comments overnight.
His followers count has almost doubled, far beyond his wildest imaginations.
With surprise and euphoria coursing through him, Jack reels at the sudden realization of becoming an internet sensation overnight.
However, his joy quickly turns to dread as odd and disconcerting incidences spike around him.

These include inexplicable noises that ring through his apartment at odd hours, an unaccountable moving of stationary objects, and fleeting appearances of obscure, humanoid shapes that seemed to be there one minute and gone the next.
Fear begins to weave its way through Jack's newfound fame, intensifying with each passing day as the strange incidents don't just continue but also expand in their range and frequency.
The terrifying entity, which initially lurked in the shadows, confined to the cover of night, starts to make its presence known even during the day, turning Jack's life into a real-life terror novel.
Moving towards desperate measures, Jack approaches a renowned team of paranormal experts to seek help in shedding light on the uncanny occurrences.
The experts disclose to an astounded Jack that he has unknowingly and inadvertently summoned an ancient entity that feeds on fame and attention through his ritual.
As the revelation sinks in, Jack's world spins wildly as the experts further explain that his recent surge in popularity is directly contributing to the entity's growing power.
Jack can only watch helplessly as his life spirals into a chaotic whirlpool as the entity becomes increasingly violent, physically harming him, and creating a distance between him and his loved ones.
Driven to starve the entity of its power source, in a dramatic U-turn from his usual style, Jack starts posting embarrassing, embarrassing content, hoping to shake off his followers.
But to his horror, his strategy backfires as his followers find his self-deprecating antics amusing and down-to-earth, leading to an unintentional increase in his popularity.
The entity only appears to get stronger with this unexpected turn of events.
On the edge of despair, Jack suddenly receives an email from a mysterious woman named Sofia, who professed to master the skills and knowledge to free Jack of the entity's grasp.
Sofia suggests that Jack voluntarily give up his insta-fame, by confessing his exploits as a mere stunt.
She emphasizes on the genuineness required in his confession and warns him of the sacrifices he must make to restore order in his life.
With desperation taking over, Jack sets up his smartphone and begins livestreaming a heartfelt confession to his followers.
His heart races with anxiety as he tells them everything about the entity and pleads with them to stop fueling the entity by giving him attention.
Overnight, his follower count decreases from thousands to a few hundreds.
The withdrawal of attention causes the entity to weaken significantly and retreat to the shadows, stripped down to a fragment of its full power.
Spurred on by Sofia's advice and the decreasing online attention, Jack steels himself for a final showdown with the slowly retreating entity.
After a tense, sweat-filled confrontation, Jack miraculously manages to banish the entity completely into the void, leaving behind only its haunting memories.
Free at last, Jack reflects on the ramifications of his careless actions - primarily the damage caused to his mental health due to his relentless pursuit of internet fame.
He decides to step away from social media for a while to appreciate the simplicity and peace of a non-virtual life, free from the hassles of chasing fame.
He begins the task of wiping clean the remnants of his disgraceful virtual fame and the horrors it had attracted.
One by one, he deletes the posts that brought him overnight fame and the trouble that followed.
Jack recognizes the importance of seeking help and takes a proactive approach in rebuilding his mental fortitude.
A transformation begins to take over him as he emerges stronger mentally and emotionally from the terrifying ordeal.
As he heals, Jack slowly reaches out to his friends and family, who he had ignored in his race for fame.
He slowly rebuilds his relationships, prioritizing them over the virtual world where he had once sought validation.
Eventually, he finds comfort in his simple existence.
The need for validation slowly recedes, allowing him to appreciate the beauty in everyday life.
Jack makes a solemn promise to himself never to be enticed by the dazzle of fame and the artificial validation that might accompany it again.
Instead, he decides to give up his ambitious chase for Internet stardom, focusing his energy on personal growth and cherishing the beauty of an unembellished, simple life.
He experiences the refreshing feeling of his relationships overpowering the ephemeral thrill of internet fame, teaching him a lesson through a horrific, life-turning experience.
Slowly, but surely, Jack's life returns to its peaceful routine, the constant threat and fear of the entity now reduced to a distant memory, albeit a chilling one.
He makes his peace with his past, acknowledging the fear and anxiety that the ordeal had caused him, but also appreciating the valuable life lesson it had taught him.
Jack is finally leading a peaceful life, far removed from the tumultuous world of Instagram fame and its aftermath.
Despite the horrifying experience, he is grateful for the journey and the lesson it taught him about the volatile, unstable facets of fame.
In the final scene of the narrative, we see Jack basking in his newfound contentment, focusing on rekindling and nurturing the relationships that matter to him.
He reflects on his past mistakes, understanding the gravity of his foolish endeavor to seek fulfillment through artificial fame.
As the sun sets on the horizon, Jack is seen cherishing the peace and tranquility of his once tumultuous existence.
The need to impress anyone or gain validation is now replaced by the joy of living an average life.
The entity, now just a shadow in the corner of his bedroom, serves as a constant reminder of his past mistakes and the vow he has made to never repeat them.

62911766.title: Spree (film)
synopsis: A young man named Kurt Kunkle is obsessed with being a social media star and becoming viral.
A child he used to babysit, Bobby, is now an internet celebrity who frequently makes live streams and has high viewer numbers, making Kurt jealous.

Kurt finds work as a driver for a rideshare app called Spree, then fits out his car with cameras and begins a new Livestream titled "The Lesson", where he instructs viewers on how to become famous on social media.
Kurt starts picking up passengers and killing them with poisoned bottles of water that he hands out in his car to gain attention.
Despite this, he doesn't gain any viewers besides Bobby, who believes the killings are fake.
One of the passengers  Kurt accepts is Jessie Adams, a comedian with a large social media following.
Kurt is awestruck by Jessie, but she is unimpressed by Kurt and his obsession with gaining followers and leaves the ride.
Kurt later learns that Jessie will be performing in a comedy show that will be live-streamed to millions.
Kurt goes to Bobby's house, demanding that Bobby share Kurt's stream, but Bobby refuses and starts live streaming their argument, attracting a large audience.
Kurt kills Bobby and takes his gun before live streaming for Bobby's fans, who assume the murder is fake.
Kurt's father Kris asks him for a ride to a club where he is performing, claiming that a famous DJ called uNo will be there and promising that the DJ will tag Kurt in a photo.
When Kurt picks up Kris and takes him to the club, he approaches uNo; she initially refuses to tag him, but then asks him to take her to a taco truck with the promise of tagging him.
While waiting for Kurt to get her some food from the truck, uNo discovers Bobby's gun and poses with it on a Livestream before drinking some of the poisoned water and passing out.
After realizing this, Kurt attempts to drive away but is stopped by two police officers, who grow suspicious of him.
It is revealed that Kurt's murders have already become known to the public, with Kurt being called "The Rideshare Killer" after police are unable to identify him.
uNo, having survived drinking the poisoned water, wakes up and panics, shooting dead one of the officers before fleeing, pursued by the second officer.
Kurt tries to flee, but he too is pursued by more police, forcing him to escape while crashing his car through a homeless camp.
With Kurt's murders becoming more well-known, Spree is temporarily shut down to allow an investigation to take place.

Jessie begins her show, by performing a bit about her encounter with Kurt and how disgusted she is by people's desperation for social media fame before concluding her set by destroying her phone on stage, followed by a mic drop.
Her actions cause her speech to go viral.
After getting drunk, she is picked up by Kurt via another rideshare app called GoGo, with Kurt having killed the previous driver.
Kurt gloats that as Jessie destroyed her phone on stage, she has no way of calling for help; she tries to escape after learning he is taking her to his house.
Unable to get out of the car, Jessie garrotes Kurt with a charger cable, causing them to crash, but Kurt recovers and beats Jessie unconscious.
He arrives at his house and places Jessie's unconscious body outside before being requested by his now-eager viewers to kill Jessie.
Distracted by a faulty camera, Kurt doesn't notice Jessie regaining consciousness.
She manages to take control of the car and crashes into Kurt's house while trying to run him over.
Kurt flees into the house while Jessie is confronted by an intoxicated Kris.
The pair discover Kurt's dead mother, who had been killed by Kurt at the start of his Livestream.

Kurt shoots his father dead and tries to kill Jessie, but she pins him to the wall with his car and beats him to death with a phone, takes a selfie with his dead body, and posts it on her Instagram account.
Jessie becomes a nationwide star after taking credit for disrupting Kurt's rampage, while Kurt and his killings become revered in small corners of the internet.
A user in one of these corners announces they have finished compiling Kurt's killings into a film and have titled it "Spree".

86227273.title: Warrior's Quest: Chronicles of the Uncharted Realm
synopsis: Our epic starts in the imposing Castle Helgastoria, an architectural wonder that stands as a beacon for an uncommon flock of novice warriors.
Taking command of this sea of potential is their venerable master, Ragnar - Highguard the fierce.
In the great expanse of the castle's grand hall, the lively clatter of training skirmishes resounds.
Observing their youthful overconfidence, Ragnar decides to share his wisdom, cautioning their heedless zeal.
His words seem to impact them differently than intended; instead of curbing their impetuousness, his teachings serve to ignite their relentless determination.
As dawn breaks, an unexpected visitor arrives at the gates of Castle Helgastoria.
A courier bearing the king's emblem extends an official decree to Ragnar, imposing an unusual task upon his unrefined warriors - to explore an uncharted northern expanse of their kingdom.
The decree brings forth a startling revelation - the existence of a celestial dragon, an entity symbolizing unparalleled power, rumored to reside within this unscathed land.
Hastily stuffing their battle armor, sharp swords, and grand ambitions into rigid leather rucksacks, the group of novices embarks on a journey riddled with untold perils and uncertainties.
The way to the unsullied northern territory proves far from easy.
Despite managing to secure victory after every fight, surviving each bout with these horrors comes with a painful realization.
It chips away at their inherent stubbornness and forces them to question and reassess their self-proclaimed invincibility.
Midway through their journey, they accidentally stumble upon a relic of the past.
This is an ancient fort once belonging to the Stone Hundred, its archaic walls adorned with runic inscriptions brimming with knowledge obscured by the passing of ages.
With immense difficulty, they manage to decode these intricate runes.
They narrate tales of the celestial dragon's awe-inspiring capabilities and, surprisingly, hint at a few potential vulnerabilities in the seemingly invincible beast.
The daunting revelation surrounding the dragon freezes their blood in their veins, instilling a sliver of uncharacteristic fear into their steadfast determination.
The once unyielding warriors now display signs of apprehension.
However, these feelings are promptly dispelled through mutual reassurances and shared trust, cementing their bond with newfound strength.
Crossing the border into the uncharted land, the debut greeters to the virgin territory prove to be the dragon's fiercely formidable wyvern minions.
Engaging these brutal creatures exhausts their physical strength and mental resilience, pushing them to their utmost limits.
Their underpowered prowess triumphs in the end, but only after a grueling test of their endurance.
The trials and tribulations on their journey teach them valuable lessons about humility and the importance of strategy.
They pore over the decrypted runes, seeking to adapt the exposed vulnerabilities of the celestial dragon into their impending fighting strategies.
Battle plans crafted and spirits rejuvenated, they dedicate themselves to a regimen of rigorous combat drills.
With anxious hearts thudding against their armors, they confront the fated day of the celestial confrontation.
The celestial dragon reveals itself in all its awe-inspiring glory - effortlessly deflecting their combined attacks and retaliating with life-threatening physical force.
Yet, empowered by their raw determination and calculated strategies, the tide of battle gradually starts shifting in their favor.
Reaching an awe-inducing climax, they exploit the dragon's unprotected underbelly, delivering a knock-out blow, finally bringing down the celestial titan.
From being considered merely intrepid rookies, they've transitioned to revered heroes, their epic tales of valor now comfortably nestled within Helgastoria's enshrined legends.
The narrative soon takes a twist with the disclosure of another unexplored territory of Byzandium hinting at another awaiting quest.
Emboldened by their newfound mastery, enhanced prowess, and a wellspring of confidence, the ex-rookies eagerly anticipate the forthcoming challenges.
Echoes of their nascent warrior days bounce off the castle's walls, dancing with the current victorious battle cries.
The visionary who orchestrated their transformation, their master Ragnar, upholds an elevated status in their hearts as the mentor who paved the path for their transformation into true warriors.
They've transformed into seasoned warriors, hardened by combat, ready to carve pathways for their future.
Wearing subtle smiles of pride and fueled by an undying tenacity, they ready themselves, mentally and physically, for the dawn of their unfolding saga.
With a time of peace upon them, their swords remain burnished, their strategies diligently analyzed, ever prepared to face the aberrant worlds that lie ahead.
Castle Helgastoria stands taller than ever.
It guards not just the warriors, but also the heroic tales of their unprecedented triumph.
Once merely reactive, their minds now meticulously calculate and assess risks, derive wisdom-driven decisions, their hearts pulsating steadily with courage.
From untrained rookies, they stand now as legends, each warrior boasting a formidable reputation that is both feared and respected.

68281309.title: Monster Hunter: Legends of the Guild
synopsis: Before Monster Hunter: World, as the Fifth Fleet makes its way across the Great Sea to the New World, a group of young hunters aboard the flagship begin to brag about the upcoming battle against the Elder Dragon, Zorah Magdaros, only to be silenced by Aiden, a veteran hunter.
Hoping to humble the youngsters, Aiden recounts his first encounter with an Elder Dragon.
Ten years ago, Aiden was a teenager living in a small mountain village.
Since the village is so small and remote, the people cannot afford the time or money required to go to the nearest Guild-house whenever some minor monster causes problems.
Aiden had taken it upon himself to hunt down these monsters for his neighbors.
He is sent into the wild to find the monster that stole some livestock from the village, only to be almost eaten by a Velociraptor-like monster.

Aiden is rescued by Julius, a Hunter from the guild, and learns from him that the monster that took the livestock, an anthropomorphic, catlike creature called a Melynx, was the true culprit and the tracks Aiden was following were fake.
Aiden finds the hideout of the Melynx, named Nox.
Aiden captures Nox and brings him to the village to show Julius.

He soon learns from the Wyverian leader that an Elder Dragon, a monster that can devastate the environment and leave mass destruction in its wake, is on its migration path to the New World, which will bring it through Aiden's village.
Julius agrees to bring Aiden to see the Elder Dragon to confirm the upcoming attack so that the villagers will agree to evacuate.
Aiden, Julius, and Nox reach the site where the Elder Dragon was sighted.
The Elder Dragon is revealed to be a Lunastra, a Manticore-like Elder Dragon that can cause explosions.
Aiden decides to have the whole village fight off the Lunastra instead of fleeing from it.
Though it's against his protocol, Julius decides to stay with the village and fight off the Lunastra as well, shooting a signal flare to call other Hunters.
Later, the trio meet up with two Hunters named Mae, the owner of a journal Nox stole, and Nadia, an old partner of Julius.
They agree to help with the fight against the Lunastra.
Information from a trapped villager leads them to the blacksmith Ravi, a retired Hunter who does not take kindly to strangers.
He refuses to help the party, saying that there is no light at the end of the tunnel if they fight the Elder Dragon.
They return to Aiden's village, letting everyone in on the plan to drive off the Lunastra.
During the preparations, the team attempts to hunt a Congalala, a primate-like monster, but are interrupted by a Deviljho, a savage Tyrannosaurid-like monster.
They manage to defeat both monsters, but Julius scolds Aiden for his reckless arrogance in failing to secure their trap for the Deviljho.
Later, in the village, Nadia tells Julius to go easy on Aiden because just like him, Julius made mistakes when trying to impress his master in the past.
Ravi meets up with the team, revealing he has changed his mind and decided to help fight the Elder Dragon.
Ravi, with the help of many other smiths, craft a super weapon using parts from the Congalala and Deviljho.
Once the preparations are complete, the villagers feast and await the siege.
During the fight, Ravi and Mae are killed by the Lunastra, but Aiden has an idea to burst the village dam to flood the village while the rest of the team distract the Elder Dragon.
The flood produced by the broken dam puts out the fire and repels the Lunastra from the village.
After dealing with Lunastra, Mae and Ravi are mourned.
Aiden then decides to join Julius and Nadia as an "Ace Cadet" to the distant town of Dundorma to become one of the Guild Hunters.
The film ends to the present day and sets up towards World.

65241158.title: Journal of a Timid Teen (2021 film)
synopsis: John Smith, an imaginative yet thoughtful 14-year-old, often unwinds in the quietude of his cozy room.
His evenings see him hunched over his worn, leather-bound journal where he meticulously pens down stories of his oddball family and curious neighbors, often peppered with his characteristic humor.
The true hero of his tales is his confidant and partner-in-crime, James Parker.

Known for their adolescent antics, they execute harmless pranks on the unsuspecting neighborhood, their infectious laughter echoing through the quiet streets, testament to their unbreaking camaraderie and shared joy.

Late at night, nestled into the plush comfort of his bed that is adorned with vibrant posters from various school sporting spectacles, John finds himself succumbing to a wave of unsettling anxiety about his transition from middle school into the intimidating world of high school.

Determined to avoid social ostracization, the introverted John, consumed with anxiety about the upcoming change, commits himself to overhauling his personality into something far removed from his natural, introverted inclinations.
However, his attempted tryst with an oncoming football smoothly spiraling towards him ends in an unpredictable fiasco.
He merely bumbles the ball, missing it by miles, and culminates the comical scene by slipping into a messy puddle of mud.
Drawing strength from his failures, John conjures up another plan involving Emily, the most desired girl at school.
Armed with little understanding of charm and even less of seduction, he effortfully tries to win her heart.
His first interaction with Emily is disastrously nerve-wracking.

He stammers his way through a mumbled introduction, promptly follows it up by accidentally soaking himself in the cola he was sipping on, a mortified expression graces his face as he swiftly exits the scene.
Amidst the self-imposed chaos of his life, John observes the normally jovial James embroiled in a heated standoff with the notoriously volatile neighborhood bully, Big Randy.
James had come to the defense of a terrified seven-year-old, attracting the wrath of Randy, which could inevitably spell trouble for both him and John.
Not one to abandon a friend in need, John, spurred by an unexpected rush of courage, intervenes in the volatile situation, joining his best friend against the imposing Randy.
However, his daring act merely serves to draw Randy's ire directly towards the duo, sparking an unfortunate chain of events that would inevitably lead to their punishment.
Dispirited by the challenging circumstances, John seeks solace in the comforting presence of his journal.
He pours out his anguished thoughts about his failed attempts at a personality makeover and the intimidating encounter with Randy.
In a moment of stark clarity, John realizes that his aspiration to "fit-in" doesn't necessitate a complete transformation of his persona.
Instead, he needs the right platform to illuminate his quirkiness and individuality.
The first day of high school finally arrives, igniting an atmosphere pulsating with a blend of eager anticipation and inherent fear of impending changes.
With a fluttering heart, John steps into the sprawling school building.
Much to his surprise, his eccentricities and attempts at transformation have unknowingly endeared him to his classmates, overshadowing his perceived awkwardness.
As the daunting day concludes, James joins John in a comforting camaraderie.
They affirm their support for each other, deciding to tackle future school challenges head-on, simply by staying true to their strengths – their shared love for mischief-making and humor.
Reflecting on the day's events, John realizes that defending his friends and embracing his authentic self were more courageous acts compared to the former image he’d held of courage.
With the school day finally put behind him, John eagerly returns home to continue his writing ritual.
The pages of a newly bought, well-crafted hardcover journal await his thoughtful introspection.
With a newfound confidence and acceptance of his quirks, John liberates himself from the chains of societal expectations and norms.
Thus, begins John's awe-inspiring journey of personal growth and acceptance.
Throughout the ordeals, he learns to embrace his eccentricities, bounce back from setbacks, and confidently navigate the rocky path of adolescence.

64771955.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid (2021 film)
synopsis: Best friends Greg Heffley and Rowley Jefferson are about to enter middle school.
Greg gets advice from his older brother Rodrick on how to "survive", putting emphasis on avoiding the Cheese Touch, which supposedly makes one incredibly unpopular.

Figuring that Rowley's childish tendencies will cause them to be bullied, Greg tries to urge Rowley to grow up, almost telling him about the cheese, but decides against it, not wanting to scare him too much.

Before long, the first day of school arrives, and Greg tries to help Rowley adjust, though both end up shunned by the majority of the students, mostly due to Rowley's somewhat childish antics, which include using the word "play" over "hang out."
Nevertheless, they manage to avoid scraping the bottom of the school hierarchy.
On Halloween night, Greg and Rowley are forced to take the former's younger brother Manny with them.
While at first annoyed, Greg realizes that Manny's adorable pirate costume allows them to acquire a large amount of candy.
Eventually, Manny and Rowley become tired, but Greg insists that they continue on and take a shortcut through Snake Road, despite his mother Susan forbidding it.
They encounter a trio of teenage boys who begin to mock and chase them with water balloons down the road.

The younger boys manage to evade them by tricking them into driving their truck into a ditch and making it home right on time, only to be soaked by Greg's father Frank, who mistook them for teenagers.
Manny then outs the Snake Road incident to Susan, who puts Greg on a weeklong video game ban as punishment.
Later on, while playing "rumble trike", Greg accidentally breaks Rowley's arm.
Susan discovers this but chooses not to punish Greg any further.
Instead, she encourages him do the right thing and be a good friend to Rowley.
Greg instead tries to take advantage of Rowley's broken arm, only to get shunned further by the other students, who dote on Rowley and demonize Greg for breaking it in the first place.
Greg attempts to take a different approach and become a cartoonist for the school paper; Rowley takes an interest in a scrapped idea of his, in which the punchline of every strip is "Zoo-Wee Mama!
", but Greg insists on a new one he drew, urging Rowley to make his own comic instead of working together.
Greg's entry gets him accepted as the new cartoonist, but the librarian butchers his comic, making his classmates mock him.
After Greg resigns from his position, Rowley's comic, which features the stolen phrase, gets accepted, causing the boys to argue and break their friendship.
Rowley befriends a boy named Chirag Gupta and starts seeing him more often.
In an attempt to get back at him, Greg decides to hang out with Fregley, an incredibly strange and unpopular boy.
Greg has a sleepover at his house but is immediately put off by his odd eccentricities.
The next day, Greg and Rowley confront each other and are urged to fight by the other kids, only for the trio of teenagers to return to get revenge on the boys.
The teenagers force Rowley to eat a piece of the cheese and are about to force Greg to do the same, but are saved by Mr. Underwood, the school's gym coach.
The other kids return to see what has transpired.
To protect Rowley, Greg claims that he was the one who ate the cheese, causing everyone else to run from him in terror.

Greg and Rowley resume their friendship as the former quickly realizes that having the Cheese Touch is a blessing as it forces everyone to give him and Rowley space, as well as a personal lunch table to themselves.

43169593.title: Digital Selflessness
synopsis: In the midst of the chaotic yet harmoniously resonant office of Digitech Solutions—abounding with myriad screens flashing lines of complex coding—we are introduced to our protagonist, Lucy.
A hardworking software engineer, she navigates her demanding profession with exceptional expertise, but there's a certain eclipse of discontent hung over her.
Lucy, with a sterling reputation among her colleagues for her uncanny ability to solve critical issues, finds herself in a constant whirl of tight schedules and back-to-back meetings.
Her life, consolidated in her stuffed Outlook calendar, is indicative of relentless pace characteristic of a tech-savvy New York City.

Lucy ceaselessly toggles between her draining professional life by day and her contemplative solitude by night, which finds her often gazing at the radiant Manhattan skyline through her apartment's floor-to-ceiling windows—reflecting upon a profound emptiness that she struggles to comprehend.
During a high-stakes executive meeting, Lucy's diligent intelligence never ceases to impress as she presents the company’s groundbreaking AI-driven initiative with zealous precision.
However, the close-ups of her expressive eyes betray a stirring realization surfacing within her.

Captured in a moment of poignant clarity, Lucy with an aura of dignity announces her resignation from her tech-dominated career, causing a wave of surprise that washes over her colleagues and fills the sleek, glass-lined meeting room with murmurs of unsettled whispers.
What follows is a series of scenes showing Lucy executing a radical lifestyle switch.

She auctions off her luxurious uptown penthouse along with its trappings of excess including high-end furniture, a formidable collection of abstract expressionist artwork, and an elaborate wardrobe of designer apparel.

Narrowing down her possessions to the essentials that fit snugly within a spacious backpack, Lucy fields a goodbye to the concrete jungle of NYC and embarks on a journey towards a rustic and unknown lifestyle.
Armed with curiosity tinged with apprehensiveness, Lucy makes her arrival in the quaint, untouched town of Harmony Springs, secluded deep within the serene landscape of Montana.

Her distinct presence in her Tesla Model S piques the curiosity of this small, simple community which humorously struggles to comprehend the sudden infiltration of metropolitan sophistication in their tranquil town.

With comical attempts at immersing herself into this drastic lifestyle shift, Lucy fumbles through rustic routines, seemingly mundane farm activities including feeding the chickens and learning the technique behind planting vegetables.

Her bewildered misuse of farm-related jargon arouses heartfelt laughter among the townsfolk and herself, weaving a delightful blend of sophisticated city life and endearing rustic charm into their daily interactions.

Amidst this rural serenity, her past life makes a sudden visit in the form of her impeccably-suited, city-based executive assistant who arrives with a suitcase filled with steadfast contracts, unsorted emails, and critical software glitches awaiting Lucy's attention.

Instead of reverting to her corporate ways, Lucy curatively tackles these looming issues through an innovative rural lens, causing a series of comedic episodes that have everyone, city assistant included, chuckling heartily.

In her efforts to resolve these complications, Lucy unwittingly incorporates the simple folks of Harmony Springs, forging an unexpected but intriguingly comical alliance between the simplistic organic living of Harmony Springs and the loftier corridors of the corporate maze.
