Over time, with the invaluable soft skills she picks up from her rural neighbours, Lucy successfully compartmentalizes her past corporate life while maintaining her distinct practicality.
Completely dedicating herself to Harmony Springs, Lucy taps into her stifled innovative spirit, leading a unique local endeavor—an initiative focused on community improvement.
Together with the townsfolk, she devises strategies using their rich traditions and hands-on methods, consciously steering clear of technological shortcuts.
An unexpected surge of followers on their barely used social media accounts jolts the villagers into a comically flabbergasted state.
Lucy, feeling the heat of their scrutiny, confesses her role in thrusting their small town into the digital realm, revealing her earnest intentions to give Harmony Springs a global identity.

Lucy's trials and tribulations in her new life take another twist when an old colleague from Digitech Solutions unexpectedly drops by, dangling an enticing offer to return to her glamorous life in Manhattan.
Lucy, however, politely declines the opportunity, unequivocally indicating her newfound fulfillment in leading a simple, meaningful life amidst Harmony Springs' calm rhythms.
This unwavering dedication to her new life earns Lucy the deep admiration and acceptance of the once skeptical residents of Harmony Springs.
Recognizing her genuine efforts, they extend a heartfelt welcome to Lucy, acknowledging and celebrating her as an official member of their quiet community.

The narrative draws to a close with scenes from a vivacious local fair, a WiFi-free zone, presided over by none other than Lucy where the townsfolk celebrate their town's newfound global prominence and the plethora of hilarious adventures that accompanied this drastic yet delightful transition.

57089154.title: Superintelligence (film)
synopsis: Eight years ago Carol Peters left her executive job at Yahoo in order to lead a more altruistic life.
Unsatisfied with the current job market in Seattle, she now lives day to day, doing non-profit work to advocate for the environment, care for animals and make the world a better place.
A friend and former colleague, Dennis, talks her into interviewing for a modern dating website.
An interviewer labels her “the most average person on Earth,” which is heard by an autonomous artificial intelligence or A.I.
The next morning, while at her apartment an all-seeing, all-knowing voice starts communicating with her through her TV, cell phone and rice maker.
The A.I.
takes on the voice of James Corden, as he is her favorite celebrity, to soothe her when she freaks out.
The supercomputer has become sentient and now is trying to decide whether to save, enslave or obliterate humanity and start over.
Carol, as his test subject, is the planet's only hope.
The A.I.
wants to study Carol and her interactions as a way to learn about humanity.
Telling Carol he'll be watching her over three days to decide, the A.I.
erases her student debt and deposits 10 million dollars into her bank account.
Suggesting she confide in Dennis, she goes to his work and A.I.
debriefs him.
A.I.
convinces Carol to get back with her ex-boyfriend, George, thinking observing their reconciliation would be the ideal way to prove humans are capable of love and redemption.
He presents her with a self-driving Tesla, which he operates to a high-end clothing designer to revamp her look.
Arriving to George's, NSA agents abduct Carol, tipped off by Dennis.
In their interrogation, she tells them the A.I.
's goal.
Then he announces he's taking her out, threatening their annihilation if they try to stop her.
A.I.
organizes a meet cute for Carol and George.
Initially ineffective, she tries again, inviting him to dinner.
In the meantime, Dennis meets with the US president, convincing her and the world to shut down all communication means, hoping to corner A.I.
Although George will be leaving the country in a few days, he and Carol bond in that time.
The A.I.
steers them to the Mexican restaurant where they had their first date.
They reconcile, spending the night together.
They spend the whole next day together doing things George loves, including meeting his personal hero at a Mariners game.
Carol steps away from him, getting accosted by the NSA again.
She's told about their grand plan of trapping A.I.
in Seattle, and they swear her to secrecy.
Although she's had an amazing day with George, Carol opts not to stay the night, believing if she did so it would be too hard to let him go.
As Carol leaves, A.I.
hounds her to explain herself, but she blocks him out.
The next morning, she's told she has not dissuaded him, and the Earth is now on a 5-hour countdown to destruction.
However, she selflessly chooses to turn down the NSA's offer to protect her with them in an underground bunker and helps George finish packing for his Ireland fellowship.
Through her selfless actions, Carol ends up changing A.I.
's mind and he cancels Armageddon.

28257526.title: The Metropolitan Still-Life
synopsis: In the heart of Manhattan, the quirky snapshot artist and still-life photographer, Jeremy, lives quietly in his tiny apartment.

His wife, Jessica, supports his artistic endeavors, patiently indulging his unconventional style and his penchant for turning the most mundane objects, like a wooden spoon or a grease-streaked frying pan, into works of art.
Despite the artistic flair evident in each of his creations, Jeremy soon realizes the harsh reality that his specialized form of art is too obscure for mainstream art studios.
Jessica, carrying the load of a demanding marketing job and domestic duties, nudges Jeremy gently towards exploring new opportunities in digital media.
Craving a new creative outlet, Jeremy signs up for an improv comedy class at the buzzing community center in Brooklyn.
His initiation into the world of comedy results in a collaboration with an ambitious young comedian named Timmy.
Elements of comedy subtly permeate Jeremy's still-life photography, attracting a following on Instagram, particularly among a younger demographic.
Life takes a sudden twist when Jessica receives an unexpected job transfer to London.
Jeremy is caught off guard and struggles with the sudden responsibility of juggling household chores along with his artistic pursuits.
This chaos contributes to an evolution of Jeremy's art as he begins to see the humorous side of life, which is reflected in his vibrant and laugh-inducing snapshots of common household items.
Encouraged by his newfound following, Jeremy plans an exhibition in a Brooklyn art gallery.
His preparations transpire into a series of incidents as he mishandles numerous aspects of the planning.
He wakes up one morning to find a neighborhood cat has wreaked havoc in his makeshift studio, causing him to question his future in art.
Jessica encourages him to keep pursuing his passion, which motivates him to recreate his exhibit in under 24 hours.
Jeremy's artwork becomes an unexpected sensation among visitors at his exhibition, leading to multiple job offers from top art studios.
His winning piece at an art competition hosted by The New Yorker magazine is a comedic centerpiece - the burnt breakfast toaster.
Jeremy's blend of art and comedy sparks a creative revolution among young artists across NYC.
The film concludes with Jeremy’s radiant smile as he holds his now-iconic burnt toaster.

74464219.title: The Civil Dead
synopsis: Clay is an unemployed photographer, living in Los Angeles with his wife, Whitney.
When she leaves town for a work trip, he promises he'll get out of the house and take some photos.
Clay tries a get-rich-quick scheme to pay rent, staging a fake open house in his apartment.
While shooting photos of a mattress spray painted with the phrase "5G killed my dog", Clay notices a man in the background and is annoyed that he is ruining the shot.
Whit is pleased that Clay sees him and he insists on tagging along.
The two are old friends from high school, but Clay had ignored Whit's texts when they separately moved to LA.
Whit fills Clay in on his success as an actor in small indie roles.
The two spend the night at Clay's house, where Whit feigns drinking alcohol and falling asleep.

In the morning, Clay asks Whit to leave, but Whit insists that he cannot: he's dead, unable to open doors or hold anything, and Clay is the only person that has been able to see or hear him since becoming a ghost.
Clay takes a Polaroid of Whit and becomes distressed when the photo develops and Whit is not pictured.
Clay allows Whit to spend time with him while Whitney is out of town.
Clay convinces Budd to bring him to a private poker game hosted by Arnold.
Whit looks at everyone's cards undetected and communicates their contents to Clay.
As they return home, Clay is attacked in an alley by a man he scammed at the open house.
The man disappears into dust.
When Whitney returns to LA, Clay asks Whit to give him a week to figure out how to integrate Whit into his life, since Whitney cannot see or hear Whit.
Whit reluctantly agrees to give Clay space and follows Belle, who had been the hostess at Arnold's game, home with her date.
In the morning, Clay tells Whitney that he got a job through his friend.
He drives out of LA with Whit, where the two rent a cabin and attempt to devise a plan for Whit's undetected presence in Clay's life.
Clay leaves the cabin door open so Whit can come and go as he pleases.
During a power outage, Clay is convinced that Whit has the ability to shut the lights off and accuses him of killing the man in the alley and other poltergeist powers.
In the morning, Clay hides a broken statue of the cabin owner's beloved horse in the attic.

Whit expresses gratitude for Clay's friendship and confesses that he is not a successful actor: he was a street performer dressed like Heath Ledger's Joker who was beaten to death by fellow performers dressed as Pennywise and Deadpool.
Clay and Whit share an awkward apology and Clay encourages Whit to check out the attic.
Clay closes the attic ladder behind him.
Whit, unable to escape, screams and begs Clay to let him out.
Clay collects his things, gets in his car, and drives away.

8692255.title: Emerald Swan (film)
synopsis: Willow Peaks, a serene town framed by mountain ranges, has a small cobalt pond that contents a shy young girl named Emma.

She spends her time quietly observing the pond's resident swan, Emerald, a bird whose graceful movement and iridescent plumage provide a source of comfort against the spectral shadows of a traumatic past.
Emma's life was altered dramatically by a tragic accident.
A boating misadventure at this peaceful pond turned dreadful, leaving Emma with memories branded into her subconscious, which only Emerald's gentle company could soothe.
Strange occurrences began disturbing the tranquillity of the town, alarming news of townsfolk going missing started unsettling everyone.
All the missing persons were last seen by the serene shores of the cobalt pond, a fact that cast a somber pall over the town.
An enigmatic figure, Christopher, made his appearance in Willow Peaks.
As more people disappeared, the town fell into the grips of fear.
Emma, who usually found solace by the pond, was the witness to something unspeakable during a moonlit night.
From her hiding place behind the dense willow trees, she saw a body being thrown into the pond, sinking without any trace.
Emma reported the incident to the authorities.
Around this time, Christopher disclosed his true identity as an undercover detective from the capital city.
Christopher revealed a strange connection between the victims' profiles and an ‘Emerald Swan’ necklace, a cherished heirloom of Emma's family.
Emma decided to join her forces with Christopher to bring justice to the victims.
They uncovered an underground cult nestled within the unsuspecting town.
The cult worshipped the swan Emerald as a deity, conducting macabre rituals in its name.
The cult believed in a prophecy, the Swan Granting, which proclaimed that those chosen by Emerald would receive immortality through ritualistic sacrifices.
As they dug further into the mystery, Emma and Christopher’s identities were revealed to the dangerous cult.
Facing the threat head-on, they resolved not to back down.
A fleet of police cruisers arrived, acting on the information provided by the courageous duo, and raided the cult's hiding place.
The operation was successful; the cult members were captured, and peace gradually returned to Willow Peaks.
Emma, in the peaceful aftermath, found healing and respite from her painful memories.
She realized that encountering Christopher was a turning point, a signal towards a journey for self-discovery.
As peaceful days passed, Willow Peaks returned to its normal rhythm, the recent horrors slowly fading into whispered rumors.
Emma made her final visit to the cobalt pond, staring intently at Emerald; a symbol of her past fears and present courage.
Emma bid farewell to Emerald and stepped towards her future.

She released herself from the fetters of her tormenting past, seeking a future rich with bravery and strength, thereby bringing the sinister Emerald Swan mystery of Willow Peaks to a peaceful and poignant conclusion.

61394870.title: Black Bear (film)
synopsis: A young woman, Allison, sits on a dock at the edge of a foggy lake.
She then retreats to a cabin and sits in a room where she looks at a notepad.
The film then moves to Part One: The Bear in the Road.
At a remote lake house in the Adirondack Mountains, Gabe and Blair entertain film director Allison, an out-of-town guest and former actress looking for inspiration.
Gabe's interest in her quickly becomes obvious, as does his unhappy relationship with his pregnant partner Blair.
Blair and Gabe constantly bicker in front of an uncomfortable Allison, with Blair targeting Gabe's lackluster musical career and Gabe criticizing Blair's drinking habits.
Allison becomes a part of these arguments, shifting between siding with Blair and Gabe and causing them to become even more aggressive to each other.
When Gabe rants against the failings of modern society, Blair becomes upset and threatens to leave after Allison jokingly sides with Gabe's criticism of feminism.
Allison awkwardly leaves as Blair and Gabe retreat to their bedroom; Blair accuses Gabe of being sexually attracted to Allison, but then they make up.
After Blair falls asleep, Gabe meets Allison for a swim at the lake.
Afterwards the two talk, and Gabe admits that the pregnancy with Blair had been an accident.
In turn, Allison admits that she had lied about many things she had told him and Blair for no reason.
They kiss and begin to have sex, but Blair interrupts them, attacks Gabe, and orders Allison to leave.
She and Gabe argue violently until Gabe shoves her against a couch.
Realizing that Blair is bleeding, Gabe orders Allison to get their car and drive them to the hospital.
As she is driving, Allison is startled by a black bear in the road and swerves, crashing into a tree.
The film switches to Part Two: The Bear by the Boat House.

The lake house is now the setting of a film shoot in which Gabe is the director and Allison and Blair are actresses, though their roles in the production are switched, with Allison the scorned wife and Blair the interloper.
Gabe and Allison have been married for years, but he is obviously rude and abrasive to her on set and favors Blair, which makes the crew uncomfortable.
Gabe continually makes Allison upset by making her believe that he and Blair are having an affair, which they actually are doing in order to make Allison's acting feel more real and intense.
However, they go too far and Allison begins drinking heavily, disappearing from the production and requiring the crew to bring her back.
When Allison returns drunk to the set, Gabe notices and quietly chastises her in front of the crew, blaming her for demanding to be the lead actress.
After repeated failed takes and arguments during the film's climactic argument scene, Allison eventually nails her part but begins fighting and hitting Blair for real.
Gabe is delighted by the results, but Allison, still upset, retreats to a room and refuses to come out despite Gabe's annoyance and her friends' support.
She orders a cameraman, Baako, to see her; when he arrives, she begins kissing him and pleads to him to lie to her that he loves her.
After she returns to the set, the scene is reshot, and Gabe asks Allison to not hit Blair.
The scene plays out as intended, but Allison has a genuine, uncontrollable breakdown as she yells at "her husband" that he was supposed to love her, not "Blair."
She continues sobbing even after the cameras are off.
Gabe consoles her as the uncomfortable crew looks on.
Afterwards, Gabe takes her away to comfort her as the rest of the crew celebrates with a wrap party.
Allison tells him that he should love Blair because she is better than her, and that she wishes that they could go back to the way things were before they were famous; she also calls him "Bear."
Gabe assures her that there had been no affair with Blair, and that things will be different in the future.
After she falls asleep, he leaves to sit with Blair.
Allison wakes up alone and tries to find Gabe in a panic, eventually returning to the lake house and having a frightening encounter with a black bear on the way there.
Witnessing Gabe and Blair having sex through a window, she becomes distraught as the bear appears behind her.
She turns and appears to walk calmly toward it.
The film cuts back to the opening scene, with Allison alone looking at the foggy lake.
She returns to the cabin to write, but this time she is seen writing "Black Bear" on the notepad before looking at the viewer.

38078838.title: Vagabonds of the Nebula
synopsis: Amidst the dystopian future where steel towers engulf the once lush green landscape, an orphaned teenager named Kai exists.
A technological megalopolis where the remnants of nature count for nothing, and chaos is the only semblance of order.
Despite the catastrophic atmosphere, Kai, known for his resourcefulness and innate intellect, manages to survive alongside his elder sister, Isabella.
The bond between Kai and Isabella transcends the usual sibling relationship.

Bereft of their parents, who vanished under still-mysterious circumstances years ago, Isabella took on the role of a maternal figure for Kai, becoming his beacon of unconditional love and steadfast hope.
However, an agonizing turn of events shook their lives to the core when Isabella suddenly disappeared, the same night a menacing black hole materialized over their beloved city.
The correlation between the two was too uncanny for Kai to ignore.

Paralyzed with fear yet fueled by desperation, Kai ventures into the abyss to unravel the eerie connection between his sister’s unexplained disappearance and the impending doom signaled by the black hole.
His pursuit of truth leads him to a fortress, more akin to a stronghold that seemed off-limits to civilians, teeming with whispers of a "nebula portal" and cryptic mentions of Isabella's abduction.
Risking everything, Kai ingeniously bypasses the state-of-the-art security of the fortress.
The fortification houses an ancient spaceship, forgotten yet functional, which Kai daringly takes possession of.

With the metallic winds whipping around, Kai steels himself to venture into the unknown, piloting the stolen spaceship with a level of determination that could only be summoned with the prospect of saving someone you love.
Steering the ancient spacecraft through the nebula portal with great courage, Kai surfaces on the other side, a foreign cosmos inhabited by a motley group of interstellar vagabonds.

United by their individual histories of survival and struggle, the space wanderers willingly commit to assist the young stranger navigate through unchartered territories in his relentless quest for his sister.
From this point forward, Kai’s personal transformation begins.

Under the seasoned guidance of the vagabonds, he exhibits rapid capabilities in mastering combat techniques, learning the art of strategic warfare, and acquiring the essential skills for traversing through the expansive universe.

Thrust into the unpredictability of the cosmos, they face numerous obstacles, fighting grotesque space creatures, fending off greedy space pirates, and escaping the deadly pull of insidious black holes threatening to consume their spaceship.
The narrative picks up pace when the ragtag group storms into the ominous stronghold of a ruthless warlord.
Engaged in a fierce battle against the minions of the warlord, Kai tirelessly scours the labyrinthine fort, searching every nook and corner for his captive sister, Isabella.
Amidst the cacophony of echoing sirens and continuous gunfire, Kai finally locates the frail yet determined figure of Isabella.
Simultaneously, he stumbles upon the terrifying blueprint of the warlord's malevolent plan.

The warlord, a master puppeteer of chaos, unveils a twisted tale of their shared past, claiming that Isabella had willingly given herself up to protect Kai and the latent, extraordinary powers they both unknowingly possessed.
This revelation leads to a surge of energy within Kai, signaling the activation of his dormant power.
Combined with his newly-minted combat skills and his unwavering resilience, Kai's strengthened resolve empowers him to face the forthcoming challenges.
As the final showdown commences, Kai, now fully awakened to his abilities and equipped with his combat skills, battles the warlord's forces.
Exerting every ounce of his strength and determination, Kai stages a heroic rescue of his sister from the iron-clad grip of the vile warlord.
As the dawn of a new day brings the promise of hope, the bond between the siblings grows stronger.
They bid a heart-wrenching goodbye to their space comrades, marking a solemn promise of a reunion in the vast expanse of unchartered galaxies.
In the victorious aftermath, they tap into their shared powers to create a return nebula portal, guiding them back to their dystopian home.
By intricately weaving their powers, they manage to neutralize the black hole that had been menacing their city, combating the apocalypse and preserving their home.
Their heroic journey culminates upon their safe return to their urban rooftop, not as powerless victims of fate but as valiant custodians of their city.
Overlooking the sprawling cityscape they’d just rescued, Kai and Isabella pledge to continue defending their world from peril while also exploring the manifold dimensions of their newfound abilities.

Their resolve sets the stage for future adventures, threading an intricate tale of their evolution from ordinary siblings to gifted heroes, exploring the depths of their powers and the extraordinary journey that awaits them.

73300195.title: Knights of the Zodiac (film)
synopsis: Seiya is a street orphan searching for his sister Patricia, who has been kidnapped.
During a fight with Cassios in a fighting ring, Seiya unleashes a strange blue light.
After the fight, he meets with Docrates and Alman Kido.
Kido warns Seiya that his ex-wife Vander Guraad is looking for him.
Guraad's warriors capture Docrates and pursue Seiya and Kido, who meet up with Mylock, Kido's assistant.
Following a brief chase, Seiya, Mylock and Kido escape from the warriors.
Seiya demands to know what is happening, but is knocked out by Mylock.
Seiya recalls his sister's kidnapping while unconscious, and is later taken to Kido's hideout.
Kido informs Seiya that his adopted daughter Sienna is the reincarnation of the goddess Athena, and Seiya is destined to become the Pegasus Knight, a warrior knight for Athena.
Patricia knew about Seiya's destiny and gave herself up to protect him.
Kido tells Seiya that he should train under Marin the Silver Knight, so that he can use his Cosmo to protect himself and Sienna, and to find Patricia.
While having breakfast with Seiya, Sienna briefly loses control of her Cosmo, but Kido is able to calm her down.
Meanwhile, Cassios beats up several of Guraad's powerful prototype soldiers, and accepts an offer from Guraad to become one as well in exchange for exacting revenge on Seiya.
Seiya and Sienna get to know each other, and she convinces him to go to Marin for training.
Seiya goes with Mylock to the mountain where Marin resides, and climbs up the mountain alone to meet with her.
Seiya's training initially goes poorly, as he is unable to channel his Cosmo properly, but he keeps training with Marin's help.
That night, Sienna experiences a vision of herself as Athena destroying Seiya's armor and causing widespread destruction, which causes her to emit another Cosmo burst.
Seiya eventually gains control of his Cosmo.
His pendant glows and unlocks his Pegasus armor, but he experiences a vision while bonding with the armor, revealing that Kido was present when Guraad took Patricia.
Seiya returns to Kido's hideout to confront him, but Sienna takes him away from the mansion.

She reveals that she destroyed Guraad's arms when she was young, forcing Guraad to drain Cosmo from children with it to stay alive, and that Guraad let Patricia go when she learned that Patricia did not have any Cosmo.
Guraad arrives at Kido's hideout after her subordinate Nero tortures its location out of Docrates.
Seiya and Sienna return to the mansion.
Seiya fights off Guraad's soldiers, but he fails to activate his Pegasus armor while fighting Cassios, resulting in him being beaten unconscious.
Kido sets his estate to self-destruct in an effort to stop Guraad, and he dies in the explosion.
Sienna is knocked unconscious and captured by Guraad's soldiers, and Seiya is unable to stop them.
Guraad admits to Sienna that she has given up on fixing herself, and proceeds to start depleting Sienna's Cosmo to prevent her becoming a threat to the world.
Mylock rescues Seiya, who forgives himself for being unable to rescue Patricia when she was taken.
Mylock and Seiya travel to Guraad's base, where Seiya unlocks his Pegasus armor and defeats Guraad's soldiers and Cassios.
Guraad becomes unable to watch Sienna be drained of her energy and tries to stop the procedure, but Nero turns against her and assumes his Phoenix Knight form.
Nero and Seiya proceed to fight, but are interrupted by Sienna, who has almost completed her transformation into Athena, causing widespread destruction.
With Seiya's help, Sienna manages to regain control, but falls unconscious afterwards.
When she wakes up, Sienna's hair has turned purple.
Sienna and Guraad reconcile, and Sienna restores Guraad's arms.
Sienna and Seiya leave the area with Mylock; Nero watches them leave.
Sienna reveals that the old gods are returning, and the Knights of the Zodiac will be needed to stop them.
She decides that they will need to find Patricia.

29052697.title: Eternal Comrades
synopsis: Tom, Sam, and Rob, three spirited retirees in their sixties, make the century-old oak tree their rendezvous point in the serene Lakeside Town Park.
Every day, they engage in the art of storytelling, spinning yarns about their prime years.
A simple, cordial day quickly veers into somber when they hear the dreaded news about the imminent closure of The Happy Toothbrush Factory, a place they called their second home for over 35 years.

This unexpected revelation triggers a wave of nostalgia, transporting them back to their sprightly days spent amongst the mechanical symphony and resounding laughter echoing around the factory's lively, bustling assembly lines.

Stirred by these bittersweet recollections, they solemnly vow over mugs of fragrant, homemade brew to prevent their cherished factory from drifting into non-existence and in doing so, they set in motion an unprecedented series of comic calamities.
The very next day finds them huddled around a weather-beaten, chipped wooden table in the dusky confines of Tom's garage.
Enthusiastically, they toss around fundraising schemes ranging from staging an all-inclusive bake sale at the local parish to orchestrating a grand car wash in the town's bustling central square.
Each event, although meant to accumulate funds, culminates in a series of unpredicted, hearty hoaxes.
Hilarious chaos ensues when the delicate art of baking morphs into a wild cream-pie face-off.
The car wash, too, evolves into an unforeseen soapy spectacle, with vibrant bubbles dancing around, reliving their own amusing version of a town-wide carnival.
Despite their relentless efforts and comical misfires, the trio manages to scrounge up a modest sum.
However, it's merely a drop in the ocean compared to the colossal funds required to ward off the looming closure.
When despair seems to cast its grim shadow, Fortuna smiles at them.
From the forgotten depths of Tom’s threadbare corduroy coat, a wrinkled old lottery ticket, long forgotten, comes to light.
They look upon their luck with wide-eyed disbelief as they see their potential windfall revealed in the form of a matching set of numbers on the weathered lottery paper.
The blissful euphoria, however, is short-lived as by the next sunshine-kissed morning, the prized lottery ticket mysteriously vanishes.
This sparks a riotous frenzy among the friends, infusing another layer of comedy into the already humorous narrative.
The valuable lottery ticket embarks on an involuntary journey around the unsuspecting residents of Lakeside Town, turning the simple piece of paper into an unintentional, highly coveted 'hot potato'.

The friends are neck-deep in a riveting hunt, which involves them skirting around Jeb's clattering chicken coops, weaving through bustling farmers’ markets, and even incidentally plunging into Granny Ellen's treasured antique barrels.
They cap off their wild pursuit by reacquiring the elusive ticket at the town's annual fair, a testament to their indomitable spirit and implacable determination.
With renewed optimism, they dash to the only lottery outlet in Lakeside, mentally dividing up the windfall to thwart the factory's impending doom.
Upon arriving at the red-bricked Happy Toothbrush Factory, they unearth a hidden ruse.
The owners had dramatized the financial crisis and planned to sell the vintage establishment for personal gain.
Unfazed by the deceitful plotters, they forge a detailed strategy, complete with schematics and backup plans, to unveil the factory owners' fraudulent scheme to the unsuspecting citizens of Lakeside.
A dramatic confrontation unfurls in the Gloria Community Hall.
Armed with incontrovertible evidence, they place their claims against the owners, winning over both the audience and the panel.
The truth laid bare, the disgraced owners are shamed out of Lakeside, and the gracious mayor, David Mercer, takes up temporary control of the beloved Toothbrush Factory.
The previously carefree retirees are hailed as the saviors of Lakeside, a triumphant trio who blew the lid off a scandal and saved the factory from an undignified end.
The town's annual gala spirals into an impromptu homage for our unstoppable heroes, blending heartfelt tribute with the jovial flavor of midsummer festivities.
The film culminates in a lively factory scene, with Tom, Sam, and Rob, sharing tales and laughter about their unpredictable yet triumphant escapade.
Their life had been a mosaic of memories and chuckles, but they universally agreed that the adventure of salvaging the Happy Toothbrush Factory was the crowning jewel.
As the radiant dusk embraces the silhouette of Lakeside, the audience is left feeling satiated, their hearts warmed by heartfelt laughter, and their faith in friendship and unity rejuvenated.

71789678.title: Old Dads
synopsis: Jack Kelly, Connor Brody and Mike Richards have been friends and colleagues for decades.
Now in their 50s, they struggle with the modern world and how they are expected to behave.
For example, when Connor tries to get his son Colin (Dominic Grey Gonzalez) to apologize for hitting people, his wife Cara reprimands him.
Deciding to sell their business Trifecta to some millennials, but kept on as employees, they are shocked when the hipster new boss Aspen fires everyone over 35 except them.
Moving away from simply selling throwback team jerseys, the company is modernizing, becoming both gender- and carbon-neutral.
Jack gets publicly chewed out by the director of his son Nate's pre-school for being two minutes late and responds with the coarsest of vulgarities.
His wife, Leah, forces him to apologize, as a recommendation will be needed from her for private kindergarten admission, and she points out he has anger management issues.
When Jack and Leah go to the school to apologize to the director, she makes him do it to the group of parents and kids.
A few pinpoint the specifics that upset them, he apologizes for each.
However, Leah points out Jack must continue to be on his best behavior for the next three months so the director gives Nate a recommendation.
Meanwhile, divorcé and father of two adult sons Mike arrives home to a surprise.
Although he had had a vasectomy, his young girlfriend Britney divulges that she is pregnant.
Later, the three friends meet at the bar and Jack and Connor try to get him to look on the bright side.
As Jack has been asked to organize the school fundraiser, he and Connor are made to feel marginalized by the millennials.
Then, the three friends are sent to find Ed Cameron, a man who has chosen to be off-grid since the 1980s, to convince him to represent the company.
Travis (Justin Miles), one of the young employees, accompanies them.
As the old friends banter, he calls them misogynistic.
Mike calls him out for his superior attitude, proving through his love of modern music that he is not always politically correct either.
When they hit an armadillo, Ed comes to collect it.
Meanwhile, Leah comes across Cara.
Colin walks up and hits her pregnant stomach.
When she warns him, he blatantly punches it.
Cara defends him and the women argue.
At Trifecta, although the trio were successful recruiting Cameron, Aspen fires them as a hidden camera in the rental car caught their misogynistic banter.
Even Travis is sacked, as his TV camera captured him singing strongly worded rap lyrics as he started his day.
Afterwards, Mike cuts off ties with Jack; Connor is not allowed to have contact because of Cara's anger at the Kellys, so Jack focuses on the school fundraiser.
Everything goes well until he has another blow up, resulting in Leah kicking him out.
Jack and Mike coincide in a late-night eatery.
They make peace, then pick up Connor for a casino bachelor party road-trip, as Britney insists they marry.
They come across Aspen, who has been fired for accidentally using politically incorrect jargon and dumped.
Later, at a strip club, Jack gets a call that Leah is in labor.
Drunk, they are forced to get an Uber.
Excruciatingly slow, they end up grabbing small electric scooters to complete the journey.
Missing the birth, Jack still makes up with Leah and vows to go to therapy.
In the end, they opt for public school for Nate and Jack has learned to control his temper.
Mike proposes to Britney properly and Connor gets Cara to lighten up.

8745932.title: Bandit's Melody
synopsis: Carlos Martinez, a struggling jazz guitarist, pours his soul into his craft in 'The Amused Brew', a quaint coffee shop positioned in the bustling centre of Montego Bay.
His only constant companion is his entertaining meerkat pet, Bandit, whose deep brown eyes and energetic disposition make him a favourite among café patrons.
Carlos notices an intriguing quirk in Bandit - the small creature mirrors his master's chord progressions and responds enthusiastically to differing pitches and timbre.
One lazy Wednesday afternoon, Carlos, backed by Bandit's taps and tail-swishes, produces an impromptu performance using the everyday items in the café to entertain the customers.
The news about the charming meerkat and the inventive jazz guitarist echoes throughout the streets of Montego Bay, attracting many visitors to 'The Amused Brew'.
This wholesome spectacle garners the attention of underhanded businessman, Alejandro De La Vega, who travels to Montego Bay with malevolent intentions.
Observing Carlos and Bandit, De La Vega plots a nefarious scheme to separate the pair and profit from Bandit's rhythmic gift.
Carlos is tantalized by a misleading record deal.
Blinded by falsified promises of international fame and fortune, Carlos, oblivious to the deception at play, signs the contract.
Devastated and filled with guilt, Carlos embarks on a challenging, yet unexpectedly humorous quest to rescue Bandit.
Throughout this journey, Carlos finds himself stuck in a leopard-patterned dress in an attempt to go undercover, and he also fumbles to impersonate one of De La Vega's intimidating bodyguards.
His misadventures are not in vain, as he eventually uncovers Bandit's location, who is being kept inside a luxurious penthouse in Kingston.
Rallying the townsfolk of Montego Bay, Carlos devises a plan to rescue Bandit.
De La Vega watches in shock as his grand villa is infiltrated.
Bandit stealthily slips away from his golden cage during the chaos and De Le Vega finds himself caught in a ward of bubble wrap.
Carlos, supported by his rhythmic sidekick Bandit, takes center stage for a grand open-air concert.
Carlos strums his heart out while Bandit complements him with his unique rhythm.
Carlos then dedicates a soul-stirring tune to Bandit.
Taking their music to a wider audience, the two become a nationwide sensation.
Their local concerts become a regular occurrence.
When the day of their nationwide debut arrives, fans from all over the country pour into Montego Bay.
The duo don't disappoint as they take the stage, combining sounds from everyday objects into jazz sessions.
Closing the night, Carlos dedicates a touching ballad to his furry friend, Bandit.
The story of Carlos and Bandit concludes on a note of loyal friendship and shared dreams.

61288403.title: Vivo (film)
synopsis: In Havana, Cuba, Andrés Hernández and his kinkajou Vivo play music together in the plaza.
One day after their show, Andrés receives a letter from his old friend, Marta Sandoval, informing him that she is retiring from her music career.
The letter offers a chance to reconnect in Miami, at the Mambo Cabana and for Andrés to finally confess his love for Marta through a song he wrote just for her.
Vivo, happy with their life in Cuba, is reluctant to help Andrés.

The next morning, Andrés dies in his sleep and that night, a funeral service is held in the plaza, with Andrés' niece-in-law Rosa and her daughter Gabi attending before they head back to their home in Key West, Florida.
Ashamed of his earlier reluctance, Vivo vows himself to get Marta to hear Andrés' song.
He stows away to Key West with Gabi and Rosa in their luggage.
Gabi finds Vivo and agrees to help him deliver Andrés' song to Marta.
Under the guise of attending a cookie sale in town, Gabi and Vivo purchase bus tickets to get to Marta's show, but they are stopped by the Sand Dollars, a girl scout troop who wants Vivo vaccinated.
Gabi and Vivo escape from them, but miss the bus.
They end up in the Everglades and are separated by a heavy rain storm, losing the song.
While searching for Gabi, Vivo comes across a roseate spoonbill named Dancarino, who is unsuccessful in finding love with one of his own.
With Vivo's help, he is able to win the heart of Valentina.
The two later rescue Vivo from a Burmese python named Lutador.
Meanwhile, Gabi discovers that she was followed by the Sand Dollars on a boat and that they have Andrés' song, keeping it from her until she leads them to Vivo.
When the girls are attacked by Lutador, Vivo saves them, but the song is destroyed in the process.
Devastated, Vivo considers returning to Cuba until he realizes he and Gabi can recreate the song, as he knows the melody and Gabi knows the lyrics.
Together, they make it to Miami and search for Marta, who has learned of Andrés' death and refuses to go on stage.
Gabi and Vivo sneak inside the Mambo Cabana, but Gabi is unable to enter and tells Vivo to go on without her.
She is soon caught by security and her furious mother.
Vivo finds a mourning Marta, who recognizes him from Andrés' obituary photo, and delivers the song.
Touched by the song, Marta is revitalized and decides to go on stage.
Vivo then locates Gabi and Rosa, who are arguing while driving back home.
Gabi confesses she decided to help Vivo because she misses her deceased father Carlos.
Deeply moved, Rosa reassures her daughter, and drives Gabi and Vivo back to the concert just in time to hear Marta play Andrés' song.
Vivo decides to stay in Florida with Gabi and Rosa.
Gabi and Vivo put on their own show in the city with Marta, entertaining the crowd.

2902506.title: Vanished Without a Trace
synopsis: The movie opens on a harsh and daunting scene in the spare and desolate environment of an interrogation room.
Thumbs, a man marked by the distinct features of Down Syndrome, sits tensely across from a detective.
This encounter is focused on the mysterious disappearance of Emily, a youthful woman whose face is peppered with freckles.
Thumbs' displays a profound fear, pleading that he's innocent.
His delicate mental state raises questions about his guilt in Emily’s disappearance.
Suddenly, the narrative shifts to Roeville, a small town that Emily once called home, before she disappeared.
Emily's parents, Robert and Maggie, cling onto hope by relying on Inspector Williams.
Williams, a sturdy, emotionless detective, is leading the investigation into Emily's disappearance.
He undertakes an exhaustive examination of Emily's past, exposing several perplexing aspects of her life.
In his pursuits, Williams uncovers a number of suspicious characters including Emily's dating history and her rapport with Thumbs.
Williams discovers Emily maintained a secret friendship with an unidentified character.
High drama unfolds when Emily's personal items are found at Thumbs' place, leading to his arrest.
Williams, under pressure from Robert, Maggie and the public, investigates further, sensing the puzzle isn't complete yet.
A crucial break is found in Emily's diary.
It discloses Emily's wish to escape her family, and her secret relationship with a criminal.
Armed with this information, Williams sets out to find the criminal, and discovers that Emily had decided to run away with this person, which led to her unintended death.
Williams, now knowing the truth, arranges for Thumbs' release, and must share the tragic findings with Emily's parents.
The revelation of Emily’s secret life devastates Robert and Maggie.
Williams finds himself emotionally affected by the case and struggles with revealing the painful truth.
Emily’s tragic end sends shockwaves through Roeville.
As the movie concludes, Williams leaves Roeville, with Emily's tragedy leaving a lasting impact.
The town struggles to regain normalcy, the memory of Emily's disappearance and death resonating through Roeville.
Williams departs from the shaken town, leaving behind a community marked forever by tragedy.

70949583.title: Last Seen Alive
synopsis: The movie opens with a brief scene of Detective Paterson accusing a man called Knuckles of kidnapping, and threatens him with life in prison.
As the detective squeezes his throat, Knuckles finally gasps, "she's dead."
Wealthy real-estate agent Will Spann and his wife Lisa are driving to Lisa's parents' house, where she wants some time to herself.
Before reaching the house, they stop for gas and Lisa heads inside to purchase a bottle of water.
As she leaves the store she's greeted by a man, but as she moves toward him a large white truck pulls up, blocking the rest of their interaction from view.
Will finishes gassing up and looks for Lisa, but cannot find her in the store or bathrooms.
He starts to panic, frantically searching the entire area, calling her phone, and asking if anyone's seen her.
He finally calls the local police department to report her disappearance and heads to her parents' house.
Lisa's parents, Barry and Anna Adams, get into a minor argument with Will as he tries to tell them what happened and asks for their help in locating her.
A flashback reveals the tension between the couple, where Lisa suggests some time apart but can't explain why she's no longer invested in their marriage.
Will heads back to the gas station and meets Detective Paterson, who questions the gas station clerk, Oscar, asking for security footage, but Oscar claims the cameras are broken.
The detective returns to the station but Will notices the camera's indicator lamp is lit.
He queries Oscar, and after a fight retrieves the CCTV recorder, which he takes to Paterson at the station.
They see the start of Lisa's interaction before the white truck blocks the view, then the people are gone, also the older model automobile around the corner.
Detective Paterson then takes Will to the interrogation room, but the questions lead Will to believe he is suspected of arranging her disappearance due to marital problems.
He leaves angrily and shows the picture of the man and his car from the security footage to Anna and Barry; they identify him as Knuckles, their handyman, and it's his car.
Will breaks into Knuckles' trailer and questions him about Lisa.
They get into a violent fight in which Will finally subdues Knuckles and takes his gun.
Knuckles says he was forced to leave Lisa with someone named Frank.
Will binds Knuckles, bundles him into his trunk, and drives off to find Frank, but gets pulled over for speeding.
The cop demands Will step out of his car to search it.
Will knows the cop will find Knuckles in the trunk, and flees through the woods on the side of the road.
Meanwhile, Detective Paterson visits Barry and Anna, who reveal Lisa's affair with "Clint", but that she had rebuffed his attempts to renew their relationship.
Another flashback indicates Anna was distrustful of Will.
Will reaches a lower road and encounters a man who turns out to be a Frank's guard, but talks him into letting him pass.
He finds Frank's camp in the woods, a derelict farm, the main building of which is an extensive but rudimentary drug lab.
Most of the inhabitants are unconcerned at his presence.
He sees Oscar arrive, confirming his earlier suspicions.
Will sneaks around the camp in search of Lisa.
A flashback reveals the moment Knuckles takes Lisa, threatening her into his car.
Will stalks Frank into the building and pulls the gun, begging him to reveal where his wife is.
A firefight ensues, ending up with Frank and one of his men dead.
A small fire starts on the floor, not far from drug chemicals and tanks of flammable solvent.
The opening scene with Detective Paterson and Knuckles replays, as Paterson pushes Knuckles to confess.
Finally, Knuckles reveals Lisa is dead, and how he had kidnapped her as part of a ransom plot, describing how he'd been forced by Frank to "fix his mistake" and dig a hole to bury her.
Will, now free to search the camp, encounters Oscar, who reveals he has Lisa's phone and that he knows where she is, demanding $20,000 for information.
The building suddenly explodes, killing Oscar, and Detective Paterson arrives on-scene.
He tells Will to stay and goes to investigate the hole, finding it empty.
At the same time, Will hears banging from a nearby shed and finds a terrified but alive Lisa tied up.
They embrace and he carries her out.
Detective Paterson visits the Adams' residence to share information with Will about Knuckles' confession.
He also reveals his awareness that not all individuals in the drug lab perished due to the explosion, as evidenced by gunshot wounds found on some of the bodies.
Despite these revelations, Detective Paterson does not pry any further.
Instead, he wishes Will luck and departs.
Subsequently, Lisa invites Will to accompany her into her parents' house.
The movie concludes with the two of them walking towards the house, smiling and holding hands.

29079277.title: Payback (2023 film)
synopsis: James Palmer, a highly esteemed financial analyst at Quantum Investments - a globally recognized, renowned multinational corporation based in Madrid, Spain leads a serene lifestyle with his wife Sophia, their seven-year-old daughter, Anna, and their vibrant five-year-old son, Leo.
The plot then introduces Thomas Bishop, a figure from James's past, his childhood partner-in-crime, and now the CEO of Quantum Investments.
There is a shift when James stumbles upon irregular transactions worth millions stealthily happening within the company's financial fortress.
Disturbed by this financial irregularity, James starts investigating and eventually sheds light on the shocking truth - the powerful reign of CEO Thomas Bishop is tainted with financial fraud.
James takes the dreaded step of revealing these irregularities to the board.
This revelation results in an urgent emergency meeting.
A subsequent intensive audit brings Thomas's guilt to light, resulting in his immediate expulsion and subsequent detention.
The corporate scandal of the century spreads like a wildfire.
Consumed by rage, Thomas retaliates from prison, plotting to kidnap James's family.
James returns to an eerily silent home, only to discover that his family has been abducted.
Their kidnap is linked to Thomas.
Seized by despair, James recuperates, determined to rescue his family.
He goes back into the financial records, tracing transactions linked to Thomas to find a clue that would lead him to his family.
James deciphers transaction patterns that point to hidden offshore accounts.
Rallying a team of trusted allies, James uncovers laundered money linked to anonymous shell corporations.
Despite the danger, he uncovers where his family is held, an abandoned warehouse at Madrid's outer rim.
James and his allies prepare a daring rescue mission.
In the climax, James and Thomas engage in a tense face-off.
James manages to outmaneuver Thomas's mercenaries and free his family.
Thomas is captured by the police.
The arresting of Thomas and the public exposure of his deeds bring severe consequences to Quantum Investments and shockwaves through the financial community.
Physically unharmed but emotionally scarred, the Palmer family chooses to start over in Marseille, France.
At his new home, James reflects on his past experiences, finding purpose in his crusade against corporate corruption.
James embraces a new mission – to root out deceptive practices and safeguard the innocent from corporate exploitation.
He becomes the scourge of fraudulent activities, protecting unsuspecting victims from corporate greed.
His painful past becomes the cornerstone of his passion to erase deceit from the corporate world.
Amid his daunting mission, the Palmers recover from their traumatic memories, finding solace in their new life.
Sophia, Anna, and Leo stand strong and proud behind James, supportive of his transformation into a figure fighting against monetary malfeasance.
James's profound metamorphosis from an unsuspecting financial analyst to a courageous, vigilant fighter against corporate deceptions becomes the beacon for his mission.
His nights in his new office attest to his relentless pursuit to stop other families from falling prey to similar frauds.

68375782.title: Retribution (2023 film)
synopsis: Matt Turner works as a financier at Nanite Capital under his friend and CEO Anders Muller and lives with his wife, Heather, and two children, Emily and Zach, in Berlin.
While driving his kids to school, Matt receives a call from an unknown number with a distorted voice who says that there is a bomb under his seat, which was already armed when Matt sat on it.
The bomb is triggered by both pressure plates placed on all the seats and a radio frequency.
He also threatens to detonate the bomb if Matt tries to get help.
Matt finds the device and he is forced to follow the bomber’s instructions in order to keep them alive.
The bomber forces Matt to watch Sylvain, the latter’s client who is also receiving a bomb threat, being killed in an explosion when Sylvain’s panicked girlfriend attempts to escape.
The bomber tells Matt to call Heather to retrieve €50,000 from his safety deposit box at the bank and deliver it to him.
After Heather retrieves it, the bomber changes the plan by telling her to give the money to a man in a blue suit.
When she does, the police arrive and arrest the man.

After seeing the news implicating Matt for the bombing, Europol agent Angela Brickmann calls him; Matt tries to convince her of his innocence and requests that cellular signals be jammed to prevent the remote trigger.
The bomber reveals that Matt and Anders have a €208 million slush fund from the clients deposited in Matt’s “emergency collateral account” in a bank in Dubai.
He arranges for Matt to meet Anders at a power plant.
Arriving there, the bomber forces Matt to order Anders to liquidate his collateral account.
Despite Anders reluctantly complying, the bomber orders Matt to kill Anders with a revolver in exchange for his life and his children.
When Matt refuses, the bomber blows up Anders’s car; the shrapnel injures Emily’s leg.
After a police chase, Matt is eventually surrounded by them with Angela and Heather arriving at the scene.
Once they realize that the pressure plate is only located under Matt's seat, the bomb squad safely removes Zach and Emily, who is then treated for her injuries.
Interrogating Matt, Angela suspects the bombing might be related to the heist.
After talking to Heather for the last time, Matt drives away and evades the police, determined to find the bomber by himself.
Matt demands the bomber to meet him in person if he wants the money.
The bomber is revealed to be Anders all along.
Anders reveals that he wanted to make Matt a fall guy for the series of bombings to cover up his scheme of embezzling €208 million wired into his crypto account.
To end this, Matt deliberately crashes his car, causing it to cling on the side of a bridge.
Matt unlocks his seat belt and falls into the river, allowing the bomb to activate and kill Anders.
Angela and the police arrive at the scene, with Angela nodding at Matt before allowing him to walk free.
During the credits, the news reports state that the bombings were part of the heist perpetrated by Anders, and Matt cooperates with Europol to resolve the incident.

69459598.title: Solitude (2021 film)
synopsis: The story unfolds in the vibrant borough of Manhattan, New York City, with our central character, Jane Doe.
Jane, a social butterfly, makes a solemn promise to Lisa, her closest friend, to be present at her upcoming birthday celebration.
An unexpected phone call from an old classmate reveals that an embarrassing college video featuring Jane has gone viral.
The public humiliation leads Jane to retreat from her thriving social life and break her promise to Lisa.
Choosing isolation, Jane seeks the help of a psychologist, Dr. Sinclair.
In the comfort of Dr. Sinclair's office, Jane opens up about her ordeal and the therapeutic effect that painting has on her.
As her confidence rebuilds through painting, Jane invites Dr. Sinclair to her transformed apartment, now a vibrant art studio.
Despite coping with her trauma, Jane suffers a panic attack at a local café, reminding her and the audience of her ongoing struggle.
Dr. Sinclair, her anchor during this time, devises a project for Jane: to chronicle her emotions and experiences via her artwork.
The project results in raw, emotionally-charged paintings that depict Jane's journey from social butterfly to recluse and finally, to an emerging artist.
Dr. Sinclair suggests showcasing Jane's artwork in a public gallery, an idea that resurrects Jane's fear of public mockery.
However, Jane decides to face her fear and share her story via her art.
The art exhibition garners immense appreciation and acts as a catalyst for Jane's redemption.
The last scene offers a glimpse of a hopeful Jane ready to re-engage with society, having found not only comfort but beauty in solitude and a stronger sense of self-worth.

62237803.title: Land (2021 film)
synopsis: After a traumatic experience, Edee Holzer is in the midst of therapy, revealing to her therapist that she doesn't like to be around people.

She leaves the city and moves to Wyoming where she purchases a small, remote cabin and resolves to live in solitude without any modern conveniences connecting her to the outside world, including telephones or cars.
Initially, she struggles with basic provisions, including chopping firewood and fishing.
When a black bear enters her cabin, eats her food, and destroys much of the rest of her supplies while she hides in her outhouse, she reaches her breaking point.
Without a fire for heat or food to eat, she tries to hunt but cannot bring herself to shoot a deer she has in her sights.
Overwhelmed, she attempts to take her life by shooting herself with the hunting rifle, stopping short when she remembers her sister Emma pleading not to hurt herself.
During a violent snowstorm, the metal roof of her cabin becomes somewhat dislodged by the wind, making loud noises.
She leaves the cabin to attempt repairs and is injured.
A local hunter, Miguel and his nurse friend Alawa, rescue her and help her recover from her illness.
Miguel remains to look after Edee by preparing her food, replenishing her supply of firewood, and restocking the rest of her cabin.
Edee thanks Miguel for his kindness in helping her, but explains that she came to her cabin to be alone and wants to keep it that way.
Miguel understands and offers to help equip her with better survival skills so that she can have the life of solitude that she wants.
He shows her how to trap in the winter and hunt in the fall so she can provide herself with food.
Over time they develop a friendship as Miguel continues to join her to hunt, harvest crops, and explore her land.
Miguel shares that his wife and daughter died in a car accident eight years prior, while Edee simply reveals that she used to have a family.
Miguel later remarks that if she doesn't want to talk about her past she ought to consider what she wants her future to be like.
She suspects that he searched her history on the internet, though he's not even aware of her last name and explains that's impossible.
Miguel asks her to watch his dog while he goes away for a while, ostensibly for work.
While he's gone, Edee retrieves a collection of old photos revealing she was married with a son, and the father and son she saw fishing earlier on had been an apparition of her family.
Months pass and Miguel hasn't returned, so Edee packs her belongings and ventures off of her land for the first time since her arrival to find him.
She makes her way into town on foot and eventually finds Alawa working at the local hospital.
Alawa takes her to see Miguel, who is bedridden and dying from throat cancer.
On his deathbed, he confesses that he was driving the night his wife and daughter were killed and it was because he was intoxicated that the accident happened.
Edee responds that her husband Adam and son Drew were killed in a random shooting in a concert hall.
She thanks him for helping her heal and the life he gave back to her.
Departing with his phone that he gave her, she calls her sister Emma for the first time since arriving in Wyoming.

92115470.title: The Salem's Echo (2021 film)
synopsis: Alice Walker, a 45-year-old historian recognized for her examination of occult happenings, makes the bold decision to uproot from the city and move to the hauntingly beautiful town of Salem, Connecticut.
She embarks on this adventure alongside her 15-year-old daughter, Rachel, who shares her mother's fascination with the unknown.

Young and passionate about arts, Rachel strangely finds an intriguing muse in their new locale, her artistic inventiveness being fed by the crumbling ruins, centuries-old church, and legendary tales that are part of their new town's identity.
To fully immerse themselves in the town's history, they choose a majestic 18th-century colonial-style house, nestled in the heart of Salem, as their new home.
Its ancient timbers, each groove a silent witness to the passage of centuries, radiate a profound connection with the town's bewitching history.

Adjusting to their new residence is a blend of nostalgia and anxiety, as they habituate themselves to the odd disturbances – unmistakeable creaking of wooden planks, sudden dimming of vintage lamps, and the fantastical silhouettes that come to life on the walls of their unusual home.
Alice's inquisitive nature and versed background pay off when she stumbles upon a hidden treasure during her exploration.
Tucked away behind the rotten wooden blocks of their attic wall, she finds an old, leather-bound diary.
The aged diary, despite being beaten by time, mesmerizes Alice with an enchanting allure, soon becoming her prime indulgence.

Alice's instincts never disappoint her; her meticulous scrutiny confirms the diary had belonged to Sarah Bridget – a significant figure and a victim of the notorious witchcraft trial that took Salem by storm in 1845.

As Alice digs deeper into the faded entries of Sarah's diary, her findings coincide with an uncanny escalation of paranormal activities, the silence of their antique house often broken by inexplicable whispers.
To Alice's distress and Rachel's fascinations, a spectral figure bearing striking resemblance to the portrait of Sarah sketched in the diary starts to manifest within their home.
The first encounter with Sarah's spirit is experienced by Rachel, igniting unfamiliar feelings—a volatile mix of terror and wonder—in the teenager’s heart.

Compelled by the gripping occurrences and Alice's curiosity to unveil the truth, she enlists the services of well-known local medium, Evelyn Fox, famed for her success in eliciting responses from spirits of the beyond.

Conducting a chilling séance in the dim, shadow-strewn ambiance of their house, lit only by the flickering candlelight, Evelyn confirms that the phantom troubling them is indeed the restless spirit of Sarah Bridget.
Far from resolving, the supernatural disturbances intensify, thrusting their peaceful Salem neighborhood into a predicament.
Sarah's spirit, torn between realms, seems to be instigating this turmoil.

Rachel, once fascinated, now becomes a target of Sarah's unsettling appearances, as she is visited nightly by nightmares filled with ghostly apparitions, blurring the lines between dreams and reality.
As if influenced by Sarah’s spirit, Rachel attempts to reenact the grim witch trials with Alice as the accused.
The horror unfolds until Rachel's conscience intervenes, sparing her mother from the terrifying acting out of historical injustice.
Recognizing the grave danger encircling her family and community, Alice throws herself into investigating their home.
She pores over local records, diaries, and newspapers, uncovering the dreadful chronicle that their abode shares with Salem.
Armed with insights from Evelyn and her discoveries, Alice uncovers the terrible history of their residence—it was the backdrop to Sarah's unjust trial and execution by hanging.

Further exploration reveals a bone-chilling connection: every resident suffering at the hands of Sarah's tormented spirit descends from the jury members who voted for her execution in the infamous trial.
Now aware of the reason behind the wrath of Sarah's spirit, Alice, Evelyn, and the plagued descendants rally together, willing to confront and pacify the haunting presence.
In a daring amalgamation of the old and new, they devise a plan incorporating modern equipment used for ghost detection along with ancient exorcism rituals well-documented in occult history.
Together, they perform a series of rites designed to liberate Sarah from her centuries-long torment.
With every step, the air heavy with fear and tension, they move closer to their terrifying goal.
As they bravely wage their spiritual battle, the once-peaceful town of Salem is thrust into chaos.
Buildings tremble, lights flicker, and eerie cries rend the night, all adding to Sarah's explosive, supernatural retaliation.

In a final, desperate attempt to quell Sarah’s rage, Alice lights a bundle of white sage – a herb traditionally used to cleanse and heal - and leads her team in a ritual meant to pacify and release trapped spirits.
As the last sage smoke twirls up towards the silent void, an encompassing tranquility starts to blanket the cacophonous Salem, signaling the end of their horrendous ordeal.
Touching moments follow, as they witness the manifestation of Sarah's spirit finally finding release from her torment, and with her departure, the eerie disturbances cease.
With methodical accuracy, Alice decides to record the events, meticulously forming a comprehensive document from their hair-raising experience.
Leveraging her innate storytelling skills, Alice translates her intensive research into an enthralling book.
In it, she narrates the unwritten history of Salem and the twisted tale of the ill-fated Sarah Bridget.
The telling pages of her book shine a light on Salem's grim past, reminding readers of the injustice endured by innocents and the importance of acknowledging their stories.
Undeterred by the eerie history and the terror she experienced, Alice champions the preservation of historical records, advocating against wiping Salem's dark past from the annals of history.
The publication of her chilling book marks a turning point in their lives.
Alice, alongside Rachel, decides it is time to move past their harrowing Salem experience.
Resolute to leave behind the spectral shadows of Salem, they prepare for their next journey, the chronicles of Salem carved into their hearts.
Their departure from Salem is bittersweet.
They bid farewell to the town with a greater respect for its haunted heritage, yet eager to leave the supernatural behind.
Their exit from Salem focuses on the haunting silhouette of the tree Sarah was hanged from, its knotted branches swaying ominously as a reminder of the town’s grim history.
As a gust of wind rustles through the grim branches, a soft, chilling echo serves as an unnerving reminder of the presence that once haunted the town.
Despite the comforting tranquility that the town has retaken, the eerie whispers suggest that Sarah's spirit may not have entirely left Salem.
The unnerving echoes serve as a grim reminder that the past, buried though it may be, continues to reverberate through the present.
The film concludes on a lingering shot of their vacant colonial mansion looming over the quiet Salem landscape.
A symbol of the uncanny events that unfolded within its walls, the house seems almost alive with history, silently whispering tales of witches and trials.
The subtle rustling leaves hark back to Sarah, creating an eerily beautiful melody that weaves its way through the decayed corridors of the abandoned house.
The camera zooms out to capture the deserted house surrounded by unsettling wilderness, symbolic of the ever-present connection between the supernatural and historical events.
As the curtain falls, the narrative leaves behind a haunting question - can a past as horrifying as Salem’s be erased from collective memory ever?

Leaving the viewer spellbound, the narrative invites personal interpretations as they wade through the murky history of Salem, experiencing the chilling tales of witch trials and haunting echoes of the past.

61818386.title: The Unholy (2021 film)
synopsis: In 1845, in Banfield, Massachusetts, Mary Elnor, a woman who has been accused of witchcraft, is hanged from a tree and set on fire.
After she dies, however, her ash is kept in a kern doll, indicating the doll has been possessed by Mary's spirit.
In the present day, disgraced journalist Gerry Fenn works a job reporting on all things unusual.
An assignment takes him to Boston, where the purported strange activity is revealed to be a teenage prank.
While preparing to leave, he discovers the doll and crushes it, accidentally freeing Mary's spirit.
Gerry later gets into an accident while driving away after seeing a young girl, Alice Pagett, run across the road.
He follows Alice to the tree where Mary was hanged, the site where he found the doll, and hears her speak before collapsing.
He takes her to a church and learns that Alice is deaf and mute.
Gerry decides to stay in town to investigate what he thinks could be a real story of the supernatural.
The following day, Alice stuns the community by speaking, proclaiming that she has been cured by the Virgin Mary.
This launches a media furore that is further propelled by other seemingly miraculous healings.
During one of them, a statue of the Virgin Mary near the chancel of the church cries tears of blood.
The Catholic Church sends Monsignor Delgarde to investigate the claims, assisted by Bishop Gyles.
Alice tells Gerry that while she has been speaking to an entity named Mary, she has only assumed that it was the Virgin Mary.

Beginning to suspect that something sinister is occurring due to visions of "Mary" as a horrific creature, Gerry finds a partner in Father William Hagan, Alice's maternal uncle, whom she healed, but also suspects the healings' true nature.
Hagan discovers a book detailing Mary Elnor, who performed miracles for Satan.
Before he has the chance to warn anybody, Elnor attacks him.
His body is found hanging in the church.
Gyles convinces Gerry to keep the apparent suicide of Hagan quiet as it will tarnish the divine occurrences; Hagan's death is declared an accident.
Gerry befriends Natalie Gates, the town's physician, and reveals that he was found fabricating stories.
That is why he now reports hoax stories, hoping this event will relaunch his career.
The pair comes across the information Hagan discovered, revealing Elnor sold her soul to Satan in order to gain power.
Satan would allow her and her descendants (one of whom being Alice) to perform "miracles" prompting people to pledge themselves to her, and in turn, Satan.
Elnor tries to kill Gerry, but Delgarde drives her away with prayer and a crucifix.
Gerry and Delgarde are shocked to learn that Gyles was aware of Elnor's story but thought that it was not connected to the recent miracles.
He warns Gerry that any attempt to share his views on the situation will fall on deaf ears due to Gerry's tarnished reputation.
Alice, who they believe is unaware of Mary's true nature, wishes to hold a church service by the tree and broadcast it to the masses.
Delgarde warns that those pledging themselves to Elnor would make her stronger and condemn their soul to Hell.
Gerry, Natalie and Delgarde try to perform a ritual in the church to stop this, but Elnor appears and crushes Delgarde with a burning cross.
Once the service begins, Alice urges everyone to pledge themselves to Mary three times.
Gerry manages to stop the crowd from fully pledging by claiming that the miracles were just more of his hoaxes, that they were all a result of the placebo effect.
Natalie communicates with Alice using sign language, urging her to stop the service.
Mary speaks to Alice, entreating her to continue it or never speak again.
Realizing Mary's true nature, Alice confirms that the miracles were not of God.
The tree bursts into flames, causing all the attendants to flee in panic as an angry Mary emerges from it.
She incinerates Gyles before attempting to kill Gerry, but Alice sacrifices herself to save his life.
This causes Mary to disappear, as Alice was her link to the living world.
Struck by Alice's sacrifice, Gerry begs God to save her life.
She comes back to life but is once again deaf.
All the people whom Alice cured soon return to their prior state.

68319282.title: Rising Rhythms: The Em Davis Story (film)
synopsis: The film begins with a heart-wrenching scene staged beneath the grand architecture of Saint Thomas Cathedral, Los Angeles.
The funeral procession of Wilder Davis, a formerly Grammy-winning local hip-hop icon, and the deeply loved father of Em Davis, is a devastating spectacle that sets our scene.
Em, trapped in the whirlpool of grief and loneliness, attempts to absorb the condolences pouring from an emotional crowd of teary-eyed fans and old childhood friends.
Her father's passing has left a void that seems all-encompassing.
In search of solace, she takes refuge in the quiet solitude of her father's secluded home studio.
Her fingers flit over his anthology of platinum albums, unpublished lyrics and scribbled music notes, each item an echo of her father's life and genius.
A zealous fire sparks within her as she decides to follow in her father's footsteps.
The ghostly beats were not just gusts of past but seeds of motivation, beckoning her to a life steeped in hip-hop, where she could uphold and continue her father's astounding legacy.
Act 2 dramatically reveals Em's journey, as she vigorously immerses herself in her music expedition.
Countless hours are spent in refining her freestyling, seasoning her songwriting with fresh creativity, and experimenting with the antiquated synthesizer.
Despite her determination, her lack of experience and burgeoning talent poses severe challenges.
They loom over her like hurdles in a race which she stumbles upon, threatening to shatter her blooming confidence.
Classmates at Carson Senior High School mock her ambitious dreams, planting seeds of doubt in her mind.
The established LA hip-hop community remains stoic, viewing her untamed raw talent with skepticism.
Her journey seems uphill, fraught with obstacles and crushed hopes.
However, Em learns to derive strength from her resilience.
This, fueled by her love for her father and a deep-seated passion for hip-hop music, bolsters her spirits.
This unrelenting determination is beautifully showcased at the annual LA Youth Music Fest.
Em transcends her fears and boldly steps into the limelight.
The crowd watches as she delivers her first public performance.
Her single mother, committed to the dream of a Stanford education for Em, is opposed to the pursuit of her unpredictable music career, which exacerbates her internal dilemma.
The conflict creates a rift, adding additional stress to the teenager's precarious situation.
Amidst this whirlwind of emotions, Em finds solace in the language she's beginning to grasp - the language of music.
She pens down her struggles, turning them into verses and tunes which eventually takes shape as a soulful track.
Her work catches the attention of the local LA music circles and the track soars on SoundCloud.
Its popularity is unexpected but well received - kickstarting a new chapter in her journey towards mainstream recognition.
Act 4 introduces a significant stakeholder in her journey - New Beat Records, an indie music label that takes note of the rising star.
The label comes forward with an enticing offer, a recording contract that could catapult her to stardom.
The lavish promises, however, come at a cost.
A contract that offers a rapid ascent towards fame also introduces the stress of losing her creative freedom and distinct musical identity.
Em is forced to weigh the allure of the glamour against her passion for her art.
Em takes a decisive stand, declining the offer to protect her individual style and her father's unfettered legacy.
It's a bold move, a refusal that resounds louder than an acceptance would have.
The film progresses towards a thrilling climax at a packed tribute concert held at the Hollywood Bowl.
This emotionally charged night is dedicated to the late Wilder Davis, a man whose contributions to hip-hop are etched in the hearts of many.
Em dominates the stage with her raw talent and an unwavering poise that belies her tender age.
Her performance, much like the journey that led her to this point, is deeply personal and beautifully executed.
The tribute concert becomes her turning point, a juncture where she attains long-awaited recognition from the LA hip-hop community.
A night to remember, a dream turning into reality.
The film culminates with a triumphant Em, successfully entrenching herself within the LA hip-hop scene.
She has etched her own distinct style while keeping her father's legacy alive in the pages of hip-hop.
Em's journey reaches a promising precipice.
As she peers into a future filled with potentials, it is her adherence to authenticity and her commitment to narrating her truth through music that will guide her into the chapters yet to be written.
Em Davis, in her resilience, originality, and raw talent, sparks a beacon of hope.
As the credits roll, we leave her at the edge of greatness - a unique voice resonating through the alleys of the LA music scene, ready to take on the world while honouring her father's rich legacy.

71791927.title: On the Come Up (film)
synopsis: Brianna "Bri" Jackson is a 16 year-old that has decided to take on the legacy of her late father, Lawless Jackson, who was a local rapper from the Garden Heights neighbourhood.
Bri is encouraged to pursued her dreams of rapping by her Aunt Pooh who manages her.
She navigates the life of who she wants to be, who she is and who everyone sees her as.
This is a struggle for her, especially at her current school.
After Bri runs from the "Ring" (a place where all the local MCs go to battle), she heads home and realizes that she needs to stop being scared and go for what she wants and what she deserves.
Her mom Jay is struggling to manage her life after losing her job.
They both start to figure out ways to come up with the money to pay bills.
This is on top of trying to rebuild the family's relationship after Jay left Bri and her older brother Trey with their grandparents while she was in active addiction.
Clean for 3 years now, Jay tries continually to reassure Bri that everything will be okay.
At school, Bri goes to sell candy to help out at home.
While saying bye to her best friends Sonny and Malik, she starts heading to class.
A male security officer becomes aggressive with her, demanding that she give him her bag full of candy.
She is then thrown to the ground, handcuffed and taken to the principal's office.
Jay is called to the school to pick up Bri and expresses her concerns on how Bri is cared for and protected at the school.
Even after the principal mentions this isn't the first time she has been in trouble.
Bri's behavior results in her getting suspended; it isn't anything compared to what is mentioned so Jay and Bri leave the school and head home.

Bri is convinced to try the battle at the Ring again by her Aunt Pooh and her friends, where she beats Milez, an up-and-coming artist who is the son of Supreme (a major producer, who worked with Bri's father before he died).
In the midst of celebrating the win, Aunt Pooh gets into an disagreement with the Kings Crown.
This disagreement resulted in everyone rushing home.
Bri and Aunt Pooh, excited about the battle go home after getting a few groceries.
Jay meets them at the door and is upset about them getting home late.
Bri gives her mom her battle winnings and tells her Aunt Pooh and her are doing good.
Since the win against Milez, Bri and Aunt Pooh decide to go back up to the Ring and battle again.
However, the bouncer disregards their entry because of the beef that happened between Aunt Pooh and some of the gang King's Crown.
Therefore, Bri goes to start a outside battle instead with another MC named Ms Tique and wins.
This gets the attention of Supreme.
Bri agrees to go to Atlanta along with Sonny and Malik to work with Supreme on a new hit.
After creating the hit, Malik and her get in an argument about her portraying someone she's not in the song.
This makes them no longer talk to each other.
