He mentions the key to Shinnok's prison has bonded to his soul and came to Raiden for advice about its purpose.
Raiden informs him that it is a key to untold power known as the Kamidogu, a supreme magical relic from a bygone era that could doom all the realms.

At the start of the tournament, Cage is defeated by Kytinn warrior D'Vorah; Sonya defeats D'Vorah and Li Mei; Kang defeats Jade; Stryker defeats Baraka; Jax defeats Kintaro by ripping his arms out of their sockets.
Back on Earth, Scorpion is being pursued by Cyrax and Sektor in a dockside shipping yard.
The trio is soon interrupted by Sub-Zero, but even he is outmatched by their superior enhancements and the arrival of the cybernetic Smoke.
With their enemies overwhelmed, the three cyber Lin Kuei apprehend their Hellspawn prey and make off to the Temple of Elements.
At their destination, they force Hanzo to open their designated portal.
As they prepare to eliminate him upon accessing its gateway, they are interrupted again by a vengeful Sub-Zero.
Scorpion fails to console Kuai Liang over mistakenly murdering his brother but agrees to a temporary alliance against Sub-Zero's clan.
Despite their efforts, the Lin Kuei retrieve the Kamidogu, leaving the pair for dead when the mountain crumbles on top of them.
As the second half of the final tournament is underway, Lao and Stryker are killed by Shao Kahn and Shang Tsung, respectively.
Kitana rebels against her stepfather instead of fighting against Raiden, only to be beaten into submission.
Kang defeats Shang Tsung regardless of a setback and spares him.
In the Netherrealm, the Lin Kuei realize too late that their employer was Shinnok as they learn of his plan to revive the One Being and bring an end to all of creation.
Subsequently, they are betrayed and killed for their services.
During the tournament's final stage, Raiden dies while losing his battle against Shao Kahn, enraging Kang to defeat the emperor and win the tournament.
However, celebrations are cut short as Shinnok finally succeeds in resurrecting the One Being and fusing himself.
With the aid of the Elder Gods, Sub-Zero, Scorpion, and Liu Kang engage in a fight and kill Shinnok while Johnny, Jax, Kitana, and Sonya protect civilians from Kahn's remaining army.
In the aftermath, Kang absorbs the One Being's power and reverts the realms into their original state, including Edenia.
Sonya and Johnny share a kiss while Liu and Kitana hold hands in hard-earned peace, unaware that Raiden is revived with his immortality.

79485685.title: Metropolitan Justice: Officer Down
synopsis: Our adventurous tale begins with Officer Maxwell "Max" Justice's introduction as the Commissioner in Los Angeles's elite Metropolitan Law Enforcement agency where he holds a position of unique prestige and responsibility.

Max, a stern and deeply devoted man, devotedly fulfills his professional duties because of an underlying sense of duty and unwavering loyalty while regularly stumbling into unforeseen mistakes and blunders.
In a plot twist that takes everyone by surprise, Max is picked to spearhead an undercover operation with the objective of apprehending a troublesome trickster causing havoc in Los Angeles.

This notorious trickster, christened as the "Pie Thief," is known for his outlandish antics of sneaking freshly baked pies from local bakeries and constructing ingenious but harmless traps for unsuspecting people.
Driven by fervor to prove his capabilities, Max dives straight into the operation with abundant excitement, leading to a chain of amusing, gut-busting sequences due to Max's lack of subtlety.
As he approaches the suspect's presumed hideout location—an abandoned barnyard—Max relies on his training and intuition but is met by a curious defense mechanism: a shiny, mouthwatering custard pie.
Intrigued, Max decides to examine this mysterious pastry but accidently sets off a ludicrous sequence of humiliating traps.
When the following dawn paintings the skies with its warm hues, Max regains consciousness only to discover himself buried in a human-shaped mound of custard remnants.
With renewed determination to capture the Pie Thief singlehandedly, he embarks on a tumultuous journey of humorously chaotic gumshoe escapades.
However, his hilarious investigation finally leads him back to the source of his embarrassment—the abandoned barnyard.
Fortunately, Max infiltrates the mischievous hideout with more sophistication this time, uncovering a hidden clue that reveals the thief's true base of operations.

Abandoning his clumsy tactics for meticulously honed detective skills, he stealthily tails the Pie Thief to uncover his secret—that the thief had been hoarding a vast collection of stolen pies in a massive warehouse.
The stage is set for a final showdown.
Amid the wild chaos, a brilliant idea blooms in the usually bumbling Max's mind.
He takes advantage of the Pie Thief's obsession with pie pranks, concocting a decoy pie laced with a harmless but potent sleep-inducing potion.
In the midst of a heated pie duel theme, Max launching the spiked pie at the thief, who unsuspectingly devours it without missing a beat.
Within moments, the now drowsy thief helplessly falls to the ground, the remnants of the drugged pie discarded nearby his unconscious body.
Victory is established.
A weary but victorious Max, covered head to toe in pie remnants, triumphantly manages to nab and handcuff the Pie Thief, heralding the much-needed peace in Los Angeles.
Despite gaining newfound fame and recognition, Max remains the same endearingly clumsy officer, continuing to provide non-stop entertainment for his colleagues.
His commitment never wavers, his determination never falters, and his spirit remains high, even in the face of relentless laughter at his expense.
Max's unwavering determination to uphold dignity despite his obvious sloppiness inspires his colleagues and sparks a wave of fresh perspective.
Max, despite his unique take on how to be a cop, positions himself as an essential character, offering a rare glimpse into the often unseen humorous side of law enforcement.
The final scene unfolds with Max stepping into the office amidst hearty applause and shared laughter, suggesting he's become a beloved figure at the office.
Amidst all the cheer and light banter, he drops his steaming mug of coffee, creating a familiar scene as case files are once again doused in fresh coffee.
The office echoes with widespread laughter as Max joins in, his face glowing with pride yet also tinted with a shade of embarrassment.
As the laughter mellows, Max picks up the drenched files, signaling the start of another usual day laced with hilarity in the precinct.
He embraces his clumsiness, but more significantly, he faces his peers and excels in his duties with a newly found sense of confidence and dedication.

64380542.title: Psych 2: Lassie Come Home
synopsis: Chief Carlton Lassiter of the Santa Barbara Police Department is ambushed on the job and left for dead.
After suffering a stroke on the operating table, Lassiter starts seeing unusual and possibly supernatural occurrences in his recovery clinic.
Concerned that his condition makes him an unreliable witness to the truth of what he saw, he reaches out to Shawn and Gus.
The pair travel to Santa Barbara from San Francisco to assist Lassiter in his efforts to find his shooter and explain what he has been seeing.
However, they are told that hallucinations are side-effects of the medicine.
What they do not realize is that Juliet O'Hara, Lassiter's former partner at the SBPD and Shawn's wife, is also investigating.
Chief Vick is attempting to become commissioner and is forced to shut down Juliet's investigation.
Morrisey, Lassiter's dog, returns from a walk with a human hand which Shawn and Gus send to Woody the coroner.
Juliet discovers the missing bullet, and sends it to be analyzed against orders.
Juliet and Shawn attempt to hide their own involvement from each other.
Woody's results reveal the hand belongs to a CEO who committed suicide and Shawn and Gus return to Santa Barbara.
Lassiter witnesses a bleeding man seek shelter in a building across from his own, but it is mixed up with other hallucinations causing everyone to disbelieve his claims.
Shawn and Gus investigate, but only find medical supplies and ice chips before being forced to leave by Dr Emile Herschel.
Selene, Gus's girlfriend, tells Juliet that the two have secretly gone back to Santa Barbara.
The two start their own investigation together.
Chief Vick discovers this, but covers it up whilst preparing for interviews.
Shawn and Gus investigate a Viking's Bar, and after being chased out, crash into a hideout where the supposedly dead CEO is hiding.
The CEO is sniped and killed and Buzz, now an SBPD detective, investigates.
Juliet and Selene arrive and Shawn finds a positive pregnancy test in her car.
Attempting to prove that the CEO's silent partner, Wilkerson, who is in Lassiter's hospital, is faking a coma, Gus and Shawn try to tickle him but it fails and they're kicked out.
Woody pretends to be an eccentric doctor named Catalon for them.
During her commissioner interview, Vick has an epiphany and leaves.

Woody, Shawn and Gus find bloodied clothes hidden among the medical supplies and them alongside Shawn's father Henry, attempt to convince Dolores - a nurse with a crush on Gus - that Herschel is guilty.

After Shawn and Gus both have vivid hallucinations they realise that the ice chips are spiked and come across an awake Wilkerson who tells them that he is being blackmailed by a doctor after the ice chips caused him to tell them everything.
The two go back to the bar with Woody where the find Selene, Juliet and Vick already there.
They discover the son of the owner murdered his father and Selene reveals she is pregnant, proposes to Gus and punches the killer.
Meanwhile, Dolores spikes Lassiter's drugs, but after he shoots the bag she tries to inject with poison.
Lassiter is encouraged by hallucinations to stand up after previously being unable and he manages to subdue her.
After it is all over, Lassiter manages to take his first steps to see his wife again and Woody is forced to flee the hospital after the real Catalon arrives.

98339164.title: Global Battleground: The Elite Coalition
synopsis: Our fragile world teeters on the brink of an abyss as major nations, including powerhouses such as America, Russia and China, are locked in a destructive conflict over dwindling natural resources, primarily oil and water.
These countries also skirmish over dominion of economically strategic locations, which are key to asserting their global dominance and survival.

Amidst vivid scenes of haunted and war-ripped battlefields scattered across the Middle East, civil unrest spilling over on the cobbled streets of Europe, and high-stakes diplomatic negotiations at the United Nations, the narrative swiftly transports us to the heart of this burgeoning crisis - the White House.

Within the austere confines of the Oval Office, an assembly of grim-faced advisors, spearheaded by laconic General Jordan Mathews—a veteran scarred by the brutalities of the Iraqi and Afghan wars—presses President John Harper about the rapidly escalating global tensions.
The geopolitical thermometer is inching toward a perilous red alert stage.

A thick cloak of anxiety descends upon the historic room as Mathews unfurls their intelligence agency’s chilling prediction: a catastrophic world conflict that could wreak havoc on America's national security and potentially spark the fires of an annihilating world war.
To counter this apocalyptic scenario, General Mathews proposes a radical solution that could alter the course of events.

His wild card involves assembling a classified task force composed of gifted individuals from varied corners of the globe, each wielding unique abilities to combat the encroaching warfront and potentially defuse the brewing crisis.
Harper, taken aback by this unconventional proposition, meets it with a raised eyebrow yet lends a patient ear to Mathews' justification.
Simultaneously, he realizes the gravity of the situation, and how the desperate times could very well justify such desperate measures.
With the odds meticulously weighed and considered, Harper spends an introspective moment gazing out at the spectacular sunset painting the Washington D.C. skyline.

He then pensively authorizes the clandestine operation, codenamed Operation Phoenix, fully aware how precariously the fate of the world hangs in the balance, suspended on the success of this daring gamble.

Act 1 concludes with an electrifying crescendo of suspense as Mathews, bearing the weight of the world and the fate of Operation Phoenix, kick-starts his precarious global recruitment drive for this unique team.

As he sifts through lofty stacks of candidate profiles, Mathews identifies several promising candidates: Aleksandr Kuznetsov, a Russian Spetsnaz commando with Herculean might; Dr. Claire Laurent, a star in the esoteric field of nanotechnology hailing from France.

Additionally, he uncovers the enigmatic Kenji Watanabe, a Japanese prodigy boasting extraordinary telekinetic capabilities, and Tupac Mamani, a revered mystic plucked from an indigenous Amazonian tribe, celebrated for his uncanny knack to harmonize and communicate with nature.

Each potential recruit flex the full gamut of their unique abilities: Aleksandr single-handedly bench-presses a decommissioned T-34 Russian tank, Dr. Laurent orchestrates an army of self-replicating nanobots to disassemble a condemned building brick by brick, Kenji exerts psychic influence over objects and skims through thoughts like braille, while Tupac calls upon nature, whipping up tempests and conversing with wild creatures.
Astounded by their exhibition of raw talent and unique abilities, Mathews resorts to strategic diplomacy and personal persuasion to enlist each member for Operation Phoenix.
Once gathered, the motley crew is whisked away to an ultra-modern underground base nestled in a nondescript location in the Nevada desert.
This clandestine bunker will serve as both their domicile, training center, and operations epicenter for the unforeseeable challenge they will soon confront.

66596313.title: Justice Society: World War II
synopsis: During World War II, President Roosevelt is asked by Colonel Steve Trevor to get the United States involved by creating a team of superhumans.

Consisting of Trevor, Black Canary, Hawkman, Hourman, Jay Garrick / Flash, and led by Wonder Woman, the Justice Society of America is formed.In the present, Barry Allen and Iris West picnic in Metropolis, hoping to get away from "work".
However, their plans are disrupted by Superman fighting Brainiac.
Allen comes to Superman's aid as the Flash.
When Brainiac fires a Kryptonite bullet, Flash tries to catch it, but runs fast enough to channel the Speed Force for the first time.
Guided by someone's voice, Allen arrives in what he believes is the past during a battle between the JSA and the Nazis.
Despite initial confusion over his allegiance, the JSA realizes Allen is an ally and seemingly comes from the future.
As the team mobilizes to stop another wave of Nazis, Allen takes Trevor back to the JSA's base and learns about the team, whom he never heard of before.
The JSA's next mission involves saving a codebreaker from a Nazi fortress.
He can presumably decode a message Trevor stole.
Despite the risk of causing a time paradox, the heroes realize they need Allen's help.
The heroes and "Shakespeare", the JSA's war correspondent, break in the fortress, defeat the guards, and discover prisoners in the dungeons.
A guard attacks Shakespeare, only for the bullets to bounce off of him.
Shakespeare's actual name turns out to be Clark Kent.
However, he has a different background from the Kent Allen knows.
Because of this, Allen realizes that he is in a parallel reality.
Meanwhile, the JSA finds the codebreaker, whom Hawkman recognizes as Doctor Fate.
Allen recognizes Fate as the man who called out to him.
He asks Fate if it is possible for him to return.
According to Fate, Barry can return but there is a lesson he needs to learn first and a mission he has to accomplish.
Breaking the code with his powers, Fate directs the team to the Bermuda Triangle before disappearing.
Arriving at the Triangle by sub, the team is detected by Nazi warships.
After depth charges disable the engines, the Flashes jump-start the sub while Wonder Woman attacks the enemy ships.
The heroes are saved by Atlantean soldiers, who direct them to a nearby outpost.
There, the JSA meets Aquaman, who imprisons them.
The code turns out to be a trap and Aquaman is being controlled by the Advisor, a telepathic mercenary who is influencing the Atlanteans to work with the Nazis.
The Advisor hopes to destroy them later and take over the planet.
The Flashes join forces to break out.
The team splits up, with one heading for New York to stop the Nazis and Atlanteans while Allen and Wonder Woman try to stop Aquaman and the Advisor from releasing sea monsters from the Trench.
While attacking Manhattan, the Atlantean forces are confronted by the JSA.
The heroes gain the upper hand until the monsters arrive, killing Hawkman and wounding Hourman.
Garrick and Canary destroy the monsters while Wonder Woman and Allen fight Aquaman.
With the help of Trevor, Wonder Woman breaks Aquaman's trident and frees him from the Advisor's control.
Realizing what he has done, Aquaman retreats in guilt.
The Advisor then reveals that a follow-up strike by Nazi bombers is imminent before killing Trevor with Aquaman's broken weapon.
Barry knocks out the Advisor while Kent returns to destroy the bombers.
Before dying, Trevor proposes to Wonder Woman, and she accepts.
The Advisor regains consciousness and escapes.
The JSA vows to avenge Trevor.
Before returning to his Earth, Allen says goodbye to the JSA.
Wonder Woman gives him the ring Trevor gave her, warning him of holding off for tomorrow.
Allen and Garrick use their combined speed to send the former back to the moment he intercepted the bullet.
After destroying Brainiac with it, Allen suggests forming a superhero team to combat future threats.
He then returns to Iris and proposes to her.
She accepts.

90474198.title: My Boy's Disappearance
synopsis: Robert Freeman, a renowned New York attorney renowned for his relentless pursuit of justice, engaged in fierce battles within the courtroom whilst representing clients in intricate murder trials, became a familiar figure in the city's legal community.

High above the city streets in his palatial seventh-floor corner office, with sweeping views of the Manhattan skyline, Robert found himself lost in the world of litigation, each brick and steel edifice blotting out the memories of his quaint suburban home and his inquisitive 8-year-old son, Tyler.
During his father's long hours at the office, Tyler, left mostly to his own devices, enjoyed pouring over enchanting tales of Greek mythology.
Encased in the labyrinthine stories, he found a passion in the unraveling of symbolic riddles and transposing his interpretations onto the worn pages of his sketchpad.
One afternoon, snatched from the clutches of legal precedents by the startling vibration of his smartphone, Robert looked down to see an unrecognizable number flashing on the screen.
Listening to the gravelly voice on the other end, Robert felt a chill of dread as the voice directed him to the Serenity Playground.
The fond memories of Tyler's excitable laughter faded, replaced by the harsh reality that the playground was now shrouded in the ink-black darkness of the night.
Rushing through the gates, the eerie silence and insomnia of the moonlight heightened the surreal and terrifying reality.
Robert’s horror-stricken eyes fell upon the stark emptiness; Tyler’s beloved sketchpad lay abandoned on a bench, a worn-out graphite pencil beside it.
The sight struck him as a brutal reminder of the widening gulf between his career and his role as a father.
His heart pounded with an unbearable terror: Tyler had vanished without a trace.
In response to Tyler’s inexplicable disappearance, the NYPD initiated a rigorous investigation; however, the lack of witnesses or any substantial evidence hindered their progress.
They were stumped by the absence of a lead.
Racked with guilt and desperation, Robert decided to utilize his keen attention to detail, harnessed over his years as an attorney, in the search for his son.
Starting in Tyler's room, he painstakingly sifted through the whimsical mess of dinosaur figurines and poster-filled walls that epitomized Tyler's spirit.
Amidst the frustration and hopelessness, Robert noticed a crumpled piece of paper in the corner.
Unfolding the paper, he discovered a cryptic note penned by Tyler, revealing a coded message based on their shared love of Greek myths.
Deciphering the mysterious note led Robert to a dilapidated tenement, swathed in shadows, in the heart of Brooklyn - a place in stark contrast to his air-conditioned, high-rise office.
The grim building was home to an eccentric old man, whispered to possess an encyclopedic knowledge of Greek mythology.
Arrogance and fear set aside, Robert sought his help.
The old man scrutinized the coded message, revealing its fascinating connection to the twelve daunting tasks of Hercules - his legendary labors.
Though skeptical and wary of the modern world's intrusions.
the man was intrigued by the unusual case and agreed to lend his expertise to the desperate father, initiating an unexpected alliance.
All the while, Mia, a striking woman with a mysterious past, whose fingerprints had been discovered at the playground, resurfaced from the shadows.
Tormented by guilt and her link to the case, Mia came forward.
She’d been the last person to see Tyler at the playground that day and felt a compelling responsibility to help in whatever way she could.

Driven by remorse and empathy, Mia allied herself with Robert, enhancing their combined knowledge with her recall of the events at the playground and any potential clues she might have unintentionally possessed.

Encountering a series of unexpected threats and engaging in chilling pursuits, the unlikely trio found themselves face to face with a dangerous criminal organization that shared a peculiar connection with Hercules's myth.
During a high-risk escape from the hair-raising dangers, Robert stumbled upon a hidden laptop in Tyler's secret treehouse.
The laptop revealed a chilling video clip of Tyler's abduction, causing his heart to stutter with fear and urgency.
In the gut-wrenching footage, the terrifying face of a masked man pressuring Tyler for information about Hercules’s ninth labor - the Belt of Hippolyta - became clearly visible.
The horrifying reality added a sense of dire urgency to their ongoing quest.
Mia and the old man joined forces with Robert to dissect the complex maze of Greek legends, leading them toward the legendary sanctuary of the belt.
Their relentless pursuit for clues reached a dramatic climax where they found themselves engaged in a brutal confrontation with the kidnapper’s ruthless henchmen.
Lured by the immeasurable power of the belt, they defended their unholy mission vehemently.
Leveraging his well-honed strategic thinking and unwavering determination, Robert led a heroic confrontation against the relentless villains.
As Robert held the antagonists at bay, Mia and the mythology savant successfully located a hidden basement where Tyler had been cruelly confined, ensnared within crude, iron bars.

With Tyler finally safe, the courageous duo made a swift exit, their flight aided by the sudden appearance of NYPD squad cars against the backdrop of the night, their sirens cutting through the ghostly silence.
Amidst New York's labyrinthine streets, Robert held his traumatized son close, promising himself to make amends for past mistakes and striving to rebuild their damaged relationship.
Gripping his phone, he dialed Linda's number, his estranged wife.
When she answered, Robert was able to share the most significant news: Tyler was safe.
Faced with the harsh reality and glaring shortcomings as a father, Robert made a momentous decision to turn his back on his thriving legal profession.
Robert hung up his crisp business suits, replacing them with everyday wear, and prioritized being a caring, attentive father.
His focus now solely on restoring Tyler’s innocence and helping him heal from the traumatic incident.

Together, they journeyed through therapy sessions, as they learned to navigate the turbulent emotional sea of their shared experiences, fostering a renewed bond founded on understanding, empathy, and unspoken love.
"My Boy's Disappearance" closes with Robert, deep into the night, softly narrating tales of Hercules’ valor to Tyler.
The stories were interspersed with shared laughter, as riddles replaced sketches, signaling a promise of a warm and reformed relationship.

65504024.title: My Son (2021 Christian Carion film)
synopsis: Edmond Murray is an absent father who is called to the site of his son Ethan's disappearance.
He meets and briefly consoles his former wife Joan there, and promptly joins a search party before being interviewed by the police.
After being interviewed by Inspector Roy (the police), Edmond visits his former wife's new partner, Frank, and the two begin talking.

After seeing that Frank has made plans for a new home for himself and Joan (without bedroom accommodation for Ethan), and upon hearing that Frank has given Joan a Valium tablet to help her sleep, Edmond becomes irate and confrontational, accusing Frank of being responsible for his son's disappearance.
He assaults him in the kitchen, knocking him unconscious and calls Inspector Roy to have him look into Frank.
Edmond is arrested but no charges are filed, as Frank is apparently forgiving of Edmond due to his emotional stress at the moment.
Edmond is later met by Inspector Roy, who hides Edmond's phone in a microwave oven (so as not to be heard), and informs him that he has been taken off the case without any explanation.
Edmond looks through Frank's phone, which he took after knocking him out, and finds videos of Ethan leading up to the disappearance.
During this, he realises there is a car present in both videos, two weeks apart, hidden barely out of sight.
Relying on Joan's brother who works in the insurance industry, Edmond obtains the vehicle owner's address, a William O'Connor who lives at an isolated farm.
After arriving at the location, Edmond hears a vehicle approach.
Hiding, he grabs a crowbar and eventually knocks out O'Connor, and ties him up to a post in the shed.

After an aggressive interrogation involving a blowtorch, O'Connor reveals that he is responsible for sending pictures of children outside of schools to a kidnapping ring operated for paedophiles, who then "choose" which children will be kidnapped.
After being told of his son's location, at a hilltop lodge, Edmond drives to near the lodge, continuing on foot to hide his approach.
Joan arrives at the O'Connor farm, and finds another kidnapped girl unconscious in the back of his vehicle; Edmond had not thought to look.
She takes the child to the hospital, then leaves when Edmond sends a text telling her where the lodge is, asking her to contact Inspector Roy.
She calls Roy as she heads to the lodge herself.
When Edmond reaches the lodge, he sees that three members of the kidnap ring are present.
He incapacitates their vehicle, which proves fortuitous, as they were preparing to take an unconscious Ethan away.
Edmond knocks out Steven, the kidnapper who was repairing the vehicle.
After a game of cat and mouse with kidnappers Alan and Fergus, during which Alan mistakenly shoots Fergus dead, Edmond finds Ethan.
By then, Joan has arrived, and the three make a narrow escape.
During the escape, Edmond is shot and veers off the road when he loses consciousness.
As a vehicle approaches, Joan and Ethan exit, hiding behind a tree before being found by Roy, who takes them to safety.
Sometime later, outdoors and surrounded by water and mountains, Joan and Edmond stand with Ethan as he flies a small remote control quadcopter.
Inspector Roy calls out to Edmond, who bids Ethan farewell after promising that he will eventually be back to stay.
Roy and Edmond drive off, revealing that the outing had been a courtesy, as Edmond is under arrest for his part in the illegal activities of his company.
Roy states that the kidnapping network is being dismantled, with many more arrests pending.
He also assures Edmond that the judge will likely take into account the benefit of Edmond's actions during his court cases.

34445238.title: Asian Alliances (2021 film)
synopsis: High up in the secluded mountains of Yunnan province in China, the serene calm of the isolated settlement is broken by the flurry of activity as the villagers commence the customary preparations for their annual Bai San Xi (Marriage Festival).
Amid the hum of the bustling community, a young, ruggedly handsome blacksmith named Chi stands out.
Chi, although known best as the village blacksmith, harbor a dream.
He wishes to break away from the norm of arranged marriages in village society, thus, choosing a wife based on love and shared interests rather than obligation.
A young, spirited lady by the name of May, who serves as the local schoolteacher, mirrors Chi's audacious sentiments.
Known for her gutsy attitude and love for adventure, she believes in personal freedom over predetermined marital alliances.
Being fully aware of their children's defiant attitudes towards the village's deeply-rooted norms, their traditionally-minded parents secretly conspire to form a union between Chi and May.
They invite both under the pretext of an innocent tea ceremony.
Unaware of their parents' subtle machinations, Chi and May meet and strike a shared chord.
However, it is not one of romance, but a united disapproval of the village's archaic marital customs.
What starts as casual conversations fueled by mutual defiance evolves into a sturdy pact: to subvert their village's longstanding tradition of obligatory marriage alliances.
The news of their unconventional alliance gradually spreads through the tiny conservative village like pollen in the wind.
Meanwhile, Chi becomes a spectacle for curious villagers who watch his quest for a non-traditional bride unfolds.
Concurrently, the bold spirited May invites who are the village's socially awkward misfits, including a reclusive poet known for his perpetual shyness and a mute artist, for bold public dates.
While rumors about her groundbreaking actions whirl all around her, May holds her ground, confidently asserting her right to choose her companion.
Amid chatty neighbors' speculations and a whirlwind of comedic trials, Chi and May find a safe haven and empathy in each other.
Their shared battles against societal norms, hilarious accounts of dreadful dates, and nightly rebellion strategies are threads that gradually weave an unseen bond between them.
Unnoticed by the villagers who are busy enjoying their humorous antics, a subtler yet significant shift occurs – Chi and May become more united in their stance and warmer towards each other.
With the Bai San Xi approaching fast, just a week away, Chi and May devise a plan to appear as the most mismatched pair in the village's history.
To the surprise of their parents, Chi embarks on an extravagant courtship of May, which include serenades in the dead of the night and the hilarious gifting of an untamed, pet jackal.
May reciprocates Chi’s dramatic gestures, escalating the absurd displays with comical repartees to the point of hilarity, causing their parents' increasing bewilderment.
With the pressure reaching boiling temperatures, their parents yield, finally revealing the truth – the initial arrangement was for Chi and May to wed.
Instead of a peaceful respite or celebratory joy, the revelation results in the village becoming a stage for an even grander and over-the-top display of feigned affection from the defiant duo.
As dusk swallows the village, Chi and May find themselves in a muddle, grappling with the unexpected twist in their tale.
Hidden from prying eyes, they probe into their hearts, their trusted friendship serving as the stage for revealing deep-seated feelings.
Their brave confessions bring out a truth they were too cautious to previously admit – that they had unknowingly fallen deeply in love.
Their realizations underline the ironic outcome of their shared rebellion; they had unknowingly fought against the very fate they had desired.
As they share their humorous revelations, the still night resonates with their heartfelt laughter, creating an ambience where irony, relief, and disbelief whirl in a dance of overwhelming emotions.
They finally come to understand that their rebellion was not aimed at the tradition itself, rather the harsh compromise it imposed on their personal choices.

They mutually agree that their spirited resistance was indeed necessary as it had steered them towards an informed choice to love each other profoundly, precisely what they had been seeking since long.
They hold each other tight, vowing to stand against the village maintenance of traditional practices while upholding their unique love.
With their newfound resolution, they decide to journey together, aligning their mutual affection with the village's age-old traditions without bowing down to societal pressure.
Hand in hand, Chi and May return to the village, spirits high and faces glowing with resolve to confront their interwoven fate.
They stand before their families and the shell-shocked villagers, announcing their resolution of binding their futures together while preserving their individuality.
Swiftly, the village takes to their heels, arranging a grand wedding for Chi and May, which is accepted by the couple with open arms and shared excitement.
Chi and May enthusiastically take part in the wedding arrangements, their energy and enthusiasm spreading like wildfire through their humble abode.

Bearing in mind their previous resistance to strict customs, they make sure to choreograph each aspect of their special day, deftly marrying traditional folklore with their personal expressions of love.
Their series of unusual arrangements not only provide a pleasant union of tradition and modern thoughts to their parents but also gifts them a profound sense of peace and pure joy.
As the wedding day breaks upon the village, it comes alive in all its vibrant colours, echoing anticipation and uninhibited joy under the crystal blue sky.
The Bai San Xi unfolds in its full glory, with everyone gathering in unity to celebrate Chi and May's unique union.
Chi arrives in style, reverently adorned in well-made wedding attire accentuated with eye-catching handcrafted accessories, epitomizing the special merger that his wedding represents.
May, sparkling in her traditional Yunnan bridal outfit, gracefully marches forth, embodying a stunning mix of respect for tradition and quest for personal freedom.

Their proud parents, with tear-filled eyes and over brimming joy, partake in the ceremony of joyously surrendering their children into this beautiful bond of love, amidst rounds of applause and blessings.
Amid echoes of heartfelt cheers and blessings, Chi and May recite their matrimonial vows, binding their unity and reaffirming their precious love.
The grand fête concludes with an elaborate banquet, exciting traditional dances, and heartwarming retelling of Chi and May's eccentric journey of love.
As the moon casts a silvery glow over the village, Chi and May walk ahead into their shared future adorned with love, mutual respect, acceptance, and personal choice above all else.

Their remarkable story draws to a close here, epitomizing their journey of brave defiance, deep friendship, heartfelt love, and a harmonious blend of traditional respects with the bravery of choosing individuality.

68127880.title: 7 Days (2021 film)
synopsis: The film opens with several Indian couples discussing their traditional arranged marriages.
An Indian website is a modern method for unmarried singles to seek a spouse.
Both Ravi's and Rita's mothers have created profiles for them on Arranged, a website for America-based Indians.
Ravi and Rita have an awkward pre-arranged date at a dry reservoir.
As her mother had posted she was a vegetarian, he had brought a special meat-free meal.
When she points out that the lemonade he brought was hard and the site stated he is a teetotaler, embarrassed, he pours it on the ground.
Suddenly they both get alerts to their phones about the COVID-19 pandemic, going back to her place they simultaneously call their moms.
It is a mess, trash everywhere, dirty dishes and evidence that she drinks.
Ravi waits for the car rental agency to call him back, as his train has been cancelled.
As there won't be a car until morning, Rita offers him the couch.
After he updates his mom, he overhears her talking dirty to someone on the phone.
In a panic, he goes to her bathroom and finds her vibrator.
First thing in the morning Ravi leaves as soon as he can on foot to the agency.
Rita gives him a friendly goodbye, but he leaves coldly.
Relieved he's gone, she grabs a beer and a cold chicken drumstick from the fridge.
Ravi suddenly pops back in, as he is told it will be three more days.
He is forced to shelter in place due to the pandemic.
When Ravi asks about the alcohol and meat Rita begs him to not tell her mother.
He concedes then blurts out that they aren't a good match, pointing out her dishonesty as a reason.
She explains that her mother pays for her rent in exchange for her participation in the website.
Ravi tries to make small talk, and then asks Rita if he can clean, saying it relaxes him.
Finished cleaning, he gets a teasing call from his brothers about being holed in with her.
He is antsy whereas she is totally relaxed, used to inactivity as she's unemployed.
Chatting again, Rita admits she's not remotely interested in marriage, whereas Ravi insists he needs to get married before he can have any intimacy.
He insists he's not boring, describing odd idiosyncrasies of his lab mates.
Rita gets a call from her lover, who turns out to be married.
Unable to go for a walk, Ravi shows he's emotional as he describes to her a Bollywood movie.
Bored, she spikes his Coke with whiskey and, as he's never touched alcohol, it quickly affects him.
He both tries to do standup and then dance for the first time, but gets sick.
Sore at Rita the next morning, Ravi blames her for his hangover.
A short while later, she joins him for an online workout.
Her mother calls, asking about the date, hoping she didn't divulge her true self, as he couldn't love 'that you'.
Ravi offers to teach Rita to cook.
In the process, he is appalled at her process and the end result, but she is pleased.
His mother sets him up on a virtual blind date, which Rita coaches him through.
Ravi finishes the date really happy, but dreams of Rita.
The next morning, after Rita hears Ravi's conversation via speakerphone with his mother she goes stir crazy and insists on going out, and doesn't take a mask.
She arrives back late.
In the morning, upon saying goodbye she coughs, so he cancels his departure to help Rita quarantine.
During the day or so of quarantining they get to know one another.
she talks about her affair, he tells her very infantile knock knock jokes during the night her bad coughing concerns him, so he spoons her.
By morning he calls an ambulance.
Once Rita is hospitalised, Ravi goes through her things, with notable and increasing affection.
He has a lot of difficulty having contact via phone.
Ravi discovers her paintings are all sweet and about love, not raunchy as she implied.
Her mom calls, and he tells her about Rita's COVID hospitalization.
She asks to zoom with him.
The few times Ravi does get through, the woman in Rita's room dies.
A newbie there kindly keeps him updated.
When she's released, they meet in a park and their mutual affection is visible.

9711330.title: When Memories Hurt
synopsis: The film “When Memories Hurt” unfolds on an idyllic Tuesday morning, with Lisa Thompson in her cozy kitchen, preparing breakfast for her husband, John.
Their Victorian-style, two-story house is located in the serene, chestnut tree-lined streets of suburban Massachusetts.
Over breakfast, their longtime friend, Sarah, joins them, and the trio immerse themselves in tales from their shared past.
However, John's subtle sips of Jim Beam throughout the morning gradually become more frequent, sign of his deep-seated dependence on alcohol.
The jovial morning descends into a heated argument when John forgets their anniversary, and Sarah intervenes, hoping to defuse the tension.
As John's dependence on alcohol deepens, he becomes increasingly volatile.
One night, under the influence of bourbon, John violently hurls a bottle, shattering an heirloom coffee table.
This act of violence fractures their tranquil home life.
Lisa decides to confront John about his spiraling addiction and their relationship.
The confrontation becomes a battlefield for painful memories and accusations, pushing their relationship to a breaking point.
Lisa shows John the door, leaving her alone in their once lively home.
After John's departure, Lisa begins to relive traumatizing flashbacks of her troubled childhood.
John seeks temporary refuge with Sarah and moves into her apartment.
Sarah chooses to support him and persuades him towards the path of professional help.
Sarah encourages John to attend Alcoholics Anonymous.
John does so, eventually attending his first ever AA meeting.
There, he is confronted by the shared stories of individuals battling their own demons of addiction and loss.
This shared pain forces him to acknowledge his destructive pattern of dependence on alcohol.

67536523.title: After We Fell
synopsis: In a flashback, Carol Young kicks her husband Richard out of their house over his alcoholism, despite Tessa's pleas for him to stay.
In the present, Tessa and her boyfriend Hardin Scott bring a now-homeless Richard to their apartment.
Tessa wants to let her father stay so she can build a relationship with him, while Hardin distrusts Richard, even offering him money to leave.
Richard declines the money, explaining that he only wants to make amends.
Tessa and Landon, Hardin's step-brother, discuss Tessa's move to Seattle to be closer to her employer Vance Publishing.
Hardin arrives and argues with Tessa over the move; he hoped to move with Tessa to London after graduation.

After a phone call with his mother Trish, who asks Hardin to attend her upcoming wedding and talks about her close relationship with Vance's owner Christian Vance, Hardin accompanies Richard to a bar, where they get into a fight with a bystander over lewd comments about Tessa.
The next day, Richard decides to leave the apartment, while Hardin and Tessa fight again about her move to Seattle.
Kimberley, Vance's fiancée, offers to let Tessa and Hardin stay with the couple in Seattle, after which Hardin apologizes to Tessa.
Tessa and Hardin accompany Hardin's dad, Ken, his step-mom, Karen, and Landon to the family's lake house for a weekend vacation.
Hardin sheds some of his previous hostilities towards his family, growing closer to them.
While the family is out for dinner, Hardin encounters an old friend, Lillian, who he introduces to Tessa.
Tessa grows jealous of the attention Lillian receives from Hardin and begins to flirt with their waiter Robert.
After having sex in a hot tub, Hardin asks Tessa if she ever had feelings towards her coworker, Trevor.
Tessa admits she may have briefly, causing him to storm away.
When Hardin tells Tessa that he is with Lillian, Tessa goes to the restaurant from before and flirts with Robert, who gives her his phone number.
Hardin and Lillian arrive, and Lillian explains that she's gay and thus has no interest in Hardin.
When Hardin finds Robert's phone number in Tessa's belongings the next day, they leave the lake house early.
After her move to Seattle, Tessa and Hardin do not speak for several days; he finds her journal, wherein she describes all the pain caused by their relationship.
Eventually, they reconcile, and Hardin takes up boxing as a way of resolving his anger issues.
Vance and Kimberly tell Tessa that they are expecting a child.
When Hardin has a nightmare of Tessa being unfaithful to him, he surprises her in Seattle, admits to reading her journal, and apologizes for causing her pain.
After spending some time together, Hardin returns home, where he finds Richard in his apartment, brutally beaten.
He had been attacked by men to whom he owed money; Hardin offers him a watch to pay off the debt.
When Tessa visits her gynecologist to start birth control, she is informed that, because of an issue with her cervix, she may never conceive.
Hardin tells Tessa he plans on moving to Seattle in two months.
Hardin eventually agrees to attend his mother's wedding in London, taking Tessa along and showing her his hometown.
The night before the wedding, Hardin catches Trish and Vance having sex, causing an altercation between the three.
Trish and her fiancé get married the next day.
Tessa sits with Kimberley, who admits she knows of Vance's infidelity, but that she loves him and can't stay angry with him.
Hardin discusses the previous night's events with Vance at a local bar.
Kimberly tells Tessa, and Vance tells Hardin, that Vance is Hardin's real father.
The news shocks Tessa and infuriates Hardin, who storms out of the bar.
Tessa finds Hardin and they embrace passionately in the street.

21212119.title: Post the Divide
synopsis: Our tale begins with Tom Peterson, a middle-aged software engineer meticulously packs every sliver of his life into a multitude of cardboard boxes.
These are the remnants from his dismantling shared home with Emily Black, a renowned occupational therapist once content in their two-story suburban haven.
Tom wrestles with the ghostly memories spiralling out from the corners of each room.
The house is an echo chamber—where once hearty laughter danced in the air, now only the silent spectres of shattered dreams of globe-trekking adventures linger.
His impending journey of solitude begins from his minimalist studio apartment, located in the heart of downtown Boston.
The sterile lifelessness of the stark apartment contrasts against the memory-infused homeliness of his former abode.
An effort to breathe life into the lifeless walls of his new home sees Tom carefully arranging his vintage book collection and vinyl records, each item seeped with nostalgia.
However, despite his every attempt, the draining gloom in his heart seems to seep into every corner.
A turn in Tom's life comes on a frosty winter evening when he's departing from his towering office building and encounters a local homeless man known as Jack.
Jack insists on grabbing his attention, but Tom, burdened by an upcoming major project deadline, ignores him in haste.
Jack keeps appearing on the periphery of Tom's new life.
Whether it's Tom's favourite coffee shop or the vicinity of his office, Jack somehow manages to carve his presence, each time with a cryptic message for Tom.
Hemmed in by his professional demands and personal turmoil, Tom continues to brush aside Jack’s mysterious hints.
Tired of Jack's relentless pursuits, Tom finally gives in and lets the homeless man speak his mind near an isolated thrift shop.

Jack begins his tale, a narrative of immense love for a woman he's lost, a devastating series of financial downfalls resulting from this affliction, and a descent into the harsh reality of homelessness.
On recognizing their situational similarities, Tom finds himself drawn towards the mystery of the wooden box Jack mentions.
Jack believes this box, layered with whispers and the secrecy of Jack's past, holds the key to amend his frayed life.
Tom, now deeply moved by Jack’s tale and invested in the mysterious box, proposes an unlikely partnership—to locate it amidst the sprawling cityscape of Boston.
They dive into the heart of Boston, busily threading through its labyrinthine alleyways filled with faces each telling their unique stories of love and loss.

After days of searching—days filled with hope, anticipation, and an underlying sense of urgency—they finally unearth the box in a dilapidated, cobweb-infested warehouse located in the grimy Grunge district of Boston.
From its dust-laden cradle, they lift a tangible chunk of Jack's past.
The box is an unexpected Pandora's box of memories—yellowed love letters and nostalgic Polaroid photographs; each item a testament to Jack's ill-fated choices and profound regrets.
As each piece uncovers a distinct chapter of Jack's life, Tom starts recognizing a haunting reflection of his own life.
Echoes of his shortcomings and misjudgements resonate in each tale of regret that spills out of the box.
Suddenly, the cracks in his relationship with Emily become glaringly apparent to him, now highlighted like neon signs against a dark sky.
Tom is shaken by this revelation.
Even the marital issues he had comfortably swept under the plush carpet of dismissal now stand in stark contrast against the brutal light of reality.
Stirred by Jack's missteps and armed with newfound self-awareness, Tom now recognises the necessity of confronting his diminishing relationship with Emily.
He chooses to face his past, suppress his inflated ego, and reach out to Emily.
He proposes that they reevaluate their decision to separate, driven by the lingering embers of their shared love.
The narrative shifts to Emily, taken aback by Tom's initiative, and now caught in contemplative silence in a bustling coffee shop.
The air grows taut with suspense as Emily mulls over her options.
In one possible unfolding of events, Emily rediscovers fondness in Tom's sincerity and tearfully relents to giving their relationship another chance.
This turn of events sees the plot thicken towards a happier conclusion where they agree to mend their crumbling relationship, seeking the guidance of a relationship counsellor.
The tale nears its finale as Tom acknowledges homeless Jack during a heartfelt exchange in a local park for unknowingly steering Tom towards personal growth and reconciliation.

61533421.title: After We Collided
synopsis: While reflecting upon his breakup with Tessa Young, Hardin Scott meets a homeless man, whom he rebuffs after the man tries to ask him a question.
On her first day as an intern at Vance Publishing, Tessa shares an awkward encounter with coworker Trevor Matthews.
Impressed with her work, Vance's owner Christian Vance takes Tessa, Trevor, and his secretary and girlfriend Kimberly to a Seattle-area work event.
At a nightclub, Tessa and Trevor network with and impress a businessman considering an investment in Vance.
Tessa drunk-dials Hardin, compelling him to track her down.
He arrives at her hotel room to find a half-dressed Trevor (whose clothes were drying after Tessa accidentally spilt wine on them).
Hardin kicks Trevor out of the room, and she fights with him before they have sex.
The next morning, Hardin and Tessa fight again before she and Trevor leave with Vance, who informs his interns that he has secured financing from the businessman.
Tessa and Hardin each come to regret ending their relationship.
When Tessa returns to the apartment she shared with Hardin to retrieve some belongings, he steps in with his mother Trish, who believes they are still dating.
Tessa plays along and finds that she enjoys spending time with both of them.
Trish reveals to Tessa the source of Hardin's personality issues: he is traumatized after watching her get violently raped by men to whom his father Ken owed money when he was a boy.
On the following day, her birthday, Tessa visits her mother Carol's and encounters her ex-boyfriend Noah.
The two accidentally reveal that Tessa's long-lost father had come looking for her, but her mother had turned him away.
Feeling betrayed, Tessa returns to Hardin's apartment and resumes their relationship.
On Christmas Day, Hardin, Tessa, and Trish attend a holiday party at Hardin's dad Ken's.
Furious at Ken's apparent willingness to forgive himself for his past misdeeds, Hardin gets drunk and assaults him.
Tessa recounts the incident to Trevor, who warns her that her relationship with Hardin will not end well.
Vance contacts Tessa to inform her that his company is expanding and moving to Seattle, and offers her a job there.
On New Year's Eve, Tessa and Hardin attend a party hosted at a university frat house, where they reconnect with a number of their former college friends.

Each misinterprets a conversation held by the other: Tessa assumes Hardin is cheating on her when she sees him asking for the forgiveness of another girl with whom he had previously been involved, and Hardin accidentally learns of Vance's offer and concludes that Tessa will leave him for Trevor.
The couple fight, and she storms off.
Hardin only sees apologetic texts sent by Tessa the next day after charging his phone.
He calls her, but she reaches for her phone while driving and is injured in a car accident.
Devastated by his indirect responsibility for the accident, Hardin decides to end his relationship with Tessa, but Trish talks him out of it.
He races to Vance's farewell party, where Vance proposes to Kimberly.
Tessa fights with Hardin once more before forgiving him.
Later, the homeless man who spoke to Hardin earlier confronts the pair and reveals his identity: he is Tessa's father.

84124014.title: Sarah's Distress: Whispering Shadows
synopsis: In the lush countryside sits a humble brick house, the home of Sarah Johnson, an extraordinarily brave young widow, and her seven-year-old son, Max Johnson.
One bone-chilling December night, the comforting silence in their home is fractured by inexplicable whispers, seemingly seeping from the dark confines of their rarely visited, dust-coated basement.
Max, a cheerful second-grader with an insatiable curiosity, seems oblivious to these uncanny phenomena that have begun to invade the tranquility of their life.
Summonsing her courage, one brave day, Sarah descends into the ominous gloom of the basement, unearthing hazy physical shadows and confounding symbols impossibly etched on the peeling basement walls.

Their sense of security, once niche in their quiet house, is shattered when an uninvited, unknown figure seizes the comfort of the night's darkness to trespass their home leaving behind the perplexing symbols present in the basement.
Fear sweeps over Sarah like a cold wave, ensnaring her into a labyrinth of trepidation and uncertainty.
Times becomes a canvas of change for Max too, who, against Sarah's hope for normality, starts withdrawing into a shell, his sunny disposition shadowed by an eerie aloofness.
His unsettling fascination for the cryptic symbols in the basement adds fuel to Sarah’s growing suspicion, escalating her fear.
Rattled by these unsettling changes and desperate for answers, Sarah approaches Mr. Whitmore, a historian and occult connoisseur, respected by the locals.

Whitmore, a man who embodies the history of this small town, unearths a blood-curling tale involved a nefarious cult which executed horrifying murders decades ago on their house's grounds, amplifying Sarah's terror.
Alarmed by Whitmore's revelation and the impending danger, Sarah alerts the local police only to be met with condescending skepticism.
The dismissive police force glibly attributes her terrifying tale to the stress of her single-motherhood, adding insult to her fears and intensifying her sense of alienation.

As the spectral whispers gradually intensify into violent apparitions and frightening poltergeist activities, Sarah, utterly desperate and panicking, seeks the help of Clint Edwards, a globally renowned paranormal investigator.
The initially soft-spoken whispers of the unseen now vociferously tear at Sarah and Max's sanity, inching them dreadfully towards an impending catastrophe.
Max, once the delightful beacon of innocence, now succumbs to the grisly hands of the supernatural, his alarming personality shift leaving Sarah in deep distress.
His unnerving utterances in the dead of the night during his trance-like states trigger an overwhelming terror in Sarah, a palpable desperation engulfing her.
But soon, help arrives in the form of Clint; a man who emanates an eerie familiarity with the nefarious unknown, which does nothing but confirm Sarah's fears.

Clint orchestrates a series of spine-chilling séances, through which he realizes that Malcolm, the sinister cult leader from Whitmore's accounts, is attempting to connect to the physical realm using Max as a gateway.
Sarah's already fraught nerves shudder under the realization that this perilous entity was not just threatening her, but was viciously preying on her innocent son.
A heated showdown ensued, Sarah channeling unthinkable courage and destroying her encroaching fear to face Malcolm's dark forces head-on.
Assisted by Clint, who armed himself with holy symbols and incanted exorcism prayers, they attempted to purge the house of its unrested spirits.

Amid the thunderous chanting and the room alive with ghostly interactions, Sarah clung to Max, a mother lioness protecting her cub from imminent danger, promising to shield him from the haunting darkness.
After a tireless struggle against the malevolent spirits, Clint managed to expel Malcolm from their residence, liberating Max from the spectral clutches the young boy found himself in.
Relocating to a cozy townhouse in the bustling suburb meant an opportunity to bury their harrowing past deep, and usher in a life filled with healing and hope.

But as they looked back one last time at their former dwelling, the walls echoed faint yet undeniable whispers, a chilling reminder of the menacing force that could potentially reappear, laying a foundation for a possible grisly sequel.

59850657.title: Brahms: The Boy II
synopsis: Liza and her son Jude are attacked in their home late at night, after Liza hears noises downstairs which she investigates.
She is then grabbed by two masked men and suffers a head wound.
Liza and Jude are left traumatized by the event.
Later, she is plagued by nightmares while Jude remains traumatized even after therapy, and is left communicating through a notepad.
Liza's husband, Sean, suggests they relocate to the countryside to recuperate.
The family move to a manor, unaware of its dark history.
Arriving at the manor house, they explore the property, and Jude finds a porcelain doll buried in the ground.
Liza and Sean explore a nearby mansion.
Realizing that Jude is missing, Liza searches for him and finds him in possession of the doll.
Encouraged by Jude's connection to it, Liza cleans off "Brahms," making the doll look new.
The next day, Liza and Jude take a walk around the property at Jude's request.
They meet Joseph, the property caretaker, and his dog.
Tensions fray when Sean urges Liza to talk about the events of the burglary, and she will not.
Back in the house, Liza and Sean overhear Jude talking in his room.
They ask if he is talking to Brahms and Jude writes 'yes' in his notepad.
Weird events occur around the house, and Sean and Liza discuss a change in Jude's behaviour with their therapist.
Joseph talks to Jude about his dog being missing, but no one appears to have seen the dog.
Liza finds disturbing pictures, and assumes they have been drawn by Jude.
Later that evening, the family has dinner and Jude writes in his notepad that Brahms' plate is missing.
Liza, upset about earlier, says that Brahms does not eat because he is a doll.
She and Sean argue in the kitchen and Sean leaves the room.
She goes to sit with Jude at the table and tells him that he needs to stay at the table until he eats.
He writes on his notepad that she is making Brahms mad.
She leaves the dining room and hears a loud noise.
She and Sean run into the room, finding the dining room table and chairs overturned.
Jude, scared, writes that he told Liza not to make Brahms mad.
Arguing about Brahms and Jude, Sean and Liza disagree about the mysterious things that are happening.
Jude leaves for the nearby mansion with Brahms in hand, leaving a note that reads 'You should have followed the rules'.
Joseph finds Sean and Liza in the mansion and tells them briefly about a family that had lived there prior.
He says that a boy named Brahms had lived there; he had killed two people, and did not leave the mansion for 30 years.
Shortly after, Sean's brother and his family come to visit.
Will, Jude's cousin, gets mysteriously injured during the visit.
Liza becomes even more upset, and later hits Joseph on the head, then begs to know where Jude is.
Joseph tells her that it will be over soon and that "Brahms and Jude are gonna be one."
She goes to look for Jude in the mansion.
Sean finds Liza and Jude in the basement and hits Brahms with a croquet mallet, revealing a demonic, rotting area under his face.
Joseph then starts to get scared and says that "It will never be over" and that Brahms will take out the family's failure to "follow the rules" on him.
A furnace then explodes, killing Joseph but leaving the family unharmed.
Jude grabs Brahms, and throws him into the fire.
Liza, Sean and Jude are soon back at their home in the city, and everything seems normal.
However, when he is left alone in his room, Jude walks over to his dresser and puts on a porcelain mask.
He wishes Brahms a good night, and says that everything will be fine if his family follows the rules.

25988333.title: Return to Iron (2020 film)
synopsis: Bob Richards, an unwavering and indefatigable Bostonian construction worker, finds himself living in the monotonous rhythm of his harsh job, succumbing to a lingering sense of dissatisfaction.

Bob's day at the bustling high-rise construction site are draining, each filled with grueling labor that takes a toll on his worn-out body, culminating into silent cries drowned in the depths of cheaply brewed whiskey at Joe's Tavern, an unevenly lit neighborhood bar.

Every night, swaying in tune with the silent whispers of the evening, Bob stumbles down the cobbled streets to his pristine Boston townhouse where he is greeted by the tired visage of his once joyous and lively art teacher wife, Susan.
Cracks of resentment decorate their once happy abode, a welcoming charm replaced by the shattering cacophony of marital discord and suppressed dreams.

On an unusually dark night, an argument reaches a breaking point, the echo of shattering frustration causing Susan to decide to part ways with Bob, her wearied heart unable to combat the harsh waves of his addiction any longer.
The morning following Susan's departure, seekers Bob in an ocean of maddening silence interrupted only by the hollow echo of her absence, amplifying his insurmountable sorrow.
His weary gaze falls upon a peculiarly folded piece of parchment left carelessly at the center of the oak kitchen table.
This mere piece of paper holds the key to change the direction of his life unbeknownst to him.

With a deep sigh resonating past his lips, Bob unveils the hidden message locked within the folds and discovers the news of a forgotten friend's demise from his high school days, leaving him a forgotten iron mine located in the small town of Burgettstown, Pennsylvania.
Finding a glint of opportunity in his tragic inheritance, Bob decides to let go of the worn-out familiarity of Boston and start anew, hoping to escape his overpowering grief.
He packs his worn-out suitcase with a newly fueled determination, each crumpled shirt hurriedly jammed within reminding him of his lingering loss.
Arriving in Burgettstown, Bob stands before the crumbling infrastructure of the iron mine, witnessing how its decay mirrored his hollow life.
The mine, stuck in the shackles of the past, stands with dusty remnants of industrial machines from the 60's and an unmotivated labor force that scurried around the site.
Embracing the daunting sight, Bob takes his first step towards change and dives headfirst into reviving the mine, his grease-stained shirt solidifying his unwavering commitment.
Grit lights up Bob's faded eyes, pushing him through the weeks of daunting work, successfully numbing his alcohol cravings.

Challenges, including volatile disputes surrounding labor rights, maintaining warehouse decorum while managing deflated morale, and handling safety hazards due to outdated machinery, press against him.
Amidst the turmoil, Bob forges onward to understand the lives of his fellow miners.
Their shared struggle becomes a foundation for perseverance, providing a newfound sense of camaraderie.
He cultivates a familial bond with the rugged miners, who replace his solitary lifestyle with a comforting brotherhood, which sustains his motivation to overcome his addiction.
During a short lunch break, Bob crosses paths with Mary, a cheerful waitress casting her charming spell behind the diner counter.
Months zoom by, and Bob's untamed willpower and perseverance succeed in breathing life back into the forsaken mine and uplift its productivity to unforeseen heights.
Meanwhile, Bob's connection with Mary begins to deepen, her comforting presence providing solace after grueling days of labor underground.
One calamitous day, an unexpected explosion in the mine's western shaft traps several miners underground, sending waves of terror rippling through the heart of Burgettstown.
Bob's leadership arises amidst the chaos, standing strong with a plan as swirling clouds of dust engulf the panic-stricken faces of his comrades.
Bob orchestrates a daring rescue mission, risking his own life in the relentless pursuit of saving his equally desperate brethren.
Bob's unwavering courage under duress results in the successful extraction of each trapped miner, making him an integral and revered figure in the mining community.
With this unfathomable victory, Bob clinches more than just a successful rescue; he champions his addiction, making the first steps to reclaim his place in society.
Back in Boston, Susan, now alone in their once-shared townhouse, discovers Bob's heroic acts through a newspaper headline.
Touched with varying emotions of surprise and admiration, her heart aches to see the changed man Bob has become, compelling her to journey to Pennsylvania.
A profound and intimate conversation takes place when she meets Bob, confronting the emotional ruins of their shared past.
They recount past joys, regrets, and bittersweet memories.
Susan applauds Bob for finding his path.
Throughout their exchange, Bob realises that to keep thriving; he must sever ties with their heart-wrenching past.
With the first ray of dawn marking Susan's departure, Bob finally liberates himself from the chains of his past and fully embraces his new life.
Bob skillfully balances his responsibilities at the mine, focuses on deepening his bond with Mary, and continues to fight off the temptations of alcohol.
As the narrative prepares to tie loose ends, Bob emerges as a changed man - grounded and in control, leading a successful life amidst the harsh landscapes of Pennsylvania.
He finds a staunch ally in Mary - her kindness becomes his stronghold as they build a life together, planning the future growth of their iron mine.
Their collective ambition and exchanges of loving glances in the comfortable silence of their shared space signify the robustness of their bond.
Bob stands atop a hillock, overlooking his industrious mine.
His legacy complements Mary's unwavering support and resilience.
Together, they are the central pillars of this transformed community.
When their eyes meet, a deep sense of respect and burgeoning affection is evident.
This acknowledgment of each other marks their strengthened bond.
Their laughter fills the mining site, marking the beginning of a new chapter laced with hope, love, and unwavering resolve.

The closing shot captures the star-crossed lovers against a twilight sky, cementing their triumphant fight against adversities and the commencement of their shared journey towards a prosperous future.

58593196.title: The Way Back (2020 film)
synopsis: Jack Cunningham is an alcoholic ironworker who is separated from his wife, Angela.
While at Thanksgiving dinner with his family, they express concern about his habits.
The next day, Jack receives a call from Father Devine at his former Catholic high school, Bishop Hayes.
He asks him to coach the basketball team, as the previous coach has had a heart attack.
Introduced to assistant coach and algebra teacher Dan and the team members, Jack learns that the school hasn't been in the playoffs since he was a student.
Interest has waned, and now there are only six varsity players.
Initially annoyed by Jack's stricter practices and attitude, they soon grow to respect him.
The team improves and Jack begins to bond with them.
His drinking decreases, and he spends more time with his family and friends.
Jack and Angela attend a birthday party together for David, the son of their friend Miguel.
It is revealed that their son Michael had died from cancer.
David and Michael met in the hospital, and David is now in remission.
Affected by the birthday party and memories of his son, Jack protests a call at a game, which results in him being ejected.
Afterwards, Jack reveals to a player that his father only paid attention to him due to his basketball talent.
As a result, Jack turned down a full athletic scholarship to the basketball program at the University of Kansas, and hasn't played since.
The team's final game of the season is a rematch with Memorial, the top-ranked team.
Bishop Hayes completes the victory to clinch a playoff berth.
Later, Angela calls Jack to tell him David has been hospitalized.
There, when they overhear that David's cancer has returned, Jack is disturbed upon seeing their grief.
He leaves the hospital and begins drinking again.
The following morning, Jack arrives late and drunk to practice, Dan informs Father Devine who fires Jack as he says he can't trust him with the team.
This causes Jack to spiral further.
One night, while driving drunk with a woman he met at a bar, Jack rear-ends a boat hitched to a parked car.
She flees, telling him to enter her house through the back, but he enters the wrong house and is confronted by its occupant.
Jack attempts to leave before the police arrive, but in the scuffle he falls and is knocked unconscious.
Awakening in the hospital, Jack is met by his sister, who demands that he get help for his alcoholism.
He starts psychotherapy and begins opening up about his son's death.
He meets with Angela and apologizes for his past mistakes.
The team dedicates their first playoff game to Jack.
Meanwhile, at an outdoor court, he picks up a basketball and practices shooting.

72028733.title: Operation Freedom: Amalfi Escape
synopsis: Nick, a highly trained operative and veteran of the Navy SEALS, and Jane, a brilliant CIA intelligence analyst, had together completed a perilous mission in Somalia, East Africa.
They sought refuge in the serene town of Positano, nested along the Amalfi Coast in Italy.

Dreaming of her retirement years, Jane envisaged a life filled with pleasure in small things, immersing herself in a love for reading mystery novels, painting landscapes, and the charm of touring vineyards.
As they enthusiastically explored the charming maze of Positano's cobblestone lanes, they stumbled upon an eccentric old man selling beautiful pieces of antique jewelry.
Jane took a special interest in a collection of old necklaces the vendor had.
The vendor gifted Jane a particular necklace.
Unbeknownst to them both, the necklace possessed a dormant power, an ancient supernatural energy concealed within its form.
Donning this necklace, Jane experienced an electrifying rush of energy coursing through her body, consequently transforming her into something more than a human.
Jane gradually started displaying exceptional abilities - an unseen force enabling her to move objects without physically touching them (telekinesis), and strength that could rival a whole platoon.
With her new abilities challenging her grasp of reality, Jane found herself struggling to understand and control the sudden changes.
The immense magnitude of Jane’s power drew the attention of The Echelon, a clandestine organization with ambitions as dark as obsidian – global domination.
They kidnapped Jane, leaving Nick in a state of shock and disbelief.
Nick embarked on a treacherous journey across Europe, determined to bring Jane back.
Upon infiltrating The Echelon's secret base, Nick was met with the revelation of Jane’s superhuman abilities, and the substantial degree of power she now possessed.
Jane grew stronger with every confrontation, showing formidable resistance, and learning to harness her immense power.
With Nick's military training and Jane's newly discovered strength, they jointly crafted a daring escape plan.
During their daring escape, they discovered - The Echelon aimed to use a weapon of mass destruction to coerce the world into surrendering to their tyrannic rule.
The Echelon's sinister ploy was to use overwhelming fear as their weapon.

The imminent threat of a potential catastrophe had Nick and Jane realizing that they needed to intercept The Echelon's well-guarded structure, seize control of their weapon and arrest their ill intentions.
They planned to launch a direct assault on the headquarters to secure the weapon.
The prospect of the impending battle unnerved Jane.
She struggled with the fear of causing widespread harm unintentionally.
Together, with Nick's steadfast support, Jane gained mastery over her enticing yet terrifying superhuman abilities.
As The Echelon spread its ruthless influence across the globe, Jane and Nick sprung into action.
Jane struck down The Echelon's agents.
Simultaneously, Nick employed his military strategy.
Together, they broke into The Echelon's fortified headquarters.
Their aim was now to retrieve the antique necklace and annihilate the imminent threat.
An intense face-off ensued against The Echelon's ruthless commander - a fight that would determine the fate of their mission.
Jane toyed with the idea of using her unbridled energy sourced from the necklace to obliterate her adversary.
Jane outsmarted and overpowered the commander marking a significant victory.
The Echelon's vicious dream of world domination crumbled.
In the aftermath, Jane took a thoughtful decision to remove the necklace.
They dismantled the necklace, abruptly silencing its alien energy forever.

To prevent future exploitation and misuse, they journeyed to the heart of the Mediterranean sea, entrusting the necklace to its unfathomable depths - effectively lost, and out of mankind’s reach, forever.
They decided to settle in the serene hills of Ravello.
She took on the mantle of mentor, guiding potential super-humans, instilling them to discover and control their abilities using them for the greater good.
Nick committed himself to strengthen global defense systems, vowing to prevent such adversities in the future.
He played a pivotal role in shaping international defense services.
Nick and Jane continued on their intertwined paths, living their dedicated missions.
Their lives slipped into a beautiful rhythm.
Her commitment to safety became the cornerstone of their lives, a constant reminder of their shared dedication towards a better world.
Their narrative solidifies the belief that challenges, no matter how insurmountable they appear, can be overcome with unwavering courage and determination.
Their battle against The Echelon, earning them a legacy symbolizing resilience, heroism, and an enduring pursuit for justice, guiding innumerable individuals through the most formidable storms.

56794086.title: Bloodshot (film)
synopsis: After leading a successful rescue operation of hostages in Mombasa, U.S. Marine Ray Garrison and his wife, Gina, travel for a holiday at an Italian beachside town in the Amalfi Coast.
They are kidnapped by a group of mercenaries led by Martin Axe, who demands to know how the US military learned about the hostages and their location.
When Ray explains that he cannot answer, Axe executes Gina in front of him.
Ray vows revenge, and Axe kills Ray as well.
An amnesiac Ray awakens in the labs of Rising Spirit Technologies (RST), a company in Kuala Lumpur specializing in cybernetic enhancements for disabled US military personnel.

CEO and lead scientist Dr. Emil Harting tells Ray he is the first successful human subject of the "Bloodshot" program, resurrecting and healing him through the injection of experimental nanite technology now replacing his entire bloodstream.
This technology increases his strength and heals his injuries, but the nanites need to be regularly replaced and recharged or he will eventually succumb to damage and die again.
Ray is introduced to Dr. Harting's other patients, including female former U.S. Navy Diver "KT", former U.S. Army Ranger Marcus Tibbs, and ex-Navy SEAL Jimmy Dalton.
After experiencing flashbacks of Gina and Axe, Ray abruptly leaves to avenge Gina's death.
Using the nanites and RST servers to hack into databases, Ray tracks Axe to Budapest and kills him along with his bodyguards.
Back at RST, Ray is put to sleep as his nanites are rebooted.
As he has done many times before, Harting replaces Ray's memories with a new scenario of how Gina died, this time with his own former associate at RST,   Nick Baris, as the culprit.

KT objects to Harting repeatedly manipulating Ray's memories so he will go after different targets without question or remorse, but she is ignored and reminded that RST can kill her by deactivating her enhancements.
Ray awakens, once again amnesiac, and is re-introduced to RST, then experiences flashbacks of Baris kidnapping and killing him and Gina.
Driven by revenge, he tracks Baris to East Sussex and kills him, despite the man pleading that RST is lying.
Wilfred Wigans, a programmer forced to work for Baris, activates an EMP bomb that incapacitates Ray and severs his link with RST.
Ray awakens in Wigans's office and experiences multiple contradicting memories of who killed Gina.
Wigans helps him realize RST has been manipulating him so he would kill Harting's former associates.
Ray tracks down Gina, not only learning she is actually still alive, but that their relationship ended five years ago, and she has since started a new life and family in London.

Harting sends KT after Wigans, but after KT asks Wigans for help in freeing herself from RST's control and taking down the corporation, she returns to RST and tells Harting she failed to capture the programmer.
Meanwhile, Ray is recaptured by Dalton and Tibbs and brought back to the laboratory.
KT and Wigans sabotage the reprogramming process and destroy the RST computers.
Ray awakens, but Dalton and Tibbs try to subdue him.
After a lengthy battle, he kills them as the RST building collapses.
Harting confronts Ray with a grenade launcher, confident that the soldier will surrender now that his nanites have been exhausted.
To his surprise, Ray is willing to die to achieve victory and activates a grenade that the nanites deconstructed, killing them both.
Ray later awakes with his full memories, revived by Wigans who has updated his technology so that his nanites are self-sufficient.
They and KT then leave in search of a new life.

25767775.title: Journey of Faith: A Midwest Tale
synopsis: Our film's tale takes flight with a glimpse of little-known Rayfield, a peaceful, Midwestern Floridian town, bound together by an air of familial affection and camaraderie.
