Ross secretly visits England and informs Macduff of his family's demise.
A grief-stricken Macduff vows revenge, while Malcolm raises an army with English help.
The troops cut down branches from Birnam Wood, using them as camouflage, and march on Macbeth's castle at Dunsinane, fulfilling one of the prophecies.
Lady Macbeth dies, implied to have been killed by Ross,  plunging Macbeth into further despair.
Still convinced of his invincibility, he is ultimately challenged by Macduff to a duel.
Macduff declares he is not born of a woman but instead "untimely ripped" from his mother's body.
Macbeth initially refuses but ultimately accepts Macduff's challenge.
Macduff defeats and beheads Macbeth, fulfilling the final prophecy.
Malcolm is crowned the new King of Scotland.
Meanwhile, Fleance is revealed to be alive, and Ross spirits him away from Scotland.
A flock of crows emerges in the foreground clearing the path and signaling the fulfillment of the witches' prophecy regarding Banquo's progeny.

78476801.title: Melody of Heritage (2021 film)
synopsis: The film begins by transporting us to the spiritual realm of the holy River Ganga, where a traditional Indian ritual is being performed for a cherished mother who has recently passed away.
Kavya, Arjun and their father are deeply immersed in the profound rituals, bound by their deep love for their mother and their strong Indian roots.
In the wake of their mother's sudden demise, the family is forced to take over her multiple roles.
This, importantly, includes the management of the family-owned restaurant, “Dawat”.

As days turn into weeks, on a surprisingly ordinary afternoon, Kavya, a thoughtful 17-year-old girl, stumbles upon her mother's classic Indian sitar, hidden beneath years of collected dust in the dimly lit attic.
As she curiously brushes her fingers over the long-forgotten strings, she senses an overwhelming surge of emotions and an inexplicable bond bridging her to her mother's soul.
Each resonating hum of the sitar tugs at her heartstrings, nudging her towards a journey of self-discovery and therapeutic healing.
Determined, Kavya undertakes the challenge of learning to play the sitar.

Simultaneously, Kavya's brother Arjun, an earnest youth dedicated to the sinking ship that is Dawat, is seen in heated debates with Kavya over the restaurant's uncertain future and their contradictory visions to propel it forward.
Their clashing ideas about revitalizing the restaurant fuel an uncomfortable tension, stretching their sibling relationship to its limits and erupting into loud arguments.
One evening, while practicing a new sitar melody, Kavya loses her grasp, causing the instrument to fall over, revealing a hidden compartment.
Inside, she finds her mother's old, weathered diary.
Intrigued, Kavya devours the diary, which unravels previously unknown chapters of her mother's life.
With each passing page, she discovers her mother's hidden talent and love for music.
Throughout this, their loving grandmother, Nani, unearths the escalating financial troubles that threaten the survival of Dawat.
Fear and panic embed themselves into their lives as they scramble to save Dawat.

Drawing inspiration from her mother's life, Kavya decides to hold a music event in their restaurant, hoping that showcasing her newly-acquired sitar talent could raise the funds they desperately need.
As the news of Kavya's budding talent and her melodic sitar performances begins to seep into the local communities, it sparks interest and anticipation over the upcoming event.
The looming event forces Kavya and Arjun to bury their differences and concentrate their efforts to pull off a successful evening.
Their shared purpose gradually brings them closer, mending the fractured bond between them.
Kavya's heart beats in rhythm with the melodies as she plays her mother's sitar, while Arjun, drenched in sweat, manages the restaurant and its eager patrons.
The event not only served its purpose but raised more funds than their expectations, providing ample resources to keep Dawat sustaining into the foreseeable future.
During her performance, Kavya feels a surreal presence, which she deduces to be her mother, standing by her, inspiring her to perform impeccably.
Arjun, too, garners strength that empowers him to tackle the mounting pressure of running the event.
Post the event, Kavya makes peace with her journey, recognizing how intimately connected her mother is with her music.
Simultaneously, a humbled Arjun accepts the lessons he has absorbed along this journey, acknowledging the role of persistence and sacrifice in overcoming adversities.
The family then pays homage to their late mother.
Her enduring values and timeless cultural lessons remain their guiding light, illuminating their darkest paths.
The sitar in Kavya's life evolves from a simple instrument to a symbol of hope, resilience, and undying love, her connection to her mother.
The diary immortalizing their mother's life becomes Kavya’s inseparable companion, allowing her to discover a new facet of her mother's identity every day.
Their father, too finds peace, both in coping with his wife's bereavement and in the comfort of their children carrying her legacy forward.

63400176.title: Spin (2021 film)
synopsis: After the death of her mother, Indian-American teenager Rhea Kumar works at her family's restaurant "Spirit of India" with her brother Rohan, her dad Arvind and her maternal grandmother (Nani in Hindi) Asha.
While on her Sunday dinner shift, she meets Max, a transfer student from England, a DJ who she shares a Calculus class with, and his mother.
Sundays are also special in the restaurant because of Nani's special performance to classic Bollywood songs.
At home, we see Arvind partly reeling from the emotional turmoil of losing his wife eight years ago.
Although Nani tries to convince him to move on and let it go, it's hard for him.

Meanwhile, in a flashback, we are shown a younger Rhea (eight years old) in her room at night, complaining to her mother Meera she cannot sleep because of the overwhelming sounds from the nearby electronic dance music festival, and the radio.
Meera describes to her the different sounds she can hear, and shows her she doesn't have to take it all in, just the sounds she likes, before telling her , "it's all music".
She then kisses her goodnight, and leaves the room, humming the lullaby she would always hum to her while doing that.
Back to the present, Rhea goes to sleep.

The next morning, she and her friends Watson, Molly, and Gingers gossip about Max, then shift to talking about Rhea's idea of the homecoming fundraiser "Festival of Colors", inspired by the Hindu festival of Holi, before they go to class.
In the class, Watson and Molly present their pizza drone, but the pizza drops before they can land it safely.
Miss Naomi asks them to clean up, before she calls on Rhea, who presents an app for tracking inventory and sales at her family restaurant.
Although Miss Naomi is relieved that it's not a failure like the pizza drone, she is a bit unsettled because the assignment was supposed to be about fun projects.
Even though Rhea insists this is fun for her, Miss Naomi, even though she accepts that insistence for the time being, is uncertain whether Rhea feels burdened by responsibility.
Later that night, Rhea shows Arvind the app for the restaurant, and Arvind is impressed and happy.

The next day, while the rest of the gang have their lunch, Ginger runs to them in panic after the DJ she had hired for the festival is unavailable, and Rhea, after she remembers having bonded with Max about music, playlists and mixes, recommends him to Ginger.
The event is a success despite Ginger's constant anxiety, and Max thanks Rhea for recommending him to Ginger, offering to repay her kindness.
She is initially hesitant, but finally asks him to teach her the art of the turntable, and Max agrees to take her to the vinyl store.

The next day, at the vinyl store, he shows her what each of the parts of the turntable do, and they are at it on the turntable when their common favorite DJ Luka Cent walks in, drawn by the music, clearly liking it, and asks them to meet him at the billing counter, where they get flyers for the contest "Battle of the Beatmasters".
They bond over coffee and Max invites her for practice at his house.
Over the next few days, she learns more about the art of DJ mixing, and improves daily.

Responsibility beckons as she ends up being late for her dinner shift, and her work-life balance falls apart as she either turns up late at school or does not turn up at all, even when they are working on improving the track that he made and which was rejected by Ginger.
It all starts to crack when the plates she's carrying fall down and break, although Nani is there to save her day.
Finally on the day of the fundraiser, she is tasked with looking after the enormous amount of guests of a baby-shower, which she sneaks out of to attend the festival and enjoy with her friends.

When the track has been played, Max fails to acknowledge Rhea, leading to an argument between him and her after the show, while unbeknownst to Max, Rhea's gang has been watching them, and confronts him after she storms out.
Back home, Arvind grounds Rhea for two months.

Discouraged by how everything's falling apart, and heartbroken that Max did not acknowledge her after she helped him create the track, at the cost of her own integrity and peace of mind, she turns to her Nani, who tells her it's not on her to keep her father happy when he can't move on from Meera's death thinking he has only the restaurant and them both to care for.

About her not being acknowledged by Max, Nani tells Rhea she will make more tracks, and "fill the world with so much music it will crush him", and when Rhea confides in Nani about her fear that she may have given him her best ideas, Nani smiles and recounts how Meera used to have the same notion, the same dark cloud of mope, exhaustion and sorrow over her, thinking the "well has run dry", and before Nani knew, Meera would hum a new tune as she walked around the house.
Nani then takes out a box containing Meera's prized possessions, including her wedding gajra, her cassettes, and her cassette player.
Rhea spends the night and the next morning listening to those cassettes and something sparks in her amid the calm.
Later one day, her gang turns up at her doorstep with DJ equipment from Molly's Gen-X-er father's basement, and with news that they entered her into the contest with an edit of her playlists.

Although adamant up to that point that she won't compete, she finally decides to enter the contest after Ginger shows her Max has already entered, that too with the track she practically made for him with much sacrifice.
Over the next few days, she starts working on her track, while her friends procure sounds and footage for her.
She also incorporates her mother's music in the track she has prepared for the final.

When her Nani listens to the track, she feels as if Meera is back with her, and they prepare for the contest, Nani with her makeup and dress to support her daughter and Rhea with her equipment and her attire, and both of them taking a day off from the restaurant.
Amid all the rush, they, along with the gang and Miss Naomi, reach the venue, and both Rhea and Max crush the semi-finals, reaching the finals.
Meanwhile, at the restaurant, Arvind catches Rohan watching Ginger's Instagram Live feed with Rhea in it, and realizes he had been lied to about groceries.
He takes Rohan along with him to the venue of the contest, to confront Rhea.
Back at the contest, Max has already played the track Rhea made for him, and has received a round of applause from everybody but the gang.
As Rhea's turn approaches, she takes a deep breath before she comes to the stage.
When she puts on her track, people start to sway, and everybody's initially intrigued, finally getting to the groove.

When Arvind does arrive, it is at this moment that he hears his late wife's musical voice on the speaker, and is both overwhelmed and happy that she's watching from above over her daughter, realizing that this is where Rhea is happy.
He discards the idea of confronting Rhea, and joins Nani, Miss Naomi and the gang in dancing to the music.
After the track ends, Rhea and Max are called to the stage, and Rhea is declared the winner.
Max, having been defeated by her, and regretting not having cared about her, runs away amidst the crowd of newfound fans Rhea meets outside.

The mid-credits show that Sunday nights at the restaurant are now DJ nights, with DJ Rhea on the turntable; Watson and Molly have finally perfected their pizza drone project which now also serves food to the guests; Naomi and Arvind have been growing closer since the contest.
Rhea is happy, having finally found what she wanted to do, and honoring her late mother.

99776112.title: Scuffed (film)
synopsis: We open on the quaint suburban life of our character, Beauty Bison, a renowned figure in the world of mixed martial arts (MMA).
Now, Bison finds a tranquil lifestyle in the city of Newark, in bustling New Jersey, where she resides with her partner, Tate, a celebrated author known for his gripping crime novels.
One day, during one of their usual TV sessions, they happen upon a series of old MMA matches on ESPN, stirring a wave of nostalgia in Bison.
Tate, relaxed, appreciates the peace and downtime of their lovely brownstone house.
His tranquility starkly contrasts Bison's subtle, yet growing restlessness.
They must confront their differences during a cozy dinner conversation over homemade pasta and a bottle of rich red wine.
Bison is haunted by her aspirations—her yearning for a life dotted with thrill and ambition.
Tate, on the other hand, finds contentment within the tranquil confines of his writing desk which overlooks the serene tree-lined streets of Newark.
Compelled by her cravings for excitement, Bison gravitates back to her old stomping grounds—a battle-worn gym known amongst locals as 'The Fight Club', located in the heart of the city.
There, Bison catches sight of Tessa—a young, aspiring MMA hopeful.
Tessa pleads for Bison's mentorship, aiming to glean her expertise and learn the tactical sobriety that had led Bison to triumph in the ruthless world of MMA.

Despite her sterling record in MMA, Bison initially hesitates in embracing the prospect of teaching Tessa but inevitably gives in—the temptation of being engaged with MMA again tugs too strongly at her heart.
Despite Tate expressing his reservations during their romantic candlelit dinners, Bison seeks refuge in the boxing sandbags and timed sparrings.
Tension escalates between Bison and Tate over her decision to immerse herself back into the challenging world of MMA, leading to heated discussions and arguments.

In a bitter verbal showdown in their rustic attic studio, Tate verbalizes his concern over Bison's careless flirtation with danger—a haunting memory of a spine-shattering career-ending match that had left her severely injured.
However, Bison stands firm in her decision, expressing her determination to help Tessa achieve her dream, even if it means revisiting the traumatic shadows of her past.
Emotional burnout drives them to a silent separation—meals eaten in silence, nights sleeping in different rooms.
The period of estrangement begins to eat away at the fabric of their relationship.
Undeterred by her faltering personal life, Bison remains committed to her promise—training Tessa every dawn in 'The Fight Club.'

Meanwhile, Tate finds himself succumbing to self-reflection in his newfound solitude, wrestling with his past mistakes, the haunting fear of losing Bison, and contemplating possible ways to reconcile.
Meanwhile, Tessa struggles with backlashes from her single mother and childhood friends, fearing the dangerous life she's chosen in the MMA world.
Nearing the day of Tessa's adversarial battle against 'Iron Lady', Bison trains Tessa fervently.
Despite the demanding process clearly taking a toll on Bison's health—her skin growing paler, her breathing becoming labored.
Overworking results in an accident as Bison collapses during a training session—a chilling reproduction of her past back injury.
A panicked Tate rushes her to the Beth Israel Medical Center in Newark, forcing him to confront the harsh reality of Bison's declining health.
Waiting nervously under the stark hospital lights, Tate teeters on the edge of despair, fearing he might lose Bison—ironically, to the very passion he had resented.
On the eve of Tessa's anticipated match against 'Iron Lady', Tate visits Bison in the sterile hospital room.
He initiates an honest and tearful conversation with her.

Amid smiles and tears, they realize they need to stop running from their past and instead use it as their strength—an emotional reconciliation that marks a pivotal moment in their seven-year relationship.
Tessa steps into the octagon ring, the crowd roaring with anticipation.
All the while, Bison and Tate watch nervously from the hospital bed on the small television screen.
After an intense fight, a victorious Tessa finds her voice amidst the cheering crowd.
On national television, she acknowledges Bison's staunch support and invaluable mentorship in shaping her skills.
The narrative takes a positive turn as Bison's medical reports show signs of recovery.
Her relationship with Tate blossoms stronger than ever before.
After their tumultuous journey and tearful reconciliation, Bison and Tate's relationship has metamorphosed—now standing on the firm ground of mutual understanding and empathy.
Tessa's victory resounds with echoes of Bison's legacy in MMA history, marking a successful initiation into its famed hall of fame.
Together, they bask in the satisfaction of Bison's profound influence on MMA, as Tate admits the fulfillment Bison's mentorship provides.
Finding the perfect balance between Bison's past life of intense clashes in the ring and her present life of comforting murmurs in her humble Newark home becomes their quest to fulfillment.
The movie ends on a bittersweet note as Bison sees in Tessa a reflection of her younger self, thus expressing a feeling of both elation and remorse.
Bison's profound impact on Tessa and hence on the MMA world establishes her enduring effect, finally fulfilling her dormant aspirations.
Bison finally finds the key to her unanswered longing—a quiet life occasionally punctuated with the cheers from Tessa's matches, witnessing someone else climbing the ladder that she once did.
Looking back on their journey together, Bison and Tate better understand each other's desires and vow to support each other fully in light of their own differing passions.
The regret of her past contributions to MMA has dwindled, replaced instead by a fresh sense of pride and fulfillment.
Tessa's triumphant journey comes full circle, Bison's story being the primary motivation for her success.
In turn, Tessa's victory serves as a satisfaction to Bison's long-held yearnings and expectations.
Bison takes a step back into the MMA world—but this time, not as a reigning champion but as a revered mentor.
Tate's previous fears no longer hold him back from fully supporting Bison.
He now understands the sheer happiness Bison receives from mentoring Tessa.
Their dream of a suburban life in Newark doesn't lose its appeal.
Instead, each of Tessa's victorious matches broadcasting on ESPN adds excitement to their serene lifestyle.
Bison and Tate continue to grow individually and as a couple—realizing that embracing changes and accepting imperfections are the keys to a lasting relationship.
Together, they enjoy their shared solitude— taking strolls in a nearby park, watching Tessa's escalating success, their love blossoming with shared pride.
The challenges Bison now faces give her life more meaning.
In their tranquil suburban life, she finds an unexpected blend of calm and thrill.
The movie concludes in a comforting setting—their candle-lit living room.
Bison and Tate, hands affectionately intertwined, watch Tessa execute powerful moves in the unforgiving octagon ring on live TV, a powerful depiction of Bison's enduring legacy.

62169868.title: Bruised (film)
synopsis: Four years after forfeiting a major fight, former UFC fighter Jackie "Pretty Bull" Justice lives with her boyfriend and manager, Desi, in inner-city Newark.
Earning a living as a housecleaner, Jackie relies on alcohol to cope with the tedium of her daily life.
Desi pushes Jackie to start fighting again, but she refuses, angrily blaming him for mismanaging her career.
Desi takes Jackie to an illegal underground match, hoping to sign a new fighter.
Recognized, the "Werewolf" provokes her into fighting.
When Jackie finally loses her temper, she pins the Werewolf down and headbutts her unconscious.

Catching the eye of Immaculate, a local promoter of the all-female MMA league Invicta Fighting Championships, he recruits Jackie and sets her up with Bobbi "Buddhakan" Berroa and Pops, his best trainers, to get back into fighting shape.
Heading home, Jackie and Desi are pulled over by Jackie's estranged mother Angel who has brought Manny, Jackie's six-year-old son who she has not seen since he was an infant.
Manny has been placed into her custody after his father, Jackie's former boyfriend, was killed in a shooting.
The trauma caused Manny to stop speaking entirely.
Manny moves in with his mother, and Jackie, under Buddhakan's guidance, slowly gets back in shape.
Immaculate convinces her to sign a contract with him excluding a manager; infuriating Desi, but they eventually patch things up.
Growing closer to Buddhakan, Jackie learns she is also a mother, but has not seen her child in over two years following the breakdown of her marriage.
Jackie enrolls Manny into school while learning to be a mother, even dumping all of her alcohol down the sink.
However, Jackie's relationship with Desi deteriorates, until he finally snaps, smashing Manny's keyboard and hitting Jackie in the face when she tries to stop him.
Jackie leaves him for good with Manny.
Angel reluctantly allows them to move in with her until the fight.
Jackie is pitted against Lucia "Lady Killer" Chavez, Invicta FC's flyweight champion, in an Atlantic City title bout.
Immaculate claims the fight is to get Jackie back into the UFC, but he later angrily admits he recruited her as a can against Chavez.
Jackie suffers a panic attack, reliving the memory of her last fight.
Manny tries to comfort her, but she screams at him to go away.
He runs off, and a stranger brings him to Angel.

Already on bad terms with her daughter (as Jackie accused her of letting her boyfriends and Jackie's uncle rape her as a child), Angel scornfully tells Jackie she is an unfit mother and that she will take over caring for Manny.
With no one else to turn to, Jackie starts living with Buddhakan, throwing herself into her training.
Confessing her fears of returning to the ring, they kiss and become intimate.
However, when Buddhaken asks her to consider becoming official, Jackie admits she is not ready and Buddhakan goes on a bender, ending up hospitalized the day before the fight.
With only Pops in her corner, Jackie enters the fight against Chavez distracted, so the champion dominates the first round.
In the second and third rounds, her confidence builds as she wears down Chavez and wins over the audience.
In the fifth and final round, Jackie matches Chavez blow-for-blow, ending in a split decision, where Chavez narrowly retains her championship.
Despite this, she and the audience celebrate Jackie's successful comeback.
After reconciling with Buddhakan, Jackie goes back to Angel's, promising them she is going to get their own place.
The women part on good terms.
As they walk down the street, Jackie stops to help Manny tie his shoes and he speaks to her for the first time, accepting her as his mother.

72161526.title: Biblical Times: Ladies' Unity
synopsis: Our film commences with a drone shot of the peaceful Bethlehem College campus.
Treading across the serene campus are four characters - Sarah, Leah, Rebecca, and Hannah, bound by the bond of friendship.

Sarah, a passionate journalism student, Leah, dreams of becoming the student council president, Rebecca, in search of her biological mother, and Hannah, in search of love, are introduced through their respective voiceover monologues.
Amidst the New Year's Eve party, the friends come together and make a pact to unconditionally support each other in their personal endeavors.
The narrative takes a turn when Sarah stumbles upon questionable fund transfers in the college account while working at the college accounting office.
She finds evidence suggesting the dean's involvement in fraudulent activities.
As the drama escalates, Leah announces her candidacy for the student body presidency on the college radio.
Despite facing criticism and scorn, Leah stands firm in her resolve to effect meaningful changes in the academic environment.
Meanwhile, Rebecca, on her quest to find her biological mother, sets out on a journey across multiple towns.
Simultaneously, Hannah’s journey to find love leads to multiple comedic misadventures.
As the third act sets in, the friends gather in the campus café, reflecting on their setbacks and reinvigorating their pact to support each other.
Amid this, Sarah and Leah plan to expose the dean's malpractices during an upcoming live debate.
A bohemian woman turns out to be the final stop in Rebecca's search and to her surprise, her biological mother.
Meanwhile, Hannah realizes she needs to focus more on self-love and self-confidence after multiple failed attempts to gain Mike's affection.
The story further intensifies as Sarah presents evidence of the dean's financial scams during a live-streamed college debate, leading to the dean's removal.
Following Sarah's brave actions, the school board announces the reallocation of the embezzled funds.
During this time, Leah's heartfelt speech helps her secure the position of the student council president.
Rebecca embarks on a road trip with her newfound mother, strengthening their bond.
Hannah, focusing on self-love, draws attention from the star basketball player, Mike.

The climax follows each friend conquering their personal battles: Sarah becoming a local heroine for battling corruption, Leah assuming office as student council president, Rebecca connecting with her biological mother, and Hannah discovering self-love.
The film concludes at their graduation ceremony as they toast to their journey of self-discovery and friendship.

63177488.title: American Pie Presents: Girls' Rules
synopsis: Now that it is their senior year, four young friends named Annie, Kayla, Michelle and Stephanie band together to get what they want.
Annie is trying to lose her virginity to her boyfriend.
Stephanie is a confident lacrosse player who is blackmailing her school’s perverted principal into retiring by recording him being chained up and whipped by her.
Kayla is insecure about her boyfriend Tim cheating and constantly goes through his phone asking if she is the best girlfriend he has ever had.
Michelle is a sex toy expert who prides herself on her knowledge.
They all make a pact to get what they need this year.
Along comes Grant, a handsome new guy in school.
He meets Michelle first as she is rushing to class, as she is distracted by the sight of him, she runs into a door and he helps her up.
Tim breaks up with Kayla and as Grant witnesses this, he offers help in making her ex jealous.
Stephanie is playing lacrosse and meets Grant by knocking him to the ground during a play.
Michelle takes Annie to a sex shop to buy her first toy, a vibrating set of panties.
Annie uses it later that day while having phone sex with her boyfriend.
Grant and his mother Ellen come over to introduce themselves, especially Ellen to Annie’s single father Kevin, who tells Grant to go upstairs and meet his daughter.
Michelle and Stephanie end up liking Grant and employ ways to win his affection.
Michelle, playing the damsel in distress trips and falls into a locker in front of him.
He takes her to the nurse and Oliver, the principal's assistant, a nerdy boy who has a crush on her, helps out.
Stephanie goes to Grant's friend Emmett (her old friend who she had a falling out with) and asks for his help, giving him $100.
Annie runs into Grant in the library and they team up to study and slowly start falling for each other.
Kayla and Tim start having sex clandestinely.
Stephanie and Emmett spend more and more time together to help her win over Grant and start falling for each other.
Things come to a head at Ellen’s house party when the girls realize they all know and have crushes on Grant.
Grant says he has a crush on Annie and they kiss.
She feels guilty and goes to see her boyfriend Jason at college and catches him getting a blowjob from a girl.
Initially angry, she feels relief because she realizes she has feelings for Grant.
Ellen helps Michelle realize that Oliver is the perfect guy for her as he also has a love of John F. Kennedy and when doing an imitation of his speech she realizes she likes him.
They all go to a party thrown by Stephanie in an attempt to get together with Grant.
Realizing that Grant likes Annie they call off the pact.
A fight breaks out when Stephanie gets called a slut and Emmett defends her, which then causes Stephanie to punch the assailant and throw him out.
Emmett and Stephanie kiss, realizing the whole time they had feelings for each other.
Kayla and Tim get back together.
Michelle and Oliver end up together.
Jason shows up and inaccurately describes the girls' pact to Grant, who leaves as he feels used.
The girls all go to the pajama prom together and help Annie win back Grant.
He shows up and they kiss.
Their friends set up a tent on the football field so Annie can finally lose her virginity.
They all end up having sex with their respective partners.

77372912.title: Basil's Bakery Blues
synopsis: Amidst the serene tranquility of Vermont's snow-capped mountains, against a backdrop of cascading foliage, we find our humble hero Basil, an endearing baker known for his winsome innocence.
His maple-scented bakery, quite fittingly named 'Basil's Buns and Bombs', lies nestled within a realm of rustic tranquillity.
Basil dreams of transforming his quaint bakery into a flourishing social hub that pulsates with the rhythm of the enchanting mountain town's community life.
Yet, the picturesque town doesn't echo his ardour.
Instead, the townsfolk amuse themselves by using Basil and his cherished bakery as the stage for their elaborate practical jokes.
The resultant uproar and unpredictability have unfortunately become normal for the mild-mannered Basil.
Basil, whose resolve is as unyielding as Vermont's granite, remains unfazed by the persistent mockery.
He clings to the vision of his bakery swarming with smiling faces, and air simmering with the aroma of his cinnamon buns.
One day, a gust of zesty vitality whirled into the quiet town in the form of an effervescent woman, Sophia.
Her vibrant persona was as invigorating as a breath of spring air amongst the everlasting winter.
With her radiant smile and infectious optimism, Sophia captured the heart of the town, becoming an overnight bearer of change.
While getting to know the cobblestoned downtown, she sets her foot inside Basil's bakery, straight away charmed by its homely ambiance and inviting aromas.
A sharp observer, Sophia begins to discern the peculiar dynamics between Basil and the townsfolk.
She sees past the laughter and spots the strain on Basil's face.
Overcome with empathy, Sophia decides to assist Basil.
Her plan?
A rejuvenation project for the bakery, with a sprinkling of assertiveness lessons for its bashful owner.
Basil, standoffish at first, is eventually won over by Sophia's infectious enthusiasm and vibrant spirit.
The two then embark on a series of adventurous escapades, starting with humorous assertiveness training sessions, where Basil’s endearing attempts leave them in fits of mirth.
One of their outrageous ideas even involves a confused parrot rhyming jingles and fireworks illuminating the night sky, all to promote Basil’s bakery!
Amidst these memorable ventures, Basil’s budding confidence also germinates an affectionate liking for the sociable Sophia.
Basil, now a changed man, decides to take a stand against his regular taunter - the burly and ragging football player, Brad, leading to an unforgettable creamy spectacle.
The meticulously crafted cream pie, initially meant as a gift to the town's mayor, finds its way to Brad's face, mid-insult.
News of Basil’s unexpected defiance sends ripples through the town, marking the onset of his heroic transformation.
Throughout this upheaval, Sophia’s unwavering support remains a constant, unknowingly knitting a romantic bond between them.
This newfound courage piques the interest of the residents and the once-slumberous bakery transforms into a bustling hub.
Basil’s daring confrontation with Brad triggers a newfound respect for the once-gullible baker.
Riding on his fame wave, Basil organizes a grand re-launch for his bakery, promising an entire day of free pastries.
This innocuous invitation takes a comedic turn when the eccentric 'Vermont Valley Nudists' club mistakenly gets invited.
Amidst the grand opening's mirth, Basil receives an unexpected visit from Brad who offers a public apology to Basil.
Riding on this wave of triumph, Basil confesses his feelings for Sophia in front of the exuberant crowd, reciprocated passionately by Sophia.
Following the momentous grand opening, ‘Basil’s Buns and Bombs' becomes a beloved spot amongst townsfolk, a testament to Basil's relentless efforts.
The once placid townsfolk are now intrigued by this newfound bravery and begin to appreciate Basil’s strength.
The bakery now throbs with friendly chatter, mouth-watering pastries, and amusing town gossip, all under Basil's watchful and confident glance.
Even his former bullies queue up for his delicacies.
As we bid adieu to Basil, we see him basking in the glory of his newfound success, affectionately sharing a homemade pastry with Sophia.
The view pans out from a warmly lit bakery, echoing with laughter, symbolizing Basil's victories and a safe haven for the townsfolk.
Basil’s story turns from a tale of 'Bakery Blues' to an enchanting narrative of 'Basil’s Blissful Bakery,' winding up on a jubilant note enveloped in the aroma of fresh pastries and hearty smiles.

61253857.title: Hubie Halloween
synopsis: In Salem, Massachusetts, Hubie Dubois, a kind but dimwitted and cowardly delicatessen employee, is bullied by most of the city, and the victim of many practical jokes.
He has annoyed police sergeants Steve Downey, Blake and Father Dave for ages.
Hubie spends his Halloweens monitoring the city as the official Halloween Helper.

The day before Halloween, Hubie meets his strange new neighbor Walter Lambert, and news spreads around town about Richie Hartman, a convict and childhood friend of Hubie who has absconded from a local mental institution.
On Halloween day Hubie, working as Halloween Monitor, investigates Walter's home after hearing strange noises.
Reporting this to the police, he is "recruited" by Downey as an "AUU" (auxiliary undercover unit).
Hubie believes this assignment is genuine, but it is really just something Steve tells Hubie in hopes it will refrain Hubie from bothering him.
Hubie goes to a local Halloween party to monitor the activities, however, it soon turns sour.
He is tricked into going into a corn maze seeking a lost child.
Hubie's young co-worker Mike follows hoping to scare Hubie.
He finds Mike and watches him get pulled into the maze and then disappearing.
Hubie moves his attention to a drive-in cinema, where his old classmates Lester and Mary Hennessey scare him.
They falsely report suspicious activity in one of the cars (who turn out to be trick-or-treaters driven by Mr. Hennessey to throw eggs at Hubie).
Hubie flees into the woods and finds Walter, who thinks he is turning into a werewolf.
He chases Hubie to a haunted house in a fun fair that is overseen by Chantal Taylor.
Mr. and Mrs. Hennessey are kidnapped and Sgt.
Downey is alerted.
At the haunted house, Hubie sees a male Siberian Husky, believing he is Walter in his final form.
The dog defecates and eats his own feces while Hubie attempts to interrogate and confront him, runs into the haunted house and he chases him inside.
It is eventually shown that the Husky is Miss Taylor's dog named Buster.
Pete Landolfa goes in to scare Hubie, but is kidnapped right in front of him.
Sgt.
Downey arrives and suggests to Mayor Benson that they cancel Halloween.
Hubie thinks it is Walter, but then Blake calls Downey.
Walter has been at the police station with Richie, as they had turned themselves in.
Walter's real name is Nick Hudson and Richie had escaped to bring him back to the mental institution, which they refer to as the werewolf treatment center.
Downey, Benson, and Dave believe that Hubie is the kidnapper and is getting revenge on his bullies.
He runs away and goes to the radio station.
DJ Aurora tells Hubie that someone calls a lot more than him always requesting a song for Hubie.
They all think Sgt.
Downey's ex-wife Violet Valentine is the caller.
The burner phone that was planted when called is revealed to be in Hubie's house and he races there, hoping his mother is okay.
It is revealed that Hubie's mother kidnapped Pete, Mike, and the Hennesseys as revenge for tormenting Hubie and plans to burn them alive.
He rescues them just as the police, the news media, Nick, and Richie arrive, but they are still ungrateful.
His mother then scolds them all for the things they did to Hubie and they admit that they were jealous of him for various reasons.
Hubie's mother suddenly disappears upon using the Frankenstein trick.
One year later, Hubie is married to Violet, is the new Mayor of Salem, and his new foster kids are going trick or treating dressed like people they know.
Having earned respect from the locals, Hubie goes into town on his bicycle with Downey escorting him and prepares for the Halloween festivities.

75476602.title: Savannah (film)
synopsis: Alex Thompson, a driven and ambitious meteorologist, is working on a real estate construction site in the heart of Savannah.
He runs intricate weather models on his laptop, predicting an imminent Category 5 hurricane.
The brewing tension between Alex and his wife, Sarah, is due to their ten-year-old son, Sam, who struggles with managing Type 1 diabetes.
Sam's struggles turn the Thompson household into an informal clinic, where every morsel of food, every playtime, and every bedtime routine demands precision.
Alex presents his meticulously calculated hurricane projections to the City Council, hoping to raise awareness about the impending disaster.
The City Council, engrossed in celebrating Savannah's annual summer festival, laughs off his warnings.
Disappointment fills Alex, but he refuses to succumb to defeat.
He begins to make personal preparations for the anticipated hurricane, prioritizing his son's medical needs above everything else.
Meanwhile, the anticipated summer festival in Savannah commences under threatening storm clouds.
As the city's residents immerse themselves in festivity, Alex's hurricane prediction materializes abruptly.
The city of Savannah, mid-celebration, is hit by an unstoppable downpour.
The city succumbs to sudden flash floods that trap residents in their homes.
Alex, stuck in his construction site downtown, watches the city succumbing to the mayhem.
He must navigate through destruction, rising water levels, and collapsing infrastructure to reach his sick son and terrified wife.
At the Thompson home, Sarah and Sam find their familiar home turning into a potential water trap.
The flooded streets and collapsed infrastructures block Alex's way home.
Sam's survival during the disaster hangs by a thread.
The stress, anxiety, and lack of proper meals due to the emergency affect his insulin levels, disrupting his juvenile diabetic control.
Alex decides to use the construction site equipment to create a barrier against the flooding back at his site.
Back in the Thompson home, Sarah stumbles upon Sam lying unconscious on the soaked kitchen floor.
She manages to lug Sam's unconscious body up to the dry attic.
She administers essential insulin shots and starts a glucose IV drip.
Amidst the surrounding chaos, Alex and his team of co-workers embark on the daunting task of creating a makeshift flood defense barrier using the supplies of cement and construction machinery.
With dogged determination, they create a makeshift flood barrier hoping it withstands the relentless torrent.
The collective efforts slowly pay off when water levels decrease.
But Alex leaves the unfinished barrier to rescue his endangered family.
He commandeers a small boat left amindst the festival commotion and paddles fiercely towards his home.
At the Thompson residence, Sarah and an almost unconscious Sam wait, trapped.
Sarah's desperate efforts and prayers stoke life back into Sam's being.
In the middle of the disaster, Alex reaches his two-story suburban home, reuniting his family.
Back downtown, the half-constructed flood barrier miraculously withstands the forceful waves and winds of the hurricane.
With the immediate danger temporarily stalled, Alex releases a flare into the storm-ridden sky.
A rescue helicopter spots the signal among the sea of blue, and airlifts the Thompsons and their neighbors from the rapidly submerging bungalows.
They're flown to a makeshift relief center set up in Savannah High School.
The Thompsons regroup and address Sam’s medical needs.
Alex prepares a comprehensive report that captures the magnitude and effects of the flood.
He submits it to the City Council, hoping the evidence convinces them to be proactive.
The council ruefully accepts their previous ignorance and decides to implement a robust flood management system.
They entrust Alex with the task of spearheading the mission.
The Thompsons return to their partially damaged bungalow.
They survey the damage and pick out valuable possessions.
The family engages in regulating Sam's conditions, helping him recover.
Each day is a new challenge, a new victory, a shared survival.
Amidst the debris, the Thompson family emerges stronger.
The Thompsons try to restore some semblance of normal life within their damp home.
They organize small family dinners and comforting game nights, vowing to prevent a calamity from taking away their joy.
The Thompsons emerge victorious from their survival trial, their strength tested and solidarity reaffirmed by the relentless storm.
As the movie concludes, Savannah and its ordinary people unite once again.
They work under the shared dream of recreating the city, ready to rise stronger in the face of future disasters.
As the saga wraps up, it leaves an invincible city, a stronger Thompson family, and the hope that no disaster can break a community.

62265900.title: Greenland (film)
synopsis: Structural engineer John Garrity lives in Atlanta, Georgia with his estranged wife, Allison, and their diabetic son, Nathan.
He returns home to watch the near-earth passing of a recently-discovered interstellar comet nicknamed "Clarke", along with his family and neighbors.
While at the supermarket, John receives an automated Department of Homeland Security (DHS) message saying that he and his family have been selected for emergency sheltering.
He then returns home just as a comet fragment is seen entering the atmosphere on live television.
Previously expected to land in the ocean near Bermuda, the fragment instead strikes Tampa, Florida vaporizing the city along with most of the state.

John then receives a call with instructions to head to Robins Air Force Base for an evacuation flight, as Clarke is on a direct collision course with Earth and the entire planet will be bombarded with hundreds of fragments over the next two days, with one fragment so  big it could cause an extinction-level event.
John, Allison, and Nathan pack up and flee, unable to take anyone else with them as they would be denied boarding.
On the way to the base, the Garritys are held back by a long line of traffic, so they must abandon their car.
Nathan's insulin is left behind in the car.
As John goes to retrieve it, Allison is escorted off the base after Nathan's medical condition is discovered, disqualifying him.
John returns and boards a plane but quickly jumps off upon realizing Allison and Nathan were left behind.
As John exits the base, a panicked mob breaks in, blowing up and destroying several evacuation planes when gunfire ignites jet fuel.
Returning to the car, John finds a note from Allison saying she and Nathan are going to her father's home in Lexington, Kentucky.

After getting medical supplies from a looted store, Allison and Nathan hitch a ride from Ralph and Judy Vento, only for Ralph to kidnap Nathan in order to use him and the wristbands to board a flight.
John comes across a truck full of people heading towards Canada after the driver agrees to drop him off in Lexington.
A fellow passenger, a young man named Colin, tells him the truck is headed to Osgoode, Ontario, where private planes are flying to Greenland, which is believed to be the military evacuation site.
Another man attempts to steal John's wristband, causing the truck to crash, killing Colin, and John is forced to kill the other man in self-defense.
At another airport, the Ventos attempt to pose as Nathan's parents, but are arrested when the soldiers discover that Nathan is not their child.
Allison and Nathan are reunited shortly after at a nearby Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) camp.
The following morning, John learns that millions of people have died in global impacts and that the largest fragment will hit in approximately 24 hours.
Stealing a car, John reaches his father-in-law, Dale's house, and Nathan and Allison arrive shortly after.
The family learn about a complex of underground bunkers near Pituffik Space Base in Greenland, confirming that's where the evacuees are being sent.
The family has just enough time to reach Osgoode, so John and Allison decide to go while Dale chooses to stay behind and die in the impact, while giving them his truck.
Reaching Upstate New York, the family is caught in a traffic jam.
As a shower of molten debris rains down, they take refuge below an underpass, then continue on to Canada.
While making steady progress to Osgoode, the family learns over the radio that Clarke's largest fragment, which is 9 miles (14 km) wide, will hit Western Europe and obliterate it.
The family arrives at the Osgoode airport barely in time to board that night's last flight out.
As they reach Greenland, a comet fragment strikes off the coast which emits a shockwave, hitting the plane and causing it to crash-land, killing the pilots.
The Garritys and the rest of the passengers flag down a military truck and enter the bunker complex right as the largest fragment enters the atmosphere and hits, devastating civilization.
Nine months later, the bunker is able to make radio contact with other survivors as various cities are shown in total ruin, including Sydney, Chicago, Paris, and Mexico City.
The Garritys and other occupants exit the shelter to a radically changed landscape.
All are relieved to hear each other and report that the atmosphere is finally clearing, giving the survivors the chance to rebuild.

68444112.title: Memory Fade (2020 film)
synopsis: With deep wells of apprehension and a fluttering sense of hope, Barbara's dutiful offspring, John and Lisa, walked hesitantly through the electric doors of the illustrious Cosgrove Medical Facility.
Barbara was a radiant woman teeming with a sparky energy that was infectious in its impact, which a relentless cognitive disorder reduced to a mere shadow of her glorious past.
In witnessing their mother’s struggle, John and Lisa felt their hearts seared with profound grief and helplessness.
Dr. Farrow, Barbara's sympathetic and understanding neurologist, tabled an extraordinary yet intimidating proposition, a medical procedure still in its experimental phase.
The treatment was not without its ominous downside - it could potentially eradicate Barbara's precious memories nurtured and cherished over her seven decades of existence.
Amid their crushing predicament, they spent an emotional evening reminiscing in their childhood haven, surrounded by faded pictures that encapsulated a lifetime of their mother's affectionate love.
Instilled with a newfound resolve, they consented to the gamble in a desperate bid to reclaim Barbara’s former self.
The procedure was executed flawlessly, with John and Lisa warily observing medical professionals, awaiting the day when Barbara would recognize them by sight and not just by touch.
However, Barbara began exhibiting alarming symptoms such as being jolted awake by nightmarish memories of an elusive "Daniel."
Their worst fears came true when they were informed of Barbara’s enigmatic disappearance from her fortified hospital room.
Agitated and panic-stricken, the siblings sprang into action, their instincts guiding them back to their mother’s long-abandoned apartment, the starting point of their harrowing search.
Whilst scrutinizing the desolate apartment, they came across an antique envelope, discolored with age.
Enclosed was a cryptically constructed letter scripted by the elusive "Daniel."
The siblings found themselves unravelling their mother’s shrouded past, plunging into an unknown chapter of intrigue and danger that lay hidden beneath their mother's seemingly ordinary life.
Stunned, they connected with old associates from Barbara's cryptic past and unveiled her extraordinary double life as an invaluable informant assisting the police.
The reality of unmasking "Daniel," a malevolent figure with a notorious reputation from Barbara’s past, was dizzying.
Their trepidation escalated dramatically upon learning that the menacing "Daniel" had recently been released from his high-security imprisonment.
The thought of a revengeful "Daniel" targeting their mother dialed up their urgency exponentially as they came to the horrifying realization that Barbara's life was on the line.
What started as a desperate search to find their mother quickly morphed into a dangerous mission, a race against time to rescue Barbara from the clutches of a vengeful criminal.
They discovered Barbara, weak and terrified, in a warehouse shrouded in the city's outskirts.
The ominous presence of "Daniel" was immediately palpable, his silhouette lurking threateningly within the warehouse's gloom-filled corners.
They found themselves ensnared in a high-stakes cat-and-mouse game, desperately strategizing to rescue their mother without triggering Daniel’s watchful vigilance.
Surmounting the fear that gripped them, they pulled off a daring rescue, successfully thwarting Daniel and whisking Barbara away to safety.

Barbara's mental state saw significant improvements during the following weeks, but her recollection of John and Lisa remained hauntingly elusive, her mind only storing fragments of memories about them.
The innate bond of motherhood tugged at Barbara, drawn inexplicably to John and Lisa, not by distinct memories but an unexplainable, inherent pull of a mother’s deep-seated love.

They reluctantly came to terms with their mother's altered reality, taking solace not in their shared past but their mother's unfathomable resilience and their bond that had proven to transcend the barriers of memory.

58572726.title: Flashback (2020 film)
synopsis: Fred Fitzell and his wife Karen visit Fred's mother in a hospital where she is suffering from severe mental decline.
Fred works in an office job but begins to get vivid flashbacks of high school.
He remembers a girl named Cindy Williams and visits the high school and asks a librarian about her.
The librarian tells Fred that Cindy went missing after a drug went around the school.
Fred gets more flashbacks and is accosted by a scarred homeless person in his car while he is parked in an alley.
Fred begins to have memories of a child who walked past him in high school who looks like the homeless person.
Fred has disparate memories of the child and the homeless person in which they say a single word; when Fred pieces these words together, they combine to say "I'm/in/your/lobby."
Fred visits his apartment lobby with a baseball bat and is surprised by the homeless person.
Fred sees various visions of a mouth and of being on the floor looked at by Cindy and others.
He awakens after having had a mental breakdown in the lobby.
Fred reconnects with his friends from high school and continues to have more flashbacks.
He has memories of doing a drug called mercury (or merc) in his high school's boiler room and of visiting a club to get "uncut merc".
Near the club, Fred and Cindy talk on a roof about how the drug releases people from being trapped.
In the present, Fred is having difficulty at work and needs to deliver a presentation.
With his high school friends, he visits the now-abandoned club in an attempt to find out what happened.
At the club, Fred begins to have flashbacks of taking uncut merc in high school.
He finds homeless squatters, including the scarred man from earlier, and he finds Cindy.
They tell him he never left.
Fred flashes back between the homeless person and the child,  who back in high school took high amounts of merc.
He also sees visions of the mouth and people looking over him.

Fred pieces together a series of words from memories of the homeless person and the child which tells him that there is an invasive lifeform that forces people to perceive time linearly (as a way to control them by seeing their outcomes as inescapable) and that the drug allows people to temporarily break free of this and see all temporal possibilities.
Fred realizes that back in high school he had bad reaction to the merc and took a lamp and hit the child in the face, scarring his face.
Fred wakes up in bed in the present day and realizes he has little time to finish the presentation for work.
When he begins his presentation, he sees himself back in high school, where he is taking a final exam.
He has a simultaneous breakdown in the past and present.
Realizing that he can travel through multiple timelines, Fred flashes back to Cindy at the abandoned club.
The two fall in love and live many lives together and travel to many different places, such as the Middle East and a Mediterranean villa.
Eventually the two wake up in the present day at the abandoned club.
Fred realizes that he can no longer travel with Cindy and travels back to the final exam, on which he does well.
He meets his wife after the exam and does well on the presentation at his office job, ultimately leading to him and his wife buying a house.
Fred finally reconnects with his mother at the hospital and realizes the vision of a mouth he keeps seeing is of his mother yelling at him as an infant when he almost fell down a staircase.
His mother has a moment of lucidity and remembers who Fred is, and the two briefly connect.
However, his mother dies shortly afterwards.

67818432.title: Voyage (2021 film)
synopsis: On a typical winter evening, chilled but comforting, Samuel Adams, a grizzled Navy veteran who once cherished married life, completes the loved ritual of tucking his two young sons, ages ten and seven, into their shared bunk bed.
As they curl up under their dinosaur-themed blankets, their eyes wide and ears eager, he feeds their innocent curiosity with richly woven tales of his invigorating encounters at sea.
Unaware, the boys hang on his every word, completely oblivious to the hidden, underlying truth of his tales.
Their father's delicate stories skillfully shroud an internal conflict beginning to rise like a storm in the distance, masked skilfully with swashbuckling pirates and fierce oceanic battles.
Breaking the routine of their tranquil home, a knock echoes through their humble abode.
The unexpected visitor, a familiar yet coarse face with deep lines etched by time and tribulations, hands over an ominous, weather-worn envelope to Samuel.
This person had once stood shoulder to shoulder with him amidst tempestuous waves.
Torn between the curiosity gnawing at him to unveil the obscured secrets within this letter and the fear of eventually unearthing his buried past, Samuel grapples with an internal storm of dilemmas,.
The decision threatened to pull him under like a strong undertow.
As night falls and the moonlight slips through the cracks in the curtains, drawing long, soft shadows across his room, Samuel's sleepless eyes stare out into the moon-lit stillness.
He finally finds the courage to face his darkened past, not just for his own sanity but as a formidable lesson to his young sons about courage and truth.
Chewing quietly over his morning toast and coffee, Samuel announces to his sons about an impending sea voyage.
He twists it into an exciting escapade, a prospect both thrilling and survivally instructive, which elicits a series of excited cheers.
Driven by emitted waves of childhood enthusiasm, the boys start to prepare for the journey.

Their hands hastily gather their most prized treasures - worn-out books, wooden toy soldiers, and an old compass - into their battered backpacks, memories of past adventures drawing broad smiles on their faces.

Punctuated by their synchronized laughter and etched with a serene sea breeze, the family set sail in their sturdy vessel on a day when the sun danced upon the ocean surface, and the waves playfully nuzzled the hull of their sailboat.
But then, stillness yields to unease as bizarre, unexplainable events inch into their journey, waning the once-inviting aura.
An eerie sense of unbelonging weaves its tendrils of anxiety among them, shoving daylight's harmony into the chest of forgotten moments.
Nightfall morphs the idyllic setting.
The dusk-painted canvas gives way to an endless dark yawn of sparkling stars.
An uncanny sea shanty, chilling the spine, creeps over the calm waters, leaving goosebumps trailing down their backs, sharpening their senses unnaturally.
Despite his brave facade, the sight of a spectral ship that ghostly flickers at the distant edge of his vision unnerves Samuel.
Its half-real, half-imagined existence on the gradient horizon triggers a well of anxiety in him.
The modern naval tools betray them.
Their compass turns erratically, a chaotic dance void of direction.
Their GPS disconnects, throwing them into an overbearing maze of monotonous blue.
The ambiance within the wooden hulk of their boat transforms into a stifling claustrophobic setting.
Panic fills the cabin as their meticulously planned provisions, their food stocks and clean water bottles, mysteriously start depleting at an alarming rate.
This was the final straw, which threatens to collapse Samuel's weathered courage, that had until now faired many a typhoon and white squall.
The situation escalates.
Fear and a sense of duty that outshadows his seafarer's valor force Samuel to lance into an unsolicited investigation of this phenomenon.
His fierce determination to keep his sons oblivious of his anxiety forbids him from sharing his fear.
As the days blend into chilling nights, the brave father unravels the forgotten shipwreck he once survived, a tragedy buried under pages of dismissed naval records.
Hushed whispers among his naval mates suggested the doomed ship carried an ancient trove of Aztec gold – a possible reason for the brutal coverup and inexplicable disappearance from records.
Chained to his past, Samuel watches in horror as his spectral ex-crewmates emerge from the abyss of forgotten time, reclaiming their lost lives and fortune from the deep.
These spectral presences grow stronger, casting frightening parodies of reality.
Their terrifying powers lead to a horrifying kidnap of Samuel's sons, a torturous play to force their father into digging past wreckage.
Throughout this dreadful ordeal, the young Adams are thrust into the daunting reality of their father's scorned past – a shocking revelation for their innocent minds.

Resourcefulness beyond their tender years and practical survival wisdom taught by their father come to the forefront as the family manages to shatter their spectral shackles, escaping the phantom crew's eerily tangible hold over them.
The calm seas ensure their triumphant escape but the sea, a stage of deceptive tranquility, transforms into an intense theater of battle.
The adrenaline is starkly contrasting against the backdrop of once-leisurely sails and pleasant fishing afternoons.
Samuel, in a decisive act of courage, devolves into a primal protector.
He grapples with his former comrades, now ghostly apparitions of greed and betrayal, reeking of unfinished vengeance.
The boys, young in age but weathered in experience, stand strong despite the infamous setting.
Their dauntlessness aids in diverting a potential grim fate for their father and them.
The tumult reaches its climax as they are ensnared in a monstrous tempest, the swelling sea an embodiment of Samuel's surging inner turmoil.
The scene turns surreal with the full wrath of nature unleashed around them.

Samuel finds himself standing against the formidable apparition of his former captain under the fearful flashes of lightning tearing across the inky skies, granting an apocalyptic illumination to their final confrontation.
Bolstered by wild desperation to safeguard his children, a newfound strength courses through Samuel's veins.
This enables him to roar back at his spectral past and subdue the spirit of his fallen captain, marking a significant victory etched in his maritime chronicles.
But one storm gave way to another more physical one.
A victory cry was soon replaced by collective gasps as their trusted sailboat capsizes under the fury of the thunderous tempest, casting them brutally into the churning depths.
Amid the chaos and a rapidly sinking boat, Samuel manages to activate the emergency beacon just as the icy sea washes over him, the blinking light's plea lost in the deafening rage of nature.
Miraculously, their desperate signal pierces through the storm's opaque veil, triggering a daring search and rescue operation as the forces align with their survival against insurmountable odds.
The coast guard, in their sturdy rescue boat, arrives at the crack of dawn, pulling the battered family from the grip of the tempestuous sea and onto the secure deck of their rescue vessel.
Their horrifying ordeal manages to breathe a fresh view of life into them and instigates a strength in their hearts that neither of them had fathomed.
The boys who once feared the darkness under their beds now fearlessly discuss potential monster-infested adventures, their voices firm and eyes sparkling with fervor.
Samuel, though hesitant, sees the brave men his sons have evolved into and concedes to their adventurous plea with a knowing smile, his heart swelling with a fatherly pride.
The scene cuts to their living room, a chipped coffee table bearing a large, weathered sea chart.
Samuel and his sons, their bonds tested and solidified by the past ordeal, huddle over the map, plotting their next voyage.
Anticipation wraps the room like a dense fog.
Amidst the quiet rustle of paper and scraping of pencils, Samuel suggests a potential route leading back to the sunken ship's rumored location, the implications raising a spell of thrilling silence.

An undercurrent of excitement passionately breaks into their conversation, hinting subtly at the potential hazards they could encounter, the older Adams letting his naval intuition speculate the impending dangers.

65970407.title: Encounter (2021 film)
synopsis: U.S. Marine Malik Khan has two young boys, Jay and Bobby.
At home, Jay and Bobby are living with their mother Piya and their mother's new partner, Dylan.
Piya has been feeling sick recently, and Dylan ominously tells them it is 'a bug'.
One night, Malik appears at their house, wakes up his two sons, and urgently tells them that they are going on a road trip.
While on the road with his boys, Malik passes a police car and tells his boys to get down.
Hours later, Malik is pulled over by a different cop.
Though Malik is polite, the cop is hostile and aggressive, and Malik sees something shifting behind his eyes.
Malik determines the cop has been infected by a parasitic organism from another planet.
Malik wrestles the gun away from the cop, knocks him out, and leaves him in the street.
Back on the road, Malik confesses to his boys that this is not a road trip, but a rescue mission.
He says that an alien parasite has taken over the planet and that their mother has been infected.
As much as half the population may be infected by this alien parasite, which is using human bodies to reproduce.
Malik needs to get his boys to safety and says they can protect themselves from the parasites with bug spray.
In a grocery store, Jay starts to question Malik's story.
Later, Malik learns his boys' mother is pregnant after his sons say Piya has been getting sick in the morning and having weird food cravings.
When Malik calls his parole officer Hattie, it’s revealed that he missed his psychiatric evaluation.
Malik refuses to tell Hattie where he is but asks Hattie to check on his ex-wife.
Piya and Dylan are found tied up in the garage, but alive.
Hattie works with federal law enforcement in an attempt to retrieve Jay and Bobby.
The feds believe Malik will kill his children and then himself.
Hattie speaks to a former Marine friend of Malik's, who describes the assault incident that caused Malik to get dishonorably discharged from the Marine Corps.
While describing how terrible the conditions were, he mentions that they were "getting eaten alive by bugs" and then found bodies of children in the wreckage.
This incident caused Malik to snap.
Hattie deduces that Malik is suffering from a mental disorder.
Jay begins to suspect the aliens are not real when his father sees hundreds of meteors in the sky that Jay does not see.
After they get a flat tire, Malik tries to steal a car but gets in an altercation with an old man who is the owner of the car.
Malik gets away, gravely wounding the man, but is injured.
Malik teaches Jay how to drive in order to get them to safety.
While Malik sleeps off his injury in an abandoned house, Jay drives to get his father medicine and food.
Jay overhears on the radio that his father is a wanted man for kidnapping his two children.
Back at the abandoned house, Jay confronts his father.
Malik admits that he lied, that he was in prison for two years, and that his brain has been playing tricks on him.
The sons of the man Malik attacked track him down.
The men kidnap Bobby and attempt to perform a citizen's arrest.
Almost immediately, they open fire on Malik and Jay.
Malik manages to apprehend both men without killing them and escapes with his boys.
Malik calls his ex-wife and gives her an address of a diner where he will leave the boys, telling her he will not go back to prison.
However, while the police and helicopters start chasing his car, Malik realizes Jay has hidden in the back seat.
Jay refuses to leave his dad behind, even after an hours-long standoff with the police.
Hattie insists to Malik that the authorities will take his mental health into consideration when deciding his fate, but Malik does not believe her.
Not wanting to lose his father, Jay runs out of the car and points a gun at the police.
Malik tries to distract the police to save his son, and then convinces him to put the gun down and run to him.
They embrace, with the police lowering their weapons.

48069373.title: Earthbound: The Emma Chronicles
synopsis: The film begins with the protagonist, Emma, lost in the fascination of her research work on the possible existence of extraterrestrial beings.
As a highly accomplished astronomer, she conducts her research in her rural Victorian-style turret home.
Immersed in her research, she carefully documents greatly detailed star profiles and navigates the tremendous data on numerous computer screens spread in her study.
She receives an unanticipated stream of unfamiliar sounds through her advanced communication systems.
Emma realizes that these pulsating, mysterious sounds could be a potential celestial signal from the unexplored depths of outer space.
Piqued by this unusual occurrence, Emma uses her custom-built decoding systems to decipher these puzzling extraterrestrial signals.
It dawns upon her with great surprise and fear that not only does she understand these alien-coded transmissions, but she is also unintentionally privy to galactic secrets yet unknown to mankind.

What starts as a mere curiosity blossoms into a terrifying realization—an imminent and violent invasion from an aggressive extraterrestrial force which threatens to erase Earth from the galactic map entirely.

Disoriented yet stoic, Emma understands that the unique genetic ability she possesses, which allows her to understand otherworldly codes, could be the single, fragile thread standing between Earth and total annihilation.
As the first rays of dawn break, she is joined at her secluded observatory, located on a serene grassy hilltop, by a duo of solemn individuals cloaked in flawlessly tailored black suits.
These unknown visitors reveal their identities, showing her official laminated ID cards embedded with the emblem "Earth Defense Initiative" (EDI).
The EDI agents then bring her up to speed on confidential intelligence they have amassed, details which eerily align with the lethal invasion plot that she had deciphered from the alien message.
Saddled with the terrifying reality that she might be Earth's sole chance at survival, Emma reluctantly accepts her unexpected role with the EDI.
Emma, burdened by an unsettling anxiety but driven by determination, steps into her unfamiliar territory, shouldering an inconceivable responsibility beyond her imaginings.
She relocates to the covert EDI headquarters slyly nestled within a breathtaking backdrop of snow-capped mountains, and grows to know her new team.
The EDI team, a diverse group of stern military strategists, esteemed scholars, and some seasoned veterans, has been carefully chosen for this mission.
Emma forms a unique bond with one of the team members, Max, a charismatic and reflective physicist who helps her navigate the complex landscape of this alien technology.
Emma and the EDI team devote their days and nights to developing a secure plan to counter the looming alien invasion.
Their plan revolves around fabricating an advanced human-alien hybrid defense technology, capable of neutralizing the aliens' superior technological prowess.
Emma undertakes strenuous physical training to master the controls of the alien weaponry along with an understanding of grounded military tactics.
Amid the rigorous training sessions and meticulous strategizing, Emma and Max find solace in each other as their fears and the hopes for the world lead to a deep emotional bonding.
Just as the EDI base is buzzing with preparations to test their cutting-edge defense system, an unexpected calamity strikes.
Caught unaware, the alien forces have launched a pre-emptive strike, decimating the EDI base and severely damaging the novel hybrid defense system.
Now on the backfoot and left picking up the pieces of their broken strategy, Emma and the team battle to resurrect their plan amidst their burgeoning despair.
Although facing challenging circumstances, Emma ingeniously revives the hybrid defense system utilizing her understanding of the alien technology.
Quickly pulling themselves together to face the invading forces, the EDI members rally around Emma, their unity hardened by a shared struggle as they prepare for the do-or-die battle.
The time has come as the night sky, illuminated by the eerie glow of the alien fleet, marks the eve of the decisive battle.
Emma, driven by determination and leadership, expertly assumes command of the hobbled defense system, guiding her team in the raging tempest of war.
Max, her right hand throughout this ordeal, sustains critical injuries in the onslaught, further fueling Emma's resolve to save not just her loved ones but all of humanity from impending doom.
In the face of the nearing alien invaders, Emma manages to activate the seemingly futile hybrid defense technology just in time.
This results in a massive technical failure within the alien fleet, shredding them to oblivion, thereby averting Earth's destruction.
After the overwhelming exertion, Emma loses her consciousness.
Awakening from her blackout, she is offered the permanent leadership of the EDI—a proposition she earnestly declines, choosing a serene life over the relentless danger of interstellar wars.
Emma makes it clear that she wants to return to her lifework of astrological research.
As Earth starts to pick up the pieces from the foiled invasion, Emma reclaims her quiet life in the comfort of her quaint, rural home.
Max, having survived his near-fatal injuries, pays her an unexpected visit.
He expresses his unwavering affection for her.
Emma reciprocates Max’s feelings, finding in him an unwavering steadiness that was missing in her life.
They envisage a shared future, but suddenly, an unexpected twist leaves them on tenterhooks.
A known signal disruption echoes from Emma's radio set, hinting at an incoming interstellar communication that persuades a sense of foreboding nostalgia.
Emma, apprehensive yet adhering to her duty, hesitantly deciphers the incoming transmission.
The alien communication springs to life again, this time with a twist, unrecognizable from the previous ones but metallic and distinctly alien.
The encoded message expires abruptly, leaving Emma and Max contemplating the enormity of the challenge they might have to face again.
With a heavy sigh, Emma archives the unreadable transmission.
The camera pulls back, capturing the world bustling below, oblivious to the lurking threat, slowly zooming back to our heroes-Emma and Max.
They stand resolute, an agreement silently re-cemented in their purposeful gaze, ready to face the forthcoming storm.
Their love story stands as an icon of human spirits and emotions which even the mightiest alien forces fail to extinguish.
Their camaraderie and collective resilience become a beacon of hope for the survival of mankind, facing any impending threats and revitalizing their spirit.
The final scene begins to unfold with Emma and Max studying the night sky, fear, and fascination glowing subtly in their eyes.
Emma’s story ends—a scientist-turned-reluctant-hero, transformed into the savior of humanity, catapulted back into the shadows of an impending crisis just as she barely manages to take a breather.
The last shot showcases Earth—a stunning orb, floating alone in deep, indigo cosmos—indicating the secretive battles and unsung heroes that lurk beneath.

65654086.title: Skylines (film)
synopsis: Picking up shortly after the previous film, Rose leads the human fleet against the aliens.
Now called 'Harvesters', the aliens are on board the Armada, a mother ship in orbit of the Moon.
After breaking through the enemy lines, Rose freezes before she can fire and one of her ships is destroyed.
With the aliens preparing to fire on Earth, Rose is forced to destroy one of her own ships when it gets into the crossfire.
She sacrifices thousands of humans, but succeeds in destroying the Armada.
Wracked with guilt, Rose vanishes while humanity rebuilds, living alongside billions of 'Pilots', freed alien-human hybrids.

Five years after the battle, Rose lives in a tent city near the ruins of London, avoiding resistance forces searching for her and keeping the aging effects of her hybrid nature at bay with the help of hyper-oxygenated blood transfusions prepared by her friend Dr. Mal.
A viral pandemic strikes the Pilots and anyone using transplanted Pilot limbs.
The virus eats the Pilots alive while reverting them back into their brainwashed state.
Resistance leader Leon captures Rose and brings her before General Radford who reveals that the Armada's core drive warped to Cobalt One, the Harvester homeworld, before the ship's destruction.
Only with the Armada's core drive do they have a chance of saving the Pilots.
Rose reluctantly agrees to join the mission.
At Cobalt One, the team's ship crashes after a collision that leaves it running on emergency power.
The crew of Rose, her Pilot adoptive brother Trent, Leon, Owens and Alexi find the planet filled with the bodies of dead Harvesters.
There are also strange shadow creatures that appear to be mutations of the Harvesters.
Alexi is heavily wounded and sacrifices herself with a pulse grenade to kill them.
The team manages to reach the Armada where Rose is briefly possessed by the Harvester Matriarch, who accuses the humans of coming to destroy her species.
Trent helps Rose to break free of the Matriarch's control and Rose realizes that the alien's telepathic influence was what caused her to freeze in the war.
Now no longer afraid of who she is, Rose embraces her powers and steals the core drive.
However, Owens betrays the others, infects Trent with the virus and flees with the core drive.
Rose and Leon later discover that Radford bombed Cobalt One prior to their arrival with a biological weapon, the same virus that is infecting the Pilots on Earth.
As the two make their way back aboard the ship, Radford uses the core drive to destroy Cobalt One and the Harvesters in an act of genocide.

He reveals to them that the virus was intended to peacefully euthanize the Pilots and destroy the Harvesters, but it had the unintended side effect of reverting the Pilots back into their brainwashed state.
Having boarded the ship as well, the Matriarch kills Radford, intending to destroy the Earth in revenge.
After realizing the truth about the virus, Owens attacks Zhi, who manages to fight him off.
As the ship enters a wormhole, Owens falls into an energy field and is disintegrated.
Trent, whom Leon manages to snap back to normal, knocks the Matriarch in as well, but has most of his body disintegrated in the process.
On Earth, Mal works on a cure, but the infected Pilots attack before she can finish testing it.

The residents, including Mal, Kate, Grant and Huana, fight back and manage to eliminate the attacking Pilots at the cost of Grant and several others, only to have an army of thousands more approach from London.
Arriving back just in the nick of time, Rose sucks all of the Pilots into her ship.
With Mal's cure and her ship, they now have the power to cure all of the infected Pilots worldwide.
In the aftermath, Mal transplants Trent's brain into a new Pilot body, saving him.

Zhi hacks into Radford's personal files and discovers the location of a prison where Radford had held anyone that he considered to be an enemy of the state, including Rose and Trent's long-missing father Mark Corley.
Rose orders a course set for the prison, intending to rescue her adoptive father.

31377687.title: The Study Lounge 3
synopsis: The curtain lifts on our protagonist, Jane - a lively, radiant woman exuding an infectious joy.
She is seen holding her newly acquired master's degree in linguistics, the evidence of several years of strenuous diligence.
Her ragged yet jubilant demeanor reflects the toll her studies have taken as well as the triumph that now permeates her life.
