As she settles in her university dorm, the unpacking of her baggage reveals a tiny keepsake from Seapoint, a delicate scallop seashell.
Rebecca looks around her new room at Fordham.
The movie culminates on an optimistic note, with Rebecca starting a new chapter in her journey of self-discovery.

67474179.title: Along for the Ride (film)
synopsis: Eighteen-year-old Auden West, a recent high school graduate, goes to stay with her father Robert in the small beachside town of Colby, wanting to spend a carefree summer reinventing herself before she leaves for college.
A daughter of academics and an exemplary student, her mother objects to her wanting to spend time with her father.
An absentee dad for years, locking himself away in his office to work on his studies, he has an infant and is remarried to Heidi.Upon Heidi's suggestion, Auden goes to the Tip on her first day.
As she's experimenting, she makes out with a guy, later regretting it.
Heidi takes her in to her shop the next day, where she's to look after the receipts.
She comes face to face with three girls she'd seen at the Tip (Maggie is the ex of the guy she made out with).
Now they all work together.
A loner and night-person, Auden roams the streets after everyone else is asleep.
Ten days after her arrival she meets fellow insomniac Eli.
A BMXer, he takes her on nightly adventures and he challenges her to a quest to do all the things she missed out on in her childhood.
On their first outing, they go to a secret pie shop, and he introduces her to Connect Four.
On the next, they play mini golf and she admits she never got to wear her prom dress.
Auden's mother turns up on a rainy day, taking her for lunch.
She's obviously envious of her ex and Heidi.
Auden gets closer to the girls, being invited both to watch Maggie do cross-country BMXing and to a Conch House party.
There she finds out about Eli's accident where a drunk driver killed his best friend Abe.During an outing to the drive-in to see The Princess Bride, Auden and Eli talk about being night-owls.
She admits that it started when she was a child, from trying to prevent her parents from fighting, but as usual, he doesn't share.
That night she finds videos of him and Abe on YouTube.
Another evening, Auden says yes to the quest, so they break into the lighthouse.
Later, talking in Eli's truck, he pushes the idea of learning to ride a bike again, and she tries to bring up his BMXing, but neither want to talk about it.
A night when he is wheeling her around in a shopping cart, it falls over and, although she's OK, he apologises profusely.
When Auden brings up the HDP (hot dog party) annual July 4 party, Eli tells her to have fun, refusing to go.
Hours later he actually shows up, surprising everyone.
To get everyone to forget about it, she and Eli start a food fight.
Soon afterwards, a night swim is invoked by all, and Auden and Eli kiss for the first time under the fireworks.
On a coffee run, Auden gets side-tracked.
Seeing her dad with a suitcase in front of the café, he complains that all new mothers are nuts.
She calls him out on his mistakes, that he quits the moment things get hard.
Auden checks in with Heidi, who explains she lost it because he wouldn't even go out as a family on the 4th, her favorite.
Calling her mother for support, as she's an advocate for women's rights, she drives to the house to give moral support.
Between that talk and Auden calling him out, her dad comes back and starts helping out with the baby.
Auden and Eli have a temporary falling out over biking, she because she won't admit she never learned and he because he's mostly abandoned BMXing because of Abe's death.
She asks Maggie to teach her and he gets back to training.
Some days later, Auden's called to the skate park to see Eli compete.
After his win she congratulates him, and they make up.
Eli shows up, wearing a tux, so Auden comes out wearing her prom dress.
She bikes with him to the beach, their friends join them also dressed for the prom, and they have an impromptu party.
The closing scene is of Auden rereading a postcard from Eli in Barcelona before she and Maggie, college roommates, head to lunch.

45514645.title: Flame Igniter (2022 film)
synopsis: A most terrifying revelation from Ben's past unexpectedly resurfaces, haunting him at every turn.
This revolves around his beloved infant daughter, Evie.

A seemingly ordinary child at birth, she was discovered to harbor pyrokinetic powers, a shocking truth revealed when she inadvertently set her bamboo crib ablaze at the tender age of two, an accident that culminated in the tragic demise of her mother, Amelia.
In the aftermath of this tragic event, a time jump takes us to present day, landing us into the life of the now 16-year-old Evie.
She was forced into solitude as her father, Ben, lived in constant fear of the recurrence of a tragedy due to his daughter's uncontrollable, fire-starting abilities.
Hoping to provide a semblance of normality for his isolated daughter, Ben appoints Ms. Janet, a former school teacher, for home education.
He harbors hope in his heart that this semblance of routine would help Evie in controlling her powers better.
But all hopes are dashed one petrifying evening when Evie loses control.
Her powers erupt with startling intensity, resulting in a spine-chilling accident which claims the life Ms. Janet and leaves their quaint, blue-painted house severely damaged.
Stricken with panic and guilt, Ben turns to Esther, a reserved elderly woman rumoured to be knowledgeable regarding unnatural phenomena.
His hope is that she may offer some guidance to manage Evie's extraordinary abilities.
To Ben's horror, Esther unravels a prophecy, forecasting Evie's powers to ascend in a destructive manner, leaving nothing but ruin in their path.
Ben is left to grapple with the terrifying knowledge of what his daughter's powers could eventually lead to.
Overcome with fear and dread, Ben makes the drastic decision of confining Evie to the dark, damp cellar below their century-old house.
He does this against his own will, wishing to protect both his daughter and the vicinity from her destructive powers.

Instead of mitigating the problem, the confinement appears to fuel Evie's powers even further, leading to terrifying nightmares and a deepening sense of unrest and harm, further escalating her already distressed state.

The unlikely character, Sarah, a perceptive neighbor with distinctive, curly auburn hair, stumbles upon the strange happenings of the house and is eventually drawn towards the confined, anxiety-ridden teenager, Evie.
As Sarah becomes more attuned to Evie's distress, she manages to provide a glimmer of hope and comfort for the confined teenager, reaching out to her with understanding and kindness.
Fully aware of Evie's condition and its complexity, Sarah suggests reaching out to a specialist in this field, only to be met with Ben's straightforward rejection.
Defying Ben's wishes, Sarah continues her pursuit of help, leading her to the renowned Detective Graham, a psychiatrist known for handling exceptional paranormal cases.
Under the veil of secrecy, Graham enters Evie's life.
Astounded initially by the scale of Evie's powers, Graham gradually adapts to her unique circumstances, shedding light on the potential approach to handling her abilities.
Their clandestine meetings aimed at providing Evie with crucial help are unwittingly exposed to Ben leading to an upheaval.

An explosive confrontation ensues between Ben and Sarah, triggering a surge of pyrokinetic energy from Evie, engulfing their house in an uncontrollable inferno, critically injuring Sarah in the process.
Amidst the chaos ensured by her own powers, Evie struggles with guilt.
However, the feeling pushes her to harness her abilities under the tutelage of Detective Graham.
Displaying an unprecedented degree of control, she suppresses the blazing fire threatening to consume her loved ones.
This astonishing feat rescues both Sarah and Ben from impending doom.

Witnessing Evie’s invincible determination to overpower her destructive nature and protect those she cares for, softens Ben’s heart and forces him to reconsider his approach towards his daughter’s powers.
Ben realizes that confinement isn’t the solution but providing an environment that nurtures her abilities is.
He, therefore, sets out on a path to establish a more conducive environment for her powers while also trying to make her everyday life less threatening.

The tale unfolds thrillingly, concluding in a suspense-filled cliffhanger upon the utterance of 'Phoenix Rising', an enigmatic organization dealing with extraordinary individuals, foreshadowing a riveting sequel awaiting further exploration of Evie's unprecedented potential.

63808340.title: Firestarter (2022 film)
synopsis: In a flashback, baby Charlene "Charlie" McGee sits in her crib, spontaneously setting the room ablaze with her pyrokinesis power and sending her father Andrew "Andy" McGee into a panic.

In another flashback, a young Andy and his girlfriend Victoria "Vicky" Tomlinson talk to a doctor in a clinical trial, who explains to them that they will be injected with the experimental chemical drug Lot-6, which secretly gives them supernatural powers: Andy gains telepathy, and Vicky gains telekinesis.
In the present day, Charlie is sitting at the kitchen table after having a nightmare.
Her parents join her and Charlie explains that she has been repressing something bad, her powers becoming more unstable.
She unintentionally causes a ruckus at her school after exploding a bathroom stall due to anger at being bullied.
Andy is shown using his power, "the push", to influence a client to stop smoking, although the strain causes his eyes to bleed.
Meanwhile, in a secret facility, Captain Jane Hollister, leader of the  Department of Scientific Intelligence (DSI), is monitoring thermal signatures caused by Charlie's outbursts.
She visits Doctor Joseph Wanless, creator of Lot-6 and the resulting superhumans, who implores Hollister to terminate Charlie before her powers become uncontrollable.
Hollister enlists fellow superhuman John Rainbird to assist her.
Rainbird visits the McGee home, confronting Vicky, who attempts to counterattack with her repressed telekinetic powers.
Rainbird kills her, holding Charlie at knifepoint as she and Andy enter the home.
Charlie's powers overwhelm him and she sends a concussive burst of flames throughout the house.
Andy and Charlie escape into their truck.
On the road, they encounter a man named Irv Manders.
After using the push to convince Irv to take them to Boston, they hitch a ride with him, stopping off at his house.
After Charlie accidentally stumbles upon his paralyzed wife, Irv flies into a rage before conceding that he occasionally overreacts.
Irv sits up all night watching a news report of the incident at the McGee home, which is being framed as murder by Andy.
Irv and Andy argue before Andy explains to Irv that he is just trying to protect his daughter.

Charlie tells Irv, after speaking telepathically with his wife, that she forgives him for the accident that left her paralyzed, causing him to relent and attempt to protect Andy and Charlie when the police appear due to his prior emergency call.
Rainbird appears in the bushes, kills the policemen, and then shoots Irv in the knee before black trucks roll in to pick up Charlie and Andy.
Andy uses his push to trick Rainbird so Charlie can escape to a forest.
Charlie spends time honing her fire powers before stealing a bike and clothes to follow her father's telepathic message to her from his cell at DSI.
Charlie finds DSI and takes an agent's pass card from him, then kills him after he draws his gun to attack her.
She follows a large staircase down to the restricted area where her father is being kept.
She reaches her father's glass-fronted cell, from inside which Hollister tells her not to try and burn her, lest she burn her father in the process.
Andy tells Charlie that Rainbird, not he, telepathically called for her.
Seeing no other way out, and knowing that he will die soon, he apologizes to her and then pushes her to burn the entire place down, starting with Hollister and himself.
The now-rogue Charlie sets both on fire, mentally unlocks all the security doors, and walks through the facility killing all of the DSI agents.
Rainbird is released when his holding cell is unlocked.
Charlie is surrounded by men in hazmat suits, unable to harm them.
The men are about to subdue her when Rainbird shoots them from behind.
He surrenders to Charlie and kneels for her judgment.
Charlie starts to kill him but sees herself in the mirror and, realizing that he is just as much of a pawn as her, she spares him, before finally burning the rest of the building down.
Later, Charlie is seen walking onto a beach with Rainbird following behind.
With nowhere to go, Charlie allows Rainbird to carry her, and they walk off together into the night.

88930340.title: Mushroom Hunter: The Bob Story (2021 film)
synopsis: Bob, a middle-aged man with a thick, salt-and-pepper beard, delicately bends down to pick a Tricholoma matsutake mushroom, prized for its unique flavor, then gingerly places it in his tightly woven, handmade basket.
His sturdy boots treading softly on the carpet of foliage beneath the towering oak giants, he roves further into the All Oak Forest.
His isolation and the amiable manner in which he forages for fungi testify to his identity as a humble mushroom gatherer in the remote village of Wrenville.

As the first rays of the sun infiltrate the morning fog, Bob clasps his rugged hickory walking stick firmly, noticeably arching his back under the weight of his wicker basket, now containing a diverse assortment of wild mushrooms.
He begins his homeward journey, meandering through the forest back to his quaint stone cottage, distinguished by its overgrowth of ivy and winding cobblestone path.
Upon his arrival, several village children from Wrenville, clad in loose-fitting clothes barely held by stitches, stealthily track his movements.
They watch his green harvest in wonder from a distance, their soft whispers and wide-eyed expressions conveying their intrigue for this solitary figure who is nothing short of a local legend.
Once in his kitchen, a small space that bears the witness of time with each scar on its wooden countertop and each dent on its aged utensils, Bob displays an effortless finesse.
He moves around with the precision of a trained chef, searing the morning's fresh mushrooms to perfection in a well-used cast-iron skillet.
In the warm morning glow piercing the fraying lace curtains, a wooden-framed photograph takes life.

The portrait shows a younger Bob; a clean-shaven man in his prime, wearing glasses and a crisp chef's uniform, surrounded by a crowd of jovial patrons at Antoine's Bistro, a famed culinary landmark in Paris.

Bob's mind fills with memories of his glamorous past; the sounds of champagne flutes clinking in toast, thunderous applause at the end of magnificent feasts, echoing laughter, his shining days of culinary grandeur in the City of Lights.
One evening, amidst the rustic charm of Wrenville's town hall, the bold Mayor unveils an ambitious plan.
His cavernous voice bellows a declaration of a local cooking competition, hoping it would draw epicureans from around the globe, and reinvent Wrenville as a gastronomic cornerstone.
Bob's first encounter with this stimulating news is a chance overhearing in the local grocery store, through the enthusiastic, hushed whispers of the villagers.
He feigns disinterest, preferring to keep an emotional distance from the memories of his previous culinary life.
An unexpected meeting with Emily, a lively young girl, becomes a turning point in Bob's world.
Emily, with her verdant, curious eyes, constant infectious laughter, and an uncanny intrigue for the culinary possibilities of mushrooms, unintentionally sparks a change.
Her young and piercing insistence and enthusiastic rawness gradually convince Bob to take her under his wing.
He agrees to tutor her in the subtle art of mushroom harvesting, which inadvertently pushes him towards contemplating a return to the culinary stage.
Motivated by Emily’s unwavering enthusiasm, Bob registers for The Wrenville Culinary Challenge, consciously stepping back into the glaring eye of the culinary world.
Soon, his former competitor Ralph enters the scene.
Ralph, with his flamboyant attire, finely manicured hands, and a confident smirk, brings back a chilling wave of déjà vu for Bob.

Undeterred, Bob works tirelessly throughout the competition, employing his extensive knowledge of foraging and his formidable culinary skills to create unique mushroom-centric dishes, earning him praise and admiration.
Ralph, however, resorts to unscrupulous tactics.
With silver-tongued influence, he unveils Bob's tragic past to the organizers, instigating a wave of curiosity and whispering rumors across the town.
Gossips about an infamous food poisoning incident at Antoine's Bistro surface, attacking Bob's newly regained confidence.
The shadows of his past affect his performance in the competition, causing him to stumble under the weight of old fears and uncertainties.
Observing Bob's escalating distress, Emily steps in.
Her unwavering support and optimism become his stronghold, pushing him to face his past and recover his faltering spirit.
Gathering his courage, Bob addresses the curious townsfolk at the Town Square.

He candidly unfolds his journey - his struggles with fame-induced stress, a humiliating burnout, his nightmarish ordeal of the food poisoning incident, and his resulting retreat from the delightfully chaotic world of cuisine.
His heartfelt confession opens a floodgate of understanding among the listeners.
Preconceived notions start to waver as his honesty appeals to their empathy.
As the decisive day of the final round dawns, Bob stands firm, ready to confront his tumultuous past and champion his culinary prowess.
Unfazed by Ralph’s attempts to disconcert him, Bob focuses single-mindedly on his task.
He meticulously assembles a spectacular dish, featuring a splendid variety of forest mushrooms.
The captivating aesthetics and the divine flavors of his creation leave the judges and audience spellbound.
Overwhelmed by the magnificence of his culinary artistry, the judges laud his dish unanimously.
The distinguished chief judge, a connoisseur with decades in the gastronomic field, lets tears of joy escape after tasting Bob's heavenly creation.
His talent undeniable and his resilience shining through, Bob is heralded the winner.
Bob’s triumph symbolizes his victorious resurgence in the face of his distressing past.

Standing in the spotlight, Bob is presented with a gleaming glass trophy by the Mayor, who now dons his finest tweed suit, acknowledging his tenacious journey, symbolizing Bob's victorious struggle against adversity and his redeeming return.
Once merely the town's mushroom forager, Bob now stands devoured in a surge of applause from the ecstatic people of Wrenville, who now see him as their beloved champion.
The tale of Bob's unforgettable journey concludes with him, now closely trailed by Emily, under the towering oaks of the All Oak Forest, teaching her the delicate art of mushroom foraging.
This passing of the baton signifies the dawn of Emily's culinary journey and the telling continuation of an enriching legacy.

63241742.title: Pig (2021 film)
synopsis: Robin "Rob" Feld is a reclusive truffle-forager who was once a renowned Portland chef.

Living in a cabin deep in the Oregon forests, he hunts for truffles with the help of his prized foraging pig, which he sells exclusively to Amir, a young and inexperienced supplier of luxury ingredients to high-end restaurants.
One night, Rob is attacked by unidentified assailants as they steal his pig.
He contacts Amir, who helps him locate a pair of bedraggled drug-addicts suspected by another local truffle-hunter.
They claim the pig was taken to Portland.
After his old friend Edgar refuses to help, Rob leads Amir to an underground fighting ring for restaurant people below the defunct Portland Hotel, saying certain names carry caché.
Rob identifies himself to the crowd, then allows himself to be beaten to a pulp by a waiter in exchange for Edgar's information.

Shocked to learn his identity, the following morning Amir reveals that his parents had such a miserable marriage the only happy time he remembers is a night when they had dinner at Rob's restaurant, before his mother died by suicide.
Rob in turn asks Amir to secure reservations at Eurydice, a trendy haute cuisine restaurant which is owned by Amir's father.
In the meantime, Rob visits the house where he used to live with his wife Lori, whose death compelled Rob to withdraw to the woods.
At Eurydice, Rob asks to meet with its head chef, Derek, a former prep cook at Rob's restaurant.
Rob pointedly yet empathetically criticizes Derek for opening a contemporary restaurant rather than the pub he always wanted to run.

Overwhelmed by the memory of his dream and the reality of his current circumstances, Derek confesses that Amir's wealthy father, Darius, was behind the theft of his pig, having learned of its existence from Amir.
Rob angrily ends his partnership with Amir before going to confront Darius at his home.
Darius promises him $25,000 in exchange for the pig and threatens to kill it should Rob continue his pursuit.
Rob leaves, finding Amir waiting outside, having just left his comatose mother in a care facility, revealing she is still alive.
Rob admits that he does not need his pig to hunt truffles since the trees tell him where they are; he loves her.
He gives Amir a list of items and tells him to use Rob's name to obtain them.
Rob visits his former baker for a salted baguette and a few pastries he shares with Amir before they go back to Darius' house.

Rob guides Amir as they prepare the same meal for Darius which Rob served to him and his wife, including a rare wine from Rob's personal collection, which Amir obtained from the woman caring for the mausoleum containing Lori's ashes.
All three men sit down to eat together, despite Darius' resistance.
An emotional Darius leaves the table after just a few tastes.
When Rob  follows and confronts him, Darius asks why he is doing this, and Rob says he remembers every meal he ever cooked and every person he ever served.
Darius tearfully confesses that the junkies he hired for the theft had mishandled the pig, resulting in her death.
Rob collapses in tears, and a remorseful Amir drives him back to a diner near home.
Despite Amir's foolishness, Rob says he will see him next Thursday.

Returning to his forest, Rob washes his bloody face in the lake before returning to his cabin to play a tape that Lori recorded of herself singing Bruce Springsteen's "I'm on Fire" to him for his birthday.

41613358.title: Puzzle Chamber: Duel of the Enigmas
synopsis: As though emerging from a heavy fog, Emma and Jake find their eyes jolting open to take in an intimidating panorama of stark stone walls enclosing them from all sides.
This ominous, cave-like chamber is shrouded in darkness, with the only source of light being a fading, solitary lantern, its faint glow casting long, menacing shadows.
As their consciousness fully returns, they feel the debilitating pulse of their pounding headaches reverberating through their skulls.
Their hearts echo a similar rhythm, pounding with a rapidity that spoke volumes about their clenched-fist fear.
Before them, a world they did not recognize unfolded - an intricate labyrinth of mazes and convoluted puzzles, their details etched with chilling precision into the chamber's imposing dark oak walls.

As the hellish reality of their predicament dawned upon them, they understood the severity of their situation: their lives now hung in the deadly balance of the room's enigmatic puzzles and riddles, the wrong answer to which could result in death.
Without any alternative, they lean into their dread, the cold arm of fear guiding their every move, as they start to dissect the challenges scattered around them.

Mastery over the labyrinth's complexities becomes their primary objective - they painstakingly decode encrypted inscriptions on the walls and find hidden buttons to press, hoping each action will lead them one step closer to freedom.
Surprisingly, their relentless collaborative endeavor bears fruit.

Their ordeal sees an optimistic end as a massive, iron-barred gate creaks open, finally liberating them from their deadly confinement, and offering an escape to fresh air suffused with the sweet scent of freedom.
As they step out of the chamber, they make an unspoken pact determined to uncover and expose the individual behind their terrifying, deadly game to the world.
Fuelled by their traumatic experience and a burning desire for justice, they immerse themselves in weeks of relentless online research within the perilous confinements of dark-web forums.
They make countless trips to public libraries, delving into antiquated records and branching out in their search based on every emerging clue.

Their painstaking determination and meticulous research eventually lead them to unearth the existence of Sphinx Corp - a notorious organization based in Boston, infamous for its association with labyrinthine chambers reminiscent of the one they narrowly escaped.
With this newfound information, they turn their attention towards devisive strategies and preparatory measures required for infiltrating the well-protected stronghold of Sphinx Corp.

Under the cover of an ordinary road-trip, they navigate along bustling highways headed to the forbidding heart of the East Coast, ready to burrow deeper into the very core of Sphinx Corp's covert operations.

Their ongoing investigations reach a new level of darkness when they unearth harrowing accounts of countless individuals who vanished without a trace, possibly victims of Sphinx Corp's devilish machinations.
Each grim tale driving home the reality of the malevolence they stand against.

As they delve further into the shadowy maze of Sphinx Corp, they are ominously stalked by the corporation's enigmatic CEO ominously known as Enigma, underlining the dangerous cat and mouse game they now play.

Narrow escapes from life-threatening situations, coupled with veiled threats creeping into their lives, serve as chilling confirmation of their entanglement with Enigma, their predator in this lethal game.
Undeterred by the high stakes, they adamantly decide to gather irrefutable evidence that will lay bare the Corporation's macabre secret to the world.

Driven by their grit and determination, they daringly penetrate the walls of Sphinx Corp. Their terrifying ordeal in the puzzle chamber now grants them the advantage of experience to navigate the dangers that awaited inside.
However, they are soon taken aback when they discover another behemoth labyrinth nested within the fortress-like headquarters.
This elaborate surprise was nothing short of a nightmare, swiftly nicknamed the 'Puzzle Chamber'.
As the chilling reality of their situation seeps in, they realize they have stepped right back into the life-threatening trap set by the sadistic Enigma.

Left with no choice, they throw themselves headlong into the labyrinth, their survival dependent on their ability to solve a grim series of intricate riddles amidst the nerve-wracking ambience of the chamber fitted with high-tech traps.
As the deafening tick-tock of a gigantic wall clock reverberates through their bones, the urgency to find an escape route amplifies.
Delving into separate sections of the chamber, they brave multitudes of cunning trials, their resolve tested anew in the face of the complex riddles and deadly traps laid out before them.

Through the sophisticated speaker system embedded in the labyrinth’s walls, Enigma’s gloating voice provides a haunting soundtrack to their desperate endeavour, a chilling, omnipresent reminder of his hawk-like vigilance.
Relying heavily on their logical reasoning and gut instincts, they manage to make their way through Enigma's array of lethal traps.
With every victory that spares them from the clutches of death, their bond strengthens.
Each triumph, born from their unwavering determination and shared near-death experiences, fortifies their will, making the desire to escape from this deathly ordeal unyielding.
Spotting an opportunity for a final blow, they penetrate Enigma's personal lair, its dire ambiance coming alive with a plethora of sinister gadgets and ominous secrets.

Just then, Enigma himself makes an appearance, the malevolent CEO of Sphinx Corp unfurling an icy smile as he reveals his personal office to be the final and most challenging puzzle they would have to crack.
Fear knits their brows together, but it doesn’t vein their stride.
They sweep through the office space with renewed determination, eyes alert for any possible clue that might hold the key to their survival.
An amalgamation of brilliant deductions and clear communication ensues, leading them to solve Enigma's twisted final puzzle, triggering an apocalyptic chain reaction in the process.
The labyrinth's control system initiates a self-destruct sequence, triggering a series of catastrophic tremors that send shockwaves throughout the formidable fortress.

Escaping the deadly chaos by mere seconds, Emma and Jake tear through the labyrinth one last time, leaving Enigma, the proud architect of his deadly chambers, trapped in the very vise of his diabolical accomplishment.

Gasping for fresh air amidst a downpour of debris, they stand awestruck, observing the demonstration of poetic justice as the monolithic structure crumbles to the ground, a malignant edifice sinking beneath mounds of rubble.
The piercing, reassuring wail of sirens punctuates the eerily quiet aftermath, assuring them that help was on its way.
Despite their exhaustion, faint from the dust and debris clogging their lungs, they manage to stagger towards the arriving police officers.
With trembling hands, they pass over pieces of incriminating evidence: portions of blueprints and damning documents that reveal the nefarious operations of Sphinx Corp.
Retreating to watch from a distance, they observe as the scene is inundated by police and responders, signaling the culmination of their dangerous mission.

In the wake of rigorous police investigations and expansive media coverage, Sphinx Corp's horrifying conspiracy becomes public knowledge, bringing some semblance of peace to the grieving families of its countless victims.
Emma and Jake's tales of bravery and resilience capture national attention, The public's fascination with their ordeal triggers long overdue systematic changes within the justice system.
Exhausted yet triumphant, the pair carves out a quiet moment amidst the resulting chaos, circumstances mirroring their initial ordeal.

Exhaling deeply, lifting a burden they had carried since they first woke up in that foreboding chamber, they exchange a knowing nod, a silent acknowledgement of the unforgettable bond formed in the crucible of their shared trauma.

With their heartbeats gradually settling and their spirits still radiating with their recent triumph, there's an unmistakable promise in their eyes - their courageous journey together is far from over, many more thrilling adventures certainly lie ahead.

63658354.title: Escape Room: Tournament of Champions
synopsis: After escaping the "sole survivor" escape rooms orchestrated by the Minos Corporation, Zoey Davis and Ben Miller decide to confront the shadowy organization after finding coordinates to its New York City–based headquarters.
Zoey is encouraged by her therapist to move on from her trauma and to get over her aerophobia, but she opts to drive with Ben instead of flying.
The pair find the headquarters derelict and are accosted by a vagrant who steals Zoey's necklace.
She and Ben give chase straight into the Q subway train.
Their train car separates from the rest of the train and is redirected to a remote station, sealing Zoey, Ben, and other passengers Rachel, Brianna, Nathan, and Theo inside.
As the passengers realize in horror that they are once again in Minos' deadly game, the train becomes electrified.
Zoey and Ben learn that the others are the "winners" of previous escape rooms, having survived them.
To escape, the group must collect subway tokens as the electrification increases.
Theo is killed while the rest escape.
Nathan reveals his escape room group were all priests, Brianna's were all influencers, and Rachel's consisted of people who cannot feel physical pain.
The next room is a bank with a slowly closing vault and a deadly laser security system.
The group manages to decipher the complex route to get around the lasers and escape with just seconds to spare.
While in the room, Zoey is perplexed by frequent references to someone called Sonya and that the escape rooms have no apparent connection to the group unlike before.
The next room is a postcard-like beach with more references to Sonya.
They discover that the beach is covered in quicksand.
While Rachel is sinking, Nathan sacrifices himself to save Rachel and is swallowed up by the sand.
Zoey finds an alternate route out just as Brianna unlocks the intended exit.
An argument on which route to take breaks out; Rachel and Ben side with Zoey.
Brianna escapes through the main exit while Rachel and Zoey traverse to the alternate route, but Ben falls into the quicksand.
Zoey and Rachel make their way out through a manhole back into the city.
Overjoyed at first that they are outside, they quickly realize they are still in the game when they encounter a panicked Brianna.
If they do not make it out of this room, acid rain is periodically sprayed on them.
The group opens a taxi to escape into but once Zoey enters, the taxi locks Rachel and Brianna out.
Zoey falls into the next room while Rachel and Brianna succumb to the rain and die.
The next room is a child's bedroom containing a diary from Sonya, revealing the rooms are based on a fun day out she had with her mother.
Zoey discovers Sonya's mother is Amanda Harper, who survived her fall in her original escape room and was forced into designing escape rooms for Minos after they abducted her daughter.
Amanda appears and begs Zoey to become the next puzzle-maker for Minos, warning that she has no choice.
Ben is revealed to be trapped in a cage.
When Zoey refuses Minos' demand, Ben's cage starts filling with water, but Zoey and Amanda work together to free him.
They manage to break out, fleeing the facility.
They report their findings to the police, who retrieve the bodies of Rachel, Brianna, Nathan, and Theo; the news about Minos goes public.
An FBI agent assures Zoey that Minos will be tracked down.
Filled with confidence, Zoey decides to take a plane home with Ben.
Onboard, she sees a woman who resembles her therapist, and then realizes she is in another escape room.
The distorted voice of Minos' leader mocks Zoey and Ben for falling into their latest trap as the plane begins to fall and gas fills the cabin.

71321542.title: The Leasehold
synopsis: Our film opens with a frantic montage set in New York City, where the heart of corporate America lies.

Four friends varying in profession yet common in their frustrations; Peter, a rigid yet dedicated lawyer embroiled continuously in tedious litigation; Lisa, a crafty financial analyst who's spending endless hours balancing books and making predictions; Andy, an obsessive software engineer programming lines upon lines of complex code tirelessly; and Emma, an impeccably organised project manager juggling multiple multi-million dollar projects, are all engrossed in their towering heap of files, seemingly unreachable deadlines, and stressful boardroom meetings.
They find a common rendezvous at a perpetually bustling Starbucks situated on the busy 43rd Street.
Buried in their preferred caffeine fix, conversations gradually shift from their respective fields to a shared desire to escape their suffocating routines.
Their yearning to break free lays the foundation for the thrilling escapade our story narrates.
This yearning turns into relentless planning as they scheme a week-long relaxation trip, far from the deafening hustle of New York City.
After the clock strikes five, they exchange corporate jargon for travel brochures, and spreadsheets for tourist guides.
Their planning yields a unanimous decision to rent an antique 18th-century Spanish colonial house, ensconced in the calming tranquility of the secluded Florida Keys.
Having booked their stay and packed their bags, they rent a sturdy sport utility vehicle for the journey.
They cruise through the panoramic Virginia Keys' scenic highway, the cityscape gradually being replaced by miles of serene sky.
They finally reach the historic home, the path illuminated by the truck's lonely headlights, the grandeur of the home looming in the darkness.
The stark contrast to the vibrant city life is intimidating.
The daunting silence of the house and the solitude poured over the property dampen their initial enthusiasm.
Their laughter and banter seem almost artificial, as the echoing halls of their rented space meddle with their comfort and happiness.
Pushing aside their initial apprehension, the quartet resolves to maximize their retreat.
Their first day involves typical beach activities: snorkeling and fishing in Florida’s transparent waters, sunbathing on the warm beaches, and trying local cuisines at beachside shacks.
They laugh, explore and unwind, albeit with a lingering sense of not being alone.
Nightfall casts a grim shadow over the property.
They cannot shake off the eerie creaks muffled by the antique house, the unusual sounds that interrupt the silences, and the cold gusts of wind traversing the corridors.
The mild climate of the day flips into an ominously chilly night, unsettling the guests.
Lisa, who possessed a stoic demeanor, witnesses discomforting shadows cast against the faded house walls from the corner of her eye.
On that initial night, she finds it difficult to fall asleep because of the sudden drops in temperature.
Strange noises whisper in the air---a language she finds incomprehensible.
Gathering her courage, she attributes these elements to tricks of her tired mind.
Come morning, Lisa carves the silhouette of her disturbing nightmare as she tells Peter.
Peter, ever the practical one, attributes these hallucinations to the stress built from their high-strung city lives.
Their conversation attempts to pass off the baffling experience as ordinary.
As the weeks roll by, both Emma and Andy report similar incidents.
Andy narrates a tale of the inanimate objects on his bedside table stirring without any plausible reasoning.
Emma's hairs stand on end recalling the almost indiscernible whispers she heard one late night.
Lisa’s experiences suddenly start to sound less like nightmares and more like shared suffering.
Laying their stories of terror over the breakfast table, with pancakes and coffee forgotten, they realize their shared experiences hint at a larger, and far more sinister, context.
The bone-chilling stories push a sense of fear into them.
Emma, emboldened by her concerns, strikes up a conversation with the only other inhabitant of the area: a wise, old fisherman who’d been around for generations.
His sunburnt face tells tales of wise, hardened sailor, hints of soft wrinkles carving his story every time he smiles.
As their talk prolongs, he spills horrifying folklore—he narrates stories of unresolved disappearances, unaccounted, sudden deaths etched in the house's history.
Horrifying tales that are whispered in hushed tones among the locals, passed down as chilling bedtime stories.
The fisherman's disturbing tales throw their nightmarish experiences into a horrifying frame of reference.
His stories echo their experiences, and the initial fear begins morphing into a sense of impending dread.
Galvanized by their encounters, they dive headfirst into shedding light on the house's terrorizing mysteries.
Their self-orchestrated investigation starts.
They search for clues in the strangest of places; underneath the peeling wallpapers, they discover cryptic symbols mysteriously carved.
Also hidden away in the recesses of what was once the house's study, they find a secret compartment, within which an old, dilapidated diary lay.
The diary, with its frenzied, erratic entries, presents a tale of a man's decent into madness induced by the very house they were residing in.
Chilling recounts of mysterious apparitions, unsettling noises, and invisible antagonists resonate eerily with their own experiences.
Their blood runs cold as they make an alarming realization.
From the contents of the diary and their escalating encounters, they understand the horrifying truth: an iniquity lingers within the house.
An unsettling presence making itself known piece by piece, experience by experience.
Their fears are buttressed one fateful night, when Lisa becomes the direct target of the invisible force menacing the house.
She wakes up, finding herself held down, unable to move or scream, mirrors cracking from the walls and hushed whispers in the air.
This ghastly encounter injects a trepidation within the occupants so deep it shakes them to their very cores.
Seeing the practical physical encounter, the friends unanimously resolve to desert the terrifying property.
Their plan is to flee the house at the crack of dawn, and never look back.
However, their invisible adversary holds them captive.
Mysteriously every exit point of the house gets locked without plausible reasoning.
Their attempts at escape result in eerie laughter echoing through the halls, shaking them to their core.
Terrified, yet desperate, they decide to confront their fear outright.
They decide to eradicate the entity and escape its clutches.
Emma siphons out crucial information from the old diary, the recollection of a ritual to purge the evil entity.
A 'Purging of Shadows' that the past author of the diary had attempted.
Drawing out hope from the old, forgotten pages, they decide to conduct the ritual.
Their preparation and ceremony carry them into the night.
As they chant from the diaries, they understand fragments of the house's tormented history: betrayal, despair, regret, and death.
The entity’s desperation frames why the house is an unescapable prison for its malignant presence.
Progressing through the ritual, they realize it's a race against time.
To be able to rid the house of the entity, they have to complete the ceremony before dawn, else they risk being bound to the house, trapped under the entity's clutches for eternity.
Their fear mingling with resolution, they combine forces to complete the draining ritual despite the odds.
The single thread of normalcy pulling them forward.
As the entity attempts to dissociate the group by employing tactics of psychological terror, they stand together.
They resist the push, and meet the adversary head-on.
In a lightning storm of fear, courage, and desperation, they continue their struggle, their desperate prayer for salvation echoing in the once oppressive halls of the haunting house.

Moments before the break of dawn, they manage to complete the ritual, banishing the entity just as the first rays of sunlight creep through the windows, scattering sparks of dawn in the once-cursed halls.
Relief washes over them as they recognize the break of dawn, their ethereal tormentor finally being defeated.
Their previous lives in the city now a welcome comfort, rather than a stress to escape.
Exhausted and emotionally spent, yet victorious, they step out of the daunting house.
The morning light envelopes them, broken rays kissing their faces, accentuating the relief on their faces.
They return to their work-laden lives in the city, once a dread, now an odd comfort.
Their corporate lives are now laced with an undertone of mundane tranquility.
Their journey back to normal marks their resilience, a symbol of human determination in the face of life’s horrifying surprises.
The house in Florida then returns to silence, the reminder of its ominous past fading, the echoes of its recent ghostly history vanishing, only vacant halls recounting its tale.
Oblivious to the tragic and horrifying past, a contract-based cleaning crew arrives at the quiet abode.
They clean out the dust, fix the broken mirrors, and prepare the house for future prospects.
Meanwhile, a greedy real estate agency, with no knowledge of the house’s foreboding secret, polishes its appeal for the market.
Enticed by the potential profit, they choose to turn a blind eye to the rumors circulating among the locals, dismissing them as merely tales.
They catalogue every corner of the house, its disturbing allure conveniently masked by the benign appearance of whitewashed walls and manicured gardens.
The film ends with a daunting shot of the property.
An advertisement, conspicuous in its innocence, displays an inviting picture of the once-haunting house on a popular home rental platform.

The ad reads in bold letters, "Embrace serenity in an isolated Spanish colonial beauty: Lease now.”  Innocent prospective tenants browse through the ad; sifting through the symmetrical rooms, well-groomed gardens, and architectural grandeur, they praise the property's charm and lured by the promise of tranquillity and the affordability of the deal.
Hints of impending horror start piling up as prospective clients plan their future visits and start booking correspondence with the company, completely unaware of its malignant past.
When the screen fades to black, a gruesome question hangs in the air: Who will be the house's next victim?
The ominous possibility of history reiterating itself fills the audience with terror, ending the film on a spine-chilling note.

60519186.title: The Rental
synopsis: Charlie, his wife Michelle, his brother Josh, and Josh's girlfriend/Charlie's business partner Mina rent a remote house on the Oregon Coast for a weekend getaway.
The host of the house, Taylor, receives them and gives the couples the key to the house.
After they have settled in, Mina, Josh, and Charlie take MDMA (ecstasy) while Michelle goes to bed.
Josh later passes out on the couch, and Mina and Charlie end up kissing in the hot tub and having sex in the shower.
The next morning, Charlie and Mina agree to forget what happened between them and not tell their respective partners.
While taking a shower, Mina discovers a camera in the shower head and alerts Charlie; the two are confident Taylor has installed it.
Charlie stops her from calling the police, as doing so would likely lead to Michelle and Josh learning they had sex.
He also assures her that Taylor would not reveal the footage because it would involve him admitting to spying on them.
That night, Michelle calls Taylor over to fix the hot tub, while Josh realizes his dog has gone missing.
Josh is suspicious that Taylor may have taken the dog, so he confronts Taylor upon his arrival, but he denies it.
Taylor fixes the hot tub, and Mina privately confronts him about the hidden camera in the shower, which he claims to be unaware of.
Mina threatens to call the police but Taylor trumps her and attempts to call the police, Mina tries to stop him.
Hearing the commotion, Josh rushes in and, assuming Taylor was attacking Mina, beats him unconscious.
Mina is forced to explain the hidden camera in the shower, but does not reveal that she had sex with Charlie.
The group gather in the living room to decide what to do.
Meanwhile, a masked man sneaks inside and smothers Taylor to death.
When the others return and find Taylor dead, they assume that he died from the injuries inflicted by Josh.
Frantic, Michelle demands they call the police, but Charlie refuses to let his brother, who has previously been incarcerated, return to prison.
He suggests that they stage Taylor's death as an accident by throwing him off the cliff into the ocean.
Michelle refuses to take part in their plan and goes to the bedroom.
Charlie, Josh and Mina carry Taylor's body to the cliff.
It falls onto an outcrop, forcing Josh to go down and push it into the sea.
Back at the house, Michelle hears the sound of a shower and when she investigates, she is lured into a room where a television shows the footage of Charlie and Mina having sex.
Michelle confronts Charlie about what she has seen, and drives off angrily.
Down the road, she runs over metal spikes, crashes into a tree, and is attacked by the masked man while texting Charlie for help.
Charlie gets a text from Michelle's phone and goes to search for her.
He finds her dead body on the road and is then attacked and murdered by the masked man.
Back at the house, Mina and Josh are looking for the shower camera's transceiver to destroy any footage it recorded.
Josh receives texts from Charlie's phone that contain evidence of Charlie and Mina having sex.
Josh then hears someone enter the house and, thinking it is Charlie, rushes to confront him.
Instead, the masked man ambushes and kills Josh.
Mina flees, pursued by the masked man.
Sprinting through the forest in the darkness and fog, she accidentally runs off a cliff and falls into the ocean.

The masked man returns to the house, removing all evidence and surveillance equipment and then removes his mask (revealing dark hair and what is implied to be a younger man, though his face is not shown).
As the man is about to depart, Josh's dog runs in through the backdoor, showing that he did indeed just run off for a day as opposed to being killed.
The man attempts to pet the dog gently but the dog recoils, and the man departs without harming the dog.
He rents a new property and installs cameras in it.

It becomes clear that as a serial killer; he first rents a property and installs the surveillance equipment, and at some point in the future, he uses that equipment to  aid in killing future renters before removing the equipment and moving on.
During the credits, footage is shown from the hidden cameras of the masked man attacking a sleeping couple as he emerges from a closet.

59770055.title: Caffeine Bulletstorm
synopsis: The lively city of Sansbury starts its day - cars honking, shops opening up, city dwellers bustling around - the sights and sounds of city life chaos awakening with a vivacious energy.
Amid this cacophony, Ruby and Kayla, a charming mother-daughter duo work harmoniously in their thriving coffee shop, "Caffeine Whisper."
Their complementing personalities mirrored in their approach as they meticulously set up their quaint space, ready for the wave of caffeine-craving customers soon to pour in.
As morning rolls around and people trickle in, the chaos of Sansbury is muted, replaced by the comforting hum of the coffee machine and the aroma of freshly brewed coffee.
They work with practiced ease, crafting scorching cappuccinos, creamy lattes, and aromatic espressos to locals taking their first, warming sips of the day.
Amid the morning's exchange of laughter and conversation with customers, mixed with the euphonic clink of coffee mugs, Ruby's cheerful demeanor alters abruptly.
Her hand, coarsely stained from coffee grounds, gently lifts up an unsuspected phone call that turns her joyous countenance hauntingly pale.
Uttering a rushed goodbye overshadowed by fear, she swiftly exits the café, leaving a cloud of confusion hanging over Kayla, who is surrounded by struggling to manage a crowd of patrons.
Kayla, amid the bustling café and mounting concern for her mother, musters the courage to manage the shop all by herself.
Each order she fulfills, each customer she appeases, the burning question of Ruby's sudden departure tinkers in her mind.
With a pounding heart echoing in her ears, she navigates through the dim spaces, her feet treading lightly on the coffee-splattered floor.
Her curiosity guides her to a concealed door - a gateway to a hidden basement swirling with an air of ominous mystery.

As she descends the stairs into another world, she discovers a chilling sight: a well-arranged, clandestine cache of guns mounted on the wall, alongside a drawer filled with countless untraceable burner phones.
Nerving herself, Kayla's trembling hands accidentally trigger a voicemail playback on one of the phones.
The cryptic message reveals a divergent side to Ruby's life - a dangerous double-life and an impending threat that’s encroaching upon them.
After a whirlwind day of recognizing her mother’s disappearance, Ruby finds Kayla sitting dumb-founded amidst the shield of deadly weaponry.
Confronted by a horrified and bemused daughter, Ruby reluctantly unfolds a hidden chapter of her life under the dim glow of their coffee shop.
Her confession of a dual existence shocks Kayla - her own mother, a feared and dangerous assassin-for-hire.

Ruby, in a desperate attempt to balance the peaceful normalcy of their coffee shop with her more menacing and threatening assignments, exposes an intricate yet delicate link between their quaint café façade and her life-threatening work.
She discloses a terrifying situation - an outstanding contract on her life that forced her to immediately abandon the café and lay low, leaving Sansbury behind.
As the sun ushers in a new day, Ruby, with a burdened heart, leaves a reluctant Kayla in the caring hands of her eccentric yet loving grandmother, before vanishing into the city’s bustling crowd.
Meanwhile, within the confines of the city, Kayla becomes the target of a past enemy of Ruby – an ex-handler with a vendetta to settle.
Unfamiliar men lurking in the corners of the café and unexplained disturbances render Kayla anxious and her once familiar surroundings are suddenly laden with a palpable sense of danger.
Pushed to the brink of fear, Kayla resolves to learn how to use Ruby's unconventional arsenal.
She prepares herself, her only hope of self-preservation lying in self-defense.
Confronted with mounting danger, alone and defenseless, Kayla taps into a newfound strength.
A struggle of terror and empowerment looms over her as she gears up for a battle she never expected to face.
Instinctively utilizing the little training she received from Ruby, Kayla manages to repel an attempted assault on the Caffeine Whisper.
The news of the nearly overpowering attack on her quaint café, reaches Ruby in her clandestine hideout igniting a flame of urgent concern, and sparking an impetus to get back home.
A fierce Ruby, cutting through the grimy underbelly of Sansbury city, dodges several attempts on her life as she fiercely strides homeward.
The escalating threats against Kayla and Ruby's fierce retaliation draws their perilous circumstances into a showdown of galvanizing intensity.
Ruby, stepping back onto the cobblestones of her hometown, perceives an enveloping sense of danger around her vulnerable daughter, her assassin instincts kicking in.
The narrative hits its climax with a gripping encounter - Ruby and Kayla, standing their ground against their relentless adversaries in the sanctuary of their beloved coffee shop.
A bruised yet unbroken Ruby and Kayla emerge from their ordeal fortified and ready to confront any future obstacles.
Inspired by her mother's courage, Kayla starts rigorous training, treading a new path between serving lattes and mastering combative tactics.
Despite their tumultuous circumstances, Caffeine Whisper endures.
It becomes more than just a café - premiering as a beacon of courage, serving cups of coffee that taste faintly of grit and valour to the city dwellers lost in their oblivious lives.
Unidentified threats lurking within Sansbury no longer incite fear; they are now challenges, ticking time bombs waiting to explode.
In the face of these threats, the duo tirelessly prepares themselves.
Their story, a compelling narrative of unwavering maternal love, indefatigably courage and the stark resolve to survive begins to unfold.
The saga of Ruby and Kayla continues to unravel against the backdrop of the wafting aroma of roasted coffee beans and the electrifying dread of impending danger.
Caffeine Whisper gains deep significance - it emerges as more than just a coffee shop; now, it is a symbol of unyielding resilience, fearlessness, and rekindled courage.
Their faith now finds its anchor in their combined strength and their unwavering belief in their capability to overcome whatever hurdles come their way.
But the fear has faded, replaced by a bond of resilient courage between Kayla and herself.
Their hands, once only used to grip warm mugs of coffee now confidently clasp concealed firearms.

60582100.title: Gunpowder Milkshake
synopsis: In a flashback at a diner, twelve-year-old Sam learns that her assassin mother, Scarlet, is skipping town after a job gone wrong.
Armed men arrive to kill Scarlet, but she kills them and escapes, leaving an upset Sam behind to be cared for by Nathan.
Fifteen years later, the now 27-year-old Sam works as an assassin for Nathan, the human resources head for the same firm Scarlet worked for.
Nathan gives Sam a new job, killing a man who stole money from The Firm and returning the money.
Sam goes to a weapons armory disguised as a library to exchange her weapons for new ones.
There, she meets Anna May, Madeleine, and Florence - three former accomplices of Scarlet.
They consider killing her for showing up unannounced, but change their minds when they learn her identity.
They provide her with clean weapons for the job.
Sam infiltrates a hotel room to retrieve the stolen money and shoots the man responsible in the abdomen when he lunges for his ringing phone.
Listening in on the call, she learns that he stole the money to save his kidnapped young daughter and must bring it to a nearby bowling alley to exchange for her.
Sam takes him to a firm-affiliated private doctor for treatment and agrees to handle the exchange herself.
Nathan learns of her plan and sends three henchmen to stop her and retrieve the money; Sam incapacitates them before continuing with her plan.
Masked men give her the girl, Emily, before retreating with the money; Sam pursues them, but the men turn on one another, resulting in their deaths and the destruction of the stolen money.
Meanwhile, Nathan learns that one of the henchmen Sam killed in an earlier job was the son of Jim McAlister, the head of a powerful criminal empire.
To avoid conflict, Nathan gives up Sam's information and location to be killed.
Sam returns to the doctor to reunite Emily with her father, but they learn that he did not survive.
Nathan's three henchmen are also at the doctor seeking treatment for their prior fight and they receive orders to kill her.
The doctor injects Sam with a serum that renders her arms useless.
Sam asks Emily to tape a knife and a gun to her hands and she uses them to fight and kill the three henchmen.
More henchmen arrive, but Sam and Emily escape in Sam's car, with Emily steering and Sam working the pedals.
Sam receives a text from Nathan, giving her the address to a safe house where she can find supplies to help her escape.
She and Emily travel there and run into Scarlet, who reveals she has been watching Sam from afar for 15 years.
When henchmen arrive to kill Sam, Scarlet guides them through a hidden escape route.
They manage to escape and return to the library, where the librarians angrily demand why Scarlet never tried to contact them when she disappeared.
They are interrupted by arriving gunmen.
Sam attempts to hold them off, but, after she is overpowered, Scarlet intervenes to save her.
The librarians consider fleeing with Emily, but they decide to join the fight.
All the gunmen are killed except for Virgil, Jim McAlister's nephew, who kills Madeleine and kidnaps Emily.
Virgil calls Sam, who offers to turn herself in at the diner in exchange for Emily's freedom.
Sam arrives to meet Jim McAlister who explains that his late son had four older sisters that Jim could not relate to as he does not understand women.
Jim intends to torture Sam and make Emily watch, but Scarlet, Anna May, and Florence arrive with guns to free them.
Sam takes Emily and leaves the diner before the three women kill Jim and all his henchmen.
Sometime later, Sam apologizes to Emily for killing her father and Emily forgives her.
Emily goes to Nathan's home disguised as a Girl Scout.
Sam threatens his life unless he returns to The Firm and calls off the hit on her.
Sam, Emily, Scarlet, Anna May, and Florence then drive down the coast together.

97220691.title: The Forgotten Life of Catherine Fairfield
synopsis: Shimmering lights flickered atop towering buildings, dappling the cityscape of post World War II New York and subsequently unveiling an elegant charity event, the brainchild of Catherine Fairfield, a socialite whose wealth was only outdone by her proclivity for philanthropy and fine art.
Navigating the event was akin to guiding through a sea of faces, all engaged in animated conversations, gossip, and laughter.
The guests, a motley blend of affluent socialites and entrepreneurs, were thoroughly captivated by Catherine's alluring charisma and sophisticated grace.

The pomp and ceremony of the night was violently curtailed when Catherine's 1940s Rolls-Royce, as black as the night itself, crashed with terrific impact into a recklessly speeding lorry, flinging her into a chilling realm of unconsciousness amidst the scattered wreckage.

Her world shifted abruptly from the opulent grandeur of the gold-gilded charity ballroom to the stark, sanitized walls of Bellevue Hospital, where she woke into a disorienting fog of amnesia, her past memories vaporized into non-existence.

Sensing her vulnerability, her distant relatives, the cunning Worthingtons, swooped in, artfully camouflaging their insatiable greed for her expansive estate and prized art collection behind a façade of familial loyalty.
Time lost its meaning in her prison, as Catherine wrestled to reveal the secrets trapped within her ailing mind, her days stringing into nights of loneliness and confusion in an unfamiliar world.
Each tantalizing flash of forgotten memory acted as a beacon, driving her curiosity and resolve to dig because the layers of her concealed identity.
Navigating this complex puzzle was her kind-hearted therapist, Dr. Andrew, whose refreshing and offbeat therapeutic methods gradually began to break the dense barrier of her amnesia.
The horrifying truth detonated like a bombshell - her accident was not a mere coincidence but a meticulously planned attack aimed at erasing the compromising information she inadvertently possessed.

As her memory stirred from its slumber, she confronted the startling truth about her dearest confidante, William, and his sinister game of treachery, throwing her previously unshakeable trust in him into a whirlwind of chaos.
The journey to reclaim her past morphed into a heart-stopping thriller, plastered with clandestine attempts on her life, each one a grim reminder of the very real danger she was in.
Following a harrowing, skin-of-her-teeth escape from a concealed knife attack, she hardened her resolve, swearing to confront her latent threat instead of living under the omnipresent shadow of fear.

Meticulously, she designed a strategy to trip her blackmailer, collecting evidence craftily while skillfully feigning ignorance, her unwavering bravery providing the only beacon of light in her daunting journey against the tempest.
With the showdown looming, she did the unthinkable - she forgave William for his betrayal, a shocking twist in her medley of retribution.
Yet, despite her forgiveness, her ironclad determination for justice remained undeterred, propelling her course towards the impending legal doom awaiting her manipulative confidante.

A safe distance away, Catherine watched as her carefully orchestrated plan unfolded with William's arrest, emerging victorious yet emotionally scarred from the tumultuous skirmish, her strength ushering her back into the comforting serenity of the night.
As she finally loosened her clenched grasp from the painful shards of her past, Catherine emerged victorious from her trials, her self-identity revitalized and her intentions sharpened.
Her recollections revealed and justice delivered, Catherine transformed into an emblem of unyielding resilience, her ordeal painting a stark portrait of her courage against formidable adversity.
Catherine resurfaces, a phoenix rising from the ashes of her ordeal, atop her high-rise building.
The vibrant city lights mirror back her strength and refined grace, triumphantly heralding her readiness to salute the dawn of her rebirth.

62025424.title: The Last Letter from Your Lover
synopsis: In the mid-1960s, wealthy socialite Jennifer Stirling suffers from memory loss after a car crash.
Unable to remember much of her life before or connect with her husband Laurence, Jennifer is intrigued by a letter she finds between "J" and "Boot".
She decides to try and remember what happened to her by following clues from the letter.
In modern day London, Ellie Haworth, who recently broke up with her long-time boyfriend, has to write an article about the recently-deceased editor of her paper.
Getting past the formal archivist Rory to access the editor's archive, she finds a misfiled love letter, to someone identified as "J", from "Boot".
Moved by the passionate feelings between the mysterious couple, Ellie becomes determined to learn their identities and how their love story ended.
In the past, a pre-crash Jennifer and her husband Laurence travel to the French Riviera for a summer vacation.
Foreign correspondent Anthony O'Hare arrives to interview Laurence about his business success.
At the party, Laurence is condescending to both Jennifer and Anthony.
Afterwards, a drunk Anthony complains about the awful company to a fellow guest and is caught by Jennifer.
Anthony returns the next morning with a written apology, which Jennifer forces him to read aloud.
Anthony invites the Stirlings out to eat the next day, but Laurence is called away on a sudden business trip, leaving Jennifer and Anthony to spend the summer together until his return.
They begin writing letters to each other, under the pennames "J" and "Boot" (or "B").
Neither act on their growing electricity, until Jennifer impulsively tries to kiss him.
When he pulls away, she flees.
Some days later, a letter penned by Anthony reaches her, proposing to meet at Postman's Park in London.
They start a whirlwind affair, spending moments together where Jennifer can safely be with Anthony.
Finally, he proposes she run off with him to New York.
Jennifer is hesitant to leave, in fear of being treated as an outcast by her family and friends.
After Anthony sends her a letter that he will be waiting for her at the train station on the night of his departure, Jennifer rushes off to meet him.
Just before she can arrive, she gets into a car crash, with a blow to her head causing partial amnesia.
Anthony leaves for New York, believing that Jennifer has rejected him.
Six months after the car crash, Laurence hides the last letter Jennifer received from Anthony in effort to prevent her from remembering the affair.
Jennifer feels lost as she struggles to recover her memories.
She begins finding several of the love letters from "Boot" hidden in her house, leading her to discover a postal box in her name that Laurence had closed.
Jennifer confronts Laurence, who claims Anthony had died in the crash.
Four years later, Jennifer bumps into Anthony, restoring her memories of their time together.
He once again pleads for her to run away with him, but she refuses out of consideration for her two-year old-daughter.
Enraged at Laurence for his lies, Jennifer asserts that she will stay with him because of their daughter, but vows to leave if he mistreats her.
In turn, Laurence threatens to ruin Jennifer's reputation and gain sole custody of their daughter, as she would only be seen as an adulteress by the court of law.
This prompts Jennifer to escape with their daughter to go with Anthony.
After finding out he has checked out of his hotel, she tries finding him at his workplace, but is informed by the editor that Anthony has already left.
Forced to return to Laurence, Jennifer gives the bundle of love letters to the editor to be sent to Anthony if they hear back from him.
In the present day, Ellie and Rory grow closer as they uncover more of the love letters.
After spending the night with Rory, Ellie distances herself from him.
She learns that Jennifer and Anthony are both alive and goes to speak with them.
After hearing their regrets and pain over their lost romance, Ellie decides to enter into a relationship with Rory, choosing to give romance another try and not live with regrets.
Ellie returns to Anthony and encourages him to write one last letter to Jennifer, in which he asks her to meet him once again at Postman's Park.
Ellie and Rory watch from a distance as the two lovers reunite.

16278621.title: Heartland Harbinger (film)
synopsis: From upon the hallowed steps of Hawthorne High School hailed four unlikely companions - Josh, a child prodigy with a mind blossoming for science; Mandy, the literature connoisseur whose solace was found between wrinkled pages; Leo, the prodigious mind bound to publish groundbreaking papers on the language of numbers; and Sarah, the history devotee who preferred dead kings over teenagers.
Each weekend, united by their shared passion for knowledge, they convened at their sacred sanctuary - the tranquil Grove library nestled in the hollows of Hillside town.
In one such rendezvous, they meandered through the cobweb-laden arteries of the history section, a section that time itself seemed to have forgotten.
There, barely visible under the pile of Egyptian Chronicles and Roman Histories, an archaic sheepskin diary beckoned them.
Its parchment whispered stories of an old era, heavily infused with traditional Celtic folklore, focusing primarily on a phantom known only as the Heartland Harbinger.
The Heartland Harbinger had long been a folkloric myth of Hillside, its eerie tales woven into the fabric of their society, yet remained a mystery unsolved.
Eager to unravel the knot, they smuggled the delicate relic from the library to their clandestine hideout - a forgotten relic itself - the Oakheart Manor.
Amidst the echoing grandeur of the manor, they unfolded the cracked parchment.
Josh, summoning an inner strength and channeling an ancient spirit, voiced a captivating Latin spell intricately woven in the diary.
Every chant echoed through the mansion, a raised action in their play of mystery and adventure.
With bated breath, they inhaled the damp mossy scent imbued in the manor's air, waiting.
Their hearts pounded in a fatal rhythm, an unknown excitement gripping them as they stood diminutive amidst the towering Gothic bookcases, expectant of the imminent spectral apparition.
A world of wonder unfurled before them when the looming apparition of the Harbinger painfully unfolded itself.
Iconized by a tarnished, bronze-hilted sword he proclaimed as 'El Filo', the ghost cast a comical shadow of what was once a figure of dread.
Through a gossamer mask of bravado, the Harbinger attempted to muster an aura of dread, but his comedic folly undermined him, transforming the ambiance from fear-laden to laughter-induced.

Each failed attempt at commanding respect saw him hilariously stumbling over mahogany furniture, crashing into the faded stain-glassed windows and haphazardly ringing the antique brass bell with his sword.
Intrigued by this paradoxical character, the wide-eyed teenagers plunged headfirst into the endless well of curiosity about this phantom.
In a quiet surrender, Harbinger decided to share the shackles of his past, detailing a life that was quite unlike a knight's tale.
Harbinger, it seemed, had originated from the 13th Century, a disgraced knight whose calamity was caused by an irate witch.
Caught in the unofficial act of bumbling, he was stripped off his knightly honor and cursed into a life that contested his very existence.
The curse, he lamented, would shatter only when he achieved an act of noble valor, a milestone that his chronic clumsiness seemed to turn into an unreachable mirage.
Touched by this moving tale, the friends, in a heartwarming pact of companionship, pledged to help their spectral friend break free from his centuries-long curse.
The quest began with seeking guidance from the sophisticated Mrs. Greenberry, the whimsical librarian with a vast reservoir of arcane knowledge.
Then came a turning point, engraved in golden letters on the pages of Hillside's history.
An unexpected villain, a malevolent spirit called Moros descended upon their town, casting an ominous shadow of fear and chaos.
Recognizing it as an opportunity to redeem his cursed fate, Harbinger bolstered himself to confront Moros.
The teenagers, with a renewed sense of responsibility, accompanied him, devising strategies to repel the terrorizing spirit.
The battlefield brimmed with a surreal sense of reality as Harbinger grappled with the ominous enemy.
Despite a series on unceremonious falls, comical stumbles, and unintentional slapstick comedy, which resulted in copious amounts of laughter from the terrified onlookers, Harbinger held his ground.
He swung the 'El Filo' with uncanny elegance, striking Moros into oblivion, lifting his curse, and delivered Hillside from the shadow of fear.
His departure was as monumental as his arrival.
Mandy, Sarah, Leo, and Josh said their tearful goodbyes, grateful for the laughter, the adventure, the lessons, and the ghost of a knight who had touched their lives in the most unexpected of ways.

With bittersweet smiles, they watched as he embraced the freedom he’d yearned for, his silhouette fading into the spirit realm, leaving behind a legacy that would forever echo through the annals of Hillside.
The foursome looked at each other, their hearts beating in sync with the pulsating energy of their adventure.
They decided to uphold Harbinger's memory, vowing to potentiate his legacy far and wide.

62152336.title: Freaky (film)
synopsis: After four teenagers discuss urban legends of a serial killer known as the Blissfield Butcher, the Butcher breaks into the mansion they are in and promptly murders the group of teenagers before leaving with an ancient dagger known as La Dola.
The next day, bullied high school student Millie Kessler attends the Blissfield Valley High School homecoming football game, where she performs as the school mascot.
As Millie waits for a ride home near the now-empty school, the Butcher attacks her.
He stabs Millie in the shoulder with La Dola, causing an identical wound to instantly appear on his shoulder.
Millie's older sister Char, a police officer, arrives and scares off the Butcher.
The police collect La Dola as evidence and initiate a manhunt for the Butcher.
The following morning, the Butcher and Millie discover that they have switched bodies, and they both make their way to Blissfield Valley High School.
At school, the Butcher, now posing as Millie, kills Millie's chief tormentor Ryler by locking her in a cryotherapy tank in the girl's locker room.
He realizes his innocent appearance grants him immunity from suspicion and fatally slices woodshop teacher Mr. Bernardi, another one of Millie's tormentors, in half with a table saw.
Millie, now in the Butcher's body, finds her best friends Nyla and Josh and proves her identity to them by performing the school mascot's dance routine and answering a series of personal questions.
Nyla and Josh research La Dola and discover that Millie must stab the Butcher with the dagger by midnight or else the body switch will be permanent.
Later that afternoon, with the school's official homecoming cancelled, the Butcher suggests a new dance be held at an old mill that is actually his hiding place.
The Butcher subsequently lures Millie's crush Booker into a monster mini golf course to kill him, but Millie, Nyla, and Josh arrive just in time to save him.
Millie knocks both the Butcher and Booker unconscious, and she and her friends bring the two to Josh's house.
After tying the Butcher to a chair, Millie and Nyla try to explain the situation to Booker, who remains unconvinced until Millie recites a love poem she anonymously wrote to him weeks earlier.
Josh watches over the Butcher while Millie, Nyla, and Booker drive to the police station to obtain La Dola.
Nyla tricks Char, the last officer in the station, into leaving so she can steal the dagger.

Waiting outside in the car, Booker reveals that he has always liked Millie, and Millie divulges how she enjoys the newfound strength and confidence she feels while in the Butcher's body, and they kiss.
The Butcher eventually escapes Josh's house, and Char catches Nyla stealing La Dola.
Still in the car, Millie sees the Butcher enter the police station and runs in after him, but Char tries to detain her, unaware of the situation.
Millie overpowers Char and locks her in a jail cell while the Butcher escapes in a police car.

At the Blissfield Valley High Homecoming dance out at the Butcher's mill, the Butcher kills three jocks who attempt to rape him, thinking he is Millie, as well as a fourth who attempted to assault Josh.
As midnight approaches, Millie finds the Butcher and both Nyla and Josh hold him down while Booker staves off the police.
Millie stabs the Butcher with La Dola and they switch back to their own bodies just in time, before the police shoot down the Butcher.
Later, Millie and Booker reunite, and they kiss again.
After faking his death in an ambulance, the Butcher follows Millie home and attacks her, mocking her physical weakness and anxiety.
Millie, Char, and their mother struggle to overpower the Butcher, but Millie finally kills him by impaling him with a broken table leg.

12430974.title: Final Sundown (2020 film)
synopsis: Sarah Thompson, famous for her fine details in sketch artistry, is immersed in her passion - sketching the opulence of Victorian-era interior design on her canvas sheets.
Meanwhile, in the heart of the city, Dr. John Thompson, a prominent heart surgeon is embroiled in a complex coronary bypass surgery.
They end their hardwork-filled day with a candlelit dinner on a vintage oak table rescued from a flea market long ago.

Following a glamorous evening at an elite New York socialite's mansion, they walk back to their homely brownstone in Brooklyn Heights when John's grip tightens on his chest, a heart attack taking him hostage.
Horror seizes Sarah as he crumbles onto the hand-knotted Persian rug, writhing in pain.
Panic-stricken, she manages to pilot her shiny silver Audi A6 through New York's chaotic streets to New York-Presbyterian Hospital.
Consumed by sorrow, Sarah turns her formerly vivacious living room into a somber sanctuary.
Once a whirlwind of color and life, Sarah is now akin to an empty shell, robotically sipping bitter black coffee.
A well-hidden secret box in John's walnut study table catches her attention one gloomy November morning.
Bundled in a bright red folder among the paperwork are ID cards from Médecins Sans Frontières, hinting at John's unshared association with the humanitarian organization.
In John's navy blue, worn-out diary, she finds entries encrypted in a labyrinth of complex cyphers, detailing his secretive operations in Syria and Yemen.

Through patience and intelligence, she cracks the cryptic entries, discovering John's covert operations – a man whose compassion transcended the boundary of the operating theater to touch refugees in conflict areas.
