Tony plants his seeds in a memorial for his late parents.
Sage dreams of settling down in a new home and aspires for a normal life.
After her family's trailer breaks down when they head for a new spot to sell marijuana, Sage senses a golden opportunity to get an education at Mount Abe High School.
When she arrives, Sage is greeted by Nancy, a bubbly cheerleader who becomes her friend.
Unfortunately, Beth, the conniving captain of the cheerleading squad, hears of Sage's arrival after trying to seduce Tony to become her Homecoming King.
Beth taunts Sage for her Vermont heritage, but Sage tells Nancy and the other girls at school of her summer with Tony, who tells his fellow jocks of his special time with Sage.
Unfortunately, Beth, realizing that Sage and Tony know each other and jealous of Tony's relationship with her, devises a scheme that involves driving a wedge between the two lovers.
Beth injures Nancy by deliberately fracturing her arm and lies to Sage that Nancy was killed in an accident so Sage can take her place at the cheerleading pep rally.
Meanwhile, Cody, the school quarterback who holds a grudge against Tony for taking his spot as the football star, swipes Tony's phone and hands it to Beth.
At the pep rally, Beth humiliates Sage in front of the whole school.
The jocks run in, and Sage realizes that Tony is actually the football star.
Outside the gym, Beth blackmails Tony to join her for Homecoming, threatening to put photos of him dancing on blast if he doesn't comply.
Later, Tony confesses to Sage that he was lying to her to get through the summer to cope with his reputation and he has to win Homecoming, which his school hasn't done in twenty-five years.
Crushed, Sage leaves the school and vents her frustrations.
She fakes sick to stay home, but reluctantly goes back under her mother Kate's encouragement.

Tony asks Sage for another chance and takes her to the tool shed in his backyard, telling her that his coach became his father figure after his parents passed away, football isn't the only thing he's passionate about, and he's afraid of being honest with his coach.
Sage tells Tony of her family's drug dealing and that they're trying to steer clear of the law before showing him her flower garden.
As Homecoming approaches, Sage prepares Tony for a dance, while at school, the latter and the athletes prepare for the Homecoming game.
Meanwhile, Beth uses Cody's phone to track down Sage, discovering the marijuana her family is growing.
At school, Coach confiscates Tony's phone after catching him looking at a video of Sage.
He hands it back and reminds Tony that winning Homecoming is his responsibility.
That night, Tony proposes that he and Sage run off together.
The next day, Tony runs into Beth, who threatens to post the photos she took of the weed if he doesn't go along with her offer.
Not wanting to turn Sage over to the police, Tony takes Beth's side.
Later, Coach, having discovered that Tony went to Lakeview for the summer, reprimands him for doing so.
Tony argues with him over his chosen future and attempts to kick the ball, but ends up starting a fight instead.
Tony runs into town to vent his frustrations, then discovers that Sage had torn up her garden, giving him an idea.
At school, on Homecoming Day, Beth calls the police to report Sage's family's drug dealing to get her arrested, but Sage throws her cell phone into the toilet out of revenge.
When she gets home, Officer Gorinsky, the town cop, goes in to investigate Sage's family's cannabis farming.
Kate and Gillian arrive, and Gorinsky discovers the garden but is fooled.
As Sage discovers, Tony has switched the weed with sunflowers from his parents' memorial, leaving two to honor them.
All the while, Tony's big brother Kevin shows Coach a video of Tony as a kid celebrating his late mother's birthday, which is why he dreamed of becoming a dancer.
As the Homecoming game begins, Sage and Tony reunite and go to Mount Abe so Tony can win for the school.
Unfortunately, Beth confronts Sage in the hallway, preparing to trap her, but Nancy comes to her rescue and pummels Beth, giving Sage enough time to get to Homecoming.
Just when it seems that the Mount Abe Eagles are losing, Tony arrives in time to pull off the dance he and Sage were working on before reconciling with his coach and winning the game.
Afterwards, the whole high school comes together to celebrate the Homecoming win, with Sage and Tony finally achieving their dreams.

64795221.title: Untamed Majesty: Chronicles of a U.S. Range Horse (2020 film)
synopsis: One stormy night amidst the rain-soaked wilderness of the Rockies, a spirited horse is born under the shadow of a towering pine tree.
Wrought with raw power and vitality, he is aptly christened 'Majesty.'
His birth, amplified by the backdrop of the tumultuous sky, takes on a grandeur that leaves the cadre of onlookers breathless and transfixed.

Majesty’s early years unfold as a vivid tapestry woven from playful tussles in the sun-drenched meadows, lengthy treks over rugged terrain with fellow foals, and wisdom imparted by the old mares and stallions.
These shared experiences foster a sense of community, establishing a rhythm accommodating both introspection and bonding.
Yet beneath the idyllic surface, danger lurks ominously in the form of a greedy, ruthless rancher from a neighboring town.
He is drawn by Majesty's charisma and strength, his greed compelling him to possess the wild herd which Majesty now leads.
Despite the rancher’s well-armed cowboys, attempt after attempt to capture Majesty’s herd fails.
Each close call amplifying the sense of looming danger and rousing a resilience in Majesty and his companions.
In stark contrast to her father's avaricious pursuit, stands Lily, the rancher's introspective and compassionate daughter.
Drawn to Majesty’s wild spirit and strength, an affinity grows within her, quietly challenging her home’s views.
A moment of heart-wrenching anguish unfurls when, in an ill-fated decision, Majesty unknowingly leads his family straight into a cleverly camouflaged corral trap set by the scheming rancher.

The cruel twist of fate lands Majesty's mother and several others of his kind in steel-barred captivity, sending ripples of tension through the narrative, and stirring a pot of debilitating guilt and regret in the previously jovacious leader.
From the once spirited, carefree horse, Majesty transforms into a tormented soul shackled with guilt, burdened by the task of surviving alone and making amends for his grievous misjudgment.

Just when despair threatens to consume him entirely, Majesty crosses paths with an old, almost mythical stallion living in quiet oblivion in the wilderness, holding within him the wisdom of countless winters.
This aged horse, in a transcendental exchange of wisdom and empathy, shares survival strategies and heartwarming advice with the desolate Majesty.
Simultaneously, unbeknownst to Majesty’s self-imposed exile and learning, Lily stumbles upon her father's nefarious plan to tame the wild herd.
Courage surges within the girl as she, through daring exploration and clandestine eavesdropping, unravels the sinister plot.
Revolted by the truth of her father’s deeds, Lily vows to dismantle his operation, and free the captive horses.
Her path begins to align with Majesty's, though she is oblivious of his wilderness training yet.

Mastering horse behavior and communication, Lily gradually conveys her plan to Majesty through cleverly crafted signs and precisely timed appearances at the corral, nurturing a silent pact with the majestic horse.

Concurrently, trained by the ancient stallion, Majesty emerges from solitude at an essential point in the narrative, muscularly transformed, guided by wisdom, and ready to confront the rancher’s tyranny.
Firm in his resolve to not only free his kin but every horse abused under the rancher's rule, Majesty’s comeback into the narrative carries the burgeoning hope of salvation.

In a moment where every second brims with urgency and sharp focus, Majesty and Lily, allies with a common mission, attempt to infiltrate the heavily guarded rancher’s compound under the cloak of night.
Taking a leaf from the lessons imparted by the old horse, Majesty initiates a calculated stampede that unfolds into orchestrated chaos, providing the ideal cover for the liberation of captive horses.

As the final horse is released into the sweet embrace of freedom, a joyous montage unfolds with horses reclaiming their place in the sun-kissed meadows, signaling a moment of victory against adversity.

Majesty reassumes his rightful place as the leader, guiding his rescued family past the once threatening boundaries of their world and into the untouched, liberating expanse of the towering mountains.
The trial by fire strengthens the unlikely bond between Lily and Majesty.
Lily’s perspective shifts, her love for the horses deepening into a newfound appreciation for the unfettered wilderness they represent.
Majesty too acknowledges Lily’s role in their shared victory, treating her as an honorary member of his family.
An unspoken understanding of their coexistence and dependency is formed, a testament to the delicate symbiosis nature stands for.
Lily promises to dedicate her life to protecting them from future harm, signaling a hopeful future for a harmonious understanding between humanity and the wild inhabitants of nature's realm.

60693824.title: Black Beauty (2020 film)
synopsis: A wild mustang narrates her life from birth, born free within the Onaqui Mountains of Utah.
She explains that her mother taught that when horses pass away, they fly into the sky to rest among the stars.
One day, the mustang accidentally draws the attention of some cowboys, who wrangle her entire herd; the mustang never sees her mother again.
A horse trainer named John Manly purchases the mustang and takes her to Birtwick, a horse sanctuary.
While she likes John, the mustang refuses to cooperate, but John remains patient.
The mustang ends up befriending two other horses named Ginger and Merrylegs.
John is informed that his sister and her husband died in a car accident, leaving him to care for his niece, Jo Green.
Jo wants nothing to do with John but becomes entranced with the difficult mustang.
Eventually, the mustang recognizes Jo's pain as similar to her own, and they end up connecting.
Jo learns to tame the mustang and names her Black Beauty, or Beauty for short.
John manages to get through to Jo by having her work in the stables and tend to Beauty on a regular basis.
They popularize the phrase "partnering" a horse as opposed to "breaking" a horse.
John informs Jo that they will eventually have to sell Beauty, but Jo refuses.

During a bond between her and Jo, the latter grieves over her family while a beauty narrates that she hated seeing her upset but since Jo was unable to gallop, she decided to give Jo a ride across the stable.
Upon riding on Beauty, she began to trust Jo which the other workers at the ranch noticed Jo riding on her, much to John's surprise.
In the slow-motion, Jo can feel the wind in her mane (which is her hair), it would help her to heal.
Jo smiles as she rode for the first time until she fall off and landed on haystack.
John comes to her aid, but Jo laughed and says it's amazing.
With that, John trained Jo to ride Beauty.
Afterwards, Jo rides to the beach with Beauty, where she spread out her arms and she and Beauty were one.
One night, a fire breaks out from a stable handler who didn't turn off a heater, and the horses are evacuated.

With Birtwick losing money, Jo is concerned that Beauty will be sold, but works out a deal with John's boss, Henry Gordon, so that she can work extra to earn the money to buy Beauty, though he states that they might lease her.
The upperclass Winthorp family who are migrants from England arrive to purchase horses for their estate with the daughter Georgina immediately choosing Beauty to be leased.
John manages to convince them to have Jo come along as her tenant.
At the Earlshall estate, Beauty learns that her friend Ginger was purchased for the Winthorp's son George, who unlike Georgina, is kind and takes an interest in Jo.
Georgina is cruel and rude to Beauty, who resists the urge to harm her as it would get her and Jo in trouble.
Jo discovers that Beauty has serious injuries and George tries to have Jo be closer with her, but his mother puts an end to it.
A race is held at a social gathering where Georgina's poor horse riding results in Beauty injuring one of her legs.
George stands up to his mother and the Winthorps choose to return Beauty.
However, John arrives to inform Jo that Birtwick is closing down and all the horses have to be sold.
Beauty is taken away without Jo getting a chance to say goodbye.
She becomes determined to find and buy her again.
Beauty is sold to a ranger named Terry and together they go on rescue missions in the wilderness.
Eventually Terry decides to retire and Beauty is given to a farmer who uses old tools, forcing her to work harder.
Then she is sold to a kind carriage driver in New York City whose daughter chooses to name her Lady.
One night, Beauty is reunited with Ginger, who had been sold without George's knowledge, but she dies shortly afterwards.
All this time, Beauty continues to think about Jo, who has not given up on finding her.
When Jerry gets sick, Beauty is sold to another carriage company, which treats its horses cruelly and engages in illegal horse trading.
While out driving, Beauty spots Ginger's body being taken away.
Heartbroken, Beauty sits on the road during her carriage rotation, which draws media attention.
The company attempts to sell Beauty, but a kind stable boy named Manuel alerts the police of the company's illegal activities.
Jo finds Beauty and reunites with her.
Jo reveals that she has managed to rebuild Birtwick in full and now works with John and George, now her husband, to help rehabilitate horses; she even finds that Merrylegs was also recovered.
Beauty lives with Jo happily ever after for the rest of her days.

28479462.title: Dark Jungle: Mystery
synopsis: The film opens with a stunning view of Seville, Spain.
Carlos and Raquel, more than being a couple, are two adrenaline junkies living in Spain, widely known for their passion for nerve-wracking, exhilarating adventures.
Their life together is marked by a thirst for unexplored territories and heart-pounding adventures.
Raquel visits a dusty bookstore, where a glossy guide book to the Amazon rainforest catches her attention.
Despite their families' pleas, Carlos and Raquel decide to chart a course into the Brazilian Amazon.
They land in a rural village where they meet their guide, Diego.
Diego advises them against wandering beyond the clearly marked trails, advice they ignore.
Drawn by the jungle's mesmerizing biodiversity, Carlos and Raquel detour to an awe-inspiring cavern.
Their exploration is abruptly interrupted by the appearance of a ferocious jaguar.
The jaguar attacks them, injuring Carlos and causing Raquel to fall and twist her ankle, leaving them stranded.
Realizing their predicament, Carlos ventures back into the jungle for aid, leaving Raquel alone.
Back at the village, Diego realizes their predicament and mounts a rescue mission.
Meanwhile, Carlos and Raquel encounter the jaguar again and manage a harrowing escape, only to end up deeper in the jungle.
Diego follows their trail, eventually finding the exhausted and frightened couple.
Diego engages in a chase with the menacing jaguar, ending in a showdown where Diego defeats the creature.
The trio sets off toward the village as dawn breaks.
Months later, Carlos and Raquel stroll along the sun-drenched plazas in Seville with newfound respect for Mother Nature and vow to incorporate wisdom and caution in their future adventures.
As the film concludes, the camera lingers on the jaguar's abandoned enclave signifying the enduring mysteries of the Amazon rainforest.

67608841.title: Black Water: Abyss
synopsis: Two Japanese tourists get lost in an Australian forest and fall into a remote cave, where they are ambushed and killed by an unknown creature.

Five enthusiast explorers; Cash (Anthony Sharpe), Eric (Luke Mitchell), Jen (Jessica McNamee), Victor (Benjamin Hoetjes) and Yolanda (Amali Golden) go to check out the cave that Cash previously discovered.
Cash brushes off a storm warning from the weather app and they continue on into the cave.
They follow a tunnel down to an open lake.
Unbeknownst to the group, it begins to rain and the cave begins to flood; soon, the path they came in through is submerged underwater.
They begin to look for a way out, but are unaware of the presence of the creature that killed the two Japanese tourists.
Victor sees something in the water and leaves the group to retrieve it.
He is attacked by the creature - revealed to be a massive saltwater crocodile - but survives with critical injures.
Cash and Eric leave to look for an exit while the others stay behind.
Swimming back underwater to the tunnel they came through, they reach the exit and find it blocked with rocks.
They decide to go back and look for another way.
Back in the cave, Victor starts having a severe asthma attack, forcing Yolanda to get in the water and retrieve his inhaler where she has a close encounter with the beast.
Eric's foot gets trapped between some rocks and he nearly drowns while Cash makes it back to the first tunnel, but is soon attacked by the beast and killed.
Eric reaches the tunnel only to see Cash's headlight in the water.
He returns to the group and informs them of Cash's death.
Jen notices a breeze and goes to investigate, finding a previously unseen passage in the cave.
Yolanda tells Victor that she is pregnant.
The water continues to rise, bringing the beast closer to the group.
Yolanda volunteers to go through the new tunnel to find a way out with Eric assisting her.
On the way, she tells Eric that she is pregnant and reveals that the baby is in fact his, and not Victor's.
The water back in the cave starts rising fast, forcing Jen and Victor to get to higher ground, even though it means going in the water.
They make it to a ledge, but the beast attacks, forcing them to go higher.
Yolanda and Eric fail to find an exit through the new tunnel, which is blocked by rocks and return to the group.
Jen looks through Yolanda's camera and finds pictures of Eric and Yolanda on a night out.
She sees a picture of the two looking lovingly at each other and gets upset.
She leaves Victor on the high ledge to get something in the water but she cannot reach it.
She decides to get into the water to get it.
The beast starts swimming towards her.
She panics and in her rush to get out of the water, she slips and knocks herself unconscious.
Victor leaves the ledge to help her, but the beast leaps out of the water and drags Victor in, killing him.
Jen races back up to the high ledge and cries.
She spots a light under the water just as Eric and Yolanda return to the cave.
Jen has to tell Yolanda that Victor has been killed.
Jen confronts Eric and Yolanda about their affair, and the two tell her that it was a mistake.
They also confirm that the baby is Eric's and not Victor's.
Once again, Jen notices the light and Eric realizes that water is getting sucked out through a tunnel and he believes it leads outside.
Yolanda doesn't want to go, but Jen says she would rather take her chances than sit in the cave and wait to die.
This convinces Yolanda to go.
They all get in the water and swim for the tunnel.
Soon enough, the beast starts swimming towards them.
Eric splashes the water to distract it while the girls escape.
The beast grabs Eric and kills him.
Swimming through the cave, Jen almost runs out of air but Yolanda grabs her arm and pulls her to safety.
They follow the tunnel and find that they are outside by the shore.
They climb up a hill and come to the road and find the car they came in.
Yolanda tries to apologize to Jen, but she doesn't want to hear it.
The girls drive down the road but a fallen tree forces Jen to swerve straight into the river and begins to sink.
When they realize they are in the same water they came out of, the beast reappears and starts attacking the side of the car.
Both girls make it out of the car and swim to shore but Yolanda can't swim quickly due to an ankle injury.
Jen makes it to shore and turns to see Yolanda being stalked by the beast.
She starts shooting at it, but it leaps out of the water and grabs her, dragging her under.
Jen manages to escape and it is revealed that she killed the beast.
They embrace and get out of the water to venture home.

33020046.title: Hooked: A Dark Pursuit (2022 film)
synopsis: David, a highly skilled computer programmer, is depicted laboring over a complicated cybersecurity program in his personal workspace.
To maintain his intense focus, he sporadically takes pills visibly labeled as Ritalin, highlighting his dependence on the medication to keep up with the demands of his profession.
Situated in Silicon Valley, David's 24/7 data center brims with cutting-edge computers, servers, and advanced technologies.
Through fragmented flashbacks that intersperse with the present, audiences are pulled into David's grim past.
Growing up in a rundown neighborhood in Detroit, prolific scenes of poverty, crime, and domestic abuse depict a childhood devoid of safety and stability.
The immense pressure of timely delivering the cybersecurity program, coupled with the haunting memories of his traumatic past, lead David down a dark path.
His reliance on Ritalin morphs into a full-fledged addiction.
David develops a deep resentment for the relentless pace of Silicon Valley, blaming his rising dependence on Ritalin to cope with the mental exhaustion it induces.
As the addiction intensifies, it starts to erode his familial relationships.
Concurrently, his stellar reputation at the data center begins to crumble.
Chasing a stronger high to dull his desolation, David drives across town to East Palo Alto to connect with Kilo, a fearsome and heavily tattooed drug dealer.
He watches in complete horror as Kilo casually executes another gang member, sparking a wild chase that tears through the decaying streets of East Palo Alto.
Returning home, still visibly shaken, David uses his formidable online research skills to investigate Kilo.
His findings reveal Kilo's deep-rooted connections with a powerful Mexican drug cartel.
Parallel to David's descent, audiences are introduced to Detective Laura Harlow of the San Francisco PD.
A gritty police officer burdened by personal traumas and working punishing graveyard shifts, she's handed the murder case that David witnessed.
Trapped between a rock and a hard place, David confides in his childhood friend, Sammy, about the crime he witnessed and his spiraling drug dependence.
Sammy, a former addict turned counselor at a San Jose rehab center called "A New Dawn", is David's only lifeline.
He catches David at a fragile point, encouraging him that sobriety may provide the mental fortitude required to traverse this dangerous labyrinth.
David takes a challenging step towards recovery by admitting himself into the rehab center.
As he wrestles with the harsh realities of coming clean, Detective Harlow successfully links David to the murder case through his vehicle's number plate captured on a surveillance camera.
She locates him at "A New Dawn", amidst the throes of withdrawal symptoms, gestures of support from fellow inhabitants, and confronting truths in group healing sessions.
While initially hesitant to cooperate with Harlow, he eventually agrees to help, crafting a daring plan to gather damning evidence against Kilo.
Despite painful withdrawal symptoms, David skillfully exploits his programming expertise to penetrate Kilo's encrypted communication network.
Armed with concrete evidence secured by David, Harlow orchestrates a high-risk SWAT raid on Kilo's fortress-like safe house.
During the climactic confrontation, the gravity of David’s sacrifices and Harlow’s unwavering bravery come under the ultimate test.
In the aftermath, David grapples with a tumultuous decision - to flee to Mexico, avoiding any potential consequences or to face his fears and testify against the feared Kilo.
Choosing assertion over fear, he presents the irrefutable evidence to the local District Attorney, leading to Kilo's arrest.
As chaos ensues, David forges a new identity, embarking on a life of anonymity.
The ensuing scenes capture David, now "Alex Cooper", forging a tranquil life in the serene ambiance of Astoria, a quaint town nestled in the Pacific Northwest.
An unexpected opportunity sees him mentoring young coding enthusiasts at a local Portland non-profit organization.
His teachings intertwine life lessons with coding skills, adding a nurturing aspect to his character.
Meanwhile, Harlow dives into therapy sessions, addressing her subconscious monsters.
Sammy, continuing to work at "A New Dawn", aids countless recovering addicts.
David's narrative advances in Portland’s emerging tech scene, now as Alex Cooper.
David fights his battles against triggers and temptations as part of his continuous recovery journey.
Amidst these struggles, David's dedication to recovery remains unflinching.
Harlow becomes a regular visitor to "A New Dawn", slowly healing her emotional scars while forming a strong bond with Sammy.
Sharing open conversations and empathetic moments with Sammy lay the foundation for a possible collaboration to help others battling different predicaments.
Driven by these experiences, she realizes the significance of mental health in tandem with her demanding police work.
Their transformation from victims to victors of their circumstances paints them as living testaments of unyielding strength.

70761006.title: Bluff (2022 film)
synopsis: The film starts with a junkie going to buy some drugs from a dealer.
It then flashes forward to the present to show that the junkie is actually an undercover police officer who is seeing a therapist.
It then flashes back even further into the past to show that the police officer is Detective Sergeant Daniel Miller.

Miller has just been suspended from the London Metropolitan Police so that his superior, Chief Constable Collins, can secretly assign him on a long-term undercover deployment in a small town to investigate drug trafficking organizations by posing as a heroin addict.
Miller begins his investigation by befriending and manipulating a local gullible junkie named Cooks.
The film flashes forward to show Miller and Cooks now successfully working for a dangerous drug dealer named Imran.
The film continues to flash forward and backwards in time from these two points of Miller’s investigation.
The past Miller continues to gain Cooks’s trust to get more information on Imran.
The future Miller continues to gain Imran’s trust to get more information on his drug operation with the help of Cooks who now also knows about Miller’s true identity.

In a desperate attempt to make some progress in his investigation, past Miller pretends to be suffering from withdrawal because he can no longer afford to buy drugs and Cooks takes the bait and agrees to work for Imran with him.

Future Miller has a close encounter with a rival gang member who tries to rob him at knifepoint but Miller manages to fight him off and save the drugs which impresses Imran who brings Miller closer to his inner circle.
Past Miller and Cooks make a daring attempt to contact Imran but they are intercepted by his enforcer Neil.
They are taken to a remote building where Imran waits to interrogate them but against all odds, Cooks manages to convince Imran to let them both work for him.

Past Miller and Cooks are making such good progress selling drugs for Imran that they get an apartment to operate out of and are given an even bigger batch of drugs to sell but Cooks is starting to get high more often now.
Future Miller overhears Imran talking to Neil about going away on business, Miller speculates this must be to meet his supplier and decides to follow Imran.
Past Miller discovers that their latest batch of drugs was stolen when Cooks got high and passed out in the apartment.
Imran and Neil arrive at the apartment and threaten to kill both of them but Cooks takes all the blame.
At the same time, future Miller follows Imran to find him meeting with another senior police officer which means Imran was a protected informant for the police all along.
Past Miller is forced to watch Cooks inject a lethal dose of fentanyl to which we discover that Cooks was dead all along and future Miller had been hallucinating him the whole time.
Future Miller meets with Collins who wants to shut down the investigation as there is nothing they can do about Imran if he is a protected informant but Miller refuses to let Cooks death be in vain.
Miller confronts Imran and kills him.
We flash forward to the present where Miller is seeing the therapist, despite killing Imran, Miller’s hallucinations of Cooks have not stopped.
Realizing he will never be free of his guilt, Miller decides to inject himself with a lethal dose of fentanyl.
Cooks watches Miller as he sticks the syringe full of fentanyl in his vein.
Cooks grabs Miller’s arm to stop him but when Miller looks up, Cooks is nowhere to be seen.
Miller looks back down at the syringe in his hand, unsure whether to inject himself or not.

59959261.title: Surveillance Badge (film)
synopsis: Nestled comfortably amidst the lush, rolling landscapes of Ohio, the quaint town of Middleton was a sight to behold.
Within this calm, Officer Jack Reynolds, an adept law enforcer with years of experience, stood vigilant, his steel-gray eyes scanning the picturesque surroundings.
Among the blush of normalcy, a jade-colored Dodge Grand Caravan stood out starkly, bereft of the mandated registration stickers.
Jack's instinctual alarm flared, prompting him to investigate what appeared to be a routine traffic violation but promising potential hidden layers of intrigue.
The man at the wheel introduced himself as Stanley, his fingers jittering slightly as he presented a driver's license that looked suspiciously outdated for the current times.
The discrepancy did not filter past Jack, fuelling his suspicions further.
Only a few days following this incident, the tranquil peace of Middleton began showing cracks.
Residents exhibited signs of fear, unfamiliar symbols cropped up on building walls, all hinting at a connection to Stanley's recent arrival - a puzzle demanding Jack's expertise in putting together.
Bringing his concerns to his superiors at the police headquarters resulted in dismissive laughter and gentle ribbing towards his supposed active imagination.
Despite their lack of support, Jack couldn't simply brush off the brewing danger his instinct was warning him about.
Choosing to act on his alert intuition rather than give ear to skeptical colleagues, Jack delved deeper into Stanley's background.
To his horror, he uncovered a significant fact.
Stanley was an ex-convict with a history intertwined with occult practices - facts that startled Jack and set off alarm bells in his mind.
Immersed in his off-duty detective work, Jack did not realize that Stanley was watching him.
That oversight led to a dangerous confrontation in a gloom-ridden alleyway, landing Jack with a few nasty bruises and a larger, more potent determination.
Despite his physical injuries, Jack's determination only strengthened.
He was certain the disaster threatening Middleton had roots in Stanley's arrival, and he was hell-bent on averting it.
Decidedly alone in his defense of Middleton, Jack took on the role of a secret guardian, tracking Stanley's movements under the cover of the night, determined to catch him in the act.

This dedication eventually led him to a shocking discovery - a concealed underground bunker filled with multiple surveillance monitors, grotesque dolls, and cryptic symbols suggested of dark, mystic practices.
The grisly sight confronted Jack's senses, making him recoil in sheer dread.
But it also proved his suspicions, confirming Stanley's link to the town's disturbing happenings and the abductions.
Armed with this new evidence, he forced a meeting with the Middleton Police Chief, laying out all he had uncovered.
His persistence finally paid off as the skepticism was replaced with alarm, setting off a flurry of action within the department.
Stanley, however, had been alerted anonymously of his impending exposure, which initiated a deadly race against time to complete his horrifying plan.
The tranquility of Middleton was shattered, replaced with a desperate and chaotic manhunt.
Jack, unwilling to comply with the police's standard protocol, determinedly chose to face Stanley mano a mano.
His seasoned instincts pointed towards an isolated, abandoned lumber mill—the perfect setting for Stanley's unnerving ritual.
Jack infiltrated the mill, its vast echoey an ominous stage.
He arrived right as Stanley was preparing to commence the hideous ritual.
The sight of the children, bound and gagged, sent a wave of righteous fury through him, elevating the stakes at hand.
The confrontation that followed was a high-stakes face-off between Jack and Stanley.
In the ensuing struggle, Stanley managed to precariously initiate the ritual.
Racing against time, Jack successfully sabotaged the devilish alter, neutralizing the imminent catastrophe Stanley had planned.
Despite the injuries that racked his body, Jack pulled through the ordeal.
His relentless grit had finally neutralized the faceless horror to Middleton's serenity.
Recovering in the veteran hospital of Middleton, Jack basked in the newfound respect from his colleagues, who now saw him as the town's unsung hero.
At the heart of the rejoicing, Jack reminded his fellow officers of the symbolic importance of their badges - an enduring commitment to shield their community from threats obscure and conspicuous.

Jack, in his ever-modest demeanor, dismissed any heroic tag, highlighting the shared responsibility among all law enforcers to remain vigilant, always ready to face incognito threats lurking in their idyllic neighborhoods.
Jack played a vital role in reuniting the rescued children with their euphoric families.
His relentless pursuit of justice had once more reinstated a sense of safety in the heart of Middleton, reaffirming the town's faith in the law.

58531212.title: Body Cam (film)
synopsis: In Swinton, Louisiana, police officer Kevin Ganning pulls over a green van for not having a license plate.
Ganning demands the driver to leave their vehicle.
When Ganning notices a bloody rag, he aggressively demands the driver to exit the vehicle.
When Ganning points his gun at the driver, an unknown entity pulls him away.
12 hours earlier, Officer Renee Lomito-Smith is being cleared to return to active duty after an altercation with a civilian and is paired with rookie Danny Holledge.
They get a call from dispatch where officer Ganning is "failing to respond."
Officers Lomito-Smith and Holledge go to investigate Ganning's last known location.
Lomito-Smith finds the dash-cam footage in the police car, where she witnesses Ganning's beating from an unknown entity.
They soon find Ganning's lifeless body hanging and call it in.
Sergeant Kesper tells them the footage has been destroyed, long before Lomito-Smith and Holledge had arrived.
Lomito-Smith soon gets a lead, when she recognizes the logo of a hospital from the driver's pants.
She is then able to get the identity and home address of the driver; Taneesha Branz.
She and Holledge arrive at Taneesha's home and discover it has been abandoned.
While checking the home, they find a photo of Taneesha and her son.
Holledge leaves quickly when he becomes too scared because of roaches.
Officer Lomito-Smith is unable to find anything and leaves.
As she goes to exit, she finds that it is locked and as she tries to get out, she realizes the entity is watching her.
As if it is intending to kill her, Renee breaks the window on the door.
Lomito-Smith investigates Taneesha; she discovers her son Demarco was killed in a gang shoot out.
Taneesha shops in a grocery’s store late at night where she is immediately harassed by two men in-store.
Officers Roberts and Birke spot the green van, calling for backup.
Lomito-Smith and Holledge answer the call for help and change their route to provide assistance to Roberts and Birke.
Birke and Roberts enter the store and question the two men aggressively, despite neither man showing any hostility towards the officers.
One of the men shoots and kills Birke as he takes Taneesha hostage.
As he threatens to kill Taneesha, the entity suddenly lifts him into the air, freeing Taneesha.
He fires his gun attempting to escape; accidentally killing the store clerk as well as his partner.
Taneesha slips out through the back exit during the commotion.
Roberts investigates the shooter's last location, only for his bloodied body to fall onto the floor from above.
He attempts to warn Roberts the entity is behind him (as he cannot speak).
The entity attempts to suffocate Roberts with a bag, and when the attempt fails, it lifts him into the air and kills him off-screen.
The bloodied man dies from his injuries.
Officers Lomito-Smith and Holledge arrive at the store, and find everyone dead.
Lomito-Smith investigates in the rear parts of the store, finding no one.
She discovers the security camera footage is unusable.
When she goes back into the store, she finds the phone belonging to one of the men and steals it hoping to find a lead.
After returning to the station, she visits the medical examiner to get details about the victims.
The medical examiner explains how the body is damaged in the most unusual way but points out victims had their teeth knocked out.
Lomito-Smith pleads with the medical examiner to give her five minutes alone with the bodies.
He agrees, but tells her she cannot steal anything or disrupt the bodies.
She pulls out the phone that she found at the store, unlocking it with the thumbprint of one of the two men.
Later that evening, she reviews the video from the phone, noticing the entity behind Taneesha and the man holding her hostage.
Lomito-Smith gets a lead on the origin of the green van, where it was reported stolen.
She heads to an unnamed church and questions the Pastor, deducing the van was never stolen.
The Pastor explains Taneesha's son, Demarco, was deaf and avid volunteer to many organizations.
When Lomito-Smith asks where Taneesha could be, the Pastor gives a possible location.
She only finds articles of Demarco's death alongside photos of Officers Ganning, Roberts, Holledge, and Penda.
Officer Lomito-Smith sees a camera watching her.
She tries to call Sergeant Kesper, but he does not pick up.
She then calls Holledge and says she needs to talk to him face-to-face.
He agrees that she can come over in one hour.
Renee goes to Danny's house and discovers he has committed suicide.
The grief-stricken Renee finds a note left on the sink, "I'm sorry, Danny", along with a flash drive.
Renee inserts the flash drive into her computer.
It reveals Holledge's body cam footage of himself and officers Ganning, Roberts, and Penda during a police stop.
It shows where they are yelling at a young man to stop walking under the assumption he is a suspect.
Penda shoots him when the young man refuses to stop.
Roberts hands the cell phone to Penda and goes the young man's backpack.
Penda realizes the young man was Demarco, Taneesha's deaf son.
Officer Holledge points out his teeth came out, but Penda tells Holledge how bad this situation is.
Penda suffocates Demarco.
Lomito-Smith calls Sergeant Kesper.
She meets him at a warehouse and tells him what the four officers did to Demarco.
Kesper pulls his gun on Renee and tells her the incident best left covered and it will do more harm than good.
As she walks inside the building at gun point, Officer Penda emerges from his car and follows behind them.
Penda demands Renee to hand over the footage.
When she refuses, Penda shoots into her Kevlar vest.
Taneesha appears and speaks to Penda, "YOU KILLED MY SON, DEMARCO.
YOU REMEMBER HIM?
BECAUSE HE REMEMBERS YOU."
The entity is revealed as Demarco's vengeful spirit, who beats up Sergeant Kesper and knocks his teeth out.
Renee and Taneesha escape to another part of the warehouse with Penda in pursuit.
Demarco's spirit finally takes his revenge; removing Penda's innards from his body and impaling him onto a large pipe.
As Renee readies herself to confront Demarco, Taneesha reveals he will not harm her.
Emergency services arrive to the scene.
Renee and Taneesha see both of their sons together, signifying they have now found peace and can move on.
Kesper, who survived Demarco's attack, is sent to prison.

60471270.title: Searing Edge (2023 film)
synopsis: Drenched in the glow of morning sun, the kitchen of a quaint Parisian restaurant bloomed to life as Matthew Smith, a celebrated Michelin-star chef, directed his team of skilled sous-chefs with an effortless authority.

It was mesmerising watching him transform unassuming ingredients like sun-ripened tomatoes and fresh basil into culinary symphonies with a level of dedication that was evident in every carefully measured slice and innovative garnish he created.

Unfolding stories from Matthew's past unearthed a troubled youth where he found solace and a sense of purpose in the encompassing heat of a bustling diner kitchen, amidst the rhythmic chorus of sizzling pans and ringing knives.

As he confidently steered his workspace, his world was interrupted by a surprise visitor, Eveline Deschamps, a formidable Michelin food critic known for her trademark diamond-shaped glasses, who breezily stepped into his revered establishment, Le Cordon Bleu.
Her icy aura sent shockwaves through the kitchen staff, yet Matthew remained composed as he served Eveline his pièce de résistance – a deconstructed version of the traditional Ratatouille.
The harmony was abruptly broken when an overseas phone call from his family in the USA relayed the disturbing news that his sister Sarah's fight with breast cancer had taken a grim turn.
News of Sarah's deteriorating health, stirred up a whirlpool of suppressed, guilt-ridden memories.
Matthew made a pivotal decision - to relinquish the glamour and prestige of Paris, and steer towards his humble, tranquil Midwestern beginnings.
He tendered his resignation at Le Cordon Bleu, pledging allegiance to a new purpose - to provide for his sister in her fading days and make up for the time he had shied away from two decades earlier.

His return to the unassuming rusticity of his birthplace, St. Louis, Missouri, felt unfamiliar, a stark contrast from the effervescent charm and rapid pace of the Parisian streets he had come to call home.

His encounters with acquaintances from his past and reconnection with his family grew into a series of awkward conversations surrounding his successful stint in Paris; and the undercurrent tension between him and his estranged sister, Sarah, was alarmingly evident.
Amid his tumultuous homecoming, Matthew found solace in a local eatery, Becky's Diner, the very place where he first fell in love with the chaos and passion of a professional kitchen.
In Sarah's adolescent daughter Emily, Matthew found a keen protégé who lit up at the thought of baking, a shared passion helping them connect.
As they crafted cookies and engaged in warm conversations by the fireside, Matthew was reminded of the time he spent with his mentor, Chef Jean-Pierre.
He rediscovered the comforting powers of cooking.
In the opportunity to prepare a special therapeutic meal for his ill sister, Matthew revealed a purpose he did not know was missing, serving as a beacon of light during his time of sorrow.

As he initiated Emily into the intricate world of gourmet cooking, he fondly recalled tales of Chef Jean-Pierre, the man who wove lessons of healing emotional wounds with food, bolstering his bond with Emily.
Inspired by Emily's unwavering optimism despite the heart-wrenching predicament, Matthew decided to organize a charity gala in honor of Sarah, with an aim to raise funds for cancer research.
Sadly, not long after the charity gala, Sarah lost her battle with cancer, leaving young Emily under Matthew's guardianship.
Matthew, grieving yet resolved, embraced his new role as Emily’s surrogate father, a familiar face amid unfamiliar circumstances.
In dealing with the loss of his dear sister, Matthew found a revived purpose in St. Louis and decided to remain there, comforted by the nostalgia of his childhood place.
He breathed new life into Becky's Diner, rechristening it 'Searing Edge', and welcoming Emily as his budding apprentice, marking the beginning of their shared culinary adventure.
The narrative draws to a close with Matthew contemplating on the lessons imparted by Chef Jean-Pierre about the sentimental power of food and its significance in his journey.
The concluding scenes unveil Matthew and Emily jovially operating the thriving Searing Edge, preserving Sarah’s legacy with an added layer of hope and unity.
Their bond, moulded under adverse circumstances, transformed into a symbol of resiliency, forming the backbone of the diner's triumph.
The small Midwestern town, originally divided, united in their newfound appreciation for Parisian cuisine and the spirit of community.
The story, streaked with trials and tribulations, concludes on an uplifting note, enjoying the palette of redemption and community solidarity.

69019040.title: Boiling Point (2021 film)
synopsis: Andy Jones is Head Chef of Jones & Sons, an upmarket restaurant in London.

Andy is embarrassed to learn that his restaurant has been downgraded from a 5 star Health and Safety rating to 3 stars following an inspection, mostly due to insufficient administration and subpar sanitation at each work station.

After the inspector leaves, Andy reprimands the kitchen staff for their lack of thoroughness, though backtracks when he learns that the turbot that he had prepared earlier was discarded by the inspector for not being labelled.
Front of house manager Beth holds a short meeting to discuss the evening's service being overbooked.
She also mentions that they have a marriage proposal on one table and a booking for celebrity chef Alastair Skye, for whom Andy previously worked, plus his guest for the evening, a known food critic.
During dinner service, conflict begins to brew in the kitchen and dining room.

Beth annoys the kitchen staff with micro-management; a black waitress is treated with hostility by an aggressive guest (in contrast to her white colleague); a young pastry chef (Jamie) is revealed to be self-harming; a pregnant kitchen porter spars with a lazy and disrespectful co-worker; and the new cold chef Camille, who is from France, struggles with the language barrier and British regional accents.
Tension grows until Beth demands the already-stressed chef Carly go off-menu by preparing steak and chips to appease a group of "influencer" guests.
Carly finally blows up at her when a dish of lamb is returned for being supposedly undercooked.
Carly blames Beth for not properly instructing her staff to explain that the lamb is properly cooked.
She tells her that she is failing the restaurant with her lack of ability.
Beth retreats to the toilets in tears, admitting to her father on the phone that she does not think the job is right for her.
Andy serves Alastair's table, where Alastair reveals that Andy owes him £200,000 and wants the payment in full to cover his private losses.
Andy explains that he does not have the money to pay him back.
Alastair offers to work together with Andy again and proposes that he should get a 70% share of the restaurant, leaving Andy and his other investors with just the remaining 30% to share between them.
A guest suffers a severe allergic reaction, which Camille had inadvertently caused.
Taking advantage of the situation, Alastair informs Andy that Carly should take the fall or else the restaurant as well as their potential partnership will fail.
After the guest is picked up by an ambulance, the kitchen staff and Beth meet at the back of kitchen to determine the cause.
They conclude that it was Andy's fault the food was contaminated.
Earlier, he had instructed Camille to use a bottle containing walnut oil as a substitute garnish.
This culminates in one of the chefs, Freeman, lambasting Andy for his constant lateness and mistakes as well as his rampant alcoholism.
A fight nearly breaks out between Andy and Freeman, which Carly prevents.
The staff return to work and Andy then reveals to Carly that Alastair wanted him to lay the blame on her, which leads to Carly quitting.
Andy goes to his office, where he drinks vodka and snorts cocaine.
He calls his ex-wife, and asks her to tell his son he loves him, and that he will go to rehab.
After ending the call, Andy throws away the drugs and alcohol and starts to return to the kitchen before collapsing.
The staff's voices are heard calling his name.

8252031.title: Time Warp Soldier
synopsis: The opening credits roll as Roy Pulver, a grizzled and withdrawn yet athletic figure who once served as an elite Delta Force soldier, navigates the bustling cityscape of Atlanta, Georgia.
His life after retirement has led him to lead a rather quiet, monotonous existence in the heart of the metropolis.
Each day, punctuated by solitary routines, involves him jogging along the winding paths of Centennial Olympic Park, lost in his own thoughts.
One particular evening, bathed in the faint city lights, Roy is accosted by a disheveled vagrant.
The man stumbles towards Roy near a haunting, dimly-lit alleyway, uttering something incomprehensible yet alarmingly cryptic about a "time loop" before dissolving back into the sprawling crowd.
Dismissing the encounter as a bizarre run-in with an inept lunatic, Roy quickly brushes off the incident and continues his grocery shopping.
But the following morning, a foreboding sense of déjà vu greets Roy.
To his profound astonishment, the neon green digits on his digital bedside clock display the exact same date as yesterday, turning his typical morning into an inexplicable quandary.
Choosing to experiment with this inexplicable phenomenon, Roy modifies certain elements of his routine.
Yet, no matter what he alters, the day's chain of events unfolds in an eerily familiar manner.
On the morning of his third chronological encounter with the same day, Roy decides to test the limits of his bewildering predicament.
With each day, Roy grows increasingly intrigued yet alarmed by his abnormal ability to move across this repetitive time field.
As the mystery surrounding his circumstances continues to unravel, Roy becomes determined to figure out why he's trapped in this never-ending cycle.
During a leisurely stop at the bustling Dancing Goats Coffee Bar, a Tedx Talk broadcast on the café's enormous TV sparks his curiosity.
The speaker, Katherine, a renowned theoretical physicist, is eloquently discussing the possibilities and quirks of time, jolting Roy's attention to the TV screen.
Seized by a newfound hope, he resolves to seek out Katherine, convinced that her in-depth knowledge of time and its eccentricities may hold the key to his puzzling circumstance.
Initially, Katherine dismisses Roy as another crackpot, unable to fathom his incredible claims.
However, he manages to pique her interest by accurately predicting a mishap involving a clumsy waiter and a large tray full of steaming coffees, as well as the subsequent sequence of events.
Strengthening his stance, Roy manages to save Katherine from an impending accident involving a rogue signboard at a local construction site, solidifying his claim of being entrapped in a time loop.
Katherine, a scientist through and through, is eventually won over by the sheer improbability of Roy's existence and agrees to explore the scientific aspects of his temporal anomaly.

Through their intensive research and discussion sessions, they stumble upon the root cause of Roy’s failed escape from the cycle, a secretive organization known only as “The Fates.” Upon investigating further, Roy realizes that this covert syndicate, labeled The Fates, is conducting illicit activities, exploiting time for personal gain.

A deeper probe into the syndicate reveals that The Fates were indulging in experimental procedures, which inadvertently led to the faulty creation of the unstable time-hopping technology that entrapped Roy in his recurring nightmare.

To Roy’s sheer horror, he discovers an added detail - The Fates, emboldened by their control over time, plan to use this hazardous technology on a larger scale, to manipulate global events to their advantage.
As the loop persists, Roy uses his knowledge of the recurring events to infiltrate The Fates' highly fortified facility.

Moving quickly and prudently through the maze-like infrastructure, he manages to locate and deactivate the time-warping machine, thus causing a significant blow to The Fates' plan to dominate the world.
Battling against the seemingly insurmountable odds, Roy successfully overcomes the deadly squad, making a stealthy getaway, leaving The Fates in disarray and their plan in ruins.
The day following the thwarted plan, Roy awakens, hoping to embrace the dawn of a new day.
However, to his dismay, he discovers that he is still shackled to the binding chains of the temporal cycle.
Full of dread, fearing that all his heroic efforts might have been in vain, Roy hastens to Katherine's high-rise apartment near the Georgia Institute of Technology to discuss the recent developments.

In the meantime, unbeknownst to Roy, Katherine, utilizing the complex data retrieved from The Fates' base, been keenly studying the time-distorting mechanism to devise a solution that could potentially break the time loop.

Working tirelessly, fueled by determination and copious amounts of coffee, Katherine experiments with various principles of theoretical physics, initiating the creation of a counter-device to break the time loop's constraints.
After ample brainstorming and countless failed attempts, the day they had been anticipating finally arrives.
They proceed with the activation of the newly assembled counter-device, a small yet immensely powerful gadget, in Katherine's cluttered home-based laboratory.
A moment of high suspense ensues.
Upon regaining consciousness, Roy experiences a rush of indescribable relief as he finds that the perpetual cycle has finally been broken.
The single day he had been desiring to see has finally arrived.
Unbelievably, Roy had single-handedly dismantled a criminal empire that could have potentially exploited time to change the course of history.
From their initial encounters where they were skeptical of each other's claims, Roy and Katherine evolve into trustful allies, continuously investigating the mysteries of time together.

With Roy's strategic expertise, honed by years spent navigating battlefields, and Katherine’s ground-breaking scientific breakthroughs, they form an unparalleled team, ready to guard against temporal anomalies.
Overlooking the tranquil city from their lab, Roy and Katherine sit side by side, basking in the glow of their accomplishment, silently reveled in the soft morning light.
As a new day dawns and the golden rays of the sun illuminate the cityscape, Roy and Katherine share a peaceful moment, welcoming the first day of their new journey.
As the movie draws to a close, the scene captures the tranquility of the pair, their relentless dedication, and profound respect for their newfound mission.

56960461.title: Boss Level
synopsis: Roy Pulver, a retired Delta Force soldier in Atlanta, has been stuck in a time loop, and has learned the day's patterns through many previous loops.
He wakes at 07:00 AM each day, avoids an assassin in his apartment and an attack by a gunman in a helicopter outside his window, then escapes his apartment before it explodes.
He has been able to elude more assassins throughout the morning, but finds himself unable to figure out how to survive a final attack at 12:47 PM, waking up back in his apartment on the next loop.
On the day before Roy entered the loop, his estranged wife Jemma had asked Roy to visit her at defense contractor Dynow Labs under the pretense of a job interview.
The two argue over Joe, their son, whom Jemma has led to believe that Roy is just a family friend.
When Colonel Clive Ventor, head of Dynow, discovers Roy near Jemma's highly classified project, he has him escorted out, but not before Jemma obtains a sample of Roy's hair.
In one loop, Roy tries to call Jemma but instead reaches Ventor, who tells him that Jemma died from a lab accident the day before.
Roy becomes suspicious.
On a later loop, he finds Joe at Underground Atlanta, skipping school for a video game tournament.
Roy spends the day with Joe but does not mention Jemma's death.
The assassins arrive to kill Roy, and Roy uses his body to protect Joe, telling him as he dies that he is his father.
When Roy next wakes, he realizes that the assassins had followed him using a dental tracking device implanted by Alice, his date from the night before (a dental hygienist).
Through more trial-and-error loops, Roy finds a way to remove the tracker and sneak into Dynow, killing several guards and assassins, but is always stopped by Ventor and the sword wielding Guan Yin.
Ventor reveals to Roy that Jemma's project is the Osiris Spindle, a quantum device capable of rewriting history, which Ventor plans to use to set himself up as the world's dictator.
Ventor admits he was responsible for Jemma's death after an argument the night before.
As she had started the Spindle and no one else knows how to operate it, Ventor warns Roy the Spindle will destroy the world if it runs too long.
On further loops, Roy makes the connection to the Egyptian god of the afterlife, Osiris, and he realizes that Jemma must have placed him in the Spindle to stop Ventor.
While he is able to further infiltrate Dynow and kill Ventor after learning sword fighting, Roy learns the assassins were sent to kill Joe, and arrives too late.
As he mourns over Joe, the Osiris Spindle explodes and destroys the world.
Roy spends several loops in a despondent state, then decides to spend several more loops with Joe, staying with him until the Spindle's explosion.
In one loop, he learns that Jemma had called Joe that morning, later than he previously thought she was still alive, and realizes he can save her.

After determining the exact time and place she died at Ventor's hands in Dynow, fourteen minutes after he wakes up, Roy uses the next loop to hijack the helicopter, get to Dynow, kill the waiting assassins, and stop Ventor before he kills Jemma.
Roy tells Jemma he has been spending his loops with Joe, and that he has seen the end of the world.
Jemma tells Roy that he has to enter the Osiris Spindle in order to reset it, and that he would wake up and repeat the day once more but if he died he would stay dead.
Roy kisses Jemma before entering the spindle as Jemma looks on in awe.
Roy reawakens back in bed and tells himself not to die as the attacks begin.
The international release ends as he enters the Spindle.
No mention is made of having to repeat the day.

1761984.title: Urgent Missive
synopsis: Anna Reed, an accomplished author in the thrilling world of suspense novels, reclines comfortably in her sumptuous mahogany chair.

Without prior warning or request, a frigid gust of air sways the velvet curtains as an unmarked envelope, crisp as freshly fallen snow and white as a brewing storm, trespasses the quiet serenity of her space, slipping quietly under her polished walnut door, intruding upon her profound concentration.
With curiosity gnawing at her, she succumbs to the distraction, peeling open the envelope.
The parchment within unfolds to reveal a vast array of cryptic runes, an elaborate cipher devised and used only by Anna and Cynthia–her estranged sister–during their radical childhood escapades.
The pungent urgency penned in the mesmerizing symbols overwhelms her rational thoughts, compelling her to abandon her rapidly progressing writing endeavour.
Anna places all her creative energies on the back-burner, prioritizing the desperate plea hidden within her sister's encoded message, despite the bitter aftertaste of a feud distorted by time.
Intertwined within Anna's impulsive decision to reconnect with Cynthia, vivid flashes of their shared history come sweeping back.
Adrenaline-fuelled, they form a haunting chronicle of a tragic accident leading to Cynthia’s debilitating injuries that permanently shattered their tight-knit sibling bond.

Pursuing the trail of the enigmatic message, Anna embarks on a mystifying journey towards Cynthia's last known haunt–a town ominously enveloped within the windswept moorlands, far removed from urban living, evoking an unsettling ambiance.
She navigates her way through a labyrinth of eccentric and unorthodox townsfolk.
Their guarded responses and cryptic gazes conceal a multitude of suppressed tales.
Concealed meticulously behind their carefully crafted polite smiles, a veil of uncertainty hits Anna.

As the destructive tension amplifies and peaks, old fragments of Cynthia begin to emerge from the recesses of Anna’s mind, further revealing her sister's enigmatic personality and deeply buried secrets.
These escalating revelations force Anna to reconsider her preconceived perceptions about her sister, painting Cynthia in a brighter, yet all the more mysterious, light.
Propelled by a sudden radiance of hope, Anna stumbles onto an ancient oak box concealed beneath a frayed loose floorboard in Cynthia’s deserted lodge.

As she starts unraveling the entangled intricacies of the plot, Anna effectively steps into Cynthia's hazard-laden path, inadvertently transforming into the next target in a relentless, unforgiving hunt.

Despite the paralyzing fear and the ever-present menace, Anna calls upon the wealth of expertise painstakingly garnered over the years as a renowned thriller author to outmaneuver and outsmart the predator at her heels.
As the plot reaches heightened levels of intensity, Anna locates the frigid, decrepit warehouse where Cynthia, tormented and isolated, is held captive by the shadowy adversaries.
With her heart pounding a fierce rhythm against her rib cage, she decisively concocts a daring rescue plan.
Employing her strategic mindset and honed survival instincts, she prepares to encounter the lurking adversaries and save her sister.
After successfully liberating Cynthia from her captors, Anna and Cynthia stand face-to-face amidst debris and raw emotion.
Forced to confront their past, the unspoken resentment and unresolved issues become tangible between them.

Trudging through the painful remnants of their past, they embark on a new shared journey, involving a hidden promise to allow old grievances to dissipate and a quest to rebuild a bridge towards a healthier future relationship.
With the damning amount of evidence gathered during her perilous adventure, Anna seeks out the assistance of the initially skeptical, but later swayed, local sheriff.
Ensuing events lead to the swift incarceration of the town's vicious gentry, connecting them to the convoluted conspiracy and Cynthia’s abduction.
As the icy grip of winter gradually transitions into the warmth of spring, the sisters seek solace within each other while nursing their severely fractured relationship.
Drawing from her harrowing experiences and overwhelming emotions, Anna channels her trauma to the pages of a fresh manuscript.
An engaging narrative unfolds, rooted in their real-life saga, effectively merging her reality with her fiction seamlessly.
The narrative concludes on an encouraging note, spotlighting the resilient bond between the sisters.
Their newfound ability to forgive, to grow and to hope transforms them, leaving behind only the faint echo of their haunting past.

69685587.title: Brazen (film)
synopsis: Well-known murder mystery novelist Grace Miller gets an urgent message from her sister Kathleen, who she hasn't seen for five years, to come help her.
Literally catching the first flight available, she arrives very quickly.

They haven't talked about why she'd left her rich and powerful husband Jonathan Breezewood, and Kathleen is living in their childhood home in Washington D.C. She'd wanted a divorce from the misogynist, but he refused and her pill addiction prevented her from taking their young son Kevin.
Now clean, she's teaching high school English and drama and needs Grace's support in her fight for full custody.
As the sisters co-own the house, Kathleen asks to mortgage her half.
And she vaguely mentions she's looking into other things.
When pressed, Kathleen talks of blackmail.
Homicide Detective Ed Jennings has a week off, so he's renovating his house, where he's Kathleen's next door neighbor.
Ed and Grace meet and instantly connect.
They meet up, she with the excuse of consulting with him for a story idea.
Heading back next door to Kathleen's, Grace finds her lifeless body.
Ed hurries over and helps the other police in the investigation, and lets Grace stay with him that night.
After searching the house, they discover that Kathleen had been working as a dominatrix for the website Fantasy Inc.
Collecting her things from the house the next day, Grace goes over the details she'd observed with Ed, and he likewise answers some of her questions.
Detective Jennings and his partner Ben learn that Kathleen's performer name was Desiree and she had many clients.
As the company is small and family-run, access to the performers' info is limited.
Visiting Kathleen's school, a few students express their condolescences to Grace.
She collects her things, finding the papers she'd planned to use against her husband.
Outside the school Jerald Baxter, son of a senator, asks Grace what she knows about Kathleen's death, but she doesn't say.
He tells her he'd overheard janitor Billy Sachs upset her one day.

Grace approaches Billy, and he admits he'd discovered Kathleen was Desiree at his cousin Richie's, the webcam technician for Fantasy Inc. Another performer is killed, the body laid out similarly to Desiree's.
This body was discovered as she was killed during a recorded session, and her client had called 911.
Now they consider it to be a serial killing.
Grace approaches Jonathan, who insists he has a solid alibi.
He also knew of her side job, and refers to her as a hooker, so she punches him.
Grace tells him not to come to the funeral, but he disregards her.
She confronts him there, and is observed by students.
Jerald takes a moment by the casket.
Reading the cards sent with the flowers, one is addressed to Desiree.
Grace approaches Captain Rivera, showing her the card and offering her services for the investigation.
Citing help she gave to the NYPD which ended a case they'd worked on for months solved three days after she'd joined them, she offers herself as an asset.
After Grace makes a few concise observations, the captain takes her on as a consultant.
Another performer is attacked, but this time she cuts the attacker, who gets away.
She describes him as a tall white teen and his watch in detail.
Returning to student Rand's house, they find a watch fitting the description, he has an injury on his arm and his size matches.
He's taken in, but his blood type doesn't match.
After Grace speaks to Billy again, he admits Rand and Richie are a couple, although he is still closeted.
That night Grace and Ed act on their attraction.
At the next morning's debriefing, after Ben reports Rand's legit alibis, Grace proposes baiting the killer by posing as Desiree.
In the meantime, after wrestling practise Jerald beats Rand severely after he says he was obsessed with Kathleen.
The MPDC shuts down Grace's sting operation as they have enough evidence on Jerald.
While they are at the Baxters' to arrest him, having abandoned the sting operation, Grace faces him alone.
She secretly leaves the computer on live feed and Jerald confesses to all, even a plot to kill his own mother.
When Grace tells him his confession was recorded, the enraged teen goes ahead with trying to strangle her.
Ed comes in and shoots the armed Jerald dead.
Grace and Ed celebrate their victory enjoying tea and each other.

36222790.title: Exodus: The Journey to Terra Nova
synopsis: Earth, a planet once suitable for life, is now on the brink of destruction, brought about by the detrimental effects of global warming and rising sea levels.
In response to this, the mysteriously discreet agency known as Colonization Space Systems (CSS) concocts a remarkably drastic plan they name Project Exodus.
The radical plan revolves around an enormously engineered interstellar spaceship termed ‘Refuge’.
This spaceship is designed to form a sanctuary for a chosen fraction of Earth's populace, and take them to a seemingly life-supporting planet, Terra Nova.
Among the chosen people for this adventurous endeavor is our protagonist, Dr. Laura Wilson.
She is an accomplished astrophysicist known for her significant scientific contributions to discovering and understanding exoplanets.

Within the bustling ambiance of Refuge's launch bay, Dr. Laura acquaints herself with the diverse group of survivors; this includes fellow scientists, engineers, influential politicians, distinguished artists and other vital figureheads who will stand by her side during the voyage to Terra Nova.
As they venture forth on their survival mission, the dread of their unknown future, limited resources and sustainability challenges aboard Refuge initiate a wave of anxiety amongst the travelers.
After a few months spent hurdling through space, a sequence of alarming technical failures begins to emerge.
The normally reliable communication systems become erratic, and the life support systems show worrying signs of falter, causing significant distress.
Strangely unnerving sounds combined with unexpected sightings of shadowy figures slowly creep into play, progressively building an atmosphere of dread and mistrust amongst the survivors.
The situation takes a terrifying turn when an alien entity from within the deep parts of the spaceship surfaces, hunting down and viciously killing crew members in isolation.
This bizarre, relentless, predatory creature casts a shadow of fear within the Refuge's confines, transforming the spacecraft from a beacon of survival into a horrifying killing field.
Instead of succumbing to fear, Dr. Laura displays great courage.
She uncovers classified CSS documents that expose a shocking revelation - Terra Nova has previously been earmarked for possibly housing dangerous alien life forms.
This grave disclosure shatters the hope amongst the crew, shaking their sanity as they grapple with the horrific idea that their lifesaving mission could be sabotaged.
The alien entity intensifies its brutal onslaught, further reducing the crew members and leading to a severe collapse in morale.

Realizing the exigency of their terrifying situation, Laura gathers the brave fighters among the survivors with a plan to trap and kill the alien predator using their limited but functional nuclear warheads.
This daring operation sets in motion an adrenaline-fueled frenzy of risky decisions and high-stake maneuvers, throwing Laura and her team into critical situations.

Amidst their strategic deliberations, Laura stumbles upon more classified CSS files but these contain a sinister secret - the real objective of Project Exodus was a twisted experiment with a potential alien biological entity for warfare purposes.
This chilling revelation sours their faith in the survival mission, replacing it with a deep sense of betrayal and anger against the very agency they trusted to save them.
An engineer named Jack, whom Laura has come to trust implicitly, steps up for the incredibly hazardous task of baiting and ultimately trapping the antagonistic alien entity.
As the countdown to detonate the nuclear warhead begins, all available escape routes are sealed off, escalating the tension within the eerily silent corridors of Refuge.
A disturbingly violent jerk rattles through the spaceship when the warhead detonates, immersing Refuge into a near-complete blackout.
In the aftermath, the survivors wait anxiously in the suffocating darkness, praying for the life support systems to kick back in, while steeling themselves for the worst.
When the emergency lights finally flicker back on, they illuminate a horrific sight - the disfigured, lifeless carcass of their once terrifying alien nemesis.
Summoning her inner strength and leadership, Laura steps up to take charge of the remaining survivors, resolved to accomplish their primary mission.
The battle-weary but undeterred ship, Refuge, pushes through the void space towards Terra Nova, its inhabitants now highly alert and doubtful of what lies ahead.
After many tense days of journeying, a verdant Terra Nova finally appears within their view.
While the lush green landscapes and clear water bodies may seem ironically tranquil compared to their recent ordeal, the crew remains skeptical.

The sight of Terra Nova rouses a mix of emotions among the survivors - a sigh of relief for having survived their perilous journey, hope towards a promising fresh start, and an underlying apprehension about hidden threats.
The ominous warning about hostile life on Terra Nova continues to reverberate, casting a shadow of discomfort among the survivors as they approach this unexplored paradise.
Laura, also carrying these apprehensions, is pinning her hopes on this new beginning.
However, she keeps the traumatic memories of their journey fresh, as a reminder of possibilities and to prepare for an unknown future.
As Refuge embarks on its slow descent towards Terra Nova, the survivors steel themselves, ready to face any element of surprise and to pen down the next part of their tale of survival.

63235565.title: Breach (2020 film)
synopsis: Earth is suffering an extinction level event, and 300,000 survivors are selected to board a spaceship called the Ark which will take them to a new colony called New Earth.
Noah stows away on the Ark impersonating a junior janitor while his girlfriend Hayley, who is pregnant with his child is put into stasis as a passenger.
A grizzled older janitor named Clay attempts to mentor Noah.
Blue and Shady, two experienced crew members, are infected by a parasitic force.
Meanwhile, Noah spies on Clay and suspects the older man is constructing a bomb.
Clay shows Noah that he is brewing moonshine.
That evening the workers have an impromptu party where they talk about the loved ones they left behind.
Noah tells everyone he will be reassigned to be a butcher when they reach New Earth.
Ortega leaves the party to hook up with Blue and finds him welding alone.
Blue turns on Ortega, killing her.
Later Clay discovers that Noah's girlfriend is Admiral Adams' daughter.
Security officer Stanley discovers Shady's decomposed body and identifies Blue as the killer.
Clay finds Ortega's body; Stanley gathers a security detail and they find Blue attempting to break into the admiral's quarters.
Blue suddenly leaps and kills one of the security team by biting through the officer's throat.
Stanley and Teek are forced to shoot Blue.
Chambers performs an autopsy on Blue's body.
Teek meanwhile searches the video feed and sees a recording of Shady's death and Blue's initial infection.
Chambers reports that Blue is completely hollowed out and there is a parasite loose on the ship.
Chambers discovers that Noah is not a member of the crew but a stowaway and Stanley arrests him.
Clay defends Noah successfully and he is released.
While the survivors discuss next steps, the three dead crewmen reanimate and attack, killing Stanley.
Chambers manages to injure the remaining infected for Teek, Clay, and Noah to escape.
The newly infected Stanley starts to release the infected and unlocks the remaining crew's quarters who are quickly taken over and infected.
Clay guides the survivors to the arsenal.
Chambers is unable to pinpoint a weakness in the infected so Clay suggests using a flame thrower.
The flame thrower sets off the fire suppression unit which ruins visibility.
Lincoln reunites with the group just as Teek is suddenly grabbed by the infected and pulled into the mist.
Clay runs off to rescue Teek.
As Teek and Clay return, Lincoln suggests using the escape pods while Teek proposes the security bay.
Lincoln flees by himself in an escape pod, but is shown not to be alone and killed offscreen.
The remaining survivors get to the security bay but Stanley nabs Clay as they try and lock themselves in.
Noah shoots Stanley before he can infect Clay and they barricade the door.
With 84 days until the Ark reaches New Earth the survivors try to concoct a plan to fend off the infected and save the passengers.
Clay guides Noah through ducts to the Admiral, who they hope will be able to rescue them.

Noah reaches the Admiral and Teek confesses to Clay and Chambers that he is responsible for everything that has transpired, and is in reality a hardline revolutionary against the repopulation of New Earth.
The Admiral awakens his security team and proposes to use stronger weapons against the infected.
As the infected break into the security room, Clay and Chambers fight them off while Teek is killed.
The Admiral's security team are overwhelmed; Blue chases Noah, and collapses after being splashed with cleaning fluid.
As Noah attempts to relay his finding, the Admiral sacrifices himself by setting off a grenade, blowing the infected apart.
Just as Chambers and Clay think it's over, the remaining body parts start to reconnect.
A stronger mutant being is formed, and the other infected enter the reactor core.
Noah explains the effect of the cleaning fluid, and the group head to Clay's moonshine stash to construct better weapons.
As they plan their attack, the time to arrival starts to decrease as the infected overheating the reactor.

Chambers realizes that the parasite was manipulating them all along to allow them to gain access to the reactor core while Noah realizes that the parasite's plan is to wipe out the last 50 million of the human race on New Earth while wiping out the passengers at the same time with the ship.
The passengers begin to turn infected.
Clay sends Noah to rescue Hayley and they make their way towards an escape pod just as the mutant being attacks.
Chambers is killed in the alien's first attack, and Clay attempts to hold it off but he too is overwhelmed and seemingly killed.
Noah and Hayley make for the remaining escape pod, but Noah has to separate from Hayley to start the launch sequence.
He confronts the monster and manages to weaken it with his weapon.
Just as Noah attempts to leave, Clay messages him from the bridge.
Clay sets the Ark to self-destruct as Noah escapes with Hayley.
Noah and Hayley reach New Earth, but as they emerge from the escape pod Noah spots another human who turns out to be infected, and in the distance a huge monster is attacked by a jet fighter.
As the film ends Noah raises his gun and utters "Burn 'em all".

36328695.title: Dudes (film)
synopsis: Our protagonist, Samuel Kingston, is a charismatic morning radio host sweeping the airwaves in the lively Windy City of Chicago.

Samuel leads a glamorous lifestyle laced with star-studded galas, his stunningly successful morning radio program, "Sunrise with Samuel," and a self-imposed solitude, a testament to his unwavering fear of romantic commitments.
