Bass orders Blink to "walk the plank" by exposing his penis to a caged raccoon, but Junior uses a dog whistle to call his Rottweiler.
The dog attacks Bass as the trio fight his henchmen.
Bass kills the dog and prepares to shoot Blink but is out of ammunition and the trio escape.
Meanwhile, Detective Lucinda Valencia is assigned to investigate the casino robbery.
The trio stay at the home of Blink's hermit father, Lawrence.
Blink suggests they ask crime lord, The Saint, for help.
Det.
Valencia meets with the corrupt Det.
Courtney who offers her little assistance but she soon learns that Bass set the group up as he has inside connections to the casino.
Meanwhile, Demyra is threatened by Bass, and so she meets with Alderman Jackson Symms, whose wife she provided hospice services for, and he agrees to help.
He meets with Det.
Courtney and asks him to deliver the information and a payment to The Saint.
Det.
Valencia meets with Blink after finding his bloody clothing and a poker chip.
However, she has a change of heart after learning the reality of the situation from Symms.
Blink, Miracle, and Junior rob local businesses in an attempt to make quick cash and attract the attention of The Saint.
They are successful but Lawrence finds their money and forces the group to leave.
They visit a strip club where they flash their earnings and are taken prisoner by Det.
Courtney and his men.
They are delivered to The Saint who is impressed with the trio and allows them to live in exchange for cash.
They return to the Ninth Ward and Det.
Valencia concludes her investigation, urging Blink to pursue his artistic dreams instead of a life of crime.
Symms and The Saint meet to discuss the situation.
Soon after, Bass presents himself to The Saint who shoots him in the head.
Some time later, the trio continue to find themselves in poverty.
Blink proposes they rob a FEMA office but the robbery goes wrong when Miracle kills a security guard.
The police swarm the building and all three men are seemingly killed in the ensuing firefight.
However, Blink is revealed to have survived and shown at the publishing of his graphic novel where Valencia congratulates him and he thanks her for giving him a second chance.
During the ending credits, Symms meets with Courtney at the grave of Andre where he shoots him dead and appoints Miracle as the new overseer of the Lower Ninth.

51635982.title: Webcast: Reverb (Thriller Film)
synopsis: Jane Smith, a remarkable pianist with a fondness for both classical and contemporary pop fusion, discovers her true calling in creating a live music webcast.
On this platform, she showcases bursts of creativity on her cherished baby grand piano and engages with fans about her unique approach to crafting melodic narratives.

Jane quickly grows a strong following of passionate viewers ranging from every corner of the world, drawn in by her trademark smile, her thoughtful authenticity, and her avant-garde utilization of real-time comments and fan-instigated song suggestions, which she ingeniously incorporates into her evolving compositions.
However, an ominous unseen entity with malevolent intentions latches onto her progressively popular webcast.

Unbeknownst to Jane and her growing audience, this malevolent force uses her vibrant music stream as a bridge from the otherworldly to our reality, nesting within the limitless labyrinth of the Internet.
Soon enough, as Jane's fanbase swells and her online persona becomes a musical sensation, she starts receiving odd comments during her audience-interaction live-chat sessions.
These peculiar messages, disguised as intricate riddles and perplexing puzzles, begin to shape her performances in unforeseen ways.
Among these mysterious messages often comes from an eerie user named 'Diabolic12', a user whose cryptic influence starts steering her exuberant melodies to take on a darker, more ominous tone.
Jane, immersed in her artistic process, is none the wiser to the subtle manipulation of her music.
Simultaneously, the fans who downloaded Jane's chillingly transformed compositions begin to experience hair-raising incidents.
Screens spontaneously flicker, phones crash without explanation, and several even feel an unseen chilling touch against their skin, turning their comfortable living spaces into a house of haunts.
As the unsettling incidents grow more frequent, Jane herself becomes a target.
She begins to question her sanity as she experiences terrifying hallucinations involving menacing figures and hushed shadowy whispers, driving a wedge into her previously joyous creative process.
Driven by the eerie happenings surrounding her music and urged by her innate curiosity, Jane embarks on a tireless investigation into this bizarre phenomenon.
She dedicates long, nocturnal hours in the dimly lit local library, unearthing dusty old folklore that points towards something unnerving.
Jane comes across an ancient legend about a banished demon by the name of Zephyros, yearning to return to the mortal realm, following millennium-long banishment.
The chill down her spine deepens as she realizes that her music webcast seems to be the digital bridge Zephyros exploited to infiltrate into the human world.

Every piano riff that Jane tenderly develops, and every lyric she pours her heart into, unknowingly serves as an eerie chant in this digital era, further bolstering Zephyros's power in the earthly realm.
The revelation forces Jane to make a difficult decision: to abandon her passion or continue, risking her followers.
It takes days of agonizing deliberation for Jane to arrive at a decision.
Despite her profound sadness at the prospect of discontinuing her webcast, she resolves to confront the situation head-on.
Damning the risks, she uses her platform to alert her audience about the looming threat of Zephyros.
Her dedicated viewers, realizing the severity of the situation, begin getting creative.
They combine their collective wisdom, pool resources, and strategize on ways to combat Zephyros.

Zephyros cruelly morphs Jane’s inspiring melodies into abhorrent soundscapes that reverberate like tortured wails from damned souls, using distortions, screams, and excessive reverb to corrupt her music.
Yet, Jane and her viewers remain resolute, united in their determination.
They resolve to use Zephyros’ own influence against it by integrating the demon's haunting incantations into their original musical compositions.
Their aim is to dilute its power by distorting the very incantations the demon relies on, in the hope of sending it back where it belongs.

As the noble struggle intensifies, Jane's platform becomes the battleground for an unprecedented confrontation of sound and will, as they pit their unity and resolve against the horrifying might of Zephyrosism.

The viewers attempt to counterbalance the gruesome melodies of Zephyros with a powerful composition of their own – a beautiful sonic tapestry imbued with courage, hope, and an unyielding determination to reclaim control over their lives from the encroaching demon.

The collective composition, filled with sheer survival instinct and a defiant spirit, eventually dwindles the malevolent influence of Zephyros, creating an impenetrable force-field against the demon’s intrusion.
Defeated and trapped in its digital prison once more, Zephyros is unable to harness Jane's melodic compositions for its benefit any longer.
A visibly depleted but unbowed Jane re-emerges on her platform, reassuring her viewers that despite the harrowing ordeal, her spirit remains unbroken.
Jane earnestly pledges to continue her exploration of music, promising an added focus on supernatural safety rules to safeguard her audience.

68801790.title: Dashcam (horror film)
synopsis: Annie Hardy, an American musician and conservative conspiracy theorist, livestreams from her car, creating music using comments from the live chat as lyrics.
Tired of pandemic restrictions and homelessness in Los Angeles, she flies to London to visit her friend and former bandmate, Stretch, a food delivery driver.
Stretch’s girlfriend, Gemma, clashes with Annie over politics and COVID-19.
Annie accompanies Stretch on a delivery job, antagonizing restaurant owners with her anti-mask views.
Returning home, Annie refuses to remove her MAGA hat, prompting Gemma to attack her.
Overhearing Gemma urging Stretch to kick her out, Annie steals Stretch’s car and phone and takes a delivery job for him.
She arrives at a closed restaurant, but the owner offers her money to transport an elderly woman, Angela, to an address.
Angela soils herself, forcing them to stop at a diner where Annie discovers an Ariana Grande tattoo on Angela’s stomach.
A woman enters, looking for Angela, and attacks Annie, who flees the diner with Angela.
Stretch tracks Annie down via the livestream and forces his way into the car.
They argue and pull over, and Angela vanishes.
Stretch finds her standing atop a tree in a nearby forest, falls trying to reach her, and Angela floats to the ground.
The woman from the diner returns with a shotgun and attempts to kill Annie and Stretch, who escape in the car with Angela.
They learn that Angela's mouth is stapled shut from under her mask.
Annie and Stretch attempt to flag down a passing car, which hits Stretch.
The driver is the woman from the diner, who reveals she is Angela’s mother, revealing that Angela is actually sixteen and shows a photo of her with the same tattoo.
Annie tries to drive away in the mother’s car but crashes and is attacked.
With Stretch’s help, Annie traps the mother’s arm in the steering wheel and snaps it.
Angela appears, rips her mother’s head off, and pursues Annie and Stretch.
Angela chases Annie and Stretch to an abandoned amusement park.
There, Angela kills Stretch.
Annie escapes in a car, but Angela causes her to crash.
Angela pushes the car into a lake with her powers, but Annie traps Angela in the car and escapes.
Annie finds a remote house and realizes it’s the destination she was supposed to take Angela.
Inside the house, Annie finds occult symbols and cult members who kill themselves.
Angela attacks Annie, but Annie kills her with a knife.
A creature emerges from Angela’s mouth and chases Annie.
Annie kills the creature with her keyboard.
She then collapses in Stretch’s car and starts a livestream where she raps about her experiences.

35601150.title: Petite Bliss: Protector of Sharks
synopsis: The tale unfolds on the peaceful island of Petite Bliss, a blooming paradise in the middle of the Pacific.
We first meet Dr. Lillian Harper, the daughter hell-bent on preserving the island's tranquility.
She's a dedicated marine biologist with an extraordinary fondness for the great white sharks or Carcharodon carcharias.
We see her against the backdrop of the turquoise lagoon, appearing in complete harmony with her surroundings.
Interwoven with scenes of the serene island, we catch glimpses of the high-end underwater laboratory where Dr. Harper spends her days and nights.
It's clandestinely submerged, hidden beneath the azure beauty of the sea where Dr. Harper conducts her revolutionary marine studies.
However, not all's well in this peaceful paradise.
The soothing rhythm of Petite Bliss gets disturbed when Dr. Harper observes strange changes in the sharks' behavior patterns.
An unforeseen aggression replaces their usual placidity as they show signs of becoming a threat to the marine biodiversity of the island.
The sharks, known for their benign demeanor around Petite Bliss, begin to transform.
They exhibit unprecedented hostility and suffer from puzzling physical changes, leading to questions about what was causing such anomalies.
Enter the antagonist Vince Van Doren, a suave, yet egotistical real estate mogul, with plans to turn Petite Bliss into a bustling commercial hub.
Van Doren's eyes are gleaming with the prospect of turning Petite Bliss into an expensive resort.
His grand vision overlooks the hard work and devotion of Dr. Harper.
He is unaffected by her pleas and efforts to conserve the very heart of the island.
Driven by her deep-rooted concerns for the marine life, Dr. Harper strives to stop Van Doren's commercial invasion.
She warns him about the great white sharks' volatile behavior, but her warnings fall on deaf ears as Van Doren presses on with his self-centric ambitions.
Van Doren's aggressive construction work reverberates across the island, unsettling the marine life.
A series of horrifying shark attacks soon begin, underlining Harper's warning and proving the detrimental impact on the once serene environment.
The once gentle great white sharks turn into terrifying predators, attacking construction workers causing significant alarm and fear to ripple across Petite Bliss.
Van Doren brushes these incidents as mutations rather than accepting the hard truth - his greed is causing this looming catastrophe.
Some natives of the island, admitting the palpable threat, come around.
They start believing in Harper's concern about the environmental ramifications of the rapid construction.
The truth, when it comes to light, is spine-chilling.
The sharks displaying unprecedented aggression have fallen prey to Dr. Harper's experimental genetic therapy.
Overwhelmed by guilt, Dr. Harper takes it upon herself to rectify her creation and restore equilibrium to Petite Bliss, which runs the risk of becoming an ecological disaster zone.
Using her extensive knowledge of marine genetics, cutting-edge technology, and the ecosystem of Petite Bliss, Dr. Harper carefully formulates a solution to reverse the havoc wreaked on the sharks.
The daringly ambitious mission: to neutralize the forced genetic mutation in the great white sharks and restore their original, peaceful temperament.
The climax is a maelstrom of emotions.

Bravely stepping into the havoc-infested waters of the Pacific, Dr. Harper risks her life, attempting to administer her newly-developed antidote to the mutated sharks by diving deep into the hostile territory.

Seeing the disturbance as an opportunity to serve his vested interests, Van Doren stealthily schemes to disrupt Dr. Harper's rescue mission, preparing to resume his extravagant project, unbeknownst to the deadly turn of events awaiting him.
His encounter with the genetically altered sharks turns into a horrifying disaster, where Van Doren experiences first-hand the consequences of his environmental insensitivity.
Staring face-to-face with the gruesome creatures, Van Doren finally realizes the harm his unchecked ambitions have done to Petite Bliss' marine ecosystem.
Amidst all the chaos, Dr. Harper conducts her daring underwater rescue operation.
Despite the relentless raging waters, she manages to inject the antidote, pacifying the enraged predatory beasts.
Slowly, calmness begins to wash over the island as the sharks return to their original docile nature, inducing a sigh of relief for all inhabitants.
Unable to proceed with his extravagant dream without further endangering the island's peace, Van Doren grudgingly steps down from his destructive plans.
Driven by the events, Dr. Harper channels her efforts into researching ways to preserve and protect the marine life in its original form without any scientific contamination.
The United Nations heard about the incident that nearly resulted in a disaster and recognizes Petite Bliss as a marine-protected zone permanently, solidifying its status as an ecological sanctuary.

63907886.title: Deep Blue Sea 3
synopsis: Dr. Emma Collins continues the work of her deceased father on the protection of great white sharks on an artificial island near South Africa named Little Happy.
Her team includes Spinnaker (nicknamed "Spinn"), Miya, and Eugene Shaw, Emma's father's best friend and brother figure.
Also living on Little Happy are Emma's friends Nandi and her brother Bahari.

Bella, a bull shark who was responsible for the chaos in the past years, is found dead, having been killed after getting stuck in fishing lines, discovered by Dr. Richard Lowell and his team on their boat, the Thasos.
They go to Little Happy to find the three last pups of Bella are now adults, and are the only survivors from the litter.
Richard is revealed to be Emma's ex-boyfriend.
When Richard and his team dive to chase the bull sharks, Emma goes with them and discovers three great white sharks devoured by the bull sharks.
Soon after, Brown (a member of Richard's team) is found dead, having been sliced in half by the bull sharks.
With Emma's help, one of the biggest bull sharks is sedated and captured but Richard is injured.
Later, Bahari goes fishing but is attacked and devoured by one of the two remaining bulls.
Nandi later discovers his severed arm.
After the loss of her friend, Emma confronts Richard.
He reveals to her that these bull sharks are more intelligent, telling the events of the first two movies.
He says that with the beacon which was attached to their mother, he can attract her offspring as they know that their mother is dead.
He concludes in saying that if these sharks reproduce, it will be a catastrophe.
Lucas, leader of the mercenaries of Genotic Labs, overthrows Richard's command and decides to kill everyone and flee with the captured shark.
They place a mine to blow everything up, unaware that Emma and her team is spying on them with an underwater drone.
Emma confronts Richard again, accusing him of planning to murder them.
Lucas, having overheard their conversation, attacks them and Emma's team, causing massive damage to nearby structures on the island with explosives.
During the battle, Emma escapes, but Richard is captured by Schill and Earls, Lucas's men, and brought to the Thasos.
After choosing Emma's side, Richard is killed by one of the sharks as he jumps from the boat to join her.
Earls is killed by a bull shark while he fights with Shaw.
Meanwhile, Spinn is killed by a bull shark and Miya is presumed to suffer the same fate.
Emma deactivates the mine but is attacked by Schill, who has been instructed by Lucas to kill her.
She is saved by Sally, the great white shark, "friend" of Emma since her arrival on Little Happy, who devours Schill.
Emma places the mine on the Thasos and when Lucas explodes it, his boat sinks which frees the captured shark.
Shaw sacrifices himself to kill two of the three bull sharks with explosive darts.
Lucas, having survived the recent explosion, attacks Emma, but is killed by her and Nandi.
Emma then kills the last bull shark by luring it into the garbage compactor.
Nandi and Emma flee, leaving Little Happy destroyed, with Sally addressing a goodbye to Emma before disappearing into the ocean.
While Nandi and Emma navigate, they find a wardrobe and Miya is revealed alive, having hidden inside it.
Reunited, the three friends go back to civilization.

16657006.title: From Paris with Blood (2020 film)
synopsis: Our tale unravels in the pulsating heart of Paris, within a whimsically charming attic lodged amidst the city's dramatic landscape, above the spirited, never-sleeping streets.
Here, Ivan, a battle-hardened Russian assassin, converted into a silent specter by years of shadowy endeavors, marks the movements of Marcel, a notorious French mobster, from his secluded perch.

Through high-powered, military-grade binoculars, Ivan scrutinizes Marcel's predictable comings and goings in a lively café along the eclectic Rue de Rivoli, absorbing the ready rhythm of his quarry's life in his icy gaze.
On a day the sharp, biting Parisian autumn chill infiltrates every crevice of the cityscape, Ivan sets his plan in motion.
With chilling precision he stages Marcel's demise to mirror an accidental death, artfully orchestrating a chandelier's fall upon the unsuspecting gangster.

As Marcel's life force severs abruptly, his corpse crashing onto a quaint café table, pandemonium engulfs the café but Ivan, ever the phantom, dissolves seamlessly into the Parisian throng, merging into an unsuspecting cluster of wide-eyed tourists.
However, his meticulously planned escape is tainted by a gnawing sensation, a dormant animalistic instinct awakened within Ivan, signaling an unseen trap woven into the fabric of his departure.
An undercurrent of peril threatening to rupture his impromptu equanimity, Ivan swiftly forgoes Paris, seeking shelter within the metal belly of an inconspicuous Russian bound cargo ship.

Arriving in the remote hinterlands of Russia, Ivan finds sanctuary in a nondescript cabin hidden amidst the sprawling, unspoiled outskirts of Moscow, skillfully covering his tracks to shrug off any retaliatory pursuit.
Back in France, our story migrates to the historical Pere Lachaise Cemetery.
Louis, Marcel's estranged brother, broods over a gravesite hardly adorned except for a solitary, anemic white rose.
A deep, bone-chilling proclamation of reprisal seethes from the recesses of Louis's grief, resonating through the silence of the towering mausoleums walling him.
Thirsty for vengeance, Louis tracks down Pierre, a former cohort from Marcel's notorious gang.
Pierre fills Louis's ears with tales of Ivan's distinct scar and the unnerving chill of his gaze.
Grasping at this new-found knowledge, the face of his brother's executioner firmly etched in his mind, Louis embarks on a merciless manhunt stretching gracefully across the European landscape.
His relentless search brings Louis to Moscow, where he stumbles upon Nadia, Ivan’s unsuspected paramour, twirling with exquisite grace on the grand stage of the famed Bolshoi ballet.
Tension piques, as Louis, in a sadistic twist of fate, abducts Nadia during an entrancing performance, intending to use her as bait to lure Ivan out of hiding.
A blood-curdling package, bearing a blood-soaked ballet slipper and a one-way ticket to Paris, finds its way to Ivan's remote Russian abode, tucked away under a thick blanket of snow.
Accustomed to silent threats, Ivan recognizes the package's gruesome contents as a clear challenge.
His blood boils into adrenaline as his guarded patience crumbles, replaced by a fierce resolve to rescue his beloved Nadia.

Determined on saving Nadia from her grim predicament, Ivan retraces his path back to Paris, treading familiar arrondissements with uncanny ease, rallying old allies, and bracing himself against unknown foes.

Ivan convinces Pierre, a retired French intelligence officer turned detective-for-hire, to join his mission and together they weave an intricate web of intelligence centered around Louis and his operations.

As Ivan infiltrates Louis’ stronghold, the Parisian nights blend into a whirl of adrenaline-fuelled car chases and covert missions, transforming the city into an exhilarating battlefield of cat and mouse.
Every successful breach into Louis’s territory brings Ivan a step closer to Nadia’s undisclosed location: a fortified fortress tucked inconspicuously into an unsuspecting corner of Montmartre.
Upon the unforeseen discovery and liberation of Nadia, a heated crossfire ensues, resulting in a grievous gunshot wound to Ivan's left shoulder.
Bereft of options, Ivan engineers a desperate final showdown with Louis amidst the metallic skeleton of an abandoned construction site near La Defense.
Even in his grave state, bleeding heavily, Ivan's tactical mind converts the decayed site into a dangerous war zone, fashioning lethal traps from disregarded construction waste.
The climactic fight between Ivan and Louis whips into a violent dance of power and wits, a deadly clash of quicksilver advances and evasive maneuvers.
In a deadly power-play, Ivan seizes a golden opportunity and overpowers Louis, pushing him over the precipice of a steel beam to his downfall.
Securing Nadia's safety stokes Ivan’s dormant emotional attachment for her, prompting him to surrender his life shrouded in shadows and blood-laced violence.
The screen fills with the poignant vision of Ivan and Nadia slowly walking away from Paris’s twinkling skyline, toward an unfamiliar future of peace and blossoming love.
A sudden post-credit scene shatters the serenity, hinting at unresolved plots and new threats.
We are transported into a sleek office lit with artificial intelligence housed in an unnamed skyscraper standing tall in an unidentified location.
An enigmatic figure studies a collage of photographs.
The figure's gloved hand carefully replaces Ivan's photograph with a fresh dossier - Ivan's face frozen in a familiarly icy mien.

The figure’s steady but deliberate inspection of the dossier, separated by seven terrifyingly suspenseful seconds, likely foretells Ivan's past won't stay buried for long, threatening to undermine his newfound peace.

64632777.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2020 film)
synopsis: Hitman In-nam has completed an assignment in Japan, killing a Japanese mobster Koraeda.
In Thailand, Young-joo sends her daughter Yoo-min to school, and tells her that a babysitter will fetch her after school, as she meets up with real estate agents for an investment in a golf course.
Later, as Yoo-min gets down from the school bus, the babysitter takes her to her husband's car and drives away, instead of going home.
Realising that Yoo-min went missing, Young-joo reports to the police, and contacts Chun-sung to get In-nam for help, which In-nam rejects.
The next morning, In-nam receives a message from Chun-sung that Young-joo is dead.
Flashback to 8 years ago, it was known that In-nam was part of the National Intelligence Agency, with Chun-sung being his superior, and that Young-joo and In-nam were lovers.
In-nam was instructed to leave Korea without her in order to protect her.
Present day, In-nam travels to Incheon to see Young-joo's body, and subsequently discovers that Yoo-min is his child.
After visiting Chun-sung for answers, In-nam receives a call from Shimida that Ray, Koraeda's estranged younger brother, is seeking revenge on the ones involved in the murder of Koraeda.
Ray subsequently kills Shimida, then flies to Incheon and kills Chun-sung, and finds out that In-nam is headed to Thailand to find the kidnapped Yoo-min.
He follows suit.
In Bangkok, In-nam meets Young-bae.
The latter briefs about a real estate agent Jong-su, who Young-joo met before her death, who is a fraudster and has set up the kidnapping of Yoo-min.
In-nam finds Jong-su and gets information, then leaves him to die.
Meanwhile, Ray kills a gang that lied to him about having captured the babysitter.
In-nam finds the babysitter's home, and tortures both her and her husband to get information about Yoo-min.
Young-bae introduces Yui, a transgender woman, to In-nam for assistance.
In-nam and Yui head to a building, then realise that it is a child trafficking operation meant for organ transplants.
The two then know that Yoo-min already left the building for Lang Yao, Ratchaburi Province to do a heart transplant surgery.
Ray arrives in the building, and finally meets In-nam and they fight, with In-nam eventually escaping.
Yui and one child from the building also escaped, but are arrested by the police.
That night, police raided the building, which belongs to Thai criminal organisation Chaopo.
Chaopo's boss Lan instructs his men to kill In-nam and Yui.
In-nam leaves for Lang Yao.
Meanwhile, Yui tells the police that In-nam has gone to Lang Yao.
In Lang Yao, In-nam sees Yoo-min being taken away from a football factory for surgery.
In-nam gives chase, but Ray intercepts to kill him.
The police arrived, and shoot both of them.
In-nam escapes from the gunfire, kills the surgeons involved before surgery and takes Yoo-min away.
Chaopo's operations in Lang Yao are subsequently busted.
At night, Ray storms into Lan's home and asks for help to get In-nam.
Ray then visits and kills Young-bae.
The next day, In-nam and Yoo-min check in to a hotel, and then he heads out to secure an escape route for the two.
Returning to the hotel, he gets ambushed by Chaopo's men.
As he kills his way back to the room, Ray and several Chaopo's men are already inside and Yoo-min is kept in a luggage.
Ray kills a few of Chaopo's men, having changed his mind, and tells the remaining men to bring In-nam somewhere else and wait for him, as he plans to settle Yoo-min first.
In the car park, Yui sees In-nam being taken into a van, then rams the van with her pickup, and frees him.
In-nam gives chase and barges into Ray's car and fights.
He detonates a grenade, causing serious injuries to both of them.
In-nam frees Yoo-min, when Yui arrives and he tells her to take Yoo-min and run away.
He gets brutally stabbed by Ray, but then detonates another grenade inside, killing both.
In-nam left a bag of cash and documents in a locker, which Yui unlocks.
He hoped that she will take Yoo-min to Panama in his place in case he gets killed.
Yui and Yoo-min then left for Panama and settle down there.
A photo frame in the Panama house shows a photo of In-nam and a photo of Young-joo and Yoo-min side by side.

23318093.title: Disconnected Hearts (2021 film)
synopsis: Sarah, a willowy woman with sharp blue eyes, carried an aura of melancholy around her.
Her mother, Elizabeth, vanished one day without leaving the slightest trace of her departure.
Four months had passed since that fateful day and simple everyday tasks felt insurmountably difficult.
The 19th-century Victorian home she lived in seemed to have taken on a restless spirit of its own.
One ordinary morning, her black coffee slid across the wooden dining table, guided by an unseen force.
Along with these inexplicable events, Sarah could hear the familiar timbre of her mother's voice wafting through the house.
One such night, the shrill ringing of a landline broke the silence.
Shaking, Sarah picked the receiver up and heard the distinct pleading voice of Elizabeth resonating through the line.
Sensing the escalating nature of these events, Sarah sought help from her trusted confidante, Mike.
Sarah opened up about the strange happenings, from the moving cup of coffee to the phantom call from her missing mother.
Mike experienced the bizarre happenings firsthand on his visit to Sarah's house.
Nothing seemed to fit within the scope of rationality.
Mike and Sarah stumbled upon a revelatory facet of Elizabeth's past she had kept hidden.
Elizabeth had been an active part of an underground occult society named The Spirit Seekers.
Coinciding with her mother's disappearance was the onset of Sarah's vivid dreams of a cryptic location, uttered by an apparition of her mom.
Elizabeth's last journal entry linked this haunting location from Sarah's dreams.
It was an 18th-century mansion, that now stood abandoned on the outskirts of their town, once the congregational hub for The Spirit Seekers.
As they unraveled the sinister truths, resistance met them.
Despite their growing fear, they were driven to complete the unfinished ritual, hoping it would sever whatever link Elizabeth had to the otherworldly realm and return her back to them.
A spectral figure of Elizabeth emerged, advancing through a shimmering dimensional portal.
They escaped the now collapsing mansion.
With Elizabeth's return, a ray of hope punctured Sarah's previously gloomy existence.
However, even as they laughed at light-hearted anecdotes, something odd caught Sarah's attention.
A photograph of Mike, which was newly framed and hung on the old oak wall, had slightly shifted in its position.
A jolt of cold fear coursed through Sarah's spine as she stared at the slightly altered photograph.
The implication was clear; they had been marked by the occult and the supernatural entities were not willing to loosen their grip as easily as they had hoped.
They thought they had escaped the darkness, but the darkness had merely receded, biding its time to strike once again.
This daunting realization marked the chilling cliffhanger that concluded the story.

66912373.title: Demonic (2021 film)
synopsis: Carly (Carly Pope) is a young woman who has fallen out of contact with her mother Angela (Nathalie Boltt).
Angela is convicted of killing more than 20 people in a killing spree where she burned down a care home she worked at and poisoned a church.
Carly is supported by her best friend Sam (Kandyse McClure).
The pair cut off their other childhood friend Martin (Chris William Martin) after he began to espouse strange theories about Angela.
One day, Carly receives a text from Martin who wants to meet up and talk.
Martin tells Carly that he was invited to be part of a focus group test for a company called Therapol which involved real medical patients, one of which was a comatose Angela.
Carly is later contacted by Therapol, who ask her to visit their facility to discuss Angela.
She meets scientists Daniel (Terry Chen) and Michael (Michael J. Rogers) who explain Angela fell into a coma following a series of violent episodes in prison and is "locked-in" inside her body.
They tell Carly that Angela is highly active inside a simulation, calling for Carly and Martin.
They ask Carly if she is willing to enter Angela's mind to talk to her, which she reluctantly agrees to do.
In the simulation, Carly enters a copy of her childhood home and angrily confronts Angela about her crimes.
Angela, fully able to speak in the simulation, demands that Carly leaves.
That night, Carly has a nightmare where she finds a strange symbol made of a raven carcass.
Carly arrives at Therapol for another trip inside the simulation.
This time she enters through a new tunnel into a field outside an old sanatorium which Angela had worked at.
She meets with Angela, who claims that she was not the person who called for Carly and Martin.
Angela's body in the simulation starts to glitch out and the scientists ignore a terrified Carly's demands to be removed from the simulation.
Entering the sanatorium, she finds Sam's body before being attacked by an avian-like Demon which slashes its arm open, creating the same cut on Carly's real-life body.
Carly exits the simulation and tells Daniel and Michael how years ago, she and Martin found Angela in the sanatorium with the same cut on her arm.
Carly refuses to participate in another simulation.
Carly visits Martin and tells him about her experience.
He shows her his theories about demonic possession, showing Carly a sketch of the creature she saw in the simulation.
Martin claims to have suffered similar nightmares to Carly's and explains how the demon manipulates its target through their family and friends.
He also tells Carly of his theory that the Vatican is funding special black ops groups consisting of priests.

The Vatican buys companies like Therapol to detect genuinely possessed people who seemingly suffer from medical conditions before the squad eliminates the demon by bringing it to its entry point from hell.
In the case of the supposed demon taking over Angela, this is the sanatorium.
A bewildered Carly refuses to believe this theory; Martin begins to suspect the demon has latched onto Carly.
That night, a concerned Sam pays Carly a visit and Carly sends her away.
Sam returns later into the night this time with a bird mask and telling Carly "to look for me in the woods".
Sam puts on the bird mask and suddenly contorts her body, chasing Carly around the house.
Carly barricades herself in her bedroom where she is attacked by the demon.
Carly wakes up; the events are seemingly a dream and she rushes to Sam's house.
It is revealed that Daniel and Michael are watching her and that Martin's theory is correct: they are priests and plan to eliminate the demon at the sanatorium.
The demon has become obsessed with Carly while trapped in Angela's comatose body and wants to possess her to commit the same crimes it made Angela do.
Carly finds Sam missing from her house and recruits Martin to help rescue her.
They travel to the woods and retrieve a traumatized Sam, who claims a group of men took Angela into the nearby sanatorium.
They leave Sam in Martin's car and head out to find Angela.
At the sanatorium, they find the black ops team has been massacred and stumble upon a dying Daniel.
Daniel explains the demon has entered Michael, who killed the squad, and gives Carly a holy lance that will kill the demon.
In the sanatorium, Carly enters the simulation to rescue Angela.
She finds Angela, who is finally free of the demon and makes amends with her daughter before dying peacefully.
Carly escapes the simulation and looks for Martin.
She stumbles across his car which is now in flames as well as Sam's burnt corpse.
Carly finds Martin being tortured by Michael, who pursues Carly.
Carly stabs Michael with the lance, killing him and accidentally sending the demon into herself.
Carly wrestles with the possession before stabbing herself with the lance, killing the demon.
Sometime later, Carly awakens in a hospital and makes amends with Martin.
She leaves flowers at Angela's grave.

15279258.title: Eager Aspirations (film)
synopsis: Bryan, a 28-year-old man barely scraping by as a freelance writer, wakes up to yet another day full of predictability.
Stacks of books and crumbled job applications litter his meager single-room apartment, a constant reminder of his unfinished business with life.

He slips on his trusty navy blue suit, carefully ironing out the creases and expectantly preparing himself for another job interview at 'Innovative Tech Valleys', a prestigious software engineering firm he longed to be part of.
Overwhelmed by constant disappointments and rejections, Bryan vents out his frustrations to his only companion - a wilted Ficus plant perched atop his cluttered desk.
His monologue is a mix of broken dreams, shattered hopes, and optimistic aspirations.
Bryan steps into the grand, glass-walled high-rise - the headquarters of 'Innovative Tech Valleys'.
The austere image of Mr. Harding, the interviewer, intensifies his already frantic nerves.
Bryan tries to woo him with an expansive repertoire of programming languages and software development skills.
A moment of hilarity emerges when Bryan, consumed by his desperate urge to astonish Mr.Harding, mistakenly confuses his fluency level in Spanish for "Spinach".
An awkward silence ensues, broken only by the sound of suppressed chuckles from the stern Mr. Harding.
Despite his blunder, Bryan leaves the interview with a hopeful smile.
His faith in his adaptability - his unique quirkiness that differentiates him from the cookie-cutter applicants - remains unshaken.
Coming home to his lavishly disorganized apartment, Bryan takes a breather to evaluate his roller-coaster day.
He experiences a light bulb moment – a realization that his life needs a drastic overhaul, and he must take the reins.
He submerges himself in his worn-out, faded-red armchair, equipped with a yellow notepad and a pen.
His gaze is firm, and determination transforms his tired, sea-blue eyes into a visionary's sparkling stare.
He fills the pages with his audacious five-month plan.
Bryan embarks on an unwavering journey towards his aspirations, formulating an action plan focused on ensuring his presence at every significant technology job fair in the city.
He is determined for success and nothing less.
His unique approach to self-betterment lands him a job at EweCrazy - an unconventional startup sharing co-working space with a local organic sheep farm.

Amid the continuous bleating, the distinctive aroma of hay and the occasional wool stuck to his laptop, Bryan discovers tranquility—laughing at the strange absurdity that has become his professional haven.
A job fair hosted by Cybernetics Corp leads Bryan to cross paths with Emily—a confident and successful project manager.
Her aura of self-made achievement and mysterious personality turn Bryan's world upside down.
Bryan finds himself bewitched but wary around Emily.
He admires her intelligence, engages in their common ambition, and is intrigued by her sparkling wit.
As Bryan tries to navigate the uncertain romantic waters with Emily, life at EweCrazy becomes a whirlwind of activities and deadlines.
The team dives into a challenging project focused on free-range wool, cheekily titled 'Sheep Happens'.
As Bryan settles into his role, the startup grapples with a legal issue tied to alleged copyright infringement on sheep breeding procedures.
This unexpected snag turns Bryan's life into a delightful comedy of errors.
Bryan battles with juggling the nascent relationship with Emily and finding a solution for his workplace predicament.
A hilarious turn of events leaves Bryan forgetting his lines during an important product pitch due to sheer exhaustion.
Over candlelight, Bryan makes a charming yet clumsy attempt to explain the looming work crisis to an amused Emily.
The sticky notes on his shirt serve as a visual aid.
Amid the chaos, Bryan stumbles upon a breakthrough which he believes can be his savior.
He plans on utilizing the unique feature of EweCrazy's office - its cohabitant sheep - to steer clear of the company's looming crisis.
After convincing his skeptical co-workers, Bryan presents his eccentric yet nominal solution.
Shockingly, his unorthodox approach receives unanimous approval.
The crisis resolution not only safeguards EweCrazy's future but also cements Bryan's relationship with Emily – who is both struck and charmed by his problem-solving abilities.
Buoyed by Emily's acceptance, Bryan lays bare his deepest feelings.
His confession, although jumbled and wavering, is genuine and heartfelt.
Accompanied by the occasional blush and infrequent giggles, Bryan tells Emily he loves her.
Amid the absurdities of Bryan's life, Emily finds herself falling for the earnest, indefatigable Bryan finding his declaration of love both awkward and endearing.
We end with Bryan and Emily, nestled comfortably on Bryan's new plush green sofa, in an apartment transformed from disconcerting chaos to ordered mess.
Their laughter fills the space as they humorously discuss their shared future with a possible holiday in Ibiza.
Bryan's life, once filled with discontentment and disorder, has harmoniously metamorphosed into a blissful union of love, friendship, and professional satisfaction.
Carefully framed is the final shot; Bryan is smiling triumphantly at the camera, Emily in his arms.
His piercing sea-blue eyes tell a story – a victor's tale of dreams genuinely pursued, individual quirks embraced, and a chaotic life finally tamed.

60883846.title: Desperados (film)
synopsis: Wesley Darya is struggling to find a job and a partner and desperately wants to settle down.
She goes on a blind date with a man named Sean.
However, he ends the date abruptly when she mentions marriage and kids too frequently.
Immediately after leaving the date, she meets Jared, a charming and attractive man who came to her aid after she tripped and fell on the sidewalk.
Drawn to his looks and desperate to date him, Wesley starts to hide her true self to make the relationship work.
After dating for a month, Jared and Wesley finally have sex.
When he does not contact her for five days, she becomes upset and suspicious that he has ghosted her.
She gets drunk with her two best friends, Brooke and Kaylie, and the trio writes a long and insulting email to him.
Jared calls Wesley to tell her that he had gotten into a serious accident in Mexico, without having checked his emails as his phone was in his resort room.
To save her relationship, Wesley decides to go to Mexico with Brooke and Kaylie, sneak into Jared's resort room and delete the email.
After checking in, Wesley bumps into Sean at the same resort.
She repeatedly tries and fails to gain access to Jared's room, and is eventually kicked out of the resort.
When she tries to break in again, against her friends’ advice, she is caught and arrested.
Sean, Brooke, and Kaylie come to pick her up, and he agrees to help Wesley delete the email before Jared is released from the hospital.
When Jared calls her to tell her he is being released early, Wesley decides to meet him at the Mexican airport and fly back with him, deleting the email on the flight.
On the way to the airport, Sean tells Wesley that she had been his first and only date after the death of his wife, and that he is not planning on dating again.
He had ended the date because he was not ready to move on from his wife.
They bond over the drive, and Sean encourages her to tell Jared the truth.
On the plane, Wesley gains access to the email and is about to delete it when she decides to tell Jared the truth.
After reading it, he breaks up with her for lying to him.
After the plane lands, Wesley complains to her friends, but they accuse her of neglecting them during the trip.
When she tells them her problems are more important than theirs, they end their friendship with her, leaving her at the airport.
Wesley later finds a job as a guidance counselor after Sean recommends her to one of his friends.
She apologizes to her friends and they forgive her, after she admits her flaws and thanks them for always supporting her.
Wesley tracks down Sean, who is at the same restaurant where they had gone on their blind date.
She realizes he is on another blind date, and apologizes but confesses her feelings for him.
He tells her that what they had in Mexico was too serious and is only interested in something casual.
Saddened, Wesley leaves the restaurant, but Sean rushes out to find her shortly after.
He agrees to date her and they kiss on the street.
Sean's date angrily walks past them, complaining on the phone to her mother about her terrible date.

66212196.title: Feast Across the States
synopsis: The film kicks off with an introduction to the protagonist, Alex, a daring rock artist known for his rebellious spirit.
His fiery guitar solos and meaningful lyrics speak out against the government's relentless actions.
Located in the city’s bustling center stands a hive for scientific research.
A lone figure, Emma, a quirky scientist diligently continues her work on an assembly of illuminated algae.
As the hounds from the government's agencies start sniffing around for Alex, he stumbles upon sanctuary by working as a lab assistant in Emma's unconventional algae research project.
Their differing personalities initially clash, but their mutual love for food starts to break the ice.
One night, Emma proposes a trip across America focusing on its cuisine.
This unusual plan helps Alex to evade the government while experiencing the American food culture.
Their journey begins in Boston; an odd encounter with an unusually made clam chowder brings them closer.
Their journey then leads them to Philadelphia and then Texas, where an unplanned interview inadvertently turns them into internet stars.
The situation unwittingly puts a target on their backs for authorities who are watching the broadcasts.
Nevertheless, they continue their journey, which leads them to a colorful county fair in Alabama.
Eventually, their relationship blossoms amidst laughter, adrenaline-fueled escapes and shared meals.
Alex finds his feelings for Emma growing, becoming fiercely protective of her.
When they reach Florida, he chooses to hand himself in to protect her.
This decision prompts a high-speed chase as they head towards their final gastronomic stop.
Their journey ends at a sushi bar in Seattle, just as they learn that Alex's music fans have rallied together, bringing to light the corruption behind his charges.
Emma's revived lab is illuminated by her successful algae experiment, and Alex's music now fills the air.
Emma watches Alex, playing his music, her eyes glistening with admiration and love.

62531922.title: Dinner in America
synopsis: A reckless, on-the-lam punk rock singer named Simon goes home with Beth, a girl he met while volunteering at a clinical trial.
He and Beth's mother begin to flirt, and after getting caught, Simon lights the family's front yard on fire.
Meanwhile, track athletes Derrick and Brandon bully the young and awkward Patty, who goes to work at a pet store before returning home.
She eats dinner with her parents, Norman and Connie, and brother Kevin, and is unsuccessful in asking for permission to go to a rock show with her friends, Sissy and Karen.

For the past two years, Patty has been sending postcards containing nude photos and lyrics to her original music to John Q, the lead singer of her favorite band PSYOPS, who will be playing next week with the Alliance.
She is unaware that John Q is Simon, who performs wearing a ski mask.
The following morning, Simon begins to sell drugs around town.
A police officer spots him and gives chase but fails to find him.
Simon crosses paths with Patty, who recognizes him from a college course on music appreciation.
She tells him that she was just fired from the pet store by the owner, Mr. Hanley.
She takes him back to her place, where they flirt.
Simon and Patty later eat dinner with the rest of her family.
Simon convinces Norman and Connie into giving him a place to stay for the week and tells Kevin he is adopted.
Patty tells Simon about her fascination for John Q. Simon runs away and confronts his band members for setting up the rock show without his knowledge.
He returns to Patty's house and smokes weed with Kevin.
The next day, Simon and Patty make plans to demand an overdue paycheck from Mr. Hanley.
Derrick and Brandon come across them and beat up Simon.
In a rage, Simon convinces a friend to lend him his truck.
He goes home to retrieve a dead cat from Patty's front yard before tracking Derrick and Brandon down.
Patty acts provocatively to throw them off as Simon knocks them unconscious, strips them, burns their tracksuits, and places the dead cat on their bodies.
The smoke alerts the other track athletes, who find them as Simon and Patty make their escape and drive away.
They get the check from Mr. Hanley and eat lunch at a fast food restaurant.
There, they kiss passionately.
Simon and Patty spend the rest of the day on a date at an arcade.
Simon breaks into a ticket machine to win Patty a desired stuffed teddy bear.
They return home and find the rest of Patty's family completely stoned.
The following day, Simon prevents Patty from going to a job interview to be a dish cleaner and instead takes her to the basement of his mother's house.
He tells her that he is John Q and proves it by giving her back her postcards.
He praises her songwriting abilities.
They have sex and later perform one of her songs.
Her singing brings him to tears.
Simon's family arrives home and invites the pair to dinner.
When the family starts to criticize Simon and accuse him of being a drug addict, Patty confronts them, but they mistake her awkwardness for drug use.
The family kicks them both out.
When Patty asks Simon if he thinks she is retarded, he tells her to stop undervaluing herself because she is a "total punk rocker."
When Simon tells his music manager that he refuses to play with the Alliance, his band members decide to call the police and turn him in for a reward.
Simon takes Patty on another date to a "secret" rock show.
He sings one of her favorite songs, "Dinner in America," and dedicates the performance to her, cementing their relationship.
The police arrest Simon as Sissy and Karen notice Patty kissing him before he goes.
The trio decides to start a riot girl band.
Sometime later, Patty reads a letter from Simon that includes a nude photo of his.
She punches a bully that calls her a retard, walks away, puts on a ski mask, and listens to the song she recorded with Simon.

8429078.title: Undaunted Vision: Echoes of the Past
synopsis: John McAllister, an optimistic and energetic youth from New Jersey, willingly commits his life to serving his nation as part of the United States Army.
Here, he finds an unexpected camaraderie with Jake Anderson, another earnest recruit; their shared experience binds them in a deep, irrevocable friendship.

After extensive training, John is thrust into a covert operation in Afghanistan - a mission shrouded in classified information and fraught with unseen peril, driving home the stark reality of his choice to fight.
Unfortunately, the mission intended to dismantle a notorious terrorist faction spirals into a catastrophic disaster.
Fateful decisions carry severe consequences, thrusting John into a realm of emotional turmoil and existential dread.
The tragic aftermath of such a calamitous operation leaves physical scars, culminating in the grievous loss of his eyesight.
We next find John navigating his new life in the quiet suburbs of Newark, awakened from recurring nightmares of the Afghanistan operation.
Despite the severe trauma, John finds his solace and peace, focusing his attention on his twelve-year-old daughter, Mia, and his devoted guide dog Max, a Golden Retriever.
Even as he attempts to deal with his new normal, vivid flashbacks of Afghanistan punctuate his reality.
Sinister murmurs begin spreading around downtown Newark - news of an unidentified serial killer preying on city residents.
John, a man accustomed to deciphering complex pattern formations during his Army days, perceives a disturbing connection to his past linking the serial murders.

Underneath the surface of the terrifying incidents, John discerns a pattern common to the victims of the serial killer and the killing methods, all leading back to his catastrophic mission in Afghanistan.

Tormented by a past that seems to be emerging like a leviathan from the depth of time, John's life collides again with Jake's, when a Veterans' Day event draws them together at their former Army base.
Jake has evolved over the years; life as a seasoned homicide detective for the Newark Police Department has sharpened his analytical skills.
John shares his thoughts on the serial killings, introducing Jake to the unnerving possibility that the murders are tied to their doomed operation.
Despite initial dismissal, Jake is drawn into John's compelling theory.
The duo embarks on a perilous journey sifting through archived records of the operation.
John's lack of eyesight proves a considerable disadvantage.
He depends heavily on Jake or Mia to explore centuries-old dusty documents.
The turmoil under the surface intensifies, recurring nightmares morph into PTSD-induced full-blown terrifying, vivid flashbacks pressing heavily on John's mental state.
As John delves deeper into the case, threatening anonymous calls begin to shatter his precariously restored peace.
Max and Mia become the pillars of strength he leans on to continue his search for the truth.
A breakthrough reveals a chilling connection - each victim of the serial killer was linked to their unfortunate operation.
The revelation sends shockwaves through John, as he grapples with the haunting notion that their actions years ago have triggered horrifying repercussions now.
The narrative leads to a climactic confrontation, where the shadowy murderer unveils his identity.
Mason Clarke, a fellow soldier from their mission, steps forward from the darkness.
Betrayed by a comrade, John grapples with Clark's accusations - he blames John for a critical decision taken during the operation that spiraled everything out of control.
Their past unleashes itself into the familiar confines of John's house as Clarke threatens John's world - his beloved daughter Mia.
Forced into a defensive posture, John must rely on his keen senses and his deep-rooted army training, guided by Max's instincts, to protect his precious child.
An intense clash unfolds between them.
Despite his disadvantages, John embodies the spirit of a seasoned warrior.
As the life-or-death struggle reaches its tipping point, the arrival of Jake and a SWAT team from Newark PD brings much-needed reinforcement.
Clarke meets his downfall under the weight of John's relentless courage and his involvement in the deceitful military operation is revealed.
As Clarke is led away in shackles, the city of Newark reels from the disturbing revelation.
Slowly but surely, their domestic life begins to mend itself.
Through their shared connection and journey, Jake and John reignite their friendship.
Unwavering through it all, Max, the faithful canine, stays by John's side.
He remains 'undaunted,' a testament to the maxim that it's not our adversities but our courage that truly defines us.
As Newark begins to heal, they make John one of their own, admiring his unfaltering courage and tenacity.
His story of resilience pervades the city, shining a light of hope.
His journey underscores the importance of holding onto faith even in times of unparalleled turmoil.
Concluding on a hopeful note, the narrative proves that love, courage, and an 'undaunted vision' can shape our destiny, irrespective of our past and challenges we face.

62855295.title: Don't Breathe 2
synopsis: Eight years after the events of the first film, blind Navy SEAL veteran Norman Nordstrom lives with 11-year-old daughter, Phoenix and his Rottweiler, Shadow, in a Detroit suburb.
Norman tells Phoenix that her birth mother died in a fire in their old house.
Hernandez, Norman's only connection with society and a veteran Army Ranger, convinces Norman to let Phoenix accompany her on an errand in town to have some time out of the house.
A gangster named Raylan attempts to abduct Phoenix but is scared away by Shadow.
His gang follows Hernandez's van back to Norman's where they wait for her to drop Phoenix off, then kill her when she leaves.
They lure Shadow away and kill him off screen.
When Norman goes outside to look for Shadow, the gang breaks in to kidnap Phoenix.
A struggle ensues between Norman and the gang, and Raylan tells Phoenix that he is her real father, confirming it by showing they both have a streak of white hair.
It is revealed that Phoenix's house burned down after a meth lab explosion in the basement, and Raylan had been jailed for eight years.
Norman found Phoenix unconscious in the wreckage and took her home to take the place of his dead daughter.
Upon release, Raylan saw Phoenix alive when she left flowers at her mother's memorial.
Phoenix is chloroformed by a henchman.
Raylan sets his own dog to kill Norman, who traps the animal in the attic.
The gang sets the house on fire and leaves with Phoenix.
Norman befriends the dog as they escape together and it leads him to the gang's hotel hideout.

At the hotel, Raylan reveals Phoenix's real name is Tara and introduces her to her mother, who is alive but terminally ill. She explains that she triggered the explosion while cooking meth resulting in the poisoning of her internal organs.
Tara's parents have abducted her in order to transplant her compatible organs for Tara's mother.
Due to a lack of drugs and facilities, Tara will be conscious while her heart is removed.
A power blackout prevents the procedure and Raylan's men are ambushed by Norman, who exploits the dark to pick them off one by one.
Norman also kills the surgeon and a stray gunshot kills Tara's mother.
Norman gouges out Raylan's eyes and leaves him for dead.
A badly wounded Norman confirms to Tara that her father was telling the truth.
He confesses his crimes, including murder and rape, and tells her to flee to safety.
Raylan appears and stabs Norman, only to be fatally stabbed by Tara.
She attempts to help Norman, claiming she can save him, to which he replies she already has, before apparently succumbing to his wounds.
Tara leaves and heads to a children's home she had seen earlier.
She approaches a group of children playing and introduces herself as Phoenix.
In a mid-credits scene, Raylan's dog licks Norman's fingers which twitch slightly, indicating that he is alive.

44153162.title: Fumigation Heist: A Brother's Sacrifice
synopsis: Alex and Jack, two brothers, reside in a rundown neighborhood of Brooklyn.
Every day they shoulder the responsibility of their mother, who is battling an aggressive illness.
The local, underfunded city hospital – falling apart brick by brick – is the only place that offers the medical care she desperately needs.
Hospital authorities would routinely confront them, about their increasing financial arrears.
A particularly fraught meeting with the hospital's administrative team hints at the impending relocation of their mother to the general ward, packed to the rafters with patients.
Alex stumbles upon a whispered conversation about a feared mercenary reputed to have accumulated millions in wealth, squirreled away within the opulent confines of his mansion.
Alex reveals his daring plan to plunder the luxurious abode for the sake of their mother to Jack.
Jack after reflecting on their mother's rapidly deteriorating health and the mountain of debt, decides to join Alex in this ambitious venture.
The brothers, well aware of the mansion's tight security, embark on a journey of stealthy research, determined to decode the building's secret layout and understand the intricacies of the mansion.
On one restless night, Alex and Jack initiate their audacious mission to break into the mercenary's mansion.
They trigger a hidden alarm that seals off the entire mansion and injures Alex in the panic of the lockdown.
Trapped, they strive to turn this terrifying ordeal in their favor.
Jack stumbles upon a hidden vault with stacks of cash, valuable medical equipment, and proof of the mercenary's treasonous activities.
However, Jack hastily makes the decision to prioritize their lives over the prospect of ill-gotten wealth.
They manage to escape the mansion just as the dawn breaks, leaving behind the cash, but taking along the medical equipment.
Safely back home, they use the stolen apparatus to stabilize their mother's condition and vow to find a legal way to settle their debts.
Their bruised faces reflect the previous night's terror, and they go about mending their strained relationship, but the fear of being pursued lingers in the corners of their minds.

64027062.title: Don't Tell a Soul (film)
synopsis: To support their dying mother Carol, 17-year-old Matt forces his 14-year-old brother Joey to rob a remote home being fumigated.
Security guard Dave Hamby chases the two boys through a forest, but falls into an abandoned well.
Matt insists on leaving Hamby in the hole so he cannot turn the brothers in to the police.
Feeling guilty about leaving the man trapped, Joey regularly visits Hamby to bring him water, food, a sleeping bag, and a walkie-talkie.
When he discovers what his brother is doing, Matt urinates on Hamby's head to reassert authority.
Incensed when Joey continues bonding with the man, Matt drops an open pesticide canister into the hole to kill Hamby.
Joey confronts Matt when he learns his brother used the stolen money meant for their mother to host a motel party.
Matt responds by telling partygoers that Joey steals from retired people.
Joey retaliates by revealing that Matt killed a man.
Matt threatens and beats Joey.
Joey runs back home where Carol's TV news program reveals the man in the well is actually Randy Michael Sadler, a fugitive wanted for murdering his wife and children.
Joey returns to the hole and discovers Randy survived the pesticide by wearing the gas mask Joey dropped during the chase.
Randy admits he stole a security guard's uniform and was trying to retrieve the stolen money for himself.
Joey bargains to rescue Randy from the well in exchange for help punishing Matt.
Joey brings Randy home after using a rope to get him out of the hole.
Carol recognizes Randy from the news bulletin.
Carol is shocked to discover Joey is helping Randy go on the run.

At the same time, Matt reports Joey as the thief to police officers Smith and Crane, who are investigating the initial vandalism;  Matt inadvertently implicates himself in the robbery (and knowing Randy was imprisoned in a hole but failed to notify police).
Matt accompanies the two officers back to the house where a standoff ensues with Randy.
Randy shoots both officers, but Joey stops him from killing them.
Randy and Joey then take Matt to the hole in the forest.
After forcing Matt into the well, Randy compels Joey to shout angry invectives at his brother.
Randy then pushes Joey into the hole.
Matt beats Joey unconscious.
Randy starts limping away when Carol confronts him at gunpoint.
Carol reveals she killed her abusive husband.
Following a conversation about her troubled family, Carol shoots Randy dead.
Fearing he killed his brother, Matt finally manages to rouse Joey and tearfully apologizes for all he has done.
Matt and Joey embrace as Carol comes to their rescue.

70307648.title: 1928: Nobility, Love & Legitimacy
synopsis: Edward, a widower in the very prime of his early forties, maintains a composed facade embodying the quintessence of English nobility in the heart of London.
His grief, however, is interrupted by the surprising arrival of an envelope, the paper as pristine as an untouched snowfall, bearing the seal of the royal court.
His father-in-law's noble title, the esteemed Duke of Essex, has rightfully landed upon him, profoundly shifting the status of Edward amongst society’s elite.
Elsewhere, Eleanor, an incandescent beauty hailing from humble beginnings and tainted by illegitimate birth, mourns the loss of her single parent, her mother Margaret.
She is taken aback when unexpected news reaches her.
Her mother had left behind a modest fortune, secured during her years of dedicated service in King George's royal court, which now stood as Eleanor’s unlikely inheritance.
Eleanor has long harbored dreams of being acknowledged by the high society of London.
She contemplates how this newfound fortune could be her steppingstone towards that dream.
Eleanor utilizes her inheritance to elegantly maneuver her way through the societal labyrinth.
Edward, even amidst the insidious whispers concerning Eleanor's birth circulating through the hall, finds himself enchanted by her audacious charm.
Her beauty shines through her defiant demeanor and the fascinating depths of her azure eyes.
Eleanor, swayed by Edward's rugged charm and his surprisingly intimate nature, mirrors this blooming attraction.

Their romance takes form in the secluded corners of London, characterized by secret trysts in shaded alleyways, beautifully penned love letters exchanged in private, and stolen kisses behind the ornate tapestries in mansions teeming with high society’s elite.
Overwhelmed by burgeoning love and disdainful of societal norms and prejudice, Edward dares to reveal his clandestine affair with Eleanor to his close-knit family.
His revelation is met with stark consternation and objection from his two elder sisters and his mother, due primarily to the scandalous acknowledgement of Eleanor's illegitimate birth.
Eleanor, learning about their disdainful reaction during a quiet night stroll, finds herself torn between her deep-rooted love for Edward and her personal fight against societal expectations.

She is hit by an unforgiving truth, the possession of her heart by Edward would mean relinquishing her hard-earned independence and yielding to the stiff codes of conduct upheld by the English nobility of the 18th-century.
At the zenith of this internal turmoil, she stumbles upon radical speeches by Mary Wollstonecraft and leaflets advocating for women's rights.

Having weathered many a long night, with thought-provoking conversations by the warmth of Edward’s study fireplace and introspective silence, they make the bold decision to confront their families with their absolute intention to marry.
Determined, their resolve to protect their love reinforces their decision.

But as time fluidly passes and Eleanor’s frequent visits exhibit her unbroken spirit and virtue while Edward's unwavering dedication to her is clear for all to see, their stiff opposition experiences an inevitable softening.
Eleanor bravely tackles those who dismiss her love for Edward, boldly asserting her right to love and be loved, irrespective of her background.
After months of mounting tension and final negotiations leading to court approval, Eleanor and Edward's highly anticipated wedding day finally dawns.
The ceremony takes place within the grandeur of Westminster Abbey.
Their wedding represents more than their personal victory; it symbolizes a strong stand against the deeply rooted societal prejudice.
The closing scene features Edward, arm in arm with Eleanor in her elegant wedding attire, nobly walking down the red-carpeted aisle in Westminster Abbey.

Their eyes lock, and the buzz of the audience, the echoing chatter of the courtiers and nobles, fades into insignificance, leaving only the palpable triumph of their love under the high, beautifully arched ceilings of the church.

Edward’s unwavering affection and true respect for Eleanor serve to endorse a testimony that love is not restricted by societal norms or legal decree, but nurtures itself on the genuine spirit of emotions and convergence of dreams.
Their wedding amidst the ancient, stone walls of Westminster Abbey closes their enduring love story as a triumph to remember.
As the couple takes to the dance floor under the glittering chandeliers, the room filled with nobles and gentry, breaks into applause.
The film concludes with a serene, lasting shot of Edward and Eleanor’s blissful faces, reflecting the myriad hues of the abbey’s beautiful stained glass and basking in their hard-won triumph.

66729797.title: Downton Abbey: A New Era
synopsis: In 1928, Tom Branson, the Earl of Grantham's widowed son-in-law, marries Lucy Smith, the illegitimate daughter of and sole heir to Lady Maud Bagshaw, Queen Mary's lady-in-waiting.
Violet Crawley, the Dowager Countess of Grantham, astonishes the family by revealing that long ago she was given a villa in the South of France by the Marquis de Montmirail, who has recently died.

Violet is bequeathing it to her great-granddaughter, Sybbie, the daughter of Tom and the late Lady Sybil Crawley, to ensure that she is more on a par socially and financially with her cousins George, Caroline, Marigold, and Peter.
A film production company wants to use Downton to shoot a silent film called The Gambler.
Robert declines, until his eldest daughter and estate manager, Lady Mary Talbot, convinces him that the fee would be enough to replace Downton's leaking roof.
The household staff are eager to see the film's stars, but lead actress Myrna Dalgliesh's haughtiness offends several of them.
The new marquis de Montmirail invites the Crawley family to visit the villa.
The ailing Violet is unable to travel, but Tom and Lucy, Lady Bagshaw, Robert Crawley and his wife Cora, their daughter Edith and her husband, Bertie Pelham, the Marquess of Hexham, accept.
The servants they take with them are Downton's former butler Carson, Mr Bates, and Miss Baxter.
Lady Edith, once again writing for the magazine she owns, uses this as a working assignment as well.
Lady Mary remains at Downton to oversee the filming, assisted by Mrs Hughes.
The Marquis de Montmirail welcomes the family to the villa.
His mother wants to contest Violet Crawley's ownership.
However, the family lawyer states that there is no basis for a claim especially as the late Marquis bequeathed the villa to Violet before he married his wife and so the villa is legally Violet's.
The marquis speaks privately with Robert and stuns him by implying that Robert's birth date, nine months after the Dowager Countess visited in 1864, could mean they are half-brothers.
That night, Cora reveals to Robert she may be fatally ill. Robert breaks down at the prospect of losing his mother, the Crawley name, and his wife in short succession.
At Downton, the studio cancels The Gambler because silent films are no longer profitable, after the introduction of "talkie" films.
Lady Mary suggests salvaging the project by dubbing in the dialogue for the completed scenes.
Lead actor Guy Dexter's voice is suitable, but Myrna Dalgleish's cockney accent is inappropriate for her upper-class character.
Mrs Hughes suggests that Lady Mary could dub Dalgleish's voice.
Fearing her career is ruined, Dalgleish quits, but Downton servants Anna and Daisy persuade her to complete the film.
Former Downton footman Mr Molesley, who can lip-read, reconstructs the dialogue for dubbing, and creates a dialogued script for the remaining story.
The family returns to Downton while filming continues (with Robert and Cora ruining a take by accident).
Lady Mary gently rebuffs director Jack Barber's flirtations, although her husband Henry's prolonged absence for a car rally has strained their marriage.
Guy Dexter tacitly reveals to Downton's closeted butler, Thomas Barrow, that he too is gay.
This leads Barrow to accept Dexter's offer of managing his Los Angeles house and being a travelling companion so they can have a life together.
Dr Clarkson diagnoses Cora with pernicious anaemia, a treatable condition.
Cora helps Dalgleish develop an American accent, potentially saving her career.
Edith, unfulfilled and constrained as a marchioness, intends to resume working at her London-based magazine which she does a few times a week.
Newlywed servants Daisy and Andy scheme to match up Daisy's former father-in-law, Mr Mason, and Downton cook Mrs Patmore, which succeeds.
When the film's unpaid extras walk out, the Downton staff replace them, ensuring its completion.
Barber offers Molesley a lucrative deal as a screenwriter.
Molesley then proposes to Miss Baxter, unaware that they are being overheard by all the other Downton staff on an open microphone.
Violet assures Robert that the late Lord Grantham was his father and that nothing serious occurred between her and the elder Montmirail.
Violet's health deteriorates and she ultimately dies, surrounded by her family and loved ones, plus Gladys Denker, her lady's maid.
Mary asks Carson to return temporarily as butler to train footman Andy to succeed Barrow.
Months later, Tom and Lucy, along with Sybbie, return to Downton with their new infant.
A new portrait hangs in the main hall, that of the late Dowager Countess.

35134500.title: Knightbeast Chronicles: The Journey of Mystic Scales
synopsis: Our film begins as the lens capriciously moves over untouched grandeur— a bubbly coterie of virgin forests, crystal-clear blue lakes twinkling with reflections of the omnipresent golden sun.

The film introduces its primary characters: The Knight, a brave soldier veiling his human heart behind a layer of gleaming iridescent armor, and Beast, the colossal lifeform graced with penetrating emerald-green eyes.
They're captured in their unique interaction with seven ethereal beings, spirit-crafted creatures embodying various elements of the realm, creating an impression of inexplicably powerful harmony.
The audience is guided through different territories — the emerald oasis, the sapphire seafront — each holding a uniquely mystic creature given life by guarding spirits.
These spirits and their attributes are a reflection of the remarkable abilities possessed by their protected fauna.
The spotlight then shifts to Mystic Scales, an adoring aquatic creature laden with iridescent scales shimmering in the tranquil waters of the Sapphire Lagoon.
The realm has a sacred practice observed once in a yearly cycle.
The champions from each corner make their pilgrimage to the Sacred Summit.
This is a traditional gathering held to strengthen unity amongst them, fostering mutual respect across the spectrum of this diverse realm.
The stage of the Summit serves as the hatchery of prophecies.
Ancient scrolls unravel to reveal Mystic Scales, the unsuspecting sea maiden, as the chosen one to retrieve the Eternal Flame hidden deep within the catacombs of the seemingly innocuous Forest Edge.
Initially overwhelmed by the sudden responsibility, Mystic Scales, however, shows an unyielding spirit.
This display of bravery prompts her companions — a golden-maned creature Bright Fang and an air elemental Talon Whisper — to stand by her side on this unanticipated journey.
The second act commences with Mystic Scales immersing herself in rigorous training.
Knight and Beast coach her, each lesson stirring a surge in the stakes of the story.
This transformative training session imparts more than physical strength.
Mystic Scales learns navigation skills, the intricacies of solving challenging puzzles, and wilderness survival tactics, all bestowing her the aura of a formidable warrior.
Throughout their shared trials and victories, the bond between Mystic Scales, Bright Fang, and Talon Whisper is cemented.
Their mutual reliance becomes a formidable pillar of support as they face adversities.
As they sit around a campfire, Mystic Scales, with a voice filled with resolute determination, inspires her friends to remain unwavering in their pursuit.
They all bound themselves, determined to face the tyranny of odds together.
They traverse through the land's diverse landscape, overcoming snow-capped cliffs to ferocious sea waves — every adversity unveiling another facet of their resilience.
Meanwhile, the spectral scaled antagonist, Shadow Serpent orchestrates his minions to sabotage their path, attempting to halt their mission.
However, the trio, united in spirit, fiercely counter the oncoming onslaught.
Each victory amplifies their mutual trust and tightens the friendship knot they share.
The third act introduces fresh hurdles as they stumble upon an entrancing meadow; however, the floral beauty is treacherous, an evil enchantment by Shadow Serpent.
They skillfully evade perilous traps and venomous flowers — moments that amplify their unity and emphasize the strength of their alliance.
Mystic Scales' dream reveals a long-forgotten prophecy, discerning her unique connection with the Eternal Flame.
As they encounter more of Shadow Serpent's minions, Mystic Scales’ amplified prowess exemplifies her growth into a daring leader.

On reaching the edges of a moss-drowned forest, Forest Edge, Mystic Scales encounters cryptic etchings that herald her journey is more than a quest - it's a voyage leading her towards self-realization.
They arrive at Forest Edge's heart, where the Eternal Flame subtly flickers atop an intricately carved pedestal.
Soon, they face Shadow Serpent himself, with his intimidating crimson eyes glaring ominously, a terrifying catalyst leading to a daunting challenge for our heroes.
But our heroes, undeterred by their apparent disadvantage, showcase unrestrained bravery.
A display of valor like no other helps turn the tide in their favor, leading to Shadow Serpent’s downfall and the realm's reclamation.

By channeling the power of the Eternal Flame, Mystic Scales undergoes a radiant transformation, her scales radiating brighter, and her abilities boosted to unfathomable levels, thus fulfilling her destined prophecy.
Their triumph results in once somber domains bursting into jubilant celebrations.
Mystic Scales rises as a celebrated heroine and claims Forest Edge, the war-torn area, as a sanctuary of peace, declaring her pledge for prosperity within the realm.

As the narrative winds down, the audience is hinted at the presence of other landscapes yet to be explored, unmet challenges, and intriguing adventures indicating the inception of the riveting saga, the Knightbeast Chronicles.

62982590.title: Dragonheart: Vengeance
synopsis: In the years following Drago and Gareth's bonding, the seven dragons they raised left to different lands; one of them, a female named Siveth, traveled to Wallachia.
The kingdom and its ruler, King Razvan, initially welcomed Siveth, but after he was wounded in battle, Siveth refused to share her heart with him, so the king exiled her.
Twenty or thirty years after, Lukas, a young farmer, sees his family killed by savage raiders: The Bear, The Wolf, The Snake, and The Scorpion.
After losing his parents and house to them, Lukas leaves on a quest for revenge.
Lukas goes to the city where King Razvan rules, begging for help, only to be turned down.
Later, a swashbuckling mercenary, Darius, approaches Lukas, offering his services to hunt the murderers.
