After a night of ensuring safety around, Sara and Mr. Johnson retreat to their abodes, ready to tackle another day of learning and adventure.
The shared trials and their common mission fortify the synergy between mentor and pupil, evolving their bond.
As the saga concludes, the audience is left wondering what thrilling adventures the sequel holds in store for the dynamic duo, Sara and Marvelous Man.
Their coupled adventures, unforgettable lessons, personal growth tie together in a satisfying end, leaving the audience clamoring for the sequel.

61790209.title: Flora & Ulysses (film)
synopsis: Set in the 21st century in a suburban town in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, Flora Belle Buckman is a cynical 10-year-old girl who likes to get lost in the world of superheroes from the comics she reads.

Her father George is a failed comic book author who has since taken a job at an office supply store called Binders Keepers overseen by his boss Chad while her mother Phyllis is a romance novelist who had won an award in the past, but has since hit writer's block.
Their hardships have caused them to separate.
Flora's next door neighbor Tootie experiences trouble with her Ulysses brand vacuum that begins running amok in her yard.
A regular squirrel is sucked into it just as the machine dies.
Flora resuscitates the squirrel and takes to naming him after the vacuum.
The next day, Ulysses uses Phyllis' vintage typewriter to type "Squirtel.
[sic] I am.
Ulysses.
Born anew".
Flora quickly discovers that Ulysses is not only sentient, but seems to possess superpowers as well.
She regales her findings to Tootie's visiting nephew William Spiver who suffers from "hysterical blindness" due to stress.
When George arrives to see Flora, he and Phyllis discover Ulysses and he agrees to drop him off while he takes Flora out for the day.
They stop by the diner Do-Nut World first, but Rita the waitress discovers Ulysses who begins to make a mess in the diner.
George sees firsthand that Ulysses has superhuman flight and strength.
Father and daughter grab him and flee back to his apartment which is monitored by a feisty cat named Mr. Klaus.
The owner of the apartment is also named Mr. Klaus.
They see his neighbor Dr. Meescham who tells them that Ulysses is fine and also witnesses his intelligence.
Meanwhile, the diner brings in Miller, an animal control expert who has a vendetta against squirrels due to having been demoted from his park warden duty following a rabid squirrel attack.
A hysterical Rita believes that Ulysses had rabies and Miller becomes more determined to catch him.

When Flora and William visit Stanlee at his comic book store, they learn on the news that Ulysses is a fugitive and race to see George, who has decided to quit his job which also led to the regional manager to fire Chad.
They hide at George's apartment, but Miller deduces their location.
He gets attacked by Mr. Klaus, allowing the heroes to escape, but Miller gives chase.
They evade him and make it back home.
Phyllis reveals that she is stressed out about an interview tomorrow for a newspaper and George agrees to be there beside her for support, hinting to Flora that he does not want to divorce her.
In return, Phyllis reluctantly allows Ulysses to stay in their house.
The interview goes poorly when the journalist sees Ulysses' writings and believes that Phyllis is in a dead end.
The next day, Miller sees the printed article and discovers George's family.
Phyllis takes Ulysses to the woods to get rid of him, but realizes that she cannot go through with it after Ulysses gives her encouragement.
Flora and William head to the woods to rescue Ulysses and hide at an abandoned water park to escape a rainstorm.
William reveals that he was sent away because he pushed his stepfather's car into a lake.
He loved his biological father for his intellect and misses him.
George meets up with Phyllis and Ulysses and find Flora and William where Phyllis apologizes.
However, Miller arrives with a team and they capture Ulysses informing the family that they will euthanize him as they still believe he has rabies.
The Buckmans and William team up with Dr. Meescham and sneak into the animal sanctuary.
While there, William overcomes his stress and regains his sight.
They release all the animals, including a very angry Mr. Klaus, to distract Miller and his team and free Ulysses who once again displays his powers to rescue George.
They decide to release Ulysses back into the wild.
Miller arrives, but is frightened away by the abundance of squirrels.
The Buckmans work together to create a comic book called Ulysses, based on their adventure.

30087172.title: Great in Theory
synopsis: Emily, a stern and determined woman from the humble town of Pencey, Nebraska, finds herself grappling to come to terms with the tempo of life in the bustling city of New York.
Swapping the familiar sights of corn-strewn landscapes for a maze of concrete high-rises, she tries to plant her roots deep into the culturally vibrant yet somehow unforgiving cityscape.

Engulfed in the monotony of her job as a receptionist at an insurance company, Emily constantly wrestles with her heart’s craving for the glitz, glamour and more importantly, the feeling of success that she perceives lies in the world of acting and stand-up comedy.

In an unyielding attempt to strike a sort of balance between her uninspiring, routine-based job and the electrifying allure of a performance-based career, Emily utilizes her few but precious free hours at 'The Last Laugh,' a local bar.
Here, she courts the seemingly daunting task of winning over the gruff crowd that frequents the establishment with her stand-up routines.
Emily's job performance at the insurance company starts to falter under the immense pressure of her divided attention between work and passion.
Reaching her threshold, Emily decides to take a daring leap of faith, devising a master plan that she believes will pave the way to her success in the acting and comedy world.
The narrative begins with Emily, a metaphorical wallflower in auditions, attempting to traverse the nerve-wracking processes that go into acting trials.
Her passion demonstrates resilience in the face of the cold-hearted rejections that seem to be a part of her daily life.
Taking a leap from auditions to the slightly wobbly stage of 'The Last Laugh,' Emily, equipped with her sharp wit, aims to transform into a comedic dynamo.
She hopes to create an explosion of laughter amongst her audience while secretly crossing her fingers for a life-altering breakthrough.
With this newfound motivation, Emily forms the 'Spotlight Theory.'
It's her infallible strategy to effectively throw herself into the spotlight and be recognized for her talents, taking inspiration from the successful comics that she encounters in her journey.
A sense of trepidation but also anticipatory excitement wafts around Emily as she weaves the tenets of the 'Spotlight Theory' into her otherwise drab life.
Emily forges ahead, spurred on by the tantalizing hopes of making a grand triumph.

Unexpectedly, Emily's unseasoned and underprepared world turns topsy-turvy when she assumes the contentious comedic style of the controversial comic, Jeff Rogers, during an impromptu live performance at the city's hot spot, 'Jesters Den.'
Emily's act of mimicry didn't produce the expected results.
The audience, unimpressed, responded with deafening silence, followed by jeers.
Emily, instead of basking in the customary applause, finds herself sinking into a figurative pit of public humiliation because of her failed performance.
Her comedy career, it seems, is on the brink of devastation.
Still reeling from the after-effects of her disastrous set, Emily takes another daring step.
She decides to infiltrate an exclusive acting seminar conducted by the renowned and award-winning actor, Samuel Harvey, hoping to learn from his insurmountable expertise.
Unfortunately, Emily's scheme to slip into the elite acting class backfires.
Given her non-enrollment status, Emily is noticed by the class’s strict security and forcefully escorted from the premises, cementing her disgraceful standing in the acting community.
Irony finds its way into the narrative when Emily's consecutive mishaps, specifically her infamous embarrassment at 'Jesters Den,' capture the public eye, making her the talk of the town.
The narrative takes an unexpected twist when a bystander's video documenting Emily’s catastrophic comedy performance leaks onto the internet.
The subsequent explosion of views and shares takes everyone, especially Emily, by surprise.
The viewers, amused by her appalling comedic performance, find in her a refreshing dose of naivety and an unintentional knack for generating hilarity.
Emily soon finds herself the center of media attention, unexpectedly becoming an overnight viral sensation within the local comedy fanatics circle, purely for her unintended humor.
Emily grapples with the sudden regardless fame thrust upon her.
She marveled at how her string of failures had managed to attract such attention and create a fan base.
Driven by a strange sense of optimism and curiosity, Emily decides to further exploit this sudden popularity.
She starts to experiment dangerously with her comedy, pushing the boundaries of her comfort zone.
In her wild experimentation, Emily inadvertently strikes comedic gold, discovering her unique, authentic voice and style.
Slowly but surely, Emily comes to the staggering realization that her overly calculated ‘Spotlight Theory’ was merely a mirage of success.
She recognizes that her comedy was most impactful when it flowed spontaneously and was true to her personal experiences.
The narrative reaches its climax as Emily, now enlightened by the self-awareness of her capabilities, resolves to discard her meticulously calculated theories.
Instead, she decides to embrace her innate comedic persona that had inadvertently brought her fame.
Armed with a newly found sense of self-assurance, Emily decides to test the waters.
She takes a brave step and signs up for the prestigious 'New York's Top Comic' talent show.
Opting to stray from the safety of rehearsed scripts, Emily strides confidently onto the grand stage at the famed 'Times Square Grand Theater.'
She projects her unique personality, instilled with her natural charisma and comic charm.

Owning her distinct quirks, Emily crafts her narratives and interweaves spontaneous humor, fearlessly bearing herself to the crowd, regardless of whether she stumbles or if her act incites laughter at her expense.
Emily's raw, sincere performance resonates through the grand theater.
Her enchanting persona keeps the audience and jury captivated, hanging on to her every word.
As the talent show draws to a close, Emily finds herself caught in the hearty applause of the audience, their enthusiasm a clear testament to her authentic comic style’s resonance.
Emily doesn’t secure the top spot in the competition.
However, she walks away with something arguably more valuable - she gains recognition and admiration amongst her peers and the audience for the signature style that she dared to showcase.
Emily gradually reconciles with the fact that the spotlight of stardom might not be her reality.
Instead, she basks in the pleasure of her personal victories and the immense joy they garner.

The narrative concludes with Emily's profound reflection on her tumultuous journey under the theme, 'Great in Theory.’ It emphasizes the crucial importance of remaining genuine and authentic, a mantra that Emily will carry throughout the rest of her comedic journey.

67698139.title: Good on Paper
synopsis: Living in LA, Andrea Singer is a stand-up comedian and a struggling aspiring actress.
She is frustrated that Serrena, another woman who has been there for as long as her, is much more successful than she is.
At the airport on the way home from an audition in NYC, Andrea meets Dennis Kelley when he returns her missing boarding pass.
On the flight, Andrea finds herself sitting next to Dennis, who tells her that he's a Yale graduate who works in hedge funds.
They hit it off and begin hanging out together as friends in the city.
Dennis joins her for drinks at her best friend Margot's bar.
Andrea sees Dennis as both pompous and humble, and different than most everyone else.
Available to her whenever she's free, he helps her prepare for auditions and they become good friends.
Andrea is not even remotely attracted to Dennis.
After a gig at The Comedy Store, Dennis asks Andrea to be his girlfriend over an expensive dinner his credit card is declined to pay, but she isn't interested.
Complimenting her, he claims he had ordered her a bracelet at Cartier but had to return it as it wasn't what he'd asked for.
Shortly after, Andrea gets the lead in a series being shot in Vancouver called Space Cadet.
She's with Margot when she gets the call.
Excited, she calls Dennis to share the news.
He proposes they go out on Friday to celebrate, but she already has a date.
On Friday night, Dennis interrupts Andrea's date to spend time with him under the false pretense that his mother is dying of cancer.
They get high and go out, hooking up at the end of the night.
In the morning, Andrea agrees to be his girlfriend.
As Andrea and Dennis get closer, she and her friend Margot start to question if he is all that he claims.
They drive to the address Andrea has for him under the pretense of leaving him a gift.
She learns Dennis has lied about his house and that he has two female roommates.
Andrea confronts Dennis over lying about his living situation, and he further lies about his sick mother living in his house, which she believes.
They go to Santa Monica to spend the weekend with her cousin Brett and Alli, both doctors and Yale alumni.
Andrea surprises them with a gift of a round of golf, as the men are supposedly golfers.
But Dennis fakes an injury to get out of it.
That evening Andrea, beginning to be really suspicious, asks Dennis about his diploma, the bracelet and his mother.
He presents her with a gaudy ring, meant to be a pre-engagement one.
Back in LA, Margot calls Andrea to give her more dirt on him right before the table read for the pilot.
Serrena shows as a guest.
Although furious she infiltrated her first big acting gig, Andrea later enlists Serrena's help in investigating Dennis with Margot.
The house he claimed was his is inhabited by a Hispanic woman named Denise.
Andrea and Margot interview his roommates, who confirm his work and college education claims are lies.
In an attempt to get even, Margot gets Dennis drunk and he passes out.
Margot and Andrea accidentally injure him, and Andrea confronts him for his lying.
Dennis later takes her to court for kidnapping him.
After confronting him again, she is given a restraining order and more fodder for her stand-up routine.

56941476.title: Perez Pursuit: A Quest for Stability
synopsis: In 1994, nestled within Mexico's urban mass, we are introduced to the Perez family which bears the brunt of the ongoing Mexican Peso Crisis, living in a dilapidated shack.

The family is comprised of devoted parents, Jose and Maria, along with their two children - the ever-curious  Miguel and the dreamy-eyed Sofia, all harbouring dreams that expand far beyond their humble abode.
We see a snapshot of their lives as they gather around a weathered wooden table, sharing a frugal meal of beans and corn tortillas.
Captured in the dim candlelight, the patriarch of the family, Jose, is shown brooding over a decision capable of altering their lives forever.
The weight of needing to abandon his native Mexico for the alluring prospect of a better life in the United States weighs heavily on him.
A heartrending scene unfolds within their shared bedroom, where Jose confides in Maria his intentions.

After much contemplation, Jose makes the life-altering decision to leave his home behind in pursuit of the American Dream, inspired by the promise of a prosperous future, albeit leaving his beloved family behind.
The time comes for Jose to bid farewell to his family.

The rusty gate of their old home becomes a scene filled with raw emotion, tight embraces, and fervent promises of a hopeful reunion fill the air, their shared hope acting as the sole source of consolation.
Following this heartfelt departure, Jose begins his arduous journey towards the promise of the United States.

Los Angeles presents an unforgiving reality to Jose, with instances of deceptive manipulators preying on his desperation, promised employment opportunities slipping away, and intense experiences of discrimination.
Meanwhile, days turn into nights as he survives on the streets of this unfamiliar city.
Despite the numerous setbacks, Jose refuses to surrender.
His unyielding spirit drives him to take classes to learn English and sincerely attempt to understand the new culture that surrounds him.
His steady perseverance finally yields fruit when he lands a janitorial job at the local Adams High School, signifying his first step into inner stability within this alien world.
Back in Mexico, the Perez family is found clustered around a sheet of paper that holds the promise of stability - Jose’s first remittance.

A glimpse into his life gives an insight into Jose's life – the small rented room adorned with treasured photographs of his family, serving as constant reminders of his goal, and each paycheck saved meticulously to reunite his family in the land of opportunities.
Jose's routine is disrupted by an eagerly anticipated phone call.
To his jubilant disbelief, his family has been granted visas to join him.
This news brings about both excitement and nervous anticipation.
As the day of their arrival draws closer, Jose’s anxiety & anticipation heighten.
His regular routine replaced by meticulous preparations and counting down the days until he is reunited with his family.
The highly-anticipated day arrives with Jose darting through traffic jams to reach the crowded L.A. Airport.
His heart pounds as he waits for the precious moment when his family’s flight would finally land.
The wait becomes worthwhile as the Perez family finally reunites.

The airport terminal echoes with joyful cries of the children, Maria's quivering relief, and Jose's victorious smile - their group hug amidst the busy crowd symbolizing their hope and reunited strength.
Adapting to the fast-paced life in L.A. unfolds as a challenging endeavour for the family.
The kids grapple with the English language, the diverse culture is alien to Maria, and despite her expertise in sewing, she struggles to find work due to cultural differences.
Despite the struggles, Jose remains the pillar of strength for his family, providing them with a silver lining amidst these challenging situations in their newfound home.
His unwavering spirit and determination start rubbing off on Maria, Miguel, and Sofia.
Slowly, the Perez family settles into their new life.
Maria finds work as a seamstress in a local boutique, the children start making friends at school, and they begin to embrace their new identities as Americans.
Just as their life seems to gain stability, a threatening letter from the immigration office rattles their world.
A simple procedural error sends them spiralling towards the risk of deportation, thereby threatening their newfound stability.
The news of possible deportation strikes like a thunderbolt.
The children weep, unable to fully comprehend the situation, Maria spirals into a deep despair, and a sense of paralysing uncertainty engulfs their life.
Amidst this confusion, there is only one person who refuses to give up - Jose.
His unwavering resolve resonates through his vow to not yield to these circumstances and to fight this threat legally, no matter what it takes.

The narrative focuses on Jose's relentless pursuit of justice, showcasing his ironclad determination combating countless legal tribulations, laboriously striving to correct the apparent mistake that endangered their lives.
The nail-biting climax takes shape in a silent courtroom, awash in the muted morning light.
The court session proceeds as Jose’s immigration lawyer passionately pleads the family’s case as Maria, Sofia, and Miguel, sit in tense anticipation.
Then, the long-awaited verdict – victory.
The Perez family surmounts the gruelling battle and is granted permanent stay in the United States.
Cheers of joy erupt within the courtroom as the family’s victory over deportation sinks in – their relief, joy, and triumphant pride manifest through their tearful hugs amidst a burst of laughter.
Their hard-fought victory turns into a reverberating celebration.
More than just legal triumph, it symbolizes their relentless hope and commitment towards their arduously hewed prosperous future.
A series of significant events unfurl as the Perez family capitalizes on their new lease of life.
The narrative ends on a heartwarming note with the Perez family gathered around their dinner table, sharing a hearty meal.
This image serves as a testament to human resilience, and the virtues of hope, unity, and determination that echoed through their journey.

64552523.title: Half Brothers
synopsis: In 1994 Mexico, Renato Murguia's father Flavio has to immigrate to the US in search of economic opportunity as their country underwent an economic crisis.
Although Flavio promises to return soon, he does not.
25 years later, Renato is a successful aviation company executive based in San Miguel, is engaged to Pamela who already has a son Emilio and is planning to marry.
Renato is contacted by a woman named Katherine, Flavio’s second wife, who tells that Flavio is very ill and wishes for Renato to see him in Chicago.
Renato is still angry at his father for never returning all those years, but reluctantly ends up going to Chicago.
Renato meets Flavio at the hospital for the first time in decades.
Asher, whom Renato first encountered at a coffee shop, appears, which Flavio reveals that both of them are brothers.
leaving them displeased.
Flavio asks them to do one last favor for him, to look for Eloise, after delivering an envelope to a man named Evaristo.
However, Renato, still resentful, refuses and storms out of the hospital on his pleading father.
Flavio dies the next day.

Renato attends the funeral and leaves, despite Asher trying to convince him to fulfill their father’s dying wish, but he eventually relents and turns around to tell Asher to pick him up the next day from his hotel so they can head out.
On the road, Renato falls asleep and wakes up at a goat farm, finding Asher running toward the car with a small goat, as armed men with rifles chase Asher.
The two manages to escape, but Renato yells at Asher for stopping just for a goat farm.
To make matters worse, they are even further away from where they should have been.
After the long detour, they make it to an old factory where Flavio worked there with Katherine and is currently producing radio-controlled airplanes that Renato and Flavio used to play with.
Directed by one of the factory's employees, they meet a man at a Mexican bar across the street named Evaristo, a friend of Flavio who also immigrated to the United States.
Providing them with a key.
Evaristo tells Renato about how Flavio did everything he could to make enough money and return home.
He worked in the factory until he came up with the idea to make the toy planes, which revitalized the company with help from Katherine.

They had a good professional relationship that turned into a one-night stand, until Flavio felt guilty for betraying his old wife, so he left to try and make his way back home once he had enough money.
Evaristo then gives Renato a box with another envelope written as Mr. B, which contains a claim ticket for a pawnshop.
Before they can learn anything else, Asher forces them to run again when he picks a fight with guys he made a bad pool bet with.
The two stop at a motel where they were able to figure out the next location within the claim ticket from Mr. B's envelope to go to a pawn shop in Oklahoma City.
They reach the shop the following morning and meet Mr. B, who presents them with Flavio’s wedding ring.
Mr. B explains that Renato was mugged while on his way for the border.
Beaten and bloodied, he went to the shop and tried to pawn something off.
Unable to afford his personal effects, Mr. B said he would buy Flavio's wedding ring and keep it there until he had the money to buy it back.
After this, he attempted to cross the border but was arrested and thrown in jail.
He got sick afterward, and the guards dumped him on the side of the road to die.
Before telling anything else, Mr. B gives them an envelope for Eloise; it contains a picture of St. Mary's Convent in El Paso, Texas.
Renato, furious and impatient, grabs his bag and tries to head to the airport, but relents upon discovering that he doesn’t have his passport on him.
However, their car runs out of gas and the goat, whom Asher calls "Renatito" had destroyed all of the extra fuel supply, leaving Renato angry and the two had a fight.
While looking for help, they found an unlocked cabin, full of pure alcohol, which Renato plans to process it into gasoline to refuel Asher's car.
Renato flips out upon learning Asher got rid of his passport and locks him up in the bathroom before driving off.
However, he becomes remorseful midway through and tries to turn around but is stopped and arrested by a border patrol officer.
Renato is thrown into detention with other undocumented immigrants until he is bailed out the next morning.

Renato reunites with Asher in a donut shop, who told him that the cabin they broke in belonged to the group of rednecks they previously encountered at a gas station, which they also stole his goat and are planning to eat.
Renato and Asher return to the cabin and fill the place with ethanol vapor to knock out the rednecks and save the goat.
With the US-Mexico border drawing near, Renato decides to go to St. Mary's Convent in El Paso.
They meet a nun who takes them to a cabinet that requires a code.
Renato looks at the envelope with Eloise written on it and then, upon remembering to look at a different perspective, turns it upside down to reveal the combination mean for the cabinet safe.
They open it to find a DVD from Flavio explaining himself to his sons.

After being left for dead by the prison guards, he was found and took care by the church nuns from the convent nearby before he was able to set out to return home but felt remorseful for leaving Katherine without explanation.
When he arrives in Chicago, she had already given birth to Asher.
Not wanting to leave another son behind, he called his old wife to let her, and Renato know that he wasn’t going to come home, and that was when Renato stopped caring for him.
Flavio goes further and explains that although he did love Asher, he tried to recapture too much of Renato in him and distanced himself when he saw that Asher was different.
He explains that he loved both of them and hopes that they can not only forgive him but grow as brothers.
The nun then shows the brothers that Eloise really is an actual plane built by Flavio to pass down to his sons.
Now having a way of getting home, Renato gets ready to part ways with Asher and the goat; Renatito.
However, he changes his mind and invites them both to the wedding.
They fly away together and return to Mexico as they pass above the Sumidero Canyon.
Renato and Pamela get married, and Renato starts to make a bond with Emilio by having him fly a toy plane, which crashes into a nearby house, prompting everyone who witnesses the accident to flee.

59828033.title: Memories Tomorrow (film)
synopsis: The tale begins with the distinguished corporate lawyer, Samuel Parks, engrossed in a deep study of numerous medical documents, situated in the subdued lighting of a neurologist's office.
The gloomy visage of the attending neurologist candidly reveals the dreaded diagnosis before he musters the strength to verbalize it - Samuel has early-stage Alzheimer's disease.
Samuel, processing the earth-shattering news, nods solemnly, indicating his understanding.
He takes a moment before quietly leaving the neurologist’s office, his once rock-solid demeanor seemingly eroded.
He decides to take a solitary walk around the surrounding vicinity, finally settling at a small park nearby.
There, he seats himself on an ancient wooden bench, the worn grains beneath his hands a stark contrast to his own fading memories.
The past unfurls several incidents that showcase the widening gap between Samuel and his daughter, an unfortunate consequence of his never-ending devotion to his high-achieving law career.
His beloved wife's untimely passing added further strains to the already tricky father-daughter relationship, pushing them to a seemingly irreparable rift.
Among these poignant recollections, an unsettling memory bubbles on the surface - an unsolved murder trial, where Samuel faced his hard-hitting defeat.
The shadow of this disputed case lingers ominously in Samuel's consciousness, the guilt gnawing at him as the storytelling unfolds.
In the contemporary plotline, Samuel embarks on a mission to tackle his memory loss by walking down the memory lane, reigniting connections, and reminiscing old times.
He reaches out to familiar faces from his past - former coworkers, friends from his youth - and revisits places that hold a significant place in his memory album.
But the harsh progression of Samuel's condition comes into uncomfortable public view inside the hubbub of a courtroom.
He struggles to keep up with case facts and physically with his deteriorating motor skills, emphasized by the tumble of a water glass that draws unwelcome attention to his condition.
Despite his deteriorating condition, Samuel staunchly decides to take on one last client – a testament to his undying commitment to the legal profession.
A turn of events occurs when an old picture of Samuel in a newspaper article discussing Alzheimer's research inadvertently makes his condition public.
Sarah, now a grown woman, finds herself in emotional turmoil - a mix of lingering resentment for her absent father and newfound sympathy for his ailment.
After an emotional standoff, Sarah finally decides to stand by her father in his battle against time and a fading mind.
A ray of intrigue shines when a resurgence of an old memory leads Samuel to reassess the lost trial that has remained a thorn in his side, unearthing crucial facts that were ignored back then.
This reconsideration of the forgotten trial leaves Samuel wondering if the person he had indicted was, after all, innocent.

Interested in this newfound theory and unwilling to let the truth slide away again, Samuel convinces Sarah to become an ally in his quest to dig deeper into the old case in search for concrete evidence.
An imminent disbarment hearing threatens to interrupt their efforts, sparking urgency in their quest for truth.
Their hands-on inquiry, slow and painstaking, finally uncovers the overlooked proof that reveals the identity of the actual murderer in the previously bungled case.
The courtroom fills to the brim with tension as Samuel stammers through his final testimonial.
As he connects the dots between forgotten facts and fading recall, Samuel presents a bombshell evidence that implicates the real perpetrator.
His emotionally-charged address quiets the tense courtroom, leaving the attendees awestruck by his passion for justice.
The balance of justice swings in Samuel's favor.
The real criminal is exposed and Samuel's former client is cleared of all charges posthumously.
The courtroom reverberates with clapping as Samuel stands triumphant, clutching onto a victory as his world crumbles around him.
A toned-down celebration ensues, with Sarah wrestling between pride for her father's accomplishment and concern for his declining health.
These landmark events culminate in Sarah and Samuel growing closer, rekindling the strained father-daughter relationship, and leading to several heartfelt moments.
As his memory keeps deteriorating, Samuel takes the hard decision to assign Sarah as his legal guardian, entrusting his life in her capable hands.
Samuel's journey gradually transitions into the final phase, marked by his daughter's love and the satisfaction of finally putting his haunting past to rest.
The narrative eventually settles into a poignant departure sequence with Samuel reminiscing in his rocking chair on the front porch, observing the tranquil sunset.
Despite the unknown realm of his disease progression, Samuel radiates contentment derived from a fulfilling life.
His character evolves from a tough, successful lawyer to an emotional, vulnerable father, marking a significant transformation.

61957313.title: Here Today (film)
synopsis: Charlie Burnz is walking to work, having to remind himself of the directions, demonstrating that his memory isn't strong.
He arrives at the studio where he has a storied career as a successful comedy screenwriter.
Later, sitting in on a pitch meeting, Charlie goes on a lunch date with someone who won it at an auction.
Meeting Emma Payge, she explains her cheating ex-boyfriend won the auction as Charlie is his hero.
By taking his lunch date, she gets some revenge.
They get on well, but she has a severe allergic reaction to her shellfish.
Accompanying her to the hospital, Emma claims Charlie is her adoptive dad.
He gets stuck with the bill and later has to stab her with an Epi pen.
He has enjoyed himself but doubts he will see her again.
Charlie meets with his physician, who talks of his early stage of dementia.
He hasn't told his family nor his employer.
That night, Charlie attends a recorded discussion of one of his most successful movies.
Interviewed by Bob Costas with the film's director Barry Levinson and lead actors Sharon Stone and Kevin Kline, Charlie forgets the names of his fellow panelists, playing it off as a joke.
Afterwards, Charlie is surprised by Emma, who attends to support him, as she now genuinely likes him.
She also repays him for the hospital visit.
Charlie accompanies Emma to her job as a singer for a band, and is very impressed by her talent.
Afterwards, he explains the unfinished novel she saw is meant to be a memoir celebrating his life with his late wife Carrie and his children Rex and Francine.
Charlie admits writer's block and also has a strained relationship with the kids.
The same night, Emma asks Charlie how he met Carrie in a message.
This helps him focus and he begins to write his novel.
In a flashback, Charlie and Carrie met by chance while walking on the same beach.
After light conversation, he invites her to his house to remove tar from her feet.
They hit it off, declaring their love for each other after a few dates.
Later, Charlie has a breakdown when his route to work is blocked.
Then, during a live show, he has an episode.
Angry at the cast member who can't enunciate properly, thereby ruining jokes with his poor performance, Charlie walks onstage.
He critiques the actor and engages the crowd, the performance is lauded and goes viral.
Although everyone initially thinks Charlie was simply engaged in brilliant improv, it soon becomes apparent that he is unwell.
Emma rushes to the studio after seeing the live show, explaining Charlie's situation.
Darrell writes a tribute to him online, providing cover for what happened.
Meanwhile, Francine thinks Charlie was drunk and is disgusted.
Charlie’s granddaughter Lindsay arrives unexpectedly at his home while Emma is out.
She tearfully explains that she overheard Francine blame Charlie for Carrie's death behind his back.
He embraces his granddaughter, saying he will take them somewhere special to cheer her up.
When Francine finds Lindsay is missing, she and Rex go to Charlie's, finding Emma also looking for him.
They soon realize he took a rideshare service, so they track him to the country.
As they all drive to him, Emma tells Rex and Francine about his dementia.
They find Lindsay in tears as Charlie had an episode and ran into the woods without her.
Realizing they are at their childhood cabin, Francine and Rex rush to find Charlie.
He wholeheartedly apologizes for his past mistakes.
The family tearfully embraces and forgives him, and also accepts Emma as part of the family.
Forward in time, Charlie and Emma are at the cabin on Lake Charlie with Rex, Francine, Lindsay, and Darrell.
Francine and Rex reminisce about their childhood as Darrell transcribes the stories for the book.
At the sunset, they all go together to the lake to watch it.
Charlie sees Carrie's spirit watching it alongside them, and smiles.

3470905.title: Hilda and the Monarch of the Petrified Jungle
synopsis: Our story begins ominously in the Petrified Jungle, a chilling landscape home to eerie, ghost-like figures fashioned from stone – these were once creatures vibrant with life, but now exist as grim reminders of Hilda's spell cast astray.
The protagonist, Hilda, is framed as a lone figure amidst these grim figures, holding an air of melancholy.
An icy flashback throws light on the fateful moment when Hilda's mother was consumed by a malignant force, morphing her into a nightmarish entity.
This horrific transformation sets the stage for a journey that Hilda, weighed down by guilt and trepidation, has to undertake alongside her deformed mother.
Hilda summons courage from her deepest being, formulating a strategic plan to evade her monstrous, rampaging mother and restore balance.
However, an unforeseen effect of her spell traps Hilda under the sunlight, turning her into a stone statue.
While Hilda's world freezes, the town falls into sheer terror as whispers of an age-old prophecy foreshadowing apocalyptic events begin to circulate among the townsfolk.
The prophecy warns of the resurrection of an ancient king, whose rise would unleash destruction on the city.
Hilda's loyal friends, Frida and David, stumble upon Hilda’s petrified figure, triggering fear and frustration.
Struck by despair, they vow to reverse this curse and bring back their Hilda.
As they plot their next move, the prophecy initiates its manifestation.
The dreaded king of the Petrified Jungle rises from his resting place beneath the earth and descends chaos upon the city.
Social order crumbles, and devastation sweeps through the town under the king's rule.
Against the backdrop of the crumbling city, Hilda’s petrified form begins to dream, unlocking the truth behind her transformation.
Frida and David embark on a quest to find the Old Troll, an enigmatic figure who might hold the antidote to the petrification curse.
The Old Troll delivers the Sunlight’s Tear, a relic able to reverse petrification but only during a solar eclipse.
A total solar eclipse takes over the city, and Frida and David put the artifact to use, initiating a magical transformation that makes her a hybrid being.
Awoken from her stony slumber, Hilda directly challenges the king to restore her city.
A fierce fight ensues, and the king attempts to cast a city-wide petrification spell.
But Hilda uses Sunlight’s Tear, deflecting the spell back at him.
The king becomes an immovable statue, forever frozen in his moment of defeat.
Hilda uses the remnants of the Sunlight’s Tear to reverse her mother’s transformation.
The city gradually heals, and the inhabitants see Hilda as their savior.
To celebrate their victory, the townsfolk organize a grand feast, with their hearts filled with gratitude for Hilda.
Hilda reunites with her mother, bringing a sense of closure and restoration.
A glimpsing final scene shows Hilda, along with David and Frida, preparing to navigate the unknown for more adventures.
The story closes on a hopeful note, with Hilda's triumph and unity with her friends and family offering reassurance that the city is in safe hands.

68782459.title: Hilda and the Mountain King
synopsis: Picking up from the season 2 finale "The Stone Forest", Hilda, now a troll, runs away from Trylla, her troll mom, and is petrified by the sunlight when she leaves the Stone Forest.
Meanwhile, in Trolberg, Johanna discovers Baba in Hilda's place, and Tontu deduces Hilda had been the victim of a changeling spell.
Realizing what this means, Johanna, Baba, Tontu, Alfur, and Twig go searching for Hilda but are unable to locate the entrance into the Stone Forest.
Elsewhere, Erik Ahlberg holds a press conference in which he announces a curfew because of the increasing troll activity outside Trolberg.
While watching, David's mom becomes intrigued by an advertisement to volunteer for the Trolberg Safety Patrol.
Later, the students of Edmund Ahlberg Elementary School are shown a safety video about trolls, but Frida and David protest the inaccurate information portrayed in the video.
As evening approaches and with still no sign of Hilda, Johanna runs into a group of Safety Patrol officers, and reluctantly returns home.
After sunset, Hilda unpetrifies, and finds herself unable to return to Trolberg because of the belltowers.
As she retreats, Hilda stumbles upon a huge cave with dozens of bells hanging from the top of the entrance.
Inside, she finds a gigantic troll, who calls himself Trundle.
He tells Hilda he will help her become human again if she completes some tasks for him.
He also assures her that Trylla means no harm, and Hilda reluctantly returns to Trylla.
They retreat into the Stone Forest to escape the rising sun.

When the two arrive outside the mountains, Hilda "feels" a strange sound, which Trylla explains is something that all trolls hear, calling them to the city of Trolberg, and that the call has been growing stronger lately.

Frida and David discover Hilda's predicament when Baba escapes from Tontu's care and so Frida, against the advice of Kaisa, the librarian skilled in witchcraft, unsuccessfully attempts a body swap spell.
Night falls again, and Hilda begins the first of the tasks given to her by Trundle by secretly bringing a cup of troll mead to him.
Trundle then instructs her to remove the bells that trap him in the cave.
Later, Trylla shows Hilda the ruins of the castle of the Mountain King, a giant troll who tried to rally the trolls into attacking Trolberg, but was defeated.
Hilda doubles down on helping Trundle after Trylla tells her that the changeling spell cannot be undone.
She uses pillows, stolen from a troll's treasure collection, to silence and remove the bells.
Elsewhere, Johanna and Alfur find the entrance to the Stone Forest, but the trolls close it before they can enter.
The two are then attacked by a group of aggressive trolls and narrowly escape.
The following morning, Johanna begrudgingly seeks Erik Ahlberg's help as a last resort.
Frustrated by being unable to help Hilda, Frida suggests that she and David sneak out of the city so she can try magically communicating with a troll like she did with the mother Kraken in season 2.
Meanwhile, Trundle sends Hilda on her final errand: to bring him a large red orb, hidden in the ruins of the castle among the hoard of the Mountain King.
When Hilda touches it, she is thrown into a strange vision in which a giant creature resembling her mom looms over the walls of Trolberg.
Hilda is then whisked back into reality, and she attempts to bring the red orb back to Trundle, only to be attacked by a giant bearded troll.
Outside, Ahlberg, Johanna, Baba, Alfur, and Tontu arrive at the entrance to the Stone Forest.
Just as Baba opens the entrance, Hilda rushes out, chased by the bearded troll.
A fight ensues, ending with Ahlberg being knocked unconscious and Hilda causing the troll to accidentally crush Johanna's car and fall into a ravine.
Hilda and her mom are reunited and they bring the orb to Trundle's cave.
Trylla, having followed them, appears and is reunited with Baba, reversing the changeling spell, and making Hilda human again, and Baba a troll again.
Suddenly, Trundle bursts from his prison, unveiling the orb to be his eye.
With his sight now restored, it is revealed that he is the Mountain King, and he incites the trolls to storm Trolberg.

In Trolberg, David distracts his mom in the belltower so Frida can make a mental connection with one of the trolls, and she sees a similar vision to the one Hilda saw; a giant troll-like being resembling her mom, attacking the city.
Meanwhile, Trundle begins destroying the bell towers but is halted by the arrival of the bearded troll, revealed to be his brother.
Refusing to fight him, Trundle has his followers restrain his brother before breaching the city wall.
The Safety Patrol arrives to fight off the attack, with Ahlberg taking back control.

Hilda, remembering the vision from Trundle's eye, realizes that the mother of all trolls lies underneath the city, and she will rise up to defend her children if the Safety Patrol attacks them, destroying all of Trolberg in the process.
Hilda attempts to prevent the attack, but Ahlberg refuses to listen to her, and uses the Safety Patrol's cannon to destroy Trundle, awakening the mother troll.
In a last-ditch attempt to stop him, Hilda takes Trundle's eye and throws it into Ahlberg's face, causing him to see a similar vision to what Hilda saw.
Now understanding what is at stake, Ahlberg orders the Safety Patrol to stand down.
The mother troll stops trying to get up, and the trolls all walk peacefully to the center of the city where she rests.

Using Frida's magic, Hilda and Frida learn her identity: Amma, the mother and grandmother of all trolls, having laid dormant for centuries so as to not disturb the humans who built Trolberg above her.

For a while, the trolls could still reconnect with their buried mother, but then the settlers, unaware of Amma's presence and thus why the creatures kept wandering into the city, drove them away, eventually erecting a wall to keep them out.
Now that the trolls are close enough to Amma, they can finally hear her voice again, causing them to sprout plants all over their bodies.
In the aftermath, Ahlberg resigns after accepting a medal for his eventual handling of the crisis and relinquishes control of the Safety Patrol to his deputy Gerda Gustav.
Gustav immediately announces a "Night of the Trolls", in which the trolls are allowed into the city once a year to reunite with Amma.
While some humans still fear the trolls and vice versa, the annual peaceful exposure is gradually eroding the mutual fear between the two species.
Hilda's and Baba's families still maintain contact with each other, with Baba occasionally visiting Hilda's home and Hilda occasionally spending a night in the mountains with Trylla and Baba.

28199569.title: Ergot Exodus
synopsis: The eerie silence of the movie's opening sequence is shattered by the chaotic symphony of news reports from esteemed outlets like CNN, BBC, and Al Jazeera.
They narrate a disturbing series of events - mysterious crop failures occurring at an alarming rate across the major agricultural states like Nebraska and Iowa.
Meanwhile, in the vibrant heart of Chicago, Jack, a street magician renowned for his unbelievable card tricks, takes in the alarming news unfold with a growing sense of curiosity and mounting worry.

After spending days contemplatively immersed in these unfolding events, Jack, driven by an inexplicable compulsion, decides to journey to the heart of the crisis - the beleaguered town of Millwood, Iowa.
Before embarking on his mission, Jack enrolls in a lecture on plant pathology at the University of Illinois where he crosses paths with Emma, a young mycologist fiercely dedicated to her craft.

Bonding over their shared fascination with the strange phenomena wreaking havoc on the Heartland, Jack and Emma quickly form an unlikely friendship and they set off for their destination - the troubled farming communities of America's Midwest that are grappling with an unforeseen catastrophe.
The dismal sight of Millwood, eerily deserted and practically abandoned, strikes an immediate blow to their optimism.
Undeterred by the bleak surroundings, they immediately get to work.
Over the following days, they set up a makeshift lab in the deserted town, meticulously analysing the collected samples.
After extensive research, they identify the root of the problem - a unique, virulent strain of fungus they not-so-fondly name Exoprin.

The tension reaches a fever pitch when a local farmer's innocent eight-year-old girl begins displaying frightening symptoms, her small body ridden with purple blisters eerily similar to the infected wheat.
Overcome with dread, Jack and Emma come to a terrifying realization – the vicious Exoprin strain isn't just a threat to plants, but it possesses a chilling ability to infect human hosts as well.
Despite increasing adversity and personal risk from the pathogenic fungus, Jack and Emma press on with their commitment to uncover the full extent of the unfolding crisis.
Fearing the rampant spread of the devastating infection, surrounding towns hastily blockade their borders.
This act of self-preservation effectively isolates Jack and Emma, further intensifying their situation.

Emma puts her tireless dedication and scientific expertise into overdrive as she works relentlessly in their makeshift lab, desperate to find a solution to the deadly fungal strain that now threatens human hosts.
Jack, leveraging his unique street magic skills, distracts the infected townsfolk with his entrancing performances.
These captivating performances serve two purposes - to keep the infected calm and provide Emma with additional samples of the mutating fungus.
The journey takes a dangerous turn as Jack, while attempting a riskier performance among the infected, is ambushed by some of the inhabitants.
As chaos unfolds, Emma experiences a critical breakthrough, isolating a bacteriophage within the lab that displays potential in neutralizing Exoprin's devastating effects.
Infected settlers, writhing in distress, ominously close in.
Complicating matters further, Emma falls ill, with symptoms reminiscent of the violent fungal infection.
Jack, battling his own fear but steadfast in his resolve, aerosols the potential cure among the teeming infected.
Having accomplished his task, he succumbs to his own latent infection, collapsing amidst the chaos.
Emma, steadily gaining strength and recovering, spends her time by Jack's ICU bed.
A triumphant ceremony of gratitude is held in the town's square, the faces of the recovering residents reflecting newfound respect and appreciation for the duo’s heroic efforts.
The film concludes on a hopeful note, the shot lingers on Emma's hand intertwined with Jack's, symbolizing their shared victory over adversity.
The entire town of Millwood and indeed the country wait in collective anticipation for Jack, their local hero, to awaken from his coma.

66951640.title: Honeydew (film)
synopsis: Aspiring actor Sam and his botanist girlfriend Rylie have travelled to rural New England  to investigate an outbreak of an ergot-type fungus called "sordico" that has been devastating local farms.
They camp on a remote farm after their car breaks down, but elderly farmer Eulis, claiming to be the landowner, asks the couple to leave.
Sam and Rylie return to their car to discover its battery died, leaving them stranded.

They look for help at a nearby farmhouse and meet Karen, an eccentric old woman, and her supposed son Gunni, who is mute, partially catatonic, constantly watching vintage cartoons, and wears bandages around his head.
Karen explains Gunni’s behavior by claiming a bull kicked him in the head.
Karen calls a mechanic named Pete to come and jumpstart the couple’s car.

While waiting, she feeds Sam and Rylie strange food that conflicts with their strict vegan diet, while also engaging in odd conversation, which includes Rylie asking about weird Polaroids of Karen’s family.
When Pete fails to show up, Karen sets up Sam and Rylie with sleeping arrangements in the cellar.
Addicted after years of maintaining his diet, Sam leaves Rylie alone to gorge on more of Karen’s food in the kitchen, and Gunni experiences a seizure while seemingly trying to say something to Sam.
Sam then passes out and has a dream where everyone turns into Popeye characters discussing a medical condition with his stomach.
Meanwhile, Rylie investigates unsettling sounds in the cellar.
Sam returns to the basement to find her missing, and he also discovers Karen is gone from her bedroom.
Sam calls 911 before investigating Karen’s barn.
However, once he is inside, Karen injects Sam with a drug that knocks him unconscious.
Sam and Rylie recover to find themselves restrained on a raised platform and wearing breathing masks connected to gas tanks, one of Sam’s buttocks bleeding and bandaged.
Karen, Eulis, and Gunni eat at a picnic table beneath the couple.
Driven mad from sordico and justifying their lifestyle through a misinterpretation of God’s will, Karen explains that she and Eulis became cannibals to compensate for crops turning bad.
Karen additionally reveals that she and Eulis “adopt” unwilling participants to feed on.
Gunni is revealed to have been a random hunter who was lobotomized before Karen and Eulis began cutting off body parts like his cheeks to eat.
Karen and Eulis open a crate containing Delilah, a lobotomized woman without limbs whom they call their daughter.
Karen and Eulis feed Delilah pieces of Gunni’s cooked rump flesh.
Eulis prepares to lobotomize Sam when a cop unexpectedly interrupts.
While Karen and Eulis deal with the police officer, Sam talks Gunni into freeing him and Rylie.
After the cop leaves, Karen and Eulis catch Sam, Rylie, and Gunni trying to escape.
Gunni dies after triggering an animal trap.
Karen recaptures Sam and Rylie.
Some time later, Rylie is seen in Gunni’s seat at Karen’s table.
Rylie is lobotomized, wearing head bandages from having her cheeks eaten, and is visibly pregnant too.
In the basement, Sam is seen having been turned into a semi-sentient torso like Delilah.
After feeding them, Karen forces Sam and Delilah to have sex.

48658351.title: Coastal Curve
synopsis: Mary, a sophisticated web designer hailing from bustling New York City, embarks on her well-earned sabbatical.
She meanders her way to 'Mango Coast,' a heavenly tropical beachside lounge nestled in the quaint corners of the sleepy fishing town of Talisay.
However, she is captivated by the town's simplicity contrasted against the backdrop of its cultural richness.
Mary finds herself weaving invisible bonds of friendship with the warm, outgoing town folks.
She becomes particularly close to Jack, the charismatic bartender of the lounge, and Lolo Juan, a respected elder carrying the wisdom of Talisay in his stories.
As the final night of her planned stay arises, the locals pour out their love and hospitality by throwing her a heartwarming farewell party.
While Mary gets swept up in the joyous ambiance, she accidentally chances upon a furtive conversation between two dubious-looking men.
Their veiled political tones hint at something more than meets the eye - whispers of illegal smuggling activities polluting their serene town.
Alarmed and driven by concern for her new friends, Mary makes a spur-of-the-moment decision to extend her stay.
Conviction stirs within her to investigate these unusual encounters that threaten the tranquility of Talisay.
Utilizing her dormant laptop, she begins an in-depth investigation into the nefarious activities.
With her fingertips briskly gliding over the keys, she hacks into deeply encoded networks, slowly uncovering a trail of digital breadcrumbs left by the suspect culprits.
As the investigation unfolds, Mary makes the chilling discovery of a widespread network of illegal trade humming under the picturesque charm of Talisay.
The reality goes beyond her initial suspicions, causing her concern to transmute into fear.
Faced with an imminent threat, she confides in Jack, her trusted local friend, unveiling her disturbing findings about the unimaginable threats lurking within their beautiful beach town.
Jack, drawn by Mary's dedication and bravery, pledges to stand by her in exposing the villains despite understanding the inherent risks involved.

They scour through encrypted emails, questionable online financial transactions, and cryptic shipping records, unraveling an intricate smuggling operation camouflaged by the innocent-looking fishing docks of Talisay.
However, amid this complex network of deceit, the real puppeteer, the elusive mastermind referred to in hushed tones by the locals as 'El Jefe,' remains shrouded in mystery.
On a veiled moonless night, Mary and Jack courageously spy on a concealed transaction unfolding at the shadow-ridden docks.
Using an old, barely functional film camera, they manage to capture vital images that would serve as solid proof.
Their mission takes an unforeseen turn when a vigilant guard spots them, igniting a frantic chase through the labyrinthine twists and turns of Talisay's narrow streets.
They manage a narrow escape in their worn-out pickup truck, leaving a trail of frenzied criminals fearing the imminent exposure of their battery of crimes.
When the vengeful kingpin retaliates by abducting Jack and leaving behind a threatening mannequin, Mary is overwhelmed by a cocktail of guilt and fear for her newfound friend.
However, she staunchly chooses to advance rather than retreat from the unfolding dramatic chain of events.

Fueled by desperation and determination, Mary contacts Detective Hernandez, a renowned detective infamous in Manila for cracking high-profile cases, unveiling her journey and the imminent threat looming over Talisay.

Intrigued by the audacious audacity of Mary's hunt and the tantalizing prospect of nabbing a colossal smuggling ring, Detective Hernandez concedes to take up the case based on Mary's irrefutable evidence.
Joining forces with Hernandez and his skilled police taskforce, they pencil out a daring plan to ensnare the kingpin right on the territory he probably thought was the safest - Mango Coast.
The risky plan relies heavily on offering Mary as bait, fooling the kingpin into believing that she was openly risking their operation by spilling its secrets to a fabricated contact from Antigua.
With the tight-knit plan in place, surveillance devices discreetly planted in the lounge, and Mary dressed in a discreet wired microphone, she takes a brave plunge into the pit.
As the night inches to its climax, a shroud of tension envelopes the lounge.
With her heart pounding, Mary manages to deceive the kingpin and his minions, convincing them she's on a suicidal mission of spilling their operations.
At the crucial moment, when the infuriated kingpin corners Mary, Detective Hernandez and his team initiate their aggressive takedown.
Arresting the criminals red-handed and in full view of the lounge patrons, the police strike with swift precision, turning the pristine beachside lounge into an unexpected scene of justice.
In the ensuing chaos, the cornered kingpin attempts to use Mary as a human shield in a desperate bid to escape.
However, Hernandez's strategic maneuvering skillfully disarms him, ensuring Mary remains unharmed.
With El Jefe finally in custody, the police launch a swift rescue operation based on the locations revealed during interrogation.
Jack is found bereft but safe in an abandoned warehouse on the fringes of the town.
Their tenacious investigation unveils the sinister underbelly of the seemingly peaceful Talisay, leaving the town shell-shocked.
Yet, it brings a plethora of relief as their town is purged of its haunting menace.
Although quite a detour from her initial plans, Mary chooses to continue residing in Talisay with Jack.
Remembering her ordeal, Mary, with her tech acumen, collaborates with Jack and his local knowledge.
Together, they commence cyber threat seminars for local business proprietors.
Stirred by their horrifying experience, they pioneer a cybercrime awareness drive.
It aims to equip the locals with the necessary knowledge, thereby providing an armor of defense against such insidious threats in the future.
Mary's sabbatical, initially planned as a leisurely break, morphs into an inspirational saga of courage, communal service, and endearing friendships.
She now views her stay not as a mere getaway but as a profound journey fusing with her destiny.
Yearning to contribute further to Talisay's safety, she relinquishes her plans of ever leaving this community which has now become her second home.
Jack, the once friendly and unassuming bartender, now stands beside Mary as a celebrated town hero.
He switches his cocktail shaker for cyber safety manuals, aiding Mary in her newfound mission.
While adjusting to her revamped daily schedule, Mary faithfully continues iterative improvements to her mission.
Her initial career takes a backseat, the former ambitious web designer now braving the frontline in her battle against cybercrime.
Jack, too, prepares to step into this new status quo.
Mango Coast would continue serving its signature cocktails during operational hours, but his after-hours are now consumed with their fight against digital villains.
Their peaceful beach getaway envisioned initially has evolved into an unforgettable adventure etched with lessons on friendship, bravery, and the triumph of good over evil.

Thus, Mary's unexpected sabbatical in the tropical haven of Talisay culminates in a surprising turn of events, drawing the curtains to a thrilling tale while setting the stage for several more compelling narratives to follow.

63087976.title: Horizon Line
synopsis: Sara is at an island bar and is getting ready to head home.
She is with a boyfriend and he asks her for one more drink before she goes.
He orders, then heads out of the bar (presumably to the bathroom), and she leaves, as she has stated that she "hates goodbyes."
Fast forward one year later in London, Sara takes a cab to the airport to leave for a wedding.

Visiting Mauritius for her friend's wedding, Sara hooks up with ex-boyfriend Jackson, misses the last boat to the wedding venue on Rodrigues, and hitches a ride on a small plane piloted by her friend, Freddy Wyman, who is also going to the wedding.
She is surprised when it turns out that Jackson has also arranged to fly with Freddy to the wedding.
Freddy invites Sara to the co-pilot seat while Jackson sleeps.
During the flight Freddy has a heart attack and passes away, sending the plane into freefall.
Sara and Jackson recover, but the autopilot is damaged, and they are faced with the fact that Sara, who Freddy has taught some basics, will need to fly the plane to get them to safety.
They manage to contact Samuel, a local air traffic controller, on the shortwave radio, and he attempts to guide them to safety, but they have to fly through a storm first.
They manage to get through the storm but not before they damage their compass.
The plane is also starting to lose fuel at an alarming rate.
Jackson volunteers to climb out of the plane to try to patch a fuel line.
While successful, he badly breaks his arm.
The pair decides to shed weight, including the lifeless body of Freddy, to save fuel.
Sara realizes they have several bottles of rum that they can use as extra fuel, and she attempts to manually refuel the plane by climbing out the window.
Jackson manages the repair of the fuel line, breaking his arm, almost falls to his death, but Sara pulls him back into the plane.
Sara then must go outside the plane and pour Solomons “rocket fuel” in for temporary refueling.
They try to raise Samuel, but the radio is silent.
As the plane runs out of fuel, they spot a small island and attempt to glide the stricken plane to the island.
The plane crashes into the sea and flips.
Sara rescues Jackson, who got stuck at the wing of the submerged plane, and both barely escape and swim to the barren island.
They make it to the island only to discover that it is just a sandbar that will shortly disappear as the tide rises.
As the sandbar disappears, they stay afloat, but Jackson, sensing he is sure to die, offers Sara his life vest.
Sara declines, telling him they are a team.
Jackson professes his love for Sara as they sense the end is near, but just then a fishing vessel that heard their radio transmission arrives to rescue them.

95441045.title: Terror in the Vast Chihuahuan
synopsis: Set against a grim backdrop of scorched, sepia-hued landscapes of the sun-battered Chihuahuan Desert in West Texas, the movie commences.

An enigmatic narration reveals the nefarious history of the desert, accompanied by fleeting, grainy footage on local news broadcasts that proclaim it as a breeding ground for countless unsettling disappearances spanning across the years.
We are introduced to the protagonist, John Smith, in the musty corners of the 'Dead Horse Tavern', a local watering hole steeped in folklore.
The rustic tavern buzzes with locals chattering about the desert's chilling secrets.
Unperturbed by the ominous warnings about the lethal history of the desert and its inexplicable disappearances, John dares to embark on a solitary journey into the desert’s bleak depths.
We get our first peek into John’s past as a husband and father through fragmented flashbacks.
The loss of his family in a car accident has chiseled a sorrow-filled path, nudging him to seek solace in isolation.
As he ventures deeper into the desert, he stumbles upon an eerie, crumbling adobe house festooned by cryptic symbols only understood by a long-lost civilization.
As dusk veils the house, John is pestered by unsettling apparitions and distorted whispers.
John uncovers an ancient diary hidden within the innards of the crumbling house.
The diary is a chronicle of bizarre ceremonies and macabre occurrences that took place, causing him to question his sanity.
As midnight strikes, a demonic nightmare ensues.
The house unleashes its malicious energy, transforming what was once an adventure into a desperate fight for survival.
The terrifying recounts of the diary come to life, sucking John into a whirlpool of ghostly apparitions and chilling encounters.
Decrypting the maddening diary entries, John stumbles across a ritual, a potential lifeline, a solution to calm the house's evil energy.
The climax is suffused with apprehension as John is forced to battle not just vengeful spirits but his personal regrets.
The desert’s cruel reality intertwines with his traumatic past further amplifying the chilling climax.
In the face of terror, John draws strength from his most painful memories.
The confrontation reignites a will to survive, enabling him to vanquish the spectral threats and liberate himself from their lethal grip.
Emerging from a broken shell, John steps out from the horrific desert as a changed man, a beacon of hope for lost souls.
The movie propels in time revealing police officers finding John's well-preserved journal in the haunted house.
Finally, we see John in his twilight years at the 'Dead Horse Tavern', narrating his chilling encounters with the supernatural to a rapt traveler.
The movie concludes on a haunting note as the camera slowly pans down revealing the same cryptic symbols from the adobe house, now engraved on the wooden bar table.

69643418.title: Horror in the High Desert
synopsis: In the style of a documentary film, the first part focuses on the police "missing person" report of amateur hiker Gary Hinge: Toward the end of July 2017, Gary hiked to an unspecified area in the Great Basin Desert (Nevada).
His starting point was the town of Ruth and his target was presumably a cabin he had approached on a previous expedition.
When he was two days past his estimated return date and did not return home, his housemate Simon Rodgers alerted Gary's sister, Beverly Hinge, who in turn notified the police.
More than a week had passed since Gary had last been seen.
Initially, the police conducted a search based on the last GPS location of Gary's cell phone.
Local and state police were involved, as well as park rangers and even volunteer groups.
A few days later, it was reported that Gary's truck had been found, 55 miles from his departure in Ruth, Nevada, at the end of a dirt road at the bottom of a small hill.
This finding prompted search parties, who covered large areas on foot, by helicopter and with the use of drones.
None of the groups were able to find any trace or indication of Gary's location.

When several more days passed without any news, the police terminated the search, as they considered that the chances of finding Gary alive were already practically nil, due to the fact that he used to travel with minimal supplies, water and equipment, which left him at the mercy of the weather (the hottest time of the year) and other dangers, such as the local fauna or the fact that there are multiple abandoned mining pits in the area.
As time went by, the media stopped reporting on it.
Subsequently, Beverly hired a private investigator, William 'Bill' Salerno, so that the case would not be abandoned.
A reporter from a local media outlet, Gal Roberts, decided to convince her editor to keep on top of the story, lest it be forgotten as a "cold case".
Thus, the investigation then focused on the clues that could be obtained from the truck, now considered a crime scene.
Two aspects stood out; first, numerous fingerprints that did not match Gary Hinge's were found all over the truck, especially on the steering wheel.
In addition, a trail of barefoot footprints, also not matching Gary's, was found.
Since the John Doe's fingerprints did not match any database, the police found themselves at a dead end.

In parallel, Bill Salerno started digging into Gary's social networks and Gal Roberts finds a promising clue in the video blog where Gary used to post his hiking and survival adventures, under the alias "Scorpion Sam".
The hiker had some 50,000 followers, a fact unknown to his family and people close to him.
Several of his readers believe they have some idea about Gary's final whereabouts, and that the question about his final destination could be related to some of his publications.

In the next to last of the published videos, Gary appears in frame from his home, narrating a very unusual experience, which had left him very disturbed: In his last excursion, he had been walking for three days in an unknown area, when he noticed the smell of smoke.
Following that trail, he found a dilapidated-looking cabin, as if abandoned, but with smoke coming out of an old chimney.
However, a sense of "imminent danger" caused him to move away from the site and make camp away from the area.
The next morning, Gary reported that he found a trail of barefoot footprints, and on the way back to his truck, he felt he was being watched, and even felt he was being followed.

This publication had a lot of comments, most of them negative, where followers expressed serious doubts about Gary's account, questioning why he had not recorded anything and did not present any evidence; another large number of comments were from users demanding him to give the coordinates of the place and another part of the visitors of his blog challenged him to come back.

Feeling the victim of cyber-bullying and visibly affected, Gary recorded and uploaded one last video, explaining that he would not give the exact location of the mystery cabin, since he did not want to encourage inexperienced people to venture into those desert regions, and informed that he would return to the site, accompanied by his video camera and a gun for protection.

Several weeks after the truck was found and search and rescue efforts were completed, a group of hikers in White Pine County reported that a backpack, which turned out to be the property of Gary Hinge, had been left at their campsite.
Upon checking the contents of the backpack, aside from Gary's belongings and identification, his severed hand was found, still holding his video camera.
Forensic analysis revealed that the hand had been severed from the victim while he was still alive, within a period of no more than five weeks.
When authorities examined the memory card inserted into the camera, they discovered what happened to Gary on one fateful night.

The footage found reveals that Gary was indeed able to find his way back to the mystery cabin; his first video entry was recorded at dusk, mentioning that he had been on the road for a day and a half and was sure of the route.
Subsequently, he finds various markers he had left from his previous visit.

Next, the following recordings consist of video fragments all recorded under infrared light, starting with Gary talking very frightened; he comments that he is already very close to the cabin and that he can smell smoke, as in the previous time.
Suddenly, he hears chanting that seems to be a human voice, although it seems distorted.
Once he finds the cabin, Gary confirms that it is the same one he saw earlier.
While filming the outside of the cabin, Gary detects a human silhouette moving towards him.

Being very careful not to make noise on the rocky ground, Gary tries to move away from the site, but is eventually spotted by a human-like being, but with severe physical deformities, who attacks him and the camera stops recording.

Both the reporter and the private investigator speculate what or who might have attacked and killed Gary; it is mentioned that the police have made this footage public in the hope that someone in the audience might offer some additional clue, which has sparked a series of conspiracy theories linking Gary's disappearance to real or supernatural issues as diverse as Area 51, atomic testing, local Indigenous rituals, satanic groups or extraterrestrials.
However, Gal Roberts expresses serious concerns about the fact that at least 17 social media accounts have taken it upon themselves to make expeditions to the area.

Additionally, one of these groups is said to have posted that they have managed to find the trail of the cabin and its mysterious occupant, and that they will reveal the results of their expedition in 2022.

35698591.title: Deceitful Guardianship
synopsis: The film begins by subtly introducing the character Jane Doe who nestles comfortably in the center of power dynamics.
A legal guardian by profession, she exploits the law at its seams in the quiet and unsuspecting town of Whitfield.
Using her masterful manipulation skills, she systematically overrides court decisions to serve her personal interest.
Jane blames her striking blue eyes for her persuasive power, manipulating her clients with her words wrapped in deceptive innocence.
Her peculiar knack of wrapping herself with an air of sweetness and care enables her to effortlessly ensnare the elderly of the town under her caregiving.
She manipulates their entrapped vulnerability, fostering an emotional dependency on her which she exploits to gain control over their vast estates.
Despite being consciously aware of the unjustifiable and possibly illegal dimension of her activities, Jane continues veiling her hidden schemes under the mask of compassion and respectability.
She ingeniously plays the confused altruist each time her integrity is questioned by those few who happen to see through her ruse.
The town sees the arrival of Sam, an out-of-place New Yorker with a bold passion for journalism.
The truth-seeking journalist is instantly intrigued by the unusually high frequency of court-assigned guardianship cases in Whitfield.
Sam’s journalist instinct kicks in when he notices an alarming number of suspicious patterns in Jane’s extensive record.
A gut feeling, perhaps the whisper of his experience, instigates him to delve deeper into her transactions.

From digging out past records to tracing clients’ financial histories, Sam meticulously uncovers Jane’s crooked tracks revealing her dark history embedded with fraudulent cases reaching out to numerous towns.
Jane, realizing that Sam is on to her deceitful games, conceals her restlessness under an untouched exterior while clandestinely plotting her moves intending to de-track Sam.
In a thrilling sequence of events, Jane cleverely spins a web of false accusations around Sam involving him in a scandal of manipulating sensitive information.
This gutsy move successfully soils Sam's professional credibility and reputation within the town.
Meanwhile, oblivious to this heated cat and mouse chase, Jane begins to fix her vulture eyes onto Mrs. Parker, Whitfield’s affluent yet frail woman.
The frail woman's vast fortune beckons Jane, luring her into plotting the subtle takeover of Mrs. Parker.

Amidst the brewing chaos, Emily, Mrs. Parker’s daughter, a sharp-minded white-collar worker raised among the fast-paced streets of London, panics at the news of her mother’s rapidly declining health and hastily flies back home to Whitfield.
Realizing the unusual affection Jane showers on her mother, Emily suspects a narrative that exists beyond normal sights.
This sparks an unspoken feud between the guarded Emily and the cunning Jane.
Sensing Emily's discerning eye, Jane uses her expertise in forgery to create evidence of elder abuse against Emily.
Emily gradually finds herself entrapped in Jane's well-planned scheme, floundering in the face of the mounting accusations.
Distraught yet determined, Emily reaches out to the crumbled figure of Sam, set aside by the society for his supposed crimes.
Seeing a ray of hope in his experienced demeanor, Emily entrusts him with the task of unmasking Jane's vicious plans.
Sam, fueled by the possibility of redemption through unearthing Jane's malicious operation, collaborates with Emily.
Despite the unfolding chaos, he sees a window of opportunity to uncover Jane's carefully hidden web of deceitful transactions.
Emily and Sam, although a pair as unlikely as any, find themselves united under one mission: to expose Jane's manipulative strategies and assure Mrs. Parker's safety.
Sam, armed with dogged determination, navigates through Jane's complex illegal operation.
His journey reveals a multitude of bureaucrats, including a few trusted lawyers caught in Jane’s exploitative web.
Jane, upon sensing her secrets are being laid bare, uses her vast knowledge in law to inhibit Sam and Emily's progress.
Her cunning techniques include threat, intimidation, libel, and even violence, adapted to the circumstances.
Jane’s desperation slowly unwraps itself as her survival instinct pushes her into aggressive mode, asserting dominance over Emily and Sam in an attempt to snap their pursuit.

The story takes a pivotal turn as Sam, with his analytical prowess, traces Jane's financial tracks, breaks through her encrypted network, and parallelly uncovers intricate patterns involved in Jane’s fraudulent game.

Concurrently, Emily maintains a vigilant eye on the overly cordial charade displayed by Jane towards her ailing mother, ensuring her mother's wellbeing while gathering pieces of incriminatory evidence.
Emily devices a plan involving secret spy cameras in her mother's Victorian residence, capturing glimpses of Jane's manipulation.
This aids in constructing a substantial case against Jane.

Facades of victimhood are religiously put on by Jane and her lawyer amidst the chaos, successfully portraying themselves as innocent, misunderstood souls swallowed by their circumstances, thus maintaining their unnoticed operation in Whitfield.
Together, Sam and Emily weave a nearly foolproof legal case against Jane, fortified by irrefutable video evidence, financial audit trails, and heartbreaking testimonies from her previous victims.
Jane, in a feeble and desperate attempt to escape, tries to flee from Whitfield, only to be held back by the local sheriff who acts on a tip provided by Sam.
