Sam breaks open a pipe to shower him with water, allowing Joe to recover enough to escape with Sam by jumping out a window.
When Sam questions Joe about being Nemesis, he says that he is.
He tried to save his brother and has been wracked with guilt for his atrocities, that the death of Samaritan was his fault, and he couldn't move past it.
He tells Sam that there is good and evil in all people, and that Sam has to make the right decisions.
As the police arrest Reza and the remaining members of Cyrus' gang, Joe leaves, overhearing Sam tell the press that "Samaritan" survived and saved him, leaving his future unknown.

96700417.title: Phantom Prank: Belrose School of Shadows (2021 film)
synopsis: A haunting cinematic sequence unveils the vast expanse of the Belrose School for Young Ladies.
We're introduced to Nicole, a timid yearling hailing from a tranquil suburb.
Her journey down the intimidating, art-laden hallways of Belrose – adorned with intimidating portraits of eminent alumnus – is fraught with trepidation.
An innocent Nicole soon becomes the butt of bullying ringleader, Bianca's, sadistic jokes, engineered pranks calculated to embarrass her, and tactical isolation.

Bianca hatches a plot – the circulation of false stories of ghost sightings within the enigmatic north wing of the school, sparking a fresh wave of chilled whispers and fearful murmurings around campus.
Having eavesdropped, Nicole toggles between intrigue and fear, her curiosity piqued alongside her fear of the unknown.
Nicole begins to explore the pages of Belrose's archaic library.
She embarks on a quest to disentangle the truth from the lore, diving into the shadowy world of spectral entities believed to haunt Belrose.

Observing Nicole's fascination, Bianca and her band seize this opportunity to manipulate her curiosity, diverting her towards the exceptionally quiet north wing, long abandoned and draped in ominous silence.
Bianca and her band successfully execute their painstakingly planned ruse, scaring Nicole into hysteria.
But, the ruse is short-lived, as Nicole soon uncovers the hoax, beating a hasty retreat in sheer fear and terror.
In her terrified scramble, Nicole accidentally knocks down an antique silver candlestand, sending it toppling over onto the dusty wooden floor.
Bianca's confrontation with the true embodiment of the 'Belrose Phantom' ends with her mysterious disappearance.
The school is thrown into turmoil as Bianca's disappearance baffles everyone.
Nicole begins to be overcome with a sense of guilt for the accidental fire she started near the much-feared portrait, which she now suspects might have unleashed the spectral terror.
In a bid to amend the damage, she resolves to unveil the truth and make right the harm that she unknowingly caused.
Nicole discovers the heart-rending tale of a tormented student who ended her life in a tragic suicide, having been subjected to relentless bullying and ostracization.
Nicole decides to use a Ouija board to establish contact with the phantom.
She holds a glimmering hope that she can bring the wrathful spirit to reason and implore it to release Bianca.
Nicole goes ahead with her plan - a large scale 'forgiveness ritual' on the school grounds, hopeful that their collective notions of amends will help placate the furious phantom.
As the ritual commences, a shell-shocked Bianca emerges suddenly.
Nicole confronts her, expressing empathy and remorse for the phantom's past sufferings.
In a climactic moment, Nicole convinces the phantom to relinquish its control over Bianca.
Bianca, regaining her composure, apologizes to Nicole for her previous cruel behavior.
The girls pledge to use their experience as a catalyst to ensure a safe, bully-free school environment.

Inspired by Nicole's courage and wisdom, the girls form a collective promise to etch the phantom's tragic story into their minds as a reminder of the distress that bullying could cause and to take active measures to avoid such incidents in the future.
Sharing Nicole's vision of a school built on mutual respect, they vow to dismantle the previous reign of fear and torment.
Freed from the spirit's clutches, Bianca, joined by the repentant friends, compensates for their previous misdemeanors with a sincere apology to Nicole.
Bianca, now facing deep introspection, swiftly discards her unkind 'mean girl' persona and embraces the new path of positive reforms, wholeheartedly.
Bianca not only reconciles with Nicole but also emerges as an ally in spreading empathy and respect among the Belrose community.

Bianca and her clique, profoundly impacted by Nicole's bravery and kindness, turn a new leaf by mending relations and their attitude towards Nicole, leading to the emergence of an unexpected, newfound friendship.
The once-feared Bianca, Bianca, and her friends pledge to revitalize their school into a haven that radiates warmth, acceptance, and understanding.
The narrative finally concludes with the reformed Belrose standing on the edge of a bright, harmonious future.

62379098.title: Seance (2021 film)
synopsis: One night at the Edelvine Academy for Girls, a clique of girls led by ruthless popular girl Alice, play a prank on their classmate Kerrie by faking a haunting by the Edelvine Ghost, an urban legend involving a student who killed herself.
Upset, Kerrie goes back to her dorm room where she glimpses a figure watching her.
When the girls hear her screams, and rush into her room, they discover Kerrie dead, having fallen out of her dorm room window.
New student Camille Meadows takes Kerrie's place at the academy.
She meets headmistress Mrs. Landry and her son Trevor who works as a handyman.
Student Helina shows Camille to her room, which happens to be Kerrie's old room.
Camille notices strange supernatural occurrences in the dorm room.
Camille encounters Alice and the members of her clique; Bethany, Yvonne, Rosalind, and Lenora.
The group harasses Camille and Helina until a fight breaks out.
Mrs. Landry sentences the girls to spend detention in the library.
Alice convinces Camille and Helina to join her and the others in a seance to contact Kerrie.
Although Camille and Helina expect another prank, the group is stunned when they actually make contact with a spirit, which warns them that they will be murdered.
The group wonder if they communicated with Kerrie or the Edelvine Ghost.
Later that night, Lenora is attacked and killed by an unseen assailant.
The next day, Mrs. Landry questions the girls on Lenora's unusual disappearance, and informs them her personal items are missing, suspecting she has run away.
The group investigates her room with Trevor's help, and discovers a strange cross drawn in blood on Lenora's bed.
Camille later identifies the cross as a symbol on a pendant worn by Alicia Kane, the deceased student who supposedly became the Edelvine Ghost.
Later that night, Rosalind is killed in the shower with her body being discovered by Camille.
The death is presumed an accident.
Unsettled, Camille visits Helina, and they discuss the possibility of ghosts.
Bethany spots a masked figure in her room, which disappears when she screams for help.
Bethany claims it is the Edelvine Ghost, but Mrs. Landry dismisses it as a bad dream while Camille is also unconvinced it was a ghost since Bethany was able to scare it away.
Camille, Helina, Alice, Bethany, and Yvonne meet for another seance to contact Rosalind, and ask her what happened.
Rosalind's spirit states she was murdered, and identifies Camille as the killer.
Alice attacks Camille while the others grow suspicious of Camille.
While practicing for her dance recital, Yvonne is murdered by the masked figure Bethany saw.
After another haunting from Kerrie, Camille moves in with Helina, and the two comfort each other over recent events.
Alice receives a text from Yvonne asking her to go outside where she discovers Lenora's corpse before being knocked out by the masked assailant.
Camille tries to follow Alice, but is knocked unconscious by another masked assailant.
Camille awakens restrained in the library next to an unconscious Alice.

Bethany and Trevor reveal themselves as the killers and secret lovers, having murdered Kerrie and Alice's clique in an attempt to hide the fact that Bethany stole an essay from Kerrie, from which Bethany ended up winning a $250,000 scholarship.
Bethany also reveals she faked the communication with the spirits at the seances, and that Trevor murdered Alicia Kane who was his babysitter and faked her suicide.
Bethany states her plan to murder Alice, frame Camille for the murders, and then tie up any loose ends by killing Helina in a faked suicide.
Camille reveals that she is not really Camille, having assumed Camille Meadows's identity in order to avenge her friend Kerrie.
The power goes out, causing Bethany to leave and fix it.
As Trevor threatens Camille, Helina knocks him unconscious, and frees Camille and Alice, having then been led to the library by Kerrie's ghost.
The trio attempts to escape, but the power comes back on, and Bethany ambushes them.
Camille fends Bethany off and stabs her in the neck with a light bulb, killing her.
Alice and Helina escape the library as Trevor reawakens.
Camille manages to decapitate him with a bookshelf.
Camille retrieves some photos of her and Kerrie from her dorm room, and goes to leave only to be confronted by Helina.
Camille tells Helina about her faked identity while Helina asks how she will find Camille in the future.
Camille kisses Helina, waving both her and Kerrie's ghost goodbye before leaving the academy campus.

41012930.title: Rebellious Rhapsodies of Avalon's Heiress
synopsis: The film dramatically commences with a sweeping panorama of the enchanting city of Avalon.
The elaborate architectural scene, adorned with magnificent palaces, provides a feast for the spectators' eyes.
However, beneath this extravagance lies a bitter reality.
The laboring under the weight of heavy taxes combined with strict rules, imparts a disheartening gloom over the otherwise striking cityscape.
The story meanders to a grand commemoration being held in the Royal Palace's opulent ballroom, brimming with high-profile attendees.
Here, the royal family is introduced; particularly Queen Lydia, a figure exemplifying elegance and power, yet, her eyes reflect an icy distance.
Princess Amelia, lovingly called 'Amy', is also introduced, a vibrant, imaginative spirit.
Amy's strong-willed character manifests during her royal etiquette class where, defiantly dressed in simple slacks unlike her aristocratic counterparts, she audaciously challenges her mother's rules.
This act leads to her withdrawal towards her room.
Concurrently, in the labyrinthine cobble-stoned streets of the city's bustling square, a daring street performer, Jake, is seen challenging the monarchy by defacing one of their propaganda posters.
His music reaches the ears of Amy, who is observing the spectacle from her window overlooking the square.
The defiance and audacity Jake exhibits resonate in Amy's heart.
She watches his arrest from the carved marble balcony of the palace, under the gentle shadow of the night, Amy dares to trade in her royal gown for a commoner’s tunic and battered boots.
This audaciousness leads her on a nighttime expedition through the palace's weaving pathways, to the palace dungeons where she releases Jake from the clutches of the palace guards.
Jake introduces her to the forbidden group of the ‘Rebellious Rhapsodies’ an underground outfit of outlaws.
In the dim warehouse, Amy embarks on a musical journey under the guidance of Jake, transforming her disjointed lyrics into powerful songs of rebellion.
As the narrative unfolds, they decode a secret letter highlighting a plot by Avalon's nobles to elevate taxes on the already burdened citizens.
They begin to craft an uprising under the guise of covert performances staged in busy marketplaces alive with colorful stalls.
Despite the looming danger, Amy finds herself growing closer to Jake.
Their shared rebellious spirit culminates their relationship.
The height of their insurrection is met with a stern blow as royal guards capture Amy and Jake.
With her hands firm, Amy stands in the arches of the palace courtyard, facing her mother.
She boldly proclaims the truth about the noble’s plot to oppress the townsfolk.
Amy beseeches her mother to introduce a wave of reform for the betterment of Avalon.
Her impassioned plea sends a silence through the courtyard.
This incites a riot between the Royal guards and the common denizens, transforming the calm courtyard into a battleground for freedom.
In the ensuing chaos, the Rhapsodies manage to hold their ground.
Queen Lydia yields and agrees to dismantle the strict class divisions.

A council composed of representatives from across the social spectrum is set up, an explosion of color, laughter, and the harmonious sharing of meals, infusing new life into Avalon  The film culminates with a grand rock concert of unity, led by Amy, Jake, and the Rhapsodies.
The stage - the grand palace courtyard, its ancient stones pulsating with the rhythm of newfound freedom and togetherness.

60979050.title: Secret Society of Second-Born Royals
synopsis: In the kingdom of Illyria, second-born royal Princess Samantha "Sam" argues against the monarchy with her friend, Mike, by performing rock music on the streets.
Her older sister, Crown Princess Eleanor, is to succeed their mother, Regent Catherine, to the throne following the death of their father and uncle.

While spending the night out with Mike, Sam suddenly begins to experience an over-stimulation of her senses while at an underground concert and gets herself and Mike arrested when she sets off the fire sprinklers.
The next day, she is informed by Catherine that she is to take summer school to make up for missing her history test.
Sam attends summer school alongside eagerly friendly January, quiet and socially awkward Matteo, conceited and popular Tuma and social networking and pompous Roxana.

Their teacher is Professor James Morrow who reveals that they are not there to take summer school, but instead are to be trained to join the Secret Society of Second-Born Royals, a group of superpowered individuals dedicated to protecting the world and serving the various monarchies.
Morrow reveals that he has the ability to multiply himself and that Catherine is a member as well, shocking Sam.
Catherine tells her that her sister Eleanor is to never know about the Society and Morrow immediately puts them to training.
Sam discovers that her heightened senses are the result of her powers awakening.
Roxana learns that she can turn invisible, Tuma has mental persuasion, January can take other abilities temporarily and Matteo can control bugs.

As they hone their powers, they become closer and begin opening up with Tuma admitting that his powers have resulted in him becoming conceited, Matteo feeling that he has a place where he belongs after feeling ignored, Roxana realizing that there is more beyond having numerous followers and January revealing that she has a twin brother who she feels pressured by due to him being seconds older than her.
Meanwhile, a prisoner named Inmate 34 escapes and unleashes his telekinetic abilities.
After a failed simulation results in Sam missing a gig with Mike, she hangs out with her new friends to cheer her up and prepare for the upcoming coronation.
Mike catches Sam hanging out with January and believes that she has abandoned him.
Afterwards, Inmate 34 attacks the group and Sam gives chase when she hears him call her "Snowflake," a name only her father called her.
A chase in the woods results in Morrow getting severely beaten, but January rescues Sam by taking Inmate 34's powers away.
Morrow is hospitalized and Sam demands to see Inmate 34 from Catherine; discovering that he is in fact Edmond, her uncle.
He reveals that he killed his brother because he wanted to take down the monarchy and have the people of Illyria be citizens rather than subjects.
Sam begins to reevaluate her relationship with Eleanor when it becomes clear that she wants Sam to feel free.
The rest of the Society agree to be there for Sam at Eleanor's coronation.
However, on the day, January is revealed to be in league with Edmond, who takes Tuma's powers and releases him.
She wants Edmond to kill her brother so that she can take the throne to her kingdom.
Matteo manages to send a bee to warn Sam and she recruits Mike, while also apologizing and revealing her secret.
Sam and Mike manage to take out January and regroup with the rest of the Society to stop Edmond, who plans on using a device that will take out everyone with royal blood.
The Society confront him and battle him before trapping him in an experimental miniaturized chamber.
The coronation happens with no one aware of the events.
Sam, Matteo, Roxana and Tuma are inducted into the Society as Morrow recovers from his injuries.
Catherine reveals the Society to Eleanor, who promises that her first order as queen will be to add parliament to their government.
January has escaped and is now daring the Society to come and find her, and they leave by jet on their next mission.

42349863.title: Chase of Intrigue (2022 film)
synopsis: Arthur Burlington, a highly-respected playwright and fervent enthusiast of detective fiction, based in the vibrant heart of London, finds himself seated in the peaceful calm of his cozy Victorian-style study.
A surprise telegram breaks into his quiet contemplation, snapping him back into reality.
The unexpected message comes from Max, an iconic Hollywood tycoon known for his knack in turning best-selling novels into silver-screen monopolies.
Max proposes to transform Arthur's critically acclaimed theatrical mystery, "The Final Chase," into a full-scale cinematic feature—a prospect Arthur finds both enthralling and daunting.

Initially, Arthur balks at the suggestion, pointing to his deep-seated satisfaction with the artistry of theater and an inherent fear that the star-studded glitz of Hollywood might corrupt the essence of his cherished creation.
Max, however, remains unyielding in his pursuit.
He reveals his ultimate trump card—the director that has been attached to the project, none other than Jackson Weaving.
Known for his experimental directing style and enigmatic personality, Jackson is an industry legend.

Intrigued by the enticing prospect of working with a director as distinctive as Jackson, Arthur submits to Max's persuasive arguments and boards a British Airways flight bound directly for Los Angeles.
Upon meeting, Arthur and Jackson find themselves embroiled in a heated debate, voicing their disparate opinions about the representation and evolution of their shared passion - 'Art.'
Arthur staunchly defends his artistic beliefs while also striving to comprehend Jackson's groundbreaking ideas.
As the eclectic team embarks on the film's production process, mysterious anomalies begin to occur on the historically infamous Paramount Pictures’ set.
Crucial props begin to shift position, and, to Arthur's dismay, the script undergoes inexplicable changes without his authorization.

Acknowledging these anomalies, Arthur momentarily puts aside his playwright's persona and brands himself as an investigator, eager to unearth the ensnaring mysteries that are interrupting the filmmaking process.
His sudden behavior shift does not go unnoticed by the crew and cast, triggering a swirl of suspicion directed towards him.
The tension on the set escalates further when Arthur's handwritten revision of a pivotal screenplay fragment is found at the resting site of a thought-to-be misplaced Victorian era lamp prop.
Jackson accuses Arthur of instigating drama for unwarranted publicity, a charge that Arthur fiercely denies.
Absolute chaos ensues when their charismatic leading lady, Ava Belle, vanishes into thin air, leaving behind a cryptic note eerily mirroring Arthur's writing style.
This discovery triggers a full-scale Los Angeles Police Department investigation, with Arthur uncomfortably standing in the spotlight as a prime suspect.

As the possibility of the production's collapse hangs heavy in the air, augmented by the unnerving disappearance of Ava and the police’s intrusive gaze, Jackson decides to step into the role of an amateur detective.
He begins observing the crew's erratic behavior, hoping to decode the riddle that now rules the set.
As Jackson digs deeper into the unfolding mystery, he discovers a pattern of suspicious absence and peculiarity among select crew members.
Revealing these observations to Arthur, they hypothesize a broad conspiracy that extends beyond the company's production issues.
The one-time philosophical opponents, Arthur and Jackson, join forces to unravel the intricate mysteries weaved within Ava’s enigmatic note and the crew's strange behavior.
Adopting an audacious tactic, they confront the suspected crew members in front of the entire cast and crew, backing them into a corner with their hard-earned intel.
Among those accused, one folds under the pressing weight of scrutiny and confesses an envious plot set in motion by a competing film production firm, aiming to derail their project.
With this revelation resonating through the team, Arthur and Jackson meticulously strategize their retaliation.
They devise an appealing trap for the rival film producer, Alicia Hargraves, and her conspiracy accomplices.
The plan carries an ironic twist worthy of a Shakespearean tragedy.
Unawares, Alicia walks into the ambush, and as the LAPD appears on cue, the destructive plot is foiled.
The repercussions of the foiled plot leave the crew shocked, as Alicia's co-conspirators are apprehended and her malicious scheme is exposed to the public.
As chaos ensues, Arthur and Jackson seize the opportunity to complete their film.
Their project's grand opening sees an overwhelming reception and enjoys a triumphant box-office success, partly fueled by the media whirlwind covering the unraveling conspiracy.
Arthur and Jackson, once ideological opponents, celebrate their victorious journey over aged scotch, reminiscing over past contentions while basking in their newfound camaraderie.
As the curtain descends on this whirlwind adventure, both envision future collaborations that promise to captivate audiences further, marking the beginning of an interesting journey for the pair.

65893026.title: See How They Run (2022 film)
synopsis: In 1953 London, Agatha Christie's play The Mousetrap celebrates its 100th performance, and sleazy American director Leo Köpernick has been hired by producer John Woolf to direct the film adaptation.
After Köpernick's drunken behaviour towards the female lead Sheila Sim leads to a fistfight with her husband and co-star Richard Attenborough, Köpernick is killed backstage by an unseen assailant.
Inspector Stoppard investigates the murder, shadowed by the inexperienced Constable Stalker.
Everyone at the theatre is declared a suspect and a potential victim, including the play's producer Petula Spencer and Woolf's wife Edana Romney.
Stoppard attempts to close the theatre until the murder is solved, but the Metropolitan Police Commissioner, Harold Scott, intervenes, assigning Stalker to assist in the investigation.
Stoppard and Stalker search Köpernick's room at the Savoy Hotel, finding his address book of women's details.

The hotel manager recalls Köpernick's violent argument with screenwriter Mervyn Cocker-Norris, who admits to arguing with Köpernick over the director's vision for an action-packed ending for The Mousetrap film.
Mervyn, who lives with his hot-headed "nephew" Gio, remembers a "plain woman" arriving at the hotel with Köpernick's son.
Stoppard and Stalker question Woolf, who was blackmailed by Köpernick after he discovered Woolf's affair with his assistant, Ann.
Dennis, an usher at the theatre, offers an unhelpful description of a suspicious figure; Attenborough and Sim are questioned as well.
Spencer explains that she optioned The Mousetrap's film rights to Woolf, but he would be contractually unable to produce the adaptation until the show had closed.
At a pub, Stoppard bonds with Stalker and reveals that his unfaithful wife left him after having a child with another man.
Driving a drunken Stoppard home, Stalker finds news articles and a picture of his ex-wife, fitting Mervyn's description of a "homely woman with glasses".
Combined with Dennis' description, this leads Stalker to suspect Stoppard may be the killer, and she searches for his ex-wife in Köpernick's address book.

Stoppard and Stalker attend a performance of The Mousetrap, during which Mervyn, Woolf, Dennis, Gio and Stoppard leave the auditorium; Stalker soon follows after watching Stoppard retrieve his gloves.
In the foyer, Mervyn is strangled to death by a gloved figure.
Stalker spots Stoppard kneeling over the body and gives chase, knocking him unconscious with a snow shovel.
Stoppard awakens in a cell, and Stalker and Scott accuse him of carrying out the murders.
Stalker has summoned Joyce, the mother of Köpernick's son, but she is not Stoppard's ex-wife, exonerating him.
Stalker escorts Joyce and her son home, and Joyce mentions overhearing a man with a "village idiot" accent.

Reading through Mervyn's research on The Mousetrap, Stoppard realises the identity of the killer and races to the suspect's apartment, where Stalker has already burst inside and found the necessary evidence: the killer is Dennis.
Attenborough, Sim, Woolf, Ann, Spencer and her elderly mother arrive at the home of Agatha Christie in Wallingford, Berkshire, having received invitations to dinner.
The butler Fellowes is perplexed by their arrival, but Christie's husband, Max Mallowan, allows them inside.
The group are held at gunpoint by Dennis, whom Spencer's mother recognises as Dennis Corrigan, an abused child whose brother's death inspired the plot of The Mousetrap.
Dennis explains that he killed Köpernick and Mervyn in an attempt to stop the play and its adaptation, disgusted by the exploitation of his brother's tragedy for entertainment.
Having forged the invitations to lure everyone together, Dennis has captured Edana, mistaking her for Christie.
Christie enters with tea, including a poisoned cup for Dennis which Fellowes inadvertently drinks instead.

An armed Stoppard arrives and a shootout ensues; Sim distracts Dennis with a molotov cocktail, and Stalker nearly takes a bullet to save Stoppard, matching Köpernick's story pitch, before Agatha dispatches Dennis with a shovel.
It is revealed that the bullet did, in fact, hit Stoppard, though the shot was not fatal.
Some time later, Stalker passes her sergeant's exams and a recovering Stoppard receives the King's Police and Fire Services Medal, and they attend another performance of The Mousetrap together.
At the very end of the film, Stoppard turns to the camera and asks the audience to keep the identity of the killer a secret, as happens at the end of the actual play The Mousetrap.

95231697.title: Meet You There (film)
synopsis: We're introduced to the motorless Texan town of Bowie, where our heroine, Jamie, a 17-year-old teenager, whose existence is tightly wound around her traditionalist parents' concept of life and her provincial community's beliefs.

Life in this torpid town is seldom shaken up until a remarkable afternoon when Jamie's closely guarded secret percolates to the surface through a privately taped discourse with Casey, her lifelong codeswitcher.
Jamie, feeling stuck in a life that didn’t truly belong to her, makes a heartfelt admission to Casey about how she identifies - she is a transgender woman.
Jamie's ardent search for acceptance and self-rule intensely reflects on the screen, leading to a consequential progression in her relationship with Casey.
In an incredibly powerful sequence, Jamie amasses her bravery and peels back her protective layers to reveal her true identity to her parents.
This revelation pitches Jamie’s parents into a state of disbelief, shocking them.
Heartbroken but determined to find love that doesn't ask for covenants, Jamie sets her eyes on the boundless horizons of New York City.
Jamie and Casey embark on a journey from Texas to NYC, carrying suitcases brimming with bravery and tenacity.
However, the city poses a reality far harsher than what they'd envisioned - uncaring homelessness and destitution.
Amidst a society rife with prejudice, Jamie grapples with her identity, all the while searching for employment.
She kickstarts her transition journey, finding solace in the companionship of Casey and the supportive circle of LGBTQ+ individuals of a local support group.
Jamie charts her journey online, establishing a blog that becomes her catharsis.
As Jamie's blog becomes a beacon for the online community, her narrative ignites hope and empathy.
Witnessing Jamie's transformation, her parents are pushed into a state of thoughtful reflection, realizing their hasty decision caused a deep, painful divide.
Jamie's journey culminates in an invitation to speak at an LGBTQ+ conference in Austin, Texas.
The possibility of revisiting her hometown fills Jamie with a whirlpool of anxiety, excitement, and melancholic familiarity.
She reunites with her parents in an emotionally charged scene.
Jamie's return to Texas sparks a tornado of contrasting opinions.
As she strides onto the conference podium, the split audience comes alive.
However, Jamie's parents rise to defend their daughter's journey, signaling their transition from rejection to acceptance.
Jamie delivers her raw, emotionally charged monologue encapsulating her journey.
As her impassioned speech echoes in the large hall, the camera sweeps across the audience, capturing Casey’s tears and her parents’ admiration.
Jamie concludes her speech with an assurance of hope for others on a similar path.
As the echoes of her words fade, applause fills the conference hall.
Among the cheering crowd, her parents sit, awestruck at Jamie’s transformation.
Stepping off the stage, Jamie walks into Casey's arms and the embrace of her parents, their hearts softened to accept and cherish her true identity.
The camera pulls in for a close shot of Jamie's face, full of pride and gratitude.
The screen dims into black.

70557061.title: See You Then (film)
synopsis: Kris is a trans-woman from Phoenix, Arizona.
A decade after abruptly breaking up with Naomi, the duo is reuniting for a single evening in Los Angeles.
Kris is in town for a network security conference.
She is taking care of her cousin's two children.
Naomi, a professor, is a mother of two.
Kris and Naomi talk about Kris's transition and their friendship.
Naomi says she felt hurt when Kris broke up with her.
Kris apologizes.
Naomi, a performance artist, reveals she gave up on her dreams and moved back with her parents before meeting her husband, Jim.
Kris encourages her to return to performing.
Later, Kris reveals she broke up with the first person she ever dated since transitioning 13 years ago.
The duo talks about Kris' gender reassignment surgery, dating, and spending time with your loved one.
Kris tells Naomi that it is harder to be female than trans.
Naomi's colleague Peter Gleason flirts with the duo at a bar.
He is on a date with a former student.
Naomi calls her life a series of setbacks.
Kris tells her that everybody's life is unique.
Naomi introduces Kris to Martin, another of her colleagues, who flirts with her.
Naomi drives home early to see her child.
Naomi and Kris talk about having children.
They go to the campus where Naomi works and visit her office.
Naomi recalls their last night together.
Kris apologizes again, they argue, and Naomi reveals Kris impregnated her before abandoning her.
The real reason for the change in her career was her decision to keep the child.
Naomi tells Kris that she will never be a mother.
Kris says Naomi has no one to blame for her sad life.
The last scene shows Naomi performing, lying down next to a painting of a pregnant belly before destroying the art, symbolically accepting who she is.

37615442.title: Fading Vision
synopsis: We introduce Lena, a woman possessing prodigious talent on the ski slopes, dreaming of one day making her mark on the Winter Olympics.

Her passion for skiing evident during an intense training drill on the rugged, snow-capped peaks of Aspen mountains, where every elegant swoop, every fearless dive, testifies to her years of unwavering dedication to the sport.
An equally vibrant personality emerges with vivid clarity in Lena's off-slope interactions with her close-knit team and their fiercely supportive coach, Chris Donovan.
They form a dynamic blend of camaraderie and competitiveness, their intricate ties forged through mutual respect, laughter, and the endless hours battling the brutal Aspen trails.
That unwavering spirit is tested during a dusk-lit practice session when her vision starts to swirl and blur under the intense neon floodlights.
Lena brushes it off as nothing more than exhaustion but remains unaware that this is a precursor to a more serious health condition.
As her vision gradually worsens, she decides to consult a renowned ophthalmologist.
The diagnosis is debilitating; she is suffering from Retinitis Pigmentosa, a relentless and ruthless condition that slowly erodes one's vision until total blindness.
Lena grapples with the enormous weight of this revelation, attempting to comprehend a world devoid of the vibrant blend of colors she cherishes.
Her vulnerability shines through in intimate moments of frustration and despair as she reconciles herself with the dire prognosis.
Her stubborn resilience takes over as she decides not to burden her team and family with the devastating news.
Instead, Lena chooses to continue training, disguising her rapidly deteriorating vision as best as she could.

The deteriorating condition of her vision paints a stark picture of her struggles as she stumbles among caution cones, falls after attempted maneuvers, and fails to negotiate essential turns on the ski slope.
All the while, a shadowy organization called 'The Orion' comes across Lena’s confidential medical history.
The Orion, led by the cunning Maximillian Stone, sees a sinister opportunity to exploit her affliction for an unproven cure they seek.
Maximillian presents Lena with an offer, interspersed with cryptic guarantees and lofty promises of a miracle solution for her creeping blindness.
As Lena's sight worsens, causing distressing incidents during her training sessions and team gatherings, her once-robust facade begins to crack.
Unsettled by her growing clumsiness, her teammates and Coach Chris demand answers.
Cornered, Lena dissolves into tears and unravels her closely guarded secret within the log-lined walls of their team abode.
The revelation devastates the team, but their shared bond transcends this betrayal, and they rally around Lena in her darkest hour of need.
Enclosed in a cocoon of hopelessness, Lena becomes enticed by the empty promises hitherto made by The Orion, hoping for a miracle that would restore her sight and allow her dreams to soar once again.
Parallelly, Chris, the team, and a mysterious Detective Rafe Santiago, join forces to peel back the unsettling shroud of enigma surrounding The Orion and their too-good-to-be-true miracle cure.
Their investigation hits a wall when Lena goes missing, leaving behind a trail of confusion and chaos.
Lena is abducted by The Orion's henchmen and transported to a remote fortress hidden in the wilderness for their underhanded medical procedures.
Chris, the relentless team, and Detective Santiago refuse to abandon Lena, vowing to pursue her abductors deep into the dangerous world of illegal human experiments.
Within The Orion's stronghold, Lena stumbles upon the horrifying truth.
She sees sequestered victims, all subjected to the same cruel experiments.
She is just another guinea pig in their twisted pursuit of what they virulently believe may transform humanity.
But Lena, the once fearless skier, refuses to accept her fate.
She conspires a daring escape using her heightened auditory senses and excellent skiing skills, dashing through treacherous, snow-blasted corridors.

Blazing a trail of resistance, she makes her electrifying escape simultaneously as Chris, her teammates, and Rafael reach the fortress, unearthing the dark reality of The Orion and their unholy operations.
Surviving the harrowing ordeal, Lena grapples with the bitter truth - her dreams of Olympic glory may forever remain a mirage in her steadily depleting eyesight.
Lena reinvents herself, embracing her new reality.
She becomes an inspirational skiing coach for young cadets and a charismatic speaker, using her motivational speeches to encourage those grappling with life-altering adversities.

Her transformation culminates when she delivers a stirring keynote speech at an international athlete symposium in Geneva, where she addresses the power of resilience and shares her personal battle against impending blindness.
The story culminates with a heartwarming image of Lena, now a renowned trainer, teaching a group of earnest, young ski students on the very slopes of Aspen.
Her spirit, unfettered and strong, navigates her world, undeterred by her ineluctable blindness.

68408141.title: See for Me
synopsis: Downhill skier Sophie Scott has her Olympic dreams dashed when she is diagnosed with retinitis pigmentosa, a degenerative eye disease causing blindness.
Although her friend Cam offers to help her train for the Paralympics by working as her seeing guide, she refuses and gives up on her skiing dreams.
To make money, she cat sits for wealthy homeowners and steals expensive wine from them to resell, with help from Cam.
Sophie answers an ad for a cat sitter placed by Debra, a rich woman in upstate New York leaving for a vacation after just divorcing her husband.
After locking herself outside of the house, Sophie uses See For Me, a phone app that allows blind people to connect with sighted volunteers via video call.
She is connected to Kelly, a gamer in Florida who helps her get back inside.
That night, Sophie is awoken by three men breaking into the house.
She calls 911 and reports the break-in, but the 911 operator tells her it will be a long response time due to the house's remote location.
She hangs up and uses See For Me to contact Kelly again, but is caught by the men, who disconnect the video call.
Kelly, desperate to help Sophie, contacts the police to have them cross reference 911 calls in an attempt to locate the house that Sophie is in.
Sophie learns that the men have broken into the house to steal $7 million hidden in a safe in the wall.
After checking Sophie's phone and seeing that she called 911, the men contemplate giving up the score and killing her.
They call their boss, Rico, who tells them to let Sophie live as she has not seen anyone.
Rico also instructs them to pack up their gear and come back later.
Sophie convinces them to give her a share of the take in exchange for sending the police away.
Sophie calls 911 a second time to cancel her initial report, but is told that the police have to respond even after a false alarm is reported.
When the deputy arrives to investigate, Sophie lies and says there was no emergency.
As the deputy is about to leave, Kelly's alert is radioed out and Sophie's lie is revealed.
The deputy calls for backup and attempts to arrest the intruders but is killed by one of the men.
Sophie escapes with the deputy's gun and calls Kelly for help.
Kelly helps her shoot two of the men, while the third man finishes breaking into the safe.
Kelly guides Sophie to the final robber, who opens the safe to take the money.
Before Sophie can shoot him, her phone dies and her call with Kelly ends.
Although the thief tells Sophie that he is about to leave, she shoots him when he reaches for the dead police officer's taser.
She waits for the police to arrive, but is surprised by the appearance of Rico.
Rico reveals that he is Debra's ex-husband and he hired all three of the robbers to break into the safe to steal his money back from his wife.
He tells her that Debra did not know the safe or the money was in the house, and tries to convince her to let him take the money.
Sophie refuses and cuts off the lights in the house, baiting Rico to pursue her.
After running out of ammunition in her gun, she is caught by Rico and almost dies as he strangles her but gains the upper hand and bludgeons him to death.
After recovering in the hospital, Sophie tells her mom that she has decided to try out for the Paralympics and plans to ski again.
Her mom tells her that they will need money to buy all new gear, and Sophie clutches her backpack and smiles, implying that she took some of the money with her from the house.
Shortly after, Sophie video calls Kelly to give her an update on her skiing progress, while Cam acts as Sophie's guide.

81611824.title: Caring Hearts
synopsis: Jane is an unyielding optimist, ceaselessly finding a silver lining in every cloud.
Her perspective is brutally tested the day her manager informs her that she's being let go from her routine, mind-numbing job as a data analyst.
Instead of breaking down, she embraces the challenge.
While contemplating her next step in the warmth of her favorite coffee shop one breezy afternoon, Jane stumbles upon a nanny job advert on a local online platform.
Though driven more by her urgent financial needs than genuine interest, she decides to take a risk and applies for the position.
The first meeting with her new employers quickly spirals into an assortment of comedic moments.
Jane encounters Mike, the neurotic venture capitalist; Lisa, the dedicated lawyer; and the main antagonist of her job – Max, their turbo-charged, uncontainable four-year-old.
This encounter paints an apt preview of the unconventional, chaotic environment that surrounds them.

Jane, known for her love of routine and predictability, plunges deep into the chaotic life of Max – diving headfirst into fields of strewn Lego blocks and navigating around precariously towering piles of laundry, all whilst trying to contain Max's untamed energy.

Several amusing mishaps uniquely tailored to Max's energy later, Jane finds herself amidst the Herculean task of marrying Max's free spirit with the strictly controlled timetable of the household, an exercise she surprisingly starts cherishing.
A heart-warming moment unfurls when Jane reintroduces her childhood sanctuary, painting, to Max.
Dusting off her old easels and paints, she connects with Max on a deeper level, their bond cementing with every stroke of the brush.
Over time, Jane's influence begins to seep into the mechanized lives of Mike and Lisa.
By leading through example, Jane teaches them the valuable lesson of relishing their son's quirks and enjoying his boundless energy.
Another storyline blossoms when Tom, Jane's intellectual and introverted neighbor, exposes his feelings for Jane.
As a professor of Astrophysics, his confession ensues in a charmingly calculated, yet sincerely heartfelt manner.

Even amidst their chaotic symphony of legal cases, investment meetings, and Max's never-ending turmoil, Lisa and Mike begin to rediscover their earlier, flirtier selves, guided by Jane's infectious positivity.

Despite her best attempts at juggling Max's hyperactivity, household chores, and Mike and Lisa's incessant demands, the pressure culminates in Jane submitting her resignation, leaving the once chaotic family in profound sadness.
Struggling to fill the void left by Jane’s absence, Mike, Lisa, and even little Max, launch an endearing campaign to bring Jane back.
The campaign comprises of heartfelt handmade cards and quirky 'Please Stay Jane' T-shirts, making it a blend of amusing and emotional moments.
The emotional climax arrives when Jane, wrestling with her decision to leave, ultimately commits to stay.
She realizes that bonds cultivated with the family are precious and surpass the specifics of any job description.
In addition to her decision to maintain her familial connection, Jane also verbalizes her feelings for Tom.
Their romantic tension resolves charmingly, as they mutually agree to explore a romantic relationship.
The final hurdle follows.
Max, alongside his parents, fumbles through heartfelt speeches filled with gratitude for Jane, resulting in an extraordinarily comical yet moving display of how much she means to them.
The narrative concludes with Jane embracing her now gratifying, albeit unpredictable, life.
She revels in the harmony achieved amidst childcare and a blooming romance with Tom simultaneously.
Far from her once stable, orderly job, Jane thrives in her new, chaotic world.
She successfully shapes a struggling household into a harmoniously functioning family unit.
The story concludes with Jane successfully balancing her new, multifaceted life.
She expertly manages Max's nurturing, fosters deep bonds with Mike and Lisa, navigates her budding relationship with Tom, and embraces the joyously chaotic ride her life has taken.
Jane's resilience, patience, and affectionate nature shape this narrative into an enchanting tale.

66961081.title: Sharp Stick
synopsis: 26-year-old Sarah Jo (Kristine Froseth) babysits for a family of two parents, Heather (Lena Dunham) and Josh (Jon Bernthal) and their son, Zach, who has down syndrome.
Sarah Jo lives with her single mother, Marilyn, and sister, Treina.

During a discussion about love and male attraction, Marilyn advises her daughters to ask a man she admires, “Do you find me beautiful?” The next day, Sarah Jo and Josh are alone in the family’s laundry room when Sarah Jo asks Josh if he finds her beautiful.
Josh becomes flustered, and Sarah Jo lifts up her dress to reveal a scar above her vagina.
Sarah Jo informs Josh that she had an emergency radical hysterectomy at age 15 which caused her to go into menopause by age 17.
Sarah Jo tells Josh that she is a virgin, and Josh responds by saying that she wouldn’t want to lose her virginity to him.
After some awkward rambling from Sarah Jo, Josh approaches Sarah Jo and asks if he can kiss her.
Josh and Sarah Jo kiss, and Josh asks if he can go down on Sarah Jo.
Josh performs oral sex on Sarah Jo and takes her virginity.
Josh ejaculates quickly and becomes embarrassed.
Sarah Jo reassures Josh, and he fingers Sarah Jo.The next day, Sarah Jo returns to work and sneaks up on Josh in the attic.
Josh tells Sarah Jo that they cannot have sex again.
Sarah Jo lifts up her dress to reveal her scar again.
This turns Josh on, and the two have sex again.
Sarah Jo and Josh take a road trip to rural New York.
The couple stays in a cabin while the two lie about their whereabouts; Josh claims to have a friend commitment, while Sarah Jo blames her absence on a family emergency.
During the excursion, Sarah Jo and Josh consume hallucinogenic mushrooms and smoke marijuana.
The two have sex repeatedly and watch porn together.
Josh gives Sarah Jo a necklace.
Sarah Jo goes home and continues to watch porn.
She becomes interested in a porn actor named Vance Leroy.
When Sarah Jo returns to work, Heather’s water breaks and she goes into labor.
Sarah Jo calls Josh and leans down to comfort Heather, who notices Sarah Jo’s necklace.
When Josh arrives, Heather demands that she be taken to the hospital via ambulance.
Josh, who has now realized that the affair has been revealed, screams at Sarah Jo.
Sarah Jo leaves the house.
Distraught, Sarah Jo writes a letter to Vance Leroy about her sexual exploration.
Sarah Jo creates two checklists of sex acts she wants to try, including “anal,” “blowjob,” and “necrophilia.” Excited to complete her checklist, Sarah Jo engages in a series of casual hookups.
One fling, Arvin (Luka Sabbat), works in porn and promises to deliver her letter to Vance Leroy.
Later Vance responds to her letter with a video that Arvin brings to her, and his words reassure her.

28605426.title: Endless Nightmares: A John Green Story
synopsis: Acclaimed author John Green and his wife Sarah are depicted amidst the picturesque surroundings of the English countryside.
Their joyous moments are plentiful, from dancing under night skies illuminated by starlight, to exploring and creating new pasta recipes in their cozy kitchen.
As time lapses, the journey of their forthcoming child is portrayed.
Sarah's baby bump grows steadily while their excitement multiplies each day.
They begin setting up a pastel-themed nursery and shopping for miniature clothing.
In the sanitized setting of a hospital room, the couple is informed by their doctor that their baby is perfectly healthy.
The narrative takes a heart-wrenching turn when Sarah and their unborn child are tragically ripped away from John's life in a catastrophic head-on collision during a heavy downpour.
Distraught, John converts his once lively home into an isolated sanctuary, erecting symbolic walls around him, and cutting off all interactions with the outside world.
Mementos of Sarah pepper his house, serving as constant reminders of his loss.
Even sleep becomes an arena of torment for John, filled with nightmares of Sarah's screams and the horrifying image of the fatal car crash.
As the second act unravels, John's nightmares intensify.
On the brink of his sanity, he perceives Sarah's apparition in the corners of their house and in their frequented spots.
John turns to alcohol as an escape from his spiraling despair, abandoning his writing career and his remaining relationships.
Unexpectedly, he encounters Elaine, a friend from his childhood who is currently practicing as a therapist.
Elaine proves to be the lone ray of hope in John's despair.
Despite his refusals, she commits herself to the monumental challenge of extracting him from these dark depths of heartache.
Finally, John agrees to undergo therapy.
His grief and guilt become burdens that he can no longer bear alone.
He confesses to Elaine that his last interaction with Sarah was a heated argument over their moving decision.
He feels guilt for perceiving himself as the cause of her death and the death of their unborn child.
Elaine guides John through the maze of his guilt, grief, and nightmares.
John starts accepting the support Elaine has been offering, his defenses beginning to dissolve.
With hesitant steps, John starts rebuilding the relationships he had discarded.
He patches things up with his estranged sister, Emma, and starts healing emotionally.
The climax is a scene at Sarah's tombstone where John, his voice choked with sorrow and regret, apologizes for the argument of that fateful day.
As the final scene unfolds, John awakens from a night of peaceful sleep.
The next morning, he watches the sunrise from his home's balcony, signaling the continuation of his journey towards healing his wounds and embracing acceptance.

66504120.title: Shepherd (film)
synopsis: Eric Black has recurring nightmares following the recent death of his pregnant wife Rachel.
Thinking he needs some space, he answers a newspaper ad for work as a shepherd on a remote island in the Scottish Highlands.
En route, he drops by his childhood home but is rebuked by his mother Glenys, who blames the death of his father on Eric's decision to leave them for Rachel, whom she implied to have been adulterous.
Eric throws his wedding ring into a lake and breaks down after considering suicide.
He and his Border Collie Baxter are then ferried to the island by the half-sighted Fisher, his only contact, who hands him a journal to record his thoughts.
They settle into a dilapidated cottage by an unlit lighthouse.
Eric finds a ring in a freshwater spring and, at the cottage, a shelf of journals identical to the one Fisher gave him.
In one of the journals, he finds frantic writings about a witch on the island.
At night, he struggles to climb the stairs to his room due to severe acrophobia.
Strange events begin to occur.
Eric wakes up the next day to see Rachel's old cup inexplicably filled with hot tea.
After feeding the sheep, he sees Fisher entering the otherwise locked lighthouse and leaving the island in a hurry.
One morning, he has a waking nightmare in which a demonic Glenys stabs him.
When Baxter goes missing, he searches for him through heavy fog and finds an ancient luxury liner in a valley.
On board, he picks up an old key and runs away after sensing the presence of a robed figure from his nightmares.
While reading the journals, he finds a drawing of this figure, titled “The Wrecker”, holding a lamp to lure a ship to a rock, and is startled to also find a drawing of Baxter.
He later finds that the ring he plucked from the spring is the wedding ring he threw away.
On the phone, Fisher implies that Eric is fated to be there as penance, making him confess that Rachel’s death was due to his drunk driving.
Desperate to be saved, Eric uses the old key to the lighthouse and, after an arduous climb, turns on its light to Fisher’s dismay.
As he exits, Eric finds his sheep ritualistically flayed and finds Baxter among them, but they all disappear the next day.
When confronted by the robed figure, which takes on Rachel’s guise, Eric immolates it and the cottage with the lighter Rachel gave him.
Eric swims out to a boat but her ghost drags him underwater.
Eric wakes up ashore and is taken to the police.

When questioned, the full extent of his confession is revealed: due to drunk driving, the car carrying him and Rachel veered off to the edge of a cliff; taken over by acrophobia, Eric exited the car, causing it to be unbalanced and fall to the ocean with Rachel.
Fisher phones Eric to say that while his penance for Rachel's death was over, she is angered that he broke the rules by escaping.
It is shown that Fisher has killed Glenys using Eric’s knife and planted his journal as evidence.
Hearing the wind howl outside his interrogation room, Eric opens the door to see that he is emerging from the lighthouse back on the island.

78235948.title: Stepping In (film)
synopsis: Our tale is set in the animated corridors of the Pennsylvania Academy of Fine Arts and Crafts, located in the heart of cosmopolitan Philadelphia.
Here, at a quaint wooden desk tucked away behind towering sculptures and colorful tapestries, sat our protagonist, Sarah.
Young, filled with unseen talent, and juggling myriad art projects, Sarah was not just a budding artist.
She was also the backbone of her mother, who managed the Academy with an unbreakable vigor.
Overflowing with a palpable fervor for each brush stroke and pencil sketch she crafted, Sarah still managed to juggle her creative pursuits with her administrative responsibilities.
Her mother, a commanding and formidable figure graced by a maternal warmth, managed the Academy and its stack of paperwork.

Frequently summoning Sarah to lend a hand with the torrent of paperwork, Sarah found herself in a chaotic dance, shifting between the rhythmic resonance of numbers and smudge-filled pages of her sketchbook.
Late into the quiet Philadelphia nights, Sarah dragged herself to her corner studio, littered with canvases showcasing half-stirred ideas.
Each unfinished tapestry was a visual representation of her failed attempts at creation.
Despite her passionate efforts, Sarah's struggle was imminent.
She found herself unable to make a deep emotional connection with her work, leaving her yearning for a unique artistic voice.
Then, a heartbreaking twist unfolded.
Sarah's mother, the bedrock of the Academy, abruptly fell victim to a debilitating stroke.
The Academy plunged into a whirlpool of chaos, mirroring the storm brewing within Sarah's heart.
Pushed into the deep end, Sarah was coerced into filling her mother's cumbersome shoes.
She found herself sinking under the growing mountain of administrative work, warring with her love for art.
The Academy, now unsteady and beginning to falter, was on the brink of closure.
Financial constraints were jeopardizing its survival, with a colossal pile of neglected administrative tasks disrupting its intricate network of finances.
With every passing day, Sarah was draped in a cloak of self-doubt and frustration.
Just as hope seemed lost, a new character emerged, Joseph.
As a visiting artist with an air of charm, Joseph empathized deeply with Sarah's plight.
He provided Sarah with a much-needed lifeline, urging her to channel her tribulations into her art.
Inspired and intrigued by the concept, Sarah embarked on an enlightening journey.
She dug deep into her pool of raw emotions, projecting them onto vast, blank canvases.
Over time, Sarah's art started reflecting her roller-coaster of personal experiences.
Transforming her struggles into a fluttering array of colors and forms, Sarah found herself growing around her art and unraveling her potential.
As Sarah established a firm footing in the artistic realm and found her unique voice, her modern impressionist artwork began garnering attention from intrigued Academy members.
Accepting the Academy's dire straits, Sarah proposed financially viable solutions.
Sarah's newfound determination spills into her art, leading her to create the most ambitious and introspective piece she had ever attempted.
Behind the closed doors of the Academy, arrangements were being made for a grand art exhibition.
Finally, the much-awaited exhibition commenced.
Included among the vast expressive gallery was Sarah's introspective masterpiece, a clear testament to her phenomenal artistic growth.
To everyone's relief, Sarah's innovative crowdfunded exhibition turned the tide.
The exhibition also catapulted Sarah's work into the limelight, reinvigorating her confidence, and solidifying her reputation as a competent, unique artist.
Having boldly faced her trials, Sarah emerged as an efficient Academy manager.
Meanwhile, she continued to polish her craft and upheld her prominence as a respected artist.
Sarah’s mother’s condition began to significantly improve, her recovery signaling the potential return of the Academy's former manager.
Sarah's transformation was confirmed as she stood amidst influential members from the artistic community, effortlessly articulating her art philosophy.
The climax revealed a high-stake turn of event: Alexander Kowalski, a renowned art collector, was drawn towards Sarah's art and decided to acquire her most celebrated piece.
Sarah’s newfound success, symbolized in the acquisition of her painting by Kowalski, was a career-altering milestone.
Sarah was now confidently seated in the manager's chair, her leadership skills becoming increasingly evident with the successful restructuring and consistent operation of the Academy.
Having braved her trials, the final scene showed Sarah reentering her artist's sanctuary, her studio.
A blank canvas stood on an easel, inviting her for yet another artistic exploration.
Sarah’s eyes, once filled with doubts, now sparkled with confidence and anticipation.
A promising future loomed ahead, both for her artistic journey and for the revived Academy.
A heartwarming climax unfolded as Sarah and her mother reflected together on the past struggles, challenges, triumphs, and the journey ahead.
The steady recovery of her mother added a way of personal victory to Sarah's professional triumph, making her success all the more profound.

66505782.title: Showing Up (film)
synopsis: Lizzy is a sculptor and arts administrator assistant for her mother at her alma mater, the Oregon College of Art and Craft.
She is also working on a showing of her work, clay sculptures of women in joyful or anguished movement.
Lizzy's landlord and neighbor Jo, a rival artist, frequently spars with her.
For days Lizzy is continuously reminding Jo to fix Lizzy's hot water heater, but Jo prioritizes everything else, like hanging a tire swing in the backyard and her two upcoming shows.
To have enough time to finish her sculptures, Lizzy takes Tuesday off from work.
In the middle of the night, Lizzy's cat maims a pigeon that flew into the house.
Lizzy throws the pigeon outside, but Jo discovers and rescues it the next morning, before dumping the work of taking care of it on Lizzy.
Lizzy is at first actively resentful before she begins to bond with the bird.
She ends up taking it to the vet, which costs her $150.
When Jo finally comes for the bird, Lizzy lets her know it distracted her and kept her from her glazing.
Lizzy visits her father at home.
She does not trust the hippies who have invited themselves to stay with him, who are more grifters than friends.
Lizzy discovers that he has not had contact with her brother Sean for six months.
Concerned, Lizzy goes to see Sean.
He has become reclusive, and is delusional, convinced that his neighbors are behind his TV antenna not working.
Contacting their mother about it, Lizzy believes her brother needs more than just emotional help, but is told he is simply a misunderstood genius.
The weekend right before her show, Lizzy's final piece burns on one side in the kiln.
Visiting Sean, he is digging a massive pit in his backyard and insists he is hearing voices, which Lizzy and others choose not to hear.
She convinces her mother to come watch him.
Lizzy's mother puts Sean to sleep after he suffers the mental episode.
Although it was arranged that he would come to the show, when she arrives he is not there.
Lizzy is nervous, hearing that he has wandered off alone.
At Lizzy's show her family shows up, even Sean, having taken the bus.
Jo comes and brings the pigeon.
It has its bandages removed by two unsupervised girls.
Everyone watches as Sean releases the bird and it flies away.
Jo and Lizzy go looking for it, but eventually accept it was ready to fly.

42925086.title: Visionless Harmony
synopsis: Our idyllic scene is set in a uniquely decorated, repurposed cathedral, where antiquated chandeliers emit a timeless glow.
Celebrated cellist Melissa Bloomsfield, takes the stage and commands the room with a captivating solo on her cello.
Following the finale of her performance, Melissa bows elegantly, absorbing the applause.
Melissa lives a luxurious life filled with high-end recording studios, historical concert venues, and her opulent penthouse situated in the heart of New York.
Following her cathedral concert, Melissa is seen moving toward the parking lot when a malicious silhouette shrouded in gloom attacks her.
Melissa retracts and fights back with a fierceness befitting her determined personality.
She’s hit on her temple and falls into unconsciousness.
Melissa regains consciousness in the sterile confines of a hospital room, realizing her vision is indefinitely severed.
She learns that the irreparable loss of sight is a result of the brutal attack.
Melissa struggles to absorb this tragic reality, as vibrant hues of everyday life are suddenly replaced with tangible darkness.
She starts to sense an intrusive presence lingering within the sterile hospital corridors.
An unsettling whisper haunts Melissa’s silence, adding to her distress.
When she voices her suspicions, her mother and friends dismiss her experiences as hallucinations.
Amidst despair, Melissa finds comfort in Gemma, a compassionate and seasoned nurse.
Melissa and Gemma team up to explore the mysterious happenings at the hospital.
They record instances of misplaced items alongside unsettling sounds resonating within the hospital’s deserted corridors.
Gemma examines the hospital’s security operations and re-examines incident reports, leading to frightening discoveries.
They unearth the identity of Melissa’s assailant as a notorious contract killer hired by an infamous mafia family.
As they piece together Melissa’s recollection, they realise that she overheard details of the mafia’s illegal activities at the concert.
The mafia soon learns that Melissa is regaining her memory.
They dispatch their contract killer with renewed orders to silence Melissa.
Melissa and Gemma vow to stand their ground and shine a light on their adversaries.
They use the hospital's annual charity event at the Guggenheim Museum to expose the mafia’s activities.
Gemma’s tactical foresight and Melissa’s sharp recall combine to reveal the mafia's scam in a public presentation.
The mafia's contract killer, disguised as a hospital attendant, misses his mark in the chaos.
The NYPD, prepped by Gemma's cryptic call, storms the museum, detaining the key players and busting an international crime syndicate.
Following this encounter, Melissa’s life steers towards healing.
Through therapy sessions conducted in her penthouse, Melissa navigates her fears, focusing on her remaining senses.
She explores the braille universe, gets to know every corner of her penthouse, and reconnects with her ardently loved music.
These explorations guide Melissa back to her first love, her cherished cello.
Despite her loss of sight, Melissa reconnects with her audience at the refurbished cathedral stage.
She embarks on her solo, ‘Elgar's Cello Concerto in E minor.'
Her performance is a testament of her survival.
As the concert ends, Melissa’s music echoes across the cathedral, symbolising her triumphant journey.
Thus concludes the story of Melissa, who despite losing her physical sense of sight, finds a way to create a fresh and harmonious symphony in life.

62964875.title: Sightless
synopsis: Following a brutal attack in a parking lot, violinist Ellen Ashland wakes up in hospital to learn that she has been blinded.
During her recuperation at the hospital she receives a phone call from her brother, who says he has found an apartment for her.
Ellen wakes in her new apartment with no memory of having travelled there.
Clayton arrives, a nurse her brother has hired to care for her as she begins to adjust to life without sight.
From one of her windows Ellen can feel a breeze and hear traffic below.
But she can’t hear any sounds from the other window in her living room.
When she questions Clayton, he says the window just has thicker glass.
One night, Ellen hears the voice of a woman in distress; she initially believes the woman is in her apartment, but then realises the noise is coming through the vent from the adjoining apartment.
The following morning, she goes next door and puts up a sticky note on her neighbour's door asking her to join her for tea.
Later that day, her neighbour shows up and introduces herself as Lana.
Ellen is suspicious of Lana as she seems scared to talk.
Lana tries to leave Ellen's apartment but when Ellen tries to stop her she touches Lana's face, and is alarmed to feel a wound with stitches.
Lana reacts by whispering "trust no one" and then flees Ellen's apartment upon the arrival of her abusive husband, Russo.
Ellen contacts Detective Bryce (the officer working on her assault case) who sends Officer Neiman to check on Lana; he confirms she is okay and does not have any recent wounds.
Ellen expresses her concerns to Clayton but he tells her that he has met Lana, that she seems unhinged, and Ellen should not worry about her.
Later that day Ellen is standing near her door when she hears footsteps.

At first she thinks it's Lana and begins to apologise to her for the misunderstanding, but it’s Russo, who warns her to stay away from his wife, and says he will be talking to the building management about her.
A few moments later Clayton arrives and a frantic Ellen tells him that Russo has threatened her.
Angry and protective, Clayton says he will talk to Russo, but Ellen stops him.
Then Clayton hints that he has feelings for her, but when he confesses this, Ellen turns him down and he leaves dejected.
Hearing someone enter the apartment, Ellen thinks that Clayton has returned and begins to apologise.
However the newcomer attacks Ellen.
Hearing the assailant’s breathing pattern she recognises it as that of the person who attacked her in the parking lot.
She manages to dial 911 before passing out.
She is awoken by a paramedic and a worried Clayton, who informs her that Detective Bryce is here to see her.
Detective Bryce reassures her that after Clayton left her apartment, nobody else entered.
Detective Bryce also confirms to Ellen that her friend Sasha, who was having an affair with Ellen's ex-husband, is the prime suspect in Ellen's attack.
Feeling alone and unsure of anyone, Ellen is overwhelmed and decides to commit suicide.
She writes letters to her brother, Sasha, and Clayton, and then jumps from her apartment balcony.
Ellen wakes up on the floor of a soundproof room and quickly realises the apartment she was staying in was fake, and all of the noises "outside" were coming from a speaker system.
She explores the hallway only to find she cannot escape.
Ellen finds Lana in the hallway and asks her for help, asking about the place they are living in, and telling her that she knows they are being watched.
Lana tells her that this is home and flees before answering anymore questions.

Clayton then arrives to cook Ellen dinner and knocks twice; at that moment she realises all of the people she has interacted with since her attack - the doctors, the detective, the paramedic, Russo - were all Clayton playing different roles, but giving himself away by his habit of knocking on any surface twice.
Ellen knocks Clayton unconscious and finds Lana who reveals she is Clayton's sister and she helped him kidnap Ellen.
She then tells Ellen their only hope of escape is by using the hidden vent in Clayton's room.
Clayton finds and once again captures Ellen.
He confesses that after his mother's death, his father kept him captive in the basement for three years.
During this time, Lana played recordings of Ellen playing the violin, with the result that he became obsessed with her.
Ellen tries to escape via the vent and finds a vial, which she realises is the same substance that was used in the attack that left her blind.
She finds her way back to her room, chased by Clayton, and sprays the substance in his face.
Upon seeing Clayton disabled, Lana guides Ellen to an exit into the outside world.
Six months later, Ellen prepares to go on stage to the sound of an elated crowd, as an assistant asks her if she needs any help.
She declines and walks on stage herself.

22623847.title: Festive Feast (2021 film)
synopsis: The lively and easy-going couple, Lois and Richard, are introduced against the backdrop of their idyllic 18th-century farmhouse.
As Richard and Lois prepare for the holidays, the aromatic scent of homemade hot chocolate fills every corner of the house.
Lois is shown deeply engrossed at their dining table, writing out thoughtful Christmas cards.
Meanwhile, Richard is seen outdoors chasing a flock of wild turkeys that had invaded their organic farmland.
Back indoors, Lois undertakes the responsibility of crafting the traditional Christmas cookies.
She mistakenly swaps sugar for salt due to a mislabeled canister.
Lois's grimace and overblown reaction create a moment of intense surprise as she spits out a salty cookie.
Richard, puzzled and absurdly entertained, examines the salty cookies spread across the kitchen counter.
Shaking off their comical mishap, the duo takes to their frosty front yard, starting a friendly competition with the neighborhood kids to build the biggest snowman.
However, their ambition to build the biggest snowman hits a glitch when their icy figure starts melting prematurely, placed too close to a heat lamp by some mischief-making neighborhood kids.
Lois overlooks this, much to the amusement of their neighbors.
The party begins as Elizabeth, Lois’s audacious best friend from childhood, enters with a state-of-the-art karaoke machine.
Despite her lack of singing abilities, Elizabeth fills Lois's living room with laughter as she sings Mariah Carey's holiday anthems.
Richard's friend Raj introduces the group to Choley Bature, a delicacy from northern India.
Mark, the misunderstood antagonist from Lois and Richard’s high school days, unexpectedly shows up at the door.
Despite his arrival, the group manages to continue the festivities.
Suddenly, the evening is plunged into darkness as a power outage strikes.
However, Lois and Richard make the best out of the situation by roasting marshmallows over candles and starting a game of shadow charades.
A full-fledged bull moose surprisingly saunters into their snow-covered backyard, nibbling away at their Christmas wreaths.
Richard and Lois propose a gingerbread house building competition to lighten the mood which turns into a food fight.
Lois and Richard retreat to their cozy study to enjoy the joyful noise echoing around the house.
They make use of the gingerbread wreckage and other leftovers, creating a feast.
As the moon takes over the night sky, the gathering concludes with the guests singing Christmas carols.
The evening edges towards its conclusion as Lois and Richard reflect on the day's events while discussing plans for next year's festive bash.

62856509.title: Silent Night (2021 film)
synopsis: Married couple Nell and Simon host a yearly Christmas dinner at their country estate for their former school friends and their spouses.
This Christmas is a special occasion with everyone dressing in formal wear and the children being allowed to swear.

It is gradually revealed that because of an imminent environmental catastrophe in which a gigantic rolling poisonous gas cloud (which follows minutes after numerous smaller green tornadoes that are generally considered as heralds of the upcoming danger) is killing most life forms, the British government has issued suicide pills for a quick and easy death before the cloud hits Britain.
The suicide pills were delivered to the entire population, except for the homeless and illegal migrants.
Nell, Simon, and the rest of their friends have made a suicide pact to take the pills and give them to their children.
However, while James agrees with his friends over the decision, his young wife Sophie has recently discovered she is pregnant and is still unsure whether to take the pill.

There are several confrontations during the night: Kitty is given a doll that resembles her, and she hugs her father, but refuses to hug Sandra even though she begs her to; Art finds the act of gift giving ridiculous, so he lashes out at the adults and runs from the room; Sandra tells James she had loved him when they were in school and wondered why they never had sex; Tony gets visibly upset at her admission and claims he has never made a mistake, at which point Bella says they once had sex before he got together with Sandra; Alex feels left out during the festivities, which causes her to drink too much and pass out in her bed.
Nell, Simon and their children video chat with Nell's mother, who is abroad, to say goodbye.
She sees the gas coming, so hangs up and takes the pill.
The conversation leaves their eldest, Art, distressed.
He begins to speculate that the government and the scientists are wrong.
Art approaches James and Sophie with his fears.
Sophie then reveals to him that she is pregnant thus she does not want to take the pill.
Art tells his parents he will not take the pill; this culminates in him running away after a discussion.
Art soon discovers a family, including a baby, on the side of the road.
They are dead, and there are several packs of the pill in the car.
Shocked, Art begins to scream as the small green tornadoes twist around him; his screams allow Simon to find him and he carries him home.
After returning home, the group realizes it is past midnight and time to take their pills.
They divide into their separate rooms to say goodbye.
Art passes out and Nell holds him, while Simon gives his children the pills.
The boys ask for drinks to take the pills, so Simon gets them fizzy drinks.
Meanwhile, James pressures Sophie to take the pill saying he will not unless she does too, and they eventually take them.
Bella attempts to wake Alex to take her pill and makes her take it while she is very drunk, but she wakes and vomits the pill.
Bella tells her they have five minutes and while in the kitchen they dance and Bella uses the diversion to stab Alex.
Both die soon after.
Tony, Kitty and Sandra all lie in a bed to await death when Kitty remembers her doll and runs to get it while Sandra again begs her for a hug.
When Kitty returns, she sees her parents are dead and she crawls between them, finally hugging Sandra.
Nell notices that Art has bled through  his eyes, nose, and ears.
Frightened, the whole family rapidly take their pills, and lie next to Art.
The following morning, it is seen that everyone is dead.
The final shot focuses on Art, who suddenly opens his eyes.

47514977.title: West Coast Apprehension 2013
synopsis: Sarah Blackwood, a battle-hardened FBI agent based in Portland, Oregon, finds herself haunted by the aftermath of a personal disaster, having narrowly escaped death in a car bomb explosion.
On a seemingly ordinary day, Sarah receives a mysterious envelope containing a series of horrifying images revealing violent plans, marked by a cryptic wolf symbol.
Portland soon becomes a playground for unconventional crimes and high-end robberies, each marked with the wolf symbol.
She recognizes the wolf emblem tied to her past, bringing back traces of Anthony Lobo, her adversary assumed deceased.
A trusted colleague delivers the news that Anthony Lobo, the dreaded mastermind she thought was defeated, is causing the current chaos.
As fear threatens to overcome her, Sarah decides to confront it head-on, enlisting the help of Jacob Hayes, a new agent in the FBI.
They discover that Lobo plans to create widespread panic at the annual Christmas parade in downtown Portland.
The scale of the new crimes reminds her of her traumatic past, filling her with terror.
Their investigation uncovers a traitor within their ranks funneling top-secret information to Anthony Lobo.
Feeling betrayed, they decide to handle the predicament themselves.
The situation gets riskier when Sarah gets a threat over a call from Lobo, who taunts her and promises carnage at the city’s Christmas event.
Undeterred, Sarah and Jacob work tirelessly to piece together leads across the city.
At the annual Christmas parade, they spot Lobo among the crowd, beginning a high-stakes game of wits.
Sarah faces her lifelong nemesis in a final showdown.
With Lobo finally apprehended, Portland is safe.
The victory comes at a price, as Jacob falls severely injured in the confrontation.
The ordeal strengthens rather than breaks her, and Sarah promises to continue fighting against evil.
Haunted by her past, Sarah instead opts for resilience, finally making peace with her history.
Accepting her fear as part of her nature, she prepares for future trials and swears never to back down.
The film concludes with a stronger Sarah, readying herself for new challenges in her career.

61019688.title: Silk Road (film)
synopsis: The film begins with Ross Ulbricht's arrest in San Francisco in 2013.
It then delves into Ross's background, portraying him as a well-educated aspiring entrepreneur living in Austin, Texas.
Ross comes up with the idea for Silk Road as a way to challenge government control and regulations, believing in the idea of taking back liberty.
He starts the website to allow anonymous buying and selling of illegal goods.

The movie introduces Ross Ulbricht, a charismatic and tech-savvy young man who creates the Silk Road, an underground website that facilitates the sale of illegal drugs and other contraband using cryptocurrencies.
Ulbricht adopts the alias "Dread Pirate Roberts" to operate the site anonymously.
Ross meets Julia, a student who becomes his lover and partner in crime.
As Silk Road gains popularity, Ross makes millions by facilitating the sale of illegal items such as drugs, weapons, and identity information.
However, when a Gawker article about Silk Road brings unwanted attention, law enforcement begins investigating the darknet marketplace.
