David stands up and says the couple has their blessing, but that they do not really need it, and if he and Georgia had listened to all of their own detractors (David's friends and Georgia's parents, respectively), they never would have had Lily.
Despite how their marriage turned out, they are both happier in a world with Lily in it.
Lily and Gede are touched, complete the ceremony and get married.
On the morning after the wedding, Georgia tells Paul that she cannot marry him, and they end their relationship.
David and Georgia toy with romance again, even kissing each other once, before pulling away and laughing about it.
David, Georgia and Wren exchange tearful goodbyes with Lily and board a boat to leave.
David and Georgia consider their romantic prospects again, debating aloud whether they are too old to feel young again and when they might return to Bali.
In a flash, they both decide to stay, jumping off the boat to return to the dock.

26217119.title: Passing the Torch
synopsis: We are introduced to Tom, a highly successful but incredibly stressed software magnate who struggles with the pressures of his demanding clientele and tight project deadlines.
His tenacious dedication to his profession has caused him to fade into mere existence in his family household and life, making a balanced work and personal life seem like an unreachable aspiration.
A slow but powerful understanding falls upon him one day: he is gradually losing the deep connect he once shared with his wife Karen, and their teenaged children, Jack and Emma.
An innovative thought occurs to him: why not seek a surrogate, a temporary replacement in his personal life, someone who could keep the balance in the family intact?
His search sees him interviewing a number of potential stand-ins, but none captivates or intrigues him quite as much as the charmingly eccentric, auburn-haired Lily.
Tom undertakes the enormous task of downloading his life to Lily, guiding her through his home routines, and familiarizing her with the nuances of his unique family dynamic.
Each session serving as a mirror into his own life.
Revealing Lily as his ‘home surrogate’ to his family results in complete shock.
His wife Karen is astounded while their teenaged children Jack and Emma express a blend of confusion and rebellious defiance.
Lily’s entrance into their lives disrupts the careful balance in Tom’s household, as this unorthodox stand-in begins her new role in their lives.
The family expresses their vehement disapproval of Lily through an array of naughty pranks and outright defiance.
Despite their initial hostile reactions, Lily maintains her composure and counters their rebellion with sharp wit and irrepressible resilience.
As he observes this chaotic turmoil, Tom starts noticing a disturbing disconnect within his family, an uncovered wound he had been ignorant of until now.
Confronted with the stark reality of his failing family life, Tom comprehends the deep-rooted implications of his choices and embarks on a deliberate journey to rebuild his ties with his family.
Simultaneously, Lily — having observed the strained family dynamics and moved by the situation — quietly concocts a plan to repair the cracks that have formed in the family bonds.
Maintaining complete discretion, she starts gradually transferring responsibilities back to Tom, who steps up to navigate the unchartered territories of his fatherly and husbandly duties.
At the same time, Tom digs deep to awaken his dormant fatherly instincts and submerge himself in the deep waters of his husband duties.
He strives for improved communication, deepened connections with Karen, Jack, and Emma, and to regain their trust.
On the other end, Lily employs her clever, light-hearted tricks and thought-provoking challenges to subtly give Tom back the reigns of his family.

Through countless hurdles and numerous attempts, Tom comes to find a balance between his professional and personal commitments, realizing that achieving this delicate equilibrium isn’t merely a mirage.

Lily, once perceived only as a stand-in, gradually became a cherished member of the family, revered not merely as a surrogate but as a dear confidante who had successfully mended their strained bonds.
The story gradually comes to an end when Lily embarks on a new adventure of her own, leaving behind a much happier and harmonious Russell family.
Meanwhile, having learned a vast life lesson, Tom savors each moment of resounding laughter and deep conversations with his revitalized family.

The tale eloquently wraps up emphasizing that the responsibility of nurturing relationships and managing the work-life balance isn't a passing task but something that needs much dedication and effort from everyone.

66310205.title: Together Together
synopsis: Matt, an app developer in his forties, interviews Anna, a young coffee shop employee, to become his surrogate.
He wants to become a dad without getting married and she wants to finance her bachelor's and master's degrees.
During her first trimester, the doctor tells Matt and Anna that everything is going well, so he invites Anna to dinner to celebrate.
Afterwards, Matt tells his brother and parents about the pregnancy; his mother is unhappy about it.
At dinner, Matt and Anna talk about how nervous they are about conversing with each other.
While ordering, he makes a disapproving sound when she orders potato over salad, as what she eats the baby eats.
He orders pasta with bacon.
Once the waitress leaves, Anna points out that he should also watch his diet for the child, as in his case it matters for the next 18+ years.
Next, they attend therapy together, where Matt expresses excitement and wants to tell everybody, and is surprised that Anna is not going to tell anyone about the pregnancy.
Coming out of therapy, Matt asks if she wants a bite of candy, as when he went to couple's therapy with his ex, afterwards they would hold hands and eat candy.
At the coffee shop, Matt brings pregnancy tea and clogs for Anna.
She takes the tea, but not the clogs.
Matt takes them to Anna's house, where he meets a guy Anna hooked up with.
He gets upset as he thinks it's bad for the baby.
At the hospital, Anna insists he cannot stop her from having sex for a whole year, and it is safe for pregnant women to have sex, which the technician confirms.
They then happily listen to the heartbeat.
At therapy, Matt says that it was very exciting and he wants to hear that sound all the time, while Anna says that it was nice to see Matt so happy.
The therapist asks them if they are having any conflicts other than the clogs, and they talk about Matt's concern over Anna having sex.
Although the therapist tries to clear his doubts, he remains skeptical.
During the second trimester, Anna tells Matt that she needs the money to get into an accelerated degree program to complete her bachelor's and master's degrees in three years.
Matt shows her the future nursery, and she helps him pick the color for it.
Next, both have a deep conversation about why they are alone.
They start hanging out more and choose a gender-neutral name to refer to the baby, "Lamp".
At the mall, seeking maternity wear, Anna meets her sister's friend and lies that she works there.
She doesn't want her sister or parents to know she is pregnant, as they would disapprove.
Matt asks Anna to move in with him until the birth, as he wants to get all the possible time with the baby.
As they go crib shopping, the salesgirl calls them a couple, but Anna says, "Ew, no".
This upsets Matt a little.
Anna explains it would be gross if they were a couple, as he is twenty years older.
At the baby shower, Anna feels odd when Matt's mother says she's unrelated to the baby.
Anna realizes that despite trying so hard not to, she is getting attached to the baby and Matt.
She leaves his house afterwards, citing the importance of boundaries.
In the third trimester, Anna and Matt attend a prenatal class to prepare mothers for childbirth.
After some days, Anna feels mild cramps at night and calls Matt, fearing early labor.
The doctor says such cramps are normal and the baby is healthy, but not coming yet.
After the visit, Anna confesses that she loves Matt in a platonic way and she doesn't want to lose him, but that she can't stay, as she got accepted to a Vermont college.
Matt says they won't lose each other, as he loves her too and that he is proud of her for getting into college.
This time, after attending therapy, Anna asks if Matt wants to hold hands and eat candy, which they do in the park on a bench.
She starts having contractions one week before the due date.
They do all the things they learned at the birth center and take Anna to the hospital, where she delivers baby Lamp.
The movie ends with Matt consoling a crying Lamp as the camera lingers on Anna.

30556931.title: Predators: Obsidian Isle
synopsis: The film opens with a breathtaking panorama of a glittering cityscape similar to New York, the skyline is utterly dwarfed by the futuristic 180-floor skyscraper.
This dominating edifice is the nerve center of Verti-Chem Industries, a powerful hub of scientific innovation and advancement.

The camera dives inside to reveal a state-of-the-art planning room, where Jack, a seasoned survivalist, meticulously orchestrates his ambitious plans for an upcoming extravagant hunting expedition featuring genetically altered, real-life dinosaurs.

Assisted by Dr. Simmons, the genius bioengineer with a morally ambiguous aura, and Bella, the resourceful survivalist famed for her unyielding spirit, they delve deep into the intricate details of this unprecedented safari.
The first act crescendos with a stunning collection of luxury vehicles, ferrying an elite clientele.
These billionaires, power-hungry and thrill-seeking, are lured by the tantalizing prospect of hunting down the prehistoric creatures.
The narrative sails into Act Two as the wealthy party boards the 'Royal Neptune', an awe-inspiring galleon set for the exotic Obsidian Isle.
As the ship cuts through the sea, Jack rises to the occasion, regaling listeners with tales about the apex predators they intend to challenge.
Under the early dawn light, Obsidian Isle extends an inviting welcome.
Jack, with military precision, delegates personalized targets - from cunning velociraptors to towering T-Rex - to the eagerly anticipated groups.
Chatter subsides as hunters fan out into the verdant depths of the primal rainforest.
A group, centered around a Russian oligarch and his hardened guards, encounters a rogue Spinosaurus, a predator unexpectedly more lethal than their targeted subjects.
Their encounter resonates in their horror as they scramble back to Jack's well-secured lodge, their faces exposing the reality of their fatal brush with danger.
Disregarding their terror as a mere moment of cowardice, Jack displays unflinching faith in his meticulously planned strategy, defending its design.
As the lavish activities plunge deeper into potential catastrophe, Bella stumbles upon the dark recesses of Dr. Simmons' off-limits subterranean lab.
A spread of classified folders, filled with morally revolting experiments, conceal a revelation: a progeny of scientific manipulation, a grotesquely enhanced, unstable Spinosaurus.
The narrative twists into Act Three as Bella barges into Jack's office, thrusting the incriminating evidence at him with a demand of immediate rectification.
Jack, wrestling to maintain his composure, brush off Bella's alarming news, preferring to quell the brewing fears amongst the oblivious hunters.
With an escalating dread, more groups stream in, each bearing grim testimonies of encounters with the rogue Spinosaurus.
Driven to desperation, Jack summons the survivors, aligning them for a massive coordinated attack to exterminate the rampant Spinosaurus.
Their plotted offensive falls apart against the beast's strength and agility.
Jack's scheme lies exposed, as does Dr. Simmons' monstrous alteration of nature.
Act Four bares its teeth as the Obsidian Isle crumbles into a fearful disarray.
Jack’s stubborn arrogance and Dr. Simmons’ unchecked ambition send ripples of dread through the desperate attempts of survival among the marooned billionaires.
With the panic threatening to consume all rational thought, Bella seizes the reins, her vast understanding of predatory behavior guiding her leadership.
Ingeniously weaving a trap centered on the Spinosaurus' habitual hunting pattern, Bella motivates the remaining survivors into one final, united stand.
Gripping high-powered explosive rifles and enthused by Bella’s unwavering leadership, the survivors steel themselves for a life or death showdown.
Act Five yanks the tension tauter still as they bait the Spinosaurus towards a strategically placed trap by the waterfront.
The climax sends adrenaline surging through the veins as Bella and the Spinosaurus lock eyes in a battle of wills, the looming showdown set against a backdrop of smoke, fire, and thundering gunfire.
Rising under Bella's tactical mastery and united bravery, they corner the Spinosaurus and finally bring it down under a hail of bullets.
Their triumphant cheers die abruptly as they absorbing the magnitude of their loss.
The aftermath bares the horrifying results of Dr. Simmons' ambition and Jack's overbearing self-assurance, demanding severe accountability for their actions.
Amidst the wreckage, Bella's courage and wisdom earn her the title of the true hero.
As the battle-weary survivors regroup, they carry the mental scars of their harrowing experience, vowing to shun such crazed pitfalls of thrill-seeking extravaganzas.
As 'Royal Neptune' cuts through the crashing waves towards home, the slain Spinosaurus’ image is seared into their minds, forever stigmatizing Obsidian Isle.
The film draws to a close on a foreboding note as they vacate.
The lonely carcass of the Spinosaurus is a grim monument of human avarice and unacceptable arrogance.
The concluding shot pans back to the deserted Verti-Chem Industries skyscraper, a silent witness to the horrifying outcome of unchecked ambition.

62486665.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
synopsis: Big game hunter Bill (Richard Brake), owner of Avex-Bio Tech, leads a hunting party with his partner Dr. Richards and best hunter Anna (Cassie Clare), where he takes wealthy participants to hunt down Graboids on Dark Island, a private area where he operates his company.
Dr. Jasmine 'Jas' Welker (Caroline Langrishe) and colleague Jimmy (Jon Heder) work on the research site next to Dark Island where they were experiencing unnatural seismic vibrations.
When Jas sees Bill leaving Dark Island, she along with Jimmy and her friend Ishimon set out to investigate what Bill was up to and find a dead Graboid.
They attempt to flee when they realize it has given birth to Shriekers, but the Shriekers kill Ishimon.
Jas, knowing what Graboids are, instructs Jimmy to use coordinates provided by her son Travis to find Burt Gummer (Michael Gross).
She visits Bill at his camp and learns Bill genetically bred the Graboids on the island and made them more powerful and intelligent for his hunt.
He also cut off communications so nothing would stop him and his hunting party.
Jimmy finds Burt, who has now lived in isolation as a survivalist away from the government and is content on being retired from anything related to Graboids.
Jimmy informs him they need his help and Travis is unavailable due to being arrested in Mexico for smuggling shrooms.
Burt reluctantly agrees when Jimmy convinces him it is his destiny.
When he learns Jas is there, he nearly refuses to help due to their history and keeping Travis' birth a secret from him for so many years.
Having cleaned himself up, Burt gets to meet the crew, including tomboy Freddie (Jackie Cruz) who has a crush on Jimmy.
Bill shows up to intimidate Burt and tells him to back off his hunt, but Burt is not afraid and warns Bill that the Graboids are a strong threat no matter what planning is implemented against them.
Burt tries to gather weapons only to find out that they have no firearms to defend themselves, only a bunker from World War II which has machetes, two flamethrowers, and dynamite that is unstable.
On Dark Island, the Shriekers Jas and Jimmy encountered have begun killing off members of Bill’s hunting party.

Eventually, they find the Shriekers, but they, like their parent Graboid, are also superior to the originals and can now use their screams as sonic emitting weapons allowing them to pick off Bill's crew one by one.
They are saved when Burt and the others arrive killing the Shriekers and one Graboid, leaving two remaining Graboids.
Returning to Jas' research site, they are shocked to learn one of the Graboids made it to their location, showing signs it is much more powerful than they all realized.
Burt warns Bill to call off the hunt and turn the communication system back on, but he refuses.
Bill tranquilizes Burt and locks him and the others in the bunker.
Awakening in the bunker, everyone has been bound with zip ties.
When Jimmy looks at Burt's boots, he remembers that he loaned them to Burt and that he had the laces replaced with paracord, allowing Burt to cut the zip ties off.
Meanwhile, Bill's hunt continues but goes horribly wrong when the Graboid that made it to Jas' site earlier has shown up and is subsequently dubbed "The Queen" due to its superiority.
Anna quits when Bill's lust for the hunt proves too dangerous and insane.
Anna frees Burt and the others from the bunker, but they are attacked by a Graboid before they can leave.
They use the dynamite to blow it up leaving only The Queen.
Burt locates Bill to reason with him but is unable to convince him to give up his hunt.
Bill meets his demise when The Queen finds them and devours Bill.
Burt realizes The Queen is killing the weakest off until Burt, who Jimmy points out must be the Alpha, is left remaining.

Burt gathers the remaining survivors and, inspired by the way his friends Valentine McKee and Earl Bassett successfully killed off an intelligent Graboid in his very first encounter with the creatures (Tremors), they plan to lead The Queen to an inactive volcano dubbed Devil's Punchbowl and lure The Queen over a plateau onto a bed of spiked dynamite.
Burt and Jimmy leave to kill off the remaining Shriekers, while Jas and the others set up the trap for The Queen.
Burt and Jimmy make it to Dark Island and begin killing off the Shriekers with the bunker weapons.
They return to the research site, but find out The Queen is there waiting for Burt.
The team heads to Devil's Punchbowl to execute the plan with Jimmy following behind Burt.
The pair are successfully leading The Queen into the trap, but Burt, at the last second, pushes Jimmy out of the way and lets himself be swallowed by The Queen to ensure her demise.
The Queen dies from the dynamite and spikes, and Burt does not survive, much to the sadness of Jas and the others.
In the end, they make a memorial for Burt, leaving behind their weapons with his signature hat and sunglasses.
During the credits, scenes of Burt Gummer from all the previous  Tremors films are montaged.

91332012.title: Sorcerers: Ascend of the Enchanters
synopsis: In the mystical dominion of Arcanium, a splendid kingdom of enchantment and bewitching charisma resides an underworld, shrouded in secrecy by the Veil of Unseeing, protecting it from the prying eyes of mortals.
The air hums with an electrifying elegance, vibrant and provocative, precious stones radiate with languid brilliance, reflecting onto obsidian waters.
Tension and exhilaration permeate the first scene as it begins with the subterranean council chamber of the Arcane Union.
Charmer, an enchanting sorcerer specializing in illusion magic, emerges from the scene’s shadows with Liana, his intriguing accomplice characterized by her gift of telepathy.

We watch as they wearily escape through dense thickets, darkened alleys, and secretive passages, relentlessly hunted by Varkath and Mordoc, ruthless mercenaries whose forms flicker in and out of the dense foggy shadows.
Aura, a whimsical oracle draped in shimmering robes, meticulously unravels hushed whispers of their past associations with the Arcane Union.

Racing against the clock to outwit their persistent pursuers, Charmer and Liana cross paths with Grug, a cast-off ogre tracker with a robust physique and discerning nature, and Oriel, a diminutive pixie emitting soft bioluminescence, distinguished by healing magic.
Their initial wariness of each other transitions to mutual acceptance as they realize that forming an alliance is their only hope for survival.
Having consolidated their makeshift alliance, they manage to combine their innate magic.
The air rippling with the aftereffects, they transition seamlessly to Cyclos, a sprawling metropolis boasting of high-tech facilities.
Meanwhile, cut-off from the group, Varkath and Mordoc resume their relentless pursuit in the labyrinthian underworld of Arcanium.
Back in Cyclos, signs of impending danger transmit.

Relying on their ancient knowledge and Liana's mind-reading abilities to decipher a complex web of magical traps and cyphers set by their adversaries, they finally expose the shadowy master behind the relentless pursuit.
The climax unfolds in the dramatic heart of Cyclos, transferring viewers from urban sprawl to an expansive battleground.
Our heroes, armed with their varying magical expertise, stand against a mechanized army of drones—an epic showdown of tradition against progress, humans against machines.
Amidst dimming hopes, Grug delivers a riveting plot twist.
He unexpectedly, albeit timely, unveils his latent earth magic, causing a seismic disruption that shatters the robotic enforcers and turns the tide in favor of our heroes.
Leaving behind beaten, dismantled robotics smoldering amongst the debris of advanced energy cores, the quartet emerges triumphant.
The Cyborg citizens of Cyclos, ranging from technomancers to advanced androids, gaze in awe and gratitude upon their unexpected saviors.
In a turn of events, the outsider fugitives become celebrated liberators, welcomed with open arms into the tech-enriched society.

Amidst the rising camaraderie, Grug and Oriel decide to stay back with Charmer's group, marking the founding of an unorthodox, power-packed team that could sway the balance between the magical and modern realms.
The narrative concludes with a picturesque canvas of anticipation.
A hushed cityscape with our heroic quartet symbolically silhouetted against a somber twilight, epitomizes courage and unity, subtly hinting the existence of potent dangers lurking around.

65007906.title: Trollhunters: Rise of the Titans
synopsis: Following the events of Wizards, master wizard Hisirdoux "Douxie" Casperan and former Arcane Order member Nari lure their pursuers Belloc and Skrael onto a moving subway train in New York City where they launch a surprise attack with former Trollhunter Jim Lake Jr. and his girlfriend Claire Nunez.

Jim is wounded during the fight while his best friend Toby Domzaski accidentally snaps the train’s brakes, causing the train to be unable to stop, and complicating things for Prince Krel Taron, Steve Palchuck and Stuart as they are tasked to use 'trifurcate radiation' to negate the wizards' magic.
The subway then breaks out of the station and almost collides into a shop in Times Square , narrowly avoiding the crowd.
Then, Belloc and Skreal start a fire, in the middle of Times Square, with innocent civilians at risk.
They threatened the lives of New York's people unless Nari comes with them.
Douxie has a genius idea, and swaps his mind with Nari's.
It ultimately ends in the Arcane Order capturing Nari, unaware that Douxie swapped minds with her prior to her capture, the group being detained by the police before they escape.
Jim recovers in a newly rebuilt Camelot while learning his mother Barbara is engaged to his former teacher and principal, the changeling Strickler.
The group are then joined by Queen Aja Tarron and matured Eli Pepperjack, Steven unknowingly made himself pregnant when he kissed Aja for the seventh time.

Blinky Galadrigal relays what he learned to reveal the Order's plan to awakening the Titans and have them converge at Arcadia Oaks, the center of the universe, to unite and recreate the world by destroying the current one.
At that time, Order discovers Douxie’s spell and reverts the two back to their normal bodies, but not before Nari alerts Jim, "Trollhunter make the ninth configuration, Krohnisfere will make right".
The heroes enter the Round Table and discover that the Arcane Order is already preparing a ritual to break the Genesis Seals.
The heroes fail to prevent the ritual from carried out with each member of the order piloting their respective titan.

The heroes split up: Claire, Blinky, Douxie’s familiar Archie, and Archie’s father Charlemagne head to the Hong Kong Trollmarket in Hong Kong to acquire the Krohnisfere from the TrollDragon Zong-Shi; Krel leads Stuart, Steve, and Eli to retrieve Excalibur, while the rest split into two teams in an attempt to stop the titans of Skreal and a brainwashed Nari.
Nomura's team goes to tropical Brazil while Strickler's team heads to icy Greenland.

But it ends with Strickler and his fellow changeling Nomura killed in battle while Claire’s team manages to acquire the Krohnisfere, but are forced to leave Archie and his father behind when Belloc's titian destroys the bridge while defeating Varvatos Vex in a gigantic robotic suit of the fictional Gun Robot.
The heroes reunite and Douxie restores Nari’s freewill.
When asked of the Krohnisfere, Nari tells Jim that "Time unfolds differently, like a flower.
Only the Trollhunter will know" before using her Titan to battle and kill Skrael in his Titan, killing herself as well.

As Belloc's titan continues its advance, Blinky realizes the Titans are meant to join with a Heartstone and that the union of Trollmarket's Heartstone and Bellroc's Titan will cause the world to be reborn in fire.
The group arrive ahead of Belloc while Jim realizes that the ninth configuration is meant to represent him and his friends, enabling Jim to finally pull Excalibur out of the stone.
The heroes come face to face with Bellroc, who proves to be too powerful for them to handle.
As Jim is left alone to face Bellroc, he comes to accept that the amulet never made him a hero and he already was one.

Jim’s newly improved amulet (created with Akiridion technology, from the original blueprints from which Merlin had used when he first built the amulet and the hilt stone from Excalibur) begins to respond to Jim and flies towards him, giving him a magic/Akiridion armor which can empower Excalibur with greater power.
Toby, after remembering the anti-magic radiation generator from their first encounter with the Arcane Order, uses it on Bellroc, giving Jim the opportunity to strike Bellroc with Excalibur.
Jim finds a fatally hurt Toby, who has been crushed by debris and thanks his friends in his final moments with remaining eight heroes left to mourn him.

Remembering Nari's words and realizing that the Krohnisfere is meant for him to travel back in time and prevent any tragic events that happened to him and his dearest of friends, Jim decides to use to return to when he first became the Trollhunter.
He gives an emotional farewell and travels back to the morning where he found the mystical amulet, making his first change to the timeline by having Toby find Merlin's amulet under the canals.

69490427.title: Swipe (2022 film)
synopsis: Our story revolves around Jack, a skilled, seasoned, and discreet pickpocket who roams the mottled brick alleyways of New York City, making a modest living from his unique talents.
Daylight hours find him darting through bustling streets, slipping out wallets and watches, while nights are dedicated to silent pilfering of unsuspecting shops.
The illicit proceeds finance his humble existence within the frail walls of a second-rate motel and scanty meals at various city diners that have seen better days.
Jack's unremarkable routine spins on its axis as he finds himself on the receiving end of a cryptic, sealed envelope slipped into his not-so-secret mailbox at the seedy city motel.
The contents of the letter change everything - a perplexing job offer sent by an elusive, unidentified benefactor.
This anonymous entity sparked a desire within Jack, outlining an audacious task – to steal a high-tech, titanium briefcase tucked within a heavily fortified vault.
The vault belonged to the affluent and influential Edward Donahue, noted not only for his wealth but his controlling hand within the city.
The high-stakes task promise rewards beyond Jack's wildest imagination – enough to break free from his humble existence, a seductive proposition that ignited a surge of curiosity in Jack.
The risks were significant, but the quest was too tantalizing for a thrill-seeker like Jack to decline.
Armed with a shrewd mind honed through years of discreet operations, Jack made the life-altering decision to undertake the mission.

Long, laborious nights enveloped him as he developed his grand plan, meticulously studying and dissecting the security details of the vault, each flaw in the design driving a further notch in his scheme.
The vault he was assigned to infiltrate was a security masterpiece.
Labyrinthine laser security dauntingly entwined throughout the dense layers of fortified steel and concrete, with a small battalion of heavily armed guards monitoring the premises tirelessly.

Fearless in the face of danger and furnished with wit sharper than the urban blade, Jack interacted with the impending obstacles with an ingenious strategy– a game that involved manipulation, distraction, and deception.

Capitalizing on his innate problem-solving acumen and nimble agility, Jack progressively overcame the advanced tech fortress, disabling circuit boxes to shut down alarms and executing proficient acrobatics to dodge activating the laser grids.

Bartering his knowledge of the complex, winding sewer network and decaying fire escapes of NYC, he maneuvered throughout the city like a phantom in the night, practicing his daring, ghostly maneuvers undetected.
Jack's expertise and nerve were tested to their limit as he faced the ultimate challenge - breaking into Donahue's vault, pushing the storyline towards a breathtaking climax.
After breaching the vault and retrieving the coveted titanium briefcase, Jack found himself on the brink of life-altering wealth.
However, his tasted triumph soured as a specter from his sordid past, the irrepressible Victor, pounced him in an ambush.
A fierce, hair-raising clash ensued between the arch-rivals who were atop the iconic Empire State Building, their loathing for each other battling against the backdrop of shimmering city lights.
As Victor's strength nearly overwhelmed him, Jack found himself hanging precariously from the building's spire, his life dangling above the concrete jungle.

Summoning every ounce of resilience and strength, along with a fortunate gust of wind at the right moment, Jack clambered back onto the ledge, evading a plunge that would have spelled his dreadful end.
With the dangerous duel behind him, Jack holed up in his motel room.
Yet the curiosity that had fueled his nocturnal exploits now compelled him to reveal the secrets the stolen briefcase withheld.
Delving into the case, memories of past tragedies resurged in Jack's mind, shedding an eerie light on his life of struggle and desolation.
Each piece of the case offered a glimpse into the peculiar mission and hinted at the obscured motives of its anonymous employer.
Within the case, Jack unearthed a compact hard drive encrypted with terabytes of data, evidence ensnaring Senator Jenkins in a web of financial felony and rampant coercion.

The secrets unboxed from the drive laid bare a shadowy nexus of corruption, pilfering public funds and manipulating power that once revealed, had the potential to dismantle the senator's political empire.
As Jack decoded the explosive data, he was torn with a moral quandary.
After an agonizing internal struggle, Jack settled on a path aligned with his inherent sense of justice.
Determined, he set out to expose Jenkins by leaking the compromising data.
Oblivious to Jack's intended treachery, Senator Jenkins sensed something amiss, promptly orchestrating a manhunt to hunt down Jack.
Jack, now a marked fugitive, had to outmaneuver numerous ruthless attempts on his life while safeguarding the invaluable hard drive.
His onerous encounters across the city combined his instinct for danger and logic rooted in his days on the streets.
As the city was seized by chaos, Jack skillfully navigated the turmoil, spreading the scandalous data onto online platforms and journalist contacts within leading news outlets.
The release of the data onto the public forum sparked an immediate and vehement reaction from the world, shattering the veneer of Senator Jenkins' dignity, leaving it in irreparable shambles.
As allegations started piling up, law-enforcement agencies were forced into action, scrambling to investigate the shocking leaks and uncover their veracity.
Jenkins, caught in the gargantuan wave of evidence, was swiftly embroiled in career-annihilating scandals which led to his inevitable detainment by federal agents.
From humble beginnings as a forgotten pickpocket, Jack emerged as an unexpected champion for justice.
His mission accomplished, Jack silently disappeared back into the shadows, pocketing the agreed reward.
An eerily quiet life had restored itself around him, but now, Jack aspired to leave that all behind, discarding his life within the city's seedy underbelly.
Opting for anonymity over recognition, Jack decided to take a step back into obscurity, contented to observe the aftermath of his actions from afar.
The city of New York was left to reel from the political earthquake.
The sense of betrayal enkindled an era of public mourning and simmering anger among the citizens, sowing seeds for a sociopolitical revolution.
Jack's sudden vanish stirred up a whirlwind of speculation, his possible whereabouts hot topics in debates held in run-down pubs and back alleys.
His brazen escapade entered the annals of urban legend, a tale spun and whispered within the city, a tale of a common thief who dared to expose a political beast's sins.
As his story spread far and wide, his identity remained concealed, shrouded in mystery.
The closing scene of the story leaves a lingering suspense, inviting the audience to ponder the incidents and the enigma named Jack.
The fate of Jack, the pickpocket cum vigilante, remains a mystery, paving the way for numerous theories and speculations.

62078334.title: Twist (2021 film)
synopsis: A thief named Tom steals an envelope from a safe and escapes from guards, but is thrown off a building by an unseen assailant.
The envelope is stolen while Tom is left to die.
Years before, a boy named Oliver lived with his mother Molly and their hobby was painting.
After Molly dies from unknown causes, Oliver runs away scared due to not knowing anyone else.
He teaches himself to free run and gets the nickname "Twist".
One day while graffiti spraying on a traffic warden's van, the police chase him and he meets Dodge and Batesey (The Artful Dodger and Charles Bates).
They escape to their den near the Truman Brewery where Twist meets Fagin, their carer.
The next morning, Twist draws a giant graffiti painting on a building.
Fagin sends Red (Nancy Lee) to invite Twist (who is smitten with her) to his for dinner.
Meanwhile, Fagin meets with a friend of his named Sikes (Bill Sikes) revealing she pushed Chitling.
Twist stays with the family and Fagin reveals his plan to steal from art dealer Dr. Crispin Losberne who took everything from Fagin.
They then steal his phone and Batesey makes a copy.
Meanwhile, Red, as a distraction, asks to be an intern for Losberne, so the next day Fagin gets the blueprints to Losberne's gallery.
Twist meets Sikes and her dog Bull's-Eye.
Fagin explains that Losberne once went into partnership with a Mr. Issac Solomon who Losberne also betrayed.
Red plants a small bomb in Losberne's bathroom to steal a lost painting by William Hogarth.
The bomb floods the basement and causes the painting to have to be moved.
Back at base, Twist finds out that Red and Sikes are a couple upsetting him.
At a pub, Red appears and Sikes’ goons attack the group while Dodge plays Ever Fallen In Love in the jukebox.
Twist and Red escape to a pool where the two kiss and run through the park.
Twist is arrested by the traffic warden from earlier and is interrogated by Detectives Brownlow and Bedwin who tell him about Chitling.
Twist is let free and gets back to base.
Batesey is planning to get in a box to steal the painting while it's on the move but because he's claustrophobic, Twist switches places with him.
Losberne finds out about the thieves and this causes Twist to fall out the van.
Sikes picks Batesey up and apparently kills him.
Twist gets back to base and asks "What happened to Tom Chitling?"
and Sikes reveals that she killed Tom.
Fagin makes a plan to break into the auction building.
Disguised, the group sneak in and Fagin plants a gun in Losberne's chair.
This causes a big evacuation.
Twist steals the painting and escapes with Dodge.
Batesey, who is still alive, reveals that Sikes tried to kill him and meets them at the base where Twist reveals he made a duplicate of the painting and has hidden the real one.
He and Red escape and Sikes shoots Fagin.
She then chases them to a rooftop and is shot by Fagin and falls off the building.
A week later, Twist meets Bedwin and Brownlow at a café and leaves them the envelope and a key.
He then calls Brownlow hinting that the painting was right next to them the whole time.
The envelope reveals the true owners of the painting and the key leads them to a locker owned by Losberne (who is arrested) which houses many stolen artwork.
Fagin is revealed to be Issac Solomon and leaves the gang.
It's also revealed that when Twist was in the van, he snuck a painting by his mother and it goes on display at the National Gallery.
The film ends with Twist telling the gang to stop stealing and start selling paintings while he and Red start a relationship.

41549273.title: Echoes in the Storm (film)
synopsis: The opening scene introduces us to Tom, the agile and seasoned automotive executive of Tesla.
He is cruising in his avant-garde cyber-truck along a solitary country road late at night after an executive summit.
Suddenly, the calm is disrupted by an unforeseen storm, blocking visibility and hampering maneuvering.
As Tom continues to battle the storm with his mechanical beast, a jagged and rusted iron spike emerges from the asphalt, rendering him stranded amidst the tempest.
Around him, he discerns the silhouette of a 19th-century Victorian mansion promising shelter like a beacon in a tempest.
Summoning his courage, Tom submits to the need of the hour.
He ventures into the looming shadow of the ominous mansion standing isolated in the tempest.
Pushing past the massive, gnarled oak doors, he steps into an eerily quiet interior.
He is greeted by a stooped old man named Sebastian, alone amidst the vast corridors and echoing spaces of the mansion.
Sebastian, with an unearthly equanimity, offers an invitation to Tom - to escape the wrath of the storm and claim sanctuary in the strangely silent mansion.
As he spends time inside the neglected mansion, Tom starts noticing inexplicable happenings.
His fascination replacing fear, Tom finds himself drawn towards a subterranean basement filled with ancient astronomical tools, star charts, and obscure sculptures.
Amidst the equipment, Tom discovers age-worn journals filled with indecipherable notes and illustrations.
As he delves deeper, he begins to comprehend an incredible tale spun within these pages - the past tenant's relentless pursuit of a disconcerting idea - a portal to reach alternate dimensions.
Tom's curiosity gets the better of him, and he inadvertently activates dormant machinery initiating sequences that have remained unstirred.
A hum, alien and vibrating, lights up the gloomy mansion, sending strange pulsations through the floors and walls.
The sudden burst of cosmic energy brings forth spectral apparitions, transforming the mansion into a whirlwind of paranormal phenomena.
Thrown into this maelstrom of disorder, Tom and Sebastian attempt to stand their ground.
They dive into the labyrinthine writings of the journals, desperate to discover a method to close the destructive interdimensional rift.
In the chaos, they decode one revelation from the journals.
They uncover faded photographs of the ambitious architect of the terrifying dimensional experiment who happened to be Tom's estranged grandfather - Dr. Edward Milford.
To Tom's shock, Sebastian confesses his stolen identity.
He was not merely an old man but a loyal aide to Dr. Milford.
Now, he is the unwilling torchbearer attempting to manage the aftermath of their scientific curiosity gone awry.
Under the shadows of impending doom, the pair, now bound by both blood and mission, grapple with restoring order.
They handle the ancient machinery with a newfound understanding, managing to close the destructive portal.
Emerging from the chaos, Tom finds himself a changed man.
He makes a solemn promise to himself - to decode his grandfather's cryptic messages, understand the experiments that cost him his life, and ensure the safety of the mansion.
The storm withdraws its ferocity, an eerie silence engulfs the mansion, signaling the end of Tom's supernatural encounter - the end of "Echoes in the Storm".
Tom is seen standing at the entrance of the mansion, the dawn horizon reflecting his firm resolution - a commitment to protect the mansion and polish his grandfather's legacy.

70145813.title: Ultrasound (film)
synopsis: On a rainy night, Glen's car runs over a spike strip.
He seeks refuge in the nearby home of married couple Art and Cyndi.
Art invites him to spend the night.
Art makes it clear that he is taking medication for his depression.
Cyndi tells Glen that Art was her high school teacher and that she met him when she was 17 years old.
Art persuades Glen to sleep with Cyndi.
The next day, Glen walks home.
Art mysteriously finds Glen and plays him a video showing a pregnant Cyndi.
After Art leaves, Glen receives a text message from Cyndi telling him to "get rid" of Art.
Glen and Cyndi reunite and talk about the baby.
Glen and Cyndi are actually patients in a mental asylum who have frequent sessions with Shannon and Dr. Conners.
Glen reads from a script detailing his interactions with Cyndi.
Meanwhile, Cyndi talks about a hypnotist who made her reveal she had a crush on Art.
Shannon tells Cyndi that Glen was her high school teacher while Art was the hypnotist.
Art had hypnotized Glen and Cyndi and made them believe they were expecting a baby.
Dr. Conners reveals that Glen and Cyndi are still receptive to hypnotic suggestions, including convincing Glen that he cannot stand.
Thus, when a certain airwave is played, he can stand up when his legs no longer work.
Shannon criticizes Dr. Conners for not telling her about the airwave because she believes it is dangerous.
Dr. Conners replaces Shannon with another doctor.
Shannon helps Glen and Cyndi escape the asylum and go to a hotel.
Cyndi reveals that she was Art's assistant.
Art's house where Glen and Cyndi first met was, in fact, an apartment.
Using the airwave, Art hypnotized Glen into thinking he had sex with Cyndi.
Hours earlier, Shannon had used the airwave on Cyndi so the sound of running water would remind her of where she was.
In the hotel room, Cyndi hears the sound and leaves a trance.
Glen and Cyndi are still in the asylum.
Shannon finds Dr. Conners, yells at him, and throws a chair that breaks the one-way mirror between them and the patients.
Shannon, Glen, and Cyndi run away and leave the asylum once and for all.
Glen, however, is still partially in a trance.
Senator Harris and Katie are expecting a baby.
Harris hires Art to hypnotize Katie and tell her to stop calling him.
Art tells Katie to imagine she had sex with Harris.
Harris later hits Art, believing he had sex with Katie.
Over the phone, Katie tells someone that she is pregnant.
Meanwhile, Harris celebrates his re-election and Art tinkers with an earpiece playing the airwave.

88264590.title: Harvest Fields
synopsis: Our view is cast upon the verdant vistas of rural New York, a picturesque landscape studded with weather-beaten barns and pristine farmhouses.
Nestled within this idyllic setting, two names stand prominently - the Johnsons and the Millers, both farming families steeped in the agro-cultural traditions of this close-knit community.
A persistent tension hums between these two families, evident in their brusque exchanges at the weekly farmers' market and the chilly looks exchanged over the lush golden meadows of corn.
John Johnson, the patriarch of the Johnson clan, is an imposing figure etched by years spent laboring on the farm and tasked with the preservation of age-old customs handed down through generations.
In stark contrast to John's rigid adherence to tradition, Robert Miller, embraces modernity.
He perceives farming through the lens of technology and innovation, championing progressive farming techniques, driving a wedge between the two strong-willed heads of families.
A deep dive into their shared past reveals a simmering issue—a failed promise revolving around a land deal.
This event turned their simmering enmity into an open rivalry.
This rivalry manifested in frigid court disputes and unsuccessful conciliatory meetings, exponentially widening the divide between the two families.
The rhythm of their pastoral life knocked off-course when a series of uncanny incidents started occurring, disrupting the hitherto serene countryside routine.
One morning, a horrifying scene confronted them.
Fields bathed in an eerie, carnivorous red, far removed from their natural emerald appeal, appeared like blood-stained warfields.
The mysterious drowning of livestock in the ostensibly harmless ponds of clear water added to the growing unease.
Accusations began to fly thick and fast between the Johnsons and the Millers, each blaming the other for these unsettling farm mishaps.

As if the situation wasn't grave enough, the mysterious disappearance of Doris Miller, a sprightly fourteen-year-old, from school ratcheted up the alarm, whisking an undercurrent of fear through the community.
The find of Doris's belongings - her worn-out leather bag and a bright, pink scarf- on the disputed land further inflamed the already poisoned atmosphere, causing tempers to flare.
Bearing the weight of accumulating stress, the Johnson family sought the advice of spiritual mediums to understand the inexplicable incidents.
Multiple spiritual sessions, attended by intensely frightened families, spun the uncanny tale of an age-old curse linked to unpaid debts from a bygone era.
As dusk would swathe the countryside in lavender shades, vague spectral apparitions began to appear in the fields, imprinting fresh rumors of dread among the community.
Horrific sightings and paranormal incidents instilled deep fear, leading to self-enforced after-dark curfews amongst the families.
Parallelly, Elizabeth Johnson, a seventeen-year-old, found herself at the center of these spooky happenings, being plagued by disturbing dreams involving the missing Doris.
Consistent encounters with these frightful nightmares, and coincidental brushes with danger, established Elizabeth's unwanted, yet significant, involvement in this unfolding spectral drama.
The escalating terror pushed the obstinate patriarchs into setting aside their rivalry, realizing their families' safety was at stake.
The newfound unity led to a joint effort by the Johnsons and Millers, organizing a community fundraiser geared towards conducting an extensive land cleansing ceremony.
A local spiritual guide stepped in to explain in minute detail the mode of ritual - a series of chants, burning of sacred herbs, and the sprinkling of holy water - to the anxious families.
On an evening loaded with anticipation, families gathered on the disputed land, setting aside their differences temporarily, united against the uncanny enemy.
With a display of unity seldom seen before, they went about the ritual.
Their collective fear gave way to a shared beam of hope.
Despite being confronted by the spectral presence during the ritual, their steadfastness paid off when the ghostly figure disbanded into thin air, hinting at the lifting of the dreaded curse.
The subsequent days witnessed an end to the bizarre events; the fields re-emerged in their tranquil glory, and the livestock remained untroubled.
Much to everyone's relief, Doris reappeared unharmed, her memory of her ordeal blanked out.
This inexplicable miracle brought tears of joy to her family.
United by their ordeal, Johnsons and Millers reached a mutual agreement on the much-contested land, deciding to divide it evenly.
In commemoration of their newfound unity, an oakling was planted at the core of the disputed piece of land, signifying both their past disputes and their fresh page of peaceful coexistence.
The countryside adopted a calmer, softer tone as tranquility finally took root, and old scores began to fade.

67576139.title: Unearth (film)
synopsis: In rural Pennsylvania, two farming families - the Lomacks (father George, daughters, Heather and Kim and grandson Reese, Kim's infant son), and the Dolans (Kathryn, Tom, Aubrey and daughter Christina) - maintain a long-running feud.
Both families have fallen on desperate times financially, exacerbating the situation.

George Lomack, a single father operating a failing auto repair business, is approached by representatives of Patriot Exploration, a natural gas fracking company with an interest in acquiring drilling rights on his land.
Eager to earn money for his two daughters, George accepts the offer.
This is to the horror of Dolan matriarch Kathryn, and the tension between the two families escalates further.
Patriot Exploration brings in their equipment and begins operations on the Lomack property, greatly disrupting the lives of the two families.
Strange events begin soon thereafter; the members of both families gradually suffer the effects of a strange illness, initially compelling them to obsessively scratch their skin.
As their sanity degenerates from the illness, George's infant grandson senses something wrong with the tap water and refuses to drink it, but the others do.
Other strange events occur, such as the conspicuous absence of wildlife sounds outside the families' homes.
The illness is the result of a fungus unearthed by the fracking, poisoning the air and water.
Kathryn goes missing after working in the barn and suffering from a coughing fit, she crawls through the woods.
Christina and Tom Dolan go looking for her and Tom finds her body kneeling at a tree after and sprouting fungal tendrils.
While Tom looks at her in horror, a sack on a tendril explodes, covering Tom in a substance.
Kim finds Reese (George's grandson) in his crib, his body reduced to a gelatinous mass after his skin is digested by the fungus.
Kim is shot by Aubrey Dolan (Tom's wife) under the influence of the fungus.
Heather kills Aubrey with a baseball bat as she is attacking George.
George drives Kim to a neighbors house for help; Heather stays behind to check on the Lomacks.
George attacks and presumably kills the neighbor while hallucinating and seeing his own face.
While Christina and Heather are in the Lomack's kitchen, Tom shows up and Christina, hallucinating that he has the same tendrils growing from his body, shoots and kills him.
Heather and Christina leave and go to the tree house in the woods and pass out.
Christina, still hallucinating, thinks Heather has changed and sees blood running down her legs.
She makes her way to her truck and finds a rifle; firing it into the empty woods.
She then drives into the corn fields before getting the truck stuck and passes out.

From this point forward, it is hard to tell if the events are really happening or if they are hallucinations as Christina is in normal clothes with no signs of the fungus infection and carrying on about her day, having taken over the farms as Kathryn mentioned several times.
In the closing moments, Christina is seen scratching her skin, suggesting she may be infected.
During the end credits, the harvested corn from the Dolan farm travels by truck to an unknown destination in a bayside city.
The drone viewpoint also reveals that the watershed from the farms appears to flow in the direction of the bay, leading to the ocean.

88937145.title: Diamond Dreams (2022 film)
synopsis: In the homely mining town of Dakota, we are greeted by the sight of James Anderson, a paragon of fortitude, and his lively daughter Lily, engaged in a spirited game of baseball.
The profound love and connection between James and Lily is evident in every throw, every swing, and the jovial laughter that permeates the air.
Parallel to these joyful moments, we witness James, operating colossal machines at the Dakota Stone Quarry.
Lily is a master at multitasking.
With an impeccable balance between academics and sports, she juggles her schoolwork and rigorous baseball practice.
During an exhilarating local baseball game under the Dakota sun, Lily rises to the occasion.
Displaying her innate talent, Lily delivers a forceful swing, propelling the ball into a majestic arc.
The act of desecration brings an irate Senator Kingston to their doorstep.
The demand for financial compensation from the Anderson’s, triggers glimpses of an impending conflict.
Flexing his muscles of power, Senator Kingston subjects James to further discrimination by terminating him from his job at the quarry.
But the despair in James's eyes quickly masks with a determined glint - his resolve hardened for a battle of justice.
With the turn of events, Lily grapples with an overloaded schedule, juggling between school, household duties, and ceaseless self-training.
An intriguing twist develops when James stumbles upon a shocking secret about Senator Kingston.
Confronting the painful memories of his late wife, James's sorrow turns into a fiery determination, fuelling his pursuit for justice against the unfortunate incident.
Keeping his new-found drive in focus, James begins to meticulously plan and strategize the takedown of the power-hungry Senator Kingston.
He engages in relentless pursuits to gather substantial evidence against the senator's unethical actions.
In one of these parallel timelines, Lily's innate talent doesn't go unnoticed.
She earns a place in an upcoming charity baseball match organized by their arch-rival, Riverview High.
The plot thickens when it is revealed that the venue of this match will be no other than Kingston's vast, luxurious mansion.
Lily is determined to win, her grit can be seen in the sweat pouring down her brow as she vigorously trains for the match.
Simultaneously, in a series of heart-stopping adventures, James manages to procure overwhelming evidence against Senator Kingston.
As the day of the match draws near, a nearly palpable tension encases Dakota.
Amid the roars of the crowd, the big match begins with Lily in top form.
Each swing of her bat reflects her determination and echoes her burning desire to win.
The net of suspense tightens during halftime when James capitalizes on the moment.
He stands tall, unveiling every detail of Kingston's corrupt schemes to the stunned Dakota citizens and television correspondents present at the venue.
Cornered by the revelations, Senator Kingston scrambles to find words.
His stammering response fails to provide a credible defense, betraying his deceit.
Lily scores a winning home run, making the crowd erupt in cheers.
Humbled and relieved, James receives a warm welcome back to his former job at the quarry by his fellow workers.
Swift justice prevails eventually as law enforcement swoops in to apprehend the corrupt Senator Kingston.
The collective sigh of relief from Dakota citizens marks his well-deserved downfall.
Lily's astounding performance in the tournament grabs the attention of professional Major League Baseball scouts.
As the golden light of the early evening cascades on them, we see James and Lily basking in their hard-fought peace and monumental victories.
They are back in their backyard, engaged in their comforting game of baseball, their lives now brimming with restored hope.

69088282.title: Vendetta (2022 film)
synopsis: In suburban Georgia, family man William Duncan (Clive Standen) picks up his daughter Kat (Maddie Nichols), a softball player with dreams of playing professionally.
On their way to pick up dinner, Kat assures him that while she focuses on her sports, she will also study to become a lawyer.
While William goes inside to order the food, Kat is left in the car.

Brothers Rory (Theo Rossi) and Danny (Cabot Basden), working for their father, kingpin Donnie (Bruce Willis) turn up and drag her outside despite her pleas, with Rory informing her they only want her soul before Danny shoots and kills her.
They are soon arrested by the authorities, but William intentionally doesn't identify Danny, allowing him to go free.
The following night, William later stalks and hits Danny with his car, then proceeds to beat Danny to death with a softball bat.
Returning home, he cleans his car and the bat and disposes of the bloody garments, later noticing and washing blood off his shirt, breaking down at the horror of what he's done.
Rory is informed of Danny's death and rushes to the scene but is told the investigation is ongoing.

Detective Brody, the investigating detective finds out who Danny is and pays William a visit, informing him of Danny's murder and asking where he was that night, to which William states he was at home, and asks if he's a suspect.
Brody says he's not but asks that he call if he thinks of anything.
William's wife Jen confronts him and asks him where he was that night and begs him not to go back to his old ways, revealing that William was a former Marine.

Rory questions a prostitute who tried to solicit William in the place where Danny was killed, and after confirming William's identity from a photo, Rory and his henchman ambush William the following day at a coffee shop.
William manages to kill the henchman but loses his wallet which is picked up by Rory.
Rushing home, William calls Brody and tells him the truth, and Brody leaves a squad car for his protection.
William confesses to Jen what he has done, and she suggests they run away, but are ambushed by Rory and Donnie, who shoot him and Jen, killing her and leaving William to die.
William wakes up in the hospital, intent on revenge.
Brody visits him and gives him a file on Donnie and Rory.
After recuperating, William escapes from the hospital in a janitor outfit and gets a change of clothes and a motel to stay in as well as money from the bank.

Upon returning to the motel, William is accosted by a man named Dante, who reveals his knowledge of William from the court case and offers him firearms, revealing himself to be an arms dealer who lost his cousin to Donnie.
After telling Dante of his past, William buys firearms and moves to a secluded location where he trains himself.
Once done William comes back into town and seeks out one of Rory's henchmen, forcing him to reveal Donnie's location before shooting him dead.
Upon learning of his henchman's death, Donnie orders Rory to kill William once and for all.
Rory and his gang set out to find William, but William having already been at the club, sneaks inside and confronts Donnie.
He tells Donnie that he has become emotionless to all that he has experienced, and that killing is normal for him now before shooting Donnie dead.
He uses Donnie's phone to call Rory and inform him about his father's death.

Upon reaching the club and seeing his father's body, Rory doesn't react as he hates his father due to Donnie constantly mentioning that Danny was better than him but orders his gang to find and kill William.
William ambushes the gang but escapes to the motel, where the prostitute that identified him earlier tips off Rory.
Dante learns of the ambush and helps William remove a bullet lodged in him, but Rory shows up at the motel and calls out to William.
William opens fire on the gang and he and Dante escape with Rory in pursuit.
Dante calls his friend Roach, who sets up an ambush for Rory and drives them away.
Knowing they will be back, Dante, Roach and his gang prepare for the ambush, during which all gang members from both sides are killed, and Rory kills Roach, leaving him and William.
Rory shoots William in the stomach and gloats over him, allowing William to grab a screwdriver and stab Rory in the neck.
As he watches Rory die, smiling with insult, the face he wants William to never forget as he finally dies.
Dante, having survived the assault, escapes upon hearing police sirens.
Brody meets William and has a chat with him before William succumbs to his injuries as he dies.
William finally avenges his family by not only killing the notorious Fetter family and their gang, but destroying their community, putting an end to their crime, but at the cost of his own life.
After William's death Brody states that he hopes it was worth it.

51507872.title: Yuletide Secrets
synopsis: Suburbanite Paul Castleton, a weary financial analyst and a man of routine, finds himself trapped in monotony, questioning his life choices; his lacklustering career and his strained union with his exuberant homemaker wife, Julie, weigh heavily on him.
Julie Castleton, on the other hand, embraces her life and the unconventional familial chaos with a large heart.

Yearning to recreate the old-world Christmas charm, she makes an unyielding proposal to their yearly Christmas celebration plans; she suggests spending it at her beloved grandmother Nana Jane's enchanting Victorian mansion situated amid the lush greens of Vermont.
Their tech-obsessed 16-year-old son Jake, accustomed to his solitary digital world, initially shows mild irritation but reluctantly succumbs to his mother’s plans of traditional family gathering.

The family embarks on a picturesque journey through a winter wonderland to Vermont, during which they encounter an unusual assortment of characters; an enigmatic woman draped in velvety robes fortune-telling through Tarot; Bob, the clumsily charming baker who treats them to a box of his aromatic Christmas cookies; and Hank, a lanky cowboy with a knack for spinning humorous tales, his Stetson hat its very own character.

As the Castletons step into Nana Jane's grand Victorian mansion through its elaborately carved oak doors, they're greeted by an eclectic mix of family members, unorthodox friends and peculiar neighbours; unique individuals that infuse the mansion with an infectious vibrancy.
As the holiday euphoria builds, an ages-old family legend concerning a hidden treasure trove resurfaces.
An unclaimed bounty reputedly stashed away within the mansion's hundred-year-old timbered floorboards.
Paul, usually a reluctant participant in family lore, finds his dormant spirit of adventure awakening, his analytical mind intrigued by this unsolved family mystery.
He assume the role of an amateur sleuth, becoming intensely obsessed over deciphering cryptic clues to uncover Nana Jane’s forsaken treasure.
Paul's tireless investigation opens a pandora’s box of comedic errors.
His misadventures include wild goose chases, deciphering enigmatic riddles and dealing with the playful, yet meddling relatives providing false leads just for laughs.

His awkward stumbles include an accidental tumble down an ancient laundry chute, and a hilarious episode where he's mistaken for a long-gone Civil War-era ancestor thanks to a portrait showcasing an uncanny resemblance.

In his relentless pursuit, Paul infiltrates the mansion's dust-laden library, and finds himself in the middle of slapstick scenarios; toppling towers of books revealing secret levers, and prankster relatives hell-bent on adding to the cheerful chaos.
Julie, initially overwhelmed and skeptical about the treasure hunt, finds unexpected joy in the madness.
She laughs till tears stream down her face for the first time in years, her laughter breathing life into every nook and cranny of the mansion.
The usually aloof Jake breaks away from his digital confines, allowing the holiday pandemonium to draw him out of his shell.
He finds himself absorbed into the family misadventures, and to his own surprise, he doesn't resent it.
Adding to Jake's newfound fascination with the tangible world, he is gradually smitten by the vivacious Martha, the unpredictable and radiant daughter of one of Nana Jane's quirky neighbours.
Her charm and vitality encourage Jake to explore beyond his comfort zone.
Paul's relentless detective pursuit bears fruit in the mansion's forgotten attic.
Amongst shadowy corners and cobweb-draped trunks, he discovers a locked oak chest long believed to hold Nana Jane's elusive treasure.

The chest yields not glittering jewels or abundant wealth, but yellowed pages filled with Nana Jane’s heartful memoirs, vintage photographs reflecting their family's past, and keepsakes symbolizing significant family events.
Paul’s initial disappointment soon turns into astonished appreciation.

Their laughter, initially fueled by the letdown of finding no materialistic treasure, evolves into shared joy - a profound realization that the memories, ties and shared family history were real treasures they had overlooked.
Amidst the contagious laughter and familial camaraderie, Julie and Paul, rekindle their dwindling spark - the good-humoured anarchy helping them rediscover what once brought them together.

Jake, by now immersed in the holiday conviviality, wholeheartedly participates in the festive frolic - dancing with Martha, and for the first time, relishing the unconventional charm of his family's company.

The Christmas Eve evening comes alive with the strikingly united Castletons initiating a familial toast; a heartfelt acclamation of their eccentric family bonds and shared laughter as their real treasure.
Amid their shared laughter and array of comedic outcomes, the family’s search for physical wealth is overshadowed by the true treasure; their extraordinary, jovial, and loving family.
As the Christmas night settles and the laughter subsides, the Castletons, united in love and laughter, paints an inspiring narrative of rekindling family bonds and embracing their unique traditions.

69287585.title: Violent Night
synopsis: In Greenwich, Connecticut, Jason Lightstone and his estranged wife Linda take their daughter Trudy to his mother Gertrude's mansion for a Christmas gathering.
They overhear Trudy's Christmas wish for family unity through an old walkie-talkie.
Other family members at the gathering are Jason's sister Alva, her boyfriend Morgan Steel, and her son Bert.

Meanwhile, Santa Claus arrives at the estate, just as a group of mercenaries with holiday codenames, led by "Mr. Scrooge," raid the house with some of them having posed as caterers and take the family hostage after killing the staff.
Discovered by the mercenary Tinsel, Santa's reindeer are frightened off as Santa kills Tinsel by causing him to be impaled by an icicle.
Stranded, he decides to rescue Trudy and her family from Scrooge, who wants $300 million cash hidden in a vault in the mansion.
After killing the mercenary Frosty, Santa takes his radio and finds Trudy's channel.
He then finds that the mercenaries are on his "naughty list."

When Scrooge discovers that Trudy has been talking with Santa on her walkie-talkie, Jason denies Santa's existence, and a distraught Trudy runs past the kidnappers and successfully hides in the attic.
Santa reassures her over the radio, revealing to her his ancient Viking warrior past.
Wounded Santa is captured by Scrooge, who hates Christmas.
Recognizing their real identities, Santa convinces henchmen Gingerbread and Candy Cane of his authenticity and escapes magically, although his magic sack is burned.
Gertrude's "kill squad," led by Commander Thorp, arrives and kills Morgan; revealing their allegiance to Scrooge.
Discovering an empty vault, Scrooge threatens Linda.
Jason admits he stole the money, hidden in an outdoor nativity, and planned to flee with his family.
Gertrude forgives him, revealing this as a Lightstone family rite of passage and naming him her heir.
In a shed, Santa finds a sledgehammer and eliminates the kill squad.
Trudy sets up Home Alone-inspired traps, leading to Gingerbread's death.
Santa kills Candy Cane before she can shoot Trudy.
Alva, Linda, and Bert thwart Scrooge's order to kill hostages by killing Krampus.
Scrooge and Thorp escape into the woods with Gertrude and the money, pursued by Santa, who kills Peppermint.
Linda kills Jingle, and Trudy witnesses her parents' reunion.
Santa and Scrooge fight in a cabin; as they grapple, a badly-wounded Santa magically flies up the chimney, mangling Scrooge’s body and killing him.
Thorp shoots Santa, but is killed by a vengeful Gertrude.
Despite using burnt money for warmth, Santa slowly starts succumbing to the gunshot wounds.
Trudy rallies her family to affirm their belief in Santa, healing him from near death.
Confused by the magic, but renewed in faith, Santa receives his returning reindeer, a note from Mrs. Claus, a new gift sack, and the return of his long-lost hammer Skullcrusher.
He bids Trudy farewell and continues his gift deliveries.
In a mid-credits scene, Bert vlogs next to a dead mercenary, telling his viewers that Santa is real and warning them to behave during Christmas.

94068075.title: We Continue to Bless
synopsis: Edward, an unshakeable follower of Christianity, meticulously plans an ordinary dinner with his loving wife, Susan, and their dynamic daughters, Mandy and Lily.
Edward, filled with renewed vigor, introduces an intriguing lychee-flavored beverage he unearthed during a spiritual journey in Tibet.
He christens it the "divine nectar," alluding to its holy origins.
To Edward's gently persuasive coaxing, Susan, Lily, and Mandy, though harboring a few reservations, agree to take tentative sips of this lauded holy lychee mixture.
The family shares a tranquil pasta dinner.
After this distinctive dinner, strange phenomena start appearing within their home.
Whispers of oddity creep into the otherwise peaceful house.
Edward, Susan, Lily, and Mandy find common ground in their increasingly shared experiences of unusually vivid dreams, extreme sensitivities to tastes and smells, and recurring daydreams.
Each family member unravels these peculiar events in their unique ways, leading them down divergent paths of interpretation.
Edward, anchored by his strong faith, posits the sudden onslaught of these surreal experiences as spiritual awakening induced by the alleged holy lychee nectar.
Susan, the voice of reason in the family, nurtures growing worry about Edward's unwavering belief in the mysterious beverage and frets its psychological effects on their impressionable daughters.
For Lily, grappling with the emotional upheaval of adolescence and nursing the fresh wounds from her recent breakup, these enigmatic events further magnify her emotional repertoire.
Mandy, haunted by her impending separation from her secure family cocoon for the unfamiliar terrains of a college campus, experiences amplified restlessness due to the inexplicable happenings.
Edward's fervent belief in the spiritual properties of the strange lychee brew tensions within the family, creating unintended rifts and gradually isolating him from his treasured family members.
Susan realizes the imperative need for an open discussion and challenges Edward, despite the discomfort.
She articulates her apprehensions and queries about the strange drink's negative impact on Lily and Mandy - a concern Edward hurriedly brushes off as mere skepticism.
Amid the escalating tension, Lily and Mandy decide to team up and dig deeper into the root cause of the eerie phenomena plaguing their home life.
Despite their differing beliefs - Lily's trust in the spiritual and Mandy's scientific rationale - they find solace and unity in their shared feelings of apprehension and uncertainty.
As they dive deeper into their united investigation, they unearth an unexpected finding.
They uncover that the uncanny events they've been grappling with are rooted in their psychological landscape - an outer projection of their unresolved fears and insecurities.
This startling revelation stirs a paradigm shift in their comprehension of reality.
With this newfound insight, they comprehend that the turmoil was self-inflicted, ignited by their anxieties stemming from the rapidly shifting circumstances of their lives.
Energized by this clarity, Mandy bravely decides to confront her fear of leaving home for college and chooses to welcome her impending academic journey with open arms.
She shares a bittersweet goodbye with her family, a significant stamp on her course to her chosen college life.
Lily struggles with her increasing sorrow but simultaneously learns to steer her emotional ship, gaining resilience and growing into a more confident, self-reliant individual.
As this whirlwind of personal evolution unfolds, Susan and Edward are left grappling with the increasing strain on their marital harmony.
Over a nostalgic navigation through their family photo album, they admit the ill-effects of Edward's extreme methodologies, although they were propelled by his noble intentions.
Subsequently, Edward expresses heartfelt contrition, acknowledging the family-wide unrest induced by his rigid faith in the unidentified holy drink.
His remorse is tangible as he ensures a future driven by love, rationality, and an accommodative spirit, creating a space for logical reasoning within his profound faith.
The narrative reaches its high point at another family dinner now ornamented with lessons learned and profound emotions.
Edward, remorse dripping from his words, issues a sincere apology over bowls of comforting chicken soup, vowing to tread on his faith journey with learned wisdom.
Their tumultuous journey, though perplexing, has unearthed hidden layers of mutual understanding and empathy amongst the family members.
Raising their glasses filled with sparkling apple juice, they toast to love, comprehension, resilience, and survival, celebrating their journey towards emotional emancipation.
A poignant moment descends as they clink their glasses, echoing the promise of a fresh, unblemished beginning.
They unpacked their deepest fears, crossed generational misunderstandings, and braved unnerving challenges, maturing into robust individuals.
Across the table, Edward and Susan exchange a comforting glance, silently assuring constant support through their upcoming challenges.
United, they relish this extraordinary moment, recognizing the distinct role of their individual tribulations in shaping their sturdy familial bond.
The consequence of Edward's chapter with the divine Tibetan nectar concludes, but bequeaths an irreplaceable window into their subconscious fears and concerns.
Looking around the table at the family he cherishes, Edward registers his past errors yet takes pride in fostering growth within his family.
Mandy, on the verge of her new, independent life, feels an invigorating wave of braveness replacing her fears.
Lily, having survived her first heartbreak, exudes newfound resilience and begins to anticipate upcoming life struggles with a fortified heart.
With invigorated wisdom and strength, they acknowledge that confronting their fears is the first victorious step towards tackling them.
They concede that confronting their personal fears collectively has assisted them to evolve stronger as a family unit.
The narrative concludes with a reaffirmed toast to love, understanding, blessings, and familial ties on another cherished family dinner night.
Zooming out from the warm family dinner tableau, a glimpse is seen of a family ready to take on the world, together.
They stand stronger, more resilient, having faced their fears and uncertainty head-on.

65985890.title: We Still Say Grace
synopsis: Harold is a religious fanatic who gives his family, consisting of his wife Betty and daughters Maggie and Sarah, an unknown liquid to drink.
After revealing it to be poison, Maggie is the only one to become frightened with the thought of dying, and Harold later reveals it was merely a test of faith for a future suicide pact.
The following day, Harold's family is visited by three strangers :  Fisher, Randy, and Luke who ask for help replacing a flat tire.
After Harold invites them in, he tells them that his family lives several miles away from civilization without a phone.
Offering to help, Harold allows the group to stay at his house for another day, but also throws away their beer and criticizes them for using foul language.
At dinner, Fisher establishes himself as the most respectful of the group and tells Harold's family that he is moving to California from Chicago.
After asking to use the restroom, Randy sneaks into Harold's room to snoop around.
Harold becomes suspicious and searches for Randy before calling for his family, where they find Randy suffering a seizure.
Harold tells the group that their best option is to stay at his place while Randy recovers, and Maggie begins to grow feelings for Fisher.
Anxious about the stay, Luke wakes up at night and spots Harold taking a bath with Sarah.
In the morning, Luke also finds that Harold lied about having a car and the group uses its tires to fix their vehicle.
While doing so, Fisher shows Maggie the inside of the car, where the pair take an instant photograph together that Maggie keeps.
After departing, the group suffers another flat tire and returns to the house.
After going on a rant and accusing Harold of molesting Sarah, Luke is kicked out.
Before leaving, Sarah hands Luke a bottle of poisoned lemonade and dies after discovering a spike strip that caused both of their car accidents.
At home, Maggie notices that Randy has also died.
Maggie finds a note stating that she is from Nebraska.
Fisher also finds several photographs of Maggie and Sarah from the past, where the pair are with other people.
Together, Maggie and Fisher realize that Harold and Betty kidnapped the girls as their own after killing their parents.
Inside, Betty overhears Sarah and Harold talking about their intimate relationship, and Fisher discovers Randy's body.
Harold arrives and knocks Fisher out with chloroform.
At home, Betty commits suicide.
Tied up in a basement, Fisher is rescued by Maggie and the pair share a kiss and try to escape, finding a crucified Randy and Luke, before Fisher is shot and killed by Sarah and also crucified.
Burning the bodies, Harold says the group served as a sacrifice for god.
Discovering Maggie, Harold decides it is time for his family to complete their suicide pact.
After handing his daughters a glass of poisoned wine, Sarah willingly drinks it and dies.
Maggie, on the other hand, refuses and sees Harold drink from an unpoisoned glass, before hitting him with the wine bottle.
Armed with a handgun, Harold searches for Maggie, who cuts his ankles and slashes his neck.
The following morning, Maggie looks across the horizon.

84047403.title: Trading Vows
synopsis: Julia, an assertive and accomplished finance director for a multinational corporation, presents an impressive seminar at a crucial board meeting in New York.
