She chooses to celebrate her victory at an upscale Manhattan bar, where she ends up locking horns with her fiancé, Tom.
Their argument, however, is about the balancing act between her challenging corporate job and their lagging personal life.
Out of the blue, a PR scandal involving her company is caught in public glare.
As if her career worry wasn’t enough, she uncovers Tom's cheating web.
Determined to give her life a U-turn, she packs her designer luggage, leaves her posh apartment and says goodbye to the city of towering skyscrapers, the city that never sleeps.
Julia lands in a quaint, unconventional town in Connecticut and embraces a less-demanding role at 'Loans & Laugh', a micro-lending firm battling its own survival.
She faces ridicule from her new coworkers due to her high-fashion outfits and the “Big City” attitude.
Upon discovering the shaky financial status of 'Loans & Laugh', she senses a mammoth task laying ahead.
Throwing caution to the wind, she suggests a collection of radical business reforms much to the surprise of her co-workers.
Alongside managing the office, Julia finds companionship in Dan, a goofy loans officer, whose clumsiness and light-hearted humor brings much needed laughter in Julia's otherwise tumultuous life.
In a series of amusing and sometimes awkward events, Julia and Dan's friendship grows stronger and transparent.
Despite their different worlds, a hint of intrigue sparks something between them.
Under Julia's deft guidance, her revolutionary strategies start rolling changes and transforming the face of the struggling 'Loans & Laugh'.
The progress-happy firm, however, encounters a jolt when Dan messes up during a critical paperwork audit.
Tom, Julia's ex-fiancé, decides to make a surprise visit sensing a business opportunity and offers to buy the now troubled company.
Julia, with Dan by her side, rallies the office team and devises a high-stakes plan aimed at rescuing 'Loans & Laugh' from its torrid predicament.
The finished plan banks heavily on individual abilities of the team members, ushering in a comedic set of events that brings everyone closer in the face of adversity.
Amidst this chaos, Julia finds herself constantly drawn towards Dan, and their bond deepens.
After overcoming initial obstacles, their daring plan finally works, setting a positive pace for the future of 'Loans & Laugh'.
As she refuses Tom's proposal, Julia makes the decision to make the quaint town her new home and accepts the role of CEO at 'Loans & Laugh'.
She marvels at the contentment she finds in the ebb and flow of her new life.
Amid this newfound calm, Dan presents his feelings for Julia.
In the heat of their victory celebration, Tom stages a dramatic entrance and offers an enticing merger deal.
Julia rejects the proposal.
In a desperate attempt to regain some ground, Tom spitefully invites Julia to his upcoming wedding.
Julia counters his sting with a sharp-smiled acceptance.

The film concludes with a split-screen visual: one side picturing Julia and Dan, humorously preparing for their own quirky wedding, and the other showing Tom, dressed in his wedding tuxedo, nervously anticipating his bride.

66977188.title: Wedding Season
synopsis: Asha is an economist who has recently broken off her engagement and left a Wall Street banking career behind to work for a microfinance startup in New Jersey.
Asha's mother Suneeta, concerned for her future and against the advice of her husband Vijay, sets up a dating profile for her.
Asha agrees to meet Ravi, who was found through the website his parents signed him up on, under the condition she won't have to meet with any others.
Suneeta counterproposes that she attend all of the weddings she's been invited to in order to get her profile deleted from the site.
Their first date goes badly as Asha explains she's only there to appease her mother.
She's too bogged down with work, and must focus her next months on reorganizing a pitch for a Singapore investor for their micro-loans project for disadvantaged Southeast Asian women.
Coinciding at a wedding, Asha convinces Ravi to pretend that that they are dating at various weddings throughout the summer to ease the pressure from everyone to find someone.
Asha and Ravi slowly become mutually interested, as they little by little get to know each other.
Out with her boss James seeking donors, Asha learns that Ravi is secretly a wealthy, DJ called DJ Spellbound.
She and Ravi step out to talk, and he further confides in her.
They are about to kiss when Yoshi radically alters the set, so Ravi has to save it.
After a wedding, Ravi takes Asha his little-used apartment and he details some of his philanthropic endeavors.
They kiss, and she soon falls asleep, exhausted.
In the morning they agree to keep their mutual interest secret.
Asha's pitch is so successful the Singapore group offers ten million more and she is offered a London executive promotion in their South Asian division.
Suneeta mistakes Asha's text to Priya about her 'big news' as news of her engagement to Ravi.
The families plan a surprise lunch, during which Asha confesses their deception and Ravi admits that he dropped out of MIT and has no intention of getting a more socially acceptable career.
Enraged, Asha ends their relationship because of Ravi's dishonesty.
She no longer trusts him, and Ravi declaring that he has loved her since the day they met doesn't dissuade her from walking away and blocking him.
Later, Ravi argues with his parents about their disappointment in him.
They resent the loss of years between them, although he points out that he is here now.
Ravi announces that he and Yoshi are booked to go on a new DJing tour.
Finding it difficult to wrap her head around the idea of leaving her family for London, James encourages her as he'd left Jamaica for England years ago.
Her dad comes to work, also encouraging her to go.
Priya gets cold feet just before her wedding.
Asha encourages her, realizing in turn that she truly loves Ravi.
She goes to his family's restaurant, sees him with another woman, and gives a speech about what a great guy he is.
Priya and Nick marry and introduce DJ Spellbound at the reception.
Ravi and his parents reconcile, he admits his job to the community, and gets back together with Asha.

75434887.title: Martin, Susan & Kitty
synopsis: We begin our tale in the enchanting Dusty Shore fishing village, peacefully nestled between commanding, rocky cliffs and towering maritime pine trees, offset by the gentle caress of the sea breeze.
Amidst this natural splendor resides the flourishing Sea Breeze Ginger Ale Factory.
The factory's heart and soul are Martin and Susan, a pair of kind-hearted and industrious spouses renowned for their meticulous dedication to their business and their village.
Soon, a breath of fresh air enters their world as Kitty, a lively eight-year-old, bursts onto the scene with an infectious energy.
Her eyes, bright and gleaming, beautifully capture the essence of her audacious spirit and the vivid world of her imagination.
We discover that Kitty's adventurous parents leave their only daughter in the care of their closest friends, Martin and Susan.
Kitty, during her stay in the village, is gradually drawn towards the unique Ginger Ale making process.
Filled with wide-eyed ambition, Kitty begins experimenting with creating her unique line of Ginger Ale flavors – a venture that results in a range of comedic mishaps and heartwarming moments.
The once orderly factory assembly line descends into frenzied chaos as Kitty's experiments result in overflowed brews, exploding bottles, and general calamity.
Amid the madness and the aftermath of bizarre tastes and unusual ale hues, the primary local populace finds an unusual pleasure in Kitty's adventurous creations.
News of the village’s uniquely enchanting Ginger Ale, comes to the ears of the powerful New York businessman James Sterling.
Sterling boards a flight to Dusty Shore to get a firsthand experience of the peculiar ginger ale and explore the possibility of a lucrative investment.
With the arrival of the big city tycoon, Martin and Susan grow apprehensive.
Sterling's sophisticated demeanor and ominous presence ripples fear throughout the rural community.
From her secret spot behind the hidden door to the consultation room, Kitty overhears Sterling's grand plans to transform their beloved Sea Breeze factory into a corporate magnet.
Shocked, Kitty swears to protect the factory adored and cherished by Martin and Susan.
Armed with her daredevil spirit, Kitty regroups with her fellow mischief-makers up in the factory loft, where she reveals her audacious plot against Sterling.
With the unwavering support of Martin, Susan, and her young accomplices, they aim to fight corporate greed with a dangerous cocktail of her quirkily unpredictable brews.
Their intent is to frighten Sterling away, demonstrating the mayhem and unpredictable bedlam that the factory could descend into under inappropriate management.
The team crafts an insanely volatile, color-changing drink that perfectly captures the essence of Kitty’s chaotic creativity.
Everything spirals into anarchy, resulting in hilarious circumstances, including rainbow-hued belches and outlandish behaviors turning the tranquil fishing village into a side-splitting circus.
In a strange twist, this unplanned hullabaloo forges an indomitable sense of unity among the villagers, making them more protective and supportive of their cherished ale factory.
Amidst the uproarious hilarity, village tech-whiz, Benny, captures the entire spectacle in full High Definition on his cutting-edge smartphone.
Benny posts the intriguing footage on Instagram, offering a lively account of the factory’s shenanigans and the villagers’ merry reaction.
The post reaches viral status overnight, making Dusty Shore the hot topic of the country and turns its peculiar ginger ale into an internet sensation.
The overwhelming support from millions of social media users who sign petitions and rally to save Sea Breeze Factory becomes a formidable force against Sterling’s planned corporate takeover.
This unexpected wave of popular backlash forces Sterling to rethink his plans.
Sterling abandons his aggressive acquisition campaign and retreats to the luxury of his towering Manhattan skyscraper.
Sterling's withdrawal lifts the shades of gloom that had darkened Dusty Shore, eliciting an outpour of joy and relief among the villagers who revel in their victory against corporate threats.
When they witness first-hand their daughter's bravery and ingenuity in saving the Sea Breeze Factory, they embrace their prodigious child with newfound admiration and reverence.
The celebration reaches its zenith as Dusty Shore transforms into a vibrant fiesta in honor of their victory against corporate tyranny.
The peril to their cherished factory lifting, Dusty Shore is reinvigorated, its sense of contentment deepens, and their love for one another amplifies.
The film sets its final scene on the trio of Martin, Susan, and Kitty, basking in the golden rays of the setting sun.
Their faces beam joyously, reflecting the victory they achieved through sheer determination and unyielding kinship, with the sturdy factory robustly standing behind them in solidarity.
Glasses filled with the celebrated Dusty Shore ginger ale are thrust high into the air, signifying a toast to their shared victory and a future filled with abundant promise.
While celebrations cavort around her, Kitty is seen whispering something into Martin's ear and pointing at the factory.

62011151.title: Wendell & Wild
synopsis: Eight year old Katherine "Kat" Koniqua Elliot lives with her parents Delroy and Wilma, who own a root beer brewery in the town of Rust Bank.

Driving home on a stormy night from a library fundraiser at the brewery, Kat is frightened by a two-headed worm in her candy apple, leading her father to veer off a bridge; only Kat survives after her mother sacrifices her life to save her.

Meanwhile, in the underworld, demon brothers Wendell and Wild spend their days putting rejuvenating hair cream on their balding father, Buffalo Belzer, while dreaming of making an amusement park, the Dream Fair, for departed souls to challenge Belzer's "Scream Fair".
Wild continuously steals the hair cream by eating it for its hallucinogenic effect, much to Wendell's annoyance, but Wild manages to change Wendell's mind by force-feeding him the cream.
The hallucinogenic effect kicks in, and the brothers have a vision of Kat.
Five years later, Kat is an embittered, punk rock-loving thirteen year old juvenile delinquent who blames herself for her parents' deaths.
Kat is enrolled in Rust Bank's all-girls Catholic school, headed by Father Bests.
A trio of preppy classmates attempt to befriend Kat.
The group is led by Siobhan Klaxon, whose parents Lane and Irmgard's private prison company Klaxon "Klax" Korp has taken over the town.
Kat unintentionally endears herself to Siobhan by saving her from a falling brick, which she anticipated through premonition, a power that shocks her.
Later, she meets Raúl Cocolotl, a trans boy who was once friends with Siobhan and the one who accidentally broke the brick that nearly landed on the latter’s head.
Raúl's mother, Marianna, is convinced the Klaxons are the reason the brewery burned down and caused it to kill all of its workers.
During a class taught by Sister Helley, Kat receives a marking on her hand resembling a skull when she approached Helley's desk, which Helley tells her she must hide and tell no one.

The mark alerts Wendell and Wild from a possessed stuffed-bear called Bearzebub, identifying Kat as their "hell maiden", and they appear to her in a dream and make an empty promise to revive her parents (though demons can't resurrect the dead), if she summons them to the world of the living.
Kat steals Bearzebub from Helley's desk so she can use it to summon Wendell and Wild.
Helley, once a hell maiden herself, works with the school's janitor and secret demon hunter, Manberg, who hunts demons and keeps them in jars.
Father Bests is revealed to be in league with the Klaxons, who kill him as the last witness to their factory fire.
After his funeral, Kat recruits Raúl as her witness to summon the demon brothers, who brought their father's hair cream with them after they discovered that it can bring dead organisms back to life.
However, by the taking the wrong way, the brothers appear in a different part of the cemetery, and Kat believes she has been stood up.

Wendell and Wild test the cream on Bests, who comes back to life and convinces the Klaxons to pay the brothers to revive the deceased members of the town council, which will give the Klaxons the votes they need to demolish Rust Bank and expand their prisons.

Though the Klaxons fear they could resurrect other people in the cemetery, such as the brew workers that died in the fire, and other witnesses to the brewery arson, they tell Wendell and Wild that if they revive Kat's parents or any other dead people, they won't pay for their fair or for the school.

Bests returns to school, and Kat confronts the brothers, who make her vow to serve them forever in exchange for her parents' resurrection but it is just a ruse to make sure that they won’t resurrect anyone in the cemetery.
Forced to dig up the council members, whom Wendell and Wild revive, Raúl steals the cream and revives Delroy and Wilma himself.
Reunited with her parents, Kat helps Raúl escape the brothers.
After the zombie council approves the Klaxons' plans and pay Bests, Wendell, and Wild with a bag full of money, Siobhan discovers her parents' lies about the conditions of their prisons.

Helley and Manberg make Kat undergo a ritual called soul binding, confronting her memories and severing her allegiance with Wendell and Wild, resulting in her accepting the fact that her parents' death was not her fault.
The soul binding ritual further gives Kat the control of her precognitive powers, which Helley reveals are a consequence of her status as a hell maiden.

After learning of their resurrection, Bests, Wendell, and Wild kidnap Delroy and Wilma and take them to the cemetery to kill them until Kat, Raúl, Helley, and Manberg stop them, where Siobhan, who followed her pet pygmy goat Gabby Goat to the cemetery, reveals that her parents paid Bests, Wendell, and Wild worthless company money.

Buffalo Belzer appears, having discovered Wendell and Wild's deception, but a mural painted by Raúl as his art project, depicting his mother Marianna, as a mighty Mayan warrior, defending and protecting a baby Raúl against a two-headed dragon (representing the Klaxons) painted part-by-part on every house's roof in Rust Bank, convinces him to make up with his sons.
Manberg releases his collection of jarred demons after learning they are Belzer's children in exchange for Kat and the others.
Belzer apologizes to Wendell and Wild, approving their plans for their Dream Fair.

Bests dies again, and Belzer explains that the cream's effects “don’t last.” Kat says it's too late to save Rust Bank, but Sister Helley tells her that her power to see into the future can help her change it.
Recalling that Raúl said there needs to be a witness to prove the Klaxons are guilty, Kat tells him to use the very last bit of cream to revive as many dead brew workers as he can.
The group fends off the bulldozers conducted by the zombie council set to demolish the town while Raúl revives three dead factory workers to testify to the Klaxons' crimes, resulting in their arrest.

The cream's effect begin to wear off on Delroy and Wilma, but before they die, Kat uses her precognition to give them a glimpse of the future where Rust Bank is revived, and Wendell and Wild offer them VIP passes to their afterlife fair.
Kat makes peace with her life, considering everyone her friends, even Wendell and Wild themselves.
In a post-credits scene, one of the production members finds an anthropomorphic model of Kat walking around his office desk.

19932.title: Riverside Mysteries
synopsis: Born with an adventurous spirit, our protagonist, Lulu, a teenage girl with a daring personality, returns to her rural hometown in Oregon from an exhilarating Himalayan adventure that lasted a month.

Coming home, she is met with an unexpected revelation: her late grandfather’s will bequeathing her a rustic, centuries-old cabin sitting right by the banks of the peaceful Clackamas River, a testament to history and old-world charm.
Breaking this surprising news, the family lawyer hands the deed over to Lulu, a whirlwind of emotions sweeping over her as she is suddenly made the sole proprietor of this enigmatic haven.
With the idea of spending her lengthy summer vacation in the solitude of this quaint cabin, she livens up, intrigued by its isolation and the promise of the unknown.
Taken aback by the aura of the secluded cabin, with its form obscured within the dense cover of the evergreen forest, her curiosity is piqued as she pulls closer.
The quiet rustling of leaves and the tranquil sound of the river flowing nearby add to the mysterious allure of the place, intrigue mingling with uncertainty in Lulu's heart.
Lulu decides to confide in her fearless best friend, Samantha - Sam for short, whose eyes light up at the sound of a summer adventure.
Drawn by the call of exploration, both ready themselves for the summer, packed bags filled with all necessities, bound for the rustic cabin that promises much more than just peace and tranquility.
Upon their arrival, the friends find that the cabin, nestled next to the river, is just as awe-inspiring as they had imagined, yet with a sense of foreboding hanging in the air.
Their initial few days are spent in thorough exploration of their newfound sanctuary, meeting the locals, and a gradual understanding of the fear-inducing folklore linked with the river and cabin.
As they settle into the cabin life, they start recognizing signs of the supernatural, slight movements in the old house, and the cold drafts in the middles of the nights.

The echoes in the darkest of nights, the uncanny cold winds, and an unplaceable feeling of being watched shatter their peace, the tranquility that once blanketed their summer retreat, replaced with unease and a mystery begging to be unraveled.

Exhibiting their courage, Lulu and Sam strike upon the find of a perplexing diary in the dusty basement, its entries an eerie narrative of baffling disappearances related to the cabin and the dreaded Clackamas River.
Intrepid to the core, they decide to decode the enigma, armed with Lulu's knack for drawn curtains of secrecy and Sam's insatiable curiosity.
They pour over old town records, consult wisened locals, and visit the barely-used county library, filled with old journals, to piece together the fragmented tale of the cabin's mysterious past.

Their tireless efforts reveal the cabin's haunted history, the restless spirit of a woman named ‘Raven’, whose untimely demise has forever connected her to the cabin and the turbulent river by its side.
As the young women delve deeper into the spine-chilling story of Raven’s death, the intensity of the paranormal happenings in the cabin increase drastically, hinting at an unrest in Raven's spirit.

Sensing the need for intervention, they approach the town's old medium, kindly Mrs. Crawford, who suggests the only way to be free from these haunting occurrences is to help Raven's spirit find closure.
Baffled, but determined, they throw caution to the wind and decide to take upon the monumental task of resolving the mysterious events surrounding Raven's death.
Even though they are daunted by the quest ahead, they resolve to conquer their fears, for the sake of peace - their own and Raven's.
They sift through the town's scrolls with a fine-tooth comb, unearthing the intricate details of Raven's life, troubleshooting every possible lead connected to her death.
Their investigation sheds light on disturbing information, the details of Raven's end starting to come into focus, unveiling a truth that is both shocking and disheartening.
The course of their detective work takes an unexpected turn when they stumble upon a shocking evidence pointing towards two seemingly upright figures - the town's mayor and sheriff.
Armed with undeniable proof, the girls take a bold stance against the influential town figures, unveiling the horrifying truth in front of the whole town.
The pandemonium that ensues is unprecedented - emotions run high with shock, disbelief, and anger, as the two once-respected figures face the music.
The unveiling of this concealed tragedy brings an abrupt ceasefire to the sinister happenings at their summer retreat, as the cabin and the river regain its tranquility.
The renewed serenity indicates that finally, Raven’s shadowy soul has found the closure it desired, her story now peacefully fading into the annals of town’s lore.
With a sense of fulfillment etched on their faces, Lulu and Sam pack their belongings, the fear that once dominated their expressions now replaced with satisfaction.
Their quest not only brought about justice for Raven but also returned the erstwhile gloomy haunt to a harmonious summer getaway.

Telling a story like none other, the film concludes, etching two brave girls’ timeline in the cabin's records forever, their courageous pursuit of truth giving grace to the once dreaded riverside home.

67764571.title: What Lies Below (film)
synopsis: A 16 year-old high school girl, Liberty Wells, who goes by Libby, returns to her family lake house after summer camp.
Her mother, Michelle Wells, is a romance novelist.
Libby meets her mother's new boyfriend, John, an aquatic geneticist, who gives her a bracelet with symbols for the goddess of fertility.
John explains that his work involves trying to help creatures adapt to changing environments.
Later that night, Libby goes to the kitchen and she hears loud sexual moaning, and runs back to her bed.
John stands in her doorway while Libby pretends to be asleep.

The next morning, Michelle and Libby dig up time-capsules in the yard, and have an argument about Libby thinking Michelle doesn't care about her grandparents until Michelle tells Libby she felt unwanted by her father.
Libby is bitten by a centipede and John helps her.
Michelle falls ill, and reveals that John asked her to marry him and she said yes.
Libby learns that John is working with parasites.
She starts to menstruate and when John sees the blood, he attempts to clean it up with his shirt, and touches her.
While Libby showers, John sneaks into the bathroom to smell her through the curtain.
Libby removes the bracelet he gave her to find a red mark on her wrist.
Libby asks her friend Marley to come to the house.
That night, she sees John walking into the lake, which is emitting red lights.
John suddenly appears, completely dry, and tells Libby that he suffers from sleep-walking.
The next morning, Michelle starts vomiting and sends Libby into town to get medicine and a pregnancy test.
Libby follows a man who looks like John with another woman.
She returns to the house and tells Marley that John grabbed her genitals.
Michelle says that she is pregnant.
Libby is disappointed and Michelle thinks that she is making up lies about John grabbing her.
Libby sees that John has a nictitating membrane and tries to pull Michelle away from John but Michelle slaps Libby.
Libby reveals Michelle's age which is forty-two not thirty-five then John leaves.
She then investigates the basement and notices symbols on her wrist where the bracelet used to be.
She discovers Michelle in a tank attached to an IV, with the same symbols on her wrists and on the walls.
Libby hides while John watches Michelle give birth to a dying creature.
Libby calls the police and discovers Marley's body in a water tank being devoured by parasites.
John attacks Libby as she tries to escape with Michelle, and she wakes up tied up in a basement.
Several men who look identical to John appear and start to peel the walls back to reveal many unconscious women in water tanks.
John regurgitates a glowing substance and forces Libby to consume it.
Libby awakes in a row of water tanks containing other women apparently in pupae.
As water fills her tank, she initially bangs on the glass but then smiles when she realizes she can breathe underwater.

61021918.title: Where the Sunflowers Bloom (film)
synopsis: Our story begins in the mid-20th century, deep in the humid, swampy marshlands of Southeast Texas.
Inhabiting a fragile wooden cottage is 12-year-old Jaya.
As the firstborn, Jaya has shouldered the responsibility of caring for her three younger siblings.
One day, during their routine scavenging trip within the marshlands, Jaya discovers a vibrant, yellow sunflower field.
The sight of the sunflower field ignites a dormant desire within Jaya; she dreams of recreating the same beauty in her own surroundings.
On one sunny afternoon, Jaya's sunflower field becomes a window into another world when she encounters Mr. Wellington, a landowner widely recognized within the community.
The stern exterior of the old man doesn't intimidate Jaya.
The interactions between Jaya and Mr. Wellington leads to a bond forming between them.
Impressed by her logic and optimism, Mr. Wellington offered to sponsor Jaya's education in Austin, bringing an entirely new world of opportunities for her.
After all familial discussions, they agreed to take up on his generous proposition.
Transitioning from the isolated marshlands to the bustling city life proved difficult for Jaya.
Her classmates, who belonged to a privileged class, failed to empathize with her past and bullied her incessantly.
Amongst the bullies was Laura, a soft-spoken girl from her class who was captivated by Jaya’s unbroken spirit, resulting in a friendship between them.
However, soon after a catastrophic hurricane hits the marshes, obliterating Jaya’s familial home.
The guilt of being away while her family suffered triggers a turning point for Jaya who decides to utilize her newfound knowledge from the city to uplift her family's conditions.
Together with Laura, Jaya commences a small venture selling sunflowers from Laura's garden and eventually their own.
Witnessing Jaya's struggle, Mr. Wellington decides to step in, assisting Jaya in expanding her budding floral enterprise, including helping her to set up a stall in the city market.
Despite her humble beginnings, Jaya stands courageously against the manipulative landlords, defending the poor and impoverished marsh inhabitants.
Periods of financial gain and setbacks are threaded together in this narrative.
However, Jaya never succumbs to defeat, and with every stumbling block, her determination grows, as does her sunflower venture.
Eventually, her relentless efforts and passion pay off as she significantly elevates her family's financial conditions.
Even the skeptical society that once ridiculed her, now acknowledged her resilience and began to respect her.
Just as the seasons change, Jaya’s dreams evolve into robust ambitions, growing and blooming like the sunflowers in her garden.
As she tenderly cares for her sunflower garden back at her reclaimed home, Jaya's dreams fruitfully blossom into reality.
The blooming sunflowers, reaching toward the sky, encapsulate Jaya's journey from an innocent dreamer to a beacon of ambition and hope.
Unyielding against adversity, Jaya induces positive changes not only for herself but also for her community in the marshland.
By standing bravely against the oppressive landlords, Jaya brings justice to her exploited marsh neighbors.
Eventually, Jaya's sunflower field comes to symbolize resilient individuals rising from the ashes of despair, and dreams blooming in the face of adversity.
As the film draws to a close, viewers witness the unfurling narrative of aspirations and an indefatigable will to achieve them.
The intricate narrative ends with a blossoming sunflower field, standing as a symbol of Jaya's relentlessness, courage, and hard-earned success.
The film imprints a message of undying hope, transforming Jaya's dreams into tangible reality.
The film underscores the profound message that a dream, when nurtured with resilience against all odds, can eventually bloom into a tangible reality.
Finally, the film celebrates the sheer strength, unwavering resilience, and power of dreaming big.

66500372.title: Where the Crawdads Sing (film)
synopsis: Kya's story begins when she lives in a shack with her poor family in a North Carolina marsh in 1953.
As their abusive alcoholic father gambles their money away, and Kya's mother and older siblings flee one by one, leaving Kya alone with him until he too abandons her at the age of seven.
She survives by selling mussels at Barkley Cove's general store, owned by Mabel and "Jumpin" Madison, who become Kya's good friends.
The townspeople know her as the "Marsh Girl".
Over the years, her slightly older friend Tate Walker lends her books and teaches her to read, write, and count.
They share an interest in nature and begin a romantic relationship until Tate leaves for college and breaks his promise to return to her on the 4th of July.
In 1968, Kya begins a relationship with popular local quarterback Chase Andrews, who promises her marriage.
Chase gives Kya a small shell which she makes into a necklace and gives to him.
A year later, Tate returns to Barkley Cove wanting to rekindle their romance, but Kya is unsure.
Kya ends her relationship with Chase when she discovers he is already engaged to another girl.
Kya has her nature drawings and writings published and the income helps her keep her home.
Her older brother Jodie reappears and tells her their mother died before she was able to reunite her children.
Jodie promises to visit when he can.
Kya rebuffs Chase's persistent attentions and successfully fights off his rape attempt, vowing to kill him if he does not leave her alone.
The threat is overheard by a fisherman.
Chase returns and vandalizes Kya's home while she hides in the bushes.
Days later, Chase is found dead at the bottom of a fire tower from which he had apparently fallen.
The muddy bog floods at high tide, destroying any tracks from the killer, and no fingerprints are found in the tower.
The shell necklace, which he had been wearing on the evening of his death, is missing from his body.
Kya is charged with first-degree murder and prejudged by the suspicious townspeople.

Despite knowing Kya had been meeting with a book publisher in Greenville at the time, the police and the prosecutor speculate she could have disguised herself and made an overnight round-trip bus ride to Barkley Cove, lured Chase to the fire tower during the brief layover and killed him.
With only the unfounded theory, the missing necklace, and the fisherman's testimony, Kya is found not guilty at her 1969 trial, with the help of a retired attorney.
Kya and Tate spend the rest of their lives together.
Kya publishes illustrated nature books, and is frequently visited by Jodie and his family.
While boating through the swamp in her 70s, she imagines seeing her mother returning to the cabin.
Tate finds Kya lying dead in the boat at their dock.
Boxing up Kya's things, Tate finds a passage in her journal saying that to protect the prey, sometimes the predator has to be killed.
It is accompanied by a drawing of Chase.
Tate then finds the missing shell necklace, which he throws into the marsh water.

84255587.title: Beyond Borders: Extraction
synopsis: In the shadowy, maze-like alleys of volatile Baghdad, a squad of covert operatives led by the hardened veteran Officer David Reddick seizes a highly secured mansion.
Their dire target is the rescue of an American CIA agent, held in the choking grip of a cruel and creaky wooden chair, the signs of torturous treatment extensive on his haggard face.
Their surgical plan of extraction swiftly breaks down into a violent melee when they unexpectedly collide headfirst into a unit of Al-Qaeda militants, disciplined and bitterly lethal.
Amid the prolonged firefight and painful human cost, Reddick grapples through the chaos to release the captured CIA agent.
The bitter taste of victory mixes with chaotic losses including the captivating lives of two prominent operatives, Lt. Smith and Sgt.
Jenkins, their lives snuffed out in the pitched battle.
At the side-lines of this somber event, Reddick converses lightly with the stony-faced Joint Chief of Staff, General Baker.
Within this conversation's deft intricacies, he slyly highlights his mounting suspicion of carelessness and possibly, betrayal.

Upon their unwelcomed return to the busy confines of the Pentagon in Washington DC, the team finds itself a target of a prickly internal audit due to the surprise demise of their team members during the rescue mission.
In the stark offices of the Pentagon, the cold truth is bared; the captured CIA agent was actually under the custody of rogue elements within America's corridors of power.
The realization sends shockwaves through the reviewing team.
The chilling reality propels Reddick, ever the determined puppet master, to conduct his own discreet investigation.

One shadowy evening, Reddick daringly confronts the intimidating Under Secretary of Defense, their covert rendezvous concluding in veiled threats against Reddick and a stark warning against further digging.
As he navigates this treacherous conspiracy, Reddick unearths a traitor nestled within his own flock, sparking an insidious paranoia amongst his team members.

Dodging increasingly ominous threats and narrowly evading traps designed to mute their progress, Reddick and his dwindling force unearth damning evidence against a mole, their patriotism tested beyond its breaking point.
They spend countless sleepless nights accumulating the proof, devoting every nerve and muscle to end the treachery.
Determined, they strategize an audacious midnight raid on the Under Secretary's strongly protected penthouse in America's capital.
Their final stand against the conspiracy.
As they storm the penthouse, their high spirits are punctured by the grim reality; it was a setup.
They are thrust into a grueling firefight against a formidable array of armed guards, the Secretary's private army.

Amid the violence, a tense and decisive confrontation erupts between Reddick and the traitorous Under Secretary before Reddick's team is taken into custody, outmaneuvered by the defector within their own ranks.
As the investigative evidence detonates across international media platforms, the ensuing chaos threatens to snap the thread of international diplomacy, plunging relations into a tailspin.
Meanwhile, in a bleak federal prison cell, Reddick and his team are wrongfully framed as the masterminds behind this insidious plot against their homeland.
Loyal allies rally around Reddick, their resilience shining through their refusal to accept the poisonous duplicity of their compatriots.
In the confined space of their prison cell, Reddick and his team find unexpected assistance in the form of cryptic messages smuggled through homely prison meals.
Across America, their names are etched into the national consciousness, their story of becoming an integral part of its complex history.
Reddick finally claims his well-deserved reprieve, retreating to his quaint lakeside cabin in the quiet backwoods of Maine.
One a sunny afternoon, his pacified existence is torn asunder by the delivery of an enigmatic package, a thick brown envelope with no return address.
Carefully, he cracks open the envelope only to find a cryptic letter encoded in a complex cipher, an echo of bygone missions.
Deciphering the mysterious missive, he's informed of a new looming spectre of danger over America.
His sleep still deep with the nightmare of past tribulations, Reddick must assemble his loyal team once again.
The call to arms is met with resounding ardor; their readiness to safeguard their homeland still burning brightly.
In the heartland of the United States, its saviours regroup in secret, preparing to plunge into a new battle.
Nevertheless, Reddick marshals his team, vowing to brave whatever storm lays ahead in pursuit of truth and justice.
The new campaign cracks open, introducing yet another chapter in a tumultuous saga tinged with fear, uncertainty, and the glimmering essence of hope.

59275458.title: Without Remorse (film)
synopsis: In Aleppo, Syria, a team of US Navy SEALs, including Senior Chief Petty Officer John Kelly, rescue a CIA operative taken hostage by a suspected pro-Assad paramilitary group.
The situation escalates as the SEALs discover that the captors are actually Russian military.
Three months later, in apparent retaliation for their role in the mission, several members of the team are covertly killed by Russian FSB operatives.
Kelly's pregnant wife Pam is murdered when the Russians break into their house.
Kelly kills all but one of the attackers before being rushed to the hospital with near-fatal wounds.
Meanwhile, in Washington, D.C., Kelly's SEAL team leader and friend, Lt.
Commander Karen Greer, meets with Ritter and Secretary of Defense Thomas Clay to discuss how the FSB discovered the SEALs' identities and review their response options.
Leaked news of Russia's unprecedented attack on American soil has caused the already-strained relationship between the two nations to sour further, possibly causing a new cold war.
The CIA refuses to conduct an investigation into the murders, motivating Greer to pass confidential information to Kelly.
Healed from his injuries, Kelly tracks down the Russian diplomat who issued the passports to the FSB operatives, and forces him to give up the name of the surviving assassin before killing him.
Incarcerated for murder, Kelly bargains his way out by revealing the escaped operative is Victor Rykov, an ex-Spetznaz officer who is hiding in Murmansk, Russia.
Despite Greer's objections, Clay allows Kelly to participate in Rykov's capture on the condition that Kelly serves his sentence after the mission.
Kelly flies to Murmansk with Greer and a CIA black ops team, planning to HALO jump into Russia.
Intercepted and attacked by a Russian fighter, their plane crashes into the Barents Sea.
Kelly dives into the wreckage to recover essential equipment, including a zodiac boat.
The team arrives in Murmansk and finds Ritter, whom Kelly suspects is to blame for the intelligence leaks.
Ritter swears he is not responsible and leads the team to Rykov.
Kelly goes off mission to confront Rykov, finding him wearing a suicide vest and learns that he is a deep cover CIA asset.
Rykov detonates his vest, killing himself as the team becomes pinned down by sniper fire.
As police arrive, the team realizes that the mission was a set-up to have American soldiers killed on Russian soil to start a war.
Kelly volunteers to cover the team's escape; since he is a convicted murderer, his death could be plausibly denied.
Kelly buys the team time to reach safety but is badly injured.
He then uses an explosion as cover to steal a police uniform and hijacks an ambulance to escape.
Kelly and the surviving team members leave the country by boat.
Ritter officially reports Kelly as dead, allowing Kelly to hunt for the traitor.
Back in D.C., Kelly confronts Clay and forces him into his car.

After Kelly threatens Clay's family, he confesses to being behind the intelligence leaks and orchestrating the conflict between the U.S. and Russia, intending to start a war with Russia to boost the economy and unite the American people against a common enemy.
Kelly drives the car over a bridge and lets it sink to the bottom of the Potomac River, drowning Clay.
Kelly escapes with a recording of the confession, with the help of Greer, who was waiting in the river with diving gear.
At Washington Union Station, Greer gives Kelly a new identity provided by Ritter, he leaves to begin his new life as "John Clark".
One year later, Clark meets with Ritter, newly promoted to deputy director, and proposes the creation of a multinational counter-terrorism team, codename: Rainbow.

31289906.title: Urban Fury
synopsis: The opening shot captures a captivating aerial view of Manhattan's iconic skyline, the camera expertly navigating among the towering skyscrapers, finally zoning onto a shiny black, high-security vehicle moving with an air of authority.
Its heavy-duty armor and almost invisible police escort subtly hint at a mystery that resides within its fortified innards.

Amidst the hustle and bustle of a crowded Starbucks tucked away in a busy corner of the city, Jake, a rugged ex-Special Forces soldier, gently swirls the remnants of his double espresso, his focused gaze lost in the turmoil of memories from his adrenaline-filled days in the rugged terrains of Afghanistan.
His reverie shatters abruptly as a thunderous explosion from the street violently rocks the café.
Glass windows explode into a storm of deadly shards that twirl around him, leaving trails of destruction in their wake.
Launching himself into the chaos, Jake races towards the epicenter of the explosion.
His expert eyes catch sight of anonymous individuals, their features hidden under dark masks, overpowering the paramilitary security personnel guarding the previously noted black vehicle.
He freezes as a stray bullet tears through a teenage girl who was caught in the deadly crossfire.
The sight of the innocent life being snuffed out triggers a guilt trip in Jake that propels him to investigate the frightening incident.
His search leads him to a damp, musty warehouse on the outskirts of the city, its dim, flickering lights casting eerie shadows on the deserted structure.

Among the mess of odd symbols and parts of futuristic technology scattered around the location, Jake realizes it was the thieves' safe house - a clandestine place to plan their heists and hide after the job was done.
Suddenly, a raven-haired femme fatale with icy eyes materializes from the shadows warning Jake to abandon his quest.
Her cryptic words serve to pique Jake's interest, further strengthening his determination to uncover the truth.

Relying on his rigorous military training and remarkable instinct, Jake starts deciphering the various connections that link the daring daylight theft to crime boss Decker's massive underground empire.
Concocting an ingenious plan, Jake assumes the dangerous identity of a Russian mercenary to infiltrate Decker's heavily fortified stronghold.
In a brutal brawl witnessed by all, he proves his worth to the crime boss, earning a precarious spot in his sinister world.
Among Decker's hardened men, Jake chances upon Maria.
Much to his surprise, she is revealed to be an undercover FBI agent, tasked with the same mission as him.
The shared perilous mission brings them close and together they start excavating Decker's ghastly plot from the labyrinth of industrial secrets hidden within the criminal empire.
They uncover a nefarious scheme for a massive citywide internet blackout.
Decker's plan to shut down the entire communication network in Manhattan signaled an impending catastrophe of unimaginable scale.
Maria and Jake realize the urgent need to take down Decker and prevent an unprecedented cyber onslaught that threats to plunge the city into a chaotic abyss.

Battling enemies at every turn, they navigate a path paved with deceiving paths, treacherous NYPD officers on Decker's payroll, and merciless henchmen ready to execute their boss's directives without flinching.
The ominous weight of the mission often strangles their conscience, as the cost of innocent lives hanged like a guillotine in their ongoing shadow war.
In a daring operation under the cover of a moonless night, Jake and Maria slip into Manhattan's Central Communication Hub, the very womb from where Decker planned to birth his assault.

After successfully navigating through a network of complex laser security systems and staying ahead of Decker's roving henchmen, they manage to buy Manhattan a temporary reprieve by disrupting the preliminary stages of the cyber attack.
Their ephemeral victory is overshadowed as Decker's battalion of armed men trap them in the technologically advanced control room, their encirclement tightening like a python's grip.
Bracing themselves for the imminent firefight, Jake and Maria expertly fend off the opening volley from Decker's foot soldiers, outmaneuvering them through superior strategy and teamwork.
With options running dry, Maria offers a selfless sacrifice to sabotage Decker's heinous plan and prevent further potential casualties.
Braving the storm of bullets, she manages to reach the main controls and with her dying effort, successfully deactivates the cyber onslaught, her life snuffed out with the echo of the final gunshot.
Witnessing Maria's martyrdom fuels Jake’s fury, and his fight against Decker transforms into a personal vendetta.
He battles his way to the rooftop where Decker, wrapped in an aura of malicious satisfaction, watches the lingering chaos.
A brutal rooftop battle ensues, and Jake finally gains the upper-hand over Decker.
In the climax, Decker finds his deathly demise from the rooftop, spiraling down to his much-deserved fate.
Jake, despite his victory, bears deep mental scars, the memory of Maria's sacrifice etched into his hardened expression.
His subsequent investigations unravel a spider web of corruption, with its threads stretching all the way up to the Mayor's office in Manhattan.
This shocking revelation unmasks the belly of corruption simmering beneath the facade of Manhattan's daily functioning.
Hurt but resolute, Jake dedicates himself to the monumental mission of uprooting this deep-seated corruption.
The film concludes on a poignant note with Jake standing solemnly before Maria's tombstone.
Her resting place serves now as a lasting memory of a brave comrade and an unlikely friend.
Under the tranquil sky, Jake makes a solemn pledge to hold the corrupt accountable and bring about revolutionary change - a promise earmarked on Maria's tombstone.

62000065.title: Wrath of Man
synopsis: In Los Angeles, an armored truck robbery leaves two guards and a bystander dead, which sets off a series of events told in four acts.
A Dark Spirit Five months after the robbery, Patrick Hill joins Fortico Security as an armored truck guard.
His manager Terry commends his references and company trainer "Bullet" nicknames him "H".
Hill barely passes firearm training and gets off to a rocky start with his colleagues, including “Boy Sweat” Dave and Dana Curtis.
During a pickup, Bullet is taken hostage and Hill convinces a panicked Dave to comply with the robbers before he disposes of the entire crew with expert marksmanship and merciless efficiency.
Hill is questioned by FBI agents investigating the first robbery.
The FBI investigators bring their suspicions about Hill to their superior, Agent King, who tells them to leave Hill alone.
Hill receives a dossier of Fortico employee files and an autopsy report.
Three months later, Hill and Bullet are waylaid in Chinatown, but the robbers flee at the sight of Hill.
Hill continues to investigate his coworkers and they become increasingly suspicious of him.
Scorched Earth Five months before joining Fortico on the day of the first robbery, Hill is with his son Dougie.
Revealed to be working with a robbery crew, Hill grudgingly agrees to monitor an armored truck's route, leaving Dougie in the car.
A group of robbers hijack the truck and spot Dougie.
Hill races back to his son and watches as Dougie is murdered before he is also shot and left for dead.
Three weeks later, Hill wakes up in the hospital and meets with King, who gives him a list of suspects and agrees to temporarily turn a blind eye.

Hill is revealed to be Mason Hargreaves, a notorious crime lord; determined to find Dougie's killer, Hargreaves and his men — led by Mike, Brendan, and Moggy — kill nearly everyone on King's list, without results.
Mike voices his concerns about retaliation, and Hargreaves agrees to lay low in London, but instead assumes the identity of Patrick Hill and joins Fortico to continue the hunt alone.
It was Hargreaves' own crew who attempted the Chinatown robbery until Mike recognized him.
Bad Animals, Bad Sometime before the first robbery, a group of disgruntled Afghanistan veterans — Carlos, Sam, Brad, Tom, Jan and their former sergeant Jackson — decide to become thieves.
Their first robbery results in only 110 thousand dollars.
With help from an unidentified guard who served under Jackson, they decide to pull off a more ambitious heist of an armored truck.
During this Fortico heist Jan needlessly shoots the guards, Dougie and Hargreaves, who sees Jan's face.
Liver, Lungs, Spleen & Heart Five months later, the veterans reunite to steal over $150 million from the Fortico depot on Black Friday weekend.
Bullet reveals to Hargreaves that he is Jackson's inside man, threatening him into cooperating.
The crew takes the depot hostage, but an alarm is triggered; in the ensuing gunfight, multiple guards are killed and Hargreaves kills and wounds several robbers.
Fleeing with Bullet and Jackson, Jan murders them to escape alone with the money.
At home, Jan finds a phone in one of the money bags, planted by Hargreaves to track its location.
Hargreaves confronts him with Dougie's autopsy report, shooting him in the same places he shot Dougie.
Abandoning the money, Hargreaves tells King his task is done and is driven away.

50711489.title: Lost Trail (2022 film)
synopsis: Lisa, a fashion-forward city girl, Carl, a farm boy with a knack for survival, Jake, a seasoned traveler who had been to every continent, Emily, a nature photographer with a good eye, Marco, an agile rock climber, and Diego, an experienced marine veteran, all gathered in the charming village of Mansfield.
Each friend brought their unique skills and perspective, their shared goal: the adventurous Pacific Crest Trail.
Mansfield was a fairy-tale-like village with an array of distinctive houses featuring intricate wooden facades, engulfed by centuries-old towering pine woods.
The villagers greeted them with warmth and curiosity, their old-world charm a mirror to the untouched beauty of their community.
In the convivial atmosphere of the local tavern, the friends enjoyed pints of golden craft beer, freshly brewed by the neighborhood home brewers.
The locals, full of wisdom, and slightly terrifying old tales of the trail filled the night with laughter, wariness, and excitement.
The group, high on youthful vitality and burning enthusiasm, brushed off the tales as mere folklore.
Their spirits undeterred, they were ready to face the much-anticipated challenge the trail offered.
On the appointed day, they set off on their odyssey, brimming with energy and a daring sense of expectation.
Their spirits unflagging during the initial hours, they reveled in the spectacular vistas, shared jokes, and bonded over the thrill of their shared adventure.
Soon though, an eerie feeling started to creep in, the laughter died down as an ominous atmosphere started enveloping them.
The sense of being watched, of eyes gazing from the forest's shadowy depths combined with an inexplicably frosty chill in the air switched their giggles to tense silence.
Opaque whispers, barely discernible yet persistent, echoed from the treeline, filling the void left by their ceased laughter.
As the mystery thickened, their smartphones, each with a digital compass, started malfunctioning.
Without reliable navigation, they were left to rely on instincts and traditional map reading.
Startling symbols, uncannily similar to those shared by the villagers, started appearing etched on tree trunks and wobbly stones.
This strange language agitated them further.
Strangest of all, the natural order of time felt distorted.
The sun rose and set in quick successions, and hours stretched into days even though they'd seemingly covered little distance.
Spooked by the trail's odd phenomenons, they decided to set up camp once darkness blanketed the forest under a starless sky.
There, amidst the deafening quietude of the night, Lisa, their livewire, disappeared.
Her sudden absence threw their camaraderie into chaos, suspicion took root, and the situation turned grim.
The second day began under an intense, eerie sunrise.
With the ever-smiling Carl now missing as well, his blood-stained backpack a terrifying witness to his disappearance, their courage dwindled.
Jake and Emily pooled their hiking knowledge and ventured back, attempting to reach Mansfield.
Marco and Diego, meanwhile, chose to keep progressing, hoping to find their friends.
The route back to Mansfield was treacherous, filled with ghostly apparitions and nerve-wracking sounds that persistently followed Jake and Emily.
Their sanity threatened, they nevertheless continued until they reached the once bustling village, now eerily lifeless.
Marco and Diego, however, followed a different path that led them to the unfolding of a dreadful reality.
The village legends weren't tales but the future they were living.
A vengeful ghost—the spirit of a displaced settler—guarded the trail, detaining whoever trespassed its territory.
Knowing now the terrifying truth of their ordeal, the duo decided to reunite with Jake and Emily.
Their group assembled once again, they made a terrifying decision: to face the supernatural entity.
Using their collective knowledge of urban legends, prayers, and superstitious practices, they initiated a primitive ritual to appease the ghost.
Anchored by the cryptic symbols, they started a confrontation with the spirity entity.
The violent encounters saw them pitted against disturbing visions, ear-splitting screams, and torrential storms powered by the entity’s wrath.
Bracing themselves for the showdown, their determination solidified their friendships.
The galvanizing struggle ended with the morning.
Upon the silvery curtain of dawn lifting, Lisa and Carl were found.
Visibly shaken but alive, they felt the overwhelming relief of seeing their friends.
With talks of rescue left behind, they hurriedly retreated from the sinister trail.
Their spirit sore but friendship strengthened, they replaced memories of carefree adventures with this grim tale of their survival.
Once back within the safety of their cosmopolitan lives, farewell was bittersweet.
They were distinctively united by the ordeal, even as they each took different paths to recovery.
Lisa and Carl began therapy, grappling with their lingering anxiety.
Jake and Emily sought solace in the quiet corners of their cities, finding the bustle unnerving.
Marco and Diego traded their thrill-seeking attitude for tranquil routines.
Yet, despite their personal battles, their communication didn’t falter.
The echo of their shared ordeal fortified their bond as they vowed to advocate for the respect of nature’s mysteries.
As the trail continued to attract hikers, Mansfield village remained deserted.
The legacy of their survival story stayed hidden within the trail's enigmatic symbols, forever intertwined with the story of the Pacific Crest Trail.

61783079.title: Wrong Turn (2021 film)
synopsis: Jennifer "Jen" Shaw, her boyfriend Darius, and couples Adam and Milla and Gary and Luis, arrive in a small town in rural Virginia to hike the Appalachian Trail.
They encounter hostility from locals in the bar, especially from Nate.
Jen also meets a strange woman called Edith; with her is a young mute girl, Ruthie.
They begin their hike and, despite warnings, go off the trail to find an old fort.
A huge tree trunk rolls down the hill and fatally crushes Gary.
Bruised, disoriented and lost, the group sets up camp for the night.
The following day, Milla goes missing, as well as their cellphones.
They find a plaque dated "1859", commemorating the creation of a group of settlers in the mountains called the "Foundation", who believed the end of the United States was near.
While looking for Milla, Adam triggers a trap and is dragged into a pit.
Jen, Darius and Luis come across a barn full of backpacks and clothing, then see Adam trussed to a pole, carried between two men wearing strange costumes and animal skull masks.
The friends confront the men, who talk in a language they can't understand.
Adam breaks free and manically beats one of them to death while the other escapes.
Milla appears, having earlier gone for a bathroom break and evaded the two men.
The friends encounter other traps and are surrounded by more masked men.
Milla falls into a pit and is impaled on stakes.
She is killed with an arrow by a member of the Foundation.
Jen, Adam, Darius and Luis are all captured.
The group is taken to a primitive settlement deep in the forest, the headquarters of the Foundation, and put before a court.
Edith is one of their captors.
Morgan, the brother of the man Adam killed, testifies how Adam murdered his brother, Samuel.
The group is charged with murder.
The leader, Venable, sentences Adam to death.
The others try to lie before the court to save his life, only to be exposed as perjurors by other witnesses, and are therefore sentenced to "darkness" for perjury in court.
Adam breaks free and holds Ruthie hostage, demanding the release of his friends.
Ruthie uses a concealed blade to stab Adam in the leg; he is then executed in front of his friends by Venable, who beats him to death using the log he used to kill Samuel.
Luis tries to flee and Venable blinds him with a hot poker.
Jen tries to manipulate Venable and fellow Foundation members for mercy.

She sells Darius to the group as a desirable professional who is able to solve social problems of their closed society; and offers herself to anyone as wife and mother to their children, advertising herself as having good genes and no genetic predispositions to cancer, of which she's found the Foundation people are afraid.
Venable agrees, and she and Darius are initiated into the community.
Jen becomes Venable's wife, as he discloses he's been widowed for over a year after his wife died in a mountain slope accident.
Six weeks later, Scott Shaw, Jen's father, arrives the town to search for his daughter.
He pays a local tracker to take him through the forest.
After a trap kills the tracker and his son, Scott finds the settlement but is captured.
Jen, now married to Venable, shoots her father with an arrow.
Venable sentences Scott to "darkness" for trespassing and imprisons him.
That night, Jen releases her father, revealing she only shot him so as not to raise suspicion.
She tries to get Darius to run away with her and Scott, but he refuses to leave.
Ruthie helps them escape before Venable and the other cultists pursue them.
They discover an underground chamber full of blinded and shambling prisoners, including Luis.
Jen mercy kills him and flees with Scott, killing several cultists, including Edith.
They encounter Nate and other armed townsmen who offer to help.
The cultists attack them, wounding Jen, but Scott and Jen escape.
Several months later, Jen and her father have returned to their normal lives.
Jen visits her stepmother, but finds her in the process of welcoming Venable and Ruthie to the neighborhood.
Jen confronts Venable, who notices that she is pregnant with his child.
He asks Jen to return with him to the Foundation.
Jen agrees on the condition that Venable never again interfere with her family.
She, Venable, and Ruthie leave, driving away in a recreational vehicle (RV).
As the end credits roll, Jen causes the RV to crash into a parked car.
Jen stabs Venable to death and kills the other cultist, the RV driver as well.
She then takes Ruthie's hand as they walk back towards her family home.

34425637.title: Against My Daughter's Will
synopsis: The movie, "Against My Daughter's Will," commences with an uncanny flashback.
A young Emily Davies, shrouded in her threadbare cloak and shielding baby Olivia held hostage in a blanket, navigates through a forest blanketed by twilight against stern warnings from Lisa.
Suddenly, the stillness is interrupted by the appearance of a figure, haunting and shrouded in silver moonbeams flitting through the skeletal trees.
Emily's horror-struck face sharply comes into focus as the enigmatic figure looms closer.
The film transports the audience to a now middle-aged Lisa Davies, aged 40, and her vibrant 20-year-old daughter, Olivia, enjoying life in the idyllic town of Sykesville, Maryland.
Their homely, traditional brick residence is bound with unorthodox rules enforced by Lisa.
The regular flashpoints between mother and daughter concern Lisa's stringent rules about keeping Olivia well away from the sinister forest that adds a dark fringe to their otherwise picturesque town.
On the cusp of her 20th birthday milestone, a thrill-seeking Olivia defies her mother's primary prohibition - setting foot into the depths of the forbidden forest.
Olivia, joined by adventurous companions, Brooke and Ryan, dare to unravel the forest's secrets.
Amid the grotesquely twisted, towering trees, a decrepit, abandoned cottage stands.
The derelict cottage's history unveils over time, spelling out its ties with Emily and concealing dark secrets in its dank shadows.
Olivia’s life goes downhill from the night of their disobedience, as she grapples with ghostly visions and uncanny incidents.
This new Olivia confounds her friends and family.
Lisa, noting Olivia's significant behavioral shift, discloses her bone-chilling past, and the frightful reason for her painstakingly protective nature.
Lisa chronologically outlines her history involving Emily, her dangerous dabbling with witchcraft, and her deadly alliance with malevolent entities dwelling in the forest.
Lisa shares details of how she manages to break free while carrying infant Olivia from Emily's vile grasp and why the fear for her daughter's life never leaves her.
Overwhelmed, Olivia decides to face the forest entities head-on to rid herself of the chains binding her.
Olivia, along with Brooke, ventures on a perilous journey to challenge the unseen forces triggering the turmoil in her life.
Inside the ominous forest, the friends find themselves abruptly separated by an invisible entity.
Alone, Olivia stumbles upon a familiar clearing - the same spot Emily always spoke of in hushed, fearful whispers.
Oncoming fear washes over when Olivia comes face-to-face with the vindictive spirit that she has been doomed with since birth.
Concerned about Olivia's safety, Lisa, accompanied by local Sheriff Carter and the initially doubtful Shawn, maneuvers into the spectral forest.

With Emily's diary filled with her scribbles about ritualistic incantations as their guide, they attempt a precarious ritual to break the evil grip, despite their experience with the occult being shaky.
In a twist in the plot, Emily's vengeful apparition surfaces in their showdown with the forest spirit.
The phantom of their past had all but forgotten Emily and her magical prowess.
Emily seeks redemption for the calamity she unwittingly invited upon them and commits to assisting Lisa and Shawn against the forest spirit.
Under Emily's watchful ghostly presence, Lisa and Shawn follow the intricate steps outlined in the grimoire (book of spells).
As they progress with each step, they find themselves closer to lifting the curse.
Against overwhelming odds, they succeed in ridding the curse with an adrenaline-packed struggle.
The concluding scenes depict a moving, tearful reunion between Olivia and Lisa.
Emily's anguished spirit finally finds absolution and fades away into the wind.
The humbled forest entity, defeated and placated, recedes into the night, restoring the forest's tranquility.
The locals of Sykesville breathe a collective sigh of relief as the horrifying forest truth turns into an urban legend and bedtime stories for young ones.

The movie ends with Olivia and Lisa inside their peaceful home, the forest seen through their window - a constant, silent yet harmless reminder of their successful campaign against the enigmatic entity.

68774816.title: You Are Not My Mother
synopsis: An opening flashback scene shows Rita Delaney taking her infant granddaughter Charlotte (“Char”) into the woods, while the baby’s mother Angela protests.
In the wood, Rita sits the baby on the ground and lights a ring of fire around her.
She watches as the baby screams.
In the present day, the teenage Char lives with her mother and grandmother; her uncle Aaron lives nearby and visits occasionally.
The household is somewhat dysfunctional; Rita is in poor health, Angela is depressed and spends much of her time in bed, and there is no food in the house.
Char attends a girls’ Catholic high school.
Although academically gifted, she does not fit in with the other students, who consider her their social inferior, and she is subjected to bullying.
One morning, driving Char to school, Angela tells her daughter that "she can't do this anymore".
Her car is later found abandoned, with no sign of Angela.
The family report the disappearance to the police, but they are not able to offer much help.
However Angela returns within a few days, strangely altered.
Her depression is gone, and she is cheerful, dressing up and cooking dinner for the family.
Rita seems suspicious of these changes in Angela and deliberately upsets the pan of soup that Angela had prepared, so the family are obliged to eat the chips that Aaron has brought over instead.
But Angela appears to have little appetite and sits staring sullenly at her mother.
Char witnesses several instances of increasingly bizarre behaviour in the "new" Angela and becomes frightened.
Her uncle Aaron is poisoned by Angela, which leads to him being hospitalised.
In the meantime Char is forging a friendship with one of her former bullies, Suzanne.
Char confides in Suzanne about the changes in Angela; Suzanne in turn tells Char how her own mother died when she was very young.
One evening Rita tells Char the story of her past; when Char was a baby, Rita realised she had been swapped with a “changeling”.
The only way to get the real Char back was to place her near fire, hence the fiery ring ritual in the woods.
This worked, but Char sustained a small burn to her cheek.
Her family told her the resultant scar was a birthmark.
Rita tells Char that the "new" Angela is also a changeling, and thus the fire ritual must be repeated to get the real Angela back.
Although Char appears to agree, when she sees Angela bound and gagged and tied to a bed she is appalled.
Despite her grandmother’s protests, Char frees Angela, only to realise too late that Rita spoke the truth, and that this is not the "real" Angela.
The changeling kills Rita.
Char runs out of the house, but is waylaid by the school bullies, who force her inside an unlit Halloween bonfire.
However the bullies are scared off by the approach of the changeling Angela.
Angela pushes her way into the bonfire to get to Char, but Char sets the structure alight.
Angela burns while Char is rescued from the flames by Suzanne.
In the final scene, Angela is restored to her true self, and Char makes her a lucky token from twigs "to keep her safe", as her grandmother had once made for her.
Mother and daughter are happy to be together again, ready to move forward with their lives.

95887594.title: Midwest Radiance
synopsis: As the movie begins, there are breathtaking panoramic shots of downtown Kansas City just after sunset.
The camera then takes us into Joe's diner, a bustling eatery frequented by truck drivers and late-night customers searching for a warm meal.
Bethany, our lead character, plays her role as a waitress with animated enthusiasm.
Our perception of Bethany dramatically changes when she enters a dim, smoky strip club bathed in neon lights.
One notably frosty winter night, a flamboyant character named Alex saunters into Joe's diner.
Their relationship deepens as they share confessions and lived experiences over countless cups of diner coffee.
The narrative takes a twist one afternoon when Alex, during a casual stroll along the Kansas River, opens up about her clandestine life.
Intrigued by the allure of thrill and the temptation of easy wealth, Bethany slowly succumbs to Alex's persuasive charm and willingly enters the world of crime.
Working in unison in this perilous world, Bethany and Alex undertake increasingly risky assignments.
As their criminal proficiency grows, they start outmaneuvering rival gangs from Chicago.
With newfound wealth at her disposal, Bethany starts living a flamboyant life, discarding her old clothes for designer outfits and embracing the latest tech gadgets.
Noticing this sudden surge in her lifestyle, Bethany's college-bound younger brother, James, grows suspicious.
Armed with bold confidence, Bethany and Alex carefully plot and execute a high-stakes heist on Johnson's liquor warehouse.
The intricacy of their heist captures seasoned detective's Mark's attention.
Feeling the mounting pressure of looming peril, Bethany and Alex hatch a daring plan for their grand finale, a heist on the Central Bank.
Their final plan, however, experiences multiple setbacks, intensifying the exhilaration and leaving behind unexpected clues for Detective Mark to follow.
Meanwhile, Mark diligently silhouette his suspect list and eventually narrows down on Bethany, linking her to the series of crimes that have gripped the city.
Mark confronts Bethany at the diner, revealing indisputable digital surveillance evidence connecting her to the crimes.

After a moment of hesitation, torn between loyalty and survival, Bethany begrudgingly accepts the perilous proposition, marking the start of a dangerous covert operation that puts everything she cares about at stake.
As this high-stakes game unfolds, Bethany teeters on a knife's edge, torn between truth and treachery, attempting to balance her loyalty to Alex with her obligation to bring down the crime syndicate.
Tension escalates as Bethany's sudden change in behavior does not go unnoticed by Alex, fueling suspicion and mistrust in their once-unshakeable bond.
During a nail-biting showdown, Bethany and Alex narrowly evade an assassination attempt from the syndicate.
With proof safely stashed away in an inconspicuous public locker, they brilliantly manipulate the crime boss into an elaborately planned trap set by Mark.
Seizing the chance, Mark swoops in to arrest the blindsided kingpin, setting off a chain reaction of arrests that expose and dismantle the once invincible crime ring.
In the final shot of the film, we see Bethany and Alex, reflected in the rear-view mirror of a beaten-up vehicle, leaving behind the tarnished memories of their criminal lives in Kansas City.
They hit the open road, heading towards an uncertain future that, nonetheless, holds a glimmer of promise.

58716131.title: Zola (film)
synopsis: Aziah "Zola" King, a self-assured waitress and part-time stripper in Detroit, meets Stefani, an outgoing and crass fellow stripper, while serving her at work.
Stefani invites Zola to dance with her at a club that night, and the two become friends.
The next day, Stefani proposes that Zola join her on a road trip to Tampa, Florida, the location of a strip club where Stefani claims the two can make significant money.
Zola joins Stefani; her mysterious roommate, X; and Stefani's dimwitted boyfriend, Derrek, on a road trip.
Upon arriving in Tampa, Stefani, Zola, and X leave Derrek at a seedy motel while they visit the club where Stefani claims her friends earned over $5,000 in one night.
The two perform at the club, but do not net nearly as much as Stefani insisted they would.
After, Zola learns that Stefani and X have posted photos of her and Stefani in a Backpage advertisement, selling them for sex.
Zola attempts to leave, but is threatened by X, who reveals himself to be Stefani's pimp.
X brings the women to an upscale hotel, where Stefani proceeds to have sex with a male client.
Zola, who does not wish to participate, is incredulous when she learns that X is charging only $150 per client.
Zola edits the Backpage advertisement, changing the rate to $500 to help Stefani earn more money; by the end of the night, Stefani has made over $8,000.
X is initially insulted by Zola's intervention, but quickly grows impressed.
Meanwhile, Derrek, left to his own devices, befriends a man named Dion whom he meets at the motel.
When X, Stefani, and Zola return to the motel, X is enraged to discover that Derrek informed Dion about their reason for visiting Tampa.
Worried that Dion and his associates will rob them, X forces the group to flee.
After arriving at another hotel, X arranges for Stefani to see more clients at various locations, while a reluctant Zola stands by to ensure Stefani's safety.

When Derrek realizes Stefani is again engaging in prostitution, he argues with her, revealing to Zola that Stefani has manipulated other dancers into unwittingly participating in similar prostitution rackets.
Zola is angered and loses all trust in Stefani.
Derrek and Stefani's quarreling is interrupted when X bursts in with Baybe, his lover and madam, who is armed with a gun.
After calming the situation, X gives Zola a gun for the women's protection, and Stefani and Zola are sent out so Stefani can continue to meet with clients.
After Stefani engages in a gang bang at a private residence, the two women visit another hotel, where a client has responded to their Backpage ad.
Upon opening the hotel room door, Stefani is grabbed by the client and forced into the room.
A terrified Zola flees and calls X and Derrek on her phone.
The three return to the room and find the men inside are Dion and an accomplice, armed with shotguns, who have posed as clients in order to rob Stefani of her earnings.
At gunpoint, X offers the men $50,000, along with possession of Zola, if they let him and Derrek leave with Stefani, who has been beaten unconscious.
As Zola is digitally penetrated against her will by Dion, X manages to draw the gun Zola has in her purse, then shoots Dion in the throat.
The group flee the hotel, disposing of Dion's guns by throwing them into the Tampa Bay.
The group eventually arrives at a large, luxurious home X shares with Baybe.

X finally allows Zola to leave and proclaims his possession of Stefani, but Derrek threatens to commit suicide should Stefani remain loyal to X. Derrek immediately throws himself over a balcony, landing on concrete below and injuring his head.
Zola, Stefani, and X leave to take Derrek to the hospital.
In the car, Stefani proclaims her love for Zola, but is met with cool disgust as an exhausted Zola looks out the window and ignores her.

13551754.title: Princeton Pursuit
synopsis: Grace Lily, an ambitious senior and valedictorian aspirant at Franklin D. Roosevelt High School is introduced, studying relentlessly, preparing for debates at nationals, attending late night choir practices, and strategizing for chess competitions.
Grace not only excels academically but is also well-liked by the school community for her inspiring resilience and charming, sunny nature.
A raw yet tender family moment unfolds around a simple, worn-out dinner table.

Amidst jokes, laughter and shared stories, Grace expresses her burning desire to attend her dream institution, Princeton University, hinting at her aspiration to elevate her family's modest circumstances.
In a heart-to-heart session with Miss Kendrick, her empathetic and always enthusiastic school counselor, Grace is informed about the prestigious James Madison Scholarship at Princeton University.

However, the scholarship comes with a severe prerequisite — a glowing recommendation letter from a Princeton alum, and Grace suddenly finds herself under waves of worry, given they do not know any Princeton graduates.
An unexpected lifeline presents itself when Grace reads an alumni magazine left behind by her often unpredictable, but lovable physics teacher, Mr. Lancaster.
Taking note of his photograph in alumni reunion coverage, she realizes he is a Princeton alum.
Setting aside her apprehensions, Grace gathers the courage to ask Mr. Lancaster for the recommendation letter.
However, instead of receiving an immediate affirmation, Grace is presented with a series of unusual, peculiar tasks set by him that seem to have no defined end.
Grace forms an unexpected camaraderie with Mr. Lancaster.
She experiences shared laughter, conversations about astrophysics over cups of hot cocoa, and moments of soulful exchange.
To assist Grace with her scholarship preparation and fulfill the networking aspect of her application, Mr. Lancaster surprises her with an invitation to a black-tie Princeton alumni gathering.

As Grace immerses herself in her unusual journey with Mr. Lancaster, she accidentally uncovers his unsettled past about his exit from Princeton — a case of academic miscommunication gone hilariously wrong, leading to his temporary suspension that later led to his voluntary exit.
Grace, initially startled, soon finds herself empathizing with Mr. Lancaster as she begins to resonate with his experiences and understands his perspective better.
Meanwhile, the stern, rigid Franklin D. Roosevelt High School headmaster, Mr. Hawthorne, grows suspicious about Mr. Lancaster's unorthodox teaching methods and his adventurous activities with Grace.
This revelation sinks both Grace and Mr. Lancaster into a substantial challenge.
Mr. Hawthorne threatens to dismiss Mr. Lancaster and jeopardizes Grace's hard-earned scholarship application.
Unfazed by Mr. Hawthorne's threats, Grace decides to defend Mr. Lancaster's unique educational philosophy.
After executing these humorous yet eye-opening demonstrations, Grace manages to convince the faculty of Mr. Lancaster's educational efficacy.
She saves Mr. Lancaster's job and secures her scholarship application.
