An infuriated Emily is unable to reach Luke over the phone, only to find him at the engagement party.
The two argue in front of their families, and Emily smashes a bottle on Luke's head when he suggests she had traded sexual favors for the promotion.
Emily retreats to a bathroom where Luke finds her and the two argue before having sex.
During sex, Luke forces Emily forward twice, causing her face to slam against the bathroom counter.
Emily tells Luke to stop, but he does not.
The next morning, to protect her job, Emily tells Campbell she was being stalked by Luke and they were never in a relationship.
Emily returns home to find Luke there, having packed up his belongings and planning to move in with his brother.
Infuriated by his nonchalant attitude and demanding an apology for raping her, Emily threatens Luke with a knife.
She attacks Luke with the knife until he apologizes and breaks down crying.
Luke begs for her forgiveness and Emily orders him to leave before dropping the knife and smiling.

14534233.title: Maple Ridge Tales: The Film
synopsis: The movie begins with a captivating center the midday commotion in a chaotic pet rescue center in bustling San Francisco, led by the charming and energetic Tom Cruise.
Amid the mess of scattered pet food and a symphony of animal noises, Tom discovers an unexpected letter marked with his old elementary school’s emblem.
"Maple Ridge Grand Reunion!
", it proclaimed, prompting a flood of sepia-tinted images of his quaint hometown.
After days of pondering over the invitation and melancholic walks, Tom decides to revisit his roots.
He hands over the rein of his beloved center to his long-trusted buddy from his college days, Mike.
As Tom steps off the train onto the rustic platform of Maple Ridge, he’s enveloped by the familiar scent of the town’s signature maple trees.
Inspired by the picturesque surroundings and deprived of his usual flurry of furry companions, Tom announces plans of starting a local veterinary clinic.
As the excited whispers of a new venture echo through the town, Kitty Wilson walks into the town hall meeting.
Now a renowned veterinary doctor, she's been beckoned by the town council to assist Tom in his venture, news which elated Tom.
However, Tom's dream becomes a battleground when the town council expresses interest in the same picturesque riverside spot, as the location for a metropolitan-style mega-mall.
His emotionally reserved father, returns.
His blunt criticism of Tom’s idea, dismissing it as naivety under the guise of progress, sends shockwaves through the budding project.

Over time, his city friends burst into Maple Ridge, their pickup truck crammed with rescued animals from different corners of the state, causing waves of surprise and curiosity to spread across the town.
The turning point occurs when they rescue a marooned golden retriever pup on Nixon's Rock.
In their shared aim to rescue the frightened pup, Tom and his father reach an understanding and reconciliation.

Invigorated by the tender connections made, Tom makes a passionate speech at the reunion, emphasizing the bond between the town and its pets, underlining the pressing need of his proposed animal wellness center.
Watching from the sides, Kitty, touched by Tom's speech, finds herself swaying towards supporting Tom's cause rather than the council’s commercial endeavors.
In light of the community and Kitty's unexpected support, the council reverses its decision, granting Tom's venture the riverside property.
Against all odds, Kitty joins hands with Tom, promising to provide expert medical attention for the residents of Maple Ridge.
Fast forward to the long-awaited inauguration day, the pet rescue facility and veterinary clinic welcomes in residents with a sense of community spirit, bringing hope to pets and owners alike.
As the arrival of a dusk-tinted evening fills the screen, Tom and Kitty share a deep confession of love for each other amongst the scatterings of their excited animals.
A snapshot of Tom's prosperous pet rescue center in San Francisco, competently managed by Mike, serves a poignant reminder of the journey so far.
The film begins to flicker into the credits with a heartwarming scene of a blooming, vibrant community united by their shared love for animals.

70086878.title: Teen Wolf: The Movie
synopsis: Fifteen years after leaving Beacon Hills, Scott now runs an animal shelter in Los Angeles, adjoined to Deaton's new clinic, and is single.
Lydia works at an energy company in San Francisco and has broken up with Stiles after receiving a recurring vision of his death.
Derek has a 15-year-old son named Eli, and runs an auto repair shop with Malia and Peter.
Mason has joined the Beacon Hills police force.
Liam lives in Japan and works at a restaurant with Hikari Zhang, a kitsune, where they guard the urn containing the Nogitsune.
A hooded figure attacks the restaurant and frees the Nogitsune.
The figure sets numerous fires in the Beacon Hills forest, while Scott, Lydia and Chris receive visions of Allison, who had died by the Oni's hand.
They theorize her soul is trapped in bardo and cannot move on until they perform a ritual.
They return to Beacon Hills along with Jackson for the ritual at the Nemeton, which unexpectedly resurrects Allison.
She awakens with amnesia, not recognizing Scott and retaining only fragmented memories of her family's feud with Derek.
She attacks Scott and flees the hospital.
Deaton realizes the Nogitsune has been possessing Chris and causing the visions of Allison in order to trick Scott's pack into bringing her back from the dead.
The Nogitsune uses the Nemeton's power to physically manifest and creates nine Oni.
It approaches Allison, claiming that Scott destroyed her family.
Allison attacks Derek and hunts Scott and Eli until Scott lets her stab him with a wolfsbane-coated dagger.
She takes him to the town's stadium to use him as bait for the rest of his pack.
He manages to trigger more of her memories, and she forms a truce with him against the Nogitsune.
The Nogitsune abducts Liam, Hikari, Derek, Eli, Noah, Mason and Deaton, and holds them hostage in an illusionary bardo.
Lydia and Jackson examine the forest fires and realize that rowan trees were burned in order to produce mountain ash.
The culprit is Adrian Harris, who has been in hiding since his apparent murder, blaming Scott's pack for his misfortunes and plotting revenge.
Harris surrounds the stadium with mountain ash and forces Lydia to watch her friends' plight so the Nogitsune can feed on her pain.
Lydia produces a banshee scream that causes Allison to remember her past upon hearing it.
Scott persuades the Nogitsune to let everyone go if Allison executes him.
She reluctantly shoots him, but Hikari's kitsune spirit shields him from harm.
Parrish burns through the mountain ash, and he, Chris, Melissa, and the others join the pack in bardo.
The reunited pack kill the Oni while Scott, Derek and Eli overpower the Nogitsune.
Derek restrains it until Parrish incinerates them both.
Derek's eyes turn red in his final moments, becoming a true Alpha through his act of self-sacrifice.
Allison reunites with Scott and her friends.
At Derek's funeral, Noah bequeaths ownership of Stiles' Jeep to Eli.
Scott resumes his relationship with Allison and plans to eventually adopt Eli.
Parrish has Harris committed to Eichen House.

18855422.title: Dismissed in Disgrace: Special Ops Downfall (2022 film)
synopsis: Experienced Staff Sergeant Jake Mitchell finds himself embedded deep within the treacherous Afghan mountains on a covert mission.
Accompanied by his highly trained Special Operations Forces unit, he demonstrates a strategic proficiency and physical prowess that come from years in service.
During a classified operation at the remote mission site, tragedy strikes.
An undetected IED suddenly detonates, and Jake suffers a significant shrapnel injury to his right leg, effectively crippling him on the battlefield.
Struggling through the pain, Jake exposes an opening in his army belt to procure a small pill bottle tightly concealed within, showcasing an underlying issue far from the public view.

Gritting his teeth, he quickly ingests a handful of OxyContin pills, his strained smile revealing a grim and deeply troubling dependence on the powerful opioids as a makeshift solution to his physical agony.
Following this incident, Lieutenant Ben Foster, a long-time comrade, and Jake's closest confidante, pays a visit to his military-accommodated apartment.
There he stumbles upon the hidden pill bottle tucked away in an unattended drawer - a discovery that unveils Jake's secret addiction.
This revelation sends shocks through the military chain of command, resulting in a swift and public dismissal from Jake's esteemed position in the US Army Special Forces.
This harsh blow adds a layer of public humiliation atop his already suffered physical trauma.
Disgraced and forcibly removed from his once esteemed life of service, Jake spirals into a world permeated by guilt and loneliness.
His dependency on OxyContin spirals further, unchecked and unchallenged.
In these challenging times, Jake crosses paths with Sarah Williams, a licensed psychologist specializing in PTSD and addiction issues among war veterans.
Her empathetic and keen professional eye offers a beacon of hope in his world of despair.
Sarah's expertise begins to shine through her strategic therapy sessions, gently guiding Jake through the tumultuous waters of guilt, regret, and an overpowering addiction.
Meanwhile, Ben delves into the shadows of Jake's past, gradually unveiling top-secret military files that hint at a sinister conspiracy to intentionally ruin Jake's reputation.
At the same time, Sarah and Jake embark on a journey of introspective therapy, addressing the deep-rooted causes catalyzing his dependency on powerful painkillers.
However, Ben's secret investigation comes to a horrific climax when he is mysteriously killed during an under-the-radar mission in the Middle East.
This event shakes Jake and escalates his doubts about his traumatic exit from the service.
As Jake grapples with grief and rising suspicion, an encrypted message arrives in his inbox, sent from Ben's account.
This pre-determined email confirms Jake's covert suspicions - he was deliberately set up.

Encouraged by this startling revelation, Jake is set on a path to bring the hidden injustices to light, exploring the deep-set corruption and manipulations that led to his wrongful dismissal from the army.
Touched by Jake's unwavering determination, Sarah declares she will firmly stand by his side in this dangerous quest for truth, adding her strength to his resolve.
Jake's journey into this morass of deceit and lies uncovers an increasingly treacherous network, each unturned stone bringing him closer to potential, lethal danger.
As Jake's relentless pursuit intensifies, his outings cause concern amongst high-ranking officials in the military chain of command, who respond by monitoring his every move closely.
In a thrilling turning point, Jake manages to decrypt a portion of classified files, exposing the instigators behind his disgraceful expulsion from the service.
This seemingly harmless digital detective work soon skyrockets tensions when Sarah is kidnapped by unidentified mercenaries.
A distress call to Jake demands he surrenders and ends his investigation for her life to be spared.
Driven to his limit but unwavering, Jake leans into his honed combat skills, planning an audacious mission to rescue Sarah from the clutches of her captors.
Leveraging his years of tactical military training, Jake orchestrates a stealth operation under the cloak of night.
His strategic maneuvers successfully infiltrate a fortified warehouse, leading to a victorious rescue mission.
In the heart-pounding aftermath of the rescue, they find confidential files in possession of the mercenaries.
These documents offer irrefutable proof of Jake's innocence, validating their dangerous endeavors.
Armed with decisive evidence, Jake and Sarah find themselves in a highly secretive military tribunal.
Here, they boldly expose the corrupt Major General and his associates, revealing their schemes against Jake.
The evidence sparks immediate arrests of the corrupt officials, ushering in justice for Jake's unwarranted discharge and subsequent hardships.
With this victorious twist, Jake's honor is reinstated and finally, a collective sigh of relief can be felt as the audience shares in his triumph over injustice.
As Jake embarks on rebuilding his life, he channels his personal struggles into a public platform, transforming himself into an influential motivational speaker.
Sarah, transformative in Jake's life, continues her crucial work, providing therapeutic support to struggling veterans battling PTSD and addiction.
The story concludes with a strong visual of Jake and Sarah, walking hand in hand along the serene Potomac river.
Their shared victory brings closure to this intense journey, leaving the audience applauding their resilience and unity.

62032300.title: The Contractor (2022 film)
synopsis: Sergeant First Class James Harper, a decorated Green Beret, is involuntarily discharged from the Army due to his use of illegal steroids to treat a debilitating knee injury.
Facing financial ruin, he contacts his friend Mike who works with a private military company under the command of fellow veteran Rusty Jennings.
Harper is receiving lucrative offers from similar firms, but feels a sense of duty to his country.
Mike tells him that Rusty runs clandestine operations for the Department of Defense.
Harper agrees to meet Rusty after seeing Mike's opulent house.
Harper signs on with Rusty and the team for an operation in Germany.
As a sign of good faith, Rusty gives Harper's family $50,000 to help clear their debts.
Harper spends most of his tour surveilling a Middle Eastern scientist named Salim.
After analyzing the data, Rusty informs the team that Salim is working for Al-Qaeda and developing a bio-agent.
He tells the team they have been given permission to raid Salim's laboratory and retrieve all of his research data and then dispose of Salim.
The team easily accesses the lab and acquires the data.
Mike orders Harper to finish Salim, who protests that he is just a scientist working on a cure.
Harper follows orders and then departs after setting the lab on fire, carrying Salim's laptop containing the research data.
The team are confronted by the police and after a prolonged shoot-out, during which the remaining team members are killed, Harper rescues a wounded Mike and they hide in a nearby storm drain.
Mike, believing he is about to die, begs Harper to look after his family and get the data to Rusty.
Harper provides a blood transfusion and saves Mike's life.
After recuperating, Mike is ready to return to Rusty and the main team, but Harper's knee has given out on him, and he needs to rest up.
Mike proceeds alone with Salim's laptop but informs Harper he will be picked up from a specific location after he is sufficiently rested.
Harper makes it to the hotel and finds fresh clothes and a note from Mike saying that he went to hand off the laptop.
He tries to treat his injured knee and waits for Mike to return.

When Mike doesn't come back Harper leaves the hotel, gets a burner phone, and makes contact with Rusty, who informs him there is a car waiting to exfiltrate him to safety, but Harper senses something is amiss when Rusty tells him that Mike never made it to Berlin.
As he delays going to the car, a hit team emerges and they shoot at Harper.
Harper evades capture and manages to kill the hit team, who are revealed to be former Recon Marines working for Rusty.
Before dying, one of the Marines gives Harper intel on a safe house but advises him that he can never return home.
Harper visits Salim's home, threatening Sylvie, Salim's wife, into providing him with Salim's computer files.
Sylvie gives Harper her husband's iPad, and he leaves for the safe house.
After Harper meets Virgil, he is tranquilized and awakens in the safe house.
Virgil explains that Harper's knee was infected, and that while it has been treated, Harper still cannot return to his family.

Harper plays a video on the iPad in which Salim explains that he was indeed working on a successful H5N1 vaccine formula that he intends to provide for free, rather than sell to a pharmaceutical company.
While Virgil shares dinner with Harper, another of Rusty's fire teams attacks.
Virgil is killed, but Harper escapes, setting off a booby trap for Rusty's team.
Harper returns to the United States.
He tracks down Mike, who explains that Rusty also lied to him and told him Harper had died.
Rusty has provided for Harper's family, and Mike advises Harper to disappear; Harper protests.
Winning his old friend over, they set-up a plan to get revenge on Rusty.
Mike gets Harper into Rusty's compound, where they surprise Rusty's guards.
While Mike distracts everyone with a frontal attack, Harper infiltrates Rusty's house.
Harper manages to terminate Rusty but not before Rusty has mortally wounded Mike.
Mike shares his last moments with his best friend before succumbing to his wounds and Harper burns his body with his car.
Harper is finally able to return to his family.

14459624.title: Swipe (2024 Film)
synopsis: The film begins in a scarcely lit, secretive lair where Jackson, a pioneering leader, meticulously analyzes a comprehensive blueprint of Northshore Bank, a renowned, seemingly invulnerable financial facility.
His master plan of robbing the bank slowly unfurls through a captivating series of animated schematics and charts, gradually exposing the depth and complexity of the man's ingenious intellect.
The narrative then introduces Jackson's diverse team, a ragtag bunch of specialists, each boasting unique talents and dealing with their equally unique drawbacks.
The first character to be unveiled is Blake, an adept pickpocket possessing nimble fingers made for sleight of hand.
However, his ADHD often causes him to lose focus while in the middle of planning, creating potential pitfalls in the meticulously outlined plot.
Then there's Lily, an unrivalled tech genius capable of crafting extraordinary gadgets.
However, she battles the peculiar problem of constant technical malfunctions, with her tools frequently spewing out holograms or malfunctioning in the most inconvenient of times.
Isabella, an accomplished Olympic-level gymnast, choreographs beauteous vault-busting routines with an elegance reminiscent of ballet.
However, her fear of heights creates problematic scenarios as she scrambles to remain on flat terrain.
Alex is introduced next, a man with a keen eye for detecting flaws in security systems from a significant distance.
The comic element in his character surfaces when he frequently forgets passwords, resulting in him being locked out of his own simulations.
The last member of this eclectic squad is Theodore, a locksmith fascinated with 18th-century designs.
His obsession often sees him sketching out intricate designs of antique locks, causing him to lose sight of the group's present objective.
The movie then enters its second act, the d-day of the bank heist, where comedic blunders heighten the anticipation and leaves the audience waiting for more of the team's delightful errors.
During the initiation of their mission, termed "Fortune Dance," Isabella's fear of heights inconveniently comes into play during a critical roof entry sequence.
This leads to a hilarious quick-think involving inflatable pools serving as safety nets.

Similarly, Theodore becomes so captivated by the vault's antique lock that he nearly forgets the primary objective of the mission, leading to a comically tense moment when they almost blow their cover.
Lily's alarm clock gadget decides to malfunction at the worst possible moment, breaking the intense silence with a bizarre chicken squawk, adding to the laughs.
Blake, who was tasked with evading the laser alarm grid, becomes enamored with the patterns and starts playing tic-tac-toe on them, wholly thrown off his original mission.
Alex's comic mishap involves him drawing a complete blank on his security bypass codes when tasked with cracking the mainframe code of the bank on his stylus pad, inciting panic, and more laughs.
Throughout all these comedic hiccups, Jackson's bemusement mirrors the audience's, juggling his team's blunders with the relentless passing of time.
The turn of events takes an unexpected spin when their consistent failures end up uncovering an exploitable flaw in the bank's otherwise foolproof security.
Lily's malfunctioning remote picks the perfect moment to send a random signal blast, miraculously disarming the bank's formidable vault door.
The accident's unlikely but fortunate result sends the team into fits of jubilant laughter.
Just as the team revels in their triumph, Alex's forgotten blueprint lying on a desk activates the silent alarm, instantly turning their celebrations into a clock-watching escape challenge.
In the confusion of their hurried retreat, each member unintentionally leaves behind an eccentric trademark, leading to even more intriguing plot components.
Blake, while executing a flawless somersault escape maneuver, accidentally drops his ADHD medication in the precincts of the bank.
Isabella's noticeable pink ribbon gets entangled in the enormous vault door as it grates shut during the scramble.
Theodore, intrigued by an antique Egyptian coin in the vault, absentmindedly leaves behind his gold-rimmed monocle.
Alex, in his victorious excitement, misplaces his detailed security manual in the process of stashing the loot into his bag.
Lily, trying to manage their frenzied escape, mistakenly triggers one of her dysfunctional gadgets, causing a flood of multicolored rubber ducks within the vault.

Back in their hideout, comfortable and far from the reach of law enforcement, Jackson and his team chuckle as they watch the news, relishing the delightful ruin of their unintentional diversions being deemed as deliberate masterstrokes.
Their audacious 'Fortune Dance' heist becomes an emblem of remarkable cunning and bravery as newspapers and television broadcasts worldwide feature them as a mysterious group executing grand heists.
The team, now somewhat infamous, busies themselves with games and laughs in their chic hideout.
Relaxing in their hideout, a newspaper with news of another fortified bank catches their attention.
Coincidences take on the charm of destiny.
This intriguing revelation sets the wheels in motion for a new plan, brewing a fantastic cocktail of humor, suspense and adventure, signifying that their entertaining misadventures are far from over.
Finally, the team raises their beer bottles in a unison cheer as the closing credits roll, signifying a promise of a sequel filled with more laughter, thrill, and inarguably, unexpected brilliance.

71811007.title: Lift (2024 film)
synopsis: Cyrus, a renowned international thief, leads a heist crew that consists of Denton, pilot Camila, hacker Mi-Sun, safecracker Magnus, and engineer Luke.
They undertake two simultaneous thefts, stealing a Van Gogh painting in London while staging the fake kidnapping of renowned NFT artist N8 in Venice.

The team staged a kidnapping for N8 and Cyrus points out that famous paintings rapidly increase in value after being stolen and he says that his crew stole the Van Gogh painting and sold it in the black market for $20 million to buy N8 NFTs.
After being "kidnapped", N8's NFT ballooned in value to $89 million.
N8 decides to celebrate with the team after being promised a cut of the money.
Interpol agent Abby Gladwell, a former fling of Cyrus, uncovers evidence implicating Denton, in the theft and arrests him.

Rather than proceed with charges against the crew, Abby's superior, Commander Huxley, leverages their legal predicament to force them to help capture billionaire Lars Jorgenson, who intends to make more money by working with the hacking group Leviathan to stage a massive flooding in Europe, allowing him to make billions in profit through stock manipulation.

As Leviathan requires payment in untraceable gold bullion, Jorgenson has arranged for a shipment of gold to be taken from his vault in London and flown to Leviathan's bank in Zürich via a commercial airliner.
As part of the deal for clean records for Cyrus and all his members, Cyrus insists Abby join the team to provide certain cover for Interpol.
The crew determines they will only be able to steal the gold while the airliner is in mid-air.

To do so, they procure a private jet from a rich private art collector named Molsen that Camila will fly directly underneath the airliner, allowing Mi-Sun to switch the radar signals to make it seem like the plane is still on course while the crew diverts it to a private airfield.
In exchange for loaning his private jet, Cyrus promises Molsen to persuade N8 to make a special NFT art for him.
After Magnus cracks the safe and Jorgenson's henchmen are incapacitated, the crew will extract the gold via the jet.
Their timing is complicated when Jorgenson executes a mole in his organization and moves up the delivery date.
Nevertheless, the crew is ready on time.
After successfully diverting the plane, Jorgenson's henchmen attempt an hijack, resulting in a fight on board the plane.
Magnus, Abby, Cyrus, and Camila are captured.
Magnus escapes on the ground, while the remaining three are taken aboard the jet with the gold, headed for Jorgenson's estate in Tuscany.
Desperate for the gold to not reach Jorgenson, Huxley orders the plane shot down by NATO.
Harry, the crew's contact at air traffic control, works with Camila to get a message to the pilots that there are hostages on board, forcing them to stand down.
Another fight between the crew and Jorgenson's henchmen results in the jet crash landing on the grounds of Jorgenson's villa.
Abby, Cyrus, and Camila are captured at gunpoint by Jorgenson, who also executes Leviathan's representative after they decide to cancel the deal.
The Carabinieri arrive, and Cyrus uses N8's NFT technology to show them a recording of Jorgenson murdering the representative.
Jorgenson is arrested, while Abby punches Huxley upon learning he authorized the NATO jets.
She resigns from Interpol and joins Cyrus.
Weeks later, Cyrus reveals to Abby that the crew stole the gold shipment during the heist on the airliner, replacing the actual shipment with iron bars painted to look like gold.
Together, the crew recover their gold haul and celebrate their success while Cyrus and Abby kindle their relationship.

37186038.title: Perhaps It's Yes
synopsis: Alex, an unwaveringly meticulous and dedicated corporate lawyer, based in the relentless clamour of New York, seeks his escapism in the artistry of French cinema.
The weekends for Alex are an opportunity to escape the rigidity of his professional life.
He religiously immerses himself in French classics, exploring the whimsical narratives of Jacques Tati and diving into the emotional abyss of François Truffaut.

Residing in a separate, contrasting universe, resides Olivia, a Bohemian artist known for her mesmerizing abstract paintings, who draws her fervent inspiration from the same French films Alex so deeply admires.

One usual Saturday imbued with cinematic adventures, Alex and Olivia slide their hands across the movie counter towards the same film - the 1963 French New Wave masterpiece "Le Mépris" directed by Jean-Luc Godard.
Amidst the busy theatre ambiance, they accidentally exchange each other's DVDs, perturbing their well-established movie ritual.
Still cocooned in their solitary realms, both Alex and Olivia unwittingly carry on with their weekend rituals, completely ignorant of the film swap incident.
Stumped by the peculiar confusion, they individually decide to rectify the mix-up by visiting The Lumière Theater.
To their unfortunate surprise, they find the theatre closed on Sundays.
With no other recourse, they decide to retreat into the comforting confines of 'Café du Coin' - a quaint café tailorly positioned next to the theatre.
Over a fresh cup of smooth cappuccino prepared by Jean-pierre, the café’s celebrated barista, an unexpected encounter occurs.
As they share a table, they engage in a curiously amusing conversation about the unintended movie mix-up, their mutual devotion to French cinema, and showcasing their unique perspectives on life.
The engaging exchange concludes with a mutual agreement of consciously planned movie swapping the following weekend.
Over the subsequent weekends, Alex and Olivia rendezvous again and again at Café du Coin.

Their camaraderie deepens before they venture together to The Lumière Theater, engaging in impassioned debates, sharing chuckles over cinematic conundrums, and weaving a bond over their shared passion for French films.
Each French film viewing offers fresh insights into their contrasting movie interpretations.
The intense talks forge a unique camaraderie between the corporate lawyer and the abstract artist.
Amidst whispers of shared laughter, shared boxes of crunchy popcorn, and vibrant film discussions in the dimly lit, back row of the theatre, an unforeseen bond silently strengthens their connection.
Their stark differences - once a friction point, started turning into a source of intrigue and interest.
They began appreciating each other's diverse mindsets, thereby adding more layers to their budding friendship.
Alex, entrenched in his meticulously planned life, found himself irresistibly drawn to Olivia's creative expressions and spontaneous approach, adding a new dimension to his perspective.
Olivia, finds herself admiring Alex's focused and disciplined drive towards his professional life, grounding her artistic fantasies with a realistic perspective.
What began as a chance encounter due to an unexpected mix-up of a DVD at The Lumière, started taking a romantic turn, stirring feelings of attraction and fondness they hadn't anticipated.
Each awkward mumble of an apology led to adorable revelations of affection, respect, and admiration they had begun nurturing for one another.

One starry Friday night, under the shadows of The Lumière Theatre, their contentious chemistry finally ignited, as they succumbed to their magnetic attraction while watching "Amour," a movie that mirrored their journey.

The electricity of the moment prompted them to echo the sentiment portrayed in the film’s title - "Perhaps It's Yes," leading them to explore the landscape of their burgeoning romantic feelings more openly.

Impulsively, and in a grand gesture that resonated deeply with their love for all things French, they decided to voyage into an exciting unknown - a heartfelt adventure to the land of cinematic art that connected their souls - France.
They envisioned walking through Boulogne Studios, strolling hand-in-hand along the Seine River, a sight customary in many characters of French film history.
With the anticipation of their exciting trip reaching crescendo, they sat down to curate an itinerary inspired by their favored French films.
Overcome with joy, they decided to share the exciting plan with their supportive group of friends and families.
Amidst the cheering noises and excited chatter, the couple board their Air France flight, holding hands tightly, their hearts echoing an emphatic 'Yes' to love and adventure.

As New York's towering skyline recedes behind them, they gaze ahead, their hearts swelling with anticipation, excitement, and a deep love for each other, forming an endearing chapter of their distinct love story brought alive by the enchantment of French Cinema.
As their journey takes them high across the Atlantic Ocean, they amused themselves by brainstorming possible film titles for their unique love story.

After several rounds of laughter and discussions, they find the perfect title: "Perhaps It's Yes", symbolizing their life journey that started with a simple movie mix-up at The Lumière and developed into a heartfelt romance.
As their plane soars over the Atlantic, they look at each other with irrepressible smiles, their hearts filled with certainty of their love and surrealism of the imminent adventure.

71659940.title: Maybe I Do
synopsis: We open to Sam and Grace meeting, as they are both watching a Swedish film alone.
Afterwards, they vacillate about having sex in a cheap motel.
Eventually they get a bucket of food and a six-pack, take it to the room, but spend the evening walking and talking.
Howard and Monica are staying in a hotel, and he alludes to the facts that they have been seeing each other for four months and he is married to someone else.
He is no longer interested in continuing the affair, and she gives him thinly veiled threats.
But Howard leaves nonetheless.
Finally, we see Michelle and Allen attending a wedding, where he intercepts the bouquet so Michelle cannot catch it.
She of course had fantasized it is being the idyllic start to their perfect future together.
Back at his apartment Michelle changes clothes, gives Allen a 24h ultimatum, and walks out.
Howard goes into a coffee shop after leaving Monica and a waitress and he observe a young couple.
Howard is missing his youth.
Monica leaving the hotel confronts a young female hotel clerk, pointing out how quickly people age.
Howard goes home, finding his wife Grace in the living room.
After an awkward attempt at conversation, their daughter Michelle comes in.
She brings up the ultimatum she dropped on Allen, which her mother fully supports.
Allen similarly tells his parents Sam and Monica, and his dad is pro wedding while Monica is not.
The next morning, Grace, a religious person, is watching a sermon on TV and talks back to the tv as it talks about infidelity and admitting guilt.
Horward hears the show addressing infidelity and walks back out of the kitchen without Grace knowing.
The two sets of parents continue talking to their respective children about marriage.
Both of Michelle's go on about the importance of wedding rings, symbolising commitment; the irony is both are hiding betrayal and guilt and neither happens to be wearing theirs.
Howard and Grace are surprised at why the sets of parents have never met.
They get Michelle to invite Allen and his parents to dinner.
Sam accepts although Monica does not agree.
When Allen and his parents arrive, there is extreme awkwardness although the double affairs had not come to light.
Monica goes with Howard to get the drinks, and she continues with her threat that they should continue seeing each other or she'll kill him.

Grace walks outside under the guise of showing Sam the grounds of the house and he tries to convince her that they had a strong connection, that it was fate, and that they need to pursue a relationship.
She wants to find happiness in her marriage with Howard.

Michelle and Allen continue talking the pros and cons about getting married, with the conversation ending with Michelle concluding that Allen is basing his negativity of marriage on his parents’ failing relationship.
In front of all four parents, Michelle asks Allen to trust in the now and to not fear that things could end badly, to take a leap of faith with her.
She leaves the room, and he soon follows after being encouraged by both the fathers.
Left alone, Monica spills the beans about her affair with Howard, or tries to.
Both Grace and Sam guiltily confess about meeting the previous night, and Monica smugly talks about her affair with Howard Howard begs Grace for her forgiveness.
An upset Grace goes outside, while Sam and Howard compare info about their infidelities Howard explains that theirs was purely physical whereas Sam explains theirs was purely cerebral.
They start to fight with their fists, but it soon turns into a hug.
Howard considers both his wife and Sam are better people than him.
Monica follows Grace and lets her know she thinks Howard has not gotten too lost and that their marriage could still be saved.
The men join them outside.
Howard said it was the last and only time he cheated on her, which Monica corroborates.
Grace is hurt that, instead of talking things through with her, he had sought solace in another's arms.
When she leaves in tears, Sam encourages Howard to go after her as she believes her best possible happy ending is with him.
Sam and Monica start talking once they are alone.
He says he had always felt she is more interesting than him, that she is an unstoppable force, and he has stayed because of their son.
Meeting Grace, he now sees he could love again.
Michelle and Allen write their own vows and marry.
Afterwards we see Sam and Monica in what seems like a goodbye and ending of their relationship while Howard and Grace have refound their passion for each other.

54842231.title: The Slayer: Barcelona Undercover (2023 film)
synopsis: On a balmy evening in the vibrant city of Barcelona, an ethereal figure emerges on the weather-beaten, cracked rooftop of a forgotten edifice in Girona.
This enigmatic silhouette is only known by his lethal moniker, the Slayer.

His laser-sharp gaze navigates from the amplified image in his state-of-the-art sniper scope, seamlessly shifting to feast on the simmering glow emitted from a plush suite within the renowned Ritz Carlton hotel, dwarfed by the vibrant cityscape.
The Slayer's encrypted Motorola phone springs to life, as it pulsates in his pocket.
The caller ID reveals a shroud of secrecy - the enigmatic Mr. X.
Their relationship is cloaked in professionalism, devoid of any personal connections, their identities veiled behind anonymity.
Digitized images of a feared crime lord, El Patron, alias 'The Boss' flash across the mobile screen in tandem with Mr. X’s veiled briefing - a clear instruction of assassination.

This kingpin's reign of fear extends its vipers over the beautiful city of Barcelona, a ruthless overlord tracing back to heinous acts of torture, ruthless drug trafficking, and blood-curdling murders.
The Slayer's past, a black and white reel of chilling experiences of a life he wants to leave behind, unexpectedly brims at the corner of his mind.
These blurred memories hint at traumatic experiences that he longs to repress.
Amidst this conundrum of the past, a poignant image of Maria, a mesmerizing Spanish belle clutching a heart-shaped locket, flashes before him.
Her portrait underlines a love story that the Slayer guards desperately amidst his blood-stained career.
Maria's symbolic laughter rekindles the nurturing aspect of Slayer’s life, where shedding his brutal past isn’t just a mere glimmer.
Her naive gaze draws out the assurance of a peaceful life he had solemnly promised Maria.
Resistance against performing another ruthless assassination engulfs the Slayer in a whirlwind of self-conflict.
Grinding this emotional surge into fuel, Slayer's inner turmoil spring into action, spurred by his promises to Maria.

Straddling the fence that encapsulates his unwillingness to kill yet again and the tantalizing allure of a seven-figure reward along with the possibility of starting afresh, the Slayer finds himself at a crossroads.
His mission rolls out like a merciless stub of a cigar, burned ruthily - El Patron’s fortified bodyguards, poised like a ring of iron forming an impenetrable fortress around him.
Shadowing from dilapidated buildings and executing precision profiling amidst stolen blueprints of the Ritz Carlton, the Slayer sketches out his lethal plan.
The brewing storm of suspicion in Maria's mind is evident as she grapples with the reality of the Slayer's mysterious absences and unexplained wounds.
The stress simmers over the edge, as a heated confrontation ensues in their shared apartment located in the Gothic Quarter.
She dreads the scent of gunpowder and betrayal masked and veiled behind false promises.
Although Maria braces herself for a lie, a flicker of hope pushes her to plead with the Slayer to abandon his deadly intent.
The internal battle within him is evident in her demeanour, where she lets her tears pool in her eyes, softly urging Slayer to veer away from his bloody course.
The course of the game takes an unexpected twist when a jittery local informant leaks an encoded warning to the Police about an assassination assignment set for El Patron.
The cityscape instantly metamorphoses into a tactical battlefield, the glaring lights from patrolling police cars casting ominous shadows onto the ancient city walls.
The feud turns horribly personal when El Patron's seasoned entourage kidnaps Maria, entrapping her in the Slayer's vortex.
A primal, ear-deafening roar and a deep-seeded tenacity wake within the Slayer, pushing him towards a bloodthirsty retribution.
The Slayer plots an audacious mission to save Maria, setting the expansive suite at the Ritz Carlton as his battlefield where time waits for no one.
Underneath glistening chandeliers, the Slayer manoeuvres like a shadow through guards and security cameras.
Every step he takes mirrors his deadly intentions.
The climax ensues as the Slayer wades through a heart-stopping fight - deceiving relentless police, brushing teeth with death, and hovering closer to his enemies.
Cornering El Patron in the glittering bathroom of the penthouse, the Slayer locks his exit route with a deadly gaze.

Trudging out through the smoky scene, the Slayer limps out from the gold-accented duel scene, his fresh battle scars are a testament to his title, leaving El Patron motionless amidst a storm of shattered glass.
Urgent sirens ring as the dispatched police officers swarm into the chaotic crime scene, their blue-flashing lights transforming the previously opulent suite into a turmoil-filled hurricane.
Maria's trembling arms embrace the blood-drenched Slayer, her emerald green eyes, tear-stricken, silently pleading for his survival.
Amidst the chaos, a sympathetic cop, Officer Lopez, silently assists their escape.
Even though his loyalty to the badge is paramount, the unfolding tale draws out an unusual kindness as he provides them with a nondescript black getaway van.
The Slayer whisks Maria and himself to an abandoned cathedral located on the city's bare outskirts.
Distressed and desperate, the towering bell tower stands aloof looming over their shared anguish.
Amid the silence of the cathedral, their flicker of renewed hope shrivels away as Maria and Slayer, fatigued and dwindling, collapse on the hard floor.
The morning rays break, glimpsing on the runaways resting in the back pew of the austere chapel, enmeshed within eerie fog and antique stones.

As each minute turns into an eternity of fear and uncertainty dangling on their survival, Maria and Slayer flees one more time, disappearing into the veil of thick towering pine woods located behind the cathedral.
With the vanishing criminals, the city breathes out relief.
Sultanah streets resuming their vibrancy, the collective release of the populace echoes through the city.
As the televised report fades out, a profound proclamation sits heavy in the viewers' minds.
A beacon of a fresh start for Maria and Slayer, released from the shackles of their fraught past highlights the dawn of a new era.

66888017.title: The Killer (2023 film)
synopsis: A professional assassin known only as the Killer stakes out a Parisian hotel room.
He prepares to use a sniper rifle to kill a target who will check into the hotel room at an unknown time.
While waiting for the target, he eats, practices yoga, listens to music, and talks on the phone with his handler, an attorney, and his former university law professor, Edward "Eddie" Hodges.
The target arrives with a dominatrix and the Killer shoots but misses, accidentally shooting the dominatrix.
He flees, evading the police and disposing of his equipment.
He then flies to the United States.
The Killer returns to his hideout in the Dominican Republic to find it has been broken into and his girlfriend Magdala has been attacked.
She is in the ICU of a hospital, with her brother watching over her.
He says that Magdala was interrogated and tortured by two assassins but managed to injure one of them and escape.
The Killer tracks down Leo, the taxi driver who drove the assassins to the Killer's home by breaking into the company he works for.
Leo identifies one of the assassins, a strong man with a limp leg, nicknamed "The Brute", and a woman who resembled a Q-Tip, known as "The Expert".
The Killer shoots Leo and seeks to track down the two assassins.
The Killer travels to Hodges' office in New Orleans, Louisiana, and enters the building disguised as a custodian.
After forcing Dolores, Hodges' secretary, to restrain her boss and herself, the Killer destroys their electronics.
As Hodges attempts to get the Killer to leave, the Killer shoots him in the chest with a nail gun to torture the names of the hitmen out of him.
However, Hodges doesn't reveal the information and dies quicker than the Killer anticipated.

Dolores offers to show the Killer the assassins' identities in her paper files in her home, asking in return that the Killer give her a non-suspicious death so her children can claim a life insurance payout.
After receiving the names at her home, the Killer breaks his rule not to show empathy, he snaps her neck and shoves her down a flight of stairs, making her death look like an accident.
He then disposes of Hodges' body.
The Killer drives to St. Petersburg, Florida, where he confronts the Brute, whom he identifies by his limp.

At night, he breaks into the Brute's home to kill him, but he is blindsided and tackled, ensuing a fight during which the Brute realizes who the Killer is before the Killer shoots him and sets his house on fire with a Molotov cocktail.
The Killer travels to Beacon, New York, and confronts The Expert "Q-Tip" assassin in a gourmet restaurant.
Appearing to accept her fate, the Expert offers to share with him a "last supper" of whiskey, during which she questions the Killer's motivations.

They leave the restaurant and go to a park, and after the Expert appears to slip down a small flight of ice-covered stairs, the Expert asks the Killer to help her up, but the Killer shoots her, revealing that she was concealing a knife.
The Killer travels to Chicago, to kill billionaire venture capitalist Henderson "Clay" Claybourne.
He uses tools bought on Amazon to enter his penthouse.
Confronting him, the Killer demands to know why he ordered the assassins to come after him.
Claybourne says that he has no personal problem with him and, as a first-time client of a hitman, agreed to pay Hodges for "the trail to be scrubbed".
The Killer spares Claybourne, but he promises him a slow death if Claybourne ever targets him again.
The Killer returns to the Dominican Republic and sits next to a recovering Magdala.

20509341.title: Young Southern Heavyweight
synopsis: Sammy, a ten-year-old boy living in the destitution of Corvinton shantytown slum, woke at each dawn to the monotonous singles of a rooster, commencing another relentless day of survival.

As dawn broke over the slum, he would embark on arduous tasks, carrying two dilapidated buckets of water from the community well, repairing flimsy asbestos roofs with ancient tools, and dedicating himself to back-breaking labor for a meager reward - a neglected nickel or dime.

Back in their ramshackle three-room home, his younger siblings, barely seven and six, made the most of their education from a single dilapidated textbook, a consignment of underwhelming governmental efforts.
Meanwhile, his mother, the delicate Rhoda, commenced each grueling day with hushed prayers to a deity she believed was attentive to her pleas, hoping for an end to their dire circumstances.
One evening, an altercation among local delinquents obstructed Sammy's path home.
Trapped, he found himself drawn into the turmoil, his innate survival instincts ultimately resolving the tense situation.
His unforeseen bravery caught the attention of dangerous men involved in the local illegal boxing league - hidden figures in the slum world of Corvinton.
Unable to ignore a potential route away from life in the slums, Sammy, more anticipation than trepidation, stepped into a dingy, improvised boxing ring.
Fueling his bouts with raw, desperate energy, Sammy started to rack up a trail of victories that only ensnared him deeper into the violent world of underground boxing.

Mike Walsh, a once-famous prizefighter now overshadowed by lost opportunities and desolate dreams, observed Sammy's amateur boxing career from the tattered sidelines, seeing potential in the desperate boy.
Throwing Sammy a lifeline, Mike offered him a mentorship in fighting.
It was the promise of an opportunity for Sammy to escape the crushing poverty of the slums.
However, this newfound direction in life was met with vehement resistance at home.
Sammy's mother, Rhoda, emphasized that remaining part of this fighting world would only exacerbate their despair.
Dismissing his mother's emotional pleas, Sammy committed himself to a course with Mike, creating a challenging mentorship that nurtured his raw capabilities into finesse.
Through Mike's rigorous training and strategic insights, Sammy earned recognition beyond the slum, his natural talent refined into a formidable art.
Each resounding victory in the boxing ring slowly tapered their past experiences of hunger and debt into vague memories, each subsequent fight win propelling them out of their destitution.
But just when rays of hope began to penetrate their grim existence, life struck a devastating blow.
Sammy's vivacious younger brother, Caleb, succumbed to a nasty bout with pneumonia.
The high cost of medical intervention remained a far-off dream, even with Sammy's burgeoning fight earnings.
Faced with this painfully harsh reality, Sammy found himself pushed to extremes, resorting to a perilous path in an attempt to save his brother.
He signed up for a notoriously lethal boxing match with monumentally high stakes, its reputation known far beyond the underground circuits of Manhattan.
Emerging from the barbaric match covered in blood, Sammy was not only severely injured but also penniless.
He had lost the fight and his only chance to save Caleb.
Adding to his woes, his devastating defeat cost him a golden opportunity at the statewide boxing heavyweight title.
Carrying the burden of broken dreams and physical pain, Sammy trudged home to Rhoda, whose disappointment and sorrow were more wounding than any physical impairment.
Sammy wagered everything and yet gained nothing - his prize money had evaporated, Caleb was nearing death, and his mother's faith in him was shattered.
Drowning in guilt and despair one morning, he woke in their crumbling shack to the heart-shattering news - Caleb had lost his battle with pneumonia.
The grim reality of his loss clouded Sammy's vision, making him question his future in boxing, the only solace he had from the realities of slum life.
Confiding in Mike over his uncertainties, Sammy listened to Mike's tales of personal regret and the downward spiral that sank his promising career prematurely.
The melancholic story stirred something within Sammy and sparked a reflection on his boxing career and personal life.
Encouraged by his mother's disappointed pleas, comforted by prayers, Sammy returned to the worn-out gym, setting himself on a path of redemption and perseverance.
Hours slipped into days, and days into weeks as Sammy once again immersed himself in training with renewed spirit and determination sparked by his loss.
Ultimately, Sammy once again found himself under the dazzling lights of the statewide boxing arena, surrounded by a lively crowd buzzing with excitement.
His cocky opponent, Steven "Iron Knuckles" Green - the arrogant reigning champion, was quick to belittle Sammy's humble origin, snidely dismissing Sammy's place in the ring with him.
Provoked by the insults and the unfair reality of his circumstances, Sammy channeled his anger, his pain, his sorrow into the battle amid the electrifying atmosphere of the crowded arena.
Their furious fists collided with explosive force, their unwavering spirits locked in a duel of dignity and determination - each aiming to claim the prestigious championship.
The showdown was intense, pushing both fighters to their limits, testing their mental fortitude and physical stamina.
Yet, against insurmountable odds, Sammy defied the impossible and emerged victorious.
His win signified a redemption arc, a badge of resilience, and an unexpected rise to prominence.
An unexpected hero of the Corvinton Slum, Sammy lifted the golden championship belt high, his eyes glistening with gratified tears reflected in the victory belt.
In the crowd, his mother Rhoda was overcome with emotion.
Her tears flowed freely down her worn-out face, rejoicing at her faith in Sammy, which had now been restored.
Sammy, the boy once confined to fetching water in bare feet in the shanty, now basked in his triumph as a beacon of hope and embodiment of unyielding determination.
Trampling over societal prejudices and expectations, Sammy demonstrated that one’s humble beginning doesn't dictate the future.
His momentous victory was not solely his own.
It represented Caleb's unfulfilled dreams, whose presence was deeply missed, yet felt with every victory lap.
The laurels he earned extended beyond personal acknowledgment; it resonated within Rhoda, within the heart of every slum resident, within the contagious spirit of Caleb.
The attained success brought fame, but more importantly, it created an avenue for financial security - a reality alien to his family's previous life.

Sammy set aside a part of his winnings to establish The Caleb Foundation in honor of his late brother, ensuring that the children of the slum received proper education and a chance to break free from their cycle of poverty.
Caleb's dreams found expression within others, his nonexistence marked by an enduring legacy invoked every time a slum child huddled over a textbook in the newly established learning center.
With his newfound managerial status, Sammy started to lobby actively for improved facilities, including clean water and better healthcare services within the shanty.
From a neglected street urchin moonlighting as a water carrier to an international icon serving as a beacon of hope, Sammy's trajectory was uplifting and inspiring.
Upon reflection, he realized that boxing had not arisen chaos in his life, as his mother had anticipated; instead, it unveiled a world of untapped possibilities and transformative change.
From his fresh intervention in a neighborhood clash to the thunderous applause filling the state's largest boxing arena, Sammy understood boxing was, indeed, his destiny.
Amid the cacophony of adulation, Sammy clutched his championship belt, a triumphant tear escaping his eyes as he relished his sudden metamorphosis.
No longer was he the overlooked barefoot boy wandering the rough streets of Corvinton, but was now a recognized face.

Now standing tall as a heavyweight champion, Sammy wasn't just a beacon for the inhabitants of the shantytown, he became the shared voice of anyone who believed in his journey, sharing his struggles and dreams of victory.

72911737.title: Big George Foreman
synopsis: A young George Foreman lives in poverty in Houston, Texas with his siblings and his religious mother Nancy.
Foreman, however, is riddled with anger issues and violent outbursts.
As a young adult, Foreman barely evades arrest for mugging and decides to join the Job Corps as a last-ditch effort to turn his life around.
There, he befriends his roommate Desmond Baker, however his violent outbursts nearly get him expelled.
However, the Job Corps' chairman Doc Broadus, a boxing trainer, encourages Foreman to take up boxing and channel his rage into the sport instead of fighting.
Foreman proves to be gifted in the sport and after one year of boxing, he wins the gold medal for the United States against Jonas Čepulis at the 1968 Summer Olympics.

He moves to Oakland, California to train, where former champions Dick Sadler and Archie Moore join his team as trainers, and he meets journalist Paula, whom he starts a relationship with and eventually marries.
Doc, Paula and Desmond are by his side as Foreman's career flourishes, ultimately winning a fight against Joe Frazier in 1973 and becoming the heavyweight champion.
Following his win, Foreman hires Desmond to handle his finances.
Foreman's career enables him to live lavishly, however he regularly cheats on Paula with other women and he is dismissive over his mother's attribution of his successes as blessings from God.
Foreman is heavily taunted by Muhammad Ali, whom he fights at The Rumble in the Jungle in 1974, where he loses his belt due to Ali's rope-a-dope strategy.
Foreman fires Sadler and Moore, and Paula divorces Foreman due to his infidelity.
Following an embarrassing Foreman vs. Five match where he is further mocked by Ali, he is called to the hospital where his sister Mary's newborn baby is in poor health.
Witnessing his family praying for the baby, Foreman goes outside and angrily prays to God for a sign, offering himself instead of the baby's life.
The baby is miraculously saved, and Mary names her son after her brother.

After losing to Jimmy Young in 1977, Foreman suffers from a heatstroke and collapses from exhaustion, having near-death experience where he finds himself in a place of nothingness and says that he finally believes before waking up.
He becomes a devout Christian and disavows boxing to become a full-time preacher, much to the delight of Nancy and the disappointment of Doc.
He makes amends with Ali and Paula for his past behavior towards them.
At church, he meets and pursues a relationship with fellow believer Mary Joan Martelly.
Years later, Foreman has married Mary Joan and started a family with her.
He is a preacher at the Church of the Lord Jesus Christ, and opened a youth community center to help troubled youth.
However, in 1985, he realizes the center is in danger of being closed down after finding out he is in debt due to Desmond mishandling his funds.
Nancy tells him that despite losing everything, all he needs is already inside him, and he decides to forgive Desmond after confronting him.
Foreman's attempts capitalize on his earlier fame is not enough to save the center.
He reluctantly decides to return to boxing to earn money, and with Mary Joan and Doc's encouragement, he trains to get back in shape and decides to start his career again from the bottom.
Rejecting his prior rage for a more positive outlook, Foreman manages to win several fights and enters a match against Evander Holyfield.
Although he loses to Holyfield, the payments from the fight - as well as a profitable deal involving grills - are enough to pay his debts and reopen the center.
He works his way up to a match against reigning champion Michael Moorer, which he wins and regains his title as heavyweight champion of the world.
Foreman reflects that he had to be knocked down to the bottom to realize everything he was searching for was already there.

An epilogue shares that Foreman had become close friends with Ali; Doc was inducted in the World Boxing Hall of Fame in 1998; and Foreman continues to preach at his church and run his youth center in Houston.

65333595.title: Unanchored Ambitions: The Solo Voyage
synopsis: The film dramatically opens with Sarah, a lively and ambitious young sailor from Boston, soaking up the rays on a sandy beach, her eyes intently gazing through her binoculars at luxurious yachts skimming the harbor's water.
We see Sarah skillfully commandeer her personal 8-foot yacht decked in the nautical apparel splashes of water on her face accentuating her unwavering passion for sailing.

After tying the knots on her rigorous training course for the day, Sarah navigates her way back to her snug Boston loft, where she stumbles upon an intriguing hardcover book detailing the impressive adventures of Jessica Watson, a precocious 16-year-old Australian sailor.

Spellbound, Sarah dives into the enchanting literature that narrates Jessica's audacious solo sailing journey around the globe in her 34-foot yacht named Ella’s Pink Lady, her journey igniting an audacious dream within Sarah.
She can't help but envision herself embarking on a similar journey, captivated by the daunting winds, tempestuous waters, and seemingly endless expanse of water that Jessica braved.
Animatedly, Sarah reveals her newfound aspiration of surpassing Jessica's record of maritime courage to her family at a convivial dinner in their preferred local Italian trattoria.

Her parents, prominent physicians in Boston's prominent medical community, mask their initial shock with fleeting smiles and continue eating, silently struggling to reconcile their desire for her safety with their daughter's dream filled with unknown dangers.
Sarah, undeterred, excitedly unveils her ambitious plan during lunch at school.
However, her peers laugh at her audacity, dubbing it a childlike daydream and posing Sarah in a new challenge to prove them wrong.
Sarah embarks on a rigorous self-preparation journey for her ambitious round-the-world venture, enduring the echoes of doubt from her family and friends.
Her days and nights merge into a blur of map-reading, weather pattern studies, and enhancing her sailing acumen.
Sarah finally sets sail from the busy Boston Harbor amidst a swirling mix of spectators' cheers and reservations.

While crossing the Atlantic Ocean, Sarah hits record on her compact vlogging camera each day, cataloging her struggles with turbulent weathers, unexpected technical glitches, and her moments of joy during sunrises.

Tragedy strikes as Sarah's yacht becomes the target of an Atlantic storm, devastating her deck and rendering her navigational equipment useless, essentially severing her lifeline of communication with the world.

Sarah's sudden disconnection after updating the world on the incoming storm ignites global concern and widespread fear for her safety, casting her exciting journey under the spotlight of international media.
Despite the setbacks, Sarah manages to repair her weather-stricken yacht after grueling hours of manual labor and reconnects with the world leaving them in amazement.
Her father finally manages to arrange a meeting with maritime safety officials in a desperate plea for his daughter's safety.
They strongly suggest recalling Sarah, emphasizing the extreme dangers that might still lie ahead.
With a conflicted mindset heavily tipped towards fear for Sarah's wellbeing, her dad makes a painful decision to resist their apprehensions and honor his daughter's adventurous spirit.
However, an enormous Antarctic ice barrier introduces an unexpected challenge in Sarah's plans, causing her to anchor down her yacht, and adding to her already immense mental toll.

As her food supplies decrease ominously with each passing day and the unforgiving Antarctic cold gnawing at her morale, Sarah starts seeing vivid hallucinations, challenging her mental and physical endurance.

Drawing international sympathy and unrivaled media attention, countries across the globe extend their support in the form of periodic airdrops of supplies, standing in solidarity with Sarah's seemingly unsurmountable challenge.
Her father addresses the world with a tear-strained face and choked voice, appealing for continued unity and support that Sarah manages to hear on her yacht radio.
Sarah, inspired by her father's heartfelt plea and the global support, summons her dwindling strength to outlast the relentless cold, waiting for the monstrous ice barrier to thaw.
On the bright side, the stubborn Antarctic barrier finally succumbs to the relentlessness of the summer sun, providing amicable conditions for Sarah to pick up her journey.
Sarah, taking in the breathtaking beauty of her Antarctic vista, restarts her journey.
The world watches with bated breath as she sails through her final leg across the Pacific, her closing distance from the record creating ripples of hope and inspiration.

The audience worldwide explodes into cheers and applause as Sarah crosses the invisible finish line near the Statue of Liberty, realizing her dream of becoming the youngest person to solo sail around the world.
The prodigious sailor Sarah returns to her Boston homecoming and is greeted by a grand hero's tribute.
Amid a shower of confetti, Sarah leaps into her family's open arms at the harbor, their long-awaited reunion stamping an unforgettable impression on the city's collective memory.

The film wraps up on a high note with Sarah, addressing an army of international press at the Boston Harbor, sharing her incredible voyage, and inspiring budding sailors to chase their dreams, no matter how the world perceives them.

72920456.title: True Spirit (film)
synopsis: In 2009, 16-year-old Jessica Watson dreams of becoming the youngest person to circumnavigate the globe non-stop and unassisted, which means she must sail alone and not dock at any port along the way.
The journey is estimated to take 200 days, and she must cross the equator and all Meridians of longitude.
Her team consist of her parents, three siblings, and her coach Ben Bryant: a disgraced, former competitive sailor.
When on her boat, Ella's Pink Lady, Jessica communicates with the team via satellite phone.
On a test run, Jessica's boat is hit by a 63,000 tonne cargo ship that strayed off course.
She didn't notice the oncoming ship because she forgot to turn on her alert system before going to bed.
The accident raises skepticism among the media as to whether Jessica can safely achieve her goal.
Her parents are also worried, but continue to support her ambitions.
Jessica sets off on her journey from Sydney, and things go smoothly until she encounters her first big storm.
Deciding to ride it out, Jessica lowers her sail and retreats to her cabin.
The waves are so violent that she is knocked unconscious and doesn't awake until the next morning.
Her parents fear she is concussed, but Jessica assures them she's fine and continues her trip.
A period of "dead calm" occurs and Jessica's boat remains stationary for a week.
During this time, she suffers from depression and loneliness.
She has a heated argument with Ben and cruelly reminds him that, while competing in the New Zealand Millennium Cup, one of his crew members died under his command.
He angrily quits the project in response.
Jessica's mother encourages her frustrated daughter to lift her spirits by singing David Bowie's "Starman" while looking at the brightest star in the sky.
The wind returns and Jessica continues her journey.
She eventually nears Australia and is about one thousand miles from Sydney.
Before she can reach home, she encounters three storms that merge.
Ben returns and advises her to alter the route, effectively abandoning her official circumnavigation.
Jessica refuses to give up and choses to ride it out.
The storm proves to be far more violent than the last one.
The Pink Lady capsizes and is thrust 15 feet (4.5 meters) underwater.
This sets off the boat's emergency locator beacon, and the team believes Jessica may have drowned.
The Pink Lady, however, resurfaces and rights herself.
Jessica informs her family that she and the boat are safe.
She returns to Sydney Harbor, 210 days after she left.
Her team and a crowd spectators are there to welcome her home.
The epilogue reveals that Jessica was named the 2011 Young Australian of the Year, has written two books despite having dyslexia, and is still an avid sailor.

11162531.title: Someone I Once Recognized
synopsis: Brooke, a woman of class and poise, a seasoned professional always vigilant about her responsibilities, maintains an unassailable reputation as the executive producer of a high stakes baking competition reality TV show known as "Sweets Paradise."
Over the years, she has meticulously crafted an enviable legacy of perfecting every episode, fussing over the minutest of details to ensure a superbly choreographed, engaging experience for viewers.
However, the landscape of the show business is ruthless and volatile.

Amid changing viewer preferences leaning away from elaborate, sophisticated recipes towards simplistic, Pinterest-inspired DIY recipes, "Sweets Paradise" suddenly witnesses a precipitous plunge in viewer engagement.
The situation sounds an alarm bell among the network's board members who frantically convene an emergency meeting.
They put forth a chilling ultimatum before Brooke—either she metamorphosizes "Sweets Paradise" into a fresh, innovative spectacle or prepares to accept an impending shutdown.

Confronted with this daunting task that threatens to upend her traditionally structured routine, Brooke germinates a frantic search for out-of-the-box ideas aimed at reinvigorating the show's rapidly fading magic.
As she navigates the labyrinthine hallways of the studio, Brooke comes across a long-ignored closet containing a box filled with DVDs of previous episodes.
Sifting through the faded disc cases, she stumbles upon footage of Adam, a former contestant whose entertaining and comical culinary exploits had once lit up the show's stage.
Destiny throws a surprising curveball her way when she accidentally bumps into a much less camera-ready, life-battered Adam at the local Café Mocha.
This unexpected meeting sparks an intriguing idea in Brooke's mind.

Seeing a golden opportunity to tap into the nostalgia of the show's past glory, Brooke plots a strategic move to bring back Adam, the fan-favorite former contestant, as the pivotal element of the prospective revamped show—a move she believes could bolster "Sweets Paradise" ratings.

With well-honed negotiation tactics she has acquired in her profession, Brooke painstakingly works on convincing a visibly uncertain Adam, dangling the carrot of renewed public recognition and a sizeable paycheck.
Adam finally caves in but introduces a startling caveat—his aging apartment in Los Angeles is under an extensive fumigation process, and he urgently requires temporary accommodation.

Squashing her instincts of impeccable orderliness, Brooke agrees to let Adam temporarily occupy her meticulously arranged abode—a pristine two-bedroom condo nestled in the plush Hollywood neighborhood.
A decision that leaves her with a twinge of latent irritation.
Their cohabitation resembles a tumultuous scene from an eccentric sitcom.

With Brooke embodying the epitome of perfectionism and Adam boasting a carefree, haphazard lifestyle, their shared living quarters are frequently fraught with arguments about misplaced utensils, overcooked meals, and a relentless battle of contrasting personalities.
On set, they manage to maintain a veneer of professionalism, with their heated interactions adding an edge to the show and successfully catching viewers' interest.
As a result, "Sweets Paradise" takes its first uplifting steps towards recovering its dwindling ratings.
However, Brooke's optimism meets a stumbling block when she observes Adam's once fiery culinary prowess has visibly decreased due to his extended hiatus from the kitchen.
Subsequent attempts by Adam yield a series of disastrous on-set performances.

His unsuccessful attempts at whip up tantalizing recipes culminate in a devastating scene when a much-anticipated tiramisu caves in, cupcakes turn into overbaked messes, and a soufflé obstinately refuses to rise.
However, a culinary disaster strikes in the form of an attempted late-night treat of fried chicken that triggers a minor fire in Brooke's precious kitchen.
This chaos incites Brooke to draw her boundary and abruptly cut short their living arrangement.
In the ensuing silence and absence of Adam's spontaneous antics, Brooke confronts an unexpected emptiness.
Her daily routine, once so admired and cherished for its precision, now seems unbearably monotonous devoid of Adam's infectious laughter.

As the anticipation builds up for the grand finale of "Sweets Paradise," broadcasted on national television, Brooke nervously monitors the audience's reaction from her polished glass-booth overseeing the studio.

In a masterstroke of spontaneity, Adam, defying all conventions on live television, abruptly kneels in front of Brooke, revealing a sparkling diamond ring and formally announces his marriage proposal.
This unexpected twist sends a colossal wave of surprise throughout millions of viewers riveted to their televisions.

Amidst the spiraling on-stage chaos, Brooke manages to utter a tear-choked 'yes,' stirring uproarious applause from the audience and taking the unprecedented season finale to a hilariously delightful end.
The sensational proposal episode, complete with the kitchen fire and diamond ring mishap, becomes the talk of the town.
Major news networks scramble to cover the event, turning "Sweets Paradise" into an overnight sensation worldwide.

This unexpected engagement paves the way for an exciting new chapter in the story of "Sweets Paradise," promising previously unimaginable possibilities and compelling storylines for the upcoming season.

As their off-screen romance tides into on-stage camaraderie, Brooke and Adam decide to modify the concept of "Sweets Paradise," repurposing it to reflect a more laid back, humorous cooking reality show.
The network, initially skeptical about the dramatic overhaul, eventually gives Brooke and Adam the go-ahead, fueled by the renewed popularity of the show following the unforgettable season finale.

From being a hair's breadth away from cancellation, "Sweets Paradise" gradually rises from the ashes to become the network's crown jewel, triumphantly reclaiming its past glory and bagging top-ratings.

As they navigate through the rollercoaster journey marked with unforgettable culinary disasters and bursts of laughter, Brooke and Adam discover their feelings for each other blossoming into something deeper.
Powering their journey through life post their accidental engagement is the burgeoning love they share.
This relationship becomes their compass, helping them embrace the romantic chaos that their lives have morphed into.
Gradually, their behind-the-scenes disagreements evolve into the playful banter, providing substantial proof of their blossoming intimacy and mutual understanding.
United by their shared experiences on and off set, they learn to accept each other wholeheartedly.
Their bond deepens with each passing day, amplifying their everyday drama into a shared adventure filled with laughter and affection.
Throughout their unconventional journey marked by unforeseen circumstances and rollercoaster emotions, they learn the art of embracing love in places least expected.

As Brooke adjusts her executive producer's cap and braves the storm, she finds special comfort in Adam's presence, who had miraculously transformed from an overlooked former contestant to her life partner.
In each episode of the rejuvenated "Sweets Paradise," their love story finds subtle moments of acknowledgement.
From the eye-catching banner with the words "Strangers, Professionals, Sweethearts!"
to the shared grins and loving glances on set, the show becomes a testament to their remarkable love story.

While the show continues to bask in international accolades and entertaining millions around the world, for Brooke and Adam, it is more than a mere television program—it is a distinct timeline of their unique love story, their journey from strangers to halves of a whole.

Amidst their daily lives garnished with dustings of flour and smears of frosting, their accidentally wound romance blooms beautifully, fundamentally transforming their lives and leaving them deeply in love amidst a professionally chaotic, personally cozy kitchen.

68604865.title: Somebody I Used to Know
synopsis: Ally is the showrunner of a successful, but waning, reality TV series called Dessert Island.
After filming the season's final episode, she is informed that the show will be cancelled.
With no social life outside work, Ally decides to take a break and visit her mother in Leavenworth, Washington.
At a bar in her hometown, she runs into an ex-boyfriend, Sean.
They spend the night drinking together, and kiss in the car when Sean drops her home.
Sean refuses Ally's invitation for sex, and she leaves awkwardly.
Later that day, Ally visits Sean's house with the intent to apologize for the incident, but learns that he is getting married that weekend and his family is throwing a party.
Ally tries to leave, but Sean's mother Jojo insists she attend the wedding to film it.
Ally learns that Sean's fiancée, Cassidy, is alienated from her parents.
She feels suspicious about her, and gets her assistant, Kayla, to dig up information about Cassidy's family.
Meanwhile, a streaming platform is interested to renew Dessert Island for another season and wants to interview Ally.
Cassidy is uneasy about Ally's presence at wedding parties.
She performs with her punk rock band at a bar, and later shares a table with Ally to talk about Sean.
Cassidy tells Ally that she plans to stop touring with her band to settle down with Sean after marriage.
Ally notices that she is unhappy about this.
Kayla finds information about Cassidy's parents, and Ally asks her to send them an anonymous invitation to the wedding.
When Ally and Cassidy spend more time with each other, Ally realizes her impression of her was mistaken.
They bond over common interests, even ending up streaking together on a golf course after smoking cannabis.
Sean is distracted by their growing closeness.
On the eve of the wedding, Cassidy is surprised to see her parents.
Ally does not confess to inviting them, leading Cassidy to blame Sean for it and call off the wedding.
At their hotel, Ally tries to correct her mistake by getting Sean and Cassidy to understand each other better.
Sean realizes he is suppressing Cassidy's career and apologizes.
Meanwhile, Ally takes the blame for inviting Cassidy's parents, and Cassidy reneges on cancelling the wedding.
Ally leaves the event permanently and returns to her mother's house, where they have a heart-to-heart about being one's true self.
Ally leaves for Los Angeles, but makes a pact to visit more often.
Dessert Island is picked up for another season, but Ally passes showrunning duties on to Kayla.
She chooses to focus on her interests, picking up another show instead, which centers around the topic of nudism.

70212717.title: Dog Person (film)
synopsis: Susan, an intelligent and exceedingly observant young woman attending her sophomore year studying Zoology at Sydney University, is financially independent.
She efficiently balances her hefty academic load with a part-time job at the oldest movie house in her small town, simply named, 'Cinema Paradiso.'
On an otherwise uneventful Tuesday afternoon, her work shift involves an overwhelming task of meticulously sorting through an accumulated pile of returned nature documentaries.
Among the heap, a distinctive title, "Dog Person," embossed in black letters against a soft shade of pale-green DVD case catches her eye.
She unearths a fascinating clue that a certain Alex, an introverted and lonesome man in town, had heavily patronized this documentary.
Intrigued by the distinct title and the continuous rental pattern associated with Alex, Susan arranges her schedule, to watch the documentary that very evening after her shift ends.

The documentary titled “Dog Person” presents an elaborate discussion about an ancient folklore ... a monstrous creature called Lycanthrope, which possesses an eerie ability to change back and forth between a harmless domestic dog and a human.
This unexpected revelation arouses Susan's deep-rooted academic curiosity and keeps her hooked.
