Completing the unusual documentary leaves an odd, uneasy sensation in Susan's mind.
As days pass, she begins to notice a series of oddities in Alex’s behavior, almost dog-like in their nature.
He becomes inexplicably aggressive, particularly during full-moon nights, eerily similar to the lore discussed in the documentary.
Troubled by her discovery, she confides in Mike, her bespectacled best friend who is known for his geeky fascination with folklore and a shared passion for solving unexplained mysteries.

Inspired by a common goal of unveiling the truth, they embark on a tantalizing journey spanning the town's municipal archives strewn with cobwebs, an ancient and dust-laden town library, and engrossing conversations with elderly townfolk who narrate centuries-old tales.
The common thread to a series of unsolved disappearances that had plagued their town over the century unravels itself to Susan and Mike.
Every twenty years, the town was gripped by a mysterious absence of one of its residents, which disturbingly coincided with sightings of a blood-curdling, red-eyed hound.
Overwhelmed but undeterred, Susan and Mike make up their minds to confront Alex.

The sight that awaits them freezes their blood - they witness Alex writhing in agony, his body morphing and contorting into a giant, menacing black werewolf, eerily indicative of the ancient tales recounted in the documentary.
Pulsating with fear, they seek shelter in Susan's rustic wooden house.
Making sure every entrance and window is firmly bolted, they can only listen as the beast prowls outside under a foreboding moonlit sky.
A crucial detail about the myth from the documentary suddenly surfaces in Susan’s mind - the creature’s unbearable sensitivity to ultrasonic sound frequencies.
Holding on to glimmers of hope, Susan calls upon her furry friend, Buddy, a well-trained Labrador Retriever.

Equipped with newly devised strategies, a hastily constructed ultrasonic device, and Buddy at her side, Susan braces herself to step into a grim battleground - a terrain of danger she had never fathomed.
The climactic confrontation is set in the remote outskirts of the town, in an abandoned town square bathed in a ghostly glow of flickering street lamps.
Battling her innate fear of the spectral creature before her, Susan musters the courage to face the werewolf, steeled by her affection for Mike and the lives that hang in the balance of her bravery.
With the monstrous creature subdued, tension and terror dissipate, replaced by a collective sigh of relief that echoes through the tiny town.
The battle extracts a substantial toll on Susan, her mind filled with post-traumatic stress.
But instead of retreating, she decides to continue her exploration into uncharted realms of legends, myths, and mysterious folklore.
Her victory imbibes a newfound zest in Susan to protect her fellow townsfolk.

In the aftermath of her perilous experience, she makes a solemn vow - to ensure her town is never victim to such a terrifying mythical encounter, and she will stand as the safeguard in such dire times.
As the tale reaches its conclusion, the aftermath reveals a different side to Susan – returning to the everyday hustle of her university life but with a significant twist.
Once an ordinary student, she's now a survivor of an extraordinary journey - embodying the fearless spirit of a warrior.

69021058.title: Cat Person (film)
synopsis: College sophomore, Margot, works at a local movie theater.
Her roommate, Taylor, moderates a feminist subreddit called “The Vagenda”, and tends to see the worst in men.
Margot begins dating a frequent visitor of the movie theater, Robert.
Margot begins to imagine Robert violently attacking her.
After their first official date, Robert learns Margot is only 20.
They are turned away from a bar and return to his house to have sex.
Throughout the encounter, Margot speaks to a second version of herself.
Her other self tries to convince her to tell Robert she changed her mind.
Instead, Margot has sex with him and fakes an orgasm, telling her other self she’s afraid of violent retaliation.
She finds out Robert is 33, and notes that the house has no sign of the cat he mentioned in his texts.
Margot debates whether or not to ghost Robert and imagines him dying in various ways.
Taylor steals Margot’s phone and texts him “I’m not interested please stop texting.” Robert initially takes this well, but later sends Margot a barrage of misogynistic messages and calls her a whore.
Later, Margot realizes Robert is following her.
She reports this to the police, who say he technically isn’t breaking the law, but advised to contact the reporting officer if she has more solid evidence.
Margot considers buying a taser, and the salesperson suggests she buy a gun.
She ends up buying tracking devices to see if Robert is actually stalking her.
While planting the tracking device in Robert’s car, she comes face to face with a dog - the same dog she saw  to bring inside the dorm in the beginning of the film.
She realizes that Robert had been following her before they met.
Robert hears the commotion and comes into the garage to investigate, discovering Margot.
Margot gets sprayed with pepper spray and hits her head on the garage floor, leaving her unconscious.
When she regains consciousness, she finds herself inside Robert’s house.
Robert explains that he stalked her before they began dating, and they begin to argue.

He planned to drug Margot to induce memory loss and drop her off at her dorm, out of fear that if she escaped, she would alter the story to be in her favor, which could possibly lead to Robert getting arrested.
Margot tries to escape, but Robert drags her back inside and a physical struggle ensues.
During the struggle, Margot opens a door that leads to the basement, and a cat escapes, which means Robert didn’t lie about having cats after all.
They continue to fight and they both end up falling down the basement stairs.
During the fall, a space heater is knocked over and starts a fire.
Robert climbs into his house’s cistern to avoid the flames and Margot hesitates before joining him.
Both survive the fire.
Margot wakes up in the hospital and eventually recovers.
She was told Robert left town and didn’t leave a way for anyone to contact with him.
After Margot returns to work at the movie theater, a new man hits on her in the same way Robert did.

56144416.title: Sleepwalker's Lament
synopsis: The narrative unfolds in the frost-bitten, hushed town of Eugene, Oregon in the icy grips of winter in 1995.
The narrative starts in an ivy-clad Victorian household, surrounded by a deafening silence, punctuated only by the whimpering of a child.
Here, Ethan, a blond-haired four-year-old angel, huddles helplessly under his bed late one frosty night; his limbs crippled, his voice a pained whisper.
The disturbing scene of her whimpering brother is discovered by Emily, Ethan's six-year-old sister.
Chilled to the bone with the unfolding of a horrifying inexplicability, Emily's initial shock morphs into a resolute determination to uncover the ghastly mystery of her brother's condition.
Driven by a personal quest, Emily heads towards a future with a specialized focus on sleep disorders in her formative years.

Emily's life takes an unexpected turn when she receives a frantic call from a terrified mother in Salem, whose son’s sleepwalking episodes are reminiscent of the spine-chilling narratives of Ethan's past.
Touched by the heartfelt plea, Emily feels the weight of the challenge ahead.
Yet, her resolve to help remains unshakable.
With a strengthened resolve, Emily commences her voyage of intervention and exploration.
As Emily delves deeper into the intricacies of the afflicted child's psyche, a string of terrifying episodes unfurls.
Skirting at the edge of rationale, Emily's investigation takes a daunting turn.
She contemplates the potential intervention of a supernatural force behind the terrifying sleepwalking episodes.
Moved by an overwhelming determination to protect the boy and unravel the truth, Emily decides to induce sleepwalking within herself.
As sleep envelops her, Emily experiences an uncharted realm tickling her consciousness.
Emily finds herself walking the unfamiliar, spectral terrains.
Despite the bone-chilling fear, Emily trudges forward.
As Emily progresses further, she learns about the spirit’s resentment.
Emily’s journey into the spectral realms and the downward spiral into her own family’s tragedy results in empathising with the spirit.
Inside the phantasmal realm, Emily discovers an unexpected silver lining.
She finds a channel of communication opening up between her and Ethan.
Emily begins to empathise with the spirit.

As Emily realises that the spirit's torment and curse were bound by the memories of the spirit's heinous experiences of familial betrayal and abuse, Emily and Ethan pledge to honour and remember the spirit.
As the resonance of their promise reverberates through the spectral expanse, Emily finds herself jolted awake from her induced sleepwalking.
Emily begins her mission to implement the discoveries from her spectral quests.
Each day, Emily immerses herself to apply the newfound practices and strategies.
Alongside her endeavouring to heal affected children, Emily also begins to mend her frayed bond with Ethan.
Their shared trauma, once a curse, slowly becomes the catalyst that was imperative to healing their once strained bond.
Running parallel to Emily’s growing success in her professional life, her personal life also begins to bloom.
The relationship with Ethan, once strained and disconnected, begins to flourish, marked with shared understanding and empathy.
Emily evolves into a beacon of hope.
Emily emerges with a newfound identity – a courageous healer, determined to battle the vengeful spirit and aid the afflicted children battling sleepwalking disorders.
They begin to unearth buried feelings, echoing sentiments of shared trauma that they had silently borne in their respective hearts.
Emily's unwavering pursuit of truth and healing rescues not just the sleepwalking children but also brings Ethan back from his self-exile.
Emily’s refusal to surrender to fear paves the path to peace, understanding, and healing in an otherwise tormented landscape that had only know suffering.
Emily’s transformative journey touches not just her immediate circle of influence, but reaches out far beyond.
Word of her success spreads throughout the city of Eugene, and her influence expands.
The narrative embodies a tale of empathy, resilience, and redemption from adversity.
It celebrates the raw human grit and the power of familial unity that serves as the driving forces of healing.
With her encounters in the spectral realm and her realization of therapeutic powers, Emily emerges as a hero that the afflicted sleepwalkers desperately needed.
The film reaffirms the belief that fear can only dominate us until we muster the courage to face it.
Emily's courageous confrontation with the vindictive spirit serves as a testament to this.
Ethan and Emily’s shared tale underlines the importance of preserving familial bonds through trials.
It amplifies the healing power that unity can provide.
Packed with emotional depth, fear, courage, resilience, hope, and a tale of recovery, the narrative gives a gripping cinematic experience.
The unraveling of the mystery of the sleepwalking curse, Emily's dangerous expeditions through the spectral realm, and her resilient spirit converge to sculpt a unique cinematic narrative.

72365230.title: Skinamarink
synopsis: In 1995, four-year-old Kevin injures himself in an incident that his six-year-old sister Kaylee attributes to sleepwalking.
Kevin is taken to a hospital and brought back home.
The siblings wake up in the middle of the night to find that their father has disappeared and that the windows, doors, and other objects in their house are gradually vanishing.
Kevin suggests they sleep downstairs, where they watch cartoons on television.
They awaken to find the house still dark, hear an unexplained thumping noise, and find a chair upside-down on the ceiling.
Kevin then suggests that their father "went with mom" but Kaylee does not want to talk about their mother.
The toilet in the downstairs bathroom disappears.
On their way to the upstairs bathroom, Kaylee sees a doll on a bedroom ceiling and Kevin ends up too frightened to use the toilet, so they decide to place two buckets in the downstairs bathroom.
A mysterious voice calls to Kaylee from the darkness and tells her to come upstairs, where she sees their father in a bedroom.
He tells her to look under the bed, but she does not see anything.
She then sees their mother sitting on the bed.
Her mother says that she and their father love Kaylee and Kevin, and instructs her to close her eyes before vanishing.
Kaylee looks at the open closet and hears her mother say "there's someone here".
From the closet, she hears her mother calling her name as well as moans of pain and bones breaking.
She is startled by a hand reaching around a corner and panics.
Kaylee runs downstairs, where Kevin helps her push the couch to block off the hallway from which the voice was calling her.
When Kevin falls asleep, the voice calls Kaylee again.
When Kevin wakes up, he sees that Kaylee is gone and toys and objects are suspended against a wall.
The voice beckons Kevin into the basement, where he sees Kaylee, who no longer has eyes or a mouth.
The voice tells him it wants to play as some of the toys begin to disappear.
A drawer opens in the kitchen, and Kevin complies with the voice's command that he insert a knife into one of his eyes.
Kevin calls 9-1-1 and whispers to the operator that he was cut with a knife and feels sick.
The operator tells him to stay on the line and that adults are on their way.
Kevin says that the doors have disappeared before dropping the phone.
The phone turns into a Chatter Telephone toy and the voice claims responsibility for this, telling Kevin that it can "do anything".
It says that Kaylee disobeyed it and demanded to see her parents, so it took away her mouth.
It tells Kevin to come upstairs.
Holding a flashlight, Kevin finds himself on the ceiling.
He walks into a bedroom which becomes a void, and a dollhouse is shown sitting on a pile of toys in a seemingly infinite hallway as onscreen text reads "572 days".
A woman is seen sitting on the bed and her head slowly fades away, followed by the rest of her body.
Photos are shown of people, except their faces are either missing or distorted.
Kevin cries out as blood splatters onto the floor, then disappears and splatters repeatedly.
He asks if he can watch something happy, followed by an apparition of a door.
In the dark, an unidentifiable face appears over him in his bed, telling him to go to sleep.
Kevin asks for the face's name twice, but it does not respond.

72901521.title: Journey to Joy: A Father's Tale (2023 film)
synopsis: John, an astute software engineer boasting remarkable success at a high-tech company, was deeply engrossed in meticulously crafting the blueprints of an innovative system that promised to revolutionize the tech world.
His professional world was thrown off balance by an unforeseen call from Emily, his beloved wife.
Emily articulated her news with a voice that resonated with a delirious mixture of delight, surprise, and a noticeable undercurrent of anxiety.
Her water had broken, and the initial contractions signaled the imminent arrival of their first child.
The euphoria of the news electrified John, injecting his heart with joy that bubbled over like a dazzling Christmas tree.
He hastily signed off from his system, rushed out of his towering skyscraper-like office, and embarked on a soul-stirring journey towards Manhattan General Hospital.
John, racing down the sun-kissed freeway, his heart pounding with the vibrant rhythm of anticipation, was oblivious to the maze of otherworldly events yet to unravel before him.
In the midst of his commute, fate threw him into the role of a helpless spectator to a grisly accident.

A hit-and-run incident involving an innocent adolescent bicyclist and an extravagant Bentley, chauffeuring the infamous businessman, Mr. Sinclair; notorious for his political influence and unfathomable wealth.
Horrified, John’s trembling fingers dialed 911, reporting this heart-wrenching event in precise detail.

His nightmare took shape when he found himself being singled out as the primary suspect in the tragic accident, thanks to the crafty machinations orchestrated by Mr. Sinclair’s deviously shrewd team of legal sharks.

The scene changed to Emily; alone amidst her intensifying contractions within the sterile, impersonal confines of her hospital room, came face-to-face with the absurd allegations against her indefatigable husband.
The ludicrous charges against John plunged her into an abyss of stress, which further agitated her medical condition, disproportionately escalating the complexity of her induction labor.
With law enforcement hot on his heels and Sinclair’s ruthless henchmen lurking in the shadows, John found himself navigating the sinister maze of Manhattan's seedy underbelly.
Gathering his wits, he nimbly maneuvered through the city’s dim-lit alleyways and packed hideaways, feverishly working to assemble the jigsaw of events leading to the terrible accident.
Consumed by fears and haunted by paranoia, John soldiered on, driven by his unyielding determination to vindicate his tarnished reputation.

Amid this bewildering turmoil, John stumbled upon an unexpected beacon of hope in Greg, a former workmate turned dogged investigative journalist, whose stories once rattled the power corridors of the city.

Leaning on Greg's razor-sharp journalistic acumen and proliferative network, they began to unravel the insidious chain of clandestine transactions and morally bankrupt deals connecting the appalling event.
As they dove further, the layers of conspiracy began to unmask themselves, placing the inexplicable complexities into perspective, and inching them closer to the concealed truth.

Simultaneously, John, using his advanced coding abilities, dismantled the threads of the high-profile Wellbore corruption scandal, and bravely infiltrated Mr.Sinclair’s formidable cybersecurity firewall to expose the shocking scope of his duplicitous web.

Trapped in an exhausting whirl of events, they triumphantly managed to extract the distressing truth, revealing the actual wrongdoers and absolving John from the trumped-up charges unjustly levied against him.
The waves of fear lashed against her spirit, threatening to capsize her.
Yet, Emily, not one to go down without a fight, battled on, buoyed by the hope of reuniting with John soon.
In the face of adversity, she clung onto their precious moments of shared love like a lifeline, harboring the prayer for the safe arrival of their unborn daughter.

Hearts bathed in wave after wave of relief and unabashed love, John held Emily’s hands and their newborn daughter in his arms for the first time in a profoundly emotional reunion at Manhattan General Hospital.
Cradling their tiny daughter, Zoe, John held Emily's nervous gaze, reinforcing their bond, and fully reveling in the astonishing joy of fatherhood as warm tears brimmed in his eyes.
United against their ordeal, John and Emily, with baby Zoe nestled in their arms, stood as a breathtaking symbol of enduring perseverance, blossoming love, and the miraculous promise of new life.

72303203.title: Sympathy for the Devil (2023 film)
synopsis: David Chamberlain, an expectant father, drives to the hospital where his wife is in labor.
On the way there, a stranger gets into the back of his car, simply known as “The Passenger” and tells him to pick a card while holding a gun to his head.
David randomly chooses the Ace of Spades which the passenger reveals was in his pocket.
He then tells David to drive and, fearing for his life, he does so.
The passenger reveals very little about himself at first, instead mocking David’s attempt to garner sympathy by talking about his family.
Over the course of their road trip, David tries and fails multiple times to get away.
First by mouthing “help” to a lady at a gas station who does not get the hint and drives away.
Then by speeding so a cop pulls them over but the passenger starts a fight with the cop before asking for Satan to “get behind him”.
After that, he shoots the cop several times in the head, threatens David once more, and the trip continues.
The passenger teases David by alluding that he knows him but keeping the truth of where they’re going to himself.
In another escape attempt, David jumps out of the moving car and the passenger struggles to stop before crashing.
When David thinks about running away, the passenger answers his phone and discovers the location of David’s wife in the hospital.
Knowing she’ll die if he runs, David emerges from hiding, gets back into the car, and they keep going.
They soon stop at a diner to eat where the passenger begins to reveal the true purpose of the kidnapping.
He tells David a story about a bookkeeper in Brooklyn who worked for an Irish Mob boss named Jacob Sullivan based in Boston.
The bookkeeper fell in love, got married, and had a baby girl.
Unfortunately, an associate of Sullivan started stealing money from him and Sullivan told the bookkeeper to invite him over for dinner.
He was killed that night and the passenger tells David the same thing will happen to him when they reach their destination.
The passenger gets more and more unhinged the longer they talk.
He seems to know David, thinking he’s someone else, and knows he’s lying about his personal life.
He demands to know the truth, but David doesn’t know what he’s talking about.
After more denial, the passenger snaps, shoots up the diner, and sets it on fire while David calls the cops then runs outside.
In the parking lot, the passenger continues his story.
He reveals that he was the bookkeeper and his wife walked in on the murder done by Jacob Sullivan.
David and the passenger then fight with the passenger again gaining the upper hand.
They return to the car to continue the journey.
The passenger tells David that a man named James Levine called him.
Levine was a man who “fixes things” and told him that his wife, being a witness, was a liability.
While the passenger was away from home, Levine burned his house down, killing his wife and daughter.
The passenger believes that David is, in fact, James, and demands he “say the words out loud”.
Dead-eyed, David reveals the truth: “Sullivan ordered the hit.”  David then veers off the road, crashing the car, and fatally wounding the passenger.
Cops arrive at the scene as the passenger crawls out but David shoots and kills both of them.
With the passenger dying, David, really James Levine, finally reveals the whole truth about himself: he was responsible for the death of the passenger's wife and daughter.
However, the daughter was collateral damage and he feels God punished him for that by “taking” his first born.
The passenger listens to the confession, unable to speak as he coughs up blood and weeps, and James presses his forearm to his throat, strangling him to death.
Afterwards, James wipes his fingerprints from the gun and puts it in the passenger's hand to frame him for the cops’ murder.
As more cops arrive, James finds the Ace of Spades cards amongst the wreckage and pockets it.
Listening to a voicemail, he learns his wife gave birth to a daughter that has his eyes.
He smiles, stands, and walks to the cops feigning innocence.

41453655.title: Vanishing Horizon
synopsis: Tucked within the serene confines of the tranquil Sandy Hook, our leading characters navigate their conventional daily lives in their tranquil town.
A respected and much sought-after mechanic, John spends his workdays surrounded by the disarray of his age-old garage, finding solace in the tunes played on his trusty old radio.
Concurrently, a few blocks away in the local school, Lisa, a compassionate teacher adored by her students, frequently finds herself entertained by humorous summer tales spun by her young students.
A little distance away by the Pacific coastline, seasoned surfer Alex expertly maneuvers the majestic waves, relishing the sun-kissed afternoon as he defies nature's aquatic might.

Secluded in the tranquility of an old barn on the outskirts of Sandy Hook, Rachel indulges in her passion for vintage automobiles, devoting her time to a pristine cobalt blue Jaguar E-Type- the object of her profound affection.
A mystery unfolds as each of them receives an anonymous red envelope in their mailboxes, housing cryptic notes that merely list a cardinal direction.
Perturbed yet intrigued by the circumstances, these lifelong friends come together at Betty's Diner.
Over cups of steaming coffee and blueberry pies, they ponder over the puzzling notes bearing potential clues.
Combining their individual notes, they eventually decipher a complex set of coordinates, designed to resemble a treasure map.
Spirited John, brimming with adrenaline, proposes an unexpected adventure to follow the clues nestled in the mysterious directions.
His risky idea sparks electric enthusiasm in the group, and collectively, they resolve to embark on the curious journey.
With the break of the next dawn, the friends set off on their mapped expedition, sharing tales of past adventures and nervously suppressing their inner fears of the unknown.
A day of scenic travels, camaraderie, and shared aspirations lands them at their destination- a weather-beaten mansion, its ominous silhouette shrouded by an unkempt forest.

Overcoming their initial fright, the group explores the unkempt mansion, discovering a unique artifact in the form of a cardinal compass intricately carved into the cold stone floor of the mansion's grand entrance.
Choosing to set up base in the entranceway marked by the compass, they construct a small, sturdy cabin to accommodate their needs.

As darkness engulfs the mansion, the friends begin to experience eerie phenomena- eerie whispers that break the deathly silence, sudden chilling gusts of wind, and elusive shadows dancing ominously in the dim light.
To their sheer horror, they wake up to find Alex missing, his disappearance triggering a wave of panic among them.

In their frantic search for their lost friend, they uncover chilling remnants of the mansion's dark history- faded letters, an unsettling collection of grotesque portraits, and hidden passages leading to forebodingly dark rooms.
Before they could regain composure, Rachel also vanishes inexplicably, amplifying their fears and drenching them in further terror.
Pressed by their dire circumstances, Lisa and John stumble upon a hidden room dominated by disturbing pagan symbols.
Sorting through the room's jumble of ancient manuscripts, they learn the mansion's grim past—the dwelling had once been an unholy sacrificial ground for a pagan cult.
Suddenly Lisa convulses, overcome by a supernatural force.
It traps her within its ritualistic echoes, turning her into an unwilling participant in a horrid performance from centuries ago.
Recognizing their terrifying predicament, John realizes that the mansion's entity had lured them, intending to complete the long-abandoned ritual.
Confronting this gruesome reality, John morphs from an eager adventurer into a desperate rescuer, his primary goal now to save his friends.
With newfound courage, John manipulates the compass, moving in sync with the mansion, crippling the ritual's progression.
His relentless efforts yield fruit as the spirit's hold on Lisa weakens, her body crumbling onto the cold stone floor gasping for breath.
Although Lisa returns, Alex and Rachel haven't resurfaced yet.
The mansion escalates its ill-intentioned haunting, challenging John at every step.
Provoked by the interference, the disgruntled spirit responds violently, conjuring up a ferocious storm of vivid supernatural activity.
Bracing against the considerable odds, John finds a potential solution in an old spell from a discarded cult book in the mansion’s long-abandoned library.
Fighting against his fear, he initiates a counter-ritual, aiming to banish the relentless spirit from their reality.
Resisting his actions, the spirit causes the mansion to shake violently, threatening its very foundation.
Despite the cataclysmic situations around him, John successfully completes the counter-ritual, rendering the spirit powerless.
Constrained under his spellcasting, the entity weakens, leaving the mansion in an eerie calm.
Almost resembling magic, Alex and Rachel reappear in the mansion's central hall, understandably dazed but unharmed.
On an unseen trigger, the cardinal compass in the floor spins wildly before indicating due east, symbolizing the mansion's return to normalcy.
Overwhelmed by relief, the friends come together in a warm huddle, happy that their ordeal has finally ended.
Each pledge never to succumb to curiosity's dangerous allure, lest it leads them down another dark path.
As they leave the mansion, they make sure to secure the grand doors and heavy gates, an attempt to confine any residual malicious energy inside.

72915778.title: The Outwaters
synopsis: The film opens with a panicked 9-1-1 call along with visuals indicating that the four main cast members—Robbie, Angela, Scott, and Michelle—are missing.
A title card explains that the subsequent footage was recovered from three memory cards found in the Mojave Desert.
Robbie is an aspiring filmmaker living in Los Angeles who has recruited his brother Scott and his friend Angela to help film a music video for his friend Michelle in the Mojave Desert.
While getting ready for the expedition, he celebrates his brother's birthday, surprises his mother back home, parties with Angela, and talks to Michelle about her recently deceased mother.
Footage filmed from Robbie's apartment of two separate earthquakes is also shown.
The four friends pack their equipment and begin their journey, spending the first night at a small lake.
They continue deeper into the desert the next day and encounter a pack of donkeys blocking the road.
They arrive at their final location, a small hillside area near a dried-up lakebed, and begin setting up camp.
At night, the four are awakened by booming sounds and frantic animal noises that appear to be getting closer.
Scott and Robbie leave their tent to investigate but find no clues.
Robbie continues by himself and sees a strobing light along a hillside path.
The next day, the crew discuss the uncanny events of the previous evening and begin filming the video.
During a break, Robbie and Michelle investigate the area where he saw the light and record high-pitched noises coming from a nearby hole, sensing something unusual beneath the earth.
Robbie remarks that his camera battery has not gone down the entire time they've been there.
Later, Robbie sees an axe at the top of a nearby hill.
The crew head to the lakebed to finish filming the video, and the sound is overtaken by noises similar to the ones heard earlier in the hole.
At night, the crew once again hear the booms and animal sounds.
Robbie wanders off and sees a naked man on a hill wielding the axe.
As he runs away, the man attacks Robbie off screen, giving him a head injury.
Robbie returns to camp, bloody and disoriented, and finds Scott asleep but the women frantic.
The camera cuts to Robbie running through the desert as the two girls scream and plead for their lives.
He encounters Scott and Angela, both soaked in blood.
Robbie escapes and takes shelter in a small ravine until morning.
He exits, naked and disoriented, and starts wandering the desert aimlessly.
He finds that the area is now infested with screaming, fleshy, worm-like creatures.
That night, he returns to the campsite to find the two tents covered in viscera and sees what appears to be Michelle's body.
After a number of close calls with his assailant, Robbie is transported to a pool of red liquid by the light.
He is taken back to the desert, vomits blood, and removes an unknown substance from his foot.
He encounters the pack of donkeys, then sees himself and his three friends walking through the desert from when they first arrived.
He sees a blood-soaked Michelle running across the lakebed and chases her.
He encounters a bloodied Scott and Angela, acting normally, at the campsite.
Exiting the tent, he finds himself at his mother's house and then on the wing of a plane, where he sees Scott through the window.
Back in the desert, in total darkness, Robbie runs into a large monster, which closely inspects him and appears to be calling to similar creatures in the distance.
He runs away and sees Angela back at camp, and the two are attacked by the worms.
Robbie is carried by an unseen force that transports him back into the red liquid, and the camera is shown rapidly flying through a series of white lights before returning to the desert.
Robbie finds a gas mask and an old sign indicating that he is in a government-restricted area and encounters his assailant, who appears to be his doppelgänger.
The next day, Robbie finds the decomposing heads of his three companions impaled on pikes.
He then finds the tooth of a large animal on the ground.
He uses it to sever his penis and then disembowels himself.
The film ends with a shot of a fatally wounded Robbie reaching toward the sky.

28984407.title: Once Renowned: The Artie P Story
synopsis: The tale begins with Artie Pearson, our fallen hero and a former rock legend from the late 70's, now leading a quiet, withdrawn life in the suburban serenity of a small town in Maine.
One afternoon, the cool breeze of the spring whispering tales of youth, Artie chances upon a neglected, dusty box.
Inside this box, he finds myriad remnants of his golden years - faded concert backstage passes, spent drumsticks, broken guitar strings, and worn-out album covers, among other priceless treasures.
Most intriguing of all, however, is an old, half-tattered photo album.

Nostalgia washes over him like a tidal wave as the pages unfold a myriad of memories about his untamed youth, his thrilling performances that set the stage ablaze, and his unforgettable tracks that once stirred the world of music.
Simultaneously, the narrative introduces Jenna Matthews, a lively and passionate 20-year-old music enthusiast from the same quiet town.
She approaches Artie Pearson, whom she idolizes not just as a big fan of Sonic Illusion, but also as a budding musician herself.
Summoning courage, Jenna pleads with Artie to mentor her in her musical journey.
Artie, initially reluctant, finds himself taken in by Jenna's earnest appeal and the evident passion in her eyes.
With a heavy sigh, he decides to take up the mantle of her mentor.
As they spend hours rehearsing in Artie's soundproofed basement, the tranquility of his solitary life begins to unravel.
He regales Jenna with spellbinding stories about the rise and zenith of Sonic Illusion, the adventures they had, and the passion that bound them together.

These vivid recollections bring alive the journey of Sonic Illusion - their humble beginnings, the struggles they faced, their unflinching unity, and their meteoric rise from playing at small underground venues to commanding overflowing stadiums.
Artie's narration uncovers an intense, passionate relationship between himself and Liz, a fellow member of Sonic Illusion who bewitched him with her beauty and unmatched music prowess.
The narrative intertwines Liz into the tale as Artie’s muse.
Her inspiration paradoxically fuels unrest and turmoil within the band, shaping their future.
However, with Sonic Illusion's increasing fame, Artie finds himself grappling with the immense pressure of fame and high expectations.
To escape, he increasingly turns towards the dark abyss of alcohol and drugs.
He ends up spiraling down through haunting scenes of self-destruction, losing himself in the labyrinth of his despair and dependency.
Contrasting the dark past is the hopeful present.
Jenna, with her youthful optimism, pushes him to face the ghosts of his past, the crippling addiction that once threatened to devour him, and becomes his guiding beacon leading him towards recovery.

Yet, this peaceful journey is disrupted when Liz, who is now an established solo artist, announces her return to their small town, bringing Artie's dormant feelings for her back along with a plethora of unaddressed insecurities.
As Jenna's debut performance at the much-renowned town's annual music festival draws nearer, Artie’s swirling emotions amplify, putting a strain on his life.
The night of Jenna’s gig arrives.
Artie and Jenna's relationship suffers a blow and as a consequence, Jenna’s performance disastrously collapses.
Consumed by guilt and blame for Jenna's onstage debacle, Artie retreats into his former destructive vices.
Found unconscious in his apartment, Artie is rushed to the hospital on the brink of his life.
Miraculously, he escapes the jaws of death.
This near-death experience instills in him a resolution stronger than ever to fight off his addiction.
Embarking on his journey to recovery, he attends Alcoholics Anonymous meetings, opening up to connect with others dealing with similar issues.
As days turn into weeks, Artie starts rebuilding his life.
Jenna continues to stand by his side, her faith in him unbroken and acting as a guiding force towards his redemption.
Inspired by Jenna's commitment towards music and the newfound clarity in his own life, Artie pens down his life story.
The narrative not only strikes a chord with those suffering but also piques the interest of a publishing house.
As the deals for his autobiography, 'Once Renowned: The Artie P Story', begin to unfurl, Artie finds himself at the threshold of a new chapter in his life.
The imminent success of Artie's manuscript rekindles public interest in Sonic Illusion, causing whispers of a possible reunion of the once legendary rock band.
With the increasing public demands, the iconic reunion of Sonic Illusion at the landmark Madison Square Garden is now within sight.
Meanwhile, in an emotional backstage scene just before the concert, Artie insists Jenna perform as well.
Her performance is met with a standing ovation, an affirmation of her talent.
With Jenna's performance over, the spotlight turns to Artie.
His dark past is replaced by a man filled with humility and gratitude, his eyes sparkling with resilience.
Encased in the echoing applause from the jubilant audience, Artie is a living testament of transformation.
As the applause fades, Artie allows himself a heartfelt moment on stage.
He acknowledges the role each person present played in his life's journey.
Particularly, Artie and Jenna share a tearful look that speaks volumes about their shared struggles, victories, and moments of euphoria.

The camera pulls away, revealing a fully lit concert stage, the gleaming spotlights, the cheering crowd, and the triumphant Artie, the image serving as the perfect end to the film "Once Renowned: The Artie P Story."

73117113.title: I Used to Be Famous
synopsis: Vince Denham used to be famous as "Vinnie D", one of five members of the boyband Stereo Dream.
20 years later, he lives unemployed in Peckham, London.
Desperate to recapture his former success, he struggles to write a first solo album.
One day he starts practicing on his keyboard in the middle of a market when 18-year-old Stevie starts drumming along.
The crowd is captivated, but the show ends abruptly when Stevie's worried mother Amber pulls him away.
A video of the performance goes viral, and after some scouting Vince finds a local pub manager who agrees to let them perform at an upcoming music night.
Vince searches for Stevie, and stumbles across him and Amber again when he overhears and joins a drumming circle at a church.
He invites Stevie to perform, but Amber immediately refuses.
She explains that Stevie is autistic: he is unable to handle crowds or unusual situations, and she does not trust that Vince can handle his meltdowns.
However, she changes her mind when Vince is able to calm Stevie down with a drumming exercise they learned at the church.
Dubbed "The Tin Men", the gig starts well, but after Vince punches a man for heckling Stevie the landlord kicks them out.
Amber breaks off contact between the two.
Vince spirals into depression, remembering how he chose going on tour with Stereo Dream over visiting his terminally ill brother Ted, missing his death and causing an estrangement with his mother.
Meanwhile, Stevie lashes out at Amber, accusing her of secretly resenting him for forcing her to quit her dancing career to care for him, and insisting that Vince meant well.
He begins visiting local pubs and secures another gig for The Tin Men, then sets Vince up with an opportunity to apologise to Amber.
Vince and Stevie begin practicing and writing new songs again.
Former Stereo Dream member Austin Roberts sees a video of The Tin Men and offers Vince the chance to be the opening act on his final tour.

Their old manager also offers him a recording contract, but dismisses Stevie as "a special needs kid"—he demands that Vince performs as a solo act, and only uses label-approved studio musicians instead of Stevie.
Vince is appalled, but also unable to resist the opportunity—he accepts.
He tries to let Stevie down gently by spinning it as an opportunity for him to pursue his own dream of enrolling at a music school.
Stevie is distraught, but does as Vince suggests, and he manages to win a place at the Royal College of Music.

Amber visits Vince secretly and thanks him for making her realise Stevie's potential, but also demands that Vince cut off contact entirely, worried that Stevie now has an unrealistic expectation of achieving the success Vince promised.
Vince agrees, but later in the studio is alienated by his label-assigned producers' choices, including removing Stevie's drumming for a more "contemporary" electronic beat.
On Stevie's birthday, he decides to set up one final surprise Tin Men gig at the market where they first performed together.
As Amber and Stevie arrive, he invites Stevie onto the stage.
A huge crowd gathers and cheers for Stevie, and Amber, unable to resist, joins in.

49105043.title: Crisis Chronicles
synopsis: We are introduced to Sandra Spencer, who has captivated the corporate sales sphere with her bestselling literature and her position at Global Solutions Inc. She lives a seemingly blissful life in a cozy Victorian mansion with Tyler, her high school sweetheart turned lifelong partner, and Robin, their single cherished child.
A flood of emotions sweeps over Sandra as she bids a teary farewell to Robin, who's off to Stanford University.
An abrupt change in mood brings us to Tyler's surprise 50th birthday party.
However, the festivities are abruptly interrupted when Sandra stumbles upon a heart-rending sight in their master suite: Tyler, entwined with a woman far her junior.
This poignant revelation shatters Sandra's idyllic existence, plunging her into a torturous battle to endure this breach of trust.
Amidst the storm of personal and professional setbacks, Sandra seeks guidance from Dr. Miranda Stewart.
Prompted by Stewart, Sandra finds solace at Serenity Cove, a charming local yoga studio.
She forms heartfelt connections with an engaging group of middle-aged women undergoing similar midlife crises.
Just when Sandra starts accepting her new life, another crushing discovery awaits: Global Solutions Inc. is teetering on the brink of bankruptcy due to a severe decline in sales.
Sandra, driven by her steadfast spirit and ample professional experience, concocts a desperate high-stakes proposal aimed at rescuing her company from ruin.
The dysfunctional board members sentence the company to a gamble, reluctantly accepting Sandra's audacious proposal.
Sandra charges forward with her team of middle-aged women from Serenity Cove Yoga Studio.
Despite being the subjects of ridicule and disregard, the motley crew stands strong, steadily making a name for themselves.
Remorseful, Tyler attempts to mend bridges with Sandra, only to be rejected as she wholeheartedly embraces her newfound strength and self-reliance.
Sandra’s team pulls off a spectacular launch at the futuristic Silicon Valley Expo Centre.
Forbes and Wall Street Journal, among other prestigious media outlets, feature the launch contributing to a surge in sales and investor interest, effectively averting the threat of bankruptcy.
The board, acknowledging Sandra's effective strategy and resilience, offer her the opportunity to rise as Chief Strategy Officer, which she humbly declines.
Robin returns from Stanford, they are taken aback by the transformation of their mother.
This journey of resilience and empowerment reaches its crescendo as Sandra, flanked by her newfound friends, embarks on a cross-country road trip in a vintage Volkswagen Kombi.

73167912.title: Mafia Mamma
synopsis: Kristin, a writer and sales expert for a cosmetics company, is in the throes of a midlife crisis: her only son has just left for college, she catches her husband having sex with a younger woman in the basement of their home, and her bosses at the company treat her with contempt.

She receives a call from a lawyer named Bianca in Lazio, learning that her only living relative, her grandfather, has died and that she must attend his funeral and be present at the reading of his will.
Jenny, Kristin's friend, convinces her that attending the funeral will give her a chance to start over.
Upon landing in Rome, Kristin runs into a local, Lorenzo, and his aunt Esmeralda.
Kristin is attracted to Lorenzo and gives him her number before being picked up by Bianca's associates, Dante and Aldo.
The funeral proceeds smoothly until armed men stage an ambush, and the coffin is destroyed by bullets.
Aldo and Dante, following Bianca's instructions, get Kristin to safety.

At the reading, Bianca reveals that she is in fact the consigliere of the Balbano family, a powerful branch of the Sicilian Mafia; Kristin learns that her grandfather was the boss of the family, and that despite disapproving of his son having a child with an American woman, he wishes to honor tradition and have Kristin succeed him.
A hysterical Kristin demands to leave, but Bianca calms her, and she is persuaded to take on the role.
Kristin's first act as boss is to meet with Don Carlo, boss of the rival Romano family, and settle a dispute between the two gangs over the murder of both her grandfather and the previous Romano don.
Carlo manages to seduce Kristin and lures her into his hotel room, where he slips a dose of poison into her limoncello.
As Kristin prefers the glass with less Limoncelle, she switches the glasses, and Don Carlo drinks his own poison and chokes to death.
The Romanos promote Carlo's cousin, "Mammone", to succeed him.
Fabrizio, Kristin's caporegime, disagrees with her plans to diversify the Balbano family's criminal operations by setting up "legal" businesses that include reopening her grandfather's famous winery.
Lorenzo and Kristin grow closer, but the relationship is frustrated by an inability for either of them commit to each other.

A hitman sent by Don Mammone interrupts Kristin in the middle of a Zoom conference with her bosses; she manages to stab him to death with her heel, only to then learn that the company has decided to fire her.
A despondent Kristin goes to Lorenzo's house, and they sleep together.
The next day, she meets with Don Mammone, who agrees to forswear any further acts of vengeance against her and restore the peace between their families.
Kristin finally accepts her situation and begins to take a more active involvement in the family, while also spending more time with Lorenzo.
Their relationship is tested when her husband suddenly turns up in Lazio, claiming to be broke and in need of her help.
Kristin refuses to do so and sends him away.
She also lies to her son about Lorenzo, claiming he is only a friend, and causing him to question whether she truly loves him.
Kristin arranges a meeting with the Romanos to announce that she is retiring from the Mafia and giving her role as boss to Bianca.

Don Mammone is enraged, and an armed standoff ensues before police officers led by Lorenzo and Esmeralda (who are secretly undercover detectives) raid the meeting place and take everyone into custody.
Kristin hires Jenny to represent her in court, and because many of the locals have benefitted from her family's largess, they testify in her favor.
She is cleared of all charges and meets with Lorenzo, who explains that his real name is Rudy.
Kristin forgives him for deceiving her but decides to devote herself entirely to the family.
Bianca is seemingly murdered, and Kristin finds both her husband and her son held at gunpoint by Fabrizio, who turns out to be a traitor in league with the Romanos.
He is about to murder Kristin when Bianca catches him off guard, and Kristin drops him to his death inside a grape crusher.
She sends his finger as a warning to Don Mammone.
Sometime later, Kristin's son is about to return home.
As he departs, he sees his mother formally receiving guests in her capacity as head of the Balbano family.

90428380.title: The Hidden One (film)
synopsis: Shannon, a lavish half-British half-Indian woman, dwells amid the tranquility of an expansive estate tucked away within the verdant, undulating hills of England's Northumberland countryside.
Cloaked by an intimate veil of mystery, her enigmatic past is mutually respected with her preference for solitude by the nearby villagers.
The uninterrupted calm of her existence is perturbed by the unexpected appearance of Tom, a disciplined private investigator.

Summoned by the elusive billionaire Rupert Blackwood, Tom arrives with a proof - a poorly defined, monochromatic photograph of a significant artifact from the 15th century: an ornately crafted Celtic gold brooch reported absconded from a private collection.
Tom's growing suspicions link Shannon to the unsolved burglary, her lavish lifestyle and secluded existence constantly fuelling his doubts.
Journeying back through a poignant flashback, clandestine secrets from Shannon's buried past surmount; her former profession as an infamous thief, celebrated in the underworld, comes to light.
Wounded by the backstabbing, Shannon manages to slip away, withdrawing to her secluded estate, nursing her fury in isolation, hidden away from prying eyes.
Realizing Tom's suspicion and inferring the true purpose of his investigation, Shannon aggressively defends herself against any accusations.
However, the single photograph triggers a surge of long-buried memories.
In a joint endeavour, they descend into the murky underbelly of the criminal world, exploring complex alleys and gathering evidence that may divulge the ill-gotten artifact’s present whereabouts.
Her former allies, now adversaries, retaliate by dispatching ruthless assassins, making each encounter perilously lethal.
Shannon's trust in Tom slowly solidifies.
Finally, they stumble upon the stolen artifact - the Celtic gold brooch hidden in a decrepit warehouse in the industrial district of Manchester.
The decrepit warehouse swiftly turns into a battlefield as Shannon and Tom find themselves cornered by Shannon's former crew.
Employing intricate strategies and quick wit, she devises an improvised combat plan to retaliate against their approaching foes.
Each brilliantly calculated decision she takes may mean the stark difference between life and death.
A pulse-pounding sequence of deceptions, diversion tactics and adrenaline-pumped combat unfolds as Shannon and Tom successfully retrieve the priceless brooch.
The web of deception woven by Shannon also triggers a silent alarm notifying the local Greater Manchester Police who promptly descend upon the thieving crew members.
With her purge complete and her treacherous former crew in police custody, Shannon finally puts her notorious past to rest, gaining her long sought-after redemption.
Emerging from her self-isolated shell, Shannon starts rebuilding her trust in herself and finds new courage for a fresh start.
Declarations of their feelings for each other naturally surface, their experiences having forged an unassailable bond of deep affection.
Shannon and Tom bid adieu to their tumultuous lives once filled with high-stakes and dangerous thrill, longing now for a peaceful, simpler existence.
Their adventure culminates not in the end of a tumultuous chapter, but with the optimistic inception of a peaceful one.

72901167.title: The Strays (film)
synopsis: Cheryl, a biracial woman, is living in an undisclosed location in England.
She expresses concerns about discrimination and financial difficulties to her sister on the phone.
The subsequent scenes show her rejecting phone calls from her spouse and leaving a message on the fridge about going to the hair salon.
Several years later, we are introduced to Neve, a fair-skinned biracial woman married to Ian, a white man, with two biracial children, Sebastian and Mary.
She is disdainful of anything associated with "blackness."
Neve works at her kids’ school as a deputy headmistress and plans to host a fundraising gala at her home.
She often gets visions of black people and gets disturbed.
At the fundraising gala, Neve confronts two black individuals that she believes to be strangers; they address her as their mother.
Flashbacks to five days prior, with "Carl and Dione" being the focus of the story, the two black teens Neve has been seeing.

The two are on an unknown mission that involves staying at a hotel, with Carl taking on the name "Marvin" and getting a job as the school janitor and Dione taking the name “Abigail” and working as an assistant in Ian's office.
They befriend Neve's children, Dione inviting Mary to the hotel room for drinking and partying and Carl inviting Sebastian to smoke after his basketball game.
Afterwards, Carl convinces Sebastian to brutally attack his school bully.
In the present day, it is revealed that Neve is Cheryl, and Carl and Dione are indeed her children.
She meets them at a diner and gives them ten thousand pounds each in order to help them back on their feet as they return to London.
However, Carl and Dione break into Neve's house.
Carl takes everyone's phones and dumps them in the sink, where he turns on the water that starts to flood the living room.
Carl and Dione claim it's Dione's birthday and they should celebrate as a family, and force the family to order Uber Eats.
Carl confronts Neve for trying to pay them off, which was unknown to the rest of her family.
This leads to Ian threatening a divorce, however, Dione intervenes and suggests playing a board game.
Neve, who is visibly upset, vomits.
Afterwards, she appears to adopt a new and happy persona, and the group begins to play Scrabble.
Carl becomes annoyed and forfeits the game before demanding that Ian accompany him to the family's gym.
There, Carl coerces Ian to lift increasingly heavy weights until he is unable to hold them, and the weight falls on him, resulting in his apparent death.
Meanwhile, after the Uber Eats driver arrives, Neve tells the group she will tip the driver and be right back; she does not return.
The driver's engine starts up and drives away, implying that Neve has left with him.
Mary and Sebastian are left standing in the flooded living room with Dione and Carl, as Neve has now abandoned her second set of children.

73148256.title: Guardians of Stellar Haven: Xandar's Prophecy
synopsis: In the sprawling metropolis of Stellar Haven, a city teeming with both lifeforms of various galaxies and cutting-edge technologies, resides an unassuming housewife known as Gala Xandar.
On one unusually bright morning, a prophecy of impending doom roused Kron from his usual calm composure.
Word of his prophecy quickly started circulating among the citizens of Stellar Haven, a city celebrated for its advanced technologies and cultural diversity.
Although Kron's prophecy spread like wildfire, the scientifically-minded city council members dismissed his warnings.
Meanwhile, underneath the city's growing angst, Gala made a groundbreaking discovery about herself.
Her DNA held the potential to transform her into the prophesied savior of Stellar Haven - a secret embedded within her very genetic code.
This revelation placed the weight of Stellar Haven's future onto her unsuspecting shoulders.
Driven by her newfound purpose and a desire to safeguard her cherished city, Gala embarked on a demanding training regimen.
The training was a grueling test of Gala's physical strength and mental resilience.
Overcoming a series of physical trials and emotional self-doubts, Gala emerged as the prophesied superheroine.
During Gala's transformation, the city council - gripped by palpable fear due to the looming threat - decided to enlist a group of hired guns from alien galaxies to defend Stellar Haven.
However, behind the council’s watchful eye, the power-hungry mercenaries plotted to exploit the impending chaos.
They aimed to usurp control of the city amidst the disorder, carefully concealing their deceiving intentions.
Now empowered and more attuned to her environment, Gala sensed the mercenaries’ insidious agenda.
She found herself balancing a delicate line—protecting Stellar Haven while maintaining her secret identity.
Gala's moment of truth arrived when Zorgo, the unforgiving mercenary chief, led an attack on the awe-inspiring city.
Gala's heroic intervention became a worldwide spectacle as she used her cosmic energy powers to shield the magnificent city and repel the mercenaries.
This marked the beginning of her journey as Stellar Haven’s protector.
During this cataclysmic event, the full truth of Kron's prophecy hit Gala.
She understood that the prophecy was a double-sided riddle, foresigning both her awakening and the imminent monstrous creature.
As Zorgo and his mercenaries began to rally amidst the rising turmoil, Gala – now shielded by a suit of cosmic energy – valiantly charged into the heart of the chaos.
Determined and her body pulsating with cosmic energy, Gala fully embraced her role as the city’s sole defender against the ruthless mercenaries and the rampaging cosmic leviathan.
Facing the adversity head-on, she engaged in fierce combat with the mercenaries.
This marked her first real test as a superheroine – a fight for Stellar Haven's survival in its darkest hour.
Amid the destructive chaos, Gala crossed paths with Zorgo, engaging him in a showdown.
Their clash was a spectacle of power versus power - raw brute force against cosmic energy.
The escalating battle in the city’s radioactive core thrust the dormant cosmic beast into action.
It began its destructive ascent towards the city's surface, adding another layer of threat to an already dire situation.
Faced with the dual obstacles of battling Zorgo and the imminent rampage of the cosmic monster, Gala steeled her resolve and summoned her remaining reservoir of courage and power.
With a final surge of cosmic energy, she managed to overpower the mercenaries.
Simultaneously, using skills even she didn't know she possessed, she established an empathetic energy connection with the cosmic beast, pacifying it and convincing it to return to its slumber.
By forging this connection, she fulfilled her prophesied destiny as the city's savior and returned the creature to its centuries-long sleep.
Physically exhausted yet victorious, Gala emerged from beneath the city, her once vibrant home now a war-torn landscape.
The city council, overcome by a newfound respect for the heroics of Gala and the accuracy of Kron's prophecy, publicly acknowledged their heroic deeds.
In the aftermath of the catastrophe, they bestowed upon Gala the title of Stellar Haven's Guardian, a title she accepted with fervor and determination.
Gala accepted her new role as the city's protector with grace.
A once ordinary housewife, she was now the beacon of hope and a superheroine for Stellar Haven.
Drawing strength from her newfound role, Gala pledged to guard Stellar Haven against any potential future threats to preserve peace within the city's borders.
Having braved the cataclysm, Gala and Kron looked forward to a serene era for Stellar Haven, yet remained vigilant for unforeseen changes in the city’s tides.
Kron continued to see into the future with his prophecies, providing solace to the citizens by assuring them of Stellar Haven's largely peaceful future.
Despite the promises of a tranquil future, Gala relentlessly trained and prepared for her new role as the city's guardian, ready to confront any adversity that may threaten Stellar Haven.
Kron's prophecies, which were once viewed with skepticism, now rang loud and clear throughout the cityscape, asserting the undeniable power and importance of foresight.
Gala and Kron, once an ordinary couple, were now regarded as the brave guardians of Stellar Haven.

Their bond, which was once simplistic, had bloomed into a relationship filled with shared responsibility, deeper understanding, and resilient love that had been reinforced under the pressure of shared trials.
Gala, donned in her shiny superhero armor, stood vigil over the city she had saved and sworn to protect.
Kron, stood by her side, sharing in the watch over their home.
Together, they reminisced about their perilous journey, celebrating their shared victory and envisioning a time of peace for Stellar Haven.
The new roles they had embraced stood in stark contrast to their previous lives, adding another layer of complexity to their existence.
They were optimistic about a peaceful era ahead for Stellar Haven and dedicated every waking day to ensuring the tranquility they had fought so hard for was preserved.
As this narrative draws to a close, the extraordinary journey of Gala and Kron sets the stage for further adventures.
Their once ordinary lives were now forever intertwined with the fate of Stellar Haven as its guardians.

71994797.title: Legion of Super-Heroes (film)
synopsis: In Argo City on Krypton, Alura Zor-El has been preparing for a catastrophe her brother-in-law Jor-El has predicted will destroy the planet.

However, the disaster strikes early, and Alura has just enough time to send her daughter Kara to Earth, where she is supposed to reunite with her younger cousin Kal-El, who is to arrive in his own escape ship.
Just after take-off, a fragment of the exploding planet damages Kara's pod, putting her into suspended animation and sending the vessel into a trajectory that arrives on Earth later than intended.
After her arrival, Kara - now named Supergirl - has trouble adjusting to life on Earth with its more primitive culture, and the superpowers gained from her new environment.
During a fight with Solomon Grundy, she spots masked individuals lurking nearby and is rescued by Kal-El (now called Superman) and Batman.
Kal-El suggests that Kara should travel to the 31st century and join the Legion Academy, a training school for Legion of Super-Heroes candidates.
In the 21st century, Batman intercepts the masked individuals raiding S.T.A.R.
Labs, but they commit suicide before he can question them.

Traveling to the future, Kara is introduced to the Academy by one of its trainees, Mon-El, but starts a spontaneous fight with Academy member Brainiac 5, whom she mistakes for her cousin's enemy Brainiac.
While the misunderstanding is cleared, Brainiac 5 is distrusted because of his ancestry.
Kara's own relationship with him is initially antagonistic as well, but as time passes, they develop a mutual understanding which eventually turns romantic.
One night, while looking for school pet Proty, Triplicate Girl spots Mon-El lurking near a forbidden high-security vault on the Academy's grounds, before being attacked and apparently killed.
The Legionnaires arrest Brainiac 5 and discover that he enrolled in the Academy to penetrate the vault, which contains dangerous weapons.

Brainiac 5 explains that he is trying to counter an organization called the Dark Circle, but only Kara believes him while her short-tempered teacher, Timber Wolf, informs her to stay away from Brainiac 5, criticizing her for coming to the academy from the 21st century in the first place.

After recognizing the masked figures she saw in the past from the Academy computer's files on the Dark Circle, she breaks Brainiac 5 out of confinement and learns that the Dark Circle is trying to obtain the reality-bending Miracle Machine.
Joined by Mon-El, Kara and Brainiac 5 enter the vault and overcome its security.

When they find the machine, Mon-El reveals himself as an agent of the Dark Circle, stabs Kara with a kryptonite blade, and summons the rest of the Circle who overpower the Legionnaires and Academy students.

The Circle's leader appears and is revealed as Brainiac, who founded the Dark Circle in the 21st century to facilitate his resurrection and has plotted for Brainiac 5 to grant him access to the Miracle Machine.
Because they were incapable of passing the vault's security, the bodies of Brainiac 5's predecessors were melded into a new body for Brainiac.
He claims that he has foreseen great danger approaching, and plans to bend reality to eliminate it and make himself the savior of the universe.

Kara and Brainiac 5 are rescued by fellow students Triplicate Girl (who had lost merely one of her alternate selves), Invisible Kid and Phantom Girl, who have eluded capture, and together they retrieve Dawnstar, Bouncing Boy, and Arm Fall Off Boy.
After sending an SOS to the Legionnaires in space, the other students distract Mon-El and the Circle while Kara and Brainiac 5 move to stop Brainiac.
They cannot prevent the Miracle Machine's activation, but Brainiac 5 turns his predecessors against their creator, causing Brainiac's body to tear itself apart.
The machine goes out of control.
In her attempt to stop it, Kara summons Alura's soul.
Though briefly tempted to reverse Krypton's destruction, she comes to terms with her loss and stops the cataclysm by displacing the machine into another reality.
Afterwards, the students defeat Mon-El and the Circle, and the returning Legionnaires grant them all full Legion membership.
In a post-credits scene, Kara contacts Superman about her decision to stay in the 31st century and her new relationship with Brainiac 5.
After the call is ended, Superman and Batman inspect a crater in Metropolis when they are hit and apparently teleported to parts unknown by a Zeta Beam blast.

75862611.title: Patel Can Dunk
synopsis: Sanjay Patel, affectionately known to everyone around him as "Alex," is a smart and ambitious 16-year-old.
Born in America and of Indian origin, he's a junior at a sports-oriented high school in Brooklyn, New York City.
Despite not being much of a sports enthusiast, he struggles to fit into his school's hyper-athletic culture, while trying to stay true to his Indian heritage and himself.
Allured by the graceful game of basketball, Alex secretly spends all his spare time in the gloomy, forsaken corners of the school's expansive indoor basketball court when no one is around.
It is here that he studiously perfects his shots, dribbling skills, and layups while mentally absorbed in his world of idolized NBA legends.
Fueled by isolated moments of surging confidence and spurred on by ambition, Alex audaciously attends the tryouts for his school's esteemed varsity basketball team.
He surprisingly excels in the solo drills but his efforts are undermined by the scoffing and mocking from his naturally more robust, physically larger peers.

In the midst of these unsettling high school trials and tribulations, Alex's traditional Indian family, who had moved from Mumbai a few years before Alex was born, find themselves relocating within Brooklyn due to a job opportunity for Alex's father.
This places them next door to a foreboding figure known as Frank "Walt" Walter.
Frank Walter, a towering white middle-aged male who happens to be an ex-NBA player, is an imposing figure around the neighborhood.
His magnified reclusion has led everyone around him to believe he's a misanthrope.
He busies himself with nursing unresolved past issues linked to an incident we get glimpses of—his early retirement from basketball due to an unfortunate injury.
Walt spends his day observantly watching the world outside his apartment through binoculars.
His attention is caught by Alex, practicing his shots solo in the indoor court.
He sees in Alex a reflection of his own, unwavering passion for basketball that stirs something within him.
Upon closer inspection and an invasion of Alex's solitude, Walt makes a daring choice to break his voluntary isolation and helps Alex in his pursuit for basketball mastery.
They begin a rigorous training schedule, from refining fundamental shooting techniques to advanced strategic gameplay.

Parallel to their training, the narrative gradually brings to light the extent of Walt's enigma—his sudden retirement from NBA due to a career-ending kneecap injury incurred during a potentially championship-winning game, which haunted him into isolation.
As Walt begins to openly share his unspoken journey, his mentorship becomes more than just basketball training.
It transforms into a life-lesson-packed experience, teaching Alex resilience, acceptance, and patience which coincidentally aids Walt to reconcile with his own buried past.
The duo foster an unlikely bond mirrored by their shared love for basketball, comforted by the solace of their deserted indoor court.

Walt slowly finds himself re-engaging with the community that he had distanced himself from, while Alex helps him with tasks such as grocery shopping and light cleaning around his neglected apartment.
Six relentlessly arduous months later, a confident Walt finally convinces Alex to audition for the varsity basketball team again.
This time, it won't be an act of mere audaciousness, but a show of his true unyielding potential.
The day of the tryouts finally arrives.
Thinking back to their countless hours of practice, drills, and shared wisdom, Alex courageously puts his best foot forward.
He performs exceptionally well in the solo and team sessions, impressing everyone present.
However, he is met with degrading racial discrimination from his predominantly white peers.
His classmates jeer at his average height and unfamiliar Indian origins.
However, the coach, a stern but fair man, sees the spark in Alex, valuing raw talent over narrow-minded bigotry, and boldly places him on the team's roster.

An elated Alex further stuns his teammates and spectators with his stellar shooting skills and strategy in the inter-school matches, becoming the backbone for the team's winning streak—a testament to Walt's training and Alex's unwavering dedication.
Amidst this upward trajectory, Alex goes through an unsettling episode during an away game.
He suffers racial hostility from his own teammates.
Heartbroken, he finds himself questioning if the passion for the sport he loves dearly is worth the constant struggle against cultural displacement and unwarranted hostility.
Returning home desolate from the game, he confides his agonizing experience with Walt, who patiently listens to his young protégé's distress.
Walt, having seen his fair share of bigotry, comments on the universality of their shared experiences.
He became targeted after his career-ending injury and now Alex for his racial background.
Walt imparts wisdom from his playing years, advising Alex to maintain his self-respect, disregard the harmful opinions of others, and to always put his heart and best efforts into the game.
Walt's words provide a substantial morale boost, fortifying Alex's courage to confront not just his disparagers, but anyone who challenges his passion for the sport.
Against all odds, he evolves into an invaluable player for his team.
The day of the state championships arrive amidst this transformation.
Despite the mixed feelings of excitement and anxiety, the team gears up for the final game.
It's a nail-biting match, swinging back and forth between the competing teams.
Adrenaline coursing through him, Alex pulls off an awe-inspiring, quick-witted slam dunk in the final seconds of the game, sealing a breathtaking victory for his team.
There's silence, followed by thunderous applause and cheer—the crescendo of his success story.

His parents, who initially were skeptical of his basketball fascinations compromising his academics, finally see the extent of their son's hard work and earnest passion for the sport, applauding with pride in their hearts.
His classmates, including those who once ridiculed him, are left in awe of his remarkable performance.
This victory is a turning point; classmates who once derided him now admire him, and his team who once scorned him now cherish him.
Alex’s victory party, held at a local community center, is a multicultural celebration attended by his Indian family, Walt, classmates and the entire basketball team.
The tight-knit atmosphere and shared sense of accomplishment becomes a testament to unity and shared understanding.
The next day at school, the air feels different.
There's an elevated respect in the eyes of teachers and students alike, a newfound quietude that speaks loads about the shifted dynamics.
In the frenzy of newfound social status at school and neighborhood, Alex remains humble, focused and with increased determination.
His victory paves the way for new beginnings, not just for him but also for his school.
Fueled by Alex's heroic win, it now aspires to cultivate a diverse sports environment.
Change is noticeable even in Walt's life.
The forgotten ex-NBA player transforms into an acclaimed mentor, admired for his efforts to guide a young talent towards an extraordinary triumph.
Despite all these advancements, Walt and Alex continue to share precious hours on the court in training, relishing their shared victory.
The storyline concludes with a quintessential Brooklyn sunset casting a warm glow on Alex, his parents, Walt and the basketball court.
They engage in a heartfelt conversation about Alex's promising future.
The triumphant boy engaging his family, mentor and the orange glowing basketball spins us into an affirmation—that Alex, indeed, can ‘dunk’.

67233361.title: Chang Can Dunk
synopsis: Xiao Ming "Bernard" Chang is an unpopular sophomore in high school.
He hangs out with his band friend Bo but expresses huge interest in basketball, with whom he shares a rivalry with star player Matt O'Neil, his former friend from elementary school.
One day, he meets his new bandmate Kristy and becomes smitten with her, only for Matt to start hitting on her.
Chang continues to feel threatened by Matt, especially when his friends lock him in the basement at a house party.
He escapes and confronts Matt over a prior basketball game and claims that he can dunk, but Matt puts him down and he's humiliated when he falls into a swimming pool.
Chang continues his quest to reinvent himself, especially since his mother Chen always judges his decisions, leading him to not opening up to her.
He finally confronts Matt at school and bets that he can make a dunk by homecoming.
Should Chang win, Matt must shave his head and give him his prized Kobe Bryant jersey.
Should Matt win, not only must Chang shave his head, but also give him his first edition "shadowless" Charizard Pokémon Trading Card.
Kristy knows full well that the bet is really about her, but chooses to support Chang regardless.
Bo helps Chang train rigorously, but after a week, feels that he hasn't accomplished much.
He goes online and discovers Deandre Cooke, a YouTuber who films himself dunking.
Chang meets Deandre at a Verizon store and Deandre agrees to take him on as his protégé.
Seeing as how they cannot pay him, Bo instead offers to improve his YouTube videos, calling their production terrible.
He agrees.
Chang improves significantly as Deandre films and uploads his exploits online and the two form a bond.
Chang asks Deandre why he never went pro and he says sometimes life just doesn't go the way you want it to.
At the same time, Chang and his mother start to feel distant.
The day before the dunk, Chang feels that he's still off and sneaks into the school late at night.
In the morning, everyone gathers to see Chang's dunk attempt and after large fanfare, succeeds, winning the bet and earning him school fame.
Despite his online recognition, Chen remains in the dark about her son's success.
He's invited by ESPN to New York to talk about his win and brings Bo, Kristy and Deandre with him.
When he's asked to make the dunk again, he misses, claiming that the wind threw him off.
However, Chang is swallowed up by his fame and nearly ditches his friends.
At school the next day, Matt says he knew that Chang cheated by lowering the basket on the court.
Chang accuses him of racism and they get into a fight, resulting in both boys getting suspended for a week.

Chen finally learns what Chang has been up to and angrily tells him that he doesn't need to prove himself to others, while Chang says he can never talk to her because she's always unhappy and makes everyone else unhappy.
Chang realizes that he cannot make a dunk and publicly apologizes for his cheating.
Chen confronts Deandre over the time he spent with Chang, but he tells her that he was a great kid whom he truly believes in.
Realizing that her son has potential, Chen goes home and destroys her house's unfinished veranda from her separated husband.
Chang helps her and repairs their relationship.
Chang makes up with Bo and Kristy, the latter of whom he starts dating.
He tries out for the school basketball team and makes up with Matt, with both of them becoming better people.
Sometime later, Chang is on the basketball team and his coach tells him to enter a game.
While he briefly makes a mistake, he steals the ball from an opposing player and dribbles down the court, rising for a dunk before the film ends as the crowd cheers.

43401117.title: Twister Pursuit
synopsis: The film unveils a harrowing scene imprinted in young Tom and Jake's memory, where they observe the terrifying spectacle of a monstrous F5 tornado wreaking havoc in their rural Oklahoma hometown.
The climax of the scene sees the massive twister ruthlessly claiming the lives of their parents, forever altering the course of their destinies.
Time leaps to the present day where Tom and Jake Walsh, irreversibly shaped by their traumatic past, have risen to prominence as phenomenally skilled tornado chasers.
They've gained recognition and respect for their audacious pursuits of the Tornado Alley storms that annually sweep the United-States.
The screen is filled with images of a high-tech Storm Interceptor, a custom-made beast-on-wheels with powerfully efficient hydro-aero engines and robust armored plating.
Despite their unity of purpose, tension simmers between the siblings.

Adrenaline junkie Tom is fueled by the thrill of chasing and conquering the most violent twisters, while Jake, the more cerebral of the two, harbors a profound fascination for the unpredictable and chaotic nature of tornadoes.
The intriguing plot thickens when Jake, using his profound understanding of complex weather patterns, eerily predicts an approaching superstorm that could potentially birth deadly EF-5 tornadoes.
His brother, though skeptical, cannot ignore the dark sense of premonition that lurks beneath the forecast.
Unsettled by the reminiscent horror of their past and driven by an intense sense of obligation to prevent any future catastrophes, the brothers painstakingly plan an audacious operation.
