While investigating a disturbance, Noiret is raised into the air, set on fire, and burned to death before a terrified Jacques who then flees.
Four years following the events at Saint Cartha's monastery, Sister Irene now serves in a convent in Italy.
Maurice works at a boarding school in France, where he has befriended a young Irish student named Sophie and her teacher and mother, Kate.
Irene has a vision of Maurice asking her to save him.
She is dispatched by the Cardinal to investigate a series of deaths across Europe, attributed to the demon Valak, due to her previous experience with the demon.
She travels to Tarascon with Sister Debra, a young novice who expresses her difficulty in accepting miracles, such as the real presence of Christ in the Eucharist.
In Tarascon, Irene is haunted by Valak and has a strange vision.
Sister Debra tells Irene that she received Noiret's rosary from Jacques.
At school, Sophie is bullied by classmates and locked in the deconsecrated sealed-off chapel.
The bully points out the goat on the stained-glass window, claiming the devil appears when the sun shines through and turns the goat's eyes red.
One night, the headmistress encounters a sleepwalking Maurice and is killed by Valak in the guise of her deceased son.
Irene and Debra travel to the Palais des Papes and meet with a librarian.
He explains that Valak was an angel rejected by God and the emblem on Noiret's rosary is the family crest of St. Lucy, who was martyred by a pagan.
Though she was set on fire, she miraculously did not burn; her eyes were gouged out, but her family recovered them.
The librarian suggests the demon is killing St. Lucy's descendants because it wants this powerful relic, last known to be stored in a former monastery-turned-winery.
The winery then became the present-day boarding school.
At the school, Irene and Debra face off against a fully possessed Maurice.
Sophie shows the women the stained-glass goat in the chapel and they use a flashlight to make its eyes glow red.
The red light acts as a laser-like pointer, pointing to where the eyes of St. Lucy are buried.
Irene finds the relic and the stained-glass goat vanishes, reappearing in real life as a demonic creature.
As the goat attacks the students, Maurice attacks Irene, chases Sophie, and causes the bell tower to collapse.
Debra admits to Irene that she now has faith.
Irene uses the relic against Maurice, but he grabs it, causing Valak to appear.
Similar to Father Noiret, Valak lifts Irene in the air and sets her ablaze.
Irene does not burn as Valak realizes she is a descendant of St. Lucy, able to harness the same power associated with the relic.
Irene and Debra pray the Words of Institution as the old barrels of wine in the room become the blood of Christ, banishing the demon and freeing Maurice of possession.
The next morning, Irene leads Maurice outside and helps him to regain his senses.
However, she becomes concerned as she watches him going with Sophie and Kate inside.

39783527.title: Serenity Springs: Holiday Harmony
synopsis: The film begins by welcoming audiences into the heart of Serenity Springs.
The tranquil town is aglow with festive lights wreathing each house, snow blanketing the rooftops, and an unmistakable air of expectancy as Christmas approaches.

The audience is introduced to Susan Thompson, a vivacious woman with a soulful laugh that ripples through every being she encounters, inspiring all with her boundless excitement for the festive season.

Susan is portrayed as the diligent planner behind every Christmas festivity in town, her hand being behind delightful gingerbread houses, thoughtful crafted gifts, and spirited neighborhood gatherings, commanding the festive preparations with unyielding vigor and enthusiasm.
Mayor Jim, a rotund elderly gentleman with a laughter as infectious as Susan's, frequently appears as part of this small-town tableau, often partnering Susan in her planning.

The narrative takes a surprising detour when Mayor Jim, known for directing the annual Christmas extravaganza, assigns this hefty responsibility to Susan, trusting her to orchestrate the town's most-awaited event.
Startled but resolved, Susan conceals her uncertainties behind a facade of playful nonchalance, before taking up the challenge with a blend of excitement and trepidation.
Susan seamlessly transitions into her role, meticulously planning the Christmas event while balancing her duties as the town librarian.
Amidst this comedic chaos, Susan's unwavering best friend, Becky, consistently offers well-meant yet often misunderstood advice, inadvertantly adding to Susan's stress rather than mitigating it.
Their friends' feisty disagreements over minute Christmas-related details stir additional tension into the soup of the storyline.
The narrative advances to introduce the new pastor in town, the tall and strikingly handsome John.
His serene demeanour and his timely offer of assistance act as moments of calm amid the storm of preparations.
As he steps in to help Susan, a slightly rose-tinted blush creeps onto her cheeks, subtly suggesting a budding romance between the two amidst the chaos of the holiday season.
Despite their diligent preparations, the town begins to lose some of its characteristic Christmas cheer due to the whirlwind of activities.
Uncertain of the outcome, the townspeople's worries begin to mirror Susan's, their euphoria overshadowed by the daunting task at hand.
Overcome by pressure and responsibilities, Susan seriously considers forsaking her role as the Christmas event organizer.
It is during this pivotal moment that John's comforting presence and inspiring words provide a much-needed morale boost to Susan.
John emphasizes the resonance of Serenity Springs' community spirit, and Susan's crucial role within it, encouraging her to prevail over her apprehensions and to steadfastly take up the mantle.
John's rousing words ignite a fresh determination in Susan, who dives back into her planning, her moroseness replaced with a renewed spirit.
Amidst the comedic blunders and escalating anticipation, the day of the Christmas event finally breezes in, marked by a clear blue sky radiating hope and celebration.
The initial snafus do not dampen the spirit of Serenity Springs; instead, the townsfolk prepare themselves to put on a memorable festive spectacle.
Empowered by Susan’s determination, the grand event unfolds, registering a record-clearing attendance and an electrifying atmosphere of joy and camaraderie.
As the town celebrates, the audience gets a striking image of Susan, beaming with happiness and pride for successfully binding her tight-knit community.
The townspeople, who initially had doubts about Susan's capabilities as a leader, now celebrate her efforts with heartfelt praises and immense gratitude.
In doing so, Susan triumphs by not only successfully executing an exceptional event but also replenishing the missing Christmas spirit in the hearts of Serenity Springs.
John, who has been observing Susan's selflessness and unwavering dedication, can no longer ignore the romantic spark between them.
Unafraid of their feelings, he seizes the moment under the twinkling holiday lights and confesses his growing love for Susan.
Caught by surprise but visibly touched, Susan reciprocates to John's affections, adding an unexpected sweet twist to the comedic narrative.
As the event comes to a close, the scenic shots of the Christmas decoration adorned houses, encapsulate Serenity Springs’ charming ambience.
A dramatic fireworks display illuminates the night sky, radiating a sense of community unity and gratitude.
As the last firework fizzles out, the camera uncovers a heartwarming scene - Susan and John share a tender, prolonged kiss under the starlit sky.
The overarching lesson of love, unity, and perseverance is encapsulated in their warm smiles and the fortified bonds among Serenity Springs' townsfolk.
As the joyous narrative nears its conclusion, Mayor Jim is caught approvingly smiling at the remarkable unity fostered by Susan's hard work and dedication.
The next morning, as the snow gently carpets the town, Serenity Springs appears all the more idyllic.
The story reaches its culmination, leaving no doubt that Susan, John, and the entire town have successfully reclaimed their magical Christmas spirit.
As the camera lingers on the entrance sign of Serenity Springs, which proclaims it as "Where Christmas Lives," the enduring themes of hope, resilience, and unity are reinforced.
The film ends with a grand aerial view of Serenity Springs, marking the conclusion of a heartfelt saga of love, unity, and the magic of Christmas revelry.

75003178.title: It's a Wonderful Knife
synopsis: In the town of Angel Falls, teenager Winnie Carruthers is celebrating the Christmas season with her friends and family.
During a party, Winnie witnesses her best friend Cara being murdered by a masked assailant known as "The Angel".
Winnie and her brother Jimmy chase The Angel outside, where Winnie kills The Angel by electrocuting him with jumper cables.
Winnie unmasks the killer and recognizes him as Henry Waters, a business partner of her father David.
One year later, Winnie is still grieving Cara's death, while her family has moved on from the events of the previous year.

She attends a Christmas party at her boyfriend Robbie's house, where she befriends a social outcast named Bernie, before discovering that Robbie has been cheating on her with her friend Darla for a year.
Distraught, Winnie goes alone to a bridge and, looking up at the aurora lights in the sky, wishes that she had never been born.
Suddenly, the aurora disappears, and the town's power briefly goes out before returning.
Winnie looks around in confusion, and after The Angel briefly chases her, she learns that the town's sheriff is now Henry's brother Buck, who claims he does not recognize her.
She is then left speechless upon being greeted by Henry, who is now the town mayor.

Winnie goes to see her family, who also do not recognize her, and she realizes she has been transported to an alternate reality in which she never existed, meaning that The Angel is still alive and has already killed several more people since the previous year, including Jimmy.
Upset, Winnie goes to Robbie's Christmas party and meets with Bernie, explaining her plight to her, despite her mild disbelief.

After narrowly avoiding being killed by The Angel, Bernie and Winnie deduce The Angel has been killing the children of property owners who Henry wanted to buy from, thus disheartening them into letting the properties go.

Winnie decides she needs her father's help to stop Henry and kill him again, and successfully convinces her aunt Gale of her situation by recounting an embarrassing personal detail only the family would know.
Winnie tries to convince her father that Henry killed Jimmy, but David refuses to listen to her and demands that she leave.
On her way out, Winnie witnesses the killer murdering her mother and a man she was having an affair with.
The Angel then tries to attack Winnie, Bernie, and Gale, but is knocked out.
Winnie unmasks the killer, shocked to find David behind the mask.
David regains consciousness and the trio escapes.
Winnie, Bernie, and Gale manage to kill David after luring him to the movie theater where Bernie works.
As Winnie and Bernie return to the bridge under the aurora lights, Bernie reveals that she was contemplating suicide and that Winnie saved her.
Winnie wishes that she was born after all, but to her frustration, nothing seems to happen.
She realizes that Henry still poses a danger to the town as mayor, and that he needs to die again before Winnie can return to her original timeline.
Winnie and Bernie come across a rally being hosted by Henry where all the attendees appear to be in a trance.
The two confront him and accuse him of the deaths of the past year.
Henry confirms that he killed Jimmy, and in doing so broke David's spirit and placed him under his control, making him his accomplice.
When Henry attacks Winnie, Bernie stabs him to death, breaking his control over the townspeople.
As the aurora reappears, Winnie and Bernie kiss.
Winnie wakes up in her bedroom on Christmas morning.
She cheerfully greets her family, and her parents apologize for not allowing her to process her trauma.

Winnie then rushes over to Bernie's house and tries to explain everything to her, but Bernie reveals she still has her memories of their time together in the alternate reality, and they kiss before agreeing to celebrate Christmas together.

13455517.title: Melodies of BroRealm
synopsis: Set in the picturesque town of Leafville, we're introduced to the exceptional Twig family, prominent for their extensive musical history.
Our main characters are Oak, the sympathetic yet musically challenged father, Birch, the oldest son with rigorous classical training, and the two younger members of the family, Willow and Baby Twig.
Willow cherishes the emotional resonance of folk music, while Baby Twig expresses a passionate affection for edgy rock and roll.
A humorous disagreement between the brothers regarding music preferences quickly escalates into a spontaneous decision to form their own band, excitingly named 'BroRealm'.
Initially hesitant, Oak finally succumbs to their excitement and decides to counsel them using his previous experiences as a band manager for the once-popular rock group - the Redwoods.
Act two unfolds with BroRealm attempting to merge their eclectic music styles, resulting in entertaining albeit somewhat discordant musical mishaps that lead to periodic arguments and disagreements.
The father, Oak, steps in with his paternal wisdom, encouraging the understanding of emotional consonance as vital for creating a harmonic synergy in music and maintaining their familial connections.
The plot further thickens with the unexpected appearance of Cypress, a former member of the Redwoods and Oak's current musical industry rival.
Cypress's relentless mockery and public humiliation of BroRealm’s debut performances serve as a source of discomfort for the novice band.
Their toughest challenge yet follows in the form of an invitation to perform at the celebrated Leafville's annual music festival, the venerable Leafy Jam.
With nerves escalating, the brothers find themselves preparing for their first public performance in front of an intimidating crowd of discerning music aficionados.
In an unfortunate twist, Cypress's band causes a distracting mishap during BroRealm’s performance, leading to a disastrous onstage fiasco and subsequent mockery from the unforgiving audience.
The harsh criticism leads to a sour fallout among the Twig brothers, causing them to question their individual abilities and the strength of their fraternal bond.
The once fiery dream of making it big seems to gradually diminish as their self-belief begins to falter.
Act four sees Baby Twig delivering a stirring monologue about the crucial importance of tenacity and brotherly unity in adversity, inspiring a newfound determination in his disheartened siblings.
Encouraged by Baby Twig's passionate speech, Oak unveils a dormant family secret - a captivating family melody that has been passed down through numerous generations.
Feeling invigorated and armed with their unique family tune, the daring BroRealm issues a challenge to Cypress's band for a make-or-break music showdown at the renowned GrandLeaf Theater.
News of the audacious challenge spreads like wildfire throughout the town, igniting widespread curiosity and anticipation for the impending musical face-off.
The fifth act opens in the showdown venue, the electrified atmosphere crackling with anticipation as over 3000 spectators anxiously await the impending performances.
BroRealm marches confidently onstage, their air of tension concealed behind their determined smiles.

As they begin their performance, the unforgettable sound of their harmonious family melody starts to pervade the air, creating a captivating spell that leaves a permanent mark on every audience member.
The raw emotion conveyed through their music connects with the audience on an intimate level, leaving them visibly touched and utterly spellbound.
Feeling the intense pressure to eclipse BroRealm's extraordinary musical impact, Cypress's band takes the stage, their faces carrying cocky grins.
However, their focus on flashy performance tactics rather than sincere music creation backfires as their performance fails to resonate with the discerning crowd.
As the final echoes from Cypress's band and their mediocre performance wane, the crowd erupts into spontaneous applause, their cheers resoundingly favoring BroRealm.
Act six celebrates the victorious Twig brothers, now recognized as Leafville's newest musical sensation.
The townsfolk rally around BroRealm, showering them with overwhelming admiration and becoming ardent supporters of their unique blend of music.
An emotionally stirring scene follows where the family congregates, reminiscing about their journey, marked by musical diversity, to finally becoming a successful cohesive band.
Drawing strength from their recent victory, the brothers pledge to remain united against any future obstacles, fortifying their musical alliance.

The narrative tantalizingly draws to a close with a scene of the Twig family packing their myriad musical instruments, hinting at their readiness to explore musical opportunities beyond their beloved Leafville.
With their hearts full of anticipation for the uncharted journey ahead, the family dreams of expanding their musical repertoire and reach beyond their small provincial community.
Elegantly panning out, the final shot carries the thrilling promise of countless exciting adventures awaiting the BroRealm in their musical journey.
Here the inspiring story of the courageous Twig family wraps up, leaving an indelible impression of familial unity, perseverance, and the transformative power of music on its audience.

As the Twig family begins to broaden their horizons beyond Leafville, their harmonious rhythm evolves into their distinct identity, waiting to be celebrated and, hopefully, recognized on a larger, global scale.
Accentuating the theme of perseverance, the narrative powerfully encapsulates the family's transformative journey from simple music enthusiasts to the creators of the now-famous BroRealm.
Their trials and ultimate victory echo the timeless wisdom of unity being the greatest strength.
The narrative also reaffirms the belief that when a family stands together, their collective spirit can conquer even the most formidable of hurdles.

The Twig family's narrative amalgamation of impassioned jam sessions, emotional roller-coasters, unexpected unity, and an uplifting victory delivers an array of poignant moments which contributes towards an engaging plot.

72673659.title: Trolls Band Together
synopsis: An infant Branch and his four older brothers John Dory, Spruce, Clay and Floyd perform as a boyband called BroZone.

When their clashing egos prevent them from performing the "Perfect Family Harmony", a powerful ability that Trolls can achieve when they are in complete sync, the brothers argue and break up the band.
Branch is left alone to be raised by his grandmother Rosiepuff.
In present day, about a month after preventing the Rockpocalypse, Branch and Poppy attend Bridget and Gristle's wedding in Bergen Town.
They are interrupted by John Dory, who reveals that Branch's closest brother Floyd has been captured by Velvet and Veneer, two Mount Rageon teenagers who wish to be pop stars.
The siblings have imprisoned Floyd in a diamond perfume bottle, which they use to extract his essence and improve their singing, although the process could eventually kill him.
As the Perfect Family Harmony is the only thing that can destroy diamond, Branch reluctantly agrees to help John Dory find their brothers and rescue Floyd.
Along with Poppy and Tiny Diamond, they set out in John Dory's armadillo-like portable van named Rhonda.
They find Spruce at the Vacay Island resort, where he has changed his name to Bruce and started a family.
Bruce is reluctant to help, until his wife and 13 kids convince him to do so.

The group later finds Clay at an abandoned Bergen miniature golf course, inhabited by a hidden colony of Pop Trolls who do not know that the Bergens are no longer their enemies, having been separated from the other Pop Trolls when they fled the final Trollstice.
The hidden troll colony's leader, Viva, reveals herself to be Poppy's long-lost sister.
At first, Poppy is delighted, but the visit turns sour when Viva refuses to believe the Bergens have changed, and tries to stop Poppy's group from leaving the golf course.
They manage to escape thanks to Clay, and Poppy and Viva separate with broken hearts.
Meanwhile, Velvet and Veneer continue to strip Floyd of his essence.
Velvet reveals that she forged Floyd's handwriting and sent a note to John Dory, in order to bait Floyd's brothers to come and rescue him.
Furthermore, Velvet and Veneer's assistant Crimp invents shoulder-pad suits that enhance the extraction, which the siblings plan to use when they capture all of BroZone.
The Trolls make it to Mount Rageous, but once again argue and fail to reach Perfect Family Harmony.

When his brothers decide they will split up again after saving Floyd, Branch scolds them for abandoning their family and still treating him like a baby, reminding them that he lived his whole life alone after their grandmother got eaten.
Branch, Poppy and Tiny locate Floyd on their own, but Velvet and Veneer capture John Dory, Clay, and Bruce, making a rescue even more difficult.
Branch and Poppy confront Velvet and Veneer when they start mingling with a crowd of fans, prompting them to drive away in their limo.
During the ensuing chase, Velvet and Veneer begin using the shoulder-pads to extract the essence from Branch’s brothers in order to put on a show.
Branch and Poppy are soon helped by Viva, who joined forces with Bridget and Gristle after they stumbled onto the golf course during their honeymoon.
Branch, Poppy and Viva were able to save three of the brothers, except Floyd.

Seeing that Floyd is just about out of essence, Branch tells his three brother's that they don't need to be perfect in order to be in harmony and they just have to be as they are together as a family.
Taking Branch's words to heart and accepted that he has grown up, John Dory, Clay and Bruce recoiled with both each other and their youngest brother, as they let Branch take the lead.
They, along with Poppy and Viva, perform the Perfect Family Harmony and break free of their prisons just as Floyd loses the last of his essence, but he is quickly revived through their family bond.
Veneer, who had been second-guessing Velvet's machinations, publicly confesses their crimes, simultaneously enraging his sister and sending themselves to prison.
The Trolls return to Vacay Island and witness BroZone's comeback concert, joined by Kismet, another band Branch was once part of.
Later, Poppy and Viva join BroZone, under Branch's proposal, as honorary members.

27925911.title: Celestial Warfare Chronicles: Knight's Duel
synopsis: We open on Jeffrey Knight, a seasoned martial artist actor, in a bustling Hollywood set for the filming of the high-stakes blockbuster, 'Fury Volcano’.
Despite possessing an impressive grasp on martial arts, specializing in Kung Fu and Jiu-Jitsu, Jeffrey usually finds himself performing as secondary characters in various action-oriented films.
During an otherwise typical day on the movie set, a call breaks his routine.
It is Sarah, his dynamic agent who presents an exciting opportunity: the lead role in the upcoming action flick, 'Mute Ninja'.
Seizing this chance to break away from typecasting, Jeffrey enthusiastically gives his affirmation.
He readily signs up for an intensive martial arts training program lasting several months.
Determined to hone his skills, he embarks on a worldwide search for a renowned Shaolin master.
His journey takes him deep into the heart of Shenzen's rugged mountains, a remote region famous for its elite martial artists.
Hidden within this austere landscape is a quaint dojo where the legendary Shaolin master resides.

Accepted as a student by the revered master, Jeffrey dedicates himself to a gruelling training regime, where he learns not only the intricate moves of Shaolin martial arts but also the spirituality and philosophy that birthed these ancient techniques.
His responsibilities extend beyond training.
He is entrusted with maintaining the archaic dojo.
Early one icy Shenzen morning, during his daily cleaning rituals, an old oakwood training dummy yields an unexpected discovery.
Jeffrey stumbles upon a well-concealed compartment within.
Nestled inside lies an ancient talisman, its surface etched deeply with enigmatic symbols of a forgotten era.
The instant Jeffrey’s fingers trace the talisman's mythical symbols, the earthly plane dissolves away, replaced by a surreal celestial sphere.
Here, ethereal warriors known as the Silent Samurai populate the scene.
As he navigates through this mystical domain, he discovers an unforeseen ability - he can communicate without uttering a word.
Thoughts are transferred telepathically, a new trait that mirrors his soon-to-be role of the Mute Ninja.
Suddenly, a divine being, emanating stellar radiance, materializes before Jeffrey.
The entity shares the rules of his celestial stay: he must compete in the Knight's Duel to return to Earth.
His task is simple but daunting - overcome eight celestial warriors in combat, each brandishing a unique set of skills and powers.
Fuelled by his desire to return to Earth, Jeffrey squares up against the divine warriors, unleashing a series of intense, nail-biting battles.
Each victory enriches him, granting new martial arts maneuvers unknown to his earthly world, which Jeffrey ingeniously integrates into subsequent fights.
As the duels advance, Jeffrey forms a deeper spiritual connection with the celestial realm.
Trapped between his role as an actor and the celestial warrior he's been becoming, Jeffrey is confronted with an existential conundrum.
As he struggles with this duality, his ultimate challenge manifests - a showdown with the formidable First Samurai, an imposing figure with a divine aura.
The task proves nearly insurmountable for Jeffrey.
His strength, both physical and spiritual, is being tested like never before.
At the brink of defeat, he remembers the teachings of his Shaolin master - the virtues of resilience and perseverance.
Drawing from this wisdom, he taps into a reserve of inner strength.
In a display of sheer fortitude and tactical brilliance, Jeffrey manages to land a knockout blow against the First Samurai, winning the final duel.
His victory opens a golden portal back to the earthly realm.
After due introspection, he decides to return to Earth.
He steps through the portal and appears back in the dojo.
Upon his return, he finds the premiere of 'Mute Ninja' drawing near.
Still clad in his warrior attire, he walks the red carpet.
The audience is awestruck by the authenticity and intensity of his performance.
With the fame comes a newfound wave of adulation and publicity.
Despite the glittering world of stardom, his heart aches for the tranquillity of the celestial fights.
The talisman, a reminder of his celestial adventure, is his only solace.
He finds himself reminiscing about his inter-dimensional experiences, contemplating if he could revisit the celestial realm.
As 'Mute Ninja' climbs the box office charts, the blockbuster success sprouts ideas about potential sequels and spin-offs.
Jeffrey ends his day reflecting on his future, with endless choices and potential paths laid out before him.
The contemplation leaves him swollen with anticipation and apprehension, but invigorated by the unknown.
He looks out at the setting sun, the talisman glimmering under its soft glow, as he prepares to face whatever lies ahead - in Hollywood or the celestial world.

73797663.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Cage Match
synopsis: Around Christmas in the 1980s, action star and martial artist Johnny Cage is attempting to make his big break with his next movie, Ninja Mime.
The film's producer, Brian Van Jones, expresses concerns over the disappearance of his costar, Jennifer Grey, prompting him to seek her out alongside his loyal assistant, Chuck Golden.
When he arrives at her mansion, Cage finds two women named Ashrah and Kia battling each other over a mysterious scroll.
He ends up getting caught in their fight, and the three escape before Jennifer's house explodes from a planted bomb.
As Ashrah and Kia continue their fight on the highway, Cage hijacks a tour bus to pursue them, which kills Kia after Ashrah ejects her from her car.
Cage manages to retrieve the scroll from Ashrah with Golden's help.
The two find that it is a star map of Los Angeles with Greek text on the back.
Meanwhile, Ashrah returns to the White Lotus Society to report to Lord Raiden, who encourages her to enlist Cage's help for the coming battles ahead.
On his way to report his and Golden's findings to the police, Cage is sidetracked by his agent, David Doubldy, who claims that  "The Big Man" wants to hire him for a superhero film.
However, when he visits his agent's office, Doubldy demands the scroll and reveals that a secret Hollywood club meeting at the Magical Mansion is interested in him.
The two fight, during which Cage discovers that Doubldy is actually a demon and kills him in self-defense.
With the police refusing to help, Cage and Golden decide to look into the mystery themselves and head to the Magical Mansion.
While Golden deciphers the scroll, Cage attends the party and is invited as a guest by one of the club's attendees named Jataaka, who takes him under the mansion to cut off communication with Golden.

Before Jataaka can take him further underground, the two are intercepted by Ashrah, who tells Cage that Jataaka and Kia were two of three assassins aligned with the Brotherhood of Shadows, a cult intent on summoning their god, Shinnok, to conquer Earthrealm.

Cage and Ashrah are able to defeat Jataaka with the help of Golden, who informs them that the Brotherhood intends to use the spell on the scroll and the "blood of a god" below the Oriental Theatre to open a gate to the Netherrealm.
Before they can destroy the scroll, they are attacked and captured by the third assassin, Jennifer.
Jennifer reveals to Cage that she is a demon named Sareena and was cut off from the Netherrealm before getting sent to Earthrealm decades ago.

Upon finding out that Cage possessed the blood of the gods needed to open a portal to her home, she and other demons helped set up his film career and Ninja Mime so that he could eventually be used as a sacrifice to summon her master, Shinnok.

Ashrah and Golden escape their captivity from the director, during which Golden finds out that Ashrah is a demon formerly affiliated with the Brotherhood now focused on repenting her sins and becoming human.
Ashrah and Golden manage to rescue Cage, but not before Sareena uses his blood to create the portal to the Netherrealm, bringing Shinnok to Earthrealm.
Golden suggests that they get Shinnok back through the rift and then cast the spell from the scroll to trap him back in the Netherrealm.
Cage fights Shinnok in the streets near the Oriental Theatre while Golden and Ashrah face off against Jones and Sareena, who unleash their true demonic forms.
Golden manages to knock Jones back into the portal before giving Ashrah back her sword that she uses to kill Sareena.
With his fans and onlookers cheering him on, Cage unleashes his mystical powers that allow him to fight on par with Shinnok and manages to knock the fallen Elder God back into the portal.
Golden casts the spell to close the portal, cutting off access for Shinnok and the other demons of the Netherrealm.
Cage is celebrated as a hero by the public and shares a kiss with Ashrah.
Golden attempts to follow in Cage's footsteps by taking martial arts classes but eventually ends up becoming his stunt double in video games and nicknames himself "Mokap."
Despite her strong feelings towards Cage, Ashrah leaves to continue her quest to slay demons and become human.
Cage becomes a successful action star thanks to the strong performance of Ninja Mime and its sequels, but his career eventually falls apart.
Cage is later seen packing his car and preparing to shoot his new film on a remote island.

5732231.title: Sarah Thompson: From Soldier to Assassin (2020 film)
synopsis: The movie commences deep in the chaos of Afghanistan, amidst a ferocious firefight.
We are instantly introduced to Sarah Thompson's indomitable spirit and unparalleled skills as a U.S. Army soldier.
Amidst dust, debris and gunfire, she moves with an agility born from fierce determination and rigorous training.
Sarah threads her way through a lethal gauntlet of bullets and explosions with calculated exactness, taking down one enemy after another with unwavering precision.
Her gunfire echoes ominously, each shot a testament to her capability and emboldening her adversaries' fear for this human war machine.
Coming to a halt, the scene changes drastically to an entirely different world – her post-war life in a cluttered, dimly lit apartment in Chicago.
Piles of forgotten memories and remnants of her past life lay scattered, painting a vivid contrast between civilian Sarah and her battlefield alter-ego.
Struggling with day-to-day activities, Sarah is tortured by her addiction to painkillers, a grim artefact from her challenging battlefield experience.
Every moment of her existence is a constant battle against the tempting oblivion of drugs and her desire for a regular life.
Severe flashbacks plague her, moments that vibrate with raw emotion as vivid images of wartime horror and the loss of her fellow soldiers invade her quietude.
It becomes crystal clear that her biggest adversary now is PTSD - a cruel reminder of her time in the Army.

These episodic flashbacks do not limit themselves to past nightmares but bleed into her present, convoluting her struggle towards normalcy, by flooding her real world with instances of her horrifying past.

When Sarah accidentally runs into Jack Dawson, an old fellow Army companion now a member of Blackhawk Solutions, a suspicious private security firm, life throws her an unexpected window of opportunity in her isolated existence.
Although instinctively reluctant, she quickly dismisses his offer, firmly sticking to her plan of navigating civilian life again, of piecing together the jigsaw of her shattered existence.
However, her desperate circumstances take a severe twist when she receives an eviction notice from legacy apartments.
The inevitability of a homeless existence forces her to reconsider Dawson’s earlier proposition.
The narrative then opens into extensive sequences of boot-camp-style training, as Sarah prepares to immerse herself into the private military corporation.
Adjusting uncomfortably in her unfamiliar role initially, Sarah soon starts to manage her tasks methodically, displaying a professional approach towards her assignments.
The film moves to the harsh terrains of Iraq, where covert missions unfold amid barren landscapes.

Sarah's first mission is a daunting show of Cold War-era weaponry against the stark barren setting, punctuated by gunfire and rapid manoeuvres; the task's success testifies to her remarkable transition back into military life.
But her successes do not come without costs; her fight against addiction often erupts at critical moments, threatening to destabilize her at precisely the times when she needs to stay focused.
This ongoing struggle deepens the tension and resolution of her character.
The narrative takes an unexpected turn as Sarah stumbles upon covert dealings within Blackhawk Solutions, raising questions about her role within the firm.
A growing undercurrent of skepticism starts churning within her.
A clandestine meeting that she manages to witness, reveals a conspiracy by her own department intending to stage a coup to topple a Middle Eastern government.
This realization sends shockwaves through her, shattering her understanding of the organization she is a part of.
Torn between her newfound loyalty to Blackhawk Solutions and her moral compass, Sarah starts questioning her own decisions, heralding a major crisis within her.
Eventually, choosing her sense of morality over loyalty to the firm, Sarah decides to thwart the plot irrespective of the potential risks.
A steely resolve shines through her character as she chalks out plans in this critical scenario.
In the midst of striving to execute her ambitious plans within the firm, Sarah's addiction problems and vivid war memories make her mission more treacherous.
An emotionally charged sequence depicts her struggling with PTSD amidst the mayhem, the narrative demonstrating raw emotion and elevated stakes.
Her inner turmoil bleeds into her external predicaments, complicating the mission at hand and scaling up the tension.
The climax culminates in a riveting spectacle of Sarah, drawing on all her tactical abilities to disrupt the planned coup and defend herself against the oncoming terror-stricken local populace.
Her rebellion within the organization causes ripples, raising alarm within Blackhawk Solutions, leading her into their crosshairs.
A nerve-racking chase sequence follows, as Sarah is pursued through the labyrinthine streets of Baghdad.
The struggle for survival against her former allies keeps the audience at the edge of their seats as Sarah uses her wits and training to stay a step ahead.
The final confrontation witnesses Sarah outmaneuvering both her pursuers from Blackhawk Solutions and the CIA officers.
In a cinematic twist of events, Sarah fakes her own death with an expertly orchestrated car explosion, slipping out of the grip of her relentless hunters who believe her to be dead.
Signifying her calculated exit, the flashing 'Mission Accomplished' on her apartment computer screen is the lonely remnant of the life Sarah leaves behind.
Having survived the hunt, Sarah vanishes into thin air, stealthily preparing for a nomadic life on the run from the world.
Post-credits, the tension is further amplified when an unforeseen shadowy figure is introduced, watching Sarah's every move from the confines of a high-tech surveillance room.
The emergence of this unknown adversary, painstakingly tracing Sarah's movements and activities, hints at the inception of future perils for Sarah.
Amid the eerie calmness of the surveillance room, the shadowy figure types away, tracking Sarah's every move.
The final frame hones in on the silhouette caught in the pale glow of observation monitors, preserving the identity of Sarah’s new enemy.
Living on borrowed time and freedom, yet Sarah remains indomitable, courageously facing her tormented past and fiercely confronting her inner demons.
Sarah's character continues to evolve throughout, as she refuses to be haunted by her past and propels herself into a future made more uncertain by her actions.

58419234.title: Ava (2020 film)
synopsis: Ava Faulkner is a recovering addict and former soldier turned assassin.
In France, she kidnaps her new target, an English businessman.
Before she kills him, she questions him on why someone wants him dead.
Unbeknownst to her, another woman electronically eavesdrops on the conversation.
Afterwards, Ava flies to Boston where she visits with her estranged sister Judy and her mother Bobbi who is hospitalized for angina pain.
Ava has not seen them in eight years.
Ava's handler and former Army superior, Duke, sends her to Saudi Arabia to kill a German general.
Ava lures the general into a trap and injects him with a poison to make it appear he died of a heart attack.
She is interrupted by the general's security guards.
A gunfight ensues, leaving all the men dead.
Ava escapes and travels to Barneville-Carteret where Duke apologizes for the botched operation, insisting that the bad intel was a simple mistake.
He gives her time off to decompress and she returns to Boston and meets Michael, her former fiancé who is now in a relationship with her sister Judy.
In British Columbia, Duke meets with his superior, Simon.
Simon's daughter Camille is the woman who had earlier eavesdropped on Ava's hit.
Simon believes Ava is a liability and that her questioning of targets demonstrates insufficient commitment to their operation.
After Duke leaves, Simon reaffirms the hit on Ava.
She kills her attacker and then confronts Duke who insists that it was a random drug addict attack.
That night, Ava goes to dinner with Judy and Michael but their conversation does not go well.
The next morning, Judy meets Ava and tells her Michael is missing.
Realizing he has started gambling again, Ava rescues him from a gambling den run by a woman, Toni, to whom Michael is indebted.
Duke revisits Simon and reveals he knew Ava was set up.
A fight ensues between the two men, resulting in Simon killing Duke.
He sends a video of Duke's death to Ava.
A heartbroken Ava goes to Judy's house, where she invites Michael to run away with her but he declines, revealing that Judy is pregnant.
Ava heads to Toni's den where she kills some of her men before giving Toni a bag of money to pay off Michael's debt.
Ava starts to strangle Toni, and is about to break her neck, but then changes her mind, letting her live while warning her to stay away from Michael.
Back at her hotel, Ava is attacked by Simon.
They fight, with both sustaining serious injuries.
Exhausted, Simon flees when the fire alarm goes off, warning Ava that he will kill her if he sees her again.
Ava pursues Simon, cornering and killing him under the Zakim Bridge.
Ava goes to her sister's house, warning Judy to leave the country and giving her the number to a Swiss bank account filled with Ava's earnings.
Before she leaves, Michael gives her a letter from Duke, who says that he is happy with how his life turned out.
As she walks down the street, Ava is stalked by Simon's daughter, Camille.

29401617.title: Quest for Survival: The Dawn Seekers (2022 film)
synopsis: Our film opens on the majestic panorama of the ancient land of Nowanus, a vast, desolate desert; so barren that life is little more than a struggle, yet resilient in its refusal to bow to the harsh elements.
The camera finds a family, a band of six hominids, living amongst this rugged land.
We are introduced to the eldest amongst them, a rugged individual named Tork.
The tribe has traditions, one of which we see during an elaborate ceremony under the clear night sky.
This vision details a grand journey, one leading towards the coy blush of the dawn’s horizon.
Encouraged by this great prophecy, the tribe sets forth, venturing from the familiarity of their home, placing their unwavering trust in their leader's revelation.
Their journey is a grueling one.
After days of relentless travel, their journey ends as they come upon a landscape that is as stunning as it is unexpected.
But their joy is short-lived as they notice something out of place upon this beautiful beachfront - an enormous, ancient fossil.
They aptly name it 'The Leviathan', the fossil of a sea creature so large and fearsome, they could only imagine it as a beast of cataclysmic proportions.
Their initial jubilation swiftly gives way to anxiety as they begin to fathom the complexities and potential dangers their new home presents.
Yet, they persist.
They may have arrived with uncertainty, but they resolve to make this unanticipated land of golden sand and limitless water their home.
They brace themselves for the unknown, armed only with their experience and instinct.
They acclimatize themselves to the coastal life, building sturdier shelters from driftwood, and making a collective effort to settle into this new land.
However, the peace is short-lived as they uncover the existence of another tribe living beyond their sight, beyond the horizon.
Soon, strange occurrences persistently plague the tribe.
These unsettling happenings slowly transform their serene beachfront life into a haunting riddle.
Confronted with these mysterious occurrences, Tork and the wise elders put their heads together.
With this revelation, the tribe is faced with two choices.
Flee and risk meeting another beast of unknown terror, or confront their fears and claim their future.
Tork, standing tall and resolute, suggests brokering peace with the unseen tribe.
He proposes that by facing this threat together, they have a better chance of surviving.
With survival as their common goal, the tribes put their differences aside and look towards a future of unity.
Together, they engineer an intricate strategy to confront the sea beast and reclaim their lives.
The day of the decisive battle arrives, and Tork leads the charge against the monstrous Leviathan.
Tork, drawing upon every ounce of his strength and courage, plunges his stone spear into the leviathan.
Their tribal chants shift to triumphant cheers as the formidable sea creature recoils, thrashing about in confusion and pain before sinking back into the sea's dark expanse.
The euphoria of victory is jarringly interrupted as the monstrous creature resurfaces, causing uproar and panic.
But the beast, shell-shocked by the attack, retreats into the deeper waters, shying away from the land.
It becomes evident that the Leviathan is more of a startled herbivore than a macabre predator.
It was a creature of survival, much like themselves.
The tribes, having gained a semblance of understanding of the Leviathan, decide to replace confrontation with coexistence.
They choose to live in harmony with the Leviathan, marking a significant step in their survival journey.
Both tribes accept and decide to inhabit the land together under the principle of mutual respect and unity.
Tork and the leader of the unseen tribe come to an understanding, agreeing to refrain from provoking the Leviathan and to live harmoniously in their newfound home.
The two tribes, initially rooted in basic survival needs, now transition into a life of collaboration and shared community responsibilities.
Amidst this newfound unity and peace, the sound of children's laughter and shouts of excitement fills the air, painting a lively tableau of everyday life along the serene coastline.
With the dawn of each day comes the humbling realization that their journey towards the rising sun was symbolic of their societal evolution.
Tork comprehends that his prophecy was about more than mere survival.
It was a pilgrimage towards unity, coexistence, and progression as a societal unit amidst trials, hardship, and fear.
The tribes have now evolved from a hardy survivalist lifestyle and graduated into a compassionate community, strengthening bonds and nurturing shared dreams.
They were now more than hunters.
They were lovers, friends, family.
These shared moments of joy, laughter, and camaraderie sculpted their society into a robust, unified tribe.
The sun rises from the horizon, its radiant dawn kissing their land with the promise of a new day.
The sun, which once guided their desperate search for a better home, now signifies the enduring unity and harmony achieved by this resolute tribe.
The tribes now understand that unity not only ensured survival but also paved the way for peace, prosperity, and societal progression.
Together, under the wide azure sky, they vow to live peacefully, fostering shared happiness and residing harmoniously amidst the picturesque landscape.
Their unity turns into a footprint for what was to be followed by the generations to come.
The tribes, once fractured by the struggle of survival, now present a united front.
They had not just survived but thrived amidst the trials, fear, and adversity.
The film concludes on an uplifted note, leaving the audience with a sunlit landscape resonating with laughter and celebratory dances.

73039129.title: Out of Darkness (2022 film)
synopsis: In the year 43,000, B.C., a starving, ragtag group of six prehistoric humans has reached the shores of a new world searching for food and a new place to live.
Adem is the leader of the group and has been joined by his pregnant mate, Ave, his younger brother, Geirr, and his 11-year-old son, Heron.
Also with them are Beyah, a young female 'stray' with a low ranking in the group, and Odal, an elder who was allowed to accompany the group because of his wisdom.
Heron asks Beyah for a story, but after her refusal, Odal relates how the boy's father has taken them on an adventure based on childhood stories in order to find a new life.
As they journey towards the mountains to find a new cave, the group is ambushed in the night by a mysterious creature, and Heron is abducted.
The group wait until morning to track the creature and the young boy, and are forced to follow Adem when he insists on pursuing the creature into the woods where the trail leads.
The group becomes lost in the forest, and as darkness falls, Adem hears mysterious noises in the wood and runs in pursuit while the others hold back.
Adem is attacked, and is brought back to the group's camp by Geirr with mortal wounds.
Geirr is unable to put Adem out of his misery, so Beyah steps forwards to end his suffering and then suggests the group cannibalize the body to avoid starving.
Geirr is unable to consume his brother’s flesh and buries it in the ground, but the others in the group partake.
Geirr, now assuming leadership of the group, attempts to lead the group through the woods and toward the mountain where he hopes that they will find a cave, but only manages to lead them in circles.
Odal, believing that they are being stalked by a demon, blames the catastrophe on Beyah and attempts to sacrifice her to it with Ave and Geirr, but she escapes, knocking out Geirr in the process.
Odal, in turn, offers a replacement sacrifice to the demon by stabbing Ave with a tree branch, but she breaks his ankle with her last breath.
During a night of aurora borealis, a crippled Odal watches as the creature takes Ave's body.
The following dawn, Beyah finds Geirr and they decide to go towards the mountain.
They then witness the creature killing Odal and ambush it, only to discover it is a female Neanderthal wearing a mask.
They trail her to the mountain and find a cave, where Beyah believes the Neanderthal has taken shelter.
As Beyah enters the cave, she is attacked by a male Neanderthal and nearly killed.
She feigns death, but then attacks and mortally wounds the man.
She continues into the cave where she discovers an unharmed Heron in a bed of furs, whereupon she is confronted by the Neanderthal female wielding a rock hammer.
In the meantime, Geirr, hearing Beyah's scream, tries to follow her and comes across where the male Neanderthal lays dying.
He finishes him off with his spear and continues through the cave to find Beyah, finally reaching her at the cave, whereupon the female Neanderthal attacks Geirr and kills him.
The female then threatens Beyah, who promptly sets the furs on fire and escapes with Heron through a small opening in the cave that serves as a chimney.
As the female Neanderthal attempts to escape through the hole, Heron tries to help her, but Beyah instead smashes her head in with a rock.
She tells Heron the Neanderthals are monsters who killed his father, while he says they abducted him in order to feed and protect him, knowing he would starve if he remained with the group.

The film ends with Beyah's story to Heron, detailing her regret of killing the Neanderthals, and remarking that they were just fearful human beings, as terrified of the unknown as Beyah and her group were.
Heron shows Beyah Ave’s body laid out in honor, covered in ritual paint and funeral clothing as prepared by the Neanderthals.
The two proceed to bury Ave, Geirr and the two Neanderthals.

Beyah, now claiming the Neanderthals’ cave as her and Heron's own, remarks that they will be the first of a new people, and that they will try again to survive with the lessons that they have learned.

32318667.title: Californian Struggles
synopsis: The story unveils the life of Jane Smith, a 36-year-old single mother residing in San Diego, California.
She is a strong-willed mother who has dedicated her existence to her daughter, Ava, a vivacious eight-year-old girl whose life is marred by epilepsy.
The narrative sensitively weaves the details of Jane's taxing daily routine.
Despite her work's exhaustive nature, Jane does not allow her tired body to overshadow her love for Ava.
At the school, Ava faces a lonely corner.
Her peers label her as the 'epileptic girl', openly excluding her from their gatherings.
The mother and daughter duo live in a small handmade house in a garage, which is a part of Jane's estranged brother Mike’s property.
Jane's life takes a dramatic turn as Ava's epileptic spells become more severe.

Determined to help her daughter, Jane dives into exploring every avenue concerning epilepsy, consulting several renowned neurologists and experimenting with varied treatment options to ensure Ava's wellbeing.
However, this hope dies down almost as quickly when she discovers the jaw-dropping price of the drug.
Jane's spirit shatters further when she realizes that this miraculous drug isn't covered under their current health insurance policy.
Driven by her motherly instincts, Jane dares to challenge her 550 credit score, attempting to secure a loan for Ava's treatment.
To her dismay, her poor credit rating slams the doors of every bank she approaches.
Meanwhile, Ava’s deteriorating health adds fuel to the fire of her schoolmates’ bullying.
Ava, in a bid to save her mother from more stress, decides to bear this insult in silence.
A chance overhearing of Ava relating a bullying incident to her friend over a phone call forces Jane to confront the school administration.
Amidst the whirlwind of her life, an unexpected opportunity presents itself.
A local singing competition, 'San Diego Sings' announces a cash prize of $50,000.
Jane decides to gamble on this competition.
She throws herself in to chase this opportunity, even at the risk of losing her evening job, driven by the zeal to better Ava's condition.
A few days into her decision, her commitment to the competition results in her losing her job at the laundromat.
The loss of income exacerbates her financial troubles, locking her and Ava in a deep pit of desolation.
Amid Jane's career struggle, Ava suffers a terrifyingly large seizure, worst than any they've experienced before.
This unfortunately well-timed incident fuels Jane's determination to win the competition for Ava.
A heated argument ensues between Mike and Jane after this incident - Mike advocates for practicality, insisting on a cheaper, affordable treatment for Ava.
Jane, however, is adamant about securing the new drug - a situation that strains their previously neutral relationship.
A fallout follows their argument, the disagreement driving a wedge between Jane and Mike.
Channeling her resolution and energy, Jane dives into rigorous vocal training, giving the upcoming singing competition her all.
Ava's suffering becomes her driving force.
Seeing her mother’s relentless efforts from the sidelines, Ava gathers the courage to confront her bullies in school.
The thought of not adding more problems for Jane empowers her resolve.
Witnessing Jane's ferocious efforts from afar, Mike is hit by a wave of guilt.
Baffled by his realizations, Mike steps up, offering to help with Ava's care responsibilities.

Together, they ensure Ava is well maintained and taken care of, freeing Jane from her constant worry about Ava’s wellbeing and enabling her to concentrate solely on her preparations for the competition.
The day of the 'San Diego Sings' competition arrives, with Jane's fate and Ava's future resting heavily on her performance.
Against various seasoned competitors, Jane sings her heart out on stage.
Her voice rings out with courage and raw prowess, charming the judges and ultimately winning her the competition.
The victory promises more than just solving Ava's medical needs.
Her voice earns her a full-time position as a music teacher at a local community center.
On immediately receiving the prize money, Jane procures the revolutionary 'Epilexir' for Ava.
The drug starts to work its magic, showing an immediate effect in controlling Ava’s seizures.
With an stabilised financial situation and Ava’s consistent health, Jane’s previously riddled life appears to fall into place.
Ava’s physical improvement leads to her social improvement.
The reduced seizure frequency allows her to form friendships and significantly improve her social health at school.
With a steady income flowing in and an effective treatment plan at hand for Ava, a new chapter of hope and happiness begins in their lives as they leave their nightmarish past behind.
Jane is seen indulging herself in her music teaching job, juggling between her work and efficiently managing Ava's medical needs with ease and satisfaction.
Mike, along with Jane and Ava, forms a perfectly integrated family unit, nurtured through shared struggles and successes, fostering unbreakable trust and love.
Their journey even spurred change in Ava's former tormentors, their transformation indicating the impact of empathy and kindness.

69503547.title: Pain Hustlers
synopsis: In 2011, Liza Drake is a struggling single mother living out of her sister's garage in Florida with her epileptic daughter Phoebe.
Working as an exotic dancer, she is offered a lucrative job by customer Pete Brenner.
An argument over money leads to Liza and Phoebe getting kicked out, so they move into a motel.
When her car is repossessed, Liza finds Pete at pharmaceutical company Zanna to accept the job.
She doesn't know the start-up is struggling, with difficulty breaking into the market and desperately scrambling for investors to fund a marketing push ahead of the planned IPO.
Pete rewrites Liza's dismal resume, giving her a degree in biochemistry.
She impresses the company founder, Doctor Jack Neel, who overrides their hiring freeze.
Pete gives her five days to convince a physician to prescribe their drug, Lonafen.
Liza goes through the entire list of prospects in under five days without any success.
Meanwhile, Phoebe experiences a seizure and they learn she has CAVM.
Thinking the job is over, Liza returns to Dr. Lydell's office, her first sales attempt, to collect some Tupperware and overhears a cancer patient discussing a commonly prescribed drug's side effects.
Liza argues that Lonafen would be a better option, so Lydell prescribes it.
She invites him to launch their speaker program by sharing his experience with the drug's efficacy.
The event fails and he nearly withdraws despite his patient praising the drug, but Liza gets the program on track.
When Pete offers financial incentives, Lydell prescribes Lonafen to all eligible patients.
Based on this success, they hire a team of sales reps and Zanna wins 86% of the regional market.
Larkin tries to expose Liza as a fraud for her doctored resume but Neel promotes her to National Sales Director and Pete to COO, who then fires Larkin.
The profitable company moves into larger offices where Neel's eccentricities manifest more clearly.
When CEO Eric Paley is found to be secretly recording an executive meeting, he is fired but cashes in big on his shares.
As growth flattens, Neel pressures the team to market Lonafen for all types of pain, not just cancer.
Liza disagrees with this, but Neel dismisses her.
He also instructs Liza to fire her mother Jackie as a rep, after he slept with her.
Liza approaches Lydell with her new marching orders and is disappointed when he readily agrees to go along.
Meanwhile, Phoebe experiences another seizure and requires expensive brain surgery.
Although Liza offers her stock options in Zanna as collateral for a loan, she is denied because of the pharma sector's volatility.

After Lydell is arrested in a DEA sting, a desperate Liza asks Neel for help paying for the surgery but he exhorts her to use Phoebe's situation as "fire" for inspiration, like he did when his wife was dying from cancer and he came up with Lonafen.
When a friend's husband dies from a Lonafen overdose and her condolences are rejected, Liza agrees to testify to the U.S. Attorney's office that's investigating Zanna.
She admits her involvement in Zanna's speaker and bribery programs.
Liza confirms who signed off on those programs: Eric Paley, Pete Brenner, and Jack Neel.
Asked to come up with hard proof linking Neel to the criminal activity, she explains that he has completely insulated himself from daily operations.
After Liza unsuccessfully attempts to procure a printout from Pete's jacket, he is arrested, though Neel offers to take care of his family while he's in prison.
Neel himself remains seemingly untouchable until Liza links him to Zanna's illegal activities via an old email exchange during his affair with her mother.
The investigation reveals that Lonafen is essentially fentanyl, which is why non-terminal patients became addicts and often overdosed.
Lydell, Paley, Brenner, and Neel all receive prison sentences.

After a heartfelt apology in court and the prosecution's recommendation that Liza not serve time in order not to discourage future whistleblowers, she is still sentenced to 15 months, as her greed cost lives.
After Liza's release, she partners with some of the previous Zanna reps to form the skin care company she and Jackie had envisioned years ago.

49515253.title: The Suburban Scheme
synopsis: Tom Harper, renowned as a capable engineer, has found his calling in merging his love for automobiles into a successful occupation.
Running a thriving car dealership, he shares this venture and life's numerous pleasures and difficulties with his remarkably driven wife, Sarah.
Their blissful existence unfolds against the pristine backdrop of Selton, a charmingly serene middle-class suburban neighborhood.

This tight-knit community, with its verdant greenery, white picket fences, and friendly faces, is home to their trio of sparkling-eyed children; Lily, whose beautifully nimble fingers vividly bring alive any piano composition, Samuel who dominates lacrosse fields, and Zac, their youngest, whose infectious smile can brighten even the gloomiest of days.
Everything seemed to follow a picturesque rhythm till one unusually warm Wednesday.
Tom noticed a large, luminously painted moving van blocking their once-tranquil street.
The van, plastered with cheerful imagery and parked in front of the Victorian style house next door, caused Tom a hint of anxiety.
Lo and behold, this anxiety magnified into a feeling of discomfort and dread once he discovered that the new occupants of the neighboring house were none other than his high school nemesis, Dan.
A former local football legend, Dan had always been known for his cocksure attitude and reputation for thriving in rivalries.
Every casual interaction with Dan since then seemed soaked with an underlying animosity.

Be it chance meetings at parental school functions or during the neighbor's backyard barbeque get-togethers, their conversations were invariably simmering with unsaid rivalry, hidden behind false smiles and forced laughter.
More disconcertingly, Tom comes to realize that Dan's return isn't merely a personal upset, but also a professional threat.
Dan, now a dealer specializing in coveted, high-end luxury vehicles, was not-hesitating to indirectly disparage and undermine Tom’s hard-earned business reputation.
This festering relationship with Dan didn't just perturb Tom.
It left him in a precarious spot when Dan began employing underhanded tactics, such as disseminating malicious rumors about Tom’s professional credibility, to sabotage his business.
Feeling progressively cornered by the unpleasant circumstances, Tom finally confided in Sarah during a quiet, reflective conversation over a peaceful evening embellished with their favorite coffee.
Sarah, erudite, and shrewd, proposed a strategical approach to counteract these swirling controversies.
She drew up a plan to host a grand neighborhood car show, a casual gathering yet a serious platform to showcase Tom's diverse and impressive array of vintage and modern vehicles.
Thrilled yet anxious, the couple decided to use the pride of Selton, the Faith Park, a shared open space in the heart of their community, as the venue for this ambitious event.
Parallelly, as the car show preparations brewed, Tom and Dan's petty antagonisms escalated during casual neighborhood gatherings.
Their constant one-upmanship, which began as minor, harmless jabbing, started taking on more worrying undertones.
Confronting and gradually overcoming this opposition had an overpoweringly positive effect on Tom.
It steeled his resolve and strengthened his courage to weather any adverse winds that Dan seemed determined to conjure and blow his way.
Finally, the much-awaited day of the car show dawned, albeit with ominous rain clouds roiling the sky.
To add to the mounting stress, their star attraction, a suave 1930 Ford Model A Roadster, was nonchalantly refusing to start.
Fearful for his professional image and credibility, Tom spent the morning under the temperamental car in a makeshift garage.
With the determination of a warrior, armed with tools as his weapons, he warred with the Roadster's obstinacy.
Amidst this electrifying chaos, baby Zac suddenly vanished.
A wave of panic washed over the Harpers as they frantically began looking for their youngest.
As it turns out, the little one was found cozily snuggled asleep inside the plush leather seats of a cherry-red 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air.
This discovery resulted in collective sighs of relief and subsequent laughter rippling through the family.
With all minor mishaps resolved, and the stubborn rain deciding to stay at bay, the Harpers finally kick-started their car show.
It turned into a fanfare of beautiful automobiles ranging from an imposing Rolls Royce Phantom to an agelessly charming Volkswagen Beetle.
Amidst all the glitz and gasps of awe, what stood out was Tom's impressive command over automobiles.
His expertise clearly overshadowed the petty, underhanded tactics that Dan had engaged in, affirming Tom's status as Selton's undisputed autophile.
The success story of the day was the unanticipated support and acceptance from the community.
This overwhelming display of solidarity promptly dismissed Dan's attempts at sabotage and heartened a now-relieved Tom.
This realization and reaffirmation of his credibility and position galvanized Tom's self-confidence.
It helped him understand that his authentic passion, practical knowledge, and deep domain understanding were invaluable competencies that set him apart in the industry.
In a surprising twist of the narrative, the once-ruthless Dan openly admitted his wrongdoings and praised Tom on his unparalleled collection, conceding defeat over his own luxury line-up.
His unexpectedly candid and humble admittance was the finishing touch to the success of the car show, bringing a sense of closure and redemption to the narrative.
As the days rolled into weeks, the neighborhood transformed as the bricks of antagonism fell apart.
It was replaced by a bloom of improved relations and a shared sense of harmony.
The metaphorical picket fences that had sprung up between the red brick houses and bespoke maple-lined streets of Selton had, at last, vanished.
Reflecting on the event, Tom recognized his triumph was not in trouncing Dan, but in the growing closeness within his family, and the strength of their relationship with their supportive neighbors.
The closing scene elegantly captures Selton at dusk, with twinkling fairy lights adorning the entire neighborhood, mirroring the canopy of glistening stars overhead.
The Harper family, stronger than ever, looked towards this future, filled with hope and excitement.
Their journey, undeniably difficult, had ultimately been one of collective growth and unity.

As fading laughter and lingering cheers accompanied a warm sense of fulfillment, the narrative underscored the fundamental values of unity, camaraderie, resilience, and the power to navigate and overcome adversities.
The realization that their resilience and community support far overshadowed any vendetta brought a new perspective to their lives.
It was a framework much stronger and more uplifting than what they had believed possible.
Thus, the warmly twinkling lights of Selton faded out, leaving behind an elegant tapestry of suburban life - whimsical, joyful, and infinitely stronger together.

71615827.title: The Family Plan
synopsis: Dan Morgan is a gifted car salesman living quietly in the Buffalo suburbs with his wife Jessica and their three kids, teens, Nina and Kyle, and infant child Max.
Dan is content with his low key life, and dislikes violence, technology and social media.
Meanwhile, Jessica yearns for more spontaneity and excitement.
Dan and Jessica attend the carnival for their anniversary.
He has a confrontation when someone purposely takes a selfie with them kissing in the background as a joke, then posts it on his social media.
Dan walks away, refusing to engage in a fight.
Soon after, Dan is attacked in a supermarket while shopping with Max, and easily defeats the highly trained attacker.
Afterwards, Dan, who is revealed to be an ex assassin, contacts his former associate Augie to find out why it happened.
He suggests it is Dan's former employer McCaffrey, and advises him to disappear.
Dan, realizing the carnival photo outed him, orders new passports for him and his family.
He retrieves his kids from school and Jessica from work, telling them they're taking a spontaneous road trip to Las Vegas, where he is meeting Augie to collect the new documents.
As they're leaving town, Dan realizes they're being followed and therefore their minivan must have a tracker on it.
At work he uses a service bay to find and remove it from the undercarriage.
Meanwhile, McCaffrey and his team search the Morgans' home but can't find their destination, as Dan has covered their tracks.
He drives through the night until reaching Iowa City.
Excited, Nina begs them to visit Southern Iowa University as she hopes to follow her boyfriend Trevor there, rather than pursue her original goal of attending Stanford.
She catches Trevor cheating on her, so Dan teaches her a martial arts moves to use on him.
During a campus tour, Dan notices a German man on his phone, and believes he works for McCaffrey, although he discovers he's mistaken when he's attacked by another of McCaffrey's henchmen.
Dan fights the henchman and incapacitates him in a chemistry lab before rejoining his family.
As they travel, the family grows closer.
Arriving in Vegas, Dan plans to tell Jessica the truth over a romantic dinner.
The teens are to babysit Max in their penthouse suite, but all go down to the HyperX gaming arena, as Kyle is a popular gamer.
When Dan and Jessica return to their suite to check on the kids, McCaffrey's team attacks them.
He quickly dispatches them, shocking Jessica.
Heading downstairs to retrieve the kids, a shootout ensues and his family witness him kill two more assassins.
Revealing his name to be Sean, Dan finally comes clean to his family, who are outraged.
He nevertheless gives them their new IDs, telling them that their lives in Buffalo are over, but Jessica takes the kids and leaves the next morning, believing they aren't in danger.
She calls her friend, Gwen, a travel agent who offers to fly them home.
On the private jet, Gwen reveals she works for McCaffrey and is Dan’s ex, who she is angry at for leaving.
Handing Jessica and the kids over to him, he takes them hostage.
McCaffrey, Dan’s father, threatens to kill them unless Dan accepts his offer to rejoin his team of assassins.
He relents, and Jessica and the kids are to return home.
Jessica and the kids escape after she kills their escort, and they go back for Dan.
McCaffrey calls his army into the hotel to recapture him.
Dan engages the mercenaries, with Kyle helping with a drone.
Jessica fights Gwen, culminating in Jessica impaling her with a piece of broken bamboo as a javelin, from her track and field experience.
They head downstairs where Nina distracts McCaffrey from killing Dan, giving him time to knock McCaffrey out, and he is taken into custody.

Some time later, the Morgans have returned to their lives in Buffalo; Dan now runs a security firm to train clients how to better defend against attacks while Jessica coaches high school track and field.
They then load up a rented RV to embark on a cross-country road trip to take Nina to Stanford.

45000726.title: Beyond My Shadows (film)
synopsis: Maria, a woman of gentle demeanor and silver locks adorning her head, resides in a charming Victorian dwelling nestled on the fringes of a minute, rustic town named Millbrook.
Local myths and tales echo the fascinating life she led before withdrawing into her solitude.
This quaint town soon sees the arrival of Jacob, a renowned author famed for his exhilarating suspense novels.
The surreptitious cloud surrounding Maria piques Jacob's curiosity.
Fueled by his creative instincts and a desire to understand Maria's world, he embarks on a journey to forge a bond of friendship with her.
With initial wariness, Maria is hesitant; years of isolation have made her defenses robust.
However, Jacob's genuine, respectful approach gradually erodes her seclusion until a foundation of friendship begins to lay itself.
The process unearths Maria's past slowly.
It's a life colored by passionate love and hardened by heart-wrenching loss, a testament to her resilience against the trials and tribulations she faced.
As the pieces of her intriguing past fall into place, their relationship transitions from acquaintance to a deeply rooted companionship, a bond forged in the ember of shared experiences.
Maria's past unveils itself through a series of flashbacks.
It details her life before adversity imprinted its mark, turning her existence into a melancholic solitaire.

An unexpected series of tragic events gradually shroud Maria's blissful life with sorrow: the sudden loss of her loved ones, followed by treacherous betrayal from those she trusted, insidiously frayed the edges of her joyous existence.

Nearing the climax of her narrative, the unfolding tale approaches a precarious point where Maria hesitates, the thought of revealing her innermost anguish and the burden of guilt she carries overwhelms her.
Recognizing the discomfort that grips Maria, Jacob reaffirms his intentions.
He assures her that his motives are free from judgment and scrutiny, instead they are rooted in understanding her.
He views this as a means to reinforce the already burgeoning bond of their unique friendship.
Encouraged by Jacob's reassurances and genuine concern, Maria transcends her inhibitions and mournful guilt.
She gathers the strength to share the most painful chapters of her past, the ones that left deep emotional scars.
Jacob faces the grim tales of Maria’s past, deeply moved, his heart swells with sadness and sorrow.
However, his reaction isn’t one of judgment or pity but understanding and empathy.
As they navigate through Maria’s past together, their shared experiences solidify the foundation of their compassion-tied bond.
Jacob's comforting words slowly ease Maria’s pain, providing the assurance that her past is just a single chapter of her life, not the entire narrative, and that she deserves happiness and peace.
His unwavering emotional support and understanding during this sensitive period consolidates their bond, watering the seedlings of hope slowly sprouting within Maria.
Maria, who has segregated herself from human contact and society, and remained trapped within the painful memories of her past, finds comfort and acceptance in Jacob's reassuring presence.
In Maria's brave struggle and resilience against colossal adversities, Jacob stumbles upon a moving tale that unravels itself, unfolding poignant chapters he never anticipated.
His mind teems with ideas, she becomes the muse leading him towards his upcoming novel.
Hours of shared stories and emotional exchanges over steaming mugs of coffee within the rustic charm of Maria’s home translate to ink-streaks across Jacob's once-blank pages.
The manuscript now bears the title "Beyond My Shadows".
The physical embodiment of their shared journey in the form of Jacob's novel strengthens their companionship.
Their bond evolves, the mutual understanding and acceptance transcending societal boundaries.
As the narrative reaches its climax, Maria's journey, from being a figure of sorrows to an inspiring survivor, brings the tale towards its resolution, revealing layers of hope, faith, and redemption.
The film concludes on a hopeful note.
Maria's gaze now reflects a newfound hope and radiates joy.
Her stifling solitude is replaced by the comforting presence of Jacob and their shared camaraderie.

As the curtain falls, a stirring message retained in the audience's hearts echoes: even the darkest past can find solace, understanding, and closure if embraced with empathy and an unwavering spirit of resolution.

69987604.title: Through My Window (film)
synopsis: Raquel starts narrating the story of her life.
In a classroom we see her refusing to read her assignment as even though she knows how to write a story, she isn’t brave enough to tell it.
She then says that her story doesn’t start in this classroom, it actually starts in her house.
Her house as she describes is a humble abode that, through ups and downs, ended up surrounded by an empire called the Hidalgo mansion.
The Hidalgos are her next door neighbors but their lifestyle is completely different from hers.
The Hidalgos own Alpha 3, one of the most influential companies in the country, whose headquarters is the most spectacular building in Barcelona.
Alpha 3 refers to the three heirs to the empire, the Hidalgo brothers, Artemis, Ares and Apolo.
Raquel has an unhealthy obsession with Ares but has never said a word to him.
She knows everything he does and likes to collect information about him.
Apolo thanks Raquel for letting them use her Wi-Fi as theirs is broken.
She is confused and finds out that Ares has hacked into her computer and cracked the Wi-Fi password.
The next day Raquel follows Ares into a secluded wooded area, where she confronts him about hacking into her computer.
In response, he writes the password on her hand and asks her why it is a code that says, ‘Ares, Greek God’.
They exchange words which leads to Raquel admitting that she likes him and wants him to fall for her.
At night she unplugs the Wi-Fi to assert that it's her, who is in control of it.
But Ares climbs up her window into her room and plugs it back in.
They share a steamy moment that leaves Raquel wanting for more.
The next day Ares invites her to a party where she seduces him but doesn’t let him get what he wants and exclaims that karma is a bitch.
Later, she buys a drink for Apolo who gets too drunk and doesn’t want to go back to his place.
She takes him to her place with the help of her friend, Daniela.
On the way to her place, Apolo accidentally breaks her phone.
Ares again climbs up her window and says that until their father goes to work, they can’t go back home.
Ares opens up to her about his grandfather’s death and how he too has allergies just like him.
Ares gifts Raquel a new phone but she isn’t very pleased with this gesture.
So she goes to his house to return the phone but things get too steamy and they end up having sex.
